source: translate Akkadian to English: TÚG u-la i-dí-na-ku-um
target: He did not give you a textile.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-tù-ra-ma 9 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR
target: He returned and 9 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 TÚG ša qá-tim i-tur₄-DINGIR il₅-qé
target: Itūr-ilī has received one textile of ordinary quality.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB šu-{d}EN.LÍL DUMU šu-ku-bi-im KIŠIB ṣí-lu-lu DUMU ú-ku
target: Seal of Šu-Illil son of Šu-Kūbum, seal of Ṣilūlu son of Uku.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-nu-mì i-dí-a-bu-um a-wa-sú iq-bi-ú
target: When Iddin-abum spoke his will,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a-na ša-lim-a-šùr i-dí-in
target: he gave 10 minas of silver to Šalim-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-ut-ma i-ṣí-ba-at KÙ-pì-a li-il₅-qé
target: He said: He may take it from the interest on my silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB a-lá-ḫi-im KIŠIB a-li-li KIŠIB a-bi₄-lá KIŠIB lá-qé-ep ša i-na ba-áb-tim ša a-šùr-be-el-ma-al-ki-im ša iš-ti DUMU a-tù-ri-a ù a-mur-a-šùr ḫi-na-a iṣ-bu-tù-ma a-na e-lá-ma ip-qí-du
target: Seal of Ali-ahum, seal of Ali-ilī, seal of Abila, seal of Lā-qēp, that what hinnāya had seized as part of an outstanding claim of Aššur-bēl-malkim from Atūriya's son and from Amur-Aššur and had entrusted to Elamma.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 ma-na 13.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am e-lá-ma a-na a-lá-ḫi-im ù a-li-li ip-qí-du
target: An amount of 2 minas 13.5 shekels of refined silver, which Elamma in turn had entrusted to Ali-ahum and Ali-ilī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR a-na a-lá-ḫi-im a-li-li ù ḫi-na-a a ba-re-šu-nu i-lá-ak
target: That this silver will become the joint property / responsibility of Ali-ahum, Ali-ilī and hinnāya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB ma-nu-ba-lúm-a-šur DUMU ṣí-lá-{d}IM KIŠIB šu-{d}EN.LÍL DUMU ma-nu-ki-a-šur KIŠIB MAN-a-šur DUMU a-ta-a
target: Seal of Mannum-balum-Aššur son of Ṣilli-Adad, seal of Šu-Illil son of Mannum-kī-Aššur, seal of Puzur-Aššur son of Ataya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.3333 ma-na 2 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR SIG₅ i-ṣé-er PUZUR₄-a-šur DUMU a-ta-a a-lá-ḫu-um i-šu
target: Puzur-Aššur son of Ataya owes 22 shekels of good silver to Ali-ahum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù ḫa-muš-tim ša ì-lí-dan ITU.KAM ša ke-na-tim li-mu-um e-na-sú-in a-na ITU 14 ḫa-am-ša-tim i-ša-qal
target: Reckoned from the week of Ilī-dan, month of Ša-kēnātim, in the eponymy of Enna-Suen, he will pay in 14 weeks.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma lá iš-qú-ul 1.5 GÍN.TA a-na 1 ma-na-im i-na ITU.1.KAM ṣí-ib-tám ú-ṣa-áb
target: If he has not paid in time, he will add interest at the rate 1.5 shekel per mina per month.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 pí-ri-kà-ni ù ší-it-ru-um ša a-ki-dí-e 0.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i li-bé-e ḫa-nu-ú
target: 2 pirikannus and an Akkadian undergarment, (and) 0.5 shekel silver owed by Hanu;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 pí-ri-kà-num 1 ša za-al-pá-a ni-ib-ra-ru-um a-zu-ú ù DINGIR-áš-ra-ni a-ṣé-er a-mur-IŠTAR ub-lu-ú
target: 1 pirikannu, 1 from Zalpe, a nibrāru, Azu and Ilī-ašrannī brought to Amur-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ma pí-ri-kà-ni-e a-ni-ú-tim a-na ta-ad-mì-iq-tim IŠTAR-lá-ma-sí ta-ta-dí-in
target: All these pirikannus Ištar-lamassī has given as free loans.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-um ša 10 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša PÚZUR-a-šur ù PÚZUR-{d}IŠKUR
target: A tablet about 10 minas of silver of Puzur-Assur and Puzur-Adad;

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-um ša 4 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša PÚZUR-a-šur
target: a tablet about 4 minas of silver of Puzur-Assur;

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-um ša 10 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša a-sà-nim
target: a tablet about 10 minas of silver of Asanum;

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-um ša 10 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša al-pì-lí
target: a tablet about 10 minas of silver of Alpili;

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-um ša 10 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša a-sà-nim ú PÚZUR-a-šur
target: a tablet about 10 minas of silver of Asanum and Puzur-Istar;

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-um ša 5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša a-šùr-ṣú-lu-li
target: a tablet about 5 minas of silver of Assur-sululi;

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-um ša 17 ma-na 15 GÌN ša e-na-na-tim
target: a tablet about 17 minas and 15 shekels of silver of Ennanatum;

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-um ša ḫu-bu-ul a-bi-ni i-na ku-bu-ur-na-at al-qé-šu
target: a tablet about a debt of our father, I obtained it in Kuburnat.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 9 GÍN AN.NA e-lu-ḫu-ut
target: 9 shekels of tin: Eluhut;

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-ku-tum-ma a-na IŠTAR-lá-ma-sí ù ni-ta-aḫ-šu-šar qí-bi₄-ma mì-šu ša ta-áš-pu-ra-ni-ni um-ma a-tí-na-ma É-tum a-na lá be-tim i-tù-ar
target: From Šukkutum to Ištar-lamassī and Nitahšušar: Why is that you (fem. plur.) have written me, saying: The house is no longer a house.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-pu-tum a-na en-um-a-šùr i-<gap>-ni-ma e ší-na ga <gap> ša lá ta-ḫa-dì-ri
target: Urgent, to Ennam-Aššur <gap> Do not fear!

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na IŠTAR-lá-ma-sí qí-bi₄-ma šu-ma a-ḫa-tí a-ta li-ba-am dì-ni-ší-im lá ta-ḫa-da-ar
target: To Ištar-lamassī: If you are truly my sister, then encourage her. Do not fear.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ni-ta-aḫ-šu-šar qí-bi₄-ma TÚG-pì-ri-kà-ni ša e-zi-bu na-pí-ší-šu-nu ù ṭup-pu-ú lu ša-ṣú-ru
target: To Nitahšušar: Air the -textiles that I left. Also, the tablets should be guarded.

source: translate Akkadian to English: pì-ri-kà-nu ša ma-tí ù tí-bu-lá ma-a-<gap> iš-ta-ú-mu-ni a-dí en-um-a-šùr i-lá-kà-ni a ma-ma-an lá tù-šé-ri
target: The which Mati? and Tibula <gap> have bought do not release (them) to anyone before Ennam-Aššur arrives.

source: translate Akkadian to English: <gap> GÍN KÙ.BABBAR {d}UTU-tap-pá-i ub-lá-ki-im 1 GÍN KÙ.GI ù <gap> GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i-ku-pì-a ub-lá-ki-im
target: Šamaš-tappā'ī brought you <gap> shekels of silver. Ikūn-pīya brought you 1 shekel of gold and <gap> shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 17 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ší-im e-ma-ri-im
target: 17 shekels of silver, the price of a donkey,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 30 ma-na URUDU IŠTAR-pí-lá-aḫ
target: 30 minas of copper of Istar-pilah,

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ar-be-e-šu <gap> ù-kà-pu-ú ša-pì-ú-tim
target: 4 sets of thick saddlecloths,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 9 ma-na URUDU SIG₅ i ší-im sú-ub-ri-im
target: 9 minas of refined copper from the price of a slave,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na URUDU ší-kam iš-tí DUMU IŠTAR-ba-ni
target: 1 mina of sikku-copper with the son of Istar-bani,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 kà-ar-pát kà-mu-nu
target: 2 jars of cumin —

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ma a-nim i-na du-ur-ḫu-mì-it i-ba-ší
target: all this is available in Durhumit.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 GÚ SÍG.ḪI.A
target: 1 talent of wool,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 ma-na Ì.GIŠ
target: 10 minas of olive oil,

source: translate Akkadian to English: sà-ar-dam sà-áp-tí-nam ni-ib-ra-ra-am
target: a saptinnu- and a nibraru-textile,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 ší-it-re-e ša za-al-pá
target: 2 scarfs from Zalpa,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 e-ma-re ú ù-nu-sú-nu
target: 2 donkeys with their harness —

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ma a-nim a-na a-šùr-i-mì-tí a-dí-in
target: all this I gave to Assur-imitti.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma i-tur₄-DINGIR-ma a-na en-um-a-šur ù a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi-ma
target: From Itūr-ilī to Ennam-Aššur and Ali-ahum:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-pu-tum a-pu-tum ra-ma-ku-nu za-ki-a-ma
target: Urgent, urgent, clear yourselves

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ma URUDU a-na bu-ru-uš-ḫa-dim lá tù-šé-ba-lá
target: and do not send any copper to Burušhaddum!

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-tum-ma a-ba-tí-iq
target: Sell even the slave-girls for any price,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú ú-tù-ur dí-na-ma KÙ.BABBAR le-qé-a-ma tí-ib-a-ni-ma a-tal-kà-nim
target: take the silver and set out and come!

source: translate Akkadian to English: a ma-lá i pá-ni-tim a-na be-el KÙ.BABBAR ú-sá-li-ú-ma lá im-gu₅-ru-ni-ni
target: As I previously pleaded with the financiers and they did not agree

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú-ma-am im-ta-ag-ru-ni
target: - today they have agreed!

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na É šál-ma-a-šùr a-na a-wa-tim né-ru-ub-ma um-ma šál-ma-a-šùr-ma i-a-tí a-na bu-ru-uš-ḫa-dim i-na ma-ak-sú-e-im a-na ḫu-bu-ul ÌR a-bu-ša-lim ša-qá-lim i-ra-de₈-ú-ni a-ta 30 TÚG ku-ta-ni ù ANŠE ṣa-lá-ma-am ša ÌR ta-lá-qé-e
target: We entered Šalim-Aššur's house to settle the case, and Šalim-Aššur said: While they are going to lead me personally to Burušhaddum in fetters to pay the debt of the slave Abu-šalim, will you on the other hand take 30 -textiles and a black donkey from the slave?

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-be-lúm-ma ke-na ša ÌR-dí-a a-bu-ša-lim al-qé
target: Šu-Bēlum answered: "Yes, I have taken what belongs to my slave Abu-šalim."

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša-lim-a-šur ša ni-iš a-lim{ki} úz-na-tí-ni il₅-pu-ut um-ma ša-lim-a-šur-ma a-šar ÌR a-na ÌR-dí-kà lá i-tù-ru-ú ma-a a-na ÌR-dí-a i-tù-wa-ar
target: Šalim-Aššur impressed on us what had been sworn by the City, and Šalim-Aššur said: "In case the slave does not raise claim against your slave, then, will he raise claims against my slave?"

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-be-lúm-ma šu-ma a-na ku-a-im i-tù-a-ar a-na TÚG.ḪI.A ù ANŠE.ḪI.A a-za-za-kum
target: Šu-Bēlum answered: "If he raises claim against yours, then I guarantee for the textiles and the donkey for you."

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um kà-ni-iš i-dí-ni-a-tí-ma IGI GÍR ša a-šùr ší-bu-tí-ni ni-dí-in
target: The Kanesh colony gave us for these proceedings, and we gave our testimony before Aššur's dagger.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI ú-ra-a IGI ì-lí-dan IGI ma-ni-um-ba-lúm-a-šùr
target: Witnessed by Uraya, by Ilī-dan, by Mannum-balum-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 23.5 GÚ SÍG.ḪI.A 66 maš-ku 10 ANŠE ṣa-lá-mu ú ú-nu-sú-nu 25 TÚG.ḪI.A mì-ma a-nim i ša-ni-tim šé-pí-šu-nu
target: 23.5 talents of wool, 66 fleeces, 10 black donkeys plus their harness, 25 textiles - all this in their second transport.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša-lim-ar-dí ú šu-nu-nu áp-qí-id
target: I entrusted to Šalim-wardī and Šu-Nūnu.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-šùr-i-dí DUMU mu-mu-lá-nim IGI a-šur-ta-ak-lá-ku DUMU i-ku-nim DUMU sá-ma-a
target: Witnessed by Aššur-idī son of Mu-mulānum, by Aššur-taklāku son of Ikūnum son of Samaya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: kà-ru-um dí-nam i-dí-in-ma
target: The colony has passed a verdict stating that Šalim-Aššur must mention to the sons of Iddin-abum his tablets for his witnesses to how much silver - all the silver - he has paid to cover Iddin-abum's debt.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠU.NÍGIN KÙ.BABBAR a-na me-er-e i-dí-a-bi-im i-qá-bi um-ma šu-ut-ma KÙ.BABBAR a-nim a-ḫa-a ú-ša-qí-il₅
target: He is to say: This silver I paid in different places.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-ta-mu-zi e-lá-a en-um-a-šùr ù lá-ma-sí-ma a-na en-um-a-šùr ù a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi₄-ma
target: From Šu-Tammuzī, Elaya, Ennam-Aššur and Lamassī to Ennam-Aššur and Ali-ahum:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-la na-áš-pé-er-tí-ku-nu ra-bi-ṣa-am ni-ḫu-za-ku-nu-tí
target: In accordance with your missive we have hired a attorney for you;

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-bi-a DUMU be-e-be ra-bi₄-iṣ-ni
target: Abiya son of Bebe is our attorney.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na ša-am-ší ša ra-bi-ṣú-um e-ra-ba-ni iḫ-da-ma i-zi-za-ma
target: Take care to stand by the very day the attorney arrives,

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu DAM.GÀR a-bi-ku-nu lu ša a-wa-tám tí-šu-a-ni ra-bi-ṣú-um i-na ša-ḫa-tí-ku-nu li-zi-iz-ma
target: and have the attorney assist you both with regard to the customers of your father and those with whom you have an argument,

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na KÙ.BABBAR pá-ni-ma a-šar ta-ma-ḫa-ra-ni KÙ.BABBAR ša É a-lim{ki} šu-ta-aṣ-bi-ta-ma
target: and of the first silver, wherever you receive it, collect the silver of the City Hall,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ma-lá a-bu-ku-nu ḫa-bu-lu KÙ.BABBAR ku-un-kà-ma šé-bi-lá-nim
target: as much as your father owes, seal the silver and send it;

source: translate Akkadian to English: ra-bi₄-ṣú-um iš-tí-ku-nu li-ik-nu-uk-ma KÙ.BABBAR šé-bi-lá-nim-ma li-ma-am lu nu-ša-bi
target: the attorney should seal it together with you, and then send the silver so we can satisfy the eponym.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṣí-ba-at ṣí-ib-tim lá i-ma-i-da-ku-nu-tí-ma li-ba-ku-nu e im-ra-aṣ
target: The compound interest should not grow too big for you and make you unhappy.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ma-lá e-ṭá-ar É a-bi₄-ku-nu ep-ša
target: Act so as to save your father's house.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma ta-da-ga-lá-ma ṭup-pu ḫa-ru-mu-tum ú ba-ba-a-tum ru-qá-tum i-ba-ší-ú ṭup-pí ku-un-kà-ma a-na DUMU um-me-a-nim ke-nim ša ki-ma ku-nu-tí pí-iq-da-ma
target: If you observe that there are certified deeds and credits outstanding on long terms, then seal the tablets, entrust them to a trustworthy affiliated trader, like yourselves,

source: translate Akkadian to English: u₄-me-e-ku-nu ba-lu-um mì-ma-ma lá tù-ri-qá-ma lá ta-sà-ḫu-ra iš-tí ra
target: and do not extend your terms without special reasons, do not delay but set out and come together with the attorney.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-lá-ḫi-im ú a-šur-ma-lik qí-bi₄-ma um-ma i-dí-a-bu-um-ma áš-pu-ra-ku-nu-tí iš-tí be-lúm-ba-ni um-ma a-na-ku-ma a-šur-be-el-SA.TU DUMU a-lá-ḫi-im KÙ.BABBAR a-na a-lim{ki} a-na ší-a-ma-tim i-dí-nam
target: To Ali-ahum and Aššur-malik from Iddin-abum: I wrote to you with Bēlum-bāni, saying: Aššur-bēl-šadu'e son of Ali-ahum gave me silver for purchases in the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ma-lá ta-le-e-a-ni a-wa-tám bu-ut-qá-ma ú tí-ir-ta-ak-nu li-li-kam-ma KÙ.BABBAR ú-šé-bi₄-lá-ku-nu-tí-ma šu-uq-lá-šu-um
target: Settle the affair as well as you can and then send me word so I can send you silver and you can pay him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫu-ú-a a-tù-nu lu a-wa-tum ba-at-qá-at a-ni-tum lá a-ni-tum tí-ir-ta-ak-nu li-li-kam-ma uz-ni pè-té-a
target: My dear brothers, send me word and inform me one way or the other whether the affair has been settled.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫu-ú-a a-tù-nu iḫ-da
target: My dear brothers, take care.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB a-šur-i-mì-tí DUMU a-mur-lu-ṣú KIŠIB a-bu-ša-lim DUMU a-šùr-e-mu-qí
target: Seal of Aššur-imittī son of Amur-luṣu, seal of Abu-šalim son of Aššur-emūqī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim ša ili₅-ba-ni DUMU a-mur-a-šur ù a-ḫu-qar DUMU šu-IŠTAR GÍR ša a-šùr iṣ-bu-tù-ni-ma
target: For these proceedings concerning Ilī-bāni son of Amur-Aššur and Ahu-waqar son of Šu-Ištar - they seized Aššur's dagger.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-šùr-i-mì-tí DUMU a-mur-lu-ṣú ù a-bu-ša-lim DUMU a-šùr-e-mu-qí pí-šu-nu iš-me-ú-ni
target: Aššur-imittī son of Amur-luṣu and Abu-šalim son of Aššur-emūqī heard their statement.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ša-lim-a-šùr qí-bi-ma um-ma i-dí-a-bu-um i-tur₄-DINGIR i-na-aḫ-DINGIR en-um-a-šùr ù a-la-ḫu-um-ma ta-áš-pu-ra-am um-ma a-ta-ma
target: To Šalim-Aššur from Iddin-abum, Itūr-ilī, Inah-ilī, Ennam-Aššur and Ali-ahum: You have written us, saying:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 ku-sí-a-tim 2 TÚG bu-ra-e a-na 27.8333 ma-na 2 GÍN AN.NA <gap>-nim ta-la-qé
target: 4 robes, 2 -textiles you will receive for 27.8333 minas 2 shekels of tin.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 50 TÚG a-na <gap> 7 TÚG ni-is-ḫa-tum
target: 50 textiles for 7 textiles, the import duty.

source: translate Akkadian to English: TÚG ša li-we-tim
target: textiles for the wrapping.

source: translate Akkadian to English: kur-ub-IŠTAR 5 <gap> ku-nu-ki <gap> ku-ta-nu i-na É <gap>-kà i-ba-ší-ú
target: Kurub-Ištar sealed in the house are available.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na <gap> ša a-na a-la-ḫi-im ta-dí-nu <gap> ANŠE i-n
target: that you gave to Ali-ahum, donkeys died during the journey.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-ku-pí-a ù en-um-a-šur iṣ-bu-tù-ni-a-tí-ma
target: Ikūn-pīya and Ennam-Aššur seized us,

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma i-ku-pì-a-ma a-na en-um-a-šur-ma 5 GÚ URUDU ma-sí-am ša-bu-ra-am ḫu-ub-lam-ma PUZUR₄-{d}UTU li-pu-ul-kà
target: and Ikūn-pīya said to Ennam-Aššur: Lend me 5 talents of washed, broken copper, and have Puzur-Šamaš reimburse you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 GÚ URUDU ma-sí-am ša-bu-ra-am en-um-a-šur a-na i-ku-pí-a iḫ-bu-ul-ma PUZUR₄-{d}UTU en-um-a-šur e-pu-ul
target: Ennam-Aššur lent 5 talents of washed, broken copper to Ikūn-pīya and Puzur-Šamaš should reimburse Ennam-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma PUZUR₄-{d}UTU-ma a-na 15 u₄-me-e 5 GÚ URUDU-a-kà a-na-ku a-ša-qá-lá-ku-um
target: Puzur-Šamaš said: "Within 15 days I shall personally pay you your 5 talents of copper."

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma en-um-a-šur-ma šu-ma-ba i-na 15 u₄-me-e u₄-mu-ú mì-ma e-ta-at-qú
target: Ennam-Aššur answered: "What then if indeed on the 15th day your terms become exceeded at all?"

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma i-ku-pí-a-ma 5 GÚ URUDU-a-kà ma-sí-am ša-bu-ra-am PUZUR₄-{d}UTU li-iš-qú-lá-kum a-na ṣí-ib-tim ma-lá u₄-mu e-tí-qú-ni-ni i-a-tí URUDU a-nim a-na 4 u₄-me DINGIR i-ša-ḫi-iṭ-ma ḫa-muš-tum ša {d}IM-ṣú-lu-li <gap> ITU.KAM ku-zal-li li-mu-um ṣí-lu-lu
target: Ikūn-pīya answered: "Let Puzur-Šamaš pay you your 5 talents of washed, broken copper. As for the interest, as much as the term is exceeded this copper is my obligation." In 4 days the god will rise and it is the week of Adad-ṣulūlī <gap> month Kuzallu, eponymy Ṣilūlu.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma i-ku-pí-a-ma a-na en-um-a-šur-ma i-nu-mì a-na pu-ru-uš-ḫa-dim té-ra-ba-ni ù a-ta ša KÙ.BABBAR 1 ma-na ù 2 ma-na a-na-aḫ-ta-kà ta-lá-qé-ma ù a-na-ku lá-ag-mì-il₅-kà
target: Ikūn-pīya continued saying to Ennam-Aššur: "When you arrive at Purušhaddum, then you will personally receive your earnings from 1 or 2 minas of silver, and thus I shall do you a favour myself."

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um wa-aḫ-šu-ša-na i-dí-ni-a-tí-ma IGI GÍR ša a-šu
target: The Wahšušana colony gave us for these proceedings and we gave our testimony before Aššur's dagger.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 13 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am en-um-a-šùr DUMU sú-in-na-da il₅-qé-ú
target: Ennam-Aššur son of Suen-nādā has received 13 minas of refined silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5.3333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am sú-in-na-da me-ra-šu il₅-qé-ú
target: Suen-nādā his son has received 5.3333 minas of refined silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na ší-im <gap> IGI a-šùr-i-mì-tí IGI iš-me-DINGIR IGI bi-<gap> DUMU ḫa-na-ni-a IGI DINGIR.SIPA DUMU ša-ak-ṣí-im
target: Witnessed by Aššur-imittī, by Išme-ilum, by Bi<gap> son of hannāniya, by Ilī-rē'ī son of Šakṣum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i-ṣé-er <gap>-a-šur DAM.GÀR i-šu
target: 4 shekels of silver <gap>-Aššur owes to the creditor.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ITU.KAM a-lá-na-tim a-na ITU.KAM i-ša-qal
target: Contracted in month XII. He will pay within a month.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma lá iš-qúl 0.3333 GÍN.TA i-na ITU.KAM ú-ṣa-áb
target: If he does not pay he will add as interest 0.3333 shekel per month.

source: translate Akkadian to English: li-mu-um a-šùr-na-da ḫa-mu-uš-tum ša qá-té kà-ar-wa-a
target: Year eponymy of Aššur-nādā, week eponymy of the successor of Karwaya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ki-dí-e ku-nu-ki-a 1 ANŠE ṣa-lá-ma-am ša-lim-be-lí ú a-šur-pí-lá-aḫ na-áš-ú-ni-ku-nu-tí
target: Akkadian textiles under my seal, 1 black donkey, this Šalim-bēlī and Aššur-pilah bring to you (plural).

source: translate Akkadian to English: 15 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ší-im ANŠE a-ḫa-ma 6 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ku-ta-nam a-dí-šu-nu-tí
target: I gave them 15 shekels of silver, the price of a donkey; further, 6 shekels of silver (and) a .

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR 0.3333 ma-na 1 GÍN pá-zu-ur-tí-šu-nu ša-bu-ú
target: They have been paid in silver 0.3333 mina 1 shekel for their smuggling.

source: translate Akkadian to English: TÚG ku-nu-ki-a li-im-nu-ú-ni-ku-nu-tí-ma ú TÚG ša É a-lá-ḫi-im e-zi-bu-ni a-na ú-ku pí-iq-da-ma a-na dur₄-ḫu-mì-it a-na ṣé-ri-a lu-ub-lam
target: Let them count the textiles under my seal for you, and then entrust the textiles that I left in Ali-ahum's house to Uku and have him bring them to me in Durhumit.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 ma-na AN.NA ku-nu-ki-a ú-ku na-áš-a-ku-nu-tí
target: Uku brings you 4 minas of tin under my seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-kam šu-ma ANŠE i-ḫa-ša-aḫ ANŠE ša-ma-šu-um ú sá-ḫi-ir-tám ša-ma-šu-um
target: If he wants a donkey there, buy him a donkey. Also, buy him small goods.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ANŠE ṣa-lá-ma-UM ú ú-nu-ut ANŠE a-ší-ni sú ú ší-na pa-li-li ša ša-lim-be-lí ú a-šur-pí-lá-aḫ i-ra-dí-ú-ni-ku-nu-tí-ni a-na ú-ku dí-na-ma TÚG li-is-ri-dam
target: Give Uku a black donkey plus the donkey's harness plus 2 that Šalim-bēlī and Aššur-pliah lead to you and have him pack the textiles.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma bu-bu-ra-num-ma a-na a-bi₄-a ù a-šùr-DU₁₀ qí-bi-ma
target: From Buburānum to Abiya and Aššur-ṭāb; specifically to Aššur-ṭāb:

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù na-ar-ma-ak-a-šur ba-dí-a a-ma-kam wa-ša-áb-ma ù a-ta ta-áš-ta-pu
target: Badiya has lived there since the month Narmak-Aššur, and you just kept silent.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma a-ḫu-a a-tù-nu iš-tí a-li-ki-im pá-nim-ma pì-iq-da-ni-šu-ma a-na a-lim{ki} li-li-kam-ma da-a-sú a-ša-qal
target: If you are truly my brothers, then hand him over to the very first caravan and let him come to the City, and I shall pay his fees.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma a-lá-kam lá i-mu-a a-pu-tum lá i-ṣa-li-ku-nu kà-sí-a-šu-ma šé-ri-a-ni-šu
target: If he refuses to come, then it is important that he does not cheat you. Bind him and have him brought.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB a-lá-ḫi-im ù KIŠIB i-dí-a-bi₄-im
target: seal of Ali-ahum and seal of Iddin-abum

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi₄-ma um-ma PUZUR₄-a-šur-ma
target: To Ali-ahum from Puzur-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ku-nu-ki-a en-na-num DUMU ku-zi-a ub-lá-ku-um
target: 0.5 mina of silver under my seal Ennānum son of Kuziya brought to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫi a-ta na-áš-pè-ra-tim ša a-lim{ki} ša en-na-num ub-lá-ku-ni i-ḫi-id-ma
target: My dear brother, pay attention to the missives from the City that Ennānum brought to you,

source: translate Akkadian to English: a ba-tí-qí-im pá-ni-im-ma dí-in-ma lu-ub-lu iš-tí wa-ṣí-im pá-ni-im-ma lu-ṣí-am
target: and give it (an answer?) to the very first express transport so they may bring it. He should leave with the first travellers to depart.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na en-nam-a-šur qí-bi-ma um-ma ša-ta-na-ma
target: To Ennam-Aššur from Šāt-Anna:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 ma-na 12.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša a-dí-na-ku-ni a-ḫi a-ta be-lí a-ta ší-ma-am e-pu-uš-ma iš-tí a-li-ki-im pá-ni-im-ma šé-bi-lam
target: As to the 2 minas 12.5 shekels of silver that I gave you, my dear brother, my dear lord, carry out the purchase yourself and send it with the very first transport.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lá ša ku-lu ša aq-bi₄-a-ku-ni lu TÚG-ba-tí lu AN.NA ša-dí-šu-ma šé-bi₄-lam
target: which I promised you, have him sell the textiles and the tin and send (the silver).

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na PUZUR₄-{d}IM lá-dí-a en-um-a-šur en-na-sú-in a-šur-i-dí i-ku-pí-a ù li-lá qí-bi-ma um-ma en-um-a-šùr ù a-lá-ḫu-um-ma
target: To Puzur-Adad, Ladiya, Ennam-Aššur, Enna-Suen, Aššur-idī, Ikūn-pīya and Lila from Ennam-Aššur and Ali-ahum:

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na 40 GÚ URUDU SIG₅ ša i-dí-a-šur um-me-a-ni e-pu-lu
target: Of the 40 talents of good copper about which Iddin-Aššur reached an agreement with the investors,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša 22 GÚ URUDU SIG₅ ša li-bi₄ a-lá-ḫi-im KÙ.BABBAR-áp-šu a-na-kam né-nu um-me-a-ni nu-ṭá-ib
target: we have here satisfied in silver the investors for the 22 talents of good copper that was in Ali-ahum's possession.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ.BA ša 22 GÚ URUDU qá-ta-tí-šu-nu ì-lí-a i-tur₄-DINGIR ù i-dí-ku-bu-um KÙ.BABBAR-áp-šu il₅-qé-ú
target: Thereof, for the 22 talents of copper, their shares, Iliya, Itūr-ilī and Iddin-Kūbum have received its value in silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-tí URUDU 18 GÚ 6 ma-na URUDU i li-bi i-dí-a-šur
target: The rest of the copper, 18 talents 6 minas of copper, is in Iddin-Aššur's possession.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-lá-an a-nim mì-ma i li-bi-šu ú-lá i-ba-ší
target: Apart from this nothing is in his possession.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma a-na qá-ta-tí-šu-nu en-um-a-šur ù i-ku-pí-a i-ma-ṣí-ú qá-ta-tí-šu-nu li-il₅-qé-ú-ma ší-bi šu-uk-na-šu-nu-tí
target: If Ennam-Aššur and Ikūn-pīya take responsibility for their shares, they may receive their shares, but set witnesses for them.

source: translate Akkadian to English: bé-lu-ni a-tù-nu ú tí-ir-ta-ku-nu li-li-kam ù bé-lu KÙ.BABBAR ma-du-tum ša lá il₅-qé-ú-ni a-ḫu-ru
target: Our dear lords, also, send us word, for a great many creditors who have received nothing remain.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na en-um-a-šur ù SIG₅-pí-a-šur a-na SIG₅-pí-a-šur qí-bi-ma um-ma ša-ta-na-ma
target: To Ennam-Aššur and Damiq-pī-Aššur; specifically to Damiq-pī-Aššur from Šāt-Anna:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am a-na ší-a-ma-tim a-dí-na-kum
target: I gave you 10 shekels of refined silver for purchases.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 ša-lá-ší-šu qá-dum ša ḫa-ra-an a-lim{ki} ḫa-ra-nam ú-qá
target: Three times I waited for the caravan together with those on the road to the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-kam KÙ.BABBAR ú ší-a-ma-tí-šu a-na en-um-a-šur šu-qúl
target: Pay the silver or the goods bought with it there to Ennam-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na a be-a-lim a-na ú-ṣú-ur-ša-a-šur DUMU am-ri-a
target: 0.5 mina for a working capital to Uṣur-ša-Aššur son of Amriya;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.3333 ma-na a-šur-be-el-a-wa-tim a me-er-i-šu ú ša-tí-li
target: 0.3333 mina: Aššur-bēl-awātim to his son and Šāt-ilī;

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ku-li-a qí-bi-ma um-ma a-sá-num-ma
target: To Kuliya, say, thus says Asānum:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-šu-mì a-ší-im sá-aḫ-ra-a-ku
target: I am still staying (here) because of the meteoric iron.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ši-a-im i-ma-gu₅-ru a-da-šu-ma a-ta-be-a-am-ma a-ta-lá-kam
target: When they agree with the (quality / price of the) iron I will sell it, get ready and leave to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí-i na-áš-pè-er-tí-kà ša a-šu-mì kà-lá-pí-im i-li-kà-ni
target: As for your letter which arrived here concerning the axe,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-bé-e a-dí-ni lá aḫ-ri-im
target: I have not yet recorded (the dispositions) of the witnesses.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i ší-be-a a-zu kà-ṣa-ar PUZUR₄-a-mur
target: Among my witnesses figures Azu, the transporter of Puzur-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: be-li a-ta a-na a-na PUZUR₄-a-mur pu-nu-ma a-zu-ú li-iṭ-ru-dam
target: Please, my lord, approach Puzur-Aššur and let him send Azu to me,

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tí tap-pá-i-šu ší-bu-tám li-dí-nam
target: so that he can testify for me together with his colleagues.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na lá i-da-i-a a-mì-ša-am i-tal-kam um-ma šu-ut-ma a-na e-lá-lí a-lá-ak
target: Without my knowledge he has left for there, saying: I am going to Elālī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB a-šur-i-mì-tí DUMU du-dí-ki KIŠIB ú-ṣur-ša-a-šur DUMU a-ku-a KIŠIB a-šur-ba-ni kà-al-bi₄-im
target: Seal of Aššur-imittī son of Dudiki, seal of Uṣur-ša-Aššur son of Akuwa, seal of Aššur-bāni, the dog.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 15 ma-na URUDU ší-kam a-na šu-mì en-um-a-šur DUMU šál-ma-a-šur a-na ta-áp-ḫi-ri-im áš-qúl
target: I paid 15 minas of copper to the temple-funds on behalf of Ennam-Aššur son of Šalim-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na 1.5 GÚ 4 ma-na URUDU SIG₅ ù 1 GÚ 14 ma-na URUDU ṣa-lá-mì-im ša a-lá-ḫu-um e-zi-bu
target: Of 1.5 talents 4 minas of good copper and 1 talent 14 minas of black copper that Ali-ahum left.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 31 ma-na URUDU SIG₅ ší-im <gap> a-šur-du-gul il₅-qé
target: Aššur-dugul took 31 minas of good copper as the price of <gap>.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 ma-na URUDU en-na-sú-in il₅-qé
target: Enna-Suen took 4 minas of copper.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 8 ma-na URUDU SIG₅ zi-kur-{d}IM il₅-qé
target: Zikur-Adad took 8 minas of good copper.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 15 ma-na URUDU ší-im ku-ta-nu a-na qá-tí-šu né-eš-qúl
target: 15 minas of copper were paid to his account as the price of a kutānu.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-šùr li-pu-ul-kà-ma
target: Aššur he should answer you

source: translate Akkadian to English: ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am šu-qú-ul
target: and you shall pay mina of refined silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma i-dí-ku-bu-ma ṭup-pá-am GAL ṭá-bi₄-a-nim
target: Iddin-Kūbum said: Erase the big tablet for me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na ú-mì-im ša a-na-ku ù ša-lim-a-šur ni-na-mu-ru
target: The day I and Šalim-Aššur meet

source: translate Akkadian to English: tám a-da-šu-um
target: I shall give him

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na 48 ku-ta-ni ša ik-ri-bi ŠÀ.BA 5 ku-ta-ni a-na 0.5 ma-na 7.5 GÍN ší-im-šu-nu a-na GAL pé-er-dí a-dí-in
target: Of the 48 kutānus of the votive offerings: 5 kutānus I sold to the chief of mules for a price of 0.5 mina 7.5 shekels;

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-ú ḫa-ru-mu-tum ša ší-bi-a ša me-er-e i-dí-a-bi₄-im
target: Certified tablets with my witnesses concerning the sons of Iddin-abum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-šur-ša-du-e a-mu-ur-ša-ra-sà ù ša-lim-wa-ar-dim-ma a-na a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi-ma
target: From Aššur-šadū'e, Amur-šarrassa and Šalim-wardī to Ali-ahum:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 31 ma-na AN.NA ku-nu-ki-kà ša-lim-wa-ar-dí ub-lá-am
target: Šalim-wardī brought 31 minas of tin under your seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ma-lá tí-ir-tí-kà AN.NA a-na a-mu-ur-ša-ra-sà ù ša-lim-wa-ar-dim ni-dí-ma
target: In accordance with your instructions we gave the tin to Amur-šarrassa and Šalim-wardī

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na li-bi ma-tim ú-šé-ri-bu-ma
target: and they led it into the heartland,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 6.5 GÍN.TA a-na an-ni-ki-kà ub-lu-ni-kum
target: and they brought you (silver) at 6.5 shekels per (shekel) for your tin for you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ.BA 3.5 GÍN ša-du-a-tám ni-dí
target: Thereof we deposited 3.5 shekels as transport tariff.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4.6666 ma-na 2.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ku-nu-ki-ni ša-lim-wa-ar-dim na-áš-a-ku-um
target: Šalim-wardī brings you 4.6666 minas 2.5 shekels of silver under our seals.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na qá-tí-šu ni-dí-in
target: We gave 1 shekel of silver for his disposal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na šu-mì šu-{d}EN.LÍL ša ni-iš-pu-ra-ku-ni
target: With respect to Šu-Illil about whom we wrote to you,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR šu-{d}EN.LÍL DUMU ma-nu-ki-a-šur e-pu-ul-ni-a-tí
target: Šu-Illil son of Mannum-kī-Aššur promised 3 minas of silver to us.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù ša-lim-wa-ar-dim i-li-kà-ni šu-{d}EN.LÍL lá-šu
target: After Šalim-wardī came Šu-Illil was gone.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a šu-mì-šu ša-lim-wa-ar-dim 10 u₄-me ú 20 u₄-me nu-sá-as-ḫi-ir-šu
target: Because of him we made Šalim-wardī wait 10 or 20 days.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na a-lá-ak šu-{d}EN.LÍL tí-ir-tám za-ku-tám ni-ša-pá-ra-kum
target: When Šu-Illil arrives we shall send a final report to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ku-zi-zi-a-ma ù a-mur-IŠTAR-ma a-na a-la-ḫi-im qí-bi-ma
target: From Kuziziya and Amur-Ištar to Ali-ahum:

source: translate Akkadian to English: TÚG.ḪI-tù-kà i-na ma-ri-it-ḫi-im <gap> SIG₅ i la <gap>-kam TÚG ra-qá-tum <gap> ša ta-da-nim i-ni-id-nu
target: Your textiles in Marithum, thin textiles that have been sold.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-tí TÚG.ḪI-tí-kà i-ba-ší-ú
target: The rest of your textiles are available.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-mu-um kà-sí-i a ma-lá tí-ir-tí-kà
target: The trade is at a stand-still.

source: translate Akkadian to English: TÚG.ḪI-tí-kà a-na ba-tí-iq ù DIRI ni-da-an-ma
target: In accordance with your instructions we shall sell your textiles for the best available price.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù-ul KÙ.BABBAR-áp-šu ù-ul KÙ.GI-sú né-pá-ša-kum
target: And we shall make for you either silver or gold.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ku-zi-zi-a-ma a-na en-um-a-šùr qí-bi-ma a-na ma-lá tí-ir-tí-kà ḫu-ur-ší-kà ša ṭup-pé-e pí-la-aḫ-IŠTAR i-dí-nam
target: From Kuzizya to Ennam-Aššur: In accordance with your message Pilah-Ištar gave me (access to) your store-room with the tablets.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ḫu-ur-ší-a-nu-um ù ku-nu-ku-kà ku-nu-ku ša a-lu-lá-a um-ma pí-lá-aḫ-IŠTAR-ma ṭup-pá-am ša kà-ṣa-ri-šu a-a-kam-ma ni-il₅-qé-ma ú a-na ḫu-ur-ší-a-nim ni-iš-ku-šu-ma a-lu-lá-a ik-nu-uk
target: Pilah-Ištar said: We have taken the tablet of his harnessor somewhere, and then we placed it in the container and Alulaya sealed it.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ḫu-ur-ší-a-nam ša ṭup-pí-kà eb-ri-mu-ša na-áš-a-kum ù a ma-lá tí-ir-tí-kà ṭup-pí-kà a-na pu-ru-uš-ḫa-dim nu-uš-té-bi-il₅ áš-pu-ra-kum
target: Ewarimuša brings you the container with the tablet; also, as you instructed, we have sent your tablets to Purušhaddum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ta-áš-pu-ra-am um-ma a-ta-ma a-da-an a-ḫi a-ta dí-in
target: You wrote, saying: "I shall give it." My dear brother, give it!

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR i-ṣé-er a-li-li ù kà-ar-ší-ni wa-al-dí-lúm ù IŠTAR-lá-ma-sí i-šu-ú
target: Alili and Karšini owe 1 mina of silver to Waldi-ilum and Ištar-lamassī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ša tù-ùḫ-tù-ḫa-nim 1.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ù 2 UDU.ḪI.A i-du-nu
target: They will give 1.5 mina of silver plus 2 sheep by the feast for Tuhtuhānum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI bé-li-kà-ù bé-el-tí-kà
target: Before your lord and your lady.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI wa-al-dí-lim ù kà-ar-ni-kà-šu
target: Witnessed by Waldi-ilum and Karnikašu.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma i-tur₄-DINGIR-ma a-na en-um-a-šùr qí-bi-ma
target: From Itūr-ilī to Ennam-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: lá li-bi₄ DINGIR-ma a-bu-kà me-et
target: Sadly, your father has died.

source: translate Akkadian to English: bu-lá-tù ša a-bi₄-kà kà-an-ku-ma i-ba-ší-ú
target: the assets of your father have been sealed and are available.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ma ba-áb-tám i É-tim lá i-ba-ší-ú
target: There is nothing from outstanding claims in the house.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-wa-sú iq-bi
target: He spoke his will.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-mì-a-nu mu-ut a-bi₄-kà iš-me-ú-ma
target: The investors heard of your father's death and

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-wi-lu ma-ag-ru a-pu-tum bu-lá-tim ša a-bi₄-ku-nu a-na KÙ.BABBAR
target: the men agreed to that which we had earlier pleaded with them about, Urgent, the assets of your father (should be turned) into silver

source: translate Akkadian to English: en-um-a-šùr a-na a-lá-ḫi-im iṣ-ba-at-ni-a-tí-ma um-ma en-um-a-šùr-ma a-na a-lá-ḫi-im-ma al-kam lá-áš-a-al-kà
target: Ennam-Aššur seized us against Ali-ahum and said to Ali-ahum: Come, let me question you!

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-lá-ḫu-um-ma a-na mì-nim ta-ša-a-lá-ni
target: Ali-ahum answered: Why do you want to question me?

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma en-um-a-šùr-ma a-na ta-aḫ-sí-sá-tim ša a-na-ku ù a-ta ni-kà-sí ni-sí-ú i ku-nu-ki-kà ù ku-nu-ki-a kà-an-kà-ni ik-ra-ni ú-lá kà-i-na-ni
target: Ennam-Aššur said: About the memoranda stating that I and you settled accounts. Contest or confirm to me that they are sealed by you and me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-lá-ḫu-um-ma ta-aḫ-sí-sá-tim ša ku-nu-ki-a ú ku-nu-ki-kà kà-an-kà-ni ke-na ku-nu-ku-a lá a-na-ki-ir
target: Ali-ahum answered: As to the memoranda sealed by me and by you - yes, I do not contest my seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma en-um-a-šur-ma ša ni-iš a-lim{ki} <gap> ta-mu-ú kà-i-lá <gap> a-na a-lim{ki} ú be-lí-a a-wa-tí bi₄-lá a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tím
target: Ennam-Aššur said: Keep in mind what was sworn by the City! Bring my case to the City assembly and my lord.

source: translate Akkadian to English: kà-ru-um kà-ni-iš i-dí-ni-a-tí-ma IGI GÍR ša a-šùr ší-bu-tí-ni ni-dí-in
target: The Kanesh colony gave us for these proceedings and we gave our testimony before Aššur's dagger.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-šur-GAL DUMU lá-qé-ep IGI ili₅-ba-ni DUMU a-mur-IŠTAR
target: Witnessed by Aššur-rabi son of Lā-qēp, by Ilī-bāni son of Amur-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 30 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ni-is-ḫa-sú DIRI ša-du-a-sú ša-bu ku-nu-ki-a a-na um-mì-a-ni-a ša ki-ma i-a-tí ù ḫi-na-a šu-ku-bu-um ú-bi₄-il₅
target: 30 minas of silver, its excise added, his transport fee paid, under my seals, Šu-Kūbum brought to my investors and my representatives and to hinnāya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-mur-{d}UTU DUMU mì-šar-ra-bí IGI a-mur-{d}UTU DUMU ḫa-ri-im-tim
target: In the presence of Amur-Šamaš, son of Mīšar-rabi, of Amur-Šamaš, son of harimtum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR i-a-am
target: 2 minas of silver belonging to me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša ḫi-na-a a pá-ni ILLAT-tim
target: 1 mina of silver belonging to hinnāya, sent to meet the caravan.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša um-mì-iš-ḫa-ra
target: 1.5 mina of silver of Ummī-Išhara.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 15 GÍN KÙ.KI ša lá-ma-sí-tim ú a-šur-iš-tí-kál
target: 15 shekels of gold of Lamassutum and Aššuriš-tikal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ.BA 0.5 ma-na 5 GÍN ša lá-ma-sí-tim
target: Thereof 35 shekels of silver of Lamassutum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.3333 ma-na 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša ik-ri-bi-a
target: 25 shekels of silver being my temple funds.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ma a-nim ni-is-ḫa-sú DIRI ša-du-a-sú ša-bu ku-nu-ki-a a ša ki-ma i-a-tí šu-ku-bu-um ú-bi₄-il₅
target: All this, its import tax added, his transport fee paid, under my seals, Šu-Kūbum brought to my representatives.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI lá-qé-ep DUMU i-zi-za-am-ì-lí IGI a-šur-na-da
target: In the presence of Lā-qēp, son of Izzizam-ilī, of Aššur-nādā.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-ku dam-qá-tim a-šé-e-a-kum a-ta lam-ni-iš té-pu-uš-a-ni <gap> ta-ṣa-ba-at
target: While I am bent on doing what is good for you, you have treated me badly and you have seized <gap>.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú i-a-tí be-li ki-ma NINDA e-kà-lá-ni
target: As for me, my lord is consuming me like bread.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ki-ma a-ma-kam tù-ša-ḫi-zi-ni um-ma a-ta-ma ší-im am-tim a-na me-er-i-a lá ta-dí-ni
target: As you instructed me there, saying: 'You must not give the price of the slave-girl to my son!'

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ší-a-tí a-na me-er-i-kà lá a-dí-ší
target: For that reason I have not given her to your son.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-im URUDU ù KÙ.BABBAR ba-áb-tám ša nu-a-am ú-ša-zi-za-ku-ni šé-bi₄-lam-ma
target: Send me the price of the copper and the outstanding silver for which I made the native responsible to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù šu-up-ra-am-ma a-ma-at-kà a-ša ki-ma ku-a-tí lá-dí-in
target: And send me a message then I will give your slave-girl to your representative.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-ta-ta ù kà-nu-tim qí-bi₄-ma um-ma a-na-aḫ-ì-lí-ma
target: Say to Atata and Kannutum, thus Anah-ili:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na KÙ.KI ù 1.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša kà-nu-tim ša il₅-ba-ni ki-ma kà-nu-tim KÙ.BABBAR ip-qí-da-ni
target: (As for the) 0.5 mina of gold and 1.5 mina of silver, belonging to Kannutum, which silver Ili-bani, representing Kannutum, entrusted to me -

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam a-lá-bu-um ú-ni-ḫi-ma KÙ.BABBAR 1 ma-na ú-ša-ag-me-er
target: here Ali-abum has caused me trouble and caused expenses of 1 mina of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-lim{ki} im-ta-ša-ra-ni-ma i-na dí-in a-lim{ki} KÙ.BABBAR ú KÙ.KI a-lá-bu-um i-lá-qé-ma
target: He has now dragged me before the City and by verdict of the City Ali-abum will take that silver and gold and

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-at kà-nu-tim lá-bu-um i-za-az
target: Ali-abum will be responsible for Kannutum's interests.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma kà-nu-tum a-na a-na-aḫ-ì-lí ta-tù-wa-ar a-lá-bu-um ú-ša-ḫa-sú-ú
target: Should Kannutum come back on Anah-ili, then Ali-abum will clear him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ú KÙ.KI šu-ut a-na É a-lim{ki} a-na ḫu-bu-ul ili₅-ba-ni i-ší-qí-il₅
target: The aforementioned silver and gold have been paid to the City Office for (to cover) Ili-bani's debts.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-kam a-le té-er-tí ili₅-ba-ni i-ba-ší-ú ša 0.5 ma-na KÙ.KI pá-ša-lamₓ ù 1.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ú ší-a-ma-tí-šu ṣa-áb-ta-ma mì-ṣí-a-ma li-qí-a
target: Over there, wherever goods ordered by Ili-bani are available, seize for a value of 0.5 mina of pasallum gold and 1.5 mina of silver or what has been bought for it and take it at your own responsibility.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pá-am ša a-lim{ki} da-nam ša ki-ma KÙ.KI ú KÙ.BABBAR ša kà-nu-tí-ni ú-kà-al
target: I have a strong tablet of the City stating that the silver and gold belong to Kannutum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú šu-ma ku-li-a i-lá-kam-ma a-wa-tim ú-ga-mar a-dí a-lá-kà-ni i-ta-ba-lá-šu a-wa-tim lá tù-ga-ma-ra
target: And if Kuliya comes in order to settle the affair, hold him in play until I arrive, do not settle the affair!

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB a-lá-ḫi-im DUMU e-lá-lí KIŠIB en-nam-a-šur DUMU en-na-sú-in KIŠIB dan-a-šur DUMU šál-mì-ḫi-im KIŠIB pu-šu-ki-in DUMU sú-e-a
target: Seal of Ali-ahum son of Elāli, seal of Ennam-Aššur son of Enna-Suen, seal of Dan-Aššur son of Šalim-ahum, seal of Pūšu-kēn son of Sueyya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma a-šur-ta-ak-lá-ku na-ru-qám a-na en-nam-a-šur i-tí-dí-in i-na 1 GÚ 2 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša ṭup-pì-šu ḫa-ar-mì-im ša en-nam-a-šur 2 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR i-lá-qé-ma 3 ma-na KÙ.GI iš-tí um-me-a-ni-šu šu-mì pu-šu-ki-in i-lá-pá-at
target: If Aššur-taklāku has given a joint-stock investment to Ennam-Aššur, then he will receive 2 minas of silver out of the 1 talent 2 minas of silver in his certified tablet, belonging to Ennam-Aššur, and he will write down 3 minas of gold in the name of Pūšu-kēn with his other investors.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma a-šur-ta-ak-lá-ku qá-sú im-ta-ḫa-aṣ <gap>-20 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ki-ma 10 ma-na KÙ.GI iš-tù ḫa-muš-tim ša i-dí-a-šur ù i-ku-nim a-na 46 ḫa-am-ša-tim pu-šu-ki-in a-na en-nam-a-šur i-da-an-ma na-ru-uq en-nam-a-šur a-li ṭá-bu-šu-ni pu-šu-ki-in ú-šé-ra-áb
target: If Aššur-taklāku has refused him, then Pūšu-kēn will give 40? minas of silver, representing 10 minas of gold, within 46 weeks reckoned from the week of Iddin-Aššur and Ikūnum, and Pūšu-kēn will make Ennam-Aššur's joint-stock investment enter wherever it is favourable for him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma pu-šu-ki-in na-ru-qám a-na en-nam-a-šur lá i-tí-dí-in 10 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am pu-šu-ki-in a-na en-nam-a-šur i-ša-qal
target: If Pūšu-kēn has not given a joint-stock investment to Ennam-Aššur (in time), Pūšu-kēn must give 10 minas of refined silver to Ennam-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma en-nam-a-šur qá-tám im-ta-ḫa-aṣ 10 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am a-na pu-šu-ki-in i-ša-qal
target: If Ennam-Aššur has refused, he must pay 10 minas of refined silver to Pūšu-kēn.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ta-aḫ-sí-is-tum a-ni-tum me-ḫi-ir ṭup-pì-im ḫa-ar-mì-im ša ku-nu-uk pu
target: This memorandum is a copy of a certified tablet sealed by Pūšu-kēn.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.3333 ma-na 1.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i-ṣé-er ḫa-bi-a ù a-ší-tí-šu a-lá-ḫu-um i-šu
target: Habiya and his wife owe 0.3333 mina 1.5 shekel of silver to Ali-ahum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na en-na-nim ù a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi₄-ma um-ma PUZUR₄-a-šùr-ma
target: To Ennānum and Ali-ahum from Puzur-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 20 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ku-nu-ki-a en-na-num na-ší
target: Ennānum brings 20 minas of silver under my seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR i-na ma-na-i-šu áš-du a-na e-na-aḫ-DINGIR i-ta-ší-a-ma ṭup-pá-am ša ku-nu-ki-a li-dí-na-ku-nu-tí
target: Ašdu weighed the silver with his one-mina weight for Enah-ilī so let him give you a tablet with my seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ki-lá-lá-ku-nu-ma li-tí-a-šu-ma ri-ḫi ú tù-ra-ma ku-un-kà-šu-ma a-šar a-šùr-ni-im-ri e-ez-ba-šu
target: Both of you should split (the envelope) and seal it again and leave it for Aššur-nimrī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ki-ma KÙ.BABBAR ta-áš-qú-lá-ni ma-ri-a-am ṭù-ur-da-nim
target: When you have weighed the silver send me the.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù tí-ir-ta-ak-nu iš-tí pá-ni-e-ma a-li-ki li-li-kam
target: Also, send me word with the first transport.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫu-ú-a a-tù-nu iḫ-da mì-ma i-ṣé-ri-a ṣí-ib-tum lá i-lá-qé
target: My dear brothers, take care so he does not take any interest from me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam a-na AN.NA ša KÙ.BABBAR 1 ma-na ú-šé-lá-šu-um
target: I shall realise every mina of silver on the tin here for him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB bu-bu-ra-nu-um a-na a-bi₄-a DUMU be-e-be ù a-šùr-DU₁₀
target: Sealed by Buburānum; to Abiya son of Bebe and Aššur-ṭab.

source: translate Akkadian to English: <gap>-nu a-bi₄-a šu-ma a-ḫu-a a-tù-nu iḫ-da
target: If you are truly my brothers, take care!

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 ḫi-dim KÙ.BABBAR <gap> ḫu-bu-li ša <gap> i-ší-it
target: 4 silver beads, the debt of <gap>, remains.

source: translate Akkadian to English: TÚG ku-ta-ni <gap> 1.5 GÍN.TA a-na 2 ma-na 6.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na ir-nu-id a-dí-in
target: I sold kutānu-textiles at 1.5 shekels a piece for 2 minas 6.5 shekels of silver to Irnuid.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na en-nam-a-šur qí-bi-ma um-ma ša-ta-na-ma
target: To Ennam-Aššur from Šāt-Anna:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 30 ma-na URUDU SIG₅ ku-nu-ki-a a-lu-ú-a na-áš-a-ku-um
target: Aluwa brings you 30 minas of good copper under my seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-kam ma-lá ta-le-e-ú a-na KÙ.BABBAR ta-e-er-ma
target: Convert it to silver there as best you can.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma i-lu-a-ma a-na sú-e-a qí-bi-ma 49 TÚG.ḪI.A ša a-šùr-i-mì-tí 1 TÚG ša bu-ur-sú-in 1 TÚG ša la-qé-ep 1 TÚG ša i-ku-pí-a ŠU.NÍGIN 52 TÚG.ḪI.A qá-dum ša ta-ad-mì-qá-tim ù 2 ANŠE ù ú-nu-sú-nu a-na zu-ba ap-qí-id-ma
target: From Iluwa to Sueyya: 49 textiles belonging to Aššur-imittī, 1 textile belonging to Būr-Suen, 1 textile belonging to Lā-qēp, 1 textile belonging to Ikūn-pīya - in all I entrusted to Zuba 52 textiles including those of the, plus 2 donkeys and their harness.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ṣé-er ḫu-ra-ṣa-nim i-ra-dí
target: And he leads it to huraṣānum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-kam a-ta ù i-na-sú-in ki-ma ni-a-tí i-ša-ḫa-at zu-ba i-zi-za-ma TÚG.ḪI.A a-na ḫu-ra-ṣa-nim pì-iq-da
target: You and Enna-Suen should assist Zuba there on our behalf and entrust the textiles to huraṣānum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: pá-zu-ur-tám ša-bu ku-nu-ki ša sí-sí-kà-tim pì-iq-da
target: He has been paid the smuggling-fee. Entrust them with sealings on the hems.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-šu-mì 2 TÚG ša ḫa-al-qú-ni a-na šu-IŠTAR ù e-lá-li lá kà-áš-du
target: Concerning 2 textiles that were lost they have not reached Šu-Ištar and Elāli.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-lá-ḫi-im ú zu-ku-a qí-bi-ma um-ma PUZUR₄-a-šur-ma
target: To Ali-ahum and Zukuwa from Puzur-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 13 ma-na AN.NA en-nam-a-šur a-mì-ša-am ub-lam
target: Ennam-Aššur brought 13 minas of tin there.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫu-a a-tù-nu šu-ma AN.NA i-dí-na-ku-nu-ti AN.NA ku-un-kà-ma šé-bi-lá-nim
target: My dear brothers, if he has given you the tin, then seal the tin and send it here.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma KÙ.BABBAR qá-dí AN.NA i-dí-na-ku-nu-ti ší-ma-am ša ba-lá-ṭí-a ša-ma-ma iš-tí a-li-ki pá-ni-ú-tí-ma šé-bi-lá-nim
target: If he has given you silver together with the tin, then make a profitable purchase for me and send it here with the very first travellers.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma dam-qá-a a-na a-lim{ki} ḫa-ra-šu 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR dí-na-šu-ma ki-ma a-na-ku AN.NA a-ma-kam ú-šé-li-a-ku-ni šu-ut AN.NA šál-ma-am lu-šé-li-am
target: If Damqaya is on his way to the City, then give him a mina of silver, and just as I brought up tin for him, he too should bring up tin without deductions for me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ku-ta-num 2 šu-re-en₆ ša šu-ku-bi-im a-na 0.6666 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR i-bu-ru-uš-ḫa-tim ta-ad-nu
target: 1 textile (and) 2 dark textiles belonging to Šu-Kūbum have been sold in Burušhattum for 0.6666 mina of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ.BA ša 25 ma-na URUDU KÙ-áp-šu a šu-mì šu-ku-bi₄-im ú-ṣa-ḫi-ru ša 15 ma-na URUDU a šu-mì-a ú-ṣa-ḫi-ru
target: From it they deducted the silver equivalent of 25 minas of copper for Šu-Kūbum's account and that of 15 minas of copper for my account.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-tí KÙ.BABBAR-pì-šu 14 GÍN
target: The rest of his silver is 14 shekels.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ.BA 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i-na kà-ni-iš ša-lim-a-šùr i-dí-in
target: Thereof: 10 shekels of silver Šalim-ahum gave in Kanesh.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na-ku a-na-pá-al
target: I myself will pay 4 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ.BA 0.5 ma-na LÁ 2 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR té-pu-ul-šum
target: Of this amount you paid him 28 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 GÍN KÙ i-tu-me-li-a a-dí-šum
target: 2 shekels of silver I gave him in Tumeliya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.6666 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ú-kúl-tí ANŠE ù da-a-sú ša a-dí wa-aḫ-šu-ša-na
target: 1.6666 shekel of silver fodder for the donkey and road-tax for it until Wahšušana.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša 30 TÚG.ḪI.A iš-tù ú-lá-ma a-dí bu-ru-uš-ḫa-tim ù É wa-áb-ri
target: 3 shekels of silver (expenses) for 30 textiles (transported) from Ulama until Burušhattum and (for) the cost of the inn.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu-lu en-nam-a-šur ù a-bu-um-ša-lim ša ki-ma a-šùr-DU₁₀ DUMU e-lá-ma a-na a-šur-DU₁₀ DUMU a-lá-ḫi-im iṣ-bu-tù-ni-a-tí-ma um-ma šu-nu-ma ší-im 21 GÚ 9 ma-na URUDU ma-sí-im ša a-šur-DU₁₀ DUMU e-lá-ma ša i-na É-tí-kà i-ni-id-ú a-na ší-mì-im ta-dí-šu
target: Lullu, Ennam-Aššur, and Abum-šalim, who, on behalf of Aššur-taklāku, son of Elama, seized me for Aššur-taklāku, son of Alaḫim, and they said: 'The price of 21 talents 9 minas of copper of Aššur-taklāku, son of Elama, which was deposited in your house, you must pay its price.'

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-šur-DU₁₀-ma a-dí-šu-ma 17.8333 ma-na 2 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ší-im-šu na-áš-a-ku eq-lam a šu-mì a-šur-DU₁₀ DUMU e-lá-ma KÙ.BABBAR e-tí-iq
target: Aššur-taklāku said: 'I will pay it, and I am carrying 17.8333 minas 2 shekels of silver as its price; the field in the name of Aššur-taklāku, son of Elama, the silver has passed.'

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um bu-ru-uš-ḫa-tum i-dí-ni-a-tí-ma ší-bu-tí-ni IGI GÍR ša a-šur ni-dí-in IGI i-ku-pì-a IGI ú-ṣú-ur-ša-a-šur
target: Regarding these matters, the karum of Burušḫatum gave us, and our witnesses: before the foot of Aššur we gave, before Ikuppiya, before Uṣur-ša-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ša-lim-a-šùr qí-bi-ma um-ma {d}IM.GAL-ma
target: To Šalim-Aššur from Adad-rabi:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ṭup-pí a-šu-mì i-dí-a-bi-im ša ta-áš-pu-ra-ni a-šùr-ma-lik ù ša-lim-a-šur áš-al-ma um-ma a-na-ku-ma i-nu-mì i-sú-ri-ik a-wa-tim ša i-dí-a-bi-im iš-tí me-ra-ni iš-tí GUDU₄ ša IŠTAR ù É za-ak-ta-a ù a-li ta-ad-mì-iq-tám i-dí-nu-šu-ni a-wa-tim ig-mu-ru i-nu-mì-šu-ma KÙ.BABBAR ša ša-qá-lim iš-qú-ul ù ší-tí KÙ.BABBAR ṭup-pí-šu ú-ḫa-ri-mu ša i-dí-a-bu-um ḫa-bu-lu-ma šál-ma-a-šùr qá-ta-tù-ni
target: as to the tablets concerning Iddin-abum that you wrote to me about - I asked Aššur-malik and Šalim-Aššur, saying: When Issu-arik cleared up Iddin-abum's affairs with Merani, with the Ištar-priest and Zaktaya's firm, and where he gave him a free loan, at that time he paid what silver he could - and did they certify his tablets for the rest of the silver, stating that Iddin-abum owed it, and that Šalim-Aššur was the guarantor?

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-nu-ma ṭup-pu-um šu-um-šu ú-lá ḫa-ri-im KÙ.BABBAR ú-šé-bi-lam-ma a-na a-wi-li ni-iš-qú-ul
target: They answered: "No tablet at all was certified.

source: translate Akkadian to English: He sent us the silver and we paid the men."
target: He sent us the silver and we paid the men.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-nu-ma ke-na i-sú-ri-ik i-na ma-aḫ-ri-ni e-ta-wu-šu-um um-ma šu-ut-ma ḫa-bu-ul a-ḫi-kà lu a-na-kam lu i-na GÁN-lim šu-qú-ul-ma ù a-lik-ma i-na KÙ.BABBAR-áp a-ḫi-kà le-qé šu-ma KÙ.BABBAR-áp a-ḫi-kà lá-šu i-na na-ru-qí-kà šu-qúl
target: They continued: "It is true that Issu-arik discussed with him in our presence and said: 'Pay the debt of your brother, both here and abroad, and then go and take it again out of your brother's silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: If there is no silver belonging to your brother, then pay out of your joint-stock capital.'"
target: If there is no silver belonging to your brother, then pay out of your joint-stock capital.'"

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim ša i-sú-ri-ik i-na ma-aḫ-ri-šu-nu e-ta-wu-ku-ni ú-šé-ra-sú-nu-ma KÁ DINGIR ṭup-pá-áš-nu a-lá-q
target: For these words which Issu-arik discussed with you in their presence I shall lead them off, and I shall receive a tablet with their statement in the Gate of the God.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na 11 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša ṭup-pí-kà 5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR <gap> 2 ma-na-e-en KÙ.BABBAR ša i-na ḫa-ra-nim ša-qá-lam qá-bi₄-a-tí-ni-ma lá ta-áš-qú-lá-ni KÙ.BABBAR šé-bi-lam
target: Of the 11 minas of silver from your tablet, 5 minas of silver <gap> the two minas of silver that you promised to pay during the journey and which you have not paid - send the silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ku-ta-ni SIG₅ ú ḫu-sà-ra-am lá-áš-a-ma-kum-ma ki-ma i-na e-lá-i-a KÙ.BABBAR 10 ma-na ni-lá-qé-ú ú-ša-bi-ru ta-ma-ar
target: I shall buy good and lapis lazuli for you, and you will see that we shall take 10 minas of silver <gap> when I come up.

source: translate Akkadian to English: AN.NA ù TÚG.ḪI.A a-na KÙ.BABBAR dí-na
target: Sell the tin and textiles for silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ba-a-ba-tí-a ša nu-a-e i-ḫi-id-ma KÙ.BABBAR ša-áš-qí-il₅-ma šé-bi₄-lam
target: Pay attention to my outstanding claims with Anatolians, have the silver paid and send it to me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam a-mu-tám SIG₅ ḫu-sà-ra-am SIG₅ É a-lim{ki} a-mu-ur-ma a-dí KÙ.BABBAR lá iš-qú-lu-ni a-mu-tám ù ḫu-sà-ra-am lá u-šu-ru
target: I have seen good iron and good lapis lazuli here in the City Hall, but as long as they have not paid the silver, they will not release the iron and lapis lazuli.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫi a-ta i-ḫi-id-ma AN.NA ù TÚG.ḪI.A a-na KÙ.BABBAR ta-e-er-ma ù i-na ba-ab-tí-a KÙ.BABBAR 10 ma-na ša-áš-qí-lá-ma KÙ.BABBAR šé-bi-lam-ma a-mu-tám ù ḫu-sà-ra-am lu-šé-ṣí-a-ma
target: My dear brother, take care to convert the tin and textiles to silver and then have some 10 minas of silver from my outstanding claims paid, and send me the silver so I can take out the iron and the lapis lazuli.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ki-ma i-na ba-ab É.GAL-lim <gap> ma-na ṣú-ba-tám ta-<gap>-tim a-ni-ša-am li-ta-al-ku-nim
target: and since in the palace gate <gap> they should come here.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-šur-iš-tí-kál-ma a-na a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi₄-ma
target: From Aššuriš-tikal to Ali-ahum:

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na 9 GÚ 17 ma-na URUDU ša É kà-ri-im lá-áp-ta-tí-ni
target: Of the 9 talents 17 minas of copper for which you were booked in the office of the colony:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4.5 GÚ URUDU lá-mu-num ḫu-ma ta-aṣ-ḫi-ra
target: you deducted 4.5 talents of bad copper for huma;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2.5 GÚ 7 ma-na URUDU lá-mu-num a-ni-na il₅-qé
target: Annina recieved 2.5 talents 7 minas of bad copper;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 GÚ 10 ma-na URUDU lá-mu-num a-mur-IŠTAR il₅-qé
target: Amur-Ištar recieved 2 talents 10 minas of bad copper - total of your copper:

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠU.NÍGIN URUDU-i-kà 9 GÚ 17 ma-na URUDU lá-mu-num ša É kà-ri-im lá-ap-ta-tí-ni
target: 9 talents 17 minas of bad copper for which you were booked in the office of the colony.

source: translate Akkadian to English: <gap> ni <gap> im ú-šé-bi-lá-ni a-na ma-la na-áš-pé-er-tim ša <gap> 80 ku-ta-nu ba-at-qú-ú
target: he sent to me. In accordance with the missive of <gap> 80 kutānu-textiles have been dropped.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na i-dí-a-bi-im i-tur₄-DINGIR ku-ku-wa a-dí-da ù a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi-ma um-ma en-um-a-šùr-ma
target: To Iddin-abum, Itūr-ilī, Kukawa, Adida and Ali-ahum from Ennam-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-šu-mì lu-qú-tim ša a-bi-ni a-šar ša-lá-mì-ša a-ṣé-er ša ki-ma a-bi-ni ù a-ṣé-ri-ku-nu a-dí ma-lá ú ší-ni-šu áš-pu-ra-ku-nu-tí
target: Once or twice I have written to our father's representatives and to you about how to deal with our father's goods in a safe manner.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na tí-ir-tí-ku-nu ḫa-ra-an sú-qí-ni-ma a-šé-ru-ub lu-qú-tim ta-áš-ta-na-pá-ra-nim um-ma a-tù-nu-ma a-šar ša-lá-am lu-qú-tim ša a-bi-kà mì-li-ik
target: In your instructions you keep writing to me about bringing the goods on the Narrow Track. You wrote: Decide about the safety of your father's goods!

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú a-na-kam a-wa-at e-kál-li ša ša-lá-ša-at šu-nu-tí da-na-ma a-šar iš-té-en₆ a-wa-sú-nu ša-ak-na-at
target: However, here the orders of the palaces, three of them, are strict, and they have made common cause.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú i-na ḫa-ra-an sú-qí-nim-ma DUMU a-zu-za-a iṣ-bu-tù-ma a-dí u₄-mì-im a-nim kà-li-i
target: So, they have seized Azuzaya's son on the narrow track and he is detained until this day.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí KÙ.BABBAR ša a-dí ší-ni-šu áš-pu-ra-ku-nu-tí-ni-ma šu-ut ú-lá e-zi-ba-ni a-ba-ú-a bé-lu-a a-tù-nu KÙ.BABBAR 1 ma-na tí-ri a ma-lá lu-qú-tim ša a-bi-ni ša-lá-mì-ša
target: As to the silver that I wrote you about twice, and which he has not left for me, my dear fathers, every mina of -silver as saving our father's goods

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša i-<gap> i-na KÙ.BABBAR-áp a-bi-a iš-tí ba-tí-qí-im šé-bi-lá-nim-ma lu-qú-tám lá-áš-lu-ùḫ iḫ-da-ma lá a-sá-ḫu-ur
target: Send me some of my father's silver with an express caravan so I can dispatch the goods. Take care so I am not delayed

source: translate Akkadian to English: ra-bi-ṣa-am ša a-na ṣé-er i-tur₄-DINGIR ta-ḫa-za-ni i-na ṭup-pì-im ša a-lim{ki} šu-a-tí-ma šu-um-šu wa-dí
target: The attorney whom you will contract against Itūr-ilī - indicate his name in the tablet from the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma ra-bi-ṣú-um i-ta-ṣa-am ṭup-pé-e a-na ba-tí-qí-im DUMU um-me-a-ni ke-nim
target: If the attorney has already left, (give) the tablets to an express transport, a reliable affiliated trader.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ku-a-tí li-li-kam
target: Let him come to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-wa-sú lá-ag-mu-ur
target: I shall conclude his case.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i qá-tí-im i-ri-tim lá a-lá-kam
target: I shall not arrive empty-handed.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù ni-is-ḫa-tum a-na um-me-a-ni ku-a-tí
target: plus the import duty to the investors for you

source: translate Akkadian to English: na-áš-pè-er-tum ša a-šùr-ták-lá-ku DUMU ḫa-na-na a-na na-ki-le-a-ad
target: A letter of Assur-taklaku, son of Hananna, to Nakile'ad.

source: translate Akkadian to English: na-áš-pè-er-tum ša na-ki-le-a-ad a-na a-šur-ták-lá-ku DUMU ḫa-na-na
target: A letter of Nakile'ad to Assur-taklaku, son of Hanana.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-um ša DAM.GÀR ša i-na ḫu-ra-ma ḫa-ar-mu-ni
target: A tablet of the tamkarum, that has been validated in Hurama.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù ṭup-pu-ú ša a-na-aḫ-DINGIR
target: And tablets of Anah-ili.

target: To Šalim-Aššur from Adad-rabi:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam šu-IŠTAR a-šur-ma-lik ù ša-lim-a-šùr iš-me-ú-ma um-ma šu-nu-ma a-wa-tum a-ni-tum a ma-lá ša ṭup-pí-šu ša iš-pu-ra-ni ke-na i-sú-ri-ik i-na ma-aḫ-ri-ni e-tù-wu
target: Here Šu-Ištar, Aššur-malik and Šalim-Aššur heard (your letter), and they said: This matter is correct as he wrote about it in his letter.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-IŠTAR a-wa-tám i-šu um-ma šu-nu-ma šu-IŠTAR a-wa-sú li-il₅-qé-a-ma a-na ba-áb DINGIR nu-ri-id-ma ṭup-pá-am lu ni-dí-na-kum
target: Šu-Ištar raised the matter and they said: "Let Šu-Ištar take a lawsuit and we shall go down to the Gate of the God and give you a tablet."

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na ṭup-pí-kà <gap> lu a-lá-ḫa-am ù <gap> a-šùr-ma-lik ù <gap> ša DUMU PUZUR₄.SA.TU <gap> i-na u₄-mì-im iš-té-en <gap> KÁ DINGIR ṭup-pá-<gap> DUMU i-ba-a-a a-na <gap> um-ma né-nu-ma a-wi-lum be-el na-ru-qí-im ú-ša-sà-ḫa-am

target: 20 minas of šikku-copper
