target: Šēp-Ištar and Šalim-wardī brought 12 thin textiles and 0.5 mina 3 shekels of lapis lazuli of nēreb / pu to Kuziziya in Wahšušana.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 ma-na URUDU ší-kam a qá-tí-šu-nu a-dí-in IGI šu-bé-lim DUMU ku-zi-zi-a IGI ki-zi-e DUMU lá-qé-ep
target: I gave 5 minas of copper as their share in the presence of Šubēlum, son of Kuziziya, and in the presence of Kizie, son of Lāqēp.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-mu-ru-ba-ni ù šál-ma-a-šùr qí-bi₄-ma um-ma šu-ku-bu-ma
target: To Amurrum-bāni and Šalim-Aššur from Šu-Kūbum:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 ANŠE im ṣa-lá-mu i-qá-ar-bi₄-im 2 ša up-qí-im a-ra-de₈-a-ku-nu-tí
target: I am leading 5 black donkeys, thereof 2 with -loads, to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša DAM.GÀR-ri-im a-pu-tum AN.NA qá-tim ma-sú-ùḫ ša i-dí-na a-pu-tum šu-uq-lu-um lá i-pá-ṭá-ar
target: They belong to the merchant. Urgent, the expense tin is inferior - what he gave me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-pu-tum KÙ.BABBAR a-na pá-ni-e-a šé-bi₄-lá
target: Urgent, send silver to me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-uq-lu-um lá i-pá-ṭá-ar
target: The packet must not be opened.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ra-bi-ṣú-um ša É šál-ma-a-šùr a-ba-ba iṣ-ba-at-ni-a-tí-ma a-na en-um-a-šùr ù a-lá-ḫi-im ù-ṭá-ḫi-ni-a-tí-ma
target: The attorney of Šalim-Aššur's firm Ababa seized us and made us approach Ennam-Aššur and Ali-ahum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na ṭup-pí-im ša a-lim{ki} mì-ma šál-ma-a-šùr e-zi-bu ù-pá-ḫa-ar-ma a-na a-lim{ki} ù-ba-al
target: According to the tablet of the City I shall collect all that Šalim-Aššur left behind and bring it to the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu ba-áb-tám a-bu-ku-nu e-zi-ib lu mì-ma e-zi-bu ba-a-nim kà-li-ma-ni-ma i-ša-ḫa-tí-ku-nu lá-zi-iz-ma lu-šé-ru-ku-nu-tí-ma ù a-na a-lim{ki} lu ni-lik
target: Come, show me the oustanding claims your father left and anything he left behind, then I shall assist you so they release it to you, and we can go to the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: tí-ma-li-ma áš-al-ku-nu-ma um-ma a-na-ku-ma KÙ.BABBAR ma-lá i li-bi-ku-nu a-bu-ku-nu i-dí-ú šu-uq-lá-ma ù a-na a-lim{ki} lu ni-lik
target: Yesterday I questioned you, saying: 'Pay whatever silver your father set down as owed by you and then let us go to the City!'

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-lá-ḫu-um-ma a-ḫu-kà-ma ba-a-am ma-lá a-bi KÙ.BABBAR i-na ṭup-pí-im il₅-pu-tù-ni lá-áš-qúl-ma ù a-na a-lim{ki} lu ni-lik
target: Your brother Ali-ahum answered: 'Come, let me pay what silver my father wrote in the tablet, and then let us go to the City.'

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ta ki-ma KÙ.BABBAR ša-qá-li-im da-na-tim ta-ta-na-pá-lá-ni ù KÙ.BABBAR ša-qá-lam lá ta-mu-a lá tù-na-ḫa-ni
target: But you keep giving me harsh answers instead of paying the silver, and you refuse to pay the silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù a-šar ba-áb-tum ša a-bi-kà i-ba-ší-ú kà-li-ma-ni i-ša-ḫa-tí-ku-nu lá-zi-iz-ma KÙ.BABBAR lu nu-ša-áš-qí-il₅-ma a-na a-lim{ki} lu ni-lik
target: Do not obstruct me, but show me where your father's outstanding claims are! Let me assist you and let us have the silver paid and let us go to the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫu-kà a-lá-ḫu-um KÙ.BABBAR ma-lá a-bu-šu i
target: Your brother Ali-ahum shows me the silver his father wrote in the tablet, but you refuse to pay the silver your father wrote concerning you in the tablet, so you obstruct me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-ku-tum-ma a-na ta-na-wi-iš-tí ú i-iš-ta-ku-ša-ar a-na-kam en-na-ma-a-šùr pu-uz-ra-am i-na pá-ni-a iṣ-ba-at
target: From Šukkutum to Tanawišti and Ištakušar: Ennam-Aššur has fled from me here.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na i-iš-ta-ku-ša-ar qí-bi-ma 5 pí-ri-kà-ni ša a ta-ad-mì-iq-tim ta-dí-ni-šu-ni ṣa-áb-tí-šu-ma KÙ.BABBAR ša-áš-qí-li-šu
target: To Ištakušar: Seize him concerning the 5 that you gave him as an interest-free loan and make him pay the silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma i-na-ki-ir-ki ší-bi a-na-ku i-šu-šu-um
target: If he contests you, then I have witnesses for him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma lá i-da-na-ku-nu-tí sí-ku-šu kà-i-lá É-šu
target: If he does not give it to you then detain him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša a-ki-ma-tum i-dí-nu-šu-ni a-ma-kam šu-ma KÙ.BABBAR i-na KÙ.BABBAR-pí-a il₅-qé ú šu-a-tí-ma ša-dí-na-šu
target: As to his house that Akimātum sold to him, if he has received the silver from out of my silver there, then make him pay as well.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-kam šu-ma i-iš-ḫi-li TÚG.ḪI.A e-ri-iš-ku-nu mì-ma TÚG.ḪI.A lá ta-da-na-šu-um
target: If Išhili asks you for textiles there do not give him any textiles.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ḫa-ra-ni a-ta-be-a-ma a-ta-lá-kam
target: I shall set out on my journey and come.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ma-na <gap> ša iš-tù ḫa-muš-tim ša a-šùr-ma-lik DUMU a-lá-ḫi-im li-mì-im i-na-a
target: minas of <gap> which Ennam-Aššur son of Šalim-Aššur owed to Dan-Aššur son of Šalim-ahum from the week of Aššur-malik son of Ali-ahum, eponymy Innaya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša i-ṣé-er en-um-a-šur DUMU ša-lim-a-šùr dan-a-šùr DUMU ša-lim-a-ḫi-im i-šu-ú KÙ.BABBAR ú ṣí-ba-sú en-um-a-šùr a-ḫu-šu ki-ma dan-a-šur ša-bu-ú
target: that silver and the accrued interest his brother Ennam-Aššur has been paid in full on behalf of Dan-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-um ḫa-ar-mu-um ša ḫu-bu-ul en-um-a-šur DUMU ša-lim-a-šùr ša e-li-a-ni sà-ar
target: A certified tablet concerning the debt of Ennam-Aššur son of Šalim-Aššur that may appear will be invalid.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI ku-ku-wa DUMU bu-da-tim IGI a-šur-{d}UTU-ši DUMU <gap> IGI PUZUR₄-a-šur <gap> dan <gap>
target: Witnessed by Kukuwa son of Budātum, by Ašsur-šamšī son of <gap>, Puzur-Aššur <gap>.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB ša ki-ma ku-a-tí
target: Sealed by your representatives;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 17 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am ù 7.5 GÍN KÙ.GI pá-ša-lam a-šùr-i-mì-tí DUMU e-ta-a i-na ší-im SÍG.ḪI.A ša ú-ší-na-lam il₅-qé
target: Aššur-imittī son of Etaya has received 17 minas of refined silver and 7.5 shekels of gold from the proceeds of Ušinalam's wool.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI e-nu-um-we-er DUMU šu-da-a IGI i-lá-áš-ra-ni DUMU sú-kà-li-a IGI en-na-sú-in DUMU i-dí-a-bi-im IGI DUMU a-bu-bu ta-ar-dí-im
target: Witnessed by Ennam-Wēr son of Šudaya, by Il-ašrannī son of Sukalliya, by Enna-Suen son of Iddin-abum, by Abūbu's younger son.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na 5-ší-šu šé-né-en na-áš-ú-ni-kum
target: They bring you for 5 pairs of shoes.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na ni-qí-šu a-na en-na-sú-in ni-a-im ù i-sá-a
target: 5 shekels of silver for his sacrifice for our own Enna-Suen and Isaya;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 GÍN a-na i-ku-pí-a
target: 3 shekels for Ikūn-pīya;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a me-er-i-šu
target: 1 shekel of silver for his son;

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫa-ma 18 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ší-im 2 TÚG.ḪI.A i-na li-bi me-er-e-šu
target: further, 18 shekels of silver, the proceeds from 2 textiles, is owed by his son;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 GÚ 10 ma-na AN.NA ku-nu-ki 52 TÚG SIG₅ 3 ANŠE.ḪI.A ṣa-lá-mu ku-nu-ki ša a-šùr-ba-ni ù be-lúm-ba-ni ša tám-kà-ri-im a-na PUZUR₄-a-<gap> ip-qí-du
target: 2 talents 10 minas of sealed tin, 52 good textiles, 3 black donkeys, sealed by Aššur-bāni and Bēlum-bāni and belonging to a merchant, they entrusted to Puzur-A<gap>.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu-qú-tám a-ni-tám PUZUR₄-a-<gap> a-na a-lá-ḫi-im ip-qí-id
target: Puzur-A<gap> entrusted these goods to Ali-ahum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-šùr-ba-ni DUMU ku-ta-a IGI SIG₅-pí-a-šùr DUMU ÌR-ad-ì-lí-šu DUMU a-šùr-i-dí
target: Witnessed by Aššur-bāni son of Kutaya, by Damiq-pī-Aššur son of Warad-ilīšu, (grand)son of Aššur-idī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ú-ṣur-ša-IŠTAR ù a-šur-ba-ni qí-bi-ma um-ma a-lá-ḫu-um-ma
target: To Uṣur-ša-Ištar and Aššur-bāni from Ali-ahum:

source: translate Akkadian to English: it-qú-ra-am ša Ì.GIŠ il₅-pu-tù-ku-nu-ni ta-al-qé-a
target: You have taken the spoon with which they anointed you with oil.

source: translate Akkadian to English: it-qú-ru-um 0.5 GÍN URUDU lá tù-ba-al ki-ma KÙ.BABBAR 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ù 0.3333 ma-na li-bi-i im-ta-ra-aṣ
target: The spoon is not worth 0.5 shekel of copper, but I became upset as if it was worth 10 or 20 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-kam a-na ú-ṣur-ša-IŠTAR dí-ší-ma a-na am-tim li-dí-ší
target: Give it to Uṣur-ša-Ištar there so he can give it to the maid.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma lá ta-dí-in-ší li-bi₄ i-ma-ra-aṣ
target: If you have not give it, I shall be upset.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR iš-ra-tim pu-šu-ki-in DUMU bu-za-zu i-na ku-bu-ur-na-at nu-ša-dí-in-ma
target: 1.5 mina of silver, the tithe, we collected from Pusu-ken, son of Buzazu, in Kuburnat.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ.BA 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR šu-sú-in DUMU áb-lá-ma-sí ú a-šùr-i-dí DUMU a-da-da ku-nu-ki ša wa-bar-tim ú ku-nu-ki-a a-na kà-ri-im i-ni-iš-ú
target: 1 mina of silver thereof Su-Suen, son of Abi-lamassi, and Assur-idi, son of Adada, are bringing to the karum under the seal of the wabartum and my seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR i-na tù-ùḫ-pí-a a-šùr-ma-lik DUMU ku-ra-ra e-pu-ul a-na kà-ri-im i-ša-qal
target: For 0.5 mina of silver Assur-malik, Kurara's son, gave his promise in Tuhpiya, he will pay to the karum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 15 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR DUMU a-lu-lá-a i-na ḫa-na-ak-na-ak nu-ša-dí-ma ku-nu-ki-ni li-ba-a ù ku-bi-a i-ni-iš-ú
target: 15 shekels of silver we collected from Alulaya's son in Hanaknak and under our seals Libaya and Kubiya are bringing it.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.3333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša-du-a-tám ni-mar-sú-in DUMU da-dí-a i-na du-ur-ḫu-mì-it nu-ša-dí
target: 0.3333 mana of silver, saddu'utu-tax, we levied from Nimar-Suen, son of Dadiya, in Durhumit.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.5 GÍN KÙ.AN iš-ra-tim šu-ma-bi₄-a DUMU a-šùr-e-li-tí nu-ša-dí-ma ku-nu-ke-e ša kà-ri-im du-ur-ḫu-mì-it i-na ší-na-ḫu-tim IGI wa-bar-tim a-na šu-a-nim DUMU me-na-nim ù ma-num-ki-{d}IŠKUR áp-qí-id-ma a-na kà-ri-im i-ni-iš-ú
target: 1.5 shekels of meteoric iron, the tithe, we levied from Sumi-abia, son of Assur-elliti, and under the seals of karum Durhumit I entrusted it in Sinahuttum before the wabartum to Su-Anum, son of Menanum, and Mannum-ki-Adad, who are bringing it to the karum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša-du-a-tám bu-ṣí-a ša ku-bu-ur-na-at i-na tù-ùḫ-pí-a nu-ša-dí-ma ku-nu-ki-ni {d}EN.LÍL-ba-ni DUB.SAR a-na kà-ri-im i-ni-ší-i
target: 10 shekels of silver, saddu'utu-tax, we levied from Busia of Kuburnat in Tuhpiya and under our seals Enlil-bani, the scribe, is bringing it to the karum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša-du-a-tám ṣú-
target: Half a mina of silver, saddu'utu-tax, we levied from the servants of Mannum-balum-Assur, son of Kukua.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB zu-ba DUMU en-na-nim
target: Seal of Zuba, son of Ennānum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ku-li-a qí-bi₄-ma um-ma a-ba-ba-a-ma šál-ma-ni ṣú-ḫu-ur-kà ša-lim ni-šu-kà šál-mu
target: To Kuliya, thus says Ababaya: We are well, your youngsters are well and your people are well.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-nam ša ta-áš-ta-na-pá-ra-ni um-ma a-ta-ma ṣú-ba-tí ḫa-am-ša-at šé-bi₄-li-im
target: What is the purpose of constantly writing me as follows: Send me five textiles!

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-nam ṣú-ḫa-ar-kà li-ku-ul mì-nam a-ṣí-tí-kà lá-áš-qú-ul šu-ma a-na a-bi₄-kà lá uš-té-ri-id
target: What should your youngsters eat, what should I (use to) pay for your expenditures if I had not for your father.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-ut-ma ú-ḫa-lá-qú-nu GA ša-ni-a-tù i pì-šu ša-ak-na
target: He said: "He is destroying you <gap> he has evil intentions!"

source: translate Akkadian to English: me-er-a-at-kà iš-tí-a ta-al-ta-<gap> um wa-áš-ba-at <gap> ša É a-bi₄-ni tim <gap> áb e ta-ḫi-ri-<gap> ta-áp-ḫi-ra-am a-dí-in-ma GU₄ aṭ-bu-ùḫ ší-ru-um ša i-ri-u ša-áp-lá-nu-um i-tab-ku
target: Your daughter is / keeps <gap> with me she lives <gap> of our paternal house <gap> I have sold the savings and slaughtered the ox. The meat which remained they have below.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 GÚ URUDU ag-mur <gap>-KAM ṣú-ùḫ-ur-kà lá i-mu-ut
target: I have spent 4 talents of copper <gap> your youngsters have not died!"

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma da-<gap>-ú-ma a-na a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi-ma
target: From Da<gap> (and <gap>) to Ali-ahum:

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ra-dí-ú <gap>-bu-tù-ma e-mu-qá-tám i-na ṣa-lá-tim KÙ.BABBAR ni-iṣ-ba-at-ma
target: guides have <gap> the silver, and we seized the silver by force in a quarrel,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ku-nu-ku ša a-mu-ur-ša-ra-sà 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR iš-tù ma-at ta-ḫu-ru-a ú-šé-ri-a-ma
target: and under the seal of Amur-šarrassa I brought 1 mina of silver from the land of Tahuruwa;

source: translate Akkadian to English: i qá-tí e-kà-li-e ni-iṣ-ba-sú-ma KÙ.BABBAR lá ú-šu-ru-ni-a-tí-ma a-na 2 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ú-ra-ki-sú-ni-a-tí
target: we then seized him on the authority of the men of the palace, but they did not release the silver to us, but they bound us over for 2 minas of silver,

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí ṭup-pá-áš-nu ta-du-nu
target: until you give him their tablet.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma iš-tí PUZUR₄-ma-lá-sú ṭup-pá-áš-nu lá ta-dí-in 2 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR <gap>-nu a-na e-kà-li-e ni-ša-qal
target: If you have not given their tablet together with Puzur-malasu, we shall have to pay 2 minas of silver<gap> to the men of the palace.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-pu-tum ṭup-pá-áš-nu dí-in
target: Urgent, give (them) their tablet.

source: translate Akkadian to English: e-lá-an 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR mì-ma ú-lá ni-iṣ-ba-at
target: We have not seized anything other than 1 mina of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ki-ma ṭup-pá-am ta-dí-nu é-kà-li ra-ki-is
target: When you have given the tablet, bind over the palace.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ta-ar-ki-is-tim lá i-šé-e-ú-ni-a-tí
target: They should not sue us over the contract.

source: translate Akkadian to English: PUZUR₄-ma-lá-sú a-šu-mì ki-a-am ni-iš-pu-ra-ku-um
target: For this reason we have sent you Puzur-malasu.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a qá-tí-šu ni-dí-in
target: We have given 1 shekel of silver to him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na na-áš-pè-er-tí-kà lá za-ku-a-ni <gap> tim KÙ.BABBAR ú-ša-áš-qí-lá-ku-mì-in
target: Had we not been cleared in your missive, <gap> would I have made him pay you the silver?

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 ma-na <gap> KÙ.BABBAR ša-du-a-sú ša-bu ku-nu-ki-a ú ku-nu-ki ša be-lá-nim a-na DINGIR-pì-lá-aḫ áp-qí-id
target: 5 minas <gap> of silver, its transport tariff paid, under my seal and the seal of Bēlānum I entrusted to Ilī-pilah.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 né-pí-šu 15 ma-na.TA ú iš-tí-in né-pí-šu-um 10 ma-na ni-is-ḫa-sú DIRI ša-du-a-sú ša-bu-ú ŠU.NÍGIN 42.3333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am ku-nu-ki-a a-na a-lu-wa ù e-ni-ša-ri-im áp-qí-id-ma
target: 2 packages of 15 minas each plus a single package of 10 minas, its import duty added, its transport tariff paid - in all 42 ⅓ minas of refined silver under my seal, I entrusted to Aluwa and Enišārum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-lim{ki} a ma-lá tí-ir-tí-šu a-ṣé-er ša-lim-a-šùr ú-šé-bi-il₅-šu-nu
target: I sent them to the City to Šalim-Aššur in accordance with his orders.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫa-ma 13.3333 ma-na URUDU SIG₅ a-na ga-am-ri-šu-nu ù 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na ú-ku-ul-tí-šu-nu a-dí-in
target: Furthermore, I paid 13 ⅓ minas of good copper for their expenses and 5 shekels of silver for their food.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI ili₅-ba-ni DUMU ba-ší-lam IGI a-ḫu-qar DUMU zu-ur-zu-ur IGI tù-ra-am-ì-lí DUMU e-dí-na-a-šùr
target: Witnessed by Ilī-bāni son of Baši-ilum, by Ahu-qar son of Zurzur, by Tūram-ilī son of Eddin-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫa-ma 10.3333 ma-na 3.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am <gap> tum ni <gap> 0.5 GÍN ṣí-ba-tim ša i-na ṣé-ri-a il₅-qé-ú-ni a-na ḫu-bu-li-šu a-na kà-ri-im wa-aḫ-šu-ša-na áš-qúl
target: Furthermore, 10 ⅓ minas 3 ½ shekels of refined silver <gap> ½ shekel interest that they took on my account, I paid for his debt to the Wahšušana colony.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṣí-ba-at KÙ.GI ša ší-ip-kà-at a-šur-bé-el-a-wa-tim i-ší-tù
target: The interest on the gold that remained of Aššur-bēl-awātim's investment.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ì-lí-e-mu-qí šu-ta-mu-zi a-bi₄-a-a e-lá-a ù lá-ma-sí qí-bi-ma um-ma a-dí-da ù a-lá-ḫu-um-ma
target: To Ilī-emūqī, Šu-Tammuzi, Abiya, Elaya and Lamassī from Adida and Ali-ahum:

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù ša-lim-a-šur me-tù-ú DAM.GÀR-ru-ú ša a-bi₄-ni ša a-ma-kam KÙ.BABBAR ša ḫa-bu-lu-ni i-a-tí ù en-um-a-šur lá-am-ni-iš e-pu-šu-ni-a-tí-ma sí-ku-ni ù ba-a-ba-tù-ni ṣa-bu-ta-ma
target: After Šalim-Aššur died our father's customers to whom he owed silver there treated me and Ennam-Aššur badly, we were detained and our outstanding claims blocked.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-tù-nu ta-áš-me-a-ma a-na a-lim{ki} ta-li-kà-ma a-lu-um dí-nam i-dí-in-ma
target: and you heard about it and went to the City assembly, and the City gave a verdict as follows:

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma KÙ.BABBAR ša-lim-a-šur i-na eq-lim ḫa-bu-ul i-na ṭup-pì-šu ù ší-bi₄-šu i-ku-an-ma i-na sá-bi-tí-šu KÙ.BABBAR-áp-šu i-lá-qé
target: if Šalim-Aššur owed silver abroad, it must be proved with his tablet and witnesses and he (the creditor) may then receive his silver from the funds available.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ḫu-bu-ul ša-lim-a-šur ša i-na a-lim{ki} ḫa-bu-lu ma-ma-an KÙ.BABBAR i-na eq-lim lá i-lá-qé
target: as for the debt that Šalim-Aššur owed in the City, noone could take any silver abroad.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ma-ma-an ša il₅-qé-ú ú-ta-ar ša lá ú-ta-e-ru i-ša-ri-iq-šum
target: Whoever took any would have to return it; who did not return it would have it taken away by force.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ba-ba ra-bi₄-ṣú-um ub-lá-ma KÙ.BABBAR ša ṣa-bu-tù ú-šé-ru-ma sí-ki-ni ú-kà
target: Ababa, the attorney brought a copy of the tablet of the City and they released all the silver that had been confiscated, but they detained us.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.3333 ma-na 3 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na PUZUR₄-a-šur IŠTAR-lá-ma-sí a-na ší-a-ma-tim ta-dí-in
target: Ištar-lamassī gave 0.3333 mina 3 shekels of silver to Puzur-Aššur for purchases.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB ba-zi-a šu-ḫu-bur ù ku-ul-ma-ku-ul-ma
target: Seal of Baziya, Šu-hubur and Kulma-kulma.

source: translate Akkadian to English: na-áš-pé-er-tí ma-ma-ḫi-ir ša 3 ma-na KÙ ú-šé-ru-šu-nu-tí-ni
target: Missive from Man-mahir stating that I released 3 minas of silver to them.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ša-lim-a-šùr qí-bi-ma um-ma šu-{d}DUMU.ZI a-dí-da e-lá-a ù la-ma-sí-ma
target: To Šalim-Aššur from Šu-Tammuzi, Adida, Elaya and Lamassī:

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na wa-ṣa-i-kà <gap> um-ma a-ta-ma a-šùr-DU₁₀ DUMU lu-lu KÙ.BABBAR 10 ma-na <gap>
target: When you left <gap> you said: Lulu's son Aššur-ṭāb <gap> at least 10 minas of silver <gap>"

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-ra-tí-šu ru-ba-um i-lá-qé
target: the king will receive its / his tithe.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na wa-ar-ki-tim a-we-lu-um a-na a-lim{ki} i-li-ik-ma um-ma šu-ut-ma a-na ší-a-ma-tim i-dí-nam
target: Later the man went to the City assembly and said: "He gave it to me for purchases.

source: translate Akkadian to English: qí-ip-tám a-dí 5 ša-na-tim qé-pá-ku
target: I was entrusted with a credit for 5 years."

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tí a-lim{ki} e-na-na-tim e-ri-iš-ma u₄-me-šu a-dí ša-na-at ša ki-ma šu-a-tí ú-ša-za-az-ma <gap>
target: He asked for a favour from the City assembly, and his representative will set his terms for a year and <gap>

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša ki-ma šu-a-tí uš-<gap> lu qí-ip-tám ta-qí-pu
target: his representative <gap> whether you entrusted on credit <gap>"

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 GÚ 10 ma-na AN.NA ku-nu-ki ša a-lim{ki}
target: 10 talents 10 minas of tin sealed in the City,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 me-at 23 TÚG.ḪI.A 24 ANŠE.ḪI.A ṣa-la-mu
target: 223 textiles and 24 black donkeys -

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ma a-nim en-um-a-šùr il₅-qé
target: all this Ennam-Aššur received.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ma-ma-ḫi-ir-ma a-na a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi₄-ma
target: From Man-mahir to Ali-ahum: Inform me

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma TÚG.ḪI.A ša lu-ḫu-za-tí-a ú-šé-ri-bu-nim lá ú-šé-ri-bu-nim úz-ni pè-té
target: whether or not they have brought in the textiles from Luhuzattiya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma ú-šé-ri-bu-ni-šu-nu a ma-lá ú-ša-ḫi-zu-kà a-na KÙ.BABBAR ta-er-šu-nu
target: If they have brought them in, then convert them to silver as I instructed you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫi a-ta i-ḫi-id-ma KÙ.BABBAR 1 GÍN šé-li-am
target: My dear brother, take care to raise every shekel of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: pá-zu-ur-ta-šu-nu 7.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR
target: Smuggling them cost 7.5 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.6666 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR iš-tí en-na-sú-in e-ri-šu-ma 7.5 GÍN dí-šu-nu-tí
target: They asked for 0.6666 minas of silver from Enna-Suen but give them 7.5 shekels.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-tí KÙ.BABBAR iš-tí-kà li-ib-ší
target: Let the rest of the silver be with you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na e-ša-ra ù ab-ša-lim qí-bí-ma um-ma en-nam-a-šur-ma
target: To Ešarra and Ab-šalim from Ennam-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ú ší-it-ra-am ku-nu-ki-a a-na e-ša-ra
target: 10 shekels of silver and an undergarment sealed by me is for Ešarra.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ú 2 pá-ar-ší-ke a-na áb-ša-lim ú ṣú-ḫa-ar-tim

target: Ulama has<gap> with Purušhaddum. Your textiles were stored and as they were not sold they were treated badly.

target: I gave them to a fuller for repairs with Aluwa as witness.

target: Write how much grain you have given to the lady. 4 sacks should be in her possession, so send me word for there is no silver. I shall send it to you with the proceeds from your textiles.

target: 2 textiles belonging to Šēp-Ištar, 3 belonging to Aššur-kāšid, 3 belonging to Šu-Nūnu, 2 belonging to Atata, 3 belonging to Lulu, 2 belonging to Aššur-rē'i.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠU.NÍGIN 17 TÚG ku-ta-nu ša kà-ṣa-ri-im
target: In all 17 textiles belonging to a harnessor.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 20 GÚ AN.NA šu-uq-lúm qá-du-um AN.NA qá-tim ku-nu-ku-ú 5 ma-na.TA it-ra-at šu-uq-lim 64 e-ma-ru ú-nu-sú-nu
target: 20 talents of tin, a package, including the expense-tin, under seal; 5 minas each (the weight of) the extras on the package; 64 donkeys and their harness.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 TÚG ša sà-a-tim 2 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am a-lá-ḫi-im 9 ku-sí-a-tim ma-lu-ki-a-tum 2 TÚG bu-ra-ú SIG₅ 1 GÚ ḫu-ša-ú 6 me-at sà-am-ru-a-tum i qé-er-bi₄-im 86 wa-ar-qá-tum 1 BANEŠ Ì.GIŠ ṭá-ba-am 15 SÌLA ri-iš-tám 0.3333 ma-na 2 GÍN sà-am-tám me-at sí-kà-ša-ru
target: 2 textiles of the ; 2 minas of refined silver of Ali-ahum; 9 robes of -type, 2 textiles of good quality, 1 talent of scrap metal, 600 nails, thereof 86 yellow ones, 30 litres of sweet oil, 15 litres of first class oil, 22 shekels of carnelian, 100 -stones.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-
target: All this I gave him to dispose over.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma kà-ru-um kà-ni-iš-ma a-na ša-qí-il₅ da-tim ku-li-a ší-ip-ri-ni wa-bar-tim ša ku-bur-na-at ḫa-na-ak-na-ak ú tí-iš-mur-na TUR GAL qí-bi₄-ma
target: Thus Kaniš, say to the datu-payers, our messenger Kuliya, the plenary of Kuburnat hanaknak and Tišmurna:

source: translate Akkadian to English: i {d}UTU-ši ṭup-pì-ni ta-ša-me-a-ni GÍR ša a-šur IGI ku-li-a ší-ip-ri-ni šé-ṣí-a-ma
target: As soon as you hear our letter, produce the dagger of Assur in the presence of our messenger Kuliya

source: translate Akkadian to English: ma-ma-an a-ma-kam KÙ.AN na-áš-ú lu a-na ší-mì-im a-na É.GAL-lim i-dí-nu lu a-dí-ni lá i-dí-in-ma na-ší
target: and whoever over there carries meteoric iron, whether he has already sold it to a palace or has not yet sold it and still carries it,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10-tim ša KÙ.AN ú ša-du-a-sú 1 ma-na-um 3 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša-ás-qí-lá-ma ku-li-a i pá-ni-šu-nu lu-ub-lam
target: make him pay the tithe on the meteoric iron and his -tax of 3 shekels of silver per mina. Let Kuliya personally(!) bring it here.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma i-qá-bi₄ um-ma šu-ut-ma KÙ.AN ša a-wi-lim ša NÍG.KA-sí 10-tim ú ša-du-a-sú le-qé-a-ma ša ba-ri-ni li-li-kam-ma GÍR ša a-šur li-it-ma-ma ša-du-a-sú nu-ta-ar ni-ša-me-ma
target: If one protests and declares: The meteoric iron belongs to a man with an account, still take the tithe and his -tax and let come here to swear an oath by Aššur's dagger then we will give his -tax back.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 30 ANŠE tù-i-mu-um DUMU a-šùr{ki} ḫa-ra-an sú-qí-nim ú-šé-ri-ba-am lá tù-i-mu-um ma-ma-an ḫa-ra-an sú-ki-nim e-ma-re sé-er-dam ú-šé-ri-ba-ni-ma a-ma-kam uš-té-bu-lu-ni lu wa-ší-ib kà-ri-im ú-šé-li-am
target: We hear that an Assyrian, Tūʾimum, has brought in 30 donkeys by way of the -road. Not just Tūʾimum, but anybody who has brought in a loaded donkey by way of the -road in order to do buisness there, or if an inhabitant of a has brought up (goods)

source: translate Akkadian to English: GÍR ša a-šur šé-ṣí-a-ma a-ḫu-um pá-ni a-ḫi-im ú-lá ú-ba-al
target: - produce the dagger of Aššur and people shall not spare eachother!

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na um 3 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša
target: Charge everyone his -tax at arate of 3 shekels of silver per mina, and make him pay the silver and let Kuliya personally(!) bring it here.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-dí-da a-lá-ḫi-im ú a-ba-a a-na a-ba-a qí-bi-ma um-ma SIG₅-pì-a-šur-ma
target: To Adida, Ali-ahum and Abaya; specifically to Abaya from Damiq-pī-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: ta-áš-pu-ra-am um-ma a-ta-ma 8 GÍN.TA AN.NA-kà ta-dí-in
target: You wrote as follows: Your tin was sold at the rate 1:8.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 TÚG a-bar-ni-am a-na 0.5 ma-na 0.3333 GÍN ta-dí-in
target: 1 Abarnian textile was sold for 0.5 mina 0.3333 shekel.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ša-nim 0.3333 ma-na 5 GÍN ú-kà-lu-ú
target: For the second one they offer 0.3333 mina 5 shekels.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR 0.3333 ma-na 1 GÍN ší-im TÚG.ḪI.A 21 ma-na URUDU e-zi-ba-ku-nu-tí-ni KÙ.BABBAR ub-lá-ku-nu-tí-ni KÙ.BABBAR ḫa-bu-lá-ku-nu KÙ.BABBAR ṭup-pì šé-ṣí-a-ma ṭup-pá-am li-it-a-ma li-be ṭup-pì-a id-a
target: As to both the 0.3333 mina 1 shekel of silver, the price of a textile, the 21 minas of copper that I left with you, as well as the silver that Abaya brought to you, the silver that I owe to Ṭāb-ṣill-Aššur - pay the silver, take out my tablet, split the tablet and place it among my other tablets.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB šu-bé-lim DUMU ku-zi-zi-a a-na a-la-ḫi-im DUMU a-dí-la-at DUMU a-ta-a
target: Seal of Šu-Bēlum son of Kuziziya; to Ali-ahum son of Adad-ellat, (grand)son of Ataya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫi a-ta a-na a-wa-at ṭup-pí-im i-ḫi-id-ma
target: My dear brother, pay heed to the words of the letter.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tí a-zu-ú tí-ir-ta-kà le-zi-ba-am
target: And let your message be left with Azu.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 9 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i li-bi a-šùr-{d}UTU-ši ù ku-ta-ba a-na ša-pá-ar-tim ú-kà-al
target: 9 shekels of silver owed by Aššur-šamšī and Kutaba I hold as security.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 20 ma-na URUDU ma-sí-am i-ṣé-er i-dí-a-bi-im ma-ma-ḫi-ir i-šu
target: Iddin-abum owes 20 minas of washed copper to Man-mahir.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ITU.KAM li-mu-um bu-zu-ta-a
target: Month Kuzallu, eponym of Buzutaya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ša-na-at i-ša-qal
target: He must pay in one year.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma lá iš-qúl 1 ma-na.TA i-na ITU.KAM ṣí-ib-tám a-na 10 ma-na-e ú-ṣa-áb
target: If he has not paid in time, he must pay interest at the rate 1 mina per ten minas per month.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI ṣí-lu-uš-da-gan IGI a-šùr-ba-ni
target: Witnessed by Ṣilluš-Dagān, by Aššur-bāni.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na 2 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i-ṣé-er me-a-ri a-lá-ḫu-um i-šu
target: Meari owes 1 mina 2 shekels of silver to Ali-ahum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù ḫa-mu-uš-tim ša a-šur-i-mì-tí ITU.KAM ša ke-na-tim li-mu-um ša qá-tí a-šur-i-mì-tí
target: Reckoned from the week of Aššur-imittī, month Ša-kēnātim, in the eponymy after that of Aššur-imittī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 GÍN.TA i-na ITU.KAM-im ṣí-ib-tám ú-ṣa-áb
target: He will add interest at the rate of 2 shekels (per mina) per month.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI šu-pu-na-aḫ-šu IGI a-na-lí ú-mì-šu
target: Witnessed by Šuppun-ahšu, by Annali his mother.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma i-ku-pí-a-šùr-ma a-na Ì-lí-a ù ku-ra qí-bi-ma 4.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR maš-kà-tám šu-be-lúm DUMU a-lu-lá-a ḫa-bu-lam ṣú-ḫa-ri a-na ṣé-ri-šu a-na ḫa-na-ak-na-ak a KÙ.BABBAR ša-áš-qú-lim áš-pu-ur-ma
target: From Ikūn-pī-Aššur to Iliya and Kura: Šu-Bēlum son of Alulaya owes me a deposit of 4.5 minas of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ut ṣú-ḫa-ri-a is-li-ma pu-úz-ra-am i-na pá-ni-šu-nu iṣ-ba-at-ma a-na a-lim{ki} i-ta-lá-ak
target: I sent my servants to him in hanaknak to have the silver paid, but he cheated my servants and hid himself from them and went to the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: me-er-ú-a a-tù-nu a-dí ma-lá ù 2 ší-ni-šu áš-pu-ra-ku-nu-tí-ma a-tù-nu mì-ma-ša-ma ú-lá ta-áš-pu-ra-nim
target: My dear sons, I have written you once or twice but you have sent me no answer at all.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iḫ-da-ma ki-ma na-áš-pár-tám ta-áš-me-a-ni mì-ma ša ki-ma tí-ir-tù-šu ta-aṣ-ba-ta-ni-ma qá-at-ku-nu ú-kà-lu na-áš-pè-er-ták-nu iš-tí a-nu-pì-IŠTAR ù a-ḫi-a li-li-kam-ma úz-ni pè-té-a
target: As you have heard my letter take care to send me word with Anu-pī-Ištar and my brother to inform me what from him you have seized and hold in your possession.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 TÚG SIG₅ i-na ša šé-ep sú-kà-a iš-tí a-nu-pì-IŠTAR ú a-ḫi-i-a šé-bi₄-lá-nim
target: Send me 5 good textiles from Sukaya's transport with Anu-pī-Ištar and my brother.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na Ì-lí-a qí-bi₄-ma TÚG-tí ša a-na DAM.GÀR tù-<gap>
target: To Iliya: The textiles that you <gap> to the merchant <gap>

target: To Uṣurānum, Ennam-Aššur and Ibni-Adad from Ṣill-Adad:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2.5 GÚ lu-lá-am 9 DUG a-lá-ni ib-ni-{d}IM na-áš-a-ku-nu-tí
target: Ibni-Adad brings you 2.5 talents of and 9 jars of acorns.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫu-ú-a a-tù-nu lu-lá-am ù a-lá-ni a ší-mì-im dí-na
target: My dear brothers, offer the and the acorns for sale.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 u₄-me-e ib-ni-{d}IM lá i-sà-ḫu-ur ṭur₄-da-ni-šu
target: Ibni-Adad must not tarry 5 days, send him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma KÙ.BABBAR ší-im lu-li-im ù a-lá-ni a-na ší-im 10 GÚ SÍG.ḪI.A ba-tí-iq KÙ.BABBAR ib-ni-{d}IM lu-ra-dí
target: If the silver, the proceeds of the and the acorns does not cover the price of 10 talents of wool, Ibni-Adad shall add the missing silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: sú-am ša en-um-a-šur ú-kà-lu a ší-mì-im dí-na-ší-ma KÙ.BABBAR-áp-šu li-il₅-qé-ma
target: The grinding-stone that Ennam-Aššur has, offer that for sale and let him take the silver for it,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù ṭup-pè-a ki-lá-li-ma ša ḫu-bu-li-a a-na ib-ni-{d}IM dí-na-ma lu-ub-lá-am
target: and give both of my tablets concerning my debt to Ibni-Adad so he can bring them.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na en-um-a-šur qí-bi-ma a-ḫi a-ta a-na-kam a-na ṣí-ib-tim e-né-kà lá ta-na-ší-ma i-dí-tí-šu lá ta-ṭá-ra-da-ni
target: To Ennam-Aššur: My dear brother, do not covet interest there and do not send me to court with him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù a-na-ku a-we-el gi-mì-lim ṣí-li-ni
target: I too am a man of favors.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi-ma um-ma MAN-a-šur-ma
target: To Ali-ahum from Puzur-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na KÙ.BABBAR ša a-na DAM.GÀR ḫa-bu-lá-ku-ni ḫa-ra-kà e ib-ší-ma
target: With the silver I owe to the merchant there must not be any caravan trip for you,

source: translate Akkadian to English: DAM.GÀR ṣí-ib-tám i-na ṣé-ri-a e il₅-qé-ma
target: so the merchant does not take interest on my account,

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na ṣé-er DAM.GÀR e ú-ri-i-qú-ni
target: and they must not alienate me from the merchant.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫi a-ta a-dí ša ḫa-ra-an sú-qí-nim tí-ir-ta-ak-kà a-na pá-ni-a li-li-kam-ma
target: My dear brother, send me word concerning the matter of the Narrow Track, so I can act to safeguard the merchant's silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR i-na qé-er-bi₄-ma ša 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR sà-ḫe-er-tám a-na pá-ni a-na ḫa-ḫi-im šé-bi₄-lam
target: There is 1 mina of silver, but of that send me small goods worth 5 shekels of silver to hahhum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-šu ša áš-ta-na-me-ú-ma am-tí a-dí-ni i-na wa-áš-ḫa-ni-a lu áš-ba-at-ni-ma
target: Why is it that I keep hearing that my maid is still staying in Wašhaniya and that you keep silent about it?

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ta ta-áš-ta-pu-ú a-lá a-ḫi-im ú lá a-wi-lim a-ta-áš-kà-an
target: I am treated like a non-brother and a non-gentleman.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫi a-ta am-tí šu-pur-ma li-ir-dí-ú-nim a-na ḫa-ar-pé
target: My dear brother, write about my maid so they lead her to me before harvest.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na 7.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am i-ṣé-er a-mur-IŠTAR DUMU da-da e-la-ma i-šu
target: 1 mina 7.5 shekels of refined silver Āmur-Ištar, son of Dada, owes to Elamma.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù ḫa-muš-tim ša a-la-ḫi-im ú {d}MAR.TU-ba-ni a-na 11 ḫa-am-ša-tim i-ša-qal
target: From the week of Ali-ahum and Amurrum-bāni he will pay in 11 weeks.

target: If he does not pay he will add 1.5 shekel as interest per mina per month.

target: Month II, eponymy of the successor of Ilšu-rabi, son of Baziya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI im-dí-lim DUMU šu-lá-ba-an IGI e-me-me-i DUMU a-zu-ta-a
target: In the presence of Imdī-ilum, son of Šu-Labān, of Ememe'i, son of Azutaya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: <gap> ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am <gap> GÍN KÙ.GI pá-ša-lam <gap> ma-na URUDU SIG₅ <gap> ma-na AN.NA <gap> ma-na ḫu-ša-ú <gap>-tum
target: <gap> minas of refined silver, <gap> shekels of pašallu-gold, <gap> minas of good copper, <gap> minas of tin, <gap> minas of scrap <gap>

target: Aššur-bāni son of Šalim-Aššur, Lā-qēp son of Izzizam-ilum, Ennānum son of Amriya;

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫa-ma a-šùr-ba-ni a-al-DU₁₀ ù e-lá-li-a a-na ší-bu-tim a-šu-mì šu-be-lim ù a-šùr-ta-ak-lá-ku
target: further, Aššur-bāni, Al-ṭāb and Elāli as witnesses concerning Šu-Bēlum and Aššur-taklāku.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB a-mur-{d}UTU DUMU mì-šu-ra-bi
target: Seal of Amur-Šamaš son of Miššu-rabi.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB na-bi-sú-in DUMU {d}AB-ba-ni
target: Seal of Nabi-Suen son of Illil-bāni.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB i-ku-pí-a-šùr DUMU šu-IŠTAR
target: Seal of Ikūn-pī-Aššur son of Šu-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um kà-ni-iš i-dí-ni-a-tí-ma
target: The Kanesh colony gave us for these proceedings.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pá-am ší-bu-tí-ni IGI GÍR ša a-šùr ni-dí-in
target: We gave our testimony before Aššur's dagger.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB kà-ri-im kà-ni-iš ṣa-ḫe-er GAL
target: Seal of the Kanesh colony in plenary session.

source: translate Akkadian to English: kà-ru-um kà-ni-iš ṣa-ḫe-er GAL dí-nam i-di-in-ma
target: The Kanesh colony in plenary session passed the following verdict:

source: translate Akkadian to English: ma-na KÙ.BABBAR be-ú-lá-at zi-ki-im a-na a-šùr-i-dí ir-ma-a-šùr i-ša-qal
target: mina of silver, the working capital of Zikum to Aššur-idī Ir'am-Aššur shall pay.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-lá-ḫi-im ú dam-qá-a qí-bi-ma um-ma ša-ta-na-ma a-na dam-qá-a qí-bi₄-ma
target: To Ali-ahum and Damqaya from Šāt-Anna; specifically to Damqaya;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ni-is-ḫa-sú DIRI ša-du-a-sú ša-bu-a-tí a-na ší-a-ma-tim a-na a-lim{ki} a-dí-na-kum
target: I gave you 2 minas of silver, its import duty added, its transport tariff paid to you, for purchases in the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-na-ku-ma AN.NA ša-ma-am a-ma-kam AN.NA ší-im KÙ.BABBAR-pì-a a-na a-lá-ḫi-im dí-in
target: I said: Buy tin for me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi₄-ma a-ḫi a-ta a-ma-kam dam-qá-a AN.NA li-dí-na-kum
target: Give the tin, the proceeds from my silver, to Ali-ahum there.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi₄-ma a-ḫi a-ta a-ma-kam dam-qá-a AN.NA li-dí-na-kum
target: To Ali-ahum: My dear brother, have Damqaya give you the tin there.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.6666 ma-na 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i li-bi₄ a-na-na
target: 0.6666 mina 5 shekels of silver is in the possession of Anna-anna.

target: We were not to bring in the house somebody to replace my son.

target: Because I became afraid, I was the one who has now brought one in.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lá tù-lá-mì-in
target: Do not get angry!

target: To Aššur-nimrī from Kurub-ilī: They do not want the copper you sent me.

target: They ask for scrap.

source: translate Akkadian to English: e-ma-ri i-na na-áb-ri-tim i-ta-ar-du
target: My donkeys have been brought to the paddock.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam sà-ḫe-er-tum i-na qá-tí-a lá-šu
target: No small goods are available for me here.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-kam sà-ḫe-er-tum šé-bi₄-lam
target: Send me some (from) there.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 ma-na URUDU aḫ-bu-ul-ma i-na URUDU ša tù-šé-bi₄-lá-ni il₅-té-qé
target: I borrowed 2 minas of copper from Lipit-Anum and he has taken it out of the copper you sent.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ma i-na ra-mì-ni-šu ú-lá i-dí-nam
target: He has not given me anything of his own.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma be-lí a-ta TÚG ṣú-ba-tí-a a-na ṣú-ub-ri-im ta-er-ma
target: If you are truly my lord, convert my textiles to a slave.

source: translate Akkadian to English: sú-ub-ru-um a-na-ma ša-bi₄ ú ṣú-ḫa-ri šé-ri-a-am
target: As for the slave, as soon as he has been paid in full, send the servants.

target: All this was consumed / paid during / from the .

target: Say to Šarra-Suen, thus says Aššur-rabi:

target: Your textiles and the rest of the oil are still available here.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša ki-ma ša-zu-za-tí-kà a-mì-ša-am i-ta-al-ku-nim
target: Your representatives have left to go there.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam ni-ki-iš-tum₁₀ ša kà-ri-im ša ki-ma a-na nu-a-im mì-ma ší-mì-im ma-ma-an lá i-du-nu
target: Here a decision by the colony is in force that nobody shall sell anything at all to the Anatolian.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.3333 ma-na 1 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ku-nu-ki-ni DU₁₀-ṣí-lá-a-šùr na-áš-a-kum
target: Ṭāb-ṣilli-Aššur is on his way to you with 21 shekels of silver.

target: Please my brother, send me a message telling me yes or no.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR 1 GÍN lá a-kà-al
target: I will not consume a single shekel of silver!

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma i-tur₄-DINGIR-ma a-na en-um-a-šùr qí-bi-ma
target: From Itūr-ilī to Ennam Aššur:

target: As to the matter concerning your father where I paid the balance for the owners of the silver and to which they would not agree,

target: today the men have agreed.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-nu-ma šu-pu-ur-ma me-er-ú a-we-lim li-li-ku-ni-ma a-li ús-ma-at-ni a-ta-ma mì-li-ik a-pu-tum
target: They said: Write so that the man's sons come here, and then you yourself decide what is fitting.

target: Urgent, is it not fitting with up to 5 minas of silver? Clear yourselves, come and take up the matter.

target: Send 1 talent of washed copper <gap> the other <gap> of good quality <gap> on my journey <gap>

target: and take washed copper for 10 minas of silver at the rate of <gap> minas of copper or higher,

target: and send me word so I may pay the silver here. Also, I shall send a donkey to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-šur-DU₁₀ DUMU a-zu-za-a ḫa-bu-lam ṭup-pu-šu ḫa-ar-ma-am ú-kà-al

target: The silver will come back.

target: If Ama'i will sell his goods for silver and has left on the narrow track,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2.3333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a-ta ú šu-ut ku-un-kà-ma a-ṣé-ri-a ú a-ṣé-er ša ki-ma šu-a-tí šé-bi₄-lá-nim
target: then he and you should seal 2.3333 minas of silver and send it to me and to his representatives.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tí um-mì-iš-ḫa-ra ù en-um-a-šùr pí-lá-aḫ-IŠTAR ù šu-be-lúm i-mì-ig-ru-ma KÙ.BABBAR 6.6666 ma-na ša É ḫi-na-a 4 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša kur-ub-IŠTAR DUMU a-lá-ḫi-im ù i-na ku-ur-sí-nim ša IŠTAR-pì-lá-aḫ 1.3333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR na-dí-šu-nu-tí
target: Šu-Bēlum and Ennam-Aššur reached the following agreement with Ummī-Išhara and Šu-Bēlum: 6.6666 minas of silver of the house of hinnāya, 4 minas of silver of Kurub-Ištar, son of Ali-ahum and from the 'pot' of Ištar-pilah 1.3333 mina of silver have been deposited for them.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR a-nàm pì-lá-aḫ-IŠTAR ù šu-be-lúm a-na um-mì-iš-ḫa-ra ù en-um-a-šur qá-sú-nu ik-bu-sú-ma ša-lá-áš šu-ba-tim qá-qí-ri ša 5-tum i-dí-nu-šu-nu-tí-ni
target: As for this silver, Pilah-Ištar and Šu-Bēlum have in favor of Ummī-Išhara and Ennam-Aššur dropped their right on a share <by giving them> a house-plot of 3, which the committee of five had given them.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tí um-mì-a-an e-lá-ma a-bi-šu-nu um-mì-iš-ḫa-ra ù en-um-a-šùr ú-bu-bu qá-qí-ri-šu-nu i-lá-qé-ú
target: When Ummī-Išhara and Ennam-Aššur effectuate a clearance with the investors of their father Elamma they will acquire their plot.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ITU.KAM té-i-na-tim li-mu-um en-na-sú-en₆ DUMU šu-a-šùr a-na 3 ša-na-tim qá-qí-ri-šu-nu ú-bu-bu-šu-nu-tí
target: Month X, eponymy of Ennam-Suen, son of Šu-Ištar. They will effectuate the clearance of their plot for them within three years.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma lá ú-bi-bu-ú 3 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR i-na ša kur-ub-IŠTAR i-lá-qé-ú-ma ší-im qá-qí-ri-šu-nu uš-ta-bu-ú-ma a-na qá-qí-ri-šu-nu ù-lá i-tù-ru
target: If they fail to do so, they will acquire 3 minas of the silver of Kurub-Ištar and so satisfy themselves with the value of their plot and will not vindicate their plot.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na 3 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša kur-ub-IŠTAR qá-tí pì-lá-aḫ-IŠTAR ù šu-be-lim ša-ak-na-at
target: On 3 minas of the silver of Kurub-Ištar a claim of Pilah-Ištar and Šu-Bēlum now rests.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma té-bi-ib-tum i-tab-ší qá-dí a-ḫi-šu-n
target: If the clearance has been effectuated they will be cleared together with their brothers.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na en-nam-a-šùr ù da-dí-a qí-bi₄-ma um-ma e-la-ma-ma
target: Say to Ennam-Aššur and Dadiya, thus Elamma:

target: then use 1 mina of this amount for buying Akkadian textiles. Buy for the present silver tin.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ú-zu-a il₅-qé
target: Uzuwa has received the silver.

target: If Šāt-Anna or Šāt-Anna's representative raise claim against Puzur-Aššur son of Aššur-dan.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú-zu-a DUMU li-bi₄-a ú-ba-áb-šu
target: Then Uzuwa son of Libbiya will clear him.

target: Witnessed by Nāb-Suen, by Ṭāb-ṣill-Aššur, by Ilabrat-bāni.

target: From Šalim-Aššur to Ali-ahum, Šēp-Ištar and Aššur-kāšid:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 34 ANŠE.ḪI.A ṣa-lá-mu ú ú-nu-sú-nu

target: Šalim-Aššur owes me 2 minas of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú 1 GÚ URUDU SIG₅ ša a-ma-kam ta-dí-na-šu-ni ṭup-pu-šu a-na 2 ḫa-am-ša-tim ḫi-ir-ma-ma a-na wa-aḫ-šu-ša-na 1 GÚ URUDU-i li-dí-na-ma i-na e-ra-bi-šu ú ṭup-pu-šu li-du-uk
target: Also, for the 1 talent of good copper that you gave him there certify his tablet for a term of 2 weeks, let him give me my 1 talent of copper in Wahšušana, and then when he arrives let his tablet be invalidated.

target: if there is tin available at a rate of 15 shekels (to 1), then buy it and send it to me.

target: The goods <gap> Send <gap> to Aššur-taklāku and A<gap> in Purušhaddum and let them sell it at whatever price and let the silver be available for me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 20 TÚG-té-e a qá-tí-a a-na É kà-ri-im ù 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ù 2 ma-na ki-ma KÙ.BABBAR i ni-kà-sí lá a-na-pá-al-ma li-bi₄ lá i-ma-ra-aṣ
target: (Place) 20 textiles on my account in the office of the colony, so I shall not balance 1 or 2 minas of silver instead of the silver at the accounting, and I shall not be unhappy.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ší-ip-kà-at ku-ra 7 GÍN.TA KÙ.BABBAR a-bu-ni iš qú-ul

target: Thereof we gave 0.6666 mina as excise (and) it became 3 shekels less due to purifying,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-tí KÙ.BABBAR-pì-ku-nu 16 ma-na 10.3333 GÍN

target: Aššur-mūtappil is leading this to you.

target: To Aššur-ṭāb, thus says Kuliya:

target: I myself guaranteed 1 mina of silver in Anah-ilī's name.

target: You gave me a tablet with your seal stating that you would not come back on Anah-ilī for the 1.3333 mina of silver of his debt-note.

target: As soon as he recieves that silver Abu-šalim will give to my and Anah-ilī's reprisentatives a tablet with his seal stating that he will not come back on Anah-ilī for the 1.3333 mina of silver recorded in his validated tablet.

target: And then I will give you back the tablet with your seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú na-áš-pè-er-tí a-ni tum i-mu-a-at
target: And this letter will be cancelled.

target: As to the 4 minas of silver that Enna-Suen owed to our father, 2.5 minas of silver, interest, 0.5 mina, expenses on the 5 minas of silver, I received from Enna-Suen.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR iš-tí DUMU uš-ḫa-ta
target: 1 mina of silver owed by Ušhata's son;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR iš-tí i-ku-pí-a DUMU <gap>
target: 2.5 mina of silver owed by Ikūn-pīya son of <gap>;

target: 1 talent of -copper owed by Shorty"; also Shorty gave me a slave-girl and left her with Ah-šalim.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-ma-ší-tí-ša a-dí-ni ú-lá al-qé
target: I have not yet received Šimašitiša.

target: In all: 30 minas 3 shekels of silver apart from the copper I received from the oustanding claims of my father.

target: I shall by no means show you any favours and I shall not make any payments in silver to you.

target: I myself paid 0.6666 mina 7.5 shekels of refined silver, my earnings, to Iddin-Aššur son of Dan-Aššur.

target: I personally spent 1 talent 40 minas (of copper) both when Iddin-Aššur led us to the court case and when they e the tablet with witnesses in the gate of the God, and Ṣilliya gave me half of that.

target: When I and Ababa travelled to Ilī-dan we were delayed on the journey until this very day, and we dropped his case.

target: I shall take my expenses from the silver of my father's house.

target: Ababa, the attorney of Šalim-Aššur, seized us against Ennam-Aššur son Šalim-Aššur and Ṣilliya, his brother Ali-ahum's representative.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-ba-ba ra-bi₄-ṣú-ma a-na en-um-a-šur ù ṣí-li-a ša ki-ma a-lá-ḫi-im 22 GÚ URUDU SIG₅ i-na li-bi₄-ku-nu
target: The attorney Ababa said to Ennam-Aššur and Ṣilliya, Ali-ahum's representative: 22 talents of good copper are in your possession.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma en-um-a-šur-ma ù ṣí-li-a ša ki-ma a-lá-ḫi-im a-ḫi-šu ke-na i-na li-bi₄-ni i-na kà-ni-iš a-na-ku ù a-ḫi-i ni-za-ku-ma a-li URUDU i-na li-bi₄-ni i-bu-ra-ni KÙ.BABBAR-áp-šu ni-ta-dí-a-ku-um

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um dur₄-ḫu-mì-it i-dí-ni-a-tí-ma IGI GÍR ša a-šur ší-bu-tí-ni ni-dí-in
target: The Durhumit colony gave us for these proceedings and we gave our testimony before Aššur's dagger.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI DU₁₀-ṣí-lá-a-šur IGI šu-ki-tim IGI en-nu-um-sú-in
target: Witnessed by Ṭāb-ṣill-Aššur, by Šukkutum, by Ennam-Suen.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma i-dí-a-šur-ma a-na ḫa-nu-nu <gap> a-lá-ḫi-im ù e-na-na-tim qí-bi-ma
target: From Iddin-Aššur to hanunu, Ali-ahum and Ennanātum:

target: Ennam-Adad owes worth 2 minas of refined silver at the market price in the City to a merchant.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-šu ḫa-ar-ma-am a-na-ku ú-kà-al
target: I personally have his certified tablet.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-nu-mì DAM.GÀR-ru-um ṭup-pu-šu <gap> 15 GÍN.TA <gap> na a-lim{ki} <gap> um <gap> KÙ.BABBAR <gap> az <gap> ṣí-ib-tim li-iṣ-ḫi-ir
target: When the merchant <gap> his tablet <gap> 15 shekels <gap> the City <gap> let him deduct <gap> of the interest.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṣí-ib-tám lá ta-ga-mì-lá-šu
target: Make him no favours on the interest.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša-áš-qí-lá-šu-ma iš-tí a-li-ki-im pá-ni-e-ma šé-bi₄-lá-nim
target: Make him pay and send it with the very first transport.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iḫ-da-ma ša-áš-qí-lá-šu
target: Take care to have him pay.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pá-am ša ḫu-bu-li-šu ša li-mì ša 30 ma-na iš-tí e-na-na-tim i-ba-ší
target: The tablet concerning his debt to the eponyms, concerning 30 minas, is in Ennanātum's possession.

source: translate Akkadian to English: <gap> a li-bi₄ ṭup-pè-a šu-uk-na-ma ù tí-ir-ta-ak-nu li-li-kam
target: Place it among my tablets and then send me word.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am i-ṣé-er ḫi-ta-ni DUMU DINGIR-na-da ku-li-a DUMU a-lá-bi₄-im i-šu
target: 1 minas of refined silver Hitani, son of Ili-nada, owes to Kuliya, son of Ali-abum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.5 GÍN.TA a-na 1 ma-na-im

target: Seal of the payers, of Kuliya, the messenger of Kanesh.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù kà-ri-im dur₄-ḫu-mì-it a-na kà-ar-kà-ar-ma ù wa-ba-ra-tim a-dí kà-ri-im kà-ni-iš
target: And of Durhumit, to every single and the, until Kanesh.

target: From Šalim-Aššur, Sabasiya and the merchant to Pilah-Ištar and Zikiki:

target: To Zikiki: Entrust this to Pilah-Ištar and join it to his consignment and then you personally may serve him and be positive over every shekel of silver.

target: There are two tablets that were written to Iliš-tikal and Pilah-Ištar and that have been transported by Zikiki - send them together with our silver <gap> as soon as possible.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na ṭup-pè-en₆ a-me-e-en₆ qá-tum ša-kà-nu-um wa-du tí-ir-tí a-lim{ki} da-nu-tù-um i-li-kam

source: translate Akkadian to English: qá-tum ša-kà-nu-um lá-šu we-da-ku ṭup-p
target: There is no way to lay claim. I am alone. Send those two tablets.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB ma-ma-ḫi-ir dan-a-šur DUMU PUZUR₄-a-šur a-lá-ḫi-im a-ḫi-šu ù šu-IŠTAR DUMU šu-ki-tim
target: Seal of Man-mahir, Dan-Aššur son of Puzur-Aššur, Ali-ahum his brother and Šu-Ištar son of Šukkutum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na en-um-a-šur DUMU ša-lim-a-šur
target: To Ennam-Aššur son of Šalim-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB šu-nu-nu DUMU a-mur-IŠTAR KIŠIB zu-zu DUMU en-um-ì-lí KIŠIB {d}MAR.TU-ba-ni DUMU šu-la-áb-ra-at
target: Seal of Šu-Nūnu son of Amur-Ištar, seal of Zuzu son of Ennam-ilī, seal of Amurrum-bāni son of Šu-Ilabrat.

target: Amurrum-bāni owes 8 shekels of silver to Irišum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na pá-ḫa-ar ad-ri-im i-ša-qal
target: He will pay at the gathering of the threshing floor.

target: If he has not paid he will pay interest at the rate 0.3333 shekel per month.

target: Eponymy after that of Amur-Aššur son of Karriya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ma-ma-ḫi-ir-ma dan-a-šur a-lá-ḫu-um ù šu-IŠTAR-ma a-na en-um-a-šur qí-bi-ma
target: From Man-mahir, Dan-Aššur, Ali-ahum and Šu-Ištar to Ennam-Aššur:

target: Why are you lying around there where there is no father and no mother, making the disease worse?

source: translate Akkadian to English: ki-ma a-na-kam a-na É DINGIR tù-ru-du-ma iš-tí DINGIR e-na-na-tim té-ta-ri-šu ù IGI i-li-kà tù-ta-na-nu-nu ù a-ḫu-um ù eb-ru-um li-ba-am i-da-na-ku-nu
target: Instead of going down to the temple here, asking mercy from the god, praying constantly to your god so that brother and friend could give you encouragement,

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ta a-ma-kam ki-ma a-we-lim ra-qí-im ša-na-at ta-ta-ša-áb ša tí-ir-tám ù ḫu-ša-ḫa-am lá tí-šu-ú
target: you have sat there for a year as an empty man, without purpose or wishes.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam um-me-a-nu a-bi-ku-nu ša ki-ma i-na pá-ni-tim té-ta-ta-ri-ša-ni a-na a-ḫi-kà ú-kà-lu-ma ù ki-ma a-ḫu-kà we-dí-ni-ma ù a šu-mì-kà ma-ga-ra-am ú-lá i-mu-a
target: Your father's investors here offer those things to your brother which you earlier constantly asked me for, but, in fact, since your brother is alone he is of course unwilling to agree on your behalf.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-pu-tum i-na ša-am-ší ṭup-pí-ni ta-ša-me-ú tí-ib-a-ma a-tal-kam
target: Urgent, set out and come here the very day you hear our letter!

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù a-ḫi-ú-tum i-ta-bu-lu-kà
target: Also, strangers may carry you away all the time.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR 10 GÍN lu a-na ANŠE.ḪI.A lu a-na ḫi-ša-nim gu₅-mu-ur-ma tí-ib-a-ma a-tal-kam
target: Agree to some 10 shekels of silver either for donkeys or for a pole and set out and come.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam É a-bi-ku-nu za-ki-a ma-ma-an ša-li-um i-na ṣé-ri-ku-nu lá i-ša-lá
target: Clear up the affairs of your father's house here. No evildoer should harm you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú-um-šu-ma be-el a-wa-tí-ku-nu i-na a-wa-tí i-ra-de₈-ú-k
target: Until now your accusers have been pestering you with lawsuits.

target: And in particular to Aššuriš-tikal:

target: 0.3333 mina of silver, which here Buṣu'a? for half of it <gap> when I was about to start my journey he has <gap> me and he drew up a record with you as guarantor.

target: And you said: 'After your departure <gap> Give me a -textile then I will take responsibility for the silver and the interest on it.

target: You can reach me.' You are staying there until this very day.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú a-na-ku ku-a-tí ta-ak-lá-ku-ma a-dí u₄-mì-im a-ni-im iš-tí a-ḫi-im ú eb-ri-im ku-ta-nam lá ú-šé-bi-lam-ma a-ma-kam a-na KÙ.BABBAR lá i-dí-in
target: And I, I trusted you, but until this very day he did not send me a -textile with a friend or colleague, nor did he sell it over there.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR a-na zu-ú-lu lá i-<gap> a-ta a-na u₄-mì-im a-nim ta-áš-ta-pu
target: And ? the silver to Zûlu. And you, until this very day you have kept silent!

target: Aššur and the god(s) of our father may witness <gap> give <gap>.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na e-ri-iš-tí-šu i-té-zi-iz
target: he carried out his wishes.

target: Later the colony dispatched Damiq-pī-Aššur as envoy and he rejected the wishes of the colony and accepted Itūr-ilī's wishes.

target: also, the letter that Itūr-Ilī sent to the king of Tawniya, Damiq-pī-Aššur, as the envoy of the colony, read it aloud.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫu be-lu a-tù-nu a-tù-nu a-ma-kam ší-ta-lá-ma
target: so, dear brothers and lords, take counsel there.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ki-ma a-lúm{ki} ù É a-bi₄-a ḫa-bu-lu ep-ša-a
target: and act because the City and my father's house have been turned into debtors.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-wi-lam₅ ú-ša-sà-ḫa-am
target: I shall have the man extradited.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ki-ma da-me-e ša a-ḫi-a lá ik-šu-du
target: Since he did not acquire my brother's blood-money.

target: and since he bothered (me) with the silver of my father's house for two years.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù a-ḫi a-šu-mì a-mu-tí-šu sú-ri-e dí-ku-ma
target: and my brother surely was killed because of his iron.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-kam i ša-ḫa-at a-ḫa-tí-a ù me-er-a-at a-ḫi-a i-zi-za-ma
target: (therefore) assist my sister and my brother's daughter there.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-lam₅{ki} mu-ùḫ-ra-ma ra-bi-ṣa-am da-na-am aḫ-za-nim

target: The rest of the silver, 0.3333 mina 4 ½ shekels is owed by you. My dear brother, give the silver and the purchases to Aššur-muttabbil.

target: I too am capable of doing you favours.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ITU.KAM ku-zal-li li-mu-um bu-zu-ta-a
target: Month Kuzallu, eponymy Buzutaya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ša-na-at i-ša-qal
target: He will pay within a year.

source: translate Akkadian to English: DUB a-ku-ú-a DUMU a-šùr-i-dí
target: Tablet of Akūa, son of Aššur-idī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB en-na-sú-in DUMU i-dí-a-bi-im

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù a-we-lam e-mu-qí-in e-ta-ú ma-ṣa-ni a-na ša-sú-ḫi-šu

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú a-tù-nu lu e-mu-uq ší-ip-ri-ni

target: The interest on the 51 minas of silver we borrowed for you at a merchant's house amounted to 4 minas and 15 shekels of silver.

target: Total: 55 minas 15 shekels, including its interest.
