source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na zu-ku-a qí-bi-ma um-ma PUZUR₄-a-šur-ma šál-ma-ku
target: To Zukuwa from Puzur-Aššur: I am well.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i dur₄-ḫu-mì-it wa-áš-ba-ku
target: I stay in Durhumit.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na ḫu-ra-ma 1 ku-ta-nam i-ṣé-ri-a il₅-qé
target: He took 1 on my account in hurama.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù ḫu-ra-ma a-dí dur₄-ḫu-mì-it 0.5 ma-na 2 GÍN.TA da-tum a-na ANŠE ik-šu-ud
target: The fees from hurama to Durhumit amounted to 0.5 mina 2 shekels per donkey-load.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫi a-ta we-da-ku mu-ša-ki-il₅ ANŠE ú ša ba-áb-tí ú-šé-ṣa-a-ni ú-lá i-šu
target: My dear brother, I am alone. I have no one to feed the donkey or realise the outstanding claims.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 ṣú-ḫa-ri ša li-ba-kà i-de₈-ú šu-up-ra-ma iš-tí-in ANŠE.ḪI.A lu-ša-ki-il₅ iš-tí-in i ša-ḫa-tí-a li-zi-iz-ma
target: Send me 2 servants whom you know well, so one can feed the donkeys and one can assist me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a <gap> ṣú-ba-tám a-tù-nu <gap> šé-ṣí-a-ma lá-ma ku-ṣí-im a-na bu-ru-uš-ḫa-dim le-ru-ub
target: a textile you yourselves should produce so I can enter Purušhaddum before the cold.

source: translate Akkadian to English: na-áb-ri-tum lá i-kà-ša-da-ni
target: Winter should not catch up with me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam ú-ku-ul-tí ANŠE.ḪI.A da-na-at
target: Here fodder for the donkeys is hard to get.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-ḫi-id-ma ṣú-ḫa-ri ṭur₄-da-ma ku-ṣú-um lá i-kà-ša-da-ni
target: Take care to send me servants and the cold should not catch up with me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ḫa-ra-ni le-pu-uš
target: Let me go on a trip.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na {d}UTU-ši ša ṭup-pí ta-ša-me-ú we-da-ku ṣú-ḫa-ri ṭur₄-da-am
target: The very day you hear my letter - since I am alone, send the servants!

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 ma-na 16.1666 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am i li-bi e-na-a-šur DUMU a-mu-ra a-šur-ni-šu DUMU ì-lí-ILLAT-tí i-šu
target: Ennam-Aššur son of Amuraya owes 2 minas 16.1666 shekels of refined silver to Aššur-nīšu son of Ilī-ellitī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI ku-li-a DUMU a-lá-bi-im IGI ur-ad-a-šur DUMU DIRI-im IGI a-šur-ma-lik DUMU sá-ma
target: Witnessed by Kuliya son of Ali-abum, by Urad-Aššur son of Watrum, by Aššur-malik son of Samaya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-pu-na-aḫ-šu ṣú-ḫa-ru-um ša a-we-el-tim i-li-kam-ma
target: Šuppun-ahšu, the lady's servant, came and

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-mì a-we-el-tim 2 ma-na KÙ a-na GAL sí-mì-il₅-tim áš-qúl
target: in the name of the lady I paid 2 minas of silver to the Chief of the Staircase.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 15 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR li-tí SIG₅ i-ṣé-er wa-al-ḫi-iš-na pé-ru-wa ù tù-wa-tù-ú-i a-ší-tí-šu lá-ma-sà-tum tí-šu
target: 15 shekels of refined silver Walhišna, Peruwa and Tuwatuwi, his wife, owe to Lamassutum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù ḫa-mu-uš-tim ša i-na-a a-na ša pá-ar-kà i-ša-qú-lu
target: Reckoned from the week of Innāya not later than the festival of Parka they will pay.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma lá iš-qú-lu 1.5 GÍN.TA ṣí-ib-tám ú-ṣú-bu
target: If they do not pay they will add interest at a rate of 1.5 shekel.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ITU.KAM a-lá-na-tim li-mu-um a-šur-i-mì-tí
target: Month XII, eponymy of Aššur-imittī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR i qá-qá-ad šál-mì-šu-nu ra-ki-is
target: They are jointly liable for the silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma i-na u₄-me-šu-nu lá iš-ta-aq-lu tù-wa-tù-wi ú-šé-ṣa
target: Should they not pay when their term is due, then I will take away Tuwatuwi.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI ša-ar-ni-ga-a-šu IGI e-na-a-šur
target: In the presence of Šarnigāšu, and of Ennam-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ma-ma-ḫi-ir šu-ku-tum ú i-ku-pì-a-ma a-na a-la-ḫi-im qí-bi-ma
target: From Man-mahir, Šukkutum and Ikūn-pīya to Ali-ahum:

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na 24 pí-ri-kà-ni ša ḫa-nu ub-lá-ni iš-té-en ḫa-nu a-na li-tab-ší-šu il₅-qé
target: Of the 24 that hanu brought, hanu has taken one for his clothes.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-té-en a-na ú-ku-ul-tí-šu šu-ut-ma il₅-qé
target: He has also taken one (to pay) for his food.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-tí ṣú-ba-tí-kà 22 TÚG 4.83334 GÍN.TA ta-ad-nu
target: The rest of your textiles, 22 pieces, were sold for 4.8333 shekels each.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR-áp-šu-nu 1.6666 ma-na 6.6666 GÍN
target: Their value in silver was 1.6666 mina 6.6666 shekels.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ.BA 5 GÍN KÙ e-ri-ib-tum ša AN.NA i-na wa-aḫ-šu-ša-na PUZUR₄-a-be-eḫ il₅-qé
target: Thereof Puzur-Abeh has taken 5 shekels of silver, entrance tax for the tin, in Wahšušana.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na 4.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na am-tim ni-iš-qú-ul
target: We paid 0.5 mina 4.5 shekels of silver to the maid.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ì-lí-áš-ra-ni ir-dí-a-kum
target: Ilī-ašrannī led it to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 ma-na a qá-tí-šu ni-dí-in
target: We gave 4 minas for his expenses.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-tí KÙ.BABBAR-pì-kà 1 ma-na 6 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ku-nu-ki-ni ḫa-nu na-áš-a-kum
target: hanu brings you the rest of you silver, 1 mina 6 shekels of silver under our seals.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na šu-IŠTAR qí-bi-ma um-ma zu-ba ma-ta-ga-<gap> ú {d}UTU-ba-ni-ma
target: Say to Šu-Ištar, thus Zuba, Mataga<gap>, and Šamaš-bāni:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-šu-mì ša-áp-tim ša ta-áš-pu-ra-ni eṭ-lu-tum i-ma-qú-tù-ni-ma ša-áp-tám iš-té-ni-iš₆ ni-dá-an-ma KÙ.BABBAR ni-zu-wa-azₓ KI i-<gap> a-na pu-šu-ki-in nu-šé-ba-lam
target: As for the wool about which you wrote, when the men arrive here we will sell all the wool together and we will divide the silver and with <gap> we will send it to Pūšu-kēn.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a šu-mì É-be-et DAM.GÀR-ri-im ša sà-im qá-áb-a-tí-ni a-na-kam iš-tí ir-ma-a-šur a-ta-am-ga-ar um-ma šu-ut-ma té-er-tù-šu a-ṣé-er i-ku-pì-a-šur ú i-a-tí li-li-kam-ma la-dí-na-ku-um
target: As for calling at a merchant's house (for a loan), as you have promised, I have here now come to an agreement with Ir'am-Aššur and he said: 'Let his instruction come to Ikūn-pī-Aššur and to me, then I will give it to you'.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na 8 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pí-im ì-dí-ba-ni ì-li-a-lúm ù mì-šu-ra-bi ú-kà-nam
target: For 8 minas of refined silver Idi-bāni shall confirm for me Ilī-ālum and Mīšur-rabi('s liability).

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-ku ú ì-dí-ba-ni mì-ìš-lá <gap> ú ṭup-pu-šu ḫa-ar-ma-am i-da-namₓ
target: (that) I and Idi-bāni are each (entitled to) half the amount.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša KÙ.BABBAR 8 ma-na ḫa-bu-lu šu-ma lá uk-ta-i-na-šu-nu ú ṭup-pu-šu ḫa-ar-ma-am lá i-ta-ad-nam
target: Moreover, he shall give me a valid record of his stating that he owes 8 minas of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na mu-nu-a-tí-a a-na 4 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ì-dí-ba-ni PUZUR₄-a-šur i-šé-e
target: Should he fail to confirm them and also to give me his valid record, (then) Idi-bāni shall sue Puzur-Aššur for my computed share, for 4 minas of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI su-{d}EN.LÍL IGI šu-ki-tim IGI a-mur-IŠTAR IGI šu-be-lúm
target: In the presence of Šu-El<lil>, of Šuk(k)utum, of Amur-Ištar, and of Šu-Bēlum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí-da ù a-lá-ḫu-um a-šùr-iš-ta-ki-il₅ iš-ú-lu-ma
target: Adida and Ali-ahum questioned Aššuriš-takil as follows:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3.3333 ma-na KÙ.GI ša-lim-a-šùr a-na na-ru-qí-kà a-dí-im-ma
target: Šalim-Aššur invested 3.3333 minas of gold in your joint-stock capital,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša 10 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR na-ru-qá-kà ú-la-pí-tám
target: and he wrote an amount of 10 minas of silver for your joint-stock capital.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša-lim-a-šùr i-na a-lim{ki} a-na li-mì-im ḫa-bu-ul-ma
target: Šalim-Aššur is indebted to the eponym in the City,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pá-am ša ší-ip-kà-tim ša-lim-a-šùr ad-ma-ku-ni
target: and the tablet of the investment Šalim-Aššur made to you,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pá-am šu-wa-tí qá-tí li-mì-im ú-kà-al-ma
target: that very tablet is in the eponym's possession,

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ù né-ma-al-šu dí-in-ma a-ṣé-er li-mì-im li-li-ik-ma
target: so pay the silver and the accrued profit, let it go to the eponym

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù ṭup-pá-am ša ší-ip-kà-tí-kà a-na ša ki-ma ku-wa-tí li-dí-nu
target: and then he can give the tablet concerning your capital to your representatives.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù <gap> 3 ša-na-tim iš-tù bu-ru-uš-ḫa-dim lu ta-li-kam
target: Three years ago you came from Burušhaddum

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù a-na iš-té-en ù ší-na tap-pá-e-a KÙ.BABBAR ù né-ma-al-šu ta-dí-in
target: and you have given the silver and the accrued profit to one or two of my partners.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-ku ù ša qá-ta-at a-bi-a-a na-al-pu-tù ni-ta-na-lá-kà-ku-um
target: But I and those who signed as my father's guarantors come to you time and again,

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ù né-ma-al-šu ta-dá-na-am ú-lá ta-mu-a
target: but you refuse to give the silver and its accrued profit.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ṣé-er ki-a-am-ma KÙ.BABBAR 1 ma-na ù 2 ma-na tù-uš-ta-ag-me-er-šu
target: On top of this you have caused him to have expenses of one or two minas.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ša li-mì-im a-na ṣí-ib-tim lá i-ma-id-ma
target: The interest on the silver of the eponym must not increase

source: translate Akkadian to English: É a-bi-a ù ší-ip-kà-tim ša a-bi ad-ma-ku-ni lá i-ta-ba-lá
target: and my father's house and the investments my father made for you must not be lost.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-ma-at KÙ.BABBAR dí-na-ma a-na É li-mì-im
target: Give me the agreed amount in silver, let me send it to the eponym's office,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú a-ma-kam ṣí-lu-lu ḫa-sí-is-ma na-áš-pé-er-tù-šu ù na-áš-pé-er-ta-kà a-na ṣé-er a-we-li tap-pá-e-šu lu a-na ša ki-ma šu-a-tí
target: Also, remind Ṣilulu there that his missive as well as your missive to the men who are his partners as well as his representatives.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam ṭup-pí-šu-nu lu ni-il₅-ta-qé
target: We have taken their tablet here.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-ḫi-id-ma tí-ir-ta-kà le-zi-ba-am
target: Pay attention and leave your instructions.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ša ki-ma i-a-tí qí-bi-ma um-ma MAN-a-šur-ma a ma-lá tí-ir-tim ša zu-ku-a a-ḫi-iṭ-ma iš-tù 3 ITU.KAM ší-mì ga-me-er
target: To my representatives from Puzur-Aššur: In accordance with the message from Zukua I have checked and my purchases were concluded 3 months ago.

source: translate Akkadian to English: URUDU lá-mu-num 20 GÚ i-ba-ší-ma um-ma a-na-ku-ma 10 GÍN-šu lá-ak-bu-ús-ma ḫa-ra-ni lá-ta-lá-ak
target: About 20 talents of poor copper are here, so I said: Let me remit 10 shekels on it and then leave on a journey.

source: translate Akkadian to English: URUDU lá-ma-dam ú-kà-in
target: I confirmed being aware of the copper.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na 30 ma-na URUDU TA ú-kà-in
target: I confirmed for 30 minas of copper each.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na 1 GÚ 30 ma-na URUDU a-na ar-nim kà-ru-um i-dí-ni
target: The colony imposed a penalty on me of 1 talent 30 minas of copper.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-šé-pá-tí-šu-nu mì-ta-qú-tim ù ip-ra-am a-qá-qá-dí-a ší-ta-pu-ki-im 45 ma-na URUDU SIG₅ i-ṣé-ri-a il₅-qé-ú-ma
target: By constantly falling at their feet and constantly pouring dust on my head (I achieved that) they have taken (only) 45 minas of good copper on my account.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša pì-lá-tim e-pu-uš-ma i ša-am-ší <gap> ša ṭup-pu-um lá-pu-ta-ku-ni ḫa-ra-ni a-ta-lá-ak
target: and I have made <gap> and on the very day the letter is written to you I shall leave on a journey.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ki-ma ú-ku-ul-tí e-ma-ri da-na-at-ni ù we-da-ku-ni-ma ma-ma-an iš-tí-a lá-šu-ú e-ma-ri a ší-mì-im <gap> a-tí-dí-in
target: Since fodder for the donkeys is hard to acquire and I am alone with no one staying with me, I have offered the donkeys for sale <gap>.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ma-lá <gap> áš-pu-ra-kum um-ma a-na-ku-ma 13 ma-na AN.NA ša a-na en-um-a-šur DUMU na-ra-am-ZU a-dí-nu ša-áš-qí-il₅
target: I wrote you, saying: "Have the 13 minas of tin that I gave to Ennam-Aššur son of Narām-Sīn paid."

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma e-na-sú-in-ma a-na a-šur-mu-ta-bi₄-il₅ ú a-šur-SIG₅ <gap> qí-bi₄-ma a-ḫu-ú-a a-tù-nu i-na {d}UTU-ši na-áš-pé-er-tí ta-ša-me-a-ni
target: From Enna-Suen to Aššur-muttabbil and Aššur-damiq:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na 3.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am be-ú-lá-at a-šùr-i-mì-ti
target: 1 mina and 3.5 shekels of refined silver, is the working capital of Aššur-imittī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tí KÙ uk-ta-al
target: He is held by the silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma a-na a-lim{ki} lá ik-šu-dam-ma iš-tí-a lá is-ri-dam
target: If he does not arrive in the City and does not pack together with me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù ḫa-mu-uš-tí-im ša ì-lí-ìš-tí-kál ù šu-a-nim 1.5 GÍN.TA 1 ma-na-im i ITU.KAM ú-ṣa-áb
target: Then from the week of Iliš-tikal and Šu-Anum he will add an interest of 1.5 shekel per mina per month.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI lá-qé-pì-im IGI a-šur-ma-lik
target: In the presence of Lā-qēpum, of Aššur-mālik.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-um ša a-lim{ki} ša be-ú-lá-tí-šu sà-ar
target: The tablet in the City concerning his working capital is invalid.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-lu-lá-a ú a-mur-IŠTAR-ma a-na en-um-a-šur qí-bi₄-ma na-áš-pé-er-tám ta-áš-pu-ra-ni-a-tí
target: From Alulaya and Amur-Ištar to Ennam-Aššur: You have sent us a missive.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ki-ma a-we-lu ma-du-tum lá-pu-tù-ni na-áš-pè-er-tám lá nu-ša-áš-me-ma ni-ip-nu-šu-ma um-ma né-nu-ma i li-bi-kà-ma <gap> ra ší um i-ba-ší ú na-áš-pé-er-tí-kà a-ṣé-er a-we-lim li-li-ik
target: Since many men were noted down, we have not let anyone hear the missive, but we confronted him and said: <gap> is in your possession and let your missive go to the man.

source: translate Akkadian to English: na-áš-pè-er-tám <gap> lá i-mu-a um-ma né-nu-ma na-áš-pé-er-tám <gap> li-tám IGI be <gap> a-mur ma lá i-li-bi₄-<gap> i-ba ma kà i <gap> na-áš-pé-er-tí-ni za-ku-tum a-ṣé-er en-um-a-šur li-li-ik
target: He refused to <gap> the missive. We then said: "The missive <gap> witnessed by<gap> Our final missive shall go to Ennam-Aššur."

source: translate Akkadian to English: 16.8333 ma-na NA₄.ZA.GÌN 20 GÚ 50 ma-na URUDU ma-sí-am 30 GÚ URUDU lá-mu-nam mì-ma a-nim IGI a-lu-lá-a ú ar-ší-aḫ ú-kà-in
target: 16.8333 minas of lapis lazuli, 20 talents 50 minas of washed copper and 30 talents of bad copper - all this he confirmed with Alulaya and Arši-ah as witnesses.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí a-ni-tim a-mur-IŠTAR KÙ.BABBAR-ma ri-iš tí-ir-tí-ku-nu ú-kà-al
target: Concerning this Amur-Ištar keeps the silver in accordance with your instructions.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma né-nu-ma ma-ma-an i-na um-me-a-ni-ku-nu lu tí <gap> tám i-na ša-am-ší ša ṭup-pì-ni ta-ša-me-ú qá-qá-dí-kà ki-a-ma <gap> a-ma a-tal-kam i-<gap> lá ša ša-lá-at ṭup-<gap>-ma en-um-a-šur li-li-kam-ma iš-tí a <gap> a ú a lá ša ša ki ú 2.5 ma-na.TA <gap>-šu-ni ki-am <gap>
target: We said: "Who among your investors <gap>?" The very day you hear our letter <gap> your head in this way and come<gap> Ennam-Aššur should come and with<gap>"

source: translate Akkadian to English: 28 TÚG ku-ta-ni ù 1 ANŠE.ḪI.A ṣa-lá-mu-um šu-bé-lúm il₅-qé
target: Šu-Bēlum received 28 kutānu-textiles and 1 black donkey.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma lu-qú-tum a-na ša a-we-lá-tim ù šu-bé-lim lá i-tù-ar ší-im-šu-nu KÙ.BABBAR šu-bé-lúm a-na ša-lim-a-šùr i-ša-qá-al
target: If the goods do not become the property of the woman and Šu-Bēlum, he must pay the proceeds from their sale in silver to Šalim-Assur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ.BA 0.6666 ma-na 2 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR lu pá-zu-ur-tám lu ni-ip-lá-tim šu-bé-lúm iš-qú-ul
target: Of this, Šu-Bēlum has paid 42 shekels of silver, either smuggler's goods or balance payments.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu-qú-tám ša PUZUR₄-a-šùr DUMU i-šar-ki-da-a-šur ú-šé-li-a-ni-ni
target: Goods that Puzur-Aššur son of Išār-kitt-Aššur brought up here.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI ku-zi-zi-a IGI en-um-a-šùr DUMU ba-ba-a
target: Witnessed by Kuziziya, by Ennam-Aššur son of Babaya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ma-nu-ki-a-šur ù a-na-na qí-bi-ma um-ma en-um-a-šur-ma
target: To Mannum-kī-Aššur and Anna-anna from Ennam-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ṭup-pá-am ša ba-áb DINGIR ša 9.5 ma-na 3 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša ší-bu-tí a-lu-lá-a ù lá-qé-ep ù 1 ṭup-pu-um ša 5 GÚ URUDU ša ḫu-bu-ul ku-ra ku-nu-ki-a a-kà-li ÌR ša a-šur-ma-lik na-áš-a-ku-nu-tí
target: Akali, Aššur-malik's slave is bringing you under my seal 1 tablet from the Gate of the God concerning 9.5 minas 3 shekels of silver, with the testimony of Alulaya and Lā-qēp, plus 1 tablet concerning 5 talents of copper from Kura's debt.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-kam iš-tí a-na-na li-ib-ší-ú
target: Let them remain there with Anna-anna.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-kam im-ra-mu-ša a-na ba-áb-tim ša tù-um-li-a-i-im li-ḫi-id
target: There Ewarimuša should take care of the outstanding claims of the man from Tumliya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma <gap> a-na a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi-ma a-pu-tum i-na u₄-mì-im ša ṭup-pí ta-ša-me-ú tí-ib-a-ma a-tal-kam
target: From <gap> to Ali-ahum: Urgent, the very day you hear my letter set out and come!

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-me-a-nu a-bi-kà iš-tí-in ù ší-na <gap> a-wa-tim a-ḫu-kà <gap> uš-ta-ar-ší-ú
target: One or two of your father's investors have been embroiled in a lawsuit <gap> your brother <gap>.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pá-am ša a-ma-kam a-na i-li-a ta-dí-na-ni-ma ù <gap> um-me-a-ni e-pu-lu-ni
target: The tablet that you gave me there to Iliya, and then <gap> the investors answered.

source: translate Akkadian to English: <gap>-kà-a URUDU šu-a-tí <gap> kà-a ma-la <gap> i-na li-bi-šu i-ší-tù lu a-na ší-im URUDU SIG₅ ú e-ma-ri ša a-na ša-lá-tù-ar tù-šé-bi-lá-ni-ma qá-sú iš-ku-nu
target: remains owed by him and that he laid claim to the good copper and the donkeys you sent me in Šalatuwar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na mì-ma a-nim ší-bi šu-ku-šu-ma ma-lá URUDU SIG₅ i É-tí-šu i-ba-ší-ú a-ḫa-ma i-na URUDU SIG₅ ša qá-sú iš-ku-nu a-na ni-bi-it URUDU SIG₅ IGI ší-bi ta-aḫ-sí-is-tám i-dí-ma tí-ib-a-ma a-tal-kam
target: Set witnesses for all this against him, and set down a memo before witnesses concerning the specification on copper of good quality - about how much good copper is in his house as well as the good copper to which he laid claim, and set out and come.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù a-na-kam iš-tí um-me-a-ni lu-za-ki-ku-nu
target: Then I shall clear you here with the investors.

source: translate Akkadian to English: za-ku-ú-um e-zi-ib 2 ma-na ša DAM.GÀR ŠÀ.BA a ma-lá té-er-tí-kà 4 ma-na 10 GÍN ša ik-ri-bi₄ a-na a-ta-a-a ù GAL-a-šur
target: purified, apart from 2 minas of the merchant. Thereof, in accordance with your instruction, 4 minas 10 shekels of temple funds for Ataya and Rabi-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 ma-na 8.5 GÍN a-na ḫi-na-a ú a-ta-a-a
target: 2 minas 8.5 shekels for hinnāya and Ataya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na a-na a-šur-DU₁₀
target: 0.5 mina for Aššur-ṭāb.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.6666 ma-na 1 GÍN a-na a-ta-a-a
target: 41 shekels for Ataya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.3333 ma-na a-na i-da-ZU
target: 0.3333 mina for I-da-Suen.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.3333 ma-na a-na a-šùr-ba-ni mì-ma a-nim ku-nu-ki GAL-a-šur na-ší
target: 0.3333 mina for Aššur-bāni - all this under my seals Rabi-Aššur is bringing.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na 2 ANŠE 0.3333 ma-na 3 GÍN ni-iš-qúl
target: For 2 donkeys we paid 23 shekels.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 12 GÍN KÙ a-na kà-ší-im ú ma-ṣa-ra-tim
target: 12 shekels of silver for the official and the guarding.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR i-ṣé-er a-zu a-lá-ḫu-um i-šu
target: Azu owes 0.5 mina of silver to Ali-ahum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 na-ru-uq ŠE-am 5 na-ru-uq ar-ša-tim 2 UDU.ḪI.A ù 20 NINDA ṣí-ba-at KÙ.BABBAR-pì-im
target: 5 sacks of barley, 5 sacks of wheat, 2 sheep and 20 loaves of bread are the interest on the silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù KÙ.BABBAR a-na ḫa-ar-pé-e ú-ba-lá-am
target: the silver itself he will bring by harvest.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI ga-al-ga-li-a IGI ša-ra-ak-šu-na
target: Witnessed by Galgaliya, by Šarakšuna.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB a-šur-{d}UTU-ši DUMU šu-IŠTAR KIŠIB a-šur-lá-ma-sí KIŠIB dan-a-šur DUMU ku-sú-sà-ri-im
target: Seal of Aššur-šamšī, son of Šu-Ištar, seal of Aššur-lamassī, seal of Dān-Aššur, son of Kususārum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: <gap> ma-na KÙ ṣa-ru-pá-am i-ṣé-er a-šur-lá-ma-sí la-ma-sà-tum
target: <gap> mina of refined silver Aššur-lamassī owes to Lamassutum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: tí-šu iš-tù ḫa-mu-uš-tim ša kur-ub-IŠTAR ù ì-lí-iš-ta-kál a-na 4 ITU.KAM i-ša-qal
target: From the week of Kurub-Ištar and Iliš-tikal he will pay in 4 months.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma lá iš-qúl ki-ma a-wa-at kà-ri-im ṣí-ib-tám ú-ṣa-áb
target: If he does not pay, he will add interest in accordance with the regulation of the colony.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na i-tur₄-DINGIR ù a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi-ma um-ma i-na-sú-in-ma a-ša-me-ma en-nam-a-šur me-et
target: To Itūr-ilī and Ali-ahum from Enna-Suen: I hear that Ennam-Aššur is dead.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 17 GÚ URUDU SIG₅ ḫa-bu-lam a-na a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi₄-ma
target: He owes me 17 talents of copper of good quality.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pì-a ta-ma-lá-kam ku-nu-ki-a IGI šu-be-lim DUMU ku-zi-zi-a IGI šu-IŠTAR DUMU šu-ki-tim e-zi-ba-kum
target: To Ali-ahum: I left you my tablets, a container under my seal, with Šu-Bēlum son of Kuziziya and Šu-Ištar son of Šukkutum as witnesses.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-na-ku-ma šu-ma ma-ma-an i-na DAM.GÀR-ri lu KÙ.BABBAR lu URUDU ú-šé-ba-lam mu-ḫu-ur-ma ṭup-pì-a šé-ṣí-a-ma <gap>
target: I said: If any of the customers sends either silver or copper, receive it and take out my tablets and <gap>.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-šar KÙ.BABBAR-pì lá i-ḫa-li-qú e-pu-uš
target: Act so that my silver is not lost.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ma a-bu-a na-áš-a-ku-šu i-na u₄-mì-im ša e-ra-ba-ni a-na a-lim{ki} ṭù-ru-sú
target: Abuwa brings that to you. The very same day he arrives you must send him to the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pì lu-ša-ak-ší-id
target: He shall conduct the case concerning my tablet.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na qá-tí-šu lá ta-be-i-il₅ dí-šu-um
target: Do not deny him 10 shekels of silver for his expenses - give it to him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 15 ma-na URUDU a-na ší-bi₄ šé-ru-bi₄-im ù a-na ba-áb DINGIR šé-ru-dim áš-qú-ul
target: I paid 15 minas of copper to have the witnesses brought here and led to the Gate of the God.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 ma-na URUDU da-a-sú ša a-bu-a ša iš-tù kà-ni-ìš a-dí wa-aḫ-šu-ša-na áš-qú-ul
target: 3 minas of copper, the fee for Abuwa for the stretch from Kanesh to Wahšušana, I paid.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2.5 ma-na URUDU a-na qá-tí-šu a-dí-in
target: I gave 2.5 minas of copper for his expenses.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠU.NÍGIN 20.5 ma-na URUDU a šu-mì-kà áš-qú-ul
target: In all I have paid 20.5 minas of copper for him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2.5 ma-na URUDU i-na wa-áš-ḫa-ni-a iš-tí a-ša-at da-na-a
target: 2.5 minas of copper is owed by Dannaya's wife in Wašhaniya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ú-ṣú-ra-nim ù en-nam-a-šur qí-bi-ma um-ma IŠTAR-ra-bi₄-at-ma
target: To Uṣurānum and Ennam-Aššur from Ištar-rabiʾat;

source: translate Akkadian to English: a ma-lá tí-ir-tí-kà ša a-lu-wa ta-áš-pu-ra-ni
target: In accordance with your message which you sent with Aluwa

source: translate Akkadian to English: wa-ar-ḫa-am iš-té-en ù 2 wa-ra-am e-ri-iš-kà-ma lá ta-áš-me-a-ni
target: I asked you for one or two months, but you did not listen to me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR 2 ma-na i-na be-et DAM.GÀR-ri-im a-sí-ma i-na IGI me-ra um-me-a-nim KÙ.BABBAR i ku-nu-uk a-lu-wa kà-ni-ik-ma i-na be-tí-a-ma i-ba-ší
target: I have borrowed some 2 minas of silver in a merchant-house and the silver was sealed with Aluwa's seal with an affiliated trader as witness, and it is in my own house.

source: translate Akkadian to English: me-er-i a-ta lu ṭup-pu-um ša ḫu-bu-ul ṣí-lá-{d}IM lu ṭup-pu-um iš-té-en ù ší-na lu ṭup-pu-um ša be-lu-ba-ni i-ba-ší
target: My dear son, the tablet concerning Ṣill-Adad's debt as well as one or two other tablets, and the tablet concerning Bēlum-bāni are available

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-kam IGI ú-ṣú-ra-nim ṭup-pì a-na pu-zu-ur-ku-nu ù a-lu-wa pì-iq-dá-ma lu-ub-lu-nim
target: entrust those tablets there with Uṣurānum as witness to Puzurkunu and Aluwa so they may bring them.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB bé-lí-a DUMU DINGIR-kur-ub KIŠIB ša-lim-a-šur DUMU {d}IM.SIG₅ KIŠIB a-lá-ḫi-im DUMU šu-ku-bi-im KIŠIB DU₁₀-pí-a-šùr DUMU a-lá-ḫi-im KIŠIB {d}UTU-a-bi DUMU sú-sà-nim
target: Seal of Bēliya son of Ilī-kurub, seal of Šalim-Aššur son of Adad-damiq, seal of Ali-ahum son of Šu-Kūbum, seal of Ṭāb-pī-Aššur son of Ali-ahum, seal of Šamaš-abī son of Sūsānum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 GÚ URUDU ma-sí-am ša DU₁₀-pí-a-šùr ki-ma {d}UTU-a-bi a-na lu-zi i-dí-nu-ma ṭup-pá-am ša lu-zi DU₁₀-pí-a-šur iḫ-ri-mu
target: As to the 2 talents of washed copper that Ṭāb-pī-Aššur gave to Luzi on behalf of Šamaš-abī, and for which Ṭāb-pī-Aššur certified a tablet for Luzi.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma DU₁₀-pí-a-šùr-ma šu-ma URUDU i-na kà-ni-iš{ki} {d}UTU-a-bi ša ki-ma ku-a-tí il₅-qé-ú a-na 1 GÚ URUDU ma-sí-im ša tal-qé-ú 2 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ta-ša-qal
target: Ṭāb-pī-Aššur said: If your representatives have received the copper in Kanesh (from) Šamaš-abī, you must pay 2 minas of silver for every talent of washed copper.

source: translate Akkadian to English: DU₁₀-pí-a-šur ù {d}UTU-a-bi ša-bu-ú
target: Ṭāb-pī-Aššur and Šamaš-abī have been satisfied.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-um ša 2 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša ta-ar-ki-is-tí lu-zi ša e-li-a-ni sà-ar
target: Any tablet concerning 2 minas of silver from the contract of Luzi that may appear will be invalid.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2.6666 ma-na 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am i li-bi i-ku-pí-a en-um-a-šur i-šu
target: Ikūn-pīya owes 2.6666 minas 5 shekels of refined silver to Ennam-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú iš-tù ší-im 2 ma-na 2-<gap> GÍN AN.NA-ki-šu KÙ.BABBAR-áp-šu ṣa-ḫu-ru <gap> GÚ AN.NA i-ku-pí-a a-na en-um-a-šur e-zi-ib
target: Also, after the price in silver of his 2 minas 2<gap> shekels of tin has been deducted Ikūn-pīya will leave <gap> talents of tin for Ennam-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-ta-dá-an AN.NA-ki-šu KÙ.BABBAR-áp-šu en-um-a-šur i-lá-qé
target: When the tin is sold, Ennam-Aššur will receive its value in silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú 1 su-pá-nu-um ša KÙ.BABBAR a-na 1 ma-na 7 GÍN a-ḫa-ma ša 9 GÍN iš-<gap>-ḫu-lu-im a-na en-um-a-šur i-ku-pí-a e-zi-ib
target: Also, 1 -container of silver for 1 mina 7 shekels; further, Ikūn-pīya will leave for Ennam-Aššur worth 9 shekels of <gap>.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI kur-ub-a-šur IGI GÚ-tim DUMU a-lá-ḫi-im IGI ma-ri-iḫ-šu
target: Witnessed by Kurub-Aššur, by Biltum son of Ali-ahum, by Marihšu.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫa-ma a-na 1 ma-na-im KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pí-im a-šu-mì i-ku-pí-a a-na i-na-a DUMU a-mu-ra-a a-pu-ul
target: Further, I balanced for 1 mina of refined silver because of Ikūn-pīya with Innaya son of Amuraya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-lí-ma a-na sà-ak-ta-a qí-bi₄-ma
target: Thus Šuli, say to Saktāya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫi a-ta e-eb-ri a-ta a-na a-mì-ú-tim ú-lá a-da-ga-al ku-a-tí a-da-ga-lá-ku-um
target: Please, my brother, my friend, I do not look at the others there, I only look at you!

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ta 1 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ta-qí-ša-šu ra-ki-sú-ma
target: You must bind him contractually for every shekel of silver you donated to him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: zi-ki ú šu-ku-ba-am ú-ma-kál lá i be-tu ṭù-ur-da-šu-nu
target: As for Ziki and Šu-Kūbum, they must not stay overnight one single day, send them (here).

source: translate Akkadian to English: 6 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR šé-bi₄-lam
target: Send me 6 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ.BA 0.3333 GÍN dí-in-ma ša-<gap>-am ta-ša-am
target: Make 0.3333 shekel of it available so that she / you can buy ?.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.1666 GÍN a mu-uš-ṭá-tim dí-in-ma ku-nu-uk-ma
target: Give 1 / 6 shekel for combs and put it under seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ku-bu-um e-ri-ú-ma lá tù-šé-ba-lam li-ší-am KÙ.BABBAR šé-bi₄-lam
target: Do not send Šu-Kūbum here empty-handed, let him bring it to me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: li-bi₄ lá tù-lá-ma-an šé-bi₄-lam
target: Send me silver, do not disappoint me, send it to me!

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 ma-na KÙ.GI a-na a-mur-{d}UTU ša-áp-kà-ku
target: I have invested 2 minas of gold in Amur-Šamaš;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na KÙ.GI a-na a-lá-ḫi-im DUMU sí-ku-ḫi-im ša-áp-kà-ku
target: I have invested 1 mina of gold in Ali-ahum son of Sikuhum;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na KÙ.GI a-na a-zu-za ša-áp-kà-ku
target: I have invested 1 mina of gold in Azuza;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na KÙ.GI a-na a-mur-a-šur DUMU šu-IŠTAR
target: 1 mina of gold for Amur-Aššur son of Šu-Ištar;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 ma-na KÙ.GI a-na DINGIR-ku-ru-ub DUMU ì-lí-li-dí
target: 2 minas of gold for Ilī-kurub son of Ilī-liddi;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 8 ku-ta-nu 9 ma-na AN.NA iš-tù 8 ša-na-at a-na PUZUR₄-sú-in a-na e-bu-ṭim a-dí-in
target: I gave 8 textiles and 9 minas of tin 8 years ago to Puzur-Suen as an investment loan;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 GÚ AN.NA ú li-wi-sú a-na a-mur-a-šur DUMU i-dí-lim a-na e-bu-ṭim a-dí-in
target: I gave 1 talent of tin and its wrapping to Amur-Aššur son of Iddin-ilum as an investment loan;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a-na IŠTAR-pí-lá-aḫ DUMU a-ni-nim lá-ma a-na a-lim{ki} ur-du-ni a-na e-bu-ṭim a-dí-šu-um
target: I gave 2 minas of silver to Ištar-pilah son of Anninum before he went down to the the City as an investment loan;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.3333 ma-na KÙ.GI KI en-um-a-šur DUMU ṣí-li-IŠTAR
target: 0.3333 mina of gold owed by Ennam-Aššur son of Ṣilli-Ištar;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 15 GÍN ší-kam KI ku-zi-zi-a
target: 15 shekels of šikkum owed by Kuziziya;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.25 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i-na li-bi₄ lu-lu
target: 1 1/4 shekel of silver is owed by Lulu.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na dan-a-šur ù uš-ma-a qí-bi-ma um-ma PUZUR₄-a-šur-ma
target: To Dan-Aššur and Ušmaya from Puzur-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: ki-ma AN.NA a-na a-ki-a ta-ta-ší-a-ni a-na-kam IGI a-ki-a a-ta-ší-ma
target: As you brought tin to Akiya, I have brought it here before Akiya,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 ma-na AN.NA ba-tí-iq li-tí-ik-tám ku-nu-ki ša a-ki-a DU₁₀-ṣí-lá-a-šur na-áš-a-ku-nu-tí
target: and there is 2 minas too little of the tin. Ṭāb-ṣill-Aššur brings it to you sealed by Akiya for testing.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-kam iš-tí áb-nim ša tù-ša-qí-lá-ni ma-aḫ-ṣa-ma šu-ma ba-tí-iq i-li i-ṣé-ri-šu id-a
target: Check it there with the weight-stone that you weigh with and if there is too little, add bags on top of it.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫa-ma 2 ma-na ni-ga-li na-áš-a-ku-nu-tí
target: Further, he brings you 2 minas of sickles.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 8 ma-na <gap> ga a li-il₅-qé
target: Let him take 8 minas <gap>

source: translate Akkadian to English: 20 ma-na a-tù-nu le-qé-a-ma a-na na-áb-ri-tí e-ma-ri-a dí-na
target: You yourselves should take 20 minas and give it for the paddock of my donkeys.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-ki-a 0.3333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a-na be-a-lim ta-da-na-am qá-bi₄-a-ku
target: I promised to give 0.3333 mina of silver as a working capital to Akiya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam lá i-šu iš-tù a-lim{ki} KÙ.BABBAR-pì ú-ta-ra-am
target: I do not have it here. I shall return my silver from the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 15 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR DU₁₀-ṣí-lá-a-šur na-áš-a-ku-nu-tí
target: Ṭāb-ṣill-Aššur brings you 15 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i li-bi₄ a-ki-a KÙ.BABBAR dí-na-šu-ma
target: 5 shekels of silver is owed by Akiya. Give him the silver

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša 0.3333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṭup-pu-šu lu-up-ta
target: and write his tablet for 0.3333 mina of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR DU₁₀-ṣí-lá-a-šur na-áš-a-ku-nu-tí
target: Ṭāb-ṣill-Aššur brings you 4 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-nu-mì tí-ri-ku-nu-ni dí-na-ší-im
target: When she asks you for it, give it to her.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a ma-lá áš-pu-ra-ku-nu-tí-ni TÚG.ḪI.A SIG₅-tim DIRI a-na ša-lim-be-lí dí-na
target: In accordance with what I wrote you, give good, extra-fine textiles to Šalim-bēli.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 7 ta-ma-lá-ke ša ṭup-pé a-na šu-be-lim ni-a-im e-zi-ib
target: Seven boxes with tablets I left behind to our Šu-Bēlum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 DUB ša 2 GÚ 40 ma-na URUDU ṣa-lá-mì-im
target: One tablet for 2 talents and 40 minas of black copper.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša-ni-um ṭup-pu-um ša 15 ma-na URUDU SIG₅ ša ḫu-bu-ul en-na-sú-en₆
target: A second tablet for 15 minas of refined copper, being the debt of Ennam-Suen.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ṭup-pu-um ša 23 ma-na URUDU SIG₅ ša ḫu-bu-ul a-šur-ANDUL ù dí-dí-a
target: One tablet for 23 minas of refined copper being the debt of Aššur-ṣulūlī and Didiya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ma a-nim a-na šu-be-lim e-zi-ib
target: All this I left behind to Šu-Bēlum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI i-šu-ḫi-im DUMU <gap>-mì-im IGI a-sà-nim DUMU šu-be-lim
target: In the presence of Išuhum, son of <gap>mum, and of Asānum, son of Šu-Bēlum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ša-sú-ḫi-šu a-ma-kam a-we-lam iš-tí šé-ep-IŠTAR ší-ip-ri-ni li-sú-ḫa-am
target: Let him extradite the man there with our messenger Šēp-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú a-tù-nu lu e-mu-uq ší-ip-ri-ni
target: And you must be the executive arm for our messenger.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ki KÙ.BABBAR a-na ší-a-ma-tim ša-lim-a-šur i-dí-šum
target: Šalim-Aššur gave him the silver for purchases.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI en-na-sú-in DUMU i-ku-a-a IGI sà-li-a DUMU i-dí-a-šur IGI SIG₅-pí-a-šur IGI a-šur-na-da DUMU en-nam-a-šur
target: Witnessed by Enna-Suen son of Ikuwaya, by Salliya son of Iddin-Aššur, by Damiq-pī-Aššur, by Aššur-nādā son of Ennam-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 6 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ù 20 ak-li i-ṣé-er kà-ar-ší-ni ù a-li-li IŠTAR-lá-ma-sí tí-šu
target: Karšini and Alili owe 6 shekels of silver plus 20 loaves of bread to Ištar-lamassī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù ḫa-muš-tim ša a-šur-i-mì-tí ITU.KAM ša sà-ra-tim li-mu-um a-šur-i-mì-tí
target: Reckoned from the week of Aššur-imittī, month Ša-sarrātim, eponymy Aššur-imittī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṣí-ba-sú ù NINDA a-na ša-na-at ú-bu-lu-nim
target: They will bring 3 shekels of silver, its interest, plus the bread within one year.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI wa-al-dí-DINGIR IGI i-na-aḫ
target: Witnessed by Waldi-ilum, by Inah.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-šur-{d}UTU-ši ù da-da-a-ma a-na a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi₄-ma
target: From Aššur-šamšī and Dādaya to Ali-ahum:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-LÁ.MA tí-ir-tí-kà šu-{d}EN.LÍL a-na KÙ.BABBAR-pì ù ṣí-ba-tí-šu ni-ṣa-ba-at-ma
target: In accordance with your instructions we seized Šu-Illil with respect to the silver and its interest,

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-ut-ma a-na KÙ.BABBAR lá kà-áš-da-ku
target: and he said: I have not been able to acquire the silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma 3 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ú-ma-am a-ša-qá-al-ma ú a-na ší-tí KÙ.BABBAR-pì-kà ú-me-e ta-ša-kà-na-ni
target: (Will it be acceptable) if I pay 3 minas of silver today, and you then set a term for me for the rest of your silver?

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú KÙ.BABBAR-pu a-na ni dí šu ra-kà-sí-im 3 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR DUMU um-me-a-nim ke-nim e-pu-ul-ni-a-tí
target: So, as to the silver, to bind it to his <gap> a reliable affiliated trader guaranteed 3 minas of silver for us.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma a ma-lá ṭup-pu-ni bi-<gap> ta-am-ta-ga-ar-ni-a-tí KÙ.BABBAR ni-lá-qé
target: If you have agreed with us <gap> in accordance with our letter, we shall receive the silver,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú i-na a-wa-tí-ni šu-ma lá ta-am-ta-ga-ar-ni-a-tí a-na KÙ.BABBAR ú-lá e-pu-ul-ni-a-tí
target: but if you do not agree with us in our decision, then he will not have guaranteed the silver for us.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-kam a-ta ma-lá-kà
target: You must make up your mind there.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù a-na gi₅-mì-li-ku-nu ša šu-{d}EN.LÍL DUMU ma-num-ki-a-šur um-ma šu-ut-ma 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a-lá-qé-ma a-ḫa-ma en-um-a-šur a-ḫu-šu 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a-na a-bi₄-a ḫa-bu-ul i-na li-bi₄ KÙ.BABBAR-pì-im a-lá-qé
target: Also, as for your favours to Šu-Illil son of Mannum-kī-Aššur he said: "I shall take 1 mina of silver, and furthermore his brother Ennam-Aššur owes 1 mina of silver to my father. I shall take that out of the silver."

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim IGI kà-ri-im iq-bi
target: These words he spoke before the colony.

source: translate Akkadian to English: kà-ru-um dí-nam i-dí-in-ma a-dí da-mu ša DUMU ša-lim-a-šùr i-kà-šu-du-ni e-ba-ar ta-wi-ni-a ma-ma-an ú-lá i-kà-ba-as
target: The colony passed a verdict, to the effect that until they acquire the blood-money for Šalim-Aššur's son, no one may forgive the colleague from Tawniya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù a-na e-ri-iš-tí-šu lu i-na ra-bi-ú-tim lu i-na ṣa-ḫu-ru-tim ma-ma-an ú-lá i-za-az
target: and no one, either among the great men or among the small men may carry out his wishes.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma dí-in kà-ri-im i-de₈-ma da-me a-ḫi-a ik-bu-ús-ma ù a-na e-ri-iš-tí-šu i-zi-iz
target: If anyone knows the verdict of the colony and yet remits my brother's blood-money or indeed carries out his wishes.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na ṭup-pì-im ša a-lim{ki} wa-dí-a-nim ki-ma da-me ik-bu-sú ù i-tù-ru-ma a-na e-ri-iš-tí-šu i-zi-iz
target: then make it known in a tablet of the City, namely that he has remitted the blood-money and again has carried out his wishes.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-um ša a-lim{ki}-ma a-na ṣa-ḫe-er ra-bi li-li-kam-ma IGI GÍR ša a-šùr lu i-na ra-bi₄-ú-tim lu i-na ṣa-ḫu-ru-tim pì-šu-nu li-ip-té-ú
target: The tablet of the City should come to the plenary assembly, and they must make a statement before Aššur's dagger, whether it is one from the great men or from the small men.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-kam šu-ma ša ki-ma šu-a-tí a-lam₅{ki} im-ta-aḫ-ru um-ma šu-nu-ma da-me a-ḫi-šu a-lá-ḫu-um IGI kà-ri-im ik-bu-ús
target: If his representatives have approached the city there, saying: Ali-ahum has remitted the blood-money for his brother before the colony.

source: translate Akkadian to English: da-me mì-ma ú-lá ak-bu-ús
target: I have not in any way remitted the blood-money.

source: translate Akkadian to English: kà-ru-um a pí-šu wa-ša-áb
target: The colony supports him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: kà-ra-am a-na ší-bu-tim ú-šé-lá-am
target: He shall take the colony as witness.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma ší-bé ša ra-bi-ú-tim i-šu-am mì-nam a-qá-be a-na-ku
target: If he has witnesses among the great men against me, then what can I say?

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù šu-ut i-na ṭup-pì-ni ù ší-be-ni a-ma-kam IGI a-lim{ki} lu ni-iz-ku
target: I and he should clear our affair there with our tablets and our witnesses before the City assembly.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 TÚG ša DAM.MÍ kur-ub-IŠTAR a-na a-šur-ma-lik a-dí-in
target: Two textiles of the wife of Kurub-Ištar I gave to Ašur-malik.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am i-ṣé-er i-dí-a-bi-im a-šur-{d}UTU-ši i-šu
target: Iddin-abum owes 5 minas of refined silver to Aššur-šamši.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù ḫa-mu-uš-tim ša a-mur-IŠTAR a-na 23 ḫa-am-ša-tim i-ša-qal
target: Reckoned from the week of Amur-Ištar he must pay in 23 weeks.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma i-na u₄-me-šu ma-al-ú-tim la iš-qú-ul 1.5 GÍN.TA i ITU.KAM a-na ma-na-im ú-ṣa-áb
target: If he has not paid before the completion of his term, he must pay interest at the rate 1.5 shekel per month per mina.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-mur-IŠTAR IGI la-qé-ep
target: Witnessed by Amur-Ištar, by La-qēp.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ir-ma-a-šur qí-bi-ma um-ma en-um-a-šur-ma
target: Say to Ir'am-Aššur, thus Ennam-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 ma-na LÁ 3 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i pá-ni-tim iš-tù ḫa-tim iš-tí šu-sú-en₆ a-na kà-ni-ìš ú-šé-bi₄-lá-ku-ma
target: I sent you earlier 2 minas 57 shekels of silver from hattum with Šu-Suen to Kanesh

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR a-na a-lim{ki} tù-bi-il₅-ma
target: and you brought that silver to the City

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-na-ku a-bi šu-ut i-lá-ak-ma iš-tù a-lim{ki} AN.NA 10 ma-na ú-šé-ba-lá-ma KÙ.BABBAR 1 GÍN e-li KÙ.BABBAR a ša ṭup-pì-a a-kà-na-ak-ma ú-šé-ba-al
target: and I thought: 'He is my father, he will go and bring up from the City tin, 10 minas, so that I can seal and send at least some silver on top of that (owed) according to my tablet'.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ta AN.NA lá ta-áš-ta-ma-am
target: But you have bought no tin for me,

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-ta-ma KÙ.BABBAR a-ḫa-at-kà ta-aḫ-ša-aḫ-ma a-na a-ḫa-tí-kà a-ša ṭup-pí-kà a-tí-dí-šu-um-ma
target: with the argument: 'Your sister needed the silver, so I gave it to your sister on the basis of you tablet

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na 14 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ni-is-ḫa-sú DIRI ša-du-a-sú ša-bu a-ḫa-ma 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ni-is-ḫa-sú DIRI ša-du-a-sú ša-bu ik-ri-bi₄ ša a-šur ku-nu-ki-a IGI a-zu-ta-a IGI i-dí-ba-ni i-na ḫu-ra-ma a-dí-na-ku-um
target: and 1 mina 14 shekels of silver, its excise added, its transport fee paid, and separately 0.5 mina of silver, its excise added, its transport fee paid, temple funds of Aššur, I gave you under my seals in hurama, with Azutaya and Idi-bāni as witnesses.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-na-ku-ma a-bi₄ a-ta be-lí a-ta AN.NA ša-ma-ma šé-bi₄-lá
target: I said: 'Please by father, my boss, buy for me tin and send it to me',

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ta mì-ma-ša-ma lá tù-uš-té-bi₄-lam
target: but you have not sent me anything!

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša ki-ma i-dí-a-šùr DUMU ku-bi₄-dí ù ku-la É i-dí-a-bi₄-im a-na ḫu-bu-ul i-dí-a-bi₄-im ik-nu-ku-ma am-tám ù ÌR uš-té-ṣí-ú
target: The representatives of Iddin-Aššur son of Kūbi-idī and Kula sealed Iddin-abum's house because of Iddin-abum's debt, and they brought out the maid and slave.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na šál-ší-im ú-mì-im a-šur-i-mì-tí DUMU a-mur-DINGIR ša ki-ma šál-ma-a-šur 17 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a-na ṣí-ib-tim il₅-qé-ma a-na ḫu-bu-ul i-dí-a-bi₄-im a-na ša ki-ma i-dí-a-šùr ù ku-lá a-lá-ḫu-um DUMU i-dí-sú-en li-ba-a DUMU ú-zu-a ù šu-be-lúm DUMU šál-ma-a-šur iš-qúl-ma
target: On the third day Aššur-imittī son of Amur-ilī, Šalim-Aššur's representative, borrowed 17 minas of silver against interest and paid it to cover Iddin-abum's debt to the representatives of Iddin-Aššur and Kula: Alāhum son of Iddin-Suen, Libbaya son of Uzuwa and Šu-Bēlum son of Šalim-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: É-tí am-tám ù ÌR ša i-dí-a-bi₄-im a-na a-šur-i-mì-tí DUMU a-mur-DINGIR ša ki-ma šál-ma-a-šùr ú-šé-ru
target: And they released Iddin-abum's houses, maid and slave to Aššur-imittī son of Amur-ilī, Šalim-Aššur's representative.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um kà-né-eš i-dí-ni-a-tí-ma ṭup-pá-am ša ší-bu-tí-ni IGI GÍR ša a-šùr ni-dí-in
target: The Kanesh colony gave us for these proceedings, and we gave a tablet with our testimony before Aššur's dagger.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI ú-ra-a IGI a-ku-za IGI MAR.TU-ba-ni IGI lá-qé-pì-im IGI i-tur₄-DINGIR
target: Witnessed by Uraya, by Akuza, by Amur-rum-bāni, by Lā-qēpum, by Itūr-ilī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṣú-ba-sà-a ù ší-it-ar-ša-a eṭ-ra-šu
target: Deprive her of her garment and her head-dress.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na DUMU a-šùr ù a-na DUMU kà-né-eš lá ta-dá-na-šu
target: You must not sell her to an Assyrian or to a citizen of Kanesh.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ta-al-ḫa-tim dí-na-šu
target: Sell her to a man from Talhat.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú a-ša-ar ta-dá-na-ni um-ma a-tù-nu-ma a-na ma-at kà-né-eš a-wi-il₅-tám lá tù-ta-ra-nim
target: And where you sell (her) you must say: 'Do not bring the woman back to the land of Kanesh!'

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR iš-tù a-lim{ki} i-na e-lá-i-šu a-na IŠTAR-lá-ma-sí ù a-lá-ḫi-im SIG₅-pì-i-a-šùr DUMU IR-ad-ì-lí-šu i-ša-qal
target: Damiq-pī-Aššur son of Warad-ilīšu will pay 1 mina of silver to Ištar-lamassī and Ali-ahum when he comes up from the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-dí-da IGI a-šùr-ba-ni IGI be-lúm-ba-ni
target: Witnessed by Adida, by Aššur-bāni, by Bēlum-bāni.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mu-ut a-bi-a en-na-a-šur
target: the death of my father has Ennam-Aššur

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša-zu-úz-tí a-ba-e-ší-na ú-lá
target: the representatives of their (fem.) fathers did not

source: translate Akkadian to English: id-du-ni šu ma li-ba-am a-na a-we-li i-dí-nu-ni
target: that they did encourage the men

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-tù-nu ú-lá mu-ut a-bi₄-a ú-lá šu-lu-um-ku-nu ta-áš-pu-ra-ni-ma li-ba-am ta-dí-na-nim
target: As for you (plur.), you did not write either about my father's death or send me your greetings to encourage me

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-ku a-na-kam iš-tí DAM.GÀR
target: While I here with the merchant

source: translate Akkadian to English: ma-lá ku-nu-tí
target: as much as for you

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-šur-ma-sú-wi ú lá-ma-sí qí-bi₄-ma um-ma en-um-a-šùr-ma
target: To Aššur-massu'ī and Lamassī from Ennam-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-šu-mì ší-ma-tim ša a-bi-ni tí-ir-tí a-dí 5-ší-šu áš-pu-ra-ki-ma ma-tí-ma tí-ir-tí ú-lá e-zi-ba-am-ma úz-ni lá ta-pá-tí-i ù li-ba-am ú-lá ta-dí-ni-im
target: Concerning our father's testament I have written to you (fem. sing.) five times but no answer ever left for me, and you do not inform me or encourage me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-ku a-lá-nu-tí a-ḫa-tám ú bé-el-tám ša-ni-tám ma-nam i-šu-ú
target: As for me, apart from you, what sister and lady do I have?

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù u₄-mì-im ša a-bi-i i-mu-tù a-šu-mì mu-ší ú ú-ri lá a-ša-ga-šu-ni a-šur ú i-lá-bi-ni li-ṭù-lá
target: From the day our father died, may Aššur and our father's god be my witnesses - have I not exerted myself to the utmost night and day?

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-na-ku-ma <gap>-tí-iš a-ḫa-tí ú-za-kà ú bé-tí-ša ú-ba-áb-ší-ma pá-ni-ša ṣa-al-mu-tim ú-ša-an-wa-ar
target: I said to myself: <gap> I shall clear my sister, clean her house and lighten up her darkened face.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-tí ma-tí-ma tí-ir-tí-ki lá i-li-kam-ma li-ba-am ú-lá ta-dí-ni-im
target: But as for you, you never sent me word and never encouraged me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na u₄-mì-im ša ṭup-pí ta-ša-me-a-ni a-šur-ma-sú-i ù a-tí me-eḫ-ra-at ší-ma-tim šu-ba-al-ki-ta-ma iš-tí a-lu-wa šé-bi₄-lá-nim
target: On the day you hear my letter Aššur-massu'ī and you should have a copy made of our father's testament and send it with Aluwa.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ku-da-tum ub-lá-ki-im 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a-ḫa-ma 2 GÍN a me-er-i-tí-ki a-lu-wa na-áš-a-ki-im
target: Kudātum brought you 0.5 mina of silver; Aluwa brings you 0.5 mina of silver and furthermore 2 shekels for your daughter.

source: translate Akkadian to English: bé-el-tí a-tí mu-ší ú ú-ri ša-zu-za-tí-a ša-am-ṭí-i-ma
target: My dear lady, plague my representatives night and day,

source: translate Akkadian to English: a ma-lá áš-pu-ra-ku-nu-tí-ni 2
target: and, as I wrote to you, get 2 tablets with verdicts of the City, send Ašdu and Aluwa and write me about all the remaining that is not of our father's house, and inform me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ma-nu-ba-lúm-a-šur a-na Ì-lí-uṣ-ra-ni iṣ-ba-at-ni-a-tí-ma
target: Mannum-balum-Aššur seized us against Ilī-uṣrannī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ma-nu-ba-lúm-a-šur-ma a-na Ì-lí-uṣ-ra-ni 2 ma-na 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ḫa-bu-lá-tí lá ḫa-bu-lá-tí ú-lá ik-ri ú-lá kà-i-na-ni ṭup-pá-am ḫa-ar-ma-am ú-kà-al
target: Mannum-balum-Aššur said to Ilī-uṣrannī: Confirm or deny that you owe me 2 minas 10 shekels of silver! I have a certified tablet.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ì-lí-uṣ-ra-ni-ma ke-na 2 ma-na 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ḫa-bu-lá-ku-um ku-nu-ki-a a-na ki-ir ṭup-pé ša-as-ḫu-ur
target: Ilī-uṣrannī answered: "Yes, I owe you 2 minas 10 shekels of silver. I contest my seal. My tablet has been altered."

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ma-nu-ba-lúm-a-šur-ma a-na DINGIR-uṣ-ra-ni-ma i-nu-mì a-na a-šur-i-dí a-na ší bi-kà sú-re-e az-ku-ru IGI wa-bar-tim i ša-ḫa-tí-šu ta zi-iz lá ta-zi-iz ú-lá ik-ri ú-lá kà-i-ni
target: Mannum-balum-Aššur said to Ilī-uṣrannī: "Surely, when I formally appointed you as witness for Aššūr-idī, did you or did you not assist him (appearing) before the station? Deny or confirm that to me!"

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ì-lí-uṣ-ra-ni-ma ù šu-ma a-zi-iz a-na ši-bu-tim ta-šé-e-a-ni šu-ma a ší-bu-tim ta-šé-e-a-ni a-li-ik-ma wa-bar-tám mu-ùḫ-ra-am
target: Ilī-uṣrannī said: "And if I did assist, will you then sue me for the testimony? If you do (want to) sue me for the testimony, then go and appeal to the station!"

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ma-nu-ba-lúm-a-šur-ma ša ni-iš a-lim{ki}-ma ta-mu-ú lu ú-kà-al ki-ma e-mu-qá-tám e-ta-wu ú a-pá-lam lá i-mu-e-ni
target: Mannum-balum-Aššur said: "Remember what was sworn by an oath by the City, that he has argued in anger and that he refuses to answer me!"

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim wa-bar-tum ša wa-áš-ḫa-ni-a i-dí-ni-a-tí-ma ṭup-pá-am IGI GÍR ša a-šur ší-bu-tí-ni ni-dí-in
target: The station at Wašhaniya gave us for these proceedings and we gave a tablet with our testimony before Aššur's dagger.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma i-tur₄-DINGIR-ma a-na en-um-a-šur qí-bi₄-ma
target: From Itūr-ilī to Ennam-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ú-ùḫ-šu-ša-na tí-ir-ta-kà li-li-ik-ma ší-im 30 TÚG i-a-ú-tim li-iš-lu-ṭù-ma lu-šé-bi₄-lu-ni-kum
target: Send word to Wahšušana that they should take control of the proceeds from my 30 textiles and send it to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-im 1 TÚG a-bar-ni-im ša DUMU a-lu-<gap>-nim li-iš-lu-ṭù-ma lu-šé-bu-lu-ni-kum
target: They should take control of the proceeds from 1 Abarnian textile belonging to Alu<gap>num's son and send it to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú ší-im TÚG ṣú-ba-tí ša a-lá-ḫi-im ú e-na-nim li-iš-lu-ṭù-ma lu-šé-bi₄-lu-ni-kum
target: Also, they should take control of the proceeds from the textiles belonging to Ali-ahum and Ennānum and send it to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu-qú-tám ša ša-lim-a-šur ša i-na ḫa-ḫi-im É i-sú-ri-ik ù me-er-ú i-dí-a-bi-im iṣ-bu-tù-ni-ma i-na kà-ni-iš É a-šur-be-el-a-wa-tim i-pì-iq-du-ni-ma
target: As to the goods belonging to Šalim-Aššur that was in hahhum in Issu-arik's house, and which Iddin-abum's sons seized and entrusted in the house of Aššur-bēl-awātim in Kanesh.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a ma-lá ṭup-pì-im ša dí-in a-lim{ki} ša kà-ku-a ub-lá-ni a-na lu-qú-tim šu-a-tí en-na-sú-in ù a-nu-li a-na ša-lim-a-šur ú-lá i-tù-ru-ú
target: In accordance with the tablet with a verdict of the City that Kakuwa brought, Enna-Suen and Anuli must not raise claims to those goods against Šalim-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na 5 GÚ 15 ma-na SÍG.ḪI.A ša šé-ep-IŠTAR ù ša-lim-wa-ar-dí a-na a-lá-ni ub-lu-ni
target: Of the 5 talents 15 minas of wool that Šēp-Ištar and Šalim-wardī brought to the villages

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ.BA 1 GÚ 1.3333 ma-na URUDU SIG₅ 32.5 ma-na URUDU lá-mu-num ù 45 ma-na <gap>
target: thereof 1 talent 1.3333 mina of good copper, 32.5 minas of bad copper and 45 minas <gap>

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ni-ni ú i-lá-áb-ra-at-ba-ni KIŠIB ku-ni-lá
target: To Nini and Ilabrat-bāni; seal of Kunila.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-pu-tum a-na a-wa-at ṭup-pì-im iḫ-da
target: Urgent! Pay attention to the words of the letter.

source: translate Akkadian to English: en-nam-a-šùr a-na a-šùr-DU₁₀ iṣ-ba-at-ni-a-tí-ma
target: Ennam-Aššur seized us against Aššur-ṭāb.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma en-nam-a-šùr-ma a-na a-šùr-DU₁₀-ma a-na a-i-tim ta-ša-a-lá-ni ù sí-ki tù-kà-al
target: Ennam-Aššur said to Aššur-ṭāb: For what do you question me and detain me?

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu a-bi ḫa-bu-lá-ku-um lu a-na-ku ḫa-bu-lá-ku-um lu ṭup-pí ḫa-ar-ma-am tù-kà-al
target: If either my father owes you anything, or if I owe you anything, or if you have in your possession a tablet certified by me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-bi-kà ri-id-a-ma IGI a-ni-ú-tí-ma lu-ša-bi-kà
target: Then bring forth your witnesses and let me satisfy you with these men as witnesses!

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-šùr-DU₁₀-ma 1 GÚ KÙ.BABBAR ḫa-bu-lá-tí ma-aṣ-a-ku ú-kà-al-kà
target: Aššur-ṭāb answered: "You owe me 1 talent of silver. I take responsibility for holding you."

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma en-nam-a-šur-ma ša ni-iš a-lim{ki} ú ru-ba-im ta-mu-ú lu ú-kà-al ki-ma ša lá ḫa-bu-lá-ak-šu-ni-ma sí-ki ú-kà-lu
target: Ennam-Aššur said: "Do keep in mind what was sworn by the City and the king - that he detains me although I do not owe him anything!"

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um ḫu-ra-ma i-dí-ni-a-tí-ma IGI GÍR ša a-šur ší-bu-tí-ni ni-dí-in
target: The hurama colony gave us for these proceedings and we gave our testimony before Aššur's dagger.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-šur-e-nam DUMU lá-qé-pí-im IGI šu-IŠTAR DUMU a-šur-i-mì-tí DUMU e-ta-a
target: Witnessed by Aššur-ennam son of Lā-qēp, by Ša-Ištar son of Aššur-immittī, (grand)son of Etaya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 15.3333 GÍN 15 ŠE KÙ.BABBAR i-ṣé-er kà-ar-ší-ni a-lá-ḫu-um i-šu iš-tù ḫa-mu-uš-tim ša kà-ší-im ITU.KAM be-el-té-kál-lim li-mu-um ša qá-tí a-šur-i-mì-tí <gap> a-na e-tí-šu i-ša-qal
target: Karšini owes 15.3333 shekels 15 grains of silver to Ali-ahum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù ḫa-mu-uš-tim ša kà-ší-im ITU.KAM be-el-té-kál-lim li-mu-um ša qá-tí a-šur-i-mì-tí <gap> a-na e-tí-šu i-ša-qal
target: Reckoned from the week of the -official, month Bēlat-ekallim, in the eponymy after that of Aššur-imittī, he will pay at the earliest convenience.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI wa-al-dí-lim IGI i-na-ar
target: Witnessed by Waldi-ilum, by Inar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 6 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i-ṣé-er kà-ar-ší-ni ù a-li-li <gap> IŠTAR-lá-ma-sí tí-šu
target: Karšini and Alili owe 6 shekels of silver to Ištar-lamassī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù ḫa-mu-uš-tim ša a-šur-i-mì-tí ITU.KAM ša sà-ra-tim li-mu-um ša qá-té a-šur-i-mì-tí 3 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṣí-ba-sú ù 20 ak-li a-na ša-na-at ú-bu-lu-nim
target: Reckoned from the week of Aššur-imittī, month Ša-sarrātim, in the eponymy after that of Aššur-imittī, they will bring 3 shekels of silver, its interest, plus 20 loaves of bread within one year.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI wa-al-dí-lim IGI i-na-ar
target: Witnessed by Waldi-ilum, by Inar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am ša en-nam-a-šùr DUMU kà-ri-a en-nam-a-šùr DUMU šu-{d}EN.LÍL il₅-qé
target: Ennam-Aššur son of Šu-Illil received 1 mina of refined silver belonging to Ennam-Aššur son of Karriya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma en-nam-a-šùr DUMU kà-ri-a a-na a-šùr-DU₁₀ i-tù-ar en-nam-a-šùr DUMU šu-{d}EN.LÍL ú-ba-áb-šu
target: If Ennam-Aššur son of Karriya raises claim against Aššur-ṭāb, Ennam-Aššur son of Šu-Illil will clear him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù ḫa-mu-uš-tim ša PUZUR₄.IŠTAR DUMU šu-lá-áb-ra-at ITU.KAM ḫu-bu-ur li-mì-im a-lá-ḫi-im KÙ.BABBAR il₅-qé
target: In the week of Puzur-Ištar son of Šu-Ilabrat, month hubur, eponymy Ali-ahum, he received the silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ra-bi-ṣú-um ša šál-ma-a-šùr ma-ma-ḫi-ir iš-al
target: Šalim-Aššur's attorney questioned Man-mahir.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ra-bi-ṣú-um-ma i-na dí-in a-lim{ki} ḫu-sà-ru-um ša šál-ma-a-šùr ša i-na a-lim{ki} i-ší-ik-nu lu um-me-a-nu šál-ma-a-šùr iṣ-bu-tù-ú lu a-na ḫu-bu-ul me-er-e šál-ma-a-šùr il₅-qé-ú lu KÙ.BABBAR lu ḫu-sà-ru-ú ú-ta-ru-ú
target: According to a verdict of the City the lapis lazuli of Šalim-Aššur that was deposited in the City - whether investors of Šalim-Aššur have seized it or have taken it to cover the debts of Šalim-Aššur's sons, they must return both silver and lapis lazuli.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša lá ú-ta-e-ru-ú i-ša-ri-iq-šu-um
target: He who does not return it will have it taken away by force.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šál-ma-a-šùr i bu-ul-ṭí-šu ḫu-sà-ra-am a-na ší-a-ma-tim i-dí-na-kum
target: When Šalim-Aššur was alive he gave you lapis lazuli for purchases.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu ḫu-sà-ra-am dí-nam lu KÙ.BABBAR ší-im ḫu-sà-ri-im dí-na-ma a-na a-lim{ki} lu-bi-il₅
target: Either give me the lapis lazuli or give me the price in silver of the lapis lazuli, so I may bring it to the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lá tù-ni-ḫi ra-bi-ṣa-am i-a-tí
target: Do not create difficulties for me, the attorney!

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša ni-iš a-lim{ki} ú ru-ba-im ta-mu-ú lu ú-kà-al ki-ma ú-ni-ḫi-ni ḫu-sà-ra-am lu ší-im ḫu-sà-ri-im ta-da-nam lá i-mu-ú
target: I shall indeed remember what was sworn by an oath by the City and the king - that he has obstructed me. He refused to give either the lapis lazuli or the price of the lapis.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ta-ta a-na en-na-sú-in DUMU šu-a-nim iṣ-ba-at-ni-a-tí-ma
target: Atata seized us against Ennam-Suen, son of Šu-Anum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-ta-ta-ma a-ma 3 li-me URUDU ru-ba-um wa-aḫ-šu-ša-na-i-um a-na ga-ma-ar-tim e-pu-ul-kà
target: Atata said: Look here, 3000 (minas of) copper the ruler of Wahšušana has promised to pay to you as a final settlement.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ší-im-šu a-na a-lim{ki} tù-ša-ak-ša-dam
target: You would see to it that the silver paid for it would reach me in the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: me-na-lam a-ta ta-kà-al ší-im-tám a-na-ku a-lá-qé
target: You would enjoy the profit on it and I would obtain the capital sum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma en-na-sú-in-ma KÙ.BABBAR ší-im URUDU a-na a-lim{ki} ù-ša-ak-ša-da-ku-ma ší-ma-am a-ša-a-ma né-ma-lam a-na-ku a-kà-al
target: Ennam-Suen answered: I would see to it that the silver paid for the copper reaches you in the City and I would make purchases (with it) and the profit (on it) I would enjoy.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI na-áb-sú-in DUMU pì-lá-aḫ-IŠTAR IGI ma-lik-e-nam DUB.SAR
target: In the presence of Nab-Suen, son of Pilah-Ištar, of Malik-ennam, the scribe.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na NINDA
target: 0.5 shekel of silver for bread.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 ší-ni-šu šé-ni-in ša sí-ni-iš-tim
target: 2 pairs of women's shoes,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10.5 GÍN AN.NA
target: 10.5 shekels of tin,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5-ší-šu ma-ar-šu
target: five sets of leather straps,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša 0.25 GÍN du-ug-lu
target: duglu worth 1 / 4 shekel -

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-nu-mì a-na ku-bu-ur-na-at a-ṣé-er ì-lí-dan a-dí-da ù sá-li-a a-lu-wa áš-pu-ru
target: when I sent Aluwa to Kuburnat to Ilī-dan, Adida and Salliya

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na qá-tí-šu a-dí-in
target: I gave this to him to dispose over.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-mur-{d}UTU a-šùr-DU₁₀ ù lá-qé-pí-im qí-bi-ma um-ma en-um-a-šùr-ma
target: To Amur-Šamaš, Aššur-ṭāb and Lā-qēp from Ennam-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 20 2 GÚ SÍG.ḪI.A ku-nu-ki-a 94 maš-ki 10 ANŠE.ḪI.A ṣa-lá-mì ú ú-nu-sú-nu mì-ma a-nim ša-lim-ar-dí ù šé-ep-IŠTAR i-ra-dí-ú-ni-ku-nu-tí
target: 22 talents of wool under my seal, 94 fleeces, 10 black donkeys and their harness - all this Šalim-wardī and Šēp-Ištar lead to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-kam ša-áp-tám ú maš-ki i ḫu-ur-ší-im pí-iḫ-a-ma ṣú-ḫa-ri ṭù-ur-da-nim
target: Lock the wool and the hides in the store room there and send me the servants.

source: translate Akkadian to English: bé-tám e-li-am ku-nu-ki-a pé-té-a-ma i-na ta-ma-lá-ki-im 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a-mu-ra-am ú 1 ma-na URUDU SIG₅ ku-un-kà-ma
target: Open the upper storey sealed by me, and seal in the -container 0.5 mina of checked silver and 1 mina of good copper;

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú 1 TÚG tí-sà-ba-am SIG₅ ú-tù-ur-tám ša a-na li-tab-ší-a a-šùr-DU₁₀ iq-bi-a-ni a-na ší-mì-šu a-šùr-DU₁₀ li-dí-na-ku-nu-tí-ma
target: also, Aššur-ṭāb should give you for sale 1 -textile of extra-fine quality which he promised me for my clothing,

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tí KÙ.BABBAR a-na ṣú-ḫa-ri dí-na-ma lu-ub-lu-nim
target: and then give it together with the silver to the servants so they may bring it.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú-ma-kál lá i-bi-tù ú du-ug-li uṣ-ra-šu-nu-tí
target: They should not rest a single night.

source: translate Akkadian to English: bi-tám i-na ku-nu-ki-ku-nu ku-un-kà
target: Seal the house with your own seals.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na lu-lu ù en-um-a-šur qí-bi-ma a-na lu-lu qí-bi-ma <gap> ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am ni-is-ḫa-sú DIRI ša-du-a-sú ša-bu-ú IGI tù-ra-am-ì-lí ù šu-IŠTAR a-na ší-a-ma-tim i-nu-mì a-na a-lim{ki} ta-li-ku a-dí-na-kum
target: To Lulu and Ennam-Aššur; specifically to Lulu from <gap> I gave you <gap> minas of refined silver, its import duty added, its transport tariff paid for, with Tūram-ilī and Šu-Ištar as witnesses, for purchases when you went to the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫi a-ta šu-ma AN.NA ú-lá TÚG.ḪI.A tù-šé-li-am a-na en-um-a-šur dí-in-ma ku-un-kà-ma šé-bi-lá-nim
target: My dear brother, if you have brought up tin or textiles, give them to Ennam-Aššur, seal them and send them to me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫa-ma 6 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR-pí iš-tí en-um-a-šur tal-qé
target: Further, you received 6 shekels of silver from Ennam-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: <gap> ša KÙ.BABBAR šu-a-tí <gap>-šu a pá-ni <gap> šé-bi₄-lá-nim
target: <gap> of this silver <gap> before <gap> send it to me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB šu-ku-bi₄-im DUMU qá-a-tim KIŠIB a-lá-ḫi-im DUMU a-šur-ma-lik KIŠIB ku-na-a DUMU ma-na-na
target: Seal of Šu-Kūbum, son of Qa'atum, seal of Ali-ahum, son of Aššur-mālik, seal of Kunnāya, son of Manana.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na gám-ri-im ù ḫu-lu-qá-e ša ILLAT ì-lí-a-lim a-na mì-ma šu-um-šu ku-na-a a-na e-lá-ma ú-lá i-tù-ar
target: For expenses and losses of the caravan of Ilī-ālum, whatsoever, Kunnāya shall not raise claim against Elamma.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na 30 ma-na AN.NA ša ku-na-a a-na ILLAT ì-li-a-lim nu-du-a-e i-dí-ú qá-de₈ ILLAT-ma a-na a-wi-tí-šu i-za-sú-um
target: As for the 30 minas of tin, for which Kunnāya served Ilī-ālum's caravan a notice, it will belong to him together with (the other members of) the caravan according to its declared value.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ša-lim-a-šur a-na i-dí-a-bi-im i-tur₄-DINGIR e-na-nim i-na-aḫ-DINGIR ù en-nam-a-šur qí-bi-ma
target: From Šalim-Aššur to Iddin-abum, Itūr-ilī, Ennānum, Inah-ilī and Ennam-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫu-a be-lu-a a-tù-nu lá li-bi₄ DINGIR-li-ma i-be-sà-e ma-du-tim a-ta-ma-ar
target: My dear brothers and lords, unfortunately I have suffered great losses.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ša iš-tí šu-nu-nu tù-šé-bi-lá-ni-ni la-qé-pu-um a-na <gap> ú-ṣí-ma šu-nu-nu <gap>-bi-šu iṣ-ba-at-ma
target: The silver you sent me with Šu-Nūnu Lā-qēpum left for <gap> and Šu-Nūnu seized his <gap>.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR i-na a-wa-tim i-bu-a-ni-ma KÙ.BABBAR i-pá-al i-sà-bi-i
target: He will give in with respect to the silver in a lawsuit and balance the silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ma-du-tim a-ta-ma-ar
target: I have experienced great losses.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫu-a a-tù-nu i ni-kà-sí-a i-na bé-et kà-ri-im šu-ùḫ-ta ú qá-tí mì-ma lá ta-na-dí-a
target: My dear brothers, withdraw at my accounting in the office of the colony and do not deposit anything on my account.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB MAN-a-šur a-na a-nu-<gap>-an
target: Seal of Puzur-Aššur; to Anu<gap>

source: translate Akkadian to English: 12 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṣí-ba-at 8 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR i-li-ik
target: 12 shekels of silver became the interest on 8 minas of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB a-mur-{d}UTU DUMU mì-šar-GAL KIŠIB la-qé-pí-im DUMU {d}AB-ba-ni KIŠIB e-la-ma DUMU i-dí-sú-in
target: Seal of Amur-Šamaš, son of Mīšar-rabi, seal of Lā-qēpum, son of Ellil-bāni, seal of Elamma, son of Iddin-Suen.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša ḫu-bu-ul e-la-ma DUMU i-dí-sú-in
target: About the debt of Elamma son of Iddin-Suen.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na 6 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am i-ṣé-er e-la-ma im-dí-lúm i-šu
target: 1 mina 6 shekels of refined silver Elamma owes to Imdī-ilum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ITU.KAM kán-wár-ta li-mu-um i-dí-a-šùr DUMU ku-bi-dí
target: Month IX, eponym of Iddin-Aššur, son of Kubīdi.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma e-la-ma-ma 1 ma-na 6 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR-áp-kà a-mur-IŠTAR il₅-qé
target: Elamma said: 'Your 1 mina 6 shekels of silver Amur-Ištar has collected'.

source: translate Akkadian to English: e-la-ma a-na im-dí-lim a-mur-IŠTAR ú-kà-an-ma
target: Elamma shall confirm Amur-Ištar (as having it) to Imdī-ilum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma i li-bi a-mur-IŠTAR lá uk-ta-in KÙ.BABBAR ù ṣí-ba-sú e-la-ma a-na im-dí-lim i-ša-qal
target: If he does not confirm that Amur-Ištar has it, Elamma will pay the silver and its interest to Imdī-ilum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: GÍN KÙ.BABBAR 1 šu-ru-um a-ḫa-ma
target: shekels of silver plus 1 black textile.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 20 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ku-nu-ku ša šu-zu-zu a ma-lá tí-ir-tí-šu a-na me-er-e ì-lí-a ni-ip-qí-id
target: 20 minas of silver sealed by Šuzuzu we entrusted to Iliya's sons in accordance with his instructions.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-lá-ḫi-im ú zu-ku-a um-ma PUZUR₄-a-šur-ma 13 ma-na AN.NA ku-nu-ki-a i-na za-al-pá a-na en-nam-a-šur DUMU na-ra-ÁB-sú-in a-dí-in
target: To Ali-ahum and Zukuwa from Puzur-Aššur; I gave 13 minas of tin under my seal in Zalpa to Ennam-Aššur son of Narām-Suen.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma en-nam-a-šur e-ru-ba-am AN.NA li-dí-na-ku-nu-tí-ma AN.NA a-na KÙ.BABBAR dí-na-ma
target: If Ennam-Aššur has entered (the town), let him give you the tin and sell the tin for silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú-ul KÙ.BABBAR i-da-na-ku-nu-tí
target: or else he may give you silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na KÙ.BABBAR ší-im AN.NA-ki-a pì-ri-kà-ni
target: Buy for the silver proceeds from the tin.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša-ma-ma a-dí tí-ir-tí i-lá-kà-ni li-ib-ší-ú
target: and let them stay put until my instructions arrive.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ku-zi-zi-a ù pí-lá-aḫ-IŠTAR qí-bi-ma um-ma en-um-a-šur-ma
target: To Kuziziya and Pilah-Ištar from Ennam-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 TÚG ra-qá-tim 0.5 ma-na 3 GÍN ḫu-sà-ru-um ša-lim-wa-ar-dí ù šé-ep-IŠTAR a-ṣé-er ku-zi-zi-a ub-lu-nim
target: Šalim-wardī and Šēp-Ištar brought 2 thin textiles and 33 shekels of lapis lazuli to Kuziziya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 TÚG ša ma-e SIG₅-tum 1 TÚG lu-bu-šu-am ku-nu-ki-a a-ṣé-er ku-zi-zi-a šu-be-lúm ù a-lu-a na-áš-ú
target: Šu-Bēlum and Aluwa bring 3 good waterproof textiles and 1 garment under my seal to Kuziziya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù mì-šu ša a-dí pí-lá-aḫ-IŠTAR áš-pu-ku-nu-tí-ni ṣú-ḫa-ru-a a-dí u₄-mì-im a-nim wa-áš-bu-ni
target: But why is it that although I wrote to you about Pilah-Ištar, my servants have stayed until today?

target: I told you: 'Give me cash the travel expenses'.

target: but you answered me: 'Only when you salvage the textiles I will go and send you from hahhum 0.5, 1 or 2 minas (of silver) for your expenses'.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù a-dí ma-lá ù ší-ni-šu a-na ḫa-ḫi-im áš-pu-ra-ku-ma a-ta mì-ma lá tù-uš-té-bi-lam

source: translate Akkadian to English: TÚG.ḪI-tù i-na a-lá-ni a-šar ib-ší-ú-ni a-lik-ma TÚG.ḪI.A ú-šé-ṣí-a-ma a-na-aḫ-ma TÚG.ḪI.A a-ṣé-er ša-zu-za-tí-kà a-na wa-aḫ-šu-ša-na ú-šé-ri-ib-ma

target: Did Pilah-Ištar not tell you there that moths have spoiled them and that one offers a bad price for them?

target: Ten textiles have now been sold for 2.5 minas of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: Your representatives sealed the silver and it is here.
target: Your representatives sealed the silver and it is here.

source: translate Akkadian to English: While you instructed me in hurama as follows: 'If your sister goes to the City, give the silver, the price the textiles yielded, to her and let her come here', since a severe cold reigns here it is not feasible for her to go and therefore I did not yield the silver to her.
target: While you instructed me in hurama as follows: 'If your sister goes to the City, give the silver, the price the textiles yielded, to her and let her come here', since a severe cold reigns here it is not feasible for her to go and therefore I did not yield the silver to her.

source: translate Akkadian to English: It is up to you there what to do.
target: It is up to you there what to do.

source: translate Akkadian to English: I sent you 2 minas 57 shekels of silver with Šu-Suen from hattum, thinking: 'He is my father, he will go and bring tin up for me from the City so that I obtain at least some silver and also can pay silver to my creditor and send (what I owe) on the basis of my tablet.'
target: I sent you 2 minas 57 shekels of silver with Šu-Suen from hattum, thinking: 'He is my father, he will go and bring tin up for me from the City so that I obtain at least some silver and also can pay silver to my creditor and send (what I owe) on the basis of my tablet.'

source: translate Akkadian to English: But you, you said: 'Your sister needed silver and I have given it to her on the basis of your tablet'.
target: But you, you said: 'Your sister needed silver and I have given it to her on the basis of your tablet'.

source: translate Akkadian to English: Later, when you were about to set out on a journey, you said: 'Give me every single shekel of silver you have then I will buy for you tin, 10 minas, so that you can obtain silver and gather courage'.
target: Later, when you were about to set out on a journey, you said: 'Give me every single shekel of silver you have then I will buy for you tin, 10 minas, so that you can obtain silver and gather courage'.

source: translate Akkadian to English: But instead of encouraging me, (for) the 1 mina 14 shekels of silver - its excise added, its transport fee paid - and in addition 0.5 mina of silver, temple funds of Aššur - its excise added, its transport fee paid - that I gave you in the presence of Azutaya and Idi-bāni to make purchases with, until this very day you have not sent me the tin bought with my silver!
target: But instead of encouraging me, (for) the 1 mina 14 shekels of silver - its excise added, its transport fee paid - and in addition 0.5 mina of silver, temple funds of Aššur - its excise added, its transport fee paid - that I gave you in the presence of Azutaya and Idi-bāni to make purchases with, until this very day you have not sent me the tin bought with my silver!

source: translate Akkadian to English: I thought: 'You are my father, my boss, purchase for me tin, 10 minas, and send it me'.
target: I thought: 'You are my father, my boss, purchase for me tin, 10 minas, and send it me'.

source: translate Akkadian to English: Please, my father, my boss, send what was bought with the silver I gave you, its tin.
target: Please, my father, my boss, send what was bought with the silver I gave you, its tin.

source: translate Akkadian to English: Enable me to face Aššur!
target: Enable me to face Aššur!

target: 0.5? mina for (paying) the import-tax on the tin purchased by Iddin-Suen, we placed on top of the packet

target: Later the son of Ṣallāmum produced 18 minas of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ù KÙ.GI pá-ni-am ú-ša-ší-ib TUR GAL nu-pá-ḫe-er-ma a-ṣé-er ša ki-ma ku-a-tí a-na kà-ni-iš nu-uš-té-ri-ib
target: This silver and the earlier amount of gold he <gap> We collected everything and brought (it) into Kanesh to your representatives (saying):

target: 2 extra ingots and 2 bundles of tin under my seal, in all 35 minas of tin, that Aššur-bāni son of Iddin-abum brings;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 ri-ik-sí ku-nu-ki-a ŠU.NÍGIN 33 ma-na AN.NA ša a-mur-a-šùr DUMU a-šùr-DU₁₀ na-áš-ú

target: As for Ali-ahum and the servants who are present - plus the donkeys that Ilī-wēdāku conducted to me plus my own that Wašibru-bāni led to you, including its harness - let Ali-ahum lead that to me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR bé-ú-lá-at ki-ta-a

target: 4 minas 3.8333 shekels of silver with Idnāya, month IV, eponymy of Šudāya; he will add 1 1 / 4 shekel per (mina per month) as interest.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 8 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR KI i-ku-mì-šar
target: 8 shekels of silver with Ikūn-Mīšar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 ma-na 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR KI a-šùr-du-ri li-mu-um ip-ḫu-ru-um 1.5 GÍN.TA ṣí-ib-tám ú-ṣa-áb
target: 2 minas 10 shekels of silver with Aššur-dūrī, year eponymy of Iphurum. He will add 1.5 shekel per (mina per month).

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR KI ba-al-ṭù-im
target: 0.5 mina of silver with Balṭu'um.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.3333 ma-na 5 GÍN bé-ú-lá-at gal-da-a
target: 25 shekels (of silver) working capital of Galdaya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR KI gal-da-a
target: 1 mina of silver with Galdaya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na lu-zi-na a-dí-da ù a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi₄-ma um-ma en-na-sú-in-ma
target: To Luzina, Adida and Ali-ahum; from Enna-Suen:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5.3333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am PUZUR₄-a-šùr DUMU a-zu-za ḫa-bu-lam iš-tù ITU.KAM na-ar-ma-ak-a-šùr li-mu-um en-na-sú-in a-na 7 ITU.KAM i-ša-qal
target: Puzur-Aššur son of Azuza owes me 5.3333 minas of refined silver. He is to pay within 7 months from the month Narmak-Aššur in the eponymy of Enna-Suen.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma lá iš-qú-ul ki-ma a-wa-at kà-ri-im ṣí-ib-tám ú-ṣa-áb
target: If he has not paid (in time), he is to add interest in accordance with the rule of the colony.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫu-ú-a be-lu-ú-a a-tù-nu a-wi-lúm a-dí ma-lá ù ší-ni-šu iṣ-li-a-ni
target: My dear brothers and lords, the man has cheated me once or twice.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṣa-áb-ta-šu-ma KÙ.BABBAR ù ṣí-ba-sú ma-lá ta-le-e-a-ni ša-áš-qí-lá-šu-ma AN.NA ša-ma-nim-ma ku-un-kà-ma a-na DUMU um-me-a-nim ke-nim dí-na-ma ku-nu-ki-ku-nu lu-ub-lam
target: Seize him and have him pay the silver and as much interest as you can manage and then buy tin for me, seal it and give it to a reliable affiliated trader who can bring it to me under your seals.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB a-lu-lá-a DUMU a-li-a KIŠIB a-šur-pì-lá-aḫ DUMU šu-a-nim
target: Seal of Alulāya, son of Aliya, seal of Aššur-pilah, son of Šu-Anum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-mur-IŠTAR ú en-um-a-šur iṣ-bu-tù-ni-a-tí-ma dí-šu-nu ni-dí-ma
target: Amur-Ištar and Ennam-Aššur seized us and we passed for them the following verdict:

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-ta-ma a-mur-IŠTAR i-na šu-ga-ri-e ša a-šur ṭup-pá-am en-um-a-šur ša be-ú-lá-at a-bi₄-šu IGI be-lá-nim ú ma-ṣí-ì-lí DUMU bu-zu-zi-im lá ú-kà-li-mu-ma i-ta-ma-ma
target: Amur-Ištar will swear by the -emblem of Aššur that Ennam-Aššur did not show him the contract of the working capital of his father in the presence of Bēlānum and Maṣi-ilī, son of Buzuzum, and then, when he swears,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú en-um-a-šur ṭup-pá-am ša ku-nu-ki-šu en-um-a-šur a-na a-mur-IŠTAR i-dá-an ša ki-ma a-na be-ú-lá-at a-šur-i-mì-tí me-er-at e-lá-ma ú me-er-ú e-lá-ma a-na a-mur-IŠTAR lá i-tù-ru-ni
