target: Ennam-Aššur will give Amur-Ištar a tablet with his seal stating that the daughter of Elamma and the sons of Elamma will not raise claims against Amur-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ITU.1.KAM be-el-té-É.GAL-lim li-mu-um ša qá-té en-na-ma-nim
target: Month I, eponymy of the successor of Ennamānum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-wi-lu a-ni-ú-tum da-a-a-nu
target: The above mentioned men were judges.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ku-da-tim KIŠIB na-áb-sú-in ù en-um-a-šùr
target: To Kudātum; seal of Nāb-Suen and Ennam-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB a-na-na a-na ili₅-ba-ni ú ki-li-il₅-zu-um
target: Seal of Abela; to Ilī-bāni and Kililsum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma <gap>-a-šùr-ma a-na <gap> ù a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi-ma a-ḫu-a a-tù-nu <gap>-ma lu i-na <gap>-lá <gap>-na-ša lu i-na <gap> ta ki a ku-nu-ku-kà kà-an-ku-ma a-na ṣé-ri-a ú a-na ḫu-<gap> a-na ku-ša-ra ki-lá-lá-ku-nu et-qá-ni-ma
target: From <gap>-Aššur to <gap> and Ali-ahum: My dear brothers, <gap> either in <gap> or in <gap> are sealed with your seal, and go both of you to me and to <gap> in Kuššara.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫu-a a-tù-nu a-na-ku a-na ma-nim ú a-tù-nu a-na ma-nim i-šu-ma ku-nu-um ḫa-bu-lá-ku ku-nu-um-ma al-kà-ni-ma li-ba-am dí-na-ma <gap> ša a-<gap> ù-šé-ri-bu-ni
target: My dear brothers, to whom can I turn and to whom can you, for it is your property that I owe - it is indeed yours! Come and encourage me <gap> they had enter.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma a-na ga-ma-ri-im 0.8333 ma-na AN.NA dí-na-šu-nu šu-ma lá ki-am
target: If (it is) for expenses, then give them 0.8333 mina; if that is not the case <gap>

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na tí-bu-lá ta-nu-uš-ta ù áš-ta-aḫ-šu-šar qí-bi₄-ma um-ma šu-ku-tum-ma mì-šu ša a-ma-kam a-na kà-ri-im a-we-lúm i-li-ku-ni a-tí-na tù-šé-ra-šu sà-ru-tí iš-me
target: To Tibula, Tanušta and Aštahšušar from Šukkutum: Why is it that when the man goes to the colony there you release him? He listened to lies.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lá iš-ta-na-me ki-ma a-na-kam a-ḫi ù tap-pá-i im-šu-ḫu-ni
target: Does he not hear all the time that they maltreat my brother and my partner here?

source: translate Akkadian to English: a ší-a-tí a-na-kam as-ḫu-ur
target: For that reason I am delayed here.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na tí-bu-lá qí-bi₄-ma šu-ma a-ma-kam am-tum em-ṣa-at ù lá lá-bu-ša-at i-na KÙ.BABBAR ša DAM.GÀR e-zi-ba-ki-ni KÙ.BABBAR dí-ni-ší-im
target: To Tibula: If the maid there is hungry or not properly clothed, then give her some silver out of the silver that the merchant left with you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-tí-ma a-na kà-ri-im kà-ša-dim šu-ma um-mì a-tí ša ma-ma-an lá ta-ša-me ḫa-ra-ni a-ku-ša-am
target: If you are truly my mother, listen to no one! My trip has been put off.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ṣí-lá-{d}IM-ma a-na en-um-a-šur qí-bi₄-ma
target: From Ṣill-Adad to Ennam-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam be-lu-ba-ni a-šu-mì KÙ.BABBAR aṣ-ba-at-ma
target: I seized Bēlum-bāni here because of the silver,

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-ut-ma ḫa-ra-ni a kà-ni-iš a-lá-ak-ma ú-ṭá-áb-šu
target: and he said: I am on my way to Kanesh so I shall satisfy him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-šu-mì sà-ḫe-er-tim aṣ-ba-sú-ma
target: I seized him because of the small goods

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-ut-ma šu-ma lá KÙ.BABBAR sà-ḫe-er-tám mì-ma lá ḫa-bu-lá-ku
target: and he said: "Apart from the silver I do not owe him small goods."

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ta ma-lá-kà ra-mì-ni lá ṭá-áb-ma ṣú-ḫa-ri-a lá-aṭ-ru-dam
target: Make up your mind. I am not feeling well myself, so I shall send you my servants.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ša-lim-a-šùr-ma a-na i-dí-a-bi-im en-na-nim i-na-aḫ-DINGIR ma-ma-ḫi-ir en-um-a-šùr ù a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bí-ma
target: From Šalim-Aššur to Iddin-abum, Ennānum, Inah-ilī, Man-mahir, Ennam-Aššur and Ali-ahum:

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pé-e-a ḫa-ru-mu-tim ša ba-a-ba-tí-a am-ra-ma ma-ma-an KÙ.BABBAR 1 GÍN ḫa-bu-lá-ni KÙ.BABBAR ù ṣí-ba-sú ša-áš-qí-lá
target: Check my certified tablets concerning my outstanding claims, and make anyone who owes me a single shekel of silver pay the silver and its interest.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-šar ta-na-ṭá-lá-ni a-tù-nu-ma a-ma-kam mì-il₅-kà iḫ-da-ma KÙ.BABBAR ša-áš-qí-lá-ma i-na pá-nim-ma šé-bi-lá-nim
target: You yourselves must decide there in whatever matter you observe. Take care to have the silver paid and send it to me as soon as possible.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ša ba-a-ba-tí-a lu ša-li-iṭ a-li-bi lu-qú-tí-a lá ta-sà-ḫi-a
target: The silver from my outstanding claims must be available; do not make trouble (mixing it) with my merchandise.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 7.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR qá-tí ša tù-um-li-a-i-im 2 ma-na.TA KÙ.BABBAR ù 80 80 ú-ṭù-tù-um mì-iš-lu-um GIG ṣí-ib-tám iš-tù MU.4.ŠÈ tal-qé-a
target: 7 ½ minas of silver, the share of the man from Tumliya; you received interest for 4 years at 2 minas of silver each and two times 80 (sacks) of grain, half of it wheat.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 8 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ù 3 me-at 20 na-ru-uq ú-ṭù-tù-um ší-im ú-ṭí-tí-a ù KÙ.BABBAR ṣí-ib-tí šu-ul-ṭá-ma šé-bi₄-lá-nim
target: 8 minas of silver plus 320 sacks of grain – make the proceeds from my grain and my interest on the silver available and send it.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù šu-ma ta-áš-bi-tí qá-tí i-du-nu-ni-ku-nu-tí le-qé-a
target: And if they will give you the full payment on my share, then take it.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù šu-ma ma-ma-an i-na tap-pá-i-a lá ma-gi₅-ir-ku-nu qá-tí dí-na iš-té-ni-iš KÙ.BABBAR šé-bi-lá-nim
target: Also, if any of my partners do not agree with you, then sell the share. Send me all of the silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša be-lúm-ba-ni
target: 3 shekels of silver belonging to Bēlum-bāni

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša lá-ma-sí
target: 3 shekels of silver belonging to Lamassī

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.3333 GÍN a-na šé-pí-IŠTAR ší-im ki-ri-im
target: 0.3333 shekel silver for Šēp-Ištar, the price of drinks

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.3333 GÍN ší-im ku-ku-za-nim
target: 0.3333 shekel the price of a piglet

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ma a-ni-im i ší-im Ì.GIŠ
target: All this from the price of oil

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša té-zi-bu-ni-a-tí-ni a-na DAM.GÀR ni-iš-qúl 1 GÍN im-ṭí
target: The 2 minas of silver that you left behind to us we paid to the merchant; it was 1 shekel short.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.6666 ma-na 0.5 GÍN a-na e-na-ni-a áš-qúl
target: 40.5 shekels I paid to Ennāniya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ.BA 10 GÍN sí-lu-lu il₅-qé
target: 10 shekels, thereof Ṣilulu took.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ší-im am-tim KI ku-um-ri-im
target: 0.5 mina of silver, the price of a slave-girl is due by the priest.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša-ni-tám-a-na e-na-ni-a e-zi-ib
target: A second (slave-girl) I left to Ennāniya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 36 ma-na URUDU 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR KI zu-ba 1 ṣú-ḫa-ru-um mì-ma a-nim a-na e-na-ni-a e-zi-ib
target: 36 minas of copper (and) 5 shekels of silver due from Zuba, 1 young slave - all this I left to Ennāniya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB ni-mar-IŠTAR DUMU PUZUR₄-a-šùr KIŠIB en-nam-a-šùr DUMU kà-ri-a
target: Sealed by Nimar-Ištar son of Puzur-Aššur, by Ennam-Aššur son of Karriya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-šùr-na-da DUMU šu-{d}EN.LÍL tap-pá-i-ni
target: Aššur-nādā son of Šu-Illil is our (absent) partner.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um kà-ni-iš i-dí-ni-a-tí-ma
target: The Kanesh colony gave us for these proceedings.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI GÍR ša a-šùr ší-bu-tí-ni ni-dí-in
target: We gave our testimony before Aššur's dagger.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma en-um-a-šur-ma a-na ku-ra qí-bi-ma ḫa-ra-ni a-na a-lim{ki}
target: From Ennam-Aššur to Kura: My journey goes to the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 GÚ 35 ma-na URUDU ší-kam ša ṭup-pí-kà ša-ni-im e-li-im u₄-mu-kà 2 ša-na-at e-tí-qú
target: As to the 3 talents 35 minas of copper from your second, upper tablet, your term is exceeded by 2 years.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na tù-wa-ar ṣú-ḫa-ri-a iš-tù pu-ru-uš-ḫa-dim URUDU-ú-šu ma-sí-a-am a-na aḫ-ša-lim ù a-na ša ki-ma i-a-tí šu-qú-ul-ma ṭup-pá-kà iš-tí aḫ-ša-lim le-qé
target: When my servant returns from Purušhaddum pay his washed copper to Ah-šalim or to my representatives, and get your tablet from Ah-šalim.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma URUDU lá ta-kà-ša-ad 1 GÚ URUDU SIG₅ šu-qú-ul-ma ta-aḫ-sí-is-tám pá-tí-tám id-a-ma i-na ḫu-bu-li-kà li-iṣ-ḫi-ir
target: If you do not acquire enough copper, then pay 1 talent of good copper and set down in an open memorandum that it will be deducted from your debt.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù URUDU na-am-a-dam ša ṭup-pì-kà a-dí tù-wa-ri-a ni-sí
target: Then we have settled the majority of the copper from your tablet until my return.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na URUDU a-na qá-té ṣú-ḫa-ri-a dí-in
target: Give 1 mina of copper to my servant to dispose of.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma i-dí-sú-in a-na ku-li-a qí-bi₄-ma
target: Thus Iddin-Suen to Kuliya:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na Ì.GIŠ ša tù-ùḫ-pí-a ú 5 ma-na URUDU ša ša-du-i-šu i pá-ni-kà lá té-zi-ba-am
target: The one mina of oil of Tuhpiya and the 5 minas of copper of local origin you must not leave behind for me when you leave!

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫi a-ta i-ḫi-id Ì.GIŠ ú URUDU lá té-zi-ba-am
target: Please, my brother, take care not to leave the oil and the copper behind for me!

source: translate Akkadian to English: wa-at-ra-am lá kà-áš-du-ni li-it-ma-ma
target: let him swear that they have not achieved an extra

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù KÙ.BABBAR ma-lá ú <gap> ša TÚG.ḪI.A
target: and then we shall give the silver, as much as <gap> of the textiles

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù a-dí ša a-šur-i-mì-tí i-na a-lim{ki} e-pu-šu-ni
target: and with respect to what Aššur-imittī makes in the City

source: translate Akkadian to English: ni-dan šu-ta-mu-zi ù a-dí-da i-na ší-bi-a
target: Šu-Tammuzi and Adida must <gap> among my witnesses

source: translate Akkadian to English: 20 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pu-um i-ṣé-er i-dí-a-bi₄-im šu-{d}EN.LÍL i-šu
target: Iddin-abum owes 20 minas of refined silver to Šu-Illil.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù ḫa-mu-uš-tim ša kà-ší-im <gap> a-na 13 ḫa-am-ša-tim i-ša-qal
target: Reckoned from the week of the kaššum he must pay within 13 weeks.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma i-na ma-la u₄-me-šu lá eš-qú-ul 1.5 GÍN.TA i-na ITU.KAM a-na 1 ma-na-im ú-ṣa-áb
target: If he has not paid at the completion of his term, he must pay interest at the rate 1.5 shekel per month per mina.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI PUZUR₄-a-šùr IGI a-šùr-i-mì-tí IGI šu-a-nim IGI a-šùr-be-el-a-wa-tim
target: Witnessed by Puzur-Aššur, by Aššur-imitti, by Šu-Anum, by Aššur-bēl-awātim.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na e-lá-ma qí-bi-ma um-ma a-šùr-mu-ta-pì-il₅-ma
target: Say to Elamma, thus Aššur-mūtappil:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 GÚ AN.NA ú ṣú-ba-tí ša ta-dí-na-ni um-ma a-ta-ma 1 GÚ AN.NA a-ta ù a-ḫu-qar liq-a
target: As for the 3 talents of tin and the textiles you gave me with the instruction: 'You and Ahu-waqar must take (each) 1 talent of tin'

source: translate Akkadian to English: ki-ma šé-pu-um na-ak-ša-at-ni a-na bu-ru-uš-ḫa-tim a-ṣé-er a-šur-DU₁₀ ú-bi-il₅-ma
target: since the traffic is cut off, I brought it to Burušhattum, to Aššur-ṭāb,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 GÚ AN.NA a-na a-šùr-DU₁₀ a-dí-in
target: and I gave Aššur-ṭāb the 3 talents of tin.

source: translate Akkadian to English: TÚG.ḪI.A a-na ùḫ-šu-ša-na ú-ta-e-ra-am
target: The textiles he brought back to Wahšušana.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 35.5 GÚ URUDU i šé-ep a-šùr-DU₁₀ ú i šé-pì-a e-bu-kam
target: He shipped to you 35.5 talents of copper under Aššur-ṭāb's and my responsibility.

source: translate Akkadian to English: <gap>-30 ma-na <gap> i li-bi₄ i-ku-pì-a DUMU šu-a-nim ša be-lúm-ba-ni DUMU a-šur-be-el-a-wa-tim
target: 30 minas of <gap> are owed by Ikūn-pīya son of Šu-Anum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB a-šùr-i-mì-tí KIŠIB šu-a-nim KIŠIB i-dí-a-bi-im
target: Seal of Aššur-imittī, seal of Šu-Anum, seal of Iddin-abum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša 14 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am i-ṣé-er i-dí-a-bi-im a-mur-IŠTAR i-šu-ú
target: Concerning 14 minas of refined silver that Iddin-abum owes to Amur-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù ḫa-mu-uš-tim ša da-la-áš ù du-ùḫ-ni-iš a-na 43 ḫa-am-ša-tim i-ša-qal
target: Reckoned from the week of Dalaš and Duhniš he must pay within 43 weeks.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma i-na ma-lá u₄-me-šu lá iš-qúl 1.5 GÍN.TA i ITU.1.KAM a-1 ma-na-im ú-ṣa-áb
target: If he has not paid within the stipulated term he must pay interest at the rate 1.5 shekel per month per mina.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na KÙ a-nim 5 0.6666 ma-na 5 GÍN ša a-šùr-e-mu-qí
target: Of this silver 5.6666 minas 5 shekels belong to Aššur-emūqi.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-šé-ra-tim wa-ar-ki-a-tim i-ma-ar
target: He will await the coming.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na a-šùr-lá-ma-ša DUMU lá-qé-ep aḫ-bu-ul
target: I owe 10 shekels of silver to Aššur-lamaša son of Lā-qēp.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na šu-ta-mu-zi e-lá-a a-šur-ma-sú-wi a-dí-da ù en-um-a-šur qí-bi-ma um-ma en-um-a-šur-ma a-ba-ú-a bé-lu-a a-tù-nu
target: To Šu-Tammuzi, Elaya, Aššur-massu'ī, Adida and Ennam-Aššur from Ennam-Aššur: My dear fathers and lords, you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na 2 ṭup-pé-e ša a-lim{ki} ša áš-pu-ra-ku-nu-tí-ni a-ma-kam iḫ-da-ma a-na ša áš-pu-ra-ku-nu-tí-ni a-lam mu-ùḫ-ra-ma ṭup-pé-e ša dí-in a-lim{ki} le-qé-a-nim-ma a-lu-wa ú MAŠKIM ṭù-ur-da-nim
target: Take care there with the two tablets from the City that I wrote to you about, and confront the City concerning what I wrote to you, get tablets with verdicts of the City and send Aluwa and the attorney.

source: translate Akkadian to English: be-lu-a a-tù-nu a-ma-kam lá ta-ša-lá-ṭá-ma u₄-me-e ma-du-tim a-na-kam lá a-sà-ḫu-ur-ma É a-bi₄-a lá i-ḫa-li-iq
target: My dear lords, do not act rashly there, lest I be delayed here a long time, and my father's house be lost.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lá-li-kam-ma e-né-ku-nu lá-mu-ur
target: I shall come and see your eyes.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-ra-tim šé-bu-ul-ta-ku-nu ku-nu-ki-a a-lu-wa na-áš-a-ku-nu-tí
target: Aluwa brings you the belts, your shipment, under my seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na u₄-mì-im ša ra-bi₄-iṣ-ku-nu e-ra-ba-ni ITU.1.KAM iš-tí-in ra-mì-ni lu-za-ki-ma lá-li-kam-ma e-né-ku-nu lá-mu-ur
target: The very day your attorney arrives, I shall clear myself within a month and come to see your eyes.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-nam ma-da-tim lu-lá-pì-ta-ku-nu-tí ki-ma É a-bi-a té-ṭí-ra-ni ep-ša
target: Why should I write at length to you? Act so as to save my father's house.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi-ma um-ma SIG₅-pí-a-šur-ma
target: To Ali-ahum from Damiq-pī-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí ša wa-li-a kà-ṣa-ar a-šur-be-el-ša-du-e na-áš-pé-er-tám a-na-ku ú PUZUR₄-a-šur iš-tù ḫu-ra-ma nu-lá-pì-ta-ku-um
target: Concerning Waliya, Aššur-bēl-šaduʾe's packer, I and Puzur-Aššur wrote a missive to you from hurama.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú i na-áš-pè-er-tí-ni lá-áp-ta-ku-um ki-ma KÙ.BABBAR KÙ.BABBAR-pí-ni-ma
target: In our missive it was stated for you that the silver is my silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša-ḫu-tí-a i-ma-ṭá KÙ.BABBAR ú-ša-pí-il₅ ú-lá-pì-tám ú-ša-qí-il₅
target: Before I was cleared I have caused Puzur-Aššur to be satisfied with the deficit on the silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫi i-ḫi-id-ma KÙ.BABBAR KÙ.BABBAR tù-uš-ta-áš-qí-il₅
target: My dear brother, take care and have the silver paid.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-šar a-dí bu-ra-im li-tab-ší-kà ta-áš-pu-ra-ni bu-ra-am
target: If you have already had the silver paid, then send word to me wherever I may be staying and inform me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 25 ma-na URUDU SIG₅ KI i-ku-pì-a DUMU i-ku-pì-a
target: 25 minas of good copper owed by Ikūn-pīya son of Ikūn-pīya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na ší-ta iš-ra-tim ša ta-al-ḫa-at
target: 2.5 shekels of silver for two belts from Talhat;

source: translate Akkadian to English: a ma-lá tí-ir-tí-kà šu-{d}EN.LÍL ni-iṣ-ba-at-ma
target: In accordance with your instructions we seized Šu-Illil,

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na 3 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša šu-{d}EN.LÍL kà-ṣa-ar ì-lí-dan il₅-qé-ú 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša a-na ta-<gap>-li-im pí qá-ta-tí-šu ú-ṣa-ḫi-ir-ma
target: and of the 3 minas of silver that Šu-Illil, Ilī-dan's harnessor, received, I deducted 1 mina of silver for <gap> at the order of his guarantor,

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na 1 ma-na ší-tí KÙ.BABBAR 18.3333 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na ṭup-pì-kà ša ḫa-bu-lá-ni ú-ṣa-ḫi-ir-ma
target: and of the 1 mina of silver, the rest of the silver, I deducted 18.3333 shekels of silver for your tablet stating that he owed it to me,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pá-kà ḫa-ar-ma-am nu-šé-ṣí-a-ma PUZUR₄-sú-in na-áš-a-kum
target: we produced your certified tablet and Puzur-Suen brings it to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-tí KÙ.BABBAR-pì-kà 1.6666 ma-na 1.3333 GÍN <gap> i qé-er-bi₄-im <gap> 1.3333 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR <gap> a-dí 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR <gap> e i-ša-qal <gap>-ri-im <gap> bu <gap> ta <gap> ṣú-ba-tám i-<gap> šu-{d}EN.LÍL <gap> lu 0.3333 ma-na <gap> ul lá <gap>
target: The rest of your silver, 1.6666 mina 1.3333 shekel <gap> within <gap>

source: translate Akkadian to English: <gap> ma-na KÙ.BABBAR <gap> PUZUR₄-a-šur <gap> ma-na KÙ.BABBAR <gap> ṣí-li-IŠTAR <gap> iš-tù ḫa-mu-uš-tim ša ú-ra-a ù kur-ub-IŠTAR a-na ša-na-at i-ša-qal
target: Puzur-Aššur owes minas of silver; Ṣill-Ištar owes minas of silver; he will pay within 1 year reckoned from the week of Uraya and Kurub-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma i-na ma-lá u₄-me-šu lá iš-qúl ki-ma a-wa-at kà-ri-im ṣí-ib-tám ú-ṣa-áb
target: If he has not paid at the completion of his term, he will add interest in accordance with the rule of the colony.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ITU.KAM ša ke-na-tim li-mu-um a-al-DU₁₀ DUMU sà-sà-tim IGI PUZUR₄.IŠTAR DUMU a-šur-ma-lik IGI en-nam-a-šur DUMU ú-ta-a
target: Month Ša-kēnātim, eponymy Ali-ṭāb son of Sassātum. Witnessed by Puzur-Ištar son of Aššur-malik, by Ennam-Aššur son of Utaya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am i-ṣé-er šu-ma-bi₄-a en-um-a-šur i-šu iš-tí KÙ.BABBAR a-nim uk-ta-al
target: Šum-abiya owes 0.5 mina of refined silver to Ennam-Aššur; he is being held in service with this silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-ta-dí-a DUMU en-na-nim IGI a-šur-ni-šu DUMU a-mu-ra-a
target: Witnessed by Atadiya son of Ennānum, by Aššur-nīšu son of Amuraya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: <gap> 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pu-um KI šu-ma-bi₄-a iš-tù a-lim{ki} i-na e-lá-i-šu i-ša-qal
target: Šum-abiya owes 5 shekels of refined silver; he will pay when he comes up from the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma lá iš-qúl ki-ma a-wa-at kà-ri-im ṣí-ib-tám ú-ṣa-ab
target: If he has not paid, he will add interest in accordance with the rule of the colony.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ITU.KAM be-el-tí-É.GAL-lim li-mu-um ša qá-tí DINGIR-šu-ra-bi₄ IGI a-ta-dí-a IGI a-na-lí
target: Month Bēlat-ekallim, eponymy after Ilšu-rabi. Witnessed by Atadiya, by Annali.

source: translate Akkadian to English: <gap> ṣa-ru-pá-am <gap> DUMU du-dí-ki <gap> i-ṣé-er PUZUR₄-a-šur i-šu iš-tù ḫa-mu-uš-tim ša a-šur-ma-lik ù {d}UTU-ba-ni a-n
target: Puzur-Aššur owes mina of refined silver owed by son of Dudiki; they will pay within weeks reckoned from the week of Aššur-malik and Šamaš-bāni.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 41 ma-na 11.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am ku-nu-ku ša ki-ma šu-a-tí ú ku-nu-ki-a 3 né-pí-šu
target: 41 minas 11.5 shekels of refined silver, sealed by your representatives and by me - 3 packages;

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫa-ma 0.6666 ma-na 1 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša-du-a-sú mì-ma a-nim a-na šu-nu-nu ù ì-lí-áš-ra-ni áp-qí-id-ma a-na ṣé-er ša-lim-a-šur a-na a-lim{ki} ub-lu
target: further, 0.6666 mina 1 shekel of silver, its transport tariff - all this I entrusted to Šu-Nūnu and Ilī-ašrannī, and they brought it to Šalim-Aššur in the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫa-ma 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na ú-ku-ul-tí-šu-nu a-dí-šu-nu-tí
target: Furthermore, 5 shekels of silver I gave them for their food.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-ḫu-wa-qar DUMU šu-IŠTAR IGI ba-zi-a DUMU DINGIR-ku-ru-ub IGI DUMU qar-da-a
target: Witnessed by Ahu-waqar son of Šu-Ištar, by Baziya son of Ilī-kurub, by the son of Qardaya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫa-ma 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a bé-a-lim a-na šu-nu-nu 7 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na ì-lí-áš-ra-ni ma-aḫ-ri-šu-nu a-dí-in
target: Furthermore, I gave 10 shekels of silver to Šu-Nūnu as a working capital and 7 shekels of silver to Ilī-ašrannī witnessed by them.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 20 ma-na en-nam-a-šùr DUMU i-sú-ri-ik
target: 20 minas: Ennam-Aššur son of Issu-arik.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 14 ḫi-dim sú-sà-a-a DUMU na-áp-ra-kà
target: 14 beads: Susaya son of Napraka.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 ma-na 2.5 ḫi-dim i-zi-me-IZ-šar
target: 2 minas, 2 ½ beads: Izziz-mīšar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 ma-na 13 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am ku-nu-ki-a a-na dan-a-šùr DUMU PUZUR₄-a-šùr áp-qí-id-ma
target: I entrusted 4 minas 13 shekels of refined silver under my seal to Dan-Aššur son of Puzur-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-lim{ki} a-ṣé-er ša-lim-a-šur ú-šé-bi₄-il₅-šu
target: and he sent it to the City to Šalim-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na šál-ma-a-šur KIŠIB ma-ma-ḫi-ir
target: To Šalim-Aššur; sealed by Man-mahir.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na MAR.TU-ba-ni ṣí-lu-lu ku-zi-zi-a ù a-šùr-dan qí-bi-ma um-ma ša-lim-a-šùr-ma
target: To Amurrum-bāni, Ṣilulu, Kuziziya and Aššur-dan from Šalim-Aššur;

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ku-zi-zi-a qí-bi-ma a-dí ší-ni-šu ú ša-lá-ší-šu tí-ir-tí a-na a-lim{ki} i-li-kà-ma um-ma a-na-ku-ma TÚG ṣú-ba-tí ša i-na a-lim{ki} ša ki-ma pí-lá-aḫ-IŠTAR ù {d}IM.GAL DUMU bu-zi iš-ta-ú-mu-ni
target: specifically to Kuziziya: two or three times I sent word to the City, saying about the textiles that Pilah-Ištar's representatives and Adad-rabi son of Buzi have been buying in the City -

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-na-ku-ma TÚG.ḪI.A ša i-na ḫa-ra-ba na-du-ni i-na pá-ni-kà ta-áb-lá-šu-nu
target: I said: "The textiles that are deposited in haraba, remove them personally."

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ta TÚG.ḪI-tí-a té-ta-az-ba-am a-na KÙ.BABBAR 1 ma-na ù 2 ma-na qá-qá-ad-kà lá ta-am-ḫa-aṣ-ma ma-a TÚG.ḪI-tù-a PA MAŠKIM a-dí u₄-mì-im i-lá-pu-tù
target: But you, you left my textiles for me. You did not pledge yourself for even 1 or 2 minas of silver, in fact, until the day the attorney books my textiles.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ší-im pé-er-dim iš-tí tù-um-li-a-im wa-al-dí-DINGIR ub-lá-ku-nu-tí
target: Wald-ilum brought you 3 minas of silver, the price of a mule together with the man from Tumliya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù qá-dí KÙ.BABBAR ma-lá iš-tù tù-um-li-a ú-bu-lu-ni-ni
target: And together with the silver, as much as they will bring you from Tumliya,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i li-bi₄ i-tur₄-DINGIR i-šu i-na qá-tí-šu le-qé-a ú-ul a-na ša ki-ma šu-a-tí qí-bi-a-ma li-iš-qú-lu-ku-nu-tí
target: I have a claim on Itūr-ilī of 1 mina 10 shekels of silver; receive it from him or say it to his representatives so they can pay it to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR i-ṣé-er ga-al-ga-li-a a-lu DUMU a-du-du ù ḫa-ar-šu-nu-ma-an ku-um-ri-im ša {d}UTU ú-mu-šu-nu ma-al-
target: Galgaliya, Alu son of Adudu and haršunuman, the priest of the sun-god, (owe me) 5 minas of silver; their term has expired and they are jointly responsible for the silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma e-lá-lí-ma a-na en-um-a-šur qí-bi₄-ma
target: From Elāli to Ennam-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-lá-ḫu-um a-na ša ki-ma šu-a-tí iš-pu-ra-am um-ma šu-ut-ma
target: Ali-ahum has written to his representatives, saying:

source: translate Akkadian to English: ra-bi₄-ṣa-am i-na a-lim{ki} aḫ-za-nim-ma
target: Hire an attorney in the City for me

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ma-lá ṭup-pì-im ša a-bu-ni ḫu-bu-lam i-na li-bi₄-a ù li-bi₄ a-ḫi-a i-dí-ú i-na qí-bi-tí-ni lá-áš-ta-al-šu-ma ú lu-ša-sí-ḫa-šu
target: and let me question him (Ennam-Aššur) on the basis of our instructions in accordance with the tablet about how much our father set down as debts from me and my brother, and then have him extradited.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lá-ma ra-bi₄-ṣú-um i-li-kà-ku-ni-ma i-pì-kà iṣ-bu-tù-kà-ni ra-ma-kà za-ki-ma tí-ib-a-ma a-tal-kam
target: Clear yourself before the attorney arrives and seizes you for a statement, set out and come.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-im ṣú-ba-tí-a ša a-na a-bi₄-ku-nu a-dí-nu šé-bi₄-lam
target: Send me the proceeds from my textiles that I gave to your father.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 TÚG ša a-ki-dí-e lá-qé-ep na-áš-a-kum
target: La-qēp brings you 1 Akkadian textile.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB PUZUR₄-tí-a-am-tim KIŠIB a-šur-i-mì-tí DUMU a-ta-a KIŠIB ú-ṣur-ša-a-šur DUMU a-šur-ma-lik KIŠIB a-da-da DUMU {d}IM.GAL KIŠIB a-šur-DU₁₀ DUMU sá-da-a
target: Sealed by Puzur-Ti'amtum, by Aššur-imittī son of Ataya, by Uṣur-ša-Aššur son of Aššur-malik, by Adada son of Adad-rabi, by Aššur-ṭāb son of Sadaya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša 4 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am i-ṣé-er ú-ṣur-ša-a-šur ù a-šur-DU₁₀ ša-lim-a-šur i-šu-ú
target: Concerning the fact that Uṣur-ša-Aššur and Aššur-ṭāb owe 4 minas of refined silver to Šalim-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù ḫa-mu-uš-tim ša ma-nu-ki-a-šur ù i-ku-nim a-na 6 ḫa-am-ša-tim i-ša-qú-lu
target: Reckoned from the week of Mannu-kī-Aššur and Ikūnum they must pay within 6 weeks.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma lá iš-qú-lu 1.5 GÍN.TA i-na ITU.KAM-im a-na ma-na-im ú-ṣú-bu
target: If they have not paid (in time) they will add interest at the rate 1.5 shekel per month per mina.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR i-na qá-qá-ad šál-mì-šu-nu ra-ki-is
target: They are jointly responsible for the silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a be-e-tim na-ší
target: is bringing to the house.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šál-ma-ni ú ṣú-ùḫ-ru-um ša-lim
target: We are well and the youngsters are well.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-it-ru-kà ša té-zi-bu ù ší-it-ri ša {d}UTU-ba-ni e-zi-bu
target: With your scarfs, which you left behind, and those which Samas-bani left behind,

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-a-nim a be-e-tim na-ší
target: Su-anum is on his way to the house.

source: translate Akkadian to English: qá-qá-da-tum ma-da-tum <gap> e-ma-ru ma-du-tum
target: There are many persons and also many donkeys

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na DINGIR-mu-ta-bi-il₅ ù a-lu-a qí-bi-ma um-ma en-um-a-šùr-ma
target: To Ilī-mutabbil and Aluwa from Ennam-Aššur;

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù ḫa-muš-tim ša i-tur₄-DINGIR DUMU a-mur-IŠTAR ITU.KAM a-la-na-tim a-na-ku ù lá-qé-ep DUMU šu-a-šùr i-na É kà-ší-im ni-kà-sí ni-sí-ma
target: In the week of Itūr-ilī son of Amur-Ištar, month Allanātum, I and Lā-qēp son of Šu-Aššur settled accounts in the house of the official,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 12.5 ma-na 7 GÍN <gap> KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am i-na li-bi lá-qé-ep a-dí-ma a-na KÙ.BABBAR ku-a-tí ú-ša-zi-za-ku-šu-ma
target: and I set down 12.5 minas 7 shekels of refined silver as owed by Lā-qēp; and with respect to the silver it was you I designated for him,

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù pu-ru-uš-ḫa-dim i-na e-ra-bi šu-ma KÙ.BABBAR ki-ma i-a-tí i-ša-qá-lá-kum
target: so when he arrives from Purušhaddum he will pay the silver to you as my representative.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù ta-áš-pu-ra-am um-ma a-ta-ma ṭup-pu-šu al-pu-ut
target: And then you have written, stating: I have written his tablet.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫi a-ta ib-ri a-ta a-lá-nu-kà-ma a-ḫa-am GAL i-šu-ú
target: My dear brother and friend, apart from you do I have any older brother?

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam KÙ.BABBAR lá-qé-pá-am e-ta-ri-šu-ma ša-qá-lam ú-lá i-mu-a
target: Here I have repeatedly demanded the silver from Lā-qēp but he would not pay.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-ut-ma ṭup-pí lu-šé-tí-qú-nim-ma KÙ.BABBAR-áp-kà le-qé
target: He said: "Let them bring my tablet, and then take your silver!"

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-pu-tum a-pu-tum i ša-am-ší ša a-ma-kam e-ra-ba-ni ṭup-pá-am ša ḫu-bu-li lá-qé-ep IGI 3 DUMU um-me-a-ni šu-ba-al-ki-it-ma me-ḫa-ar-šu a-na šu-nu-tí dí-in
target: Urgent, urgent, the very day he arrives there, copy the tablets of Lā-qēp's debt with 3 affiliated traders as witnesses; then give the copy to them while you yourself keep the other copy.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù ša-nàm me-eḫ-ra-am a-ta kà-il₅ ṭup-pá-am ki-iš-ma a-na a-lu-wa DUMU um-me-a-nim p
target: Wrap the tablet and entrust it to Aluwa and an affiliated trader so they bring it.

source: translate Akkadian to English: kà-ru-um dí-nam i-dí-in-ma
target: The colony has rendered a verdict,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša-lim-a-šùr ma-la KÙ.BABBAR a-na i-dí-a-bi-im ú-ša-qí-lu
target: stating that whatever silver Šalim-Aššur has paid for Iddin-abum,

source: translate Akkadian to English: Aššur-šamšī and Ennam-Suen seized us and Ennam-Suen said to Aššur-šamšī: Give me the silver that accrues to me".
target: Aššur-šamšī and Ennam-Suen seized us and Ennam-Suen said to Aššur-šamšī: Give me the silver that accrues to me".

source: translate Akkadian to English: Aššur-šamšī answered: "I will / can not give you the silver, for I have <gap> you <gap> for <gap> ".
target: Aššur-šamšī answered: "I will / can not give you the silver, for I have <gap> you <gap> for <gap> ".

source: translate Akkadian to English: Ennam-Suen said: "Why is it me that you are<gap> me? Do it to your sons!"
target: Ennam-Suen said: "Why is it me that you are<gap> me? Do it to your sons!"

source: translate Akkadian to English: Aššur-šamšī answered: "I will personally take your expenses for my account".
target: Aššur-šamšī answered: "I will personally take your expenses for my account".

source: translate Akkadian to English: In the presence of Zuba (and) of Puzur-Adad; Ali-abum, son of Zia was our colleague.
target: In the presence of Zuba (and) of Puzur-Adad; Ali-abum, son of Zia was our colleague.

source: translate Akkadian to English: For these words the Kanesh colony made us available and this tablet (with) our testimony we presented before Aššur's dagger.
target: For these words the Kanesh colony made us available and this tablet (with) our testimony we presented before Aššur's dagger.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša 1.5 ma-na 3 GÍN AN.NA ša ni-ip-lá-tim ša ḫi-na-a 7.5 GÍN.TA KÙ.BABBAR-šu 12.3333 GÍN 10 5 ŠE KÙ.BABBAR
target: Of the 1 mina 33 shekels of tin, of the balance payment of hinnāya, at 7.5 shekels (of tin) per (shekel of silver) its amount in silver is 12 5 / 12 shekels.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na ša a-mur-a-šur 16 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša ša-du-i-tim ḫa-bu-lu ŠÀ.BA 12.3333 GÍN 15 ŠE pì-lá-aḫ-IŠTAR il₅-qé
target: From what Amur-Aššur (owes?), 16 shekels of silver, of the -tax, thereof Pilah-Ištar took 12 5 / 12 shekels.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3.5 GÍN 15 ŠE e-lá-ma il₅-qé
target: Elamma took 3 7 / 12 shekels.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na en-na-sú-in qí-bi-ma um-ma IŠTAR-lá-ma-sí-ma
target: To Enna-Suen from Ištar-Iamassī:

source: translate Akkadian to English: ta-as-li-a-ni-ma ḫu-du-be-li ta-tù-ru
target: You implored me in order to return hudu-bēlī

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR
target: 10.5 shekels of silver

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 me-et ri-ik-sí ša qá-nu-e
target: 200 bundles of reeds

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB du-šu-ba KIŠIB šu-ni-il₅-ga KIŠIB ší-li-ú-ma-an KIŠIB tal-ḫa-ma KIŠIB šar-bu-nu-a KIŠIB kà-áš-ší KIŠIB ga-dí-na
target: Seal of Dušuba, seal of Šunilga, seal of Šiliuman, seal of Talhama, seal of Šarbunuwa, seal of Kašši, seal of Gadina.

source: translate Akkadian to English: am-tám ku-zi-zi du-šu-ba ú šu-ni-il₅-ga a ší-mì-im i-dí-nu-ma 15 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR lá-ma-sú-tum ta-áš-qú-ul-ma am-tám ku-zi-zi ta-áš-am
target: The slave-girl Kuzizi Dušuba and Šunilga sold her and 15 shekels of silver Lamassutum paid and bought the slave-girl Kuzizi.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma um-ma du-šu-ba-ma ù šu-ni-il₅-ga-ma a-ma-at-ni ni-ta-ru 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR i-ša-qú-lu-ma am-tám i-ta-ru
target: If Dušuba and Šunilga say: "We want to take our slave-girl along", they will pay 0.5 mina of silver and then they can take the slave-girl along.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma ma-ma-an i-tù-ra-am um-ma šu-ut-ma am-tum i-a-tum du-šu-ba ú šu-ni-il₅-ga ú É-sú-nu a-da-ga-al
target: If anybody vindicates her, saying: "The slave-girl is mine!" then I have a claim on Dušuba and Šunilga and their house.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma KÙ.BABBAR-pì lá i-ta-ad-nu-nim am-tum ku-zi-zi am-tí ù a ší-mì-im a-da-ší
target: Should they not give me my silver then the slave-girl Kuzizi is my slave-girl and I can sell her.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ar-ší-aḫ-šu ù pè-ru-wa qí-bi₄-ma um-ma kà-šu-be-lí-ma
target: To Aršiahšu and Peruwa say, thus Kassu-bēlī:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫu-a a-tù-nu be-lu-a a-tù-nu
target: Please, my brothers my lords,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na 0.3333 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ù 15 ma-na URUDU ma-sí-a-am ku-nu-ki-a be-lúm-ba-ni na-áš-a-ku-nu-tí
target: 30.3333 shekels of silver and 15 minas of purified copper under my seals Bēlum-bāni is bringing you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: SÍG.ḪI.A za-ku-tim ša-ma-nim KÙ.BABBAR 0.5 GÍN lá ta-be-e-lá
target: Buy for me cleaned wool, do not try to save even half a shekel of silver!

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-šur lá-ak-ru-ba-ku-nu-tí
target: I will pray for you before Aššur,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ar-ḫi-iš ṭù-ur-da-ni-šu ku-ṣú-um
target: Send him quickly, it is winter time.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 7.25 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR té-ṣú-bu bi-il₅-tám ik-šu-ud
target: The additions amounted to 7 1/4 shekels of silver per talent.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ḫa-nu-nu ù en-nam-a-šur qí-bi-ma um-ma ma-ma-ḫi-ir-ma
target: To Hanunu and Ennam-Aššur from Man-mahir:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-kam a-na qá-ra-bi-tim er-ba-ma ṭup-pá-am ša bé-ú-lá-at da-ra-áš en-um-a-šur na-ší i-na li-bi ṭup-pí-a šu-uk-na
target: Enter the interior of the house there, and place the tablet (that) Ennam-Aššur carries concerning the working-capital of Daraš among my other tablets.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú ta-aḫ-sí-is-tám ša a-na ṣí-it en-um-a-šur ú-ša-qí-lu am-ra-ma i-na na-áš-pé-er-tí-ku-nu ú-dí-a-nim
target: Also, look at the memorandum stating that he paid for Ennam-Aššur's various expenses, and make it known to me in your missive.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú ta-aḫ-sí-is-tám en-nam-a-šur lu-kà-il₅-ší
target: Also, Ennam-Aššur should keep the memorandum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-la-ḫi-im qí-bi-ma um-ma SIG₅-pí-a-šur-ma
target: To Ali-ahum from Damiq-pī-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR 5 ma-na URUDU 5 ma-na ni-ga-li ša 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṣí-pá-ra-tim i-na a-li-ki-im pá-ni-im-ma ú a ni-qí za-áp-ru-tim a-na DUMU um-me-a-nim ke-nim dí-in-ma lu-ub-lam
target: 1 mina of silver, 5 minas of sickles, bronze pins worth 5 shekels of silvers with the first transport - also, rings - give that to a reliable affiliated trader so he may bring it.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ma {d}MAR.TU li-li-ik a-na ṣé-ri-kà
target: Amurrum should come to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na DUMU um-me-a-ni-im
target: to an affiliated trader

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na pá-ni-im-ma a-li-ki-im li-li-kam
target: have him come with the first transport.

source: translate Akkadian to English: bé-té-e 12 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-šur-i-mì-tí ḫa-bu-lam a-mur-IŠTAR
target: Aššur-imittī owes me 12 shekels of silver Amur-Ištar

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ša-áš-qí-il₅-šu-ma ku-nu-uk-ma a-na pá-ni-a šé-bi-lam
target: Make him pay the silver, seal it and send it to me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: tí-ir-ta-kà za-ku-sà li-li-kam-ma
target: a final report should come to me and

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tí ILLAT-tim ṭup-pá-am ša 4 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR li-li-a-ma a pá-ni-a šé-bi-lam
target: with the caravan. Produce the tablet concerning 4 shekels of silver and send it to me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫi a-ta a-lá-nu-kà a-ḫa-am ra-bi-am ú-lá i-šu
target: My dear brother, apart from you I have no elder brother.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-at ṭup-pì-im i-ḫi-id
target: Pay attention to the words of the tablet.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB lá-qé-ep DUMU {d}AB-ba-ni KIŠIB a-ku-za DUMU šu-a-nim
target: Sealed by Lā-qēp son of Illil-bāni, by Akuza son of Šu-Anum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-um ša ba-áb DINGIR ša IGI GÍR ša a-šùr ša ší-bu-tí-ni
target: The tablet from the Gate of the God from before Aššur's dagger, with our testimony.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-nu-pí-a ki-ma me-er-e šál-ma-a-šur a-na ga-al-ga-li-a ù ḫa-ar-šu-ma-an iṣ-ba-at-ni-a-tí-ma ṭup-pá-am ša 10 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša ḫu-bu-li-šu-nu iš-me-ú
target: Representing the sons of Šalim-Aššur Anupiya seized us against Galgaliya and haršumnuman, and they heard a tablet concerning 10 minas of silver, their debt.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-nu-pí-a-ma ṭup-pu-um lá ku-nu-ku-kà-a
target: Anupiya said: Does the tablet not bear your seals?

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ga-al-ga-li-a-ma ku-nu-ku-a a-ma ḫa-ar-šu-um-nu-ma-an-ma ša-qí-il₅ KÙ.BABBAR-pì-im
target: Galgaliya answered: They are my sealings. However, haršumnuman is the one who paid the silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-nu-pí-a-ma me-er-ú me-tim né-nu lu a-na šál-ma-a-šur KÙ.BABBAR ta-áš-qú-ul lu a-na me-er-e šál-ma-a-šur ta-áš-qú-ul a-na a-ni-e-ma ru-a-am
target: Anupiya said: We are inheritors. Produce evidence for this, that you have either paid the silver to Šalim-Aššur or have paid to the sons of Šalim-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ḫa-ar-šu-um-nu-ma-an-ma KÙ.BABBAR a-na-ku ša ṭup-pì-ni šál-ma-a-šur ú-ša-bi₄-i a-na i-id a-ša-kà-na-ku-nu-tí
target: haršumnuman said: I personally satisfied Šalim-Aššur with the silver of our tablet. I am willing to go to the River for you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um kà-né-eš i-dí-ni-a-tí-ma IGI GÍR ša a-šur ší-bu-tí-ni ni-dí-in
target: The Kanesh colony gave us (as witnesses) for these proceedings, and we gave our testimony before Aššur's dagger.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI ku-ra-a DUMU ú-lá-a IGI en-um-a-šur DUMU ḫu-ra-ṣí
target: Witnessed by Kuraya son of Ulaya, by Ennam-Aššur son of hurāṣī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na en-nam-a-šur ù a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi-ma um-ma SIG₅-pí-a-šur-ma
target: To Ennam-Aššur and Ali-ahum from Damiq-pī-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 ma-na AN.NA ku-nu-ki-a e-ni-iš-ta-ru-um ub-lá-ku-nu-tí
target: Eništārum brought 10 minas of tin under my seal to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 TÚG SIG₅ a-lu-a ub-lá-ku-nu-tí
target: Aluwa brought you 1 fine textile.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫu-a a-tù-nu KÙ.BABBAR ší-im AN.NA-ki ú ší-im ṣú-ba-tí-a šé-bi-lá-nim-ma gi-mì-lá-am i-na ṣé-ri-a šu-uk-na
target: My dear brothers, send me the proceeds in silver from the tin and my textiles and thus do me a favour.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-li-ik lu-qú-tim ša tám-kà-ri-im mì-il₅-kà
target: Take a decision concerning the merchant's goods.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na {d}UTU-ši ú-ṣú-ur-ša-IŠTAR e-ra-ba-ni na-áš-pé-ra-tim ší-ta-me-a-ma ú-ma-kál lá i-sà-ḫu-ur
target: Hear the missives the very day Uṣur-ša-Ištar arrives, and without a single day's delay send with him one of your servants, whom you trust like yourselves, and write me whether it is so or not, and only then send word to the merchant.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tí-in i-na ṣú-ḫa-ri-ku-nu ša ki-ma qá-qí-dí-ku-nu iš-tí-šu ṭù-ur-da-ni-ma a-ni-tám lá a-ni-tám tí-ir-ta-ak-nu li-li-kam-ma ù tí-ir-ta-ku-nu a-na tám-kà-ri-im li-li-kà-am
target: The merchant is relying on me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: tám-kà-ru-um a-na pá-ni-a i-da-gal iḫ-da lá ta-ša-lá-ta
target: Take care, do not act rashly.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB a-šùr-e-mu-qí KIŠIB en-nam-a-šur KIŠIB i-dí-a-bi-im
target: Seal of Aššur-emūqi, seal of Ennam-Aššur, seal of Iddin-abum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am a-na a-lá-ak šu-{d}EN.LÍL i-ša-qal
target: He will pay refined silver before Šu-Illil arrives.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma lá iš-qú-ul a-na ma-na-im 1.5 GÍN.TA i-na ITU.KAM ú-ṣa-áb
target: If he has not paid, he will pay interest at the rate 1.5 shekel per mina per month.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 8 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am i-ku-pí-a DUMU šu-a-nim i-na ší-im SÍG.ḪI.A ša ú-ší-na-lam il₅-qé
target: Ikūn-piya son of Šu-Anum has received 8 minas of refined silver from the proceeds of Ušinalam's wool.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI i-dí-ku-bi₄-im IGI ú-zu-bi₄-iš-ki-im a-ḫi-šu IGI en-na-sú-in
target: Witnessed by Iddin-Kūbum, by Uzub-iškum his brother, by Enna-Suen.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma en-um-a-šur a-na a-la-ḫi-im-ma me-er-ú me-tim né-nu
target: Ennam-Aššur said to Ali-ahum: We are inheritors.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-šu ša tám-kà-ru a-bi-ni sí-ki-ni ú-kà-lu
target: Why is it that our father's customers detain us?

source: translate Akkadian to English: ba-a-am a-na tám-kà-ri a-bi-ni lu nu-sà-li-ma tám-kà-ri a-bi-ni lu nu-ṭá-ib
target: Come on, let us plead with our father's customers and satisfy our father's customers.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lá tù-na-a-ni ù sí-ki-ni lá ú-kà-lu
target: Do not cheat me lest they detain us.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí 5-ší-šu ù 10-ri-šu a-ḫa-am ù ib-ra-am nu-šé-ší-ib-ma a-ta qá-tám ta-am-ta-na-ḫa-aṣ
target: Five or ten times we have arranged meetings with brothers and friends, but you keep refusing.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lá tù-na-a-ni
target: Do not cheat me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù-ma ša a-ḫi-im ù ib-ri-im lá ta-ša-me-ú ba-a-am a-ṣé-er 4 um-me-a-ni ša ki-ma a-bi-ni lu ni-li-ik-ma lu-šé-ší-ru-ni-a-tí-ma tám-kà-ri a-bi-ni lu nu-ṭá-ib-ma ù a-na a-lim{ki} a-na ṣé-er a-ḫa-tí-ni gu₅-ba-áb-tim lu ni-li-ik-ma a-na ma-lá ší-ma-at a-bi-ni ša a-lim{ki} lu ni-iz-ku
target: Since you will not listen to what brother and friend say, then come on, let us go to the 4 investors who represent our father, let them set us straight and let us please our father's customers - and then let us go to the City to our sister, the priestess and let us clear ourselves in accordance with our father's will that is in the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lá tù-na-ḫa-ni ú KÙ.BABBAR 1 GÍN lá tù-ša-ag-ma-ra-ni
target: Do not obstruct me. Also, do not let me incur an expense of a single shekel of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lá ri-ig-ma-tum ší-bu-tum
target: This is not a formal lawsuit, it is a witnessed statement.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ša-lim-IŠTAR-ma a-na a-šùr-na-da ù en-nam-a-šùr a-na en-nam-a-šùr qí-bi-ma
target: From Šalim-Ištar to Aššur-nādā and Ennam-Aššur; specifically to Ennam-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 20 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ku-nu-ki-kà da-da-a-a ù lá-dí-a ub-lu-nim
target: Dādaya and Ladiya brought 20 minas of silver under your seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ.BA 50-<gap> 4 TÚG šu-ru-tum <gap> KÙ.BABBAR it-bu-lu
target: Thereof 50 <gap> 4 black textiles cost <gap> silver;

source: translate Akkadian to English: <gap> AN.NA 16 GÍN.TA 9.8333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR
target: <gap> tin at the rate 16:1 cost 9.8333 minas of silver;

source: translate Akkadian to English: <gap> 1 ma-na <gap> 7 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR <gap>
target: 1 mina <gap> 7 shekels of silver <gap>

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR a-na a-na-lí-ma 1 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na ni-qé-šu a-na a-šur-ma-lik DUMU ili₅-ma-al-ki a-dí-in
target: silver for Anna-ilī and 1 shekel of silver for his sacrifices I gave to Aššūr-malik son of Ilī-malkī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ili₅-ba-ni DUMU i-a-a GÍR ša a-šùr it-ma-ma en-nu-um-DINGIR DUMU ku-za-ri pá-šu iš-me
target: Ilī-bāni son of Yaya swore by Aššur's dagger and Ennam-ilī son of Kuzari heard his statement.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-šùr-GAL DUMU ma-nu-um-šu-um-šu GÍR ša a-šùr it-ma-ma a-šùr-dan DUMU zu-ú NU.BÀNDA pá-šu iš-me
target: Aššur-rabi son of Mannum-šumšu swore by Aššur's dagger and Aššur-dan son of Zu'u, the lieutenant, heard his statement.

source: translate Akkadian to English: en-um-a-šùr a-lá-ḫa-am áš-a-al um-ma en-um-a-šùr-ma a-na a-lá-ḫi-im-ma e-ni-ma-ma na-áš-pé-er-tám ku-nu-ki-kà IGI 3 ú-kà-lim-kà-ma tù-kà-i-ni-ma šu-nu-tí-ma ni-ip-qí-sí
target: Ennam-Aššur questioned Ali-ahum, saying to Ali-ahum: Now here I have shown you the missive sealed by you in front of 3 (witnesses), and you have confirmed it to me and we have entrusted it to them.

source: translate Akkadian to English: am-ma a-wi-lu a-ni-ú-tum li-iš-me-ú am-ma ta-aḫ-sí-sà-tù-ni ku-nu-ku-a ú ku-nu-ku-kà i-ki-ir ú-ul kà-in ša ni-kà-sí a-na-ku ù a-ta ni-sí-ú-ma ni-iz-ku-ú lá tù-na-ḫa-ni
target: Now, may these men hear it - in fact, contest or confirm that it is our memoranda sealed by me and by you, stating that I and you have settled accounts and cleared the affair. Do not obstruct me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-lá-ḫu-um en-um-a-šùr e-pu-ul um-ma a-lá-ḫu-um-ma ta-aḫ-sí-sà-tum ku-nu-ku-kà ú ku-nu-ku-a ba-a-am 3 šál-ša-at lu ni-iṣ-ba-at-ma a ma-lá ta-aḫ-sí-sà-tim ša i-na ku-nu-ki-ni kán-kà-ni lu ni-iz-ku
target: Ali-ahum answered Ennam-Aššur, saying: "The memoranda are sealed by you and by me. Come on, let us seize 3 persons and let us settle in accordance with the memoranda that are sealed by us.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú ma-lá KÙ.BABBAR a-bu-ni i li-bi₄-a ù i li-bi-kà i-dí-ú-ma ṭup-pá-am a-bu-ni e-zi-bu-ma ṭup-pá-am um-me-a-nu a-bi₄-ni ú-kà-i-lu-ni-ma i-na IGI kà-ri-im ṣa-ḫe-er GAL iš-ku-nu-šu-ma kà-ru-um a-na ra-bi-ṣí-im ip-qí-du-ni
target: Further, our father left a tablet behind about how much silver he set down as owed by me and you, and our father's investors kept the tablet and they have placed it before the plenary assembly of the colony, and the colony has entrusted the tablet to the attorney.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ba-a-am u₄-ma-ma ma-lá KÙ.BABBAR i ṭup-pí-im lá-áp-ta-ni-ni lu ni-iš-qúl-ma a ma-lá dí-in a-lim{ki} KÙ.BABBAR lu ni-ik-nu-uk-ma a-na a-lim lu ni-lik
target: Come on, let us pay even today as much silver as we are booked for on the tablet, let us seal it in accordance with the verdict of the City and go to the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na DAM.GÀR qí-bi-ma um-ma a-da-a ù a-šùr-DU₁₀-ma
target: To the merchant from Adaya and Aššur-ṭāb:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ni-is-ḫa-sú DIRI ku-nu-ki-kà a-da-a ub-lam
target: Adaya brought 4 minas of silver, its import duty added and under your seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ni-is-ḫa-sú DIRI ku-nu-ki-kà a-šùr-DU₁₀ ub-lam
target: Aššur-ṭāb brought 5 minas of silver, its import duty added and under your seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠU.NÍGIN 9 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR-áp-kà
target: In all: 9 minas of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ.BA 1 GÚ 54 ma-na AN.NA ku-nu-ki a-šùr-DU₁₀ na-áš-a-kum
target: Specification: Aššur-ṭāb brings you 1 talent 54 minas of sealed tin;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 14.1666 GÍN.TA KÙ.BI <gap> 8 ma-na 1 ANŠE ù ú-nu-sú 0.3333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR it-ba-al
target: at the rate 14.1666 to 1 its price in silver was 8 minas of silver. 1 donkey and its harness cost 0.3333 mina of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: <gap> 4.5 GÍN wa-ṣí-tum 2 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR té-ṣú-bi a-šùr-DU₁₀ il₅-qé
target: 4.5 shekels: export tax; Aššur-ṭāb received additions of 2 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4.5 ma-na 2 GÍN AN.NA qá-tim 14.1666 GÍN.TA KÙ.BI 19 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR-áp-kà gám-ra-kum
target: 4.5 minas of expense-tin, at the rate 14.1666 to 1 its price in silver was 19 shekels. Your silver has been spent for you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ás-qú-dim ù a-bi₄-lá qí-bí-ma um-ma i-dí-sú-in-ma
target: Say to Asqudum and Abila thus Iddin-Suen:

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na URUDU a-šur-i-dí 1 GÚ URUDU SIG₅ a-na en-na-sú-in dí-in
target: Give from Aššur-idī's copper 1 talent of refined copper to Ennam-Suen.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫu-a a-tù-nu iḫ-da-ma URUDU a-šur-i-dí ša-áš-qí-lá ù na-pá-al-tù-šu šu-up-ra-nim
target: Please, my brothers, take care to make Aššur-idī pay the copper and write me also his reaction.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù 5 GÚ URUDU ša šu-IŠTAR li-iš-qú-ul
target: He must also pay 5 talents of copper of Šu-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ba-lu-um té-er-tí-a KI a-wi-lim i-mì-gi₅-ir i-ša-ḫa-at
target: He has come to an agreement with the man without an instruction of mine.

source: translate Akkadian to English: en-na-sú-in i-zi-za-ma a-na kà-ú-li-šu ù ša-ku-li-šu ma-ḫa <gap>
target: Assist Ennam-Suen and ? to support him and to provide him with food.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-dí-da ú a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi-ma um-ma SIG₅-pì-a-šur-ma
target: To Adida and Ali-ahum from Damiq-pī-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 6 na-ru-qá-tim TÚG.ḪI.A ku-nu-ki-a i-na ḫu-ur-ší-im e-zi-ib
target: I left 6 sacks with textiles under my seal in the store-room.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ.BA 12 TÚG.ḪI.A SIG₅ 8 TÚG.ḪI.A tár-dí-ú-tim 4 TÚG.ḪI.A ša uš-ma-a
target: Among those (were) 12 textiles of good quality, 8 second quality textiles, 4 textiles belonging to Ušmaya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṣú-ba-tí-a a-šar ša-ṣú-ru šu-uk-na
target: Place my textiles where they will be under guard.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.3333 ma-na 1 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ší-im ṣú-ba-tim 21 ma-na 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR e-zi-ba-ku-nu-tí
target: I left the price of a textile, 0.3333 mina 1 shekel of silver (and) 21 minas 10 shekels of with you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: URUDU-ri-i a-na KÙ.BABBAR dí-na-ma ú KÙ.BABBAR ší-im ṣú-ba-tí-a ku-un-kà-ma li-ib-ší
target: Sell my copper for silver, then seal the proceeds in silver from my textiles and let it remain.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR a-na ḫu-ša-ḫi-ku-nu lá tù-ma-na li-ib-ší
target: Do not consider the silver for your own needs, let it remain (intact).

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫu-a a-tù-nu KÙ.BABBAR ṣú-ba-tí-a a-na i-ṭá-at-lim i-ta-dí-na ba-áb-tám lá a-ra-ší
target: My dear brothers, as to the silver for my textiles, they should be sold for cash on delivery. I shall not have any outstanding claims.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 14 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša-lim-be-lí DUMU ba-šu ḫa-bu-lu-ni-im
target: Šalim-bēlī son of Bašu owes me 14 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 6 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am 6 GÍN ša-du-a-sú ša e-la-ma a-na PUZUR₄-a-na DUMU a-šur-dan áp-qí-id
target: 6 minas of refined silver, 6 shekels his transport-fee, belonging to Elamma I entrusted to Puzur-Anna, the son of Aššur-dān.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-šur-na-id DUMU a-šur-i-dí IGI zu-ba
target: In the presence of Aššur-nādā, son of Aššur-idī, and of Zuba.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-im AN.NA-ki-kà 1 GÚ-tim
target: (It is) the price of your tin to the amount of 1 talent.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 ma-na KÙ.GI ni-is-ḫa-sú DIRI ú ša-du-a-sú ša-bu ša zu-ba PUZUR₄-a-na a-na ší-a-ma-tim ú-bi-il₅
target: 5 minas of gold, its excise added extra and its transport-fee <paid>, belonging to Zuba, Puzur-Anna brought away for making purchases.

source: translate Akkadian to English: GÁN-lam a-na-nu-um ù a-lá-nu-um a šu-mì-šu-nu-ma i-tí-iq
target: It will travel overland in both directions at their expense.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ ša qí-ip-tí-šu-nu
target: (for) it is money of their trust.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-šùr-na-id DUMU a-šur-i-dí IGI ás-qú-dim
target: In the presence of Aššur-nādā, son of Aššur-idī, and of Asqūdum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB en-na-nim DUMU a-lá-bi₄-im KIŠIB a-gi-a DUMU PUZUR₄-a-šùr {d}IM.GAL DUMU bu-zi tap-pá-i-ni
target: Sealed by Ennānum son of Ali-abum, by Agiya son of Puzur-Aššur; Adad-rabi son of Buzi was our (absent) partner.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um kà-ni-iš i-dí-ni-a-tí-ma ṭup-pá-am ší-bu-tí-ni IGI GÍR ša a-šùr ni-dí-in
target: The Kanesh colony gave us for these proceedings and we gave a tablet with our testimony before Aššur's dagger.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB šu-be-lim DUMU i-dí-a-bi-im
target: Sealed by Šu-Bēlum son of Iddin-abum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-wa-tù-šu-nu ša šál-ma-a-šùr šu-bé-lam ki-ma DAM i-sú-rik₁₃ DUMU.MÍ i-sú-rik₁₃ ù DUMU.MÍ i-dí-a-bi-im ra-bi-ṣum ù šu-be-lúm KI ša-lim-a-šur ni-iš a-lim it-mu-ú-ma a-wa-tù-šu-nu gám-ra
target: Their case concerning Šalim-Aššur - Šu-Bēlum for the wife of Issu-arik, the daughter of Issu-arik and the daughter of Iddi-abum, the attorney and Šu-Bēlum swore an oath on the City with Šalim-Aššur and their case was concluded.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na lu-qú-tim AN.NA ù TÚG.ḪI.A ša É a-šùr-bé-el-a-wa-tim i-pí-iq-du ša ma-lá dí-in a-lim{ki} šu-ku-bu-um ù a-ḫu-šu i-lu-ku-nim-ma <gap> ša-lim-a-šùr a-na lu-qú-tim AN.NA ù TÚG.ḪI.A ša-lim-a-šùr ù-kà-nu-ni
target: For the goods, the tin and textiles that have been entrusted in Aššur-bēl-awātim's house, in accordance with the verdict of the City assembly Šu-Kūbum and his brother will come and confirm Šalim-Aššur for the goods, the tin and textiles.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-šùr-ta-ak-lá-ku ra-bi-ṣú-um a-na lu-qú-tim a-ni-tim
target: Aššur-taklāku was the attorney.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-bé-lúm a-ša-at i-sú-rik₁₃ DUMU.MÍ i-sú-rik₁₃ ù DUMU.MÍ i-dí-a-bi-im a-na ša-lim-a-šùr šu-ku-bi-im ù a-ḫi-šu ù-lá i-tù-ru
target: Šu-Bēlum, the wife of Issu-arik, the daughter of Issu-arik and the daughter of Iddin-abum must not raise claim to these goods against Šalim-Aššur, Šu-Kūbum or his brother.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma i-tù-ru šu-be-lúm ù ra-bi-ṣum ù-bu-bu-šu-nu
target: If they do raise claim, Šu-Bēlum and the attorney will clear them.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-mur-IŠTAR ù DINGIR-ba-ni-ma a-na i-tur₄-DINGIR ú DAM.GÀR ša šé-ep lá-qé-pí-im qí-bi-ma
target: From Amur-Ištar and Ilī-bāni to Itūr-ilī and the merchant for the goods transported by Lā-qēp:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 6 ku-ta-ni e-li-tám i-zi-er ANŠE ša <gap> ú li-wi-sú šu-ma-li-ba-a-šur ir-dí-a-ku-nu-tí ta-ší-a-tim
target: A top-pack of 6 in addition to a donkey <gap> and its wrapping Šumma-libbi-Aššur leads to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-kam e-me-me šu-ma e-ri-iš-ku-nu dí-na
target: Give the carriage costs there if Ememe asks you for it.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma Ì-lí-a-ma a-na šu-IŠTAR ú ur-me-ša qí-bi-ma
target: From Iliya to Šu-Ištar and Urmeša:

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na {d}UTU-ši ṭup-pá-am ta-ša-me-ú GÉME.ḪI.A lu ta-áb-ri-am
target: The day you hear the letter you must inspect the slave-girls.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú šu-ma ma-ma-an mì-ma ḫa-bu-ul-ší-im i-na ša-ḫa-tí-ša i-zi-iz-ma ša-dí-ší-im-ma lu ta-ta-al-kam
target: Also, if anyone owes anything to her, assist her, make the payment for her and then do come here.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ší-a-kà mì-ma lá té-zi-ba-am
target: You have not left me any of your iron.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 15 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR 1 ṣú-pu-um i li-bi ḫu-ur-šu-nu-ma-an <gap> ri <gap>
target: 15 shekels of silver, 1 white sheep owed by huršun-uman <gap>

source: translate Akkadian to English: 30 GÚ 15 ma-na URUDU qá-du-um ší-im 3 TÚG.ḪI-a bu-lá-tí ša a-bu-ni e-zi-ib
target: 30 talents 15 minas of copper, including the price of 3 textiles, were the assets that our father left.

source: translate Akkadian to English: e-zi-ib ba-áb-tim ša É.GAL-lim a-na 40 GÚ SIG₅ ša a-lá-ḫa-am ù id-na-a-šùr a-na ša ki-ma um-mì-a-ni ú-ša-zi-zu a-na ṣé-er bu-lá-tí ša a-bu-ni
target: Apart from the outstanding claim on the palace to 40 talents of good (copper) for which he had appointed Ali-ahum and Iddin-Aššur to represent the investors.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 GÚ ù 5 ma-na URUDU SIG₅ ša ma-ma-ḫi-ir na-dí i-na a-lá-ak ILLAT-tim ša ma-ma-ḫi-ir
target: In addition to our father's assets 3 talents plus 5 minas of good copper belonging to Man-mahir were deposited.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-lá-ḫu-um ù dam-qá-a ú-šé-bu-lu-ni-šum
target: When Man-mahir's caravan arrives Ali-ahum and Damqaya will send it to him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša tám-kà-ru-um i-na ṣé-er ma-ma-ḫi-ir i-šu-ú KÙ.BABBAR en-nam-a-šur iš-qú-ul-ma ṭup-pu-šu a-na a-lá-ḫi-im ù dam-qá-a e-zi-ib
target: As to the 1 mina 10 shekels of silver that Man-mahir owes to the merchant, Ennam-Aššur has paid the silver and left his tablet with Ali-ahum and Damqaya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-mì-ma a-ni-im ša e-pu-lu-ni 19 GÚ 20 ma-na SIG₅ a-na id-na-a-šur e-zi-ib
target: For all of this on which they agreed he left 19 talents 20 minas of good (copper) with Iddin-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: e-zi-ib ša ma-ṣa-ar-tim
target: This is apart from that in the safe.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ma-lá ú-ṭá-tám a-na a-wi-il₅-tim ta-du-nu ti-ir-ta-kà li-li-kam-ma
target: Send me word about how much grain you will give to the Lady.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tí ší-im ra-qá-tí-im lu-šé-bi₄-la-ku-um
target: So I can send it to you with the proceeds from the thin textiles.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na šál-ma-a-šur qí-bi₄-ma um-ma {d}IM.GAL-ma
target: To Šalim-Aššur from Adad-rabi:

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pá-kà a-na-kam šu-IŠTAR a-šur-ma-lik šál-ma-a-šur iš-me-ú-ma um-ma šu-nu-ma a-wa-tum a-ni-tum a ma-lá ša ṭup-pì-šu ša iš-pu-ra-ni ke-na i-sú-ri-ik i-na ma-aḫ-ri-ni é-ta-ú
target: Here Šu-Ištar, Aššur-malik and Šalim-Aššur heard your letter, and they said: This matter is correct as he wrote in the letter he sent: Issu-arik declared (such) in our presence.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-IŠTAR a-wa-tám i-šu um-ma šu-nu-ma šu-IŠTAR a-wa-sú li-il₅-qé-ma a-na KÁ-áb DINGIR nu-NU-ri-id-ma ṭup-pá-am lu ni-dí-na-kum
target: Šu-Ištar raised the matter, and they said: "Let Šu-Ištar have his case, so we led him to the Gate of the God, and we gave you a tablet."

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-šu-mì ša DUMU i-ba-a ú a-na ší-bi₄-kà kà-ra-am lá ša-a-lam a-ṣé-er ru-ba-im né-ru-ma um-ma ru-ba-ú-um-ma be-el a-wa-tim li-li-kam-ma lá ta-ma-ḫa-ra
target: Concerning the matter of Ibaya's son, and in order not to raise questions to the colony about your witnesses, we went in to the king, and the king said: "Let the litigant come and do not confront (the assembly)."

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-nu-mì DUMU i-ba-a i-lá-kà-ma a-lam i-ma-ḫu-ru-ni i-nu-mì-šu u₄-me er-ša a-na ší-bi₄-ku-nu ta-e-ra-ma kà-ra-am lá ša-a-lam a-na a-lim{ki} ta-e-ra-ma
target: When Ibaya's son arrives and they confront the City assembly, at that time demand terms. Rebuff (the matter) with respect to your witnesses and turn (them) back to the City assembly so as not to ask questions of the colony,

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-tù-nu-ma a-wi-lu-um be-el na-ru-qí-im ú-ša-sà-ḫa-am a-na ší-bi₄-šu kà-ra-am i-ša-al i-nu-mì-šu a-lu-um i-da-na-ku-nu-tí
target: and then say: "The man will extradite the owner of the joint-stock capital. He will question the colony about his witnesses' - then the City assembly will give you (the right to a case)."

source: translate Akkadian to English: me-at 56 TÚG 12 ma-na 18 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR it-bu-lu
target: 156 textiles cost 12 minas 18 shekels of silver;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 6 ANŠE ṣa-lá-me 0.8333 ma-na 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR it-bu-lu
target: 6 black donkeys cost 55 shekels of silver;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 30.3333 ma-na AN.NA qá-tim 2.3
target: 30.3333 minas of expense tin cost 2.3333 minas of silver;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 40 ma-na URUDU ma-sí-am ší-im ANŠE i li-bi₄ a-šur-DU₁₀
target: 40 minas of refined copper the price of a donkey, due from Aššur-ṭāb.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ANŠE ša be-la-nim i-nu-mì a-wi-il₅-tum me-ta-at-ni a-na 15 ma-na URUDU ṣa-la-mì-im il₅-qé-šu
target: The donkey of Bēlānum he took when the lady had died for 15 minas of black copper.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 ma-na a-<gap>
target: 2 minas for <gap>

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na a-na šu-ku-bi₄-im
target: 1 mina for Šu-Kubum

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.5 ma-na a-na a-pu-ut-ri-a
target: 1.5 mina for Aputriya

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB šu-mì-a-bi₄-a DUMU a-ba-ra-a KIŠIB en-na-nim DUMU šu-ḫu-bur KIŠIB PUZUR₄.IŠTAR DUMU a-šùr-ták-lá-ku
target: Seal of Šumi-abia, son of Abaraya, seal of Ennānum, son of Šu-hubur, seal of Puzur-Ištar, son of Aššur-taklāku.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 <gap> KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am a-na PUZUR₄.IŠTAR a šu-mì ir-ma-a-šùr a-šùr-DU₁₀ iš-qú-ul
target: 3.6666? shekels of refined silver Aššur-ṭāb paid to Puzur-Ištar in the name of Ir'am-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na mì-ma šu-um-šu PUZUR₄.IŠTAR a-na ir-ma-a-šùr lá i-tù-ar
target: Puzur-Ištar will not come back for anything, whatsoever, on Ir'am-Aššūr.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù ḫa-muš-tim ša kur-ub-IŠTAR ITU.KAM ša sá-ra-tim li-mu-um ša qá-tí en-na-sú-en₆
target: From the week of Kurub-Ištar, month III of the eponymy of the successor of Ennam-Suen.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB a-šur-na-da DUMU a-mur-lu-sú
target: Seal of Aššur-nādā, son of Āmur-ilūssu,

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB i-di-{d}IŠKUR DUMU a-šur-DU₁₀
target: seal of Iddin-Adad, son of Aššur-...

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma i-ku-pí-a-ma a-na en-um-a-šur {d}IM-pí-lá-aḫ ù šu-ḫu-bur qí-bi-ma
target: From Ikūn-pīya to Ennam-Aššur, Adad-pilah and Šu-hubur;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 8 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na a-bi₄-kà ḫa-bu-la-ku
target: I owe 8 shekels of silver to your father.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-li-tim 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR tal-qé
target: You have received 10 shekels of silver for Alitum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-bu-kà É-tí DAM-tí ù ÌR-dí lá i-dá-ga-al
target: Your father must not make any claim on my house, my wife or my slave.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ma a-ta KÙ.BABBAR-pì tù-ṣa-ba-at
target: Indeed, it is you who will seize my silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: na-áš-pè-er-tám ša a-bi₄-kà ša i-ku-pì-a KÙ.BABBAR ša-áš-qí-il₅
target: The missive from your father concerning Ikūn-pīya - have the silver paid.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma lá ú-<gap> KÙ.BABBAR lu-ta-<gap>-nu
target: If it is not<gap> the silver<gap>

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma na-áš-pè-er-tám uk-ta-li-im-ku-nu ṭup-pu-šu ḫi-ir-ma
target: If he has shown you the missive then certify his tablet.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma KÙ.BABBAR i-na a-lim{ki} il₅-qé
target: If he has received silver in the City

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù šu-ma 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR lá a-ta-aḫ-ba-al
target: or if (for some other reason) I am not indebted to him for 10 shekels of silver,

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ma-lá <gap> am il₅-qé-ú <gap> li-iš-qú-lá-am
target: then as much as<gap> he received<gap> he must pay (back) to me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-pu-tum lá ta-ga-mì-lá-šu
target: Urgent, show him no favours.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 15 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ni-is-ḫa-sú DIRI ša-du-a-sú ša-bu a-na i-na-aḫ-DINGIR a-dí-in
target: 15 minas of silver the excise on it extra, his transport fee paid, I gave to Ēnah-ilī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a-na ú-ṭí-tim ša-pá-ki-im a-dí-šu-um
target: 2 minas of silver for storing barley I gave him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ta-ad-mì-iq-ta-ša
target: 0.5 mina of silver (from) her free loan.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR šé-bu-ul-ta-ša ša um-mì-iš-ḫa-ra
target: 2 shekels of silver a shipment for Ummī-Išhara.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 13.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ta-ad-mì-iq-tù-šu ša be-lá-nim
target: 13.5 shekels of silver, his free loan for Bēlānum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 GÍN šé-bu-ul-tum ša PUZUR₄-lá-áb-ra-at
target: 2 shekels a gift for Puzur?-Ilabrat.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ma KÙ.BABBAR a-nim ni-is-ḫa-sú DIRI ša-du-a-sú ša-bu i-na-aḫ-DINGIR ú-bi₄-il₅
target: All this silver, the excise on it extra, his transport-fee paid Ēnah-ilī has brought away.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-sú-ri-ik a-na a-lim{ki} i-lá-ak-ma É-tí-šu ša bu-ri-im a-šar a-ni ša-lim-a-šùr wa-áš-bu-ni a-na tù-ud-ḫi-li-a a-ḫu tù-li a-na ší-mì-im i-dí-šu-nu
target: As Issu-arik will go to the City, he sold his houses by the well, where at present Šalim-Aššur is living, to Tudhiliya the brother of Tuli.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um kà-ni-iš i-dí-ni-a-tí-ma ṭup-pá-am ší-bu-tí-ni IGI GÍR ša a-šùr ni-dí-in
target: The Kanesh colony gave us for these proceedings, and we gave a tablet with our testimony before the dagger of Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI sú-kà-lí-a DUMU a-mur-a-šùr IGI a-ku-za DUMU šu-a-nim IGI ú-ra-a DUMU ma-na na
target: Witnessed by Sukkalliya son of Amur-Aššur, by Akuza son of Šu-Anum, by Uraya son of Manana.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-šùr-ša-dí-li ù a-ba-ba-a-ma a-na ku-li-a qí-bi-ma
target: Thus say Aššur-šad-ilī and Ababaya, say to Kuliya:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-šu-mì ṭup-pì-kà ša šu-sú-in DUMU i-na-a ú-kà-lu a-na-kam i-nu-mì a-wa-sú-nu i-gi₅-im-ru i-na ga-me-er a-wa-tí-šu ṭup-pá-kà ú-šu-ru-ni-a-tí-ma
target: As for your tablet which Šu-Suen, son of Innāya, has in his possession, when here their affair was concluded by (decision of) the man who settled his case they would release your tablet to us

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù né-nu ṭup-pá-am ša a-lim{ki} ša a-šur-re-ṣí nu-ša-ar
target: and then we would release the tablet of the City of / concerning Aššur-rēṣī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-sú-in ṭup-pá-am né-ta-ri-iš-ma um-ma šu-ut-ma a-da-na-ku-um a-wi-lúm i-na lá i-da-i-ni i-tá-al-kam
target: When we kept asking Šu-Suen for the tablet he said: I will give it you, but the man has left without us knowing it!

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma a-ma-kam KÙ.BABBAR e-ri-iš-kà lá ta-da-an
target: If over there he asks you for silver, do not give it.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-ta-ma i-na a-lim{ki} i-na ga-me-er a-wa-tim DUB-kà i ta-da-nam qá-bi-a-tí
target: Tell him: By decision of the man who settled the affair you have been ordered to hand over in the City the tablet you have.

source: translate Akkadian to English: né-nu a-na-kam <gap>-ni ni-ša-a-al ga-me-er a-wa-tim-ma
target: And we here <gap> will ask the man who settled the affair

source: translate Akkadian to English: šé-bi-lam a-šur-ANDUL ṭur₄-dam ì-GIŠ <gap> šé-bi-lam
target: send us that. Send Aššur-ṣululī here, send (also) <gap> oil.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 15 na-ru-uq mì-iš-lam ŠE-um mi-ìš-lam GIG ṣí-ib-tum ša ša-da-aq-de-em iš-ti ḫa-al-ga
target: 15 bags, half barley, half wheat, the interest of last year, is due from halga.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 na-ru-uq ŠE-am a-na-áp-ṭù-ur ku-pá-im i-ša-da-dam
target: 10 bags of barley when the snow disappears he will haul to me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 na-ru-uq GIG a-na e-bu-ri-im i-ša-da-dam
target: 5 bags of wheat he will haul to me not later than the harvest.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na 1.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša ik-ri-be ša a-na ṣí-ib-tim ta-da-nim a-na a-šur-GAL e-zi-bu
target: Of the 1.5 mina of silver from votive offerings that I left with Aššur-rabi to pay for interest

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù a-ḫa-ma 0.3333 ma-na 6 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša i-li-a ku-nu-ki-a e-zi-ib-šum
target: plus, further I left 0.3333 mina 6 shekels of silver belonging to my god under my seal with him

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na pí-lá-aḫ-IŠTAR ù a-mur-IŠTAR a-na pí-lá-aḫ-IŠTAR qí-bi-ma um-ma en-um-a-šùr-ma
target: To Pilah-Ištar and Amur-Ištar; specifically to Pilah-Ištar from Ennam-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 TÚG ra-qá-tám SIG₅ ša a-na ší-mì-im a-dí-na-ku-ni a-ḫi a-ta a-na ma-la a-we-lu-tí-kà ra-qá-tám dí-in-ma KÙ.BABBAR ku-nu-uk-ma KI a-mur-IŠTAR šé-bi-lam
target: As to the one thin textile of good quality that I gave you to sell, my dear brother, sell the thin one acting as a true gentleman, seal the silver and send it with Amur-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù šu-ma ra-qá-tum lá ta-ad-na-at-ma a-dí-ni i-ba-ší ki-ma a ší-mì-ša ú-bu-lu KÙ.BABBAR i ra-ma-tí-kà i-dí-ma ku-nu-uk-ma a-mur-IŠTAR lu-ub-lam
target: But if the thin textile has not been sold and is still there, put down silver yourself as much as it will fetch when sold, seal it and let Amur-Ištar bring it.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù lu gi₅-mì-lúm i-a-tí ḫa-ra-ni a-na a-lim{ki} ù a-na-ku a-we-el gi₅-mì-lim
target: So let it be a favour to me - I am going to the City; I too am a man of favours.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-mur-IŠTAR lá i-bi-a-at ṭur₄-da-šu šu-a-tí ú-qá-a-šu
target: Amur-Ištar should not delay, send him. It is him I am waiting for.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ki-ma <gap> 0.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na a-lim{ki} ša-ak-šu-dí wa-ar-ki-a qá-bi₄-a-tí
target: You have been ordered after my departure to forward 0.5 shekels of silver to me in the city.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma wa-ar-ki-tí a-na a-lim{ki} lá tù-ša-ak-ší-dí 1 ma-na-um 0.6666 ma-na i-na a-lim{ki} ta-ša-qá-lam
target: If after my departure you do not forward it to me in the city you will pay me in the city 0.6666 mina per mina (extra).

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫi a-ta KÙ.BABBAR a-na É-a-ba-áš-tí šu-qú-ul-ma wa-ar-ki-tí a-na a-lim{ki} ša-ak-ší-dí
target: Please, my brother, pay the silver to Ea-bāštī and see to it that it catches up with me in the city.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu-mu-un li-bi₄-im a-ra-ší-a-ku-um a-wa-tim ša ta-ta-wu-ni la-ší-na-ma
target: I could get angry with you, (for) the words you spoke are improper!

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR a-na É-a-ba-áš-tí šu-qú-ul-ma lu at-ḫu-a-ni
target: Pay the silver to Ea-bāštī and let us stay brothers!

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB MAR.TU-ba-ni DUMU ma-na-na KIŠIB ú-ra-a ŠEŠ-šu KIŠIB ḫa-da-a DUMU kà-ra-wa KIŠIB a-na-aḫ-DINGIR DUMU ḫi-šar KIŠIB a-da-da DUMU {d}IM.GAL KIŠIB da-ak-ni-iš KIŠIB ḫu-ra-ta KIŠIB PUZUR₄.IŠTAR KIŠIB i-dí-{d}UTU me-er-e da-la-áš
target: Sealed by Amurrum-bāni son of Manana, by Uraya his brother, by hadaya son of Karawa, by Anah-ilī son of hišar, by Adada son of Adad-rabi, by Dakniš, by hurata, by Puzur-Ištar, by Iddin-Šamaš, the sons of Dalaš.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na 9 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša É ḫa-ar-ta ù 10 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša ḫa-al-ki-a-šu ù kà-ri-a me-er-ú da-la-áš
target: For the 9 minas of silver from harta's house and the 10 minas of silver from halkiaššu and Karriya, sons of Dalaš.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ša-lim-a-šùr ù me-er-e-šu ú-lá i-tù-ru
target: They must not raise claims against Šalim-Aššur and his sons.

source: translate Akkadian to English: GÍR ša a-šùr ú-ta-me-šu
target: I / he made him swear by Aššur's dagger.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 6 ku-ta-nu ša DAM.GÀR
target: 6 kutānus belonging to a merchant.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB šál-ma-a-šur a-na i-dí-a-bi-im ù en-na-nim <gap>
target: Sealed by Šalim-Aššur; to Iddin-abum and Ennānum <gap>

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma a-šùr-i-mì-tí i-na ša-ḫa-tí-kà li-zi-iz-ma
target: Now then, let Aššur-imittī assist you

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ša É.GAL-lúm i-na ṣé-ri-kà i-lá-qé-ú a-na-ku a-za-za-am
target: and for whatever the palace will take at your expense I myself will accept responsibility.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na e-lá-ma qí-bí-ma um-ma lá-qé-pu-um ù šu-a-šur-ma
target: To Elamma say, thus Lā-qēpum and Šu-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 72 ku-ta-nu ku-wa-ú-tum 26 ku-ta-nu ša DAM.GÀR 1 ku-ta-num ša ik-ri-bi₄-kà 1 ku-ta-num ša a-ta-a-a ŠU.NÍGIN 1 me-at ku-ta-nu ša šé-ep a-šur-mu-ta-pí-il₅
target: 72 textiles belonging to you, 26 belonging to the, 1 of your, 1 of Atāya - in all 100 shipped under Aššur-mūtappil;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 71 ku-ta-nu ša šé-ep DUMU ú-ṣa-ri-a 31 ku-ta-nu ša šé-ep a-šur-lá-ma-sí 3 ku-ta-nu a-ḫa-ma pá-ni-ú-tum 1 ku-ta-num ša ḫa-ti-a ŠU.NÍGIN 2 me-at 26 ku-ta-nu
target: 71 shipped under Uṣāriya's son; 31 shipped under Aššur-lamassī; separately 3 shipped earlier; 1 of hatiya - in all 226 textiles.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ.BA 1 me-at 81 ku-ta-ni 25 ša a-ki-dí-e zi-kur-{d}IŠKUR ir-de₈-a-ku-um
target: Thereof 181 and 25 Akkadian textiles Zikur-Adad led to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3.5 GÍN 10 5 ŠE KÙ.BABBAR a-na sà-ḫe-er-tim áš-qúl
target: I paid 3 7 / 12 shekels for small wares.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 GÚ AN.NA ku-nu-ku ša a-lim{ki} ša DAM.GÀR 3 GÚ ku-wa-um 2 šu-uq-lá-an ša ar-ta-ma nu-sà-ni-iq-ší-na-ma 5 ma-na im-ṭí-a
target: 2 talents of tin provided sealed in the City belonging to the, 3 talents belonging to you, 2 packets of Artama - we checked them and they proved to contain 5 minas too little.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 šu-uq-lam ni-ip-ṭur₄-ma <gap> 0.5 ma-na 4 GÍN a-na DUMU da-da-nim ù DUMU ú-ṣa-ri-a né-pu-ul iš-tù AN.NA qà-tim ù 0.6666 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša a pá-ni-šu-nu nu-šé-bi-lu gám-ru
target: We opened one packet and we balanced 0.5 mina 4 shekels to the son of Dadānum and the son of Uṣāriya after the tin for expenses and the 0.6666 mina of silver we had sent them en route had been spent.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 šu-uq-lam a-šu-mì ni-is-ḫa-tim É kà-ri-im ú-kà-lu
target: One packet they detained in the colonial office because of the import-tax.

source: translate Akkadian to English: É šál-ma-a-šùr a-na a-wa-tim né-ru-ub-ma um-ma šál-ma-a-šùr-ma
target: We entered Šalim-Aššur's house to settle the case, and Šalim-Aššur said:

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-a-tí a-na bu-ru-uš-ḫa-dim i-na ma-ak-sú-im a-na ḫu-bu-ul ÌR a-bu-ša-lim ša-qá-lim i-ra-de₈-ú-ni
target: While they are going to lead me to Burušhaddum in fetters in order to pay the debt of the slave Abu-šalim,

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ta 30 TÚG ku-ta-ni ù ANŠE ṣa-lá-ma-am ša ÌR tal-qé
target: you on the other hand have taken 30 textiles and a black donkey from the slave.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-be-lúm-ma ke-na ša ÌR-dí-a a-bu-ša-lim al-qé
target: Šu-Bēlum answered: "Yes, I have taken what belongs to my slave Abu-šalim."

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša-lim-a-šur ša ni-iš a-lim{ki} úz-na-tí-ni il₅-pu-ut
target: Šalim-Aššur impressed on us what was sworn by the City,

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šál-ma-a-šur-ma a-šar ÌR a-na wa-ar-dí-kà lá i-tù-ru ma-a a-na wa-ar-dí-a i-tù-ar
target: and Šalim-Aššur said: "In case the slave does not raise claim against your slave, will he then raise claim against my slave?"

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-be-lúm-ma šu-ma a-na ku-a-im i-tù-ar a-na TÚG.ḪI.A ù ANŠE a-za-za-kum
target: Šu-Bēlum answered: "If he raises claim against yours, I shall guarantee for the textiles and the donkey."

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um kà-né-eš i-dí-ni-a-tí-ma
target: The Kanesh colony gave us for these proceedings

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI GÍR ša a-šur ší-bu-tí-ni ni-dí-in
target: and we gave our testimony before Aššur's dagger.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI ú-ra-a IGI ì-lí-dan IGI ma-nu-um-ba-lúm-a-šur
target: Witnessed by Uraya, by Ilī-dan, by Mannum-balum-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 56 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR i-na KÙ.BABBAR-áp a-šur-i-dí ú-ṣú-ur-ša-a-šur ù a-šur-DU₁₀ a-na ša-lim-a-šur iš-qú-lu-ma
target: Uṣur-ša-Aššur and Aššur-ṭāb have paid 56 minas of silver from Aššur-idī's silver to Šalim-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR i-ší-tám-ma ṭup-pá-am ša ú-ṣú-ur-ša-a-šur ù a-šur-DU₁₀ ša-lim-a-šur il₅-pu-ut-ma
target: But 4 minas of silver remain (unpaid), and Šalim-Aššur wrote a debt note for Uṣur-ša-Aššur and Aššur-ṭāb.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pá-am ša 1 GÚ KÙ.BABBAR ša ḫu-bu-ul a-šur-i-dí DUMU sá-ta-a a-na ú-ṣú-ur-ša-a-šur ù a-šur-DU₁₀ ša-lim-a-šur ú-ší-ir
target: And released the (old) tablet concerning 1 talent of silver, the debt of Aššur-idī son of Sadaya to Uṣur-ša-Aššur and Aššur-ṭāb.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-šur-i-mì-tí DUMU a-ta-a IGI a-da-da DUMU {d}IM.GAL
target: Witnessed by Aššur-imittī son of Ataya, by Adada son of Adad-rabi.

source: translate Akkadian to English: PUZUR₄-tí-a-am-tim tap-pá-i-ni a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um kà-ni-ìš ṣa-ḫe-er GAL i-dí-ni-a-tí-ma
target: Puzur-Ti'amtum was our (absent) partner. The plenary assembly of the Kanesh colony gave for these proceedings.
