source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI GÍR ša a-šur ṭup-pá-am ni-dí-in
target: And we gave the tablet before Aššur's dagger.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-da-da GÍR ša a-šur iṣ-ba-at-ma i-sá-a DUMU da-ga-ma-al-ki-im pì-šu iš-me
target: Adada seized Aššur's dagger and Isaya son of Dagan-malkum heard his statement.

source: translate Akkadian to English: <gap> ma-na 5.25 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na be-lúm-ba-ni ḫa-bu-lá-ku
target: I owe <gap> minas 5 1 / 4 shekels of silver to Bēlum-bāni.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma be-lúm-ba-ni-ma a-na a-lá-ḫi-im ù <gap>-a-šur qí-bi-ma
target: From Bēlum-bāni to Ali-ahum and <gap>-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: <gap> šu-ma URUDU SIG₅ 1 ma-na-a ù 2 GÍN.TA <gap> a-na KÙ.BABBAR dí-na-šu
target: if copper of good quality <gap> sell it for silver at 62 shekels per mina.

source: translate Akkadian to English: <gap> šu a-dí ITU.1.KAM-im iš-tí-in a-na DAM.GÀR la ša ša-ḫa-tim ú-ul a-na ša ba-áb ma-ḫi-ri-im <gap>
target: in a single month <gap> to a trader who gives no reason for worry, or <gap> to the entrance of the market <gap>

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ITU.10.KAM a-li i-ma-qú-tù
target: within 10 months wherever they arrive

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am a-na a-šur-DU₁₀ DUMU a-mur-na-ḫu-uš ú-šé-bi-il₅
target: 1 mina of refined silver I sent to Aššur-ṭāb son of Amur-Nahuš.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 11 ma-na URUDU a-na ma-áš-ḫi-li
target: 11 minas of copper for a sieve.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na a-mur-a-šur DUMU i-dí-lim
target: 4.5 shekels of silver for Amur-Aššur son of Iddin-ilum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 8 ma-na ša a-na-ku i li-bi a-dí-ú
target: 8 minas that I personally deposited in it.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 ma-na a-ta-aq-ri-ba-tim
target: 2 minas for the rituals.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 GÚ 33 ma-na a-na ú-ṣú-ur-ša-a-šur áš-qú-ul
target: 1 talent 33 minas for Uṣur-ša-Aššur I paid.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 GÚ 3 ma-na GÚ URUDU-ki a-šur-i-mì-tí lu tám-kà-ri-im áš-ta-qal
target: 3 talents 3 minas of copper owed by Aššur-imittī I have paid to the merchant.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 GÚ URUDU iš-tí a-šur-i-mì-tí wa-bar-tum iṣ-ba-at
target: 1 talent of copper owed by the station seized Aššur-imittī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na en-um-a-šur DUMU šál-ma-a-šùr ù šu-be-lim
target: to Ennam-Aššur son of Šalim-Aššur, and Šu-Bēlum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 11 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša qá-ta-at a-al-DU₁₀ a-šur-{d}UTU ú en-na-su-en il₅-ta-áp-tù
target: As for the 11 minas of silver for which Aššur-šamšī and Ennam-Suen had themselves registered as guarantors of Āl-ṭāb,

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma KÙ.BABBAR i-na ṣé-er a-šur-{d}UTU ú en-na-sú-in i-ta-al-qé
target: should the silver be collected at the expense of Aššur-šamšī, and Ennam-Suen,

source: translate Akkadian to English: É-bi-tám ša a-lim{ki} ša a-al-DU₁₀ e-ru-ba-at KÙ.BABBAR
target: then Āl-ṭāb's house in the City is a pledge for the silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI zu-ba IGI PUZUR₄-a-na IGI na-áb-sú-in
target: In the presence of Zuba, of Puzur-Anna, of Nabi-Suen.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am en-um-a-šur DUMU šál-ma-a-šur a-na be-a-lim a-na i-tur₄-DINGIR ù e-lá-lí DUMU me-er-e PUZUR₄-a-na i-dí-in
target: Ennam-Aššur son of Šalim-Aššur has given 1 mina of refined silver as a working-capital to Itūr-ilī and Elāli, sons of Puzur-Anna.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR šál-ma-am i-na e-ra-bi-šu-nu-ma i-na a-lim{ki} i-ša-qú-lu-ú
target: They will pay the correct amount of silver when they arrive from the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR i qá-qá-ad šál-mì-šu-nu i-na a-lim{ki} ù GÁN-lim ra-ki-is
target: They are jointly responsible for the silver, both in the City and abroad.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ITU.1.KAM ša sá-ra-tim li-mu-um ša qá-tí a-šur-na-da DUMU ili₅-bi-na-ni
target: Month Ša-sarrātim, eponymy after Aššur-nādā son of Ilī-binannī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI šu-bé-lim DUMU šu-IŠTAR IGI zu-ku-a DUMU a-šur-i-dí
target: Witnessed by Šu-Bēlum son of Šu-Ištar, by Zukuwa son of Aššur-idī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-lá-ḫu-um-ma a-na SIG₅-pì-i-a-šur qí-bi-ma
target: From Ali-ahum to Damiq-pī-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ku-nu-ki-a ú ša 8 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR sà-ḫe-er-tám e-lá-lí ú en-um-ì-lí na-áš-ú-ni-kum
target: Elāli and Ennam-ilī bring you 0.5 mina of silver under my seal and small goods worth 8 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-kam i-na {d}UTU-ši ṭup-pí ta-ša-me-ú É.GAL-lim-ku-nu áp-lá-ma
target: The very day you hear my letter there you (plur.) must satisfy your palace.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ra-bi sí-ki-tim me-et lá-ma ma-tum iš-me-ú ra-ma-ku-nu šu-ul-ḫa-a
target: for the is dead. Before the land has heard it your must withdraw yourselves.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 TÚG.ḪI.A a-na li-ta-áb-ší-a lu šu-ru-um lu bu-ra-am ša a-ki-dí-e iš-tù ḫu-ra-ma DUMU dí-ma lu-lá-ḫi-pu-šu-ma TÚG.ḪI.A a li-tab-ší-a
target: Give a set of textiles for me to wear, either a black one or an Akkadian from hurama, to an affiliated trader so they may wrap it up and have it brought in.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫi ki-ma ta-áš-li-mu šu-lu-um-kà ṣú-ḫa-ri ANŠE.ḪI.A SIG₅ ṣú-ḫa-ri
target: My dear brother, when you have come safely to Kuburnat send me greetings with Enah-ilī's servant.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR DIRI ša-du-a-sú ša-bu be-ú-lá-tí-a a-gi-a ḫa-bu-lam a-ḫa-ma
target: Also, if there are any good donkeys among my donkeys, send it here with Enah-ilī's servant for my own trip.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ú 3 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ší-im UDU.ḪI.A a-na 3 GÚ a-gi-a
target: Agiya owes me 0.5 mina of silver, its import duty added, its transport tariff paid for, my working capital.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 17 ma-na AN.NA ša ki-ma i-a-tí i-dí-nu-ma 4 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR i qá-tí-šu TAB NU
target: Further, 10 shekels of silver plus 3 shekels of silver, the price of sheep, for 3 talents: Agiya. My representatives gave 17 minas of tin and 4 minas of silver remain in his possession.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB a-ta-tí-a DUMU en-na-nim KIŠIB a-ḫu-wa-qar DUMU a-šur-SIPA KIŠIB a-mur-a-šur DUMU šu-eš-ḫa-ra KIŠIB a-šur-{d}UTU DUMU ili₅-ba-ni
target: Seal of Atatiya, son of Ennānum, seal of Ahu-waqar, son of Aššur-rē'ī, seal of Amur-Aššur, son of Šu-Išhara, seal of Aššur-šamšī, son of Ilī-bāni.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša a-al-DU₁₀ a-mur-a-šur a-na iṣ-ba-at-ni-a-tí-ma um-ma a-al-DU₁₀-ma a-na a-mur-a-šur-ma KÙ.BABBAR a-ta ù šu-IŠTAR qá-tám mi-ìš-lá i-na ša i-ip-ṭí-re ša-qá-lá-am lá qá-bi-a-tù-nu
target: Āl-ṭāb seized us against Amur-Aššur and Āl-ṭāb said to Amur-Aššur: Have you and Šu-Ištar not promised (or: been ordered) to pay each half of the silver?

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-mur-a-šur-ma ke-na qá-bi-a-ni ù i-na né-me-lim ša-li-ìš-tám áš-du-na-da i-zu-a-az ù a-na i-bi-sà-e šál-iš-tám i-za-az
target: Amur-Aššur answered: "True, we have promised (or: been ordered) to pay each half of the silver and also (that) would receive as share one third of the profit and that he (also) would be responsible for one third of the losses."

source: translate Akkadian to English: 21 gu₅-šu-ru GAL 23 tár-dí-ú-tum
target: 21 large beams, 23 of smaller size.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 6 le-ú GAL-tum 8 tár-dí-ú-tum
target: 6 large wooden boards, 8 of smaller size.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 30 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am ni-is-ḫa-sú DIRI ša-du-a-sú ša-bu ku-nu-ki-a-na en-um-a-šur DUMU ú-sà-ri-a áp-qí-id IGI PUZUR₄-{d}IM DUMU <gap> IGI kur-ub-IŠTAR
target: 30 minas of refined silver, its excise added, his transport fee paid, under <my> seals, I entrusted to Ennam-Aššur, son of Uṣāriya, in the presence of Puzur-Adad, son of <gap>, and of Kurub-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 7 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na qá-tí-šu a-dí-in
target: 7 shekels of silver I gave him for his expenses.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 15 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ni-is-ḫa-sú DIRI ša-du-a-sú ša-bu ku-nu-ki-a a-na {d}IM-pí-la-aḫ DUMU a-ni-nim áp-qí-id IGI šu-IŠTAR DUMU šu-ki-tim IGI a-šur-ma-lik DUMU ša-ba-ḫa-nim
target: 15 minas of silver, its excise added, his transport fee paid, under my seal, I entrusted to Adad-pilah, son of Anīnum, in the presence of Šu-Ištar, son of Šukutum, and of Aššur-mālik, son of Šabahānum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 30 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am ni-is-ḫa-sú DIRI ša-du-a-sú ša-bu ku-nu-ki-a a-na a-šur-SIPA DUMU i-dí-IŠTAR áp-qí-id IGI šu-ku-bi₄-im DUMU ú-zu-a IGI DUMU kur-ub-IŠTAR DUMU MAR.TU-ba-ni
target: 30 minas of refined silver, its excise added, his transport fee paid, under my seal, I entrusted to Aššur-rē'ī, son of Iddin-Ištar, in the presence of Šu-Kūbum, son of Uzua, and of the son of Kurub-Ištar, son of Amurrum-bāni.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na qá-tí-šu a-dí-in
target: 3 shekels of silver I gave for his expenses.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠU.NÍGIN 0.6666 ma-na 2 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ni-is-ḫa-sú DIRI a-na en-<gap>
target: In all 42 shekels of silver, its excise added, for Ennam-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ni-is-ḫa-sú DIRI a-na pí-la-aḫ-IŠTAR DUMU ú-zu-a
target: 10 shekels of silver, its excise added, for Pilah-Ištar, son of Ibisu'a.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-šur-ba-ni-ma a-na a-lá-ḫi-im <gap> ù lu-lu qí-bi-ma 3.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ku-nu-ki-a LUGAL-sú-in DUMU PUZUR₄-sú-in na-áš-a-ku-nu-tí
target: From Aššur-bāni to Ali-ahum and Lulu: Šar-Suen son of Puzur-Suen brings you 3.5 minas of silver under my seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫu-ú-a a-tù-nu i-na {d}UTU-ši ša LUGAL-sú-in e-ra-ba-ni 3.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR iš-tí a-šur-ma-lik DUMU a-lá-ḫi-im a ṣí-ib-tim al-qé ṭup-pí ḫa-ri-im
target: My dear brothers, the day Šar-Suen arrives - I have taken a loan of 3.5 minas of silver from Aššur-malik son of Ali-ahum against interest; my tablet is certified.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na {d}UTU-ši ṭup-pá-am ta-ša-me-a-ni KÙ.BABBAR a-na a-šur-ma-lik šu-uq-lá-ma ṭup-pí šé-ṣí-a-nim-ma li-it-a-šu-ma ù a-šar a-lá-ḫi-im li-ib-ší
target: The day you hear the letter, pay the silver to Aššur-malik, get out my tablet, split it and then let it remain with Ali-ahum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫu-ú-a a-tù-nu a-na 1 ma-na-im 1.3333 GÍN.TA KÙ.BABBAR ṣí-ib-tám ú-ṣa-áb
target: My dear brothers, I have to add interest at the rate 1.3333 shekel per mina.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na 15 u₄-me-e ḫa-mu-uš-tum ša i-dí-a-bi₄-im KÙ.BABBAR al-qé
target: I received it for 15 days in the week of Iddin-abum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na 1 ma-na-im ša en-na-nim i-ta-ak-sá-am KÙ.BABBAR al-qé
target: I received the silver cut off by way of the one-mina stone of Ennānum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iḫ-da-ma ṣí-ib-tám i-ṣé-ri-a lá i-lá-qé
target: Take care that he should not take interest from me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫi šu-ut ga-ma-al-šu a-le-e
target: He is my brother. I can do him favours.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma ṣí-ib-tám ša lá-qá-im il₅-qé 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i li-bi₄ lu-lu i-šu ŠÀ.BA dí-na-šu-um
target: If he takes interest as he can, I have 5 shekels of silver owed by Lulu; give (the interest) to him out of that.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 me-at 21 ma-na URUDU ší-ku-um iš-tí i-tur₄-DINGIR ù a-ḫi-šu
target: 221 minas of šikku-copper owed by Itūr-ilī and his brother

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 me-at 27 ma-na URUDU iš-tí ma-li-tí-il₅
target: 127 minas of copper owed by Malitil

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 ma-na KI ḫa-ma-li-a
target: 10 minas owed by hamalia

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 na-ru-uq ŠE-am i-dí-a-šur
target: 2 sacks of barley: Iddin-Aššur;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 na-ru-uq ŠE-am 1 na-ru-uq ar-ša-tum e-na-sú-in DUMU ì-lí-a-lim
target: 2 sacks of barley, 1 sack of wheat: Enna-Suen son of Ilī-ālum;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 na-ru-uq ŠE-am PUZUR₄-e-nam
target: 2 sacks of barley: Puzur-ennam;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 DUG ŠE-am a-dí-da
target: 1 jar of barley: Adida;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 DUG ŠE-um ili₅-ba-ni
target: 1 jar of barley: Ilī-bāni;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 na-ru-uq 1 DUG ŠE-am-tim a-na ḫa-dí-tum um-mì-šu
target: 1 sack 1 jar of barley of the maid for her mother haditum;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 DUG ar-ša-tim a-ba-ba ra-bi-ṣú-um
target: 2 jars of wheat: Ababa the attorney - all this the lady has given.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ma a-nim a-we-el-tum i-ta-dí-in
target: It will be deducted from the grain account.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i li-bi ú-ṭí-tim i-ṣa-ḫi-ir
target: Further, I gave 1 sack of wheat last year to Ilī-ālum's son;

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫa-ma 1 na-ru-uq ar-ša-tim ša-da-ag-de₈-e a-na DUMU ì-lí-a-lim a-dí-in
target: I sent 1 sack of wheat from Tumliya to Puzur-ennam.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.3333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR <gap> ḫi-ri-im ša PÚZUR <gap> na-áb-sú-in 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ší-im pí-ri-kà-ni 9 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša <gap> 7 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša <gap> ŠU.NÍGIN 1 ma-na 1 <gap> a-na KÙ.BABBAR a-nim
target: 0.3333 mina of silver for <gap> of Puzur- <gap> Nab-Suen, 10 shekels of silver the price of pirikannu-textiles, 9 shekels of silver of <gap>, 7 shekels of silver of <gap>, in all 1 mina 1 <gap> shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 GÍN KÙ.GI <gap> a-šùr-ṣú-lu-li <gap> 10 GÍN KÙ.GI <gap> ša ša-ku-ul-tim ŠU.NÍGIN 0.3333 ma-na KÙ.GI ù 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR
target: For this silver <gap> 10 shekels of gold <gap> Assur-sululi <gap> 10 shekels of gold <gap> for the dinner. In all 20 shekels of gold and 0.5 mina of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ma a-nim ku-nu-ki-a PÚZUR.IŠTAR DUMU en-na-nim za-al-pá-i-um a-na kà-li-tí-ni ú-bi₄-il₅
target: All this, under my seal, Puzur-Istar, son of Ennanum, from Zalpa, brought to our bride in spe.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-šùr-e-mu-qí DUMU ga-za-nim-DUB.SAR
target: In the presence of Assur-emuqi, son of GAZanum, the scribe.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma en-um-a-šur-ma a-na lá-qé-pí-im ù a-na-a-na a-na a-na-a-na qí-bi₄-ma
target: From Ennam-Aššur to Lā-qēpum and Anna-anna; specifically to Anna-anna:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí 10 iš-ri-šu áš-pu-ra-ki-im um-ma a-na-ku-ma ba-áb-tí za-ki-a-ma a-dí a-lá-kà-ni ší-lá-tum lá i-ba-ší
target: I have written you 10 times, saying: Clear my outstanding claims so there will be no wrongdoing until I come.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú KÙ.BABBAR 1 GÍN li-im-ḫu-ri a-tí ki-ma ša-pá-ri-ma úz-ni-a pá-ta-im tí-ir-tí-ki ma-tí-ma ú-lá i-lá-kam
target: So, every shekel of silver should come my way. However, you, instead of writing and giving me information - no message from you ever comes.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na 15 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ú ṣí-ba-tù-šu i-dí ša ḫa-pí-aḫ-šu
target: 1 mina 15 shekels of silver and its interest is the wages of happiahšu;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na 10 GÍN ú ṣí-ba-tù-šu iš-tí ta-ar-ḫi-ša-an
target: 1 mina 10 shekels and its interest is owed by Tarhišan;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ú 18 GÍN ṣí-ba-tù-šu iš-tí al-wa ša
target: 0.5 mina 5 shekels plus 18 shekels, his interest, owed by Alwa

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR a ṣí-ib-tí-šu-nu na-ru-uq ŠE e-zi-ib ša DUMU uš-ḫa-ta
target: silver for their interest sacks of barley apart from that of Ušhata's son

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ṣé-er am-tí-a áš-ta-pá-ra-ni ša li-bi tám-kà-ri-a lu KÙ.BABBAR lu ú-ṭá-tám ša-áš-qí-lá
target: I have written repeatedly to my maid, that you should have the claims on my customers, both the silver and the grain paid.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša lá-a i-ša-qú-lu ma-na-um 0.5 ma-na sá-as-qí-il₅-šu-nu-tí za-ku-sà ma-lá KÙ.BABBAR ta-am-ḫu-ra-ni šu-up-ra-nim-ma úz-ni pí-té-a
target: Who does not pay, calculate for them 0.5 mina per mina and write me a report about how much silver you have received and inform me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na 1 me-at pì-ri-kà-ni ú 4 ANŠE.ḪI ṣa-lá-me ša a-na dur₄-ḫu-mì-it a-na ṣé-er a-bi-ni ub-lu-ni
target: Of the 100 pirikannus and 4 black donkeys that they brought to our father in Durhumit,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ.BA 4 pì-ri-kà-ni ṣú-ḫa-ru-ú a-na lu-bu-ší-šu-nu il₅-qé
target: thereof the servants took 4 pirikannus for their clothing;

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma i-dí-a-bu-um-ma a-na ša-lim-ma mu-za ù kà-du-ta-lá qí-bi-ma
target: From Iddin-abum to Šalimma, Muza and Kadutala:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 15 GÍN ku-nu-ki-a kà-du-ta-lá na-áš-a-ki-na-tí
target: Kadutala brings you (fem. plur.) 15 shekels under my seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iḫ-da-ma i-na ša-am-ší ṭup-pí-i ta-ša-me-a-ni i-zi-za-ma
target: Take care to be ready the very day you hear my letter,

source: translate Akkadian to English: SÍG.ḪI-a da-mì-iq-tum ša-ma-ma ku-nu-ki ša ša-lim-ma a-na kà-du-ta-lá dí-na-ma lu-ub-lam
target: buy good wool and give it to Kadutala under Šalimma's seal, so he may bring it.

source: translate Akkadian to English: SÍG.ḪI.A a-ší-ni-pì-a na-ás-ḫa
target: The wool has been deducted for my two-thirds.

source: translate Akkadian to English: kà-du-ta-lá na-áš-a-ki-im
target: Kadutala brings you a <gap> dagger.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 9 ma-na URUDU SIG₅ i li-bi ur-dim ša i re-eš kà-ri-im dur₄-ḫu-mì-iš i-za-zu
target: 9 minas of refined copper due from Urdum, who serves karum Durhumit.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na URUDU ší-kam i li-bi₄ a-šur-i-dí DUMU IŠTAR-ba-ni
target: 1 mina of sikku-copper due from Assur-idi, son of Istar-bani.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 kà-ar-pát kà-mu-né ku-nu-ki-šu 13 ú-kà-pè wa-dí-ú-tum mì-ma a-nim ša ku-li-a
target: Two jars of cumin, with his seal, 13 saddlecloths — all this belongs to Kuliya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na um-mì-a-ni-a a-la-ḫi-im a-šur-re-ṣí da-dí-a ù en-nam-a-šur qí-bi₄-ma um-ma e-la-ma-ma
target: To my principals, Ali-ahum, Aššur-rēṣī, Dadiya and Ennam-Aššur, thus Elamma:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 16.6666 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am ku-nu-ki-a ni-is-ḫa-sú DIRI ša-du-a-sú ša-bu a-šur-na-da na-áš-a-ku-nu-tí
target: 16.6666 minas of refined silver, under my seals, its excise added, his transport fee paid, Aššur-nādā is bringing to youplur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma a-na ma-la té-er-tí i-li-kà-ku-nu-tí-ni 30 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a-na ṣí-ib-tim ta-al-qé-a-nim ù ší-ma-am ta-áš-a-ma-nim
target: If, following my instruction that reached you, you have indeed borowed 30 minas of silver at interest and you have made purchases (with it) for me,

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR a-šar ta-al-qé-a-ni ta-e-ra
target: then pay back the silver where you have borrowed it.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma la ta-al-qé-a-nim <gap> a-na KÙ.BABBAR ša a-šur-na-da na-áš-a-ku-nu-tí-ni ku-ta-ni ša-ma-ni-ma iḫ-da-ma a-na ba-ra-im li-ik-šu-du-nim
target: If you have not (yet) borrowed it, then buy for me for the silver which Aššur-nādā is bringing you and take care that they reach me before the suspension of traffic.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 45 na-ru-uq ŠE-am <gap> na-ru-uq ar-ša-tim a-ḫa-ma ša ša-da-aq-tí
target: 45 sacks of barley, <gap> sacks of wheat, further, from last year.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 45 na-ru-uq ŠE-am 5 na-ru-uq ar-ša-tum IGI ú-li-id ší-im-tám al-qé ki-ma ar-ša-tim ŠE-am al-qé
target: 45 sacks of barley and 5 sacks of wheat.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i-ṣé-er i-dí-IŠTAR i-sú-rik₁₃ i-šu
target: Iddin-Ištar owes 1 mina 10 shekels of silver to Issu-arik.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma 15 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i-na a-lá-ki-a lá eš-ta-aq-lu a-na KÙ.BABBAR ù ṣí-ba-tí-šu ša-ki-li ú-u₄-me-a a-tù-wa-ar-šum
target: If he has not paid 15 shekels of silver when I arrive, then I shall raise claim against him for the silver and the accrued interest for the entire period.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-bu-um-DINGIR IGI ša-lim-a-šùr
target: Witnessed by Abum-ilī, witnessed by Šalim-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 11.5 ma-na URUDU ší-ku-um i-ṣé-er sú-kà-li-im lu-zi i-šu
target: Sukkallum owes 11.5 minas of copper to Luzi.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù ITU.1.KAM áb-ša-ra-ni li-mu-um ku-bi-a-a ki-ma a-wa-at kà-ri-im ṣí-ib-tam ú-ṣa-áb
target: Reckoned from the month Ab-šarrāni, eponymy Kūbiya, he must add interest in accordance with the rule of the colony.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI ú-zu-a IGI i-dí-a-bi₄-im
target: Witnessed by Uzuwa, by Iddin-abum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na e-lá-ma qí-bi₄-ma um-ma a-šur-SIPA-ma
target: Say to Elamma, thus Aššur-rē'ī:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 GÚ 20 ma-na AN.NA ku-nu-ki 1 me-at 21 TÚG mì-ma a-ni-im a-ra-de₈-a-kum
target: 4 talent 20 minas of tin under seals (and) 121 textiles, all this I am leading to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-nu-mì a-ḫu-wa-qar iš-tù a-lim{ki} i-tù-ra-ni
target: When Ahu-waqar comes back from the City

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-uq-lam ku-nu-ki ša a-lim{ki} <gap> ù e-lá-ma i-pá-ṭù-ru-ma
target: PN and Elamma will break open the packet with seals applied in the City

source: translate Akkadian to English: 50 ma-na AN.NA i-du-nu-šu-ma
target: and they will give him 50 minas of tin

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù u₄-mì-im ša AN.NA i-lá-qé-ú 15 ḫa-am-ša-tim i-lá-ak-ma
target: and from the day he gets the tin he will go (travel) for 15 weeks

source: translate Akkadian to English: 8.3333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am a-ḫu-wa-qar i-ša-qal
target: and then Ahu-waqar will pay 8.3333 minas of refined silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: kà-ru-um kà-ni-iš TUR GAL dí-nam i-dí-ma
target: The plenary Kanesh colony passed the following verdict:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ma-lá qá-bi-ú-ni ú-ṣur-pì-a-šur iš-tí a-ḫi-šu en-um-a-šùr a-na be-et a-bi₄-šu-nu e-ra-ab ú ú-ṣí-ma qá-de₈-šu-ma e-kál ù i-ša-ti
target: In conformity with what they have promised, Uṣur-pī-Aššur will enter and leave their paternal house together with his brother Ennam-Aššur (and) will eat and drink together with him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: GÉME ki-ma aḫ-zu-ni a-ḫi-iz GÉME a ší-mì-im lá i-da-an
target: He stays married to the maid just as he has married (her), he shall not sell the maid.

source: translate Akkadian to English: té-er-tum a-na a-lim{ki} a-ṣé-er a-ḫa-ti-šu ú a-ḫi-šu i-lá-ak-ma a-dí té-er-tum i-tù-ra-ni be-tum₈ ú ú-tù-up-tum i ba-ri-šu-nu
target: A report will go to the City, to his sisters and his brothers and until a notice has come back the house and its inventory is their common property.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ma-ma-an a ší-mì-im lá i-da-an
target: Nobody shall sell (anything).

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na na-áp-ṭá-ar ku-pá-im i-ša-qú-lu
target: they are to pay at the melting of the snow.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ra-bi-ṣú-um ša É ša-lim-a-šur a-na en-um-a-šùr ú a-lá-ḫi-im me-er-e ša-lim-a-šùr iṣ-ba-at-ni-a-tí-ma
target: The attorney of Šalim-Aššur's firm seized us against Ennam-Aššur and Ali-ahum, Šalim-Aššur's sons.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ra-bi-ṣú-um-ma iš-tù ITU-<gap>-KAM a-li-kam-ma tù-na-a-ni
target: The attorney said: I came here <gap> months ago and you cheat me!

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú iš-tù ITU.2.KAM um-me-a-nu a-bi-ku-nu <gap> na-áš-pé-er-tám i-<gap> wa-šu-ri-im ú-kà-<gap> tù-na-ni-ma

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-šur-re-ṣí-ma a ma-lá té-er-tí a-lá-ḫi-im <gap> tám i-na ba-áb <gap>
target: Aššur-rēṣī told (me): In accordance with Ali-ahum's instruction <gap> in the gate <gap>

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na <gap> ù a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi-ma um-ma en-um-a-šùr-ma
target: To <gap> and Ali-ahum from Ennum-Aššur;

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí ša um-me-a-ni ša a-bi-ni tí-ir-tí a-dí ma-lá ù ší-ni-šu i-li-kà-kum-ma nu-za-kà-nim
target: My messages have come to you a couple of times concerning the investors of our father, that we should clear (the matter);

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù a-na <gap> ša qá-sú-nu iš-ku-nu-ni i-na na-áp-tù ḫa-ra-nim ú <gap>
target: also, for <gap> on which they have laid claim, when the road opens <gap>

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na wa-ar-ki-tim ki-ma ṣú-ḫa-ru iš-tù ša-lá-tù-ar im-qú-tù-ni-ni-ma KÙ.BABBAR mì-ma lá ub-lu-ni-ni
target: Later, as the servants arrived from Šalatuwar and did not bring any silver,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú a-ṣé-er <gap> tù-ša-áš-ni-ú <gap>-ni um-me-a-<gap> ù wa-ar-kà-sà ša ni-ša-me-ú <gap>
target: and in addition to <gap> you repeated <gap> investors <gap> and its resolution that we shall hear about<gap>

source: translate Akkadian to English: URUDU i-sà-ri-du-šu-ma a-na KÙ.BABBAR i-tù-ar
target: as to the copper, they will pack it for him and it will be exchanged for silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-wa-tum iš-tí ma-ma-ḫi-ir i-bi-tí-iq
target: The matter with Man-mahir has been settled.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR 1 GÍN ša ú-šé-ṣí-ú i ma-aḫ-ri-šu-nu a-ša-kán
target: Every shekel of silver that I have produced, I shall place before them.

source: translate Akkadian to English: URUDU ša ri šu 2 ANŠE.ḪI.A ṣa-lá-mì 10 i-lá-tim ú ú-nu-sú-nu šé-ep-IŠTAR i-ra-dí-a-ku-nu-tí
target: Šēp-Ištar leads the copper <gap>, 2 black donkeys, 10 bags plus their harness to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ṣé-er <gap> ma-na ša a-ma-kam i-za-zu-ni <gap> 3 GÚ URUDU KI ma-ma-ḫi-ir ša ku-a-tí <gap> SIG₅ ša e-zi-ba-ku-nu-tí-ni <gap>
target: In addition to <gap> mina which stand there, 3 talents of copper, owed by Man-mahir, that he left with you <gap>

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-ta-ta DUMU ma-num-ba-lúm-a-šùr ù kà-nu-tim DUMU.MÍ en-na-sú-in
target: To Atata, son of Mannum-balum-Assur, and Kannutum, daughter of Ennam-Suen.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB a-na-aḫ-ì-lí DUMU DU₁₀-ṣí-lá-a-šùr
target: Seal of Anah-ili, son of Tab-silli-Assur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 8 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am i-ṣé-er i-ku-mì-šar e-lá-ma i-šu
target: 8 shekels of refined silver Ikūn-Mīšar owes to Elamma.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù a-lim{ki} i tù-a-ri-šu i-ša-qal
target: He will pay when he returns from the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI šu-IŠTAR
target: In the presence of Šu-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB kà-ri-im kà-ni-iš a-na ú-bar-tim ša ku-bu-ur-na-at
target: Seal of the Kanesh colony; to the station at Kuburnat.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB kà-ri-im kà-ni-iš a-na ú-bar-tim ša ku-bu-ur-na-at
target: Let him extradite the man there with our messenger Šēp-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB kà-ri-im kà-ni-iš a-na ú-bar-tim ša ku-bu-ur-na-at
target: And you must be the executive arm for our messenger.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB ú-ra-a-a DUMU ma-na-na KIŠIB {d}MAR.TU-ba-ni DUMU ma-na-na
target: Seal of Uraya son of Manana, seal of Amurrum-bāni son of Manana.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um kà-ni-iš-ki i-dí-ni-a-tí-ma
target: The Kanesh colony gave us for these proceedings.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI GÍR ša a-šùr ší-bu-tí-ni ni-dí-in
target: We gave our testimony before Aššur's dagger.

source: translate Akkadian to English: bu-zu-ta-a ša-li-iš-ni
target: Buzutaya was our third man.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-la-ḫi-im qí-bi-ma um-ma PUZUR₄-a-šur-ma
target: To Ali-ahum from Puzur-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR 5 ma-na URUDU 5 ma-na ni-ga-li ša 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṣí-pá-ra-tim ú a-ni-qí za-áp-ru-tim iš-tí a-li-ki-im pá-ni-im-ma a-na DUMU um-me-a-nim ke-nim dí-in-ma lu-ub-lu-nim
target: Give to a trustworthy affiliated trader 1 mina of silver, 5 minas of copper, 5 minas of sickles, bronze pins worth 5 shekels of silver and -rings - with the first transport, so they may bring it.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-šu-mì ḫa-ra-an sú-qí-nim áš-ta-na-me-ma a-wa-tum dan-na
target: Concerning the Narrow Track I keep hearing that orders are strict.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫi a-ta tí-ir-ta-kà li-li-kam-ma úz-ni pé-té-e
target: My dear brother, send word to inform me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na 2 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ku-nu-ki-a i-na pu-ru-uš-ḫa-dim a-na en-na-nim DUMU a-bi-a e-zi-ib
target: I left 0.5 mina 2 shekels of silver under my seal for Ennānum son of Abiya in Purušhaddum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma en-na-num-ma a-na a-ta-a <gap> na-ni a-dí-in-ma <gap> ki ú-šé-bi-lá-ku-um
target: Ennānum said as follows: I gave <gap> to Ataya and he sent <gap> to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ta-a áš-al-ma um-ma a-na-ku-ma en-na-num KÙ.BABBAR ú-šé-bi₄-lá-kà KÙ.BABBAR dí-nam
target: I questioned Ataya, saying: "Ennānum has sent you with silver. Give me the silver."

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-ta-a-ma a-šar KÙ.BABBAR en-na-num i-dí-na-ni šu-ú-ša-al-šu-um lá-áš-qú-lá-kum
target: Ataya answered: "In case Ennānum has given me any silver I shall pay you three times back."

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI 2 DUMU um-me-a-ni ú-ra-ki-sú
target: I bound him over him with 2 affiliated traders as witnesses.

source: translate Akkadian to English: en-na-nam ṣa-ba-at-ma KÙ.BABBAR ša-áš-qí-il₅-šu-ma a-na pá-ni-a šé-bi₄-lam
target: Seize Ennānum and have him pay the silver and send it to me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma ta-da-gal-ma ḫa-ra-an sú-qí-nim lá wa-šu-ra-at-ma iš-tí ILLAT-tim-ma šé-bi-la-am
target: If you observe that the Narrow Track is not opened up then send it with the caravan itself.

source: translate Akkadian to English: tí-ib-nam ša 2 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša <gap> a pá-ni-a p
target: Close up <gap> with straw worth 2 shekels of silver for me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 TÚG ra-qá-tám SIG₅ a-na en-um-a-šur iš-tù a-lim{ki} i-na e-lá-i-šu a-šur-DU₁₀ ú-šé-lá-a-am
target: Aššur-ṭāb will bring 1 thin textile of fine quality for Ennam-Aššur up here when he comes up from the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI en-um-a-šur DUMU na-ra-am-ZU
target: Witnessed by Ennam-Aššur son of Narām-Suen.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR me-eḫ-ra-tim ša kà-ku-uš al-ma-tim iš-tí a-lu-wa en-um-a-šùr ú-šé-ba-al-šum
target: Ennam-Aššur will send him 3 shekels of silver, the corresponding amount for the -flour of the widow, with Aluwa.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na 0.3333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša qá-tí {d}NIN.ŠUBUR-ba-ni 2 GÍN a-na bi₄-ki-tim ni-il₅-pu-tù
target: From the 0.3333 mina of silver that was Ilabrat-bāni's share we booked 2 shekels for the bewailing.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2.6666 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na GIG a-lu-lu ni-dí-in
target: 2.6666 shekels of silver for wheat we gave to Lullu.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 ki-ra-tim i ša-am-ší bi₄-ki-tim ni-il₅-qé
target: 2 jars of beer we took on the day of the bewailing.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na ša-nim u₄-mì-im 3.25 GÍN a 2 UDU.ḪI.A ni-iš-qúl
target: On the second day we paid 3 1/4 shekels for 2 sheep.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.3333 GÍN 7.5 ŠE a-na e-ṣí
target: 3/8 shekel for firewood.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.25 GÍN a-na qá-nu-e
target: 1/4 shekel for reed.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 15 ŠE a šu-um-ki
target: 1/12 shekel for onions.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 15 ŠE a qá-nu-e ša ki-ra-tim
target: 1/12 shekel for reed for the jars.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2.1666 GÍN a-na UDU e-ri-im
target: 2.1666 shekels for a 'naked' sheep.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 7 ki-ra-tim 0.3333 GÍN 7.5 ŠE ni-is-pì
target: 7 jars of beer we drew, 3/8 shekel.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na ša-nim u₄-mì-im 4 ki-ra-tim ni-is-pì
target: On the second day 4 jars of beer we drew.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR DUMU a-šur-dan ù 1.3333 GÍN a-na lu-lu a-na GIG nu-ra-dí
target: 1 shekel of silver (for) the son of Aššur-dān and 1.3333 shekel for Lullu, for wheat, we added.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 GÍN 15 ŠE a-na 2 ki-ra-tim ni-iš-qúl
target: 7/12 shekel for 2 jars of beer we paid.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na UDU ni-iš-qúl
target: 1 shekel silver we paid for a sheep.

source: translate Akkadian to English: kà-ru-um <gap> dí-nam i-dí-in-ma
target: The colony passed a verdict,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša-lim-a-šùr ù me-er-ú i-dí-a-bi-im i-na ki-dim a-ḫu-um a-na a-ḫi-im da-na-sú i-qá-be
target: stating that Šalim-Aššur and the sons of Iddin-abum will each say binding words to each other outside (the city).

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí 3 u₄-me ma-ma-an GÁN-lam i-na ba-ri-šu-nu ú-lá i-lá-ak
target: Within 3 days no one among them may go away (from here).

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na en-na-ma-nim qí-bi₄-ma um-ma kà-kà-ba-ma
target: To Ennam-Anum from Kakkaba:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam DAM.GÀR-ru ú-ša-am-ṭá-a-ni
target: The merchant belittles me here.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-ša-ša-bi um-ma a-ta-ma a-lá-ak ITU.2.KAM lá a-sà-ḫu-A
target: You said to Ašašabi: I shall go. I shall not delay 2 months.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú-ma-am a-ṣé-er ma-li-a DAM.GÀR sí-ki ú-ṭá-ra-ad
target: Today the merchant detains me from going to Maliya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 ma-na URUDU ša aq-bi₄-ú DUMU zu-ba lá i-dí-nam
target: As for the 10 minas of copper that I promised, Zuba's son has not given it to me;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 ma-na URUDU a-na ṣí-ib-tim É nu-a-e al-qé-ma
target: I have borrowed 10 minas of copper against interest in the house of an Anatolian

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṣú-ḫa-ar-kà ip ta an ú-ma-am ṣú-ḫa-ar-kà ar-ta-na-pu-ud
target: and your servant <gap> Today I am running around (as) your servant.

source: translate Akkadian to English: DINGIR lu i-de₈ ma-ma-an ša en-na-an be-li-ša i-lá-qé-ú
target: The god should know whoever receives her lord's favour.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ší-im 17 ma-na AN.NA 8.5 GÍN.TA 2 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR-áp-šu ša a-dí-da i-dí-na-ni-ma a-na-ku a-na tí-me-el-ki-a a-ṣé-er a-lá-ḫi-im ú-šé-bi-lu-šu
target: I and Ali-ahum settled accounts here concerning the price of 17 minas of tin at the rate 1:8.5 (its value in silver is 2 minas) that Adida gave to me and which I personally sent to Timelkiya to Ali-ahum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam ni-kà-sí a-na-ku ù a-lá-ḫu-um ni-sí-ma
target: I and Ali-ahum settled accounts here.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù ší-im 3 TÚG ku-ta-ni ša bé-ú-lá-at a-šur-kà-ší-id i-dí-na-ni-ma 8 GÍN.TA áš-ku-nu-šu-ni
target: After he gave me the proceeds from 3 kutānu-textiles as Aššur-kāšid's working capital and I set down 8 shekels per piece for him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu ší-im 5 ma-na AN.NA-ki-šu ša iš-tí dan-a-šur <gap> mu-ṭá ù ša <gap> iṣ-ḫi-ir-ma 9 GÍN <gap> lu KÙ.BABBAR 4 GÍN ša a-šu-mì <gap> šu-um-šu ú-ṣa-ḫi-ru
target: Then both the proceeds from his 5 minas of tin that with Dan-Aššur the deficit was deducted and 9 shekels and some 4 shekels of silver that he deducted.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na 7.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am i li-bi a-la-ḫi-im en-nam-a-šùr i-dí-i
target: Ennam-Aššur set down 1 mina 7.5 shekels of refined silver as owed by Ali-ahum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI i-ri-ší-im DUMU a-mur-{d}UTU IGI šu-a-šur <gap> a-šur IGI šu-IŠTAR DUMU šu-ki-tim
target: Witnessed by Erišum son of Amur-Šamaš, by Šu-Aššur son of Aššur, by Šu-Ištar son of Šukkutum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma me-er-ú i-dí-a-bi₄-im-ma a-na ša-lim-a-šùr-ma a-na a-i-tim tù-kà-al-ni-a-tí lá-mì-id-ni-a-tí
target: The sons of Iddin-abum said as follows to Šalim-Aššur: For which things do you detain us? Inform us!

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ša-lim-a-šur-ma 43 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR i-na a-lim{ki} i-na na-ru-qí-a i-na KÙ.BABBAR a-ḫi-e-em i-na pí-i i-sú-rik₁₃ ḫu-bu-ul a-bi-ku-nu áš-qúl
target: Šalim-Aššur answered: "I paid 43 minas of silver in the City from my joint-stock capital out of silver not my own on the order of Issu-arik to cover your father's debt.

source: translate Akkadian to English: qá-ta-tum a-na-ku KÙ.BABBAR ù ṣí-ba-sú ú ṣí-ba-at ṣí-ib-tim a-šé-e-ku-nu
target: I am the guarantor: I sue you for the silver, the interest and the compound interest.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-ni-tim ú-kà-al-ku-nu
target: For these things I detain you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù a-ḫa-ma 8 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR šu-bé-lúm ša i-na ḫa-ḫi-im il₅-qé-ú šu-be-lam₅ we-dí-šu-ma a-šé-e
target: Furthermore, 8 minas of silver, my funds, that Šu-Bēlum took in hahhum, for that I sue Šu-Bēlum alone.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù ṭup-pì-a ša GÁN-lim a-mar-ma KÙ.BABBAR ma-lá ḫu-bu-ul a-bi-ku-nu ú-ša-qí-lu-ú ù ma-lá KÙ.BABBAR-áp a-bi₄-ku-nu al-qé-ú ú-ra-am a-qá-bi-a-ku-nu-tí
target: So, I shall check my tablets that are in Anatolia, and tomorrow I shall tell you how much silver I have paid for your father's debt, and how much silver belonging to your father I have received.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um kà-ni-iš i-dí-ni-a-tí-ma IGI GÍR ša a-šùr ší-bu-tí-ni ni-dí-in
target: The Kanesh colony gave us for these proceedings and we gave our testimony before Aššur's dagger.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI lá-qé-ep DUMU a-šùr-ma-lik IGI a-ba-ta-na-nim DUMU a-šur-{d}UTU-ši IGI en-na-nim DUMU am-ri-a
target: Witnessed by Lā-qēp son of Aššur-malik, by Abatanānum son of Aššur-šamšī, by Ennānum son of Amriya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na 40 GÚ URUDU SIG₅ ša i-dí-a-šur ú-mì-a-ni e-pu-lu ŠÀ.BA 6.6666 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am a-lá-ḫu-um iš-qú-ul-ma
target: Of the 40 talents of good copper about which Iddin-Aššur reached an agreement with the investors, of that Ali-ahum paid 6.6666 minas of refined silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ki-ma šu-ku-bi-im a-ḫi-šu KÙ.BABBAR ì-lí-a il₅-qé
target: and Iliya received the silver on behalf of Šu-Kūbum, his brother.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ṣé-er KÙ.BABBAR a-nim 8.3333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR en-nam-a-šur ú-ra-dí-ma ŠU.NÍGIN KÙ.BABBAR 15 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR
target: In addition to this silver Ennam-Aššur will add 8.3333 minas of silver, so in all there will be 15 minas of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-ni-šu ḫa-ra-nam i-ba-la-kà-at-ma šu-ku-bu-um KÙ.BABBAR-áp-šu uš-ta-ba
target: Twice it will cross over in a caravan and Šu-Kūbum will be satisfied with his silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI MAR.TU-ba-ni DUMU ma-na-na IGI ma-nu-ki-a-šur DUMU ší-mì-be-li IGI a-šur-ma-lik DUMU a-šur-ta-ak-lá-ku DUMU šu-{d}EN.LÍL
target: Witnessed by Amurrum-bāni son of Manana, by Mannum-kī-Aššur son of Šime-bēli, by Aššur-malik son of Aššur-taklāku, (grand)son of Šu-Illil.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-nu-mì a-na ḫa-ḫi-im a-li-ku 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na sà-ḫe-er-tim
target: When I went to hahhum: 5 shekels for small goods,

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na <gap> ù a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi-ma um-ma PÚZUR-a-šùr-ma
target: To <gap> and Ali-ahum from Puzur-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma ú-ku DUMU ṣí-lu-lu a-ma-kam wa-ša-áb <gap> ṭur₄-da-ni-šu
target: If Uku son of Ṣilūlu lives there, send him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: kà-lá ú <gap> KÙ.BABBAR 10 GÍN <gap> lá a-be-el <gap> we-da-ku
target: at least 10 shekels of silver <gap> I am alone

source: translate Akkadian to English: a da-a-ni <gap> a-na en-na-nim pu-nu-a
target: to judges <gap> Approach Ennānum

source: translate Akkadian to English: a da <gap> a-na ṣé-ri-a <gap> ṭur-da-ni-ma KÙ.BABBAR 1 GÍN il₅-qé
target: send <gap> to me, for he received every shekel of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma i-dí-sú-in-ma a-na SIG₅-pì-i-a-šùr ù a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi₄-ma
target: From Iddin-Suen to Damiq-Aššur and Ali-ahum:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí-i na-áš-pè-er-tí ša be-lúm-ba-ni ša té-zi-ba-ni iš-tí-in i-na ba-ri-ku-nu li-li-kam-ma KÙ.BABBAR-áp-ku-nu li-il₅-qé
target: Concerning the missive about Bēlum-bāni that you left me, one of you should come and receive your silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR-áp-ku-nu lá i-ru-aq
target: Your silver should not disappear.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí-i be-lúm-ba-ni a-na-kam lá na-ṭù-ma tí-ir-tí lá e-zi-ib a-na tí-ša-mu-ur-na lá e-tí-iq
target: Concerning Bēlum-bāni it is not appropriate for me to leave instructions here; he will not go overland to Tišmurna.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na SIG₅-pì-i-a-šùr qí-bi₄-ma wa-dí a-wa-tim ša ni-ta-ú-ni ta-am-tí-ší
target: To Damiq-pī-Aššur: Apparently you have forgotten the matter we discussed.

source: translate Akkadian to English: e-et-qám-ma e-et-qám-ma a-šar a-wa-tim i-lá-ku lu né-pu-uš
target: Do come here, come here, so we can do what the situation demands.

source: translate Akkadian to English: <gap> ma-na 12 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR KI be-lúm-ba-ni ŠÀ.BA
target: <gap> mina 12 shekels of silver is owed by Bēlum-bāni.

source: translate Akkadian to English: <gap> GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na <gap> a-dí-in
target: Thereof I gave <gap> shekels of silver to <gap>.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB ú-zu-a KIŠIB i-dí-a-bi-im KIŠIB sú-kà-lim DUMU i-dí-sú-in
target: Seal of Uzua, seal of Iddin-abum, seal of Sukkallum son of Iddin-Suen.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 11.5 ma-na URUDU ší-ku-um i-ṣé-er sú-kà-lim lu-zi i-šu
target: Sukkallum owes 11.5 minas of copper to Luzi.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ITU.KAM áb-ša-ra-ni li-mu-um ku-bi-a
target: Month Ab-šarrāni, eponymy Kūbiya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ki-ma a-wa-at kà-ri-im ṣí-ib-tám ú-ṣa-áb
target: He must add interest in accordance with the rule of the colony.
