target: Šep-Ištar and Šalim-wardi have entrusted 1 kutanum of good quality, 1 kutanum of secondary quality, 1 thin textile, 1 Akkadian textile — under Šalim-Aššur's seal — to Ali-abum and Iddin-Assur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šé-ep-IŠTAR ù ša-lim-wa-ar-dí a-na a-lá-bi₄-im ù i-dí-a-šùr ip-qí-du
target: Šep-Ištar and Šalim-wardi have entrusted 1 kutanum of good quality, 1 kutanum of secondary quality, 1 thin textile, 1 Akkadian textile — under Šalim-Aššur's seal — to Ali-abum and Iddin-Assur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI bu-zu-a IGI DU₁₀-ṣí-lá-a-šùr
target: Witnessed by Buzuwa, by Tab-sill-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-lá-ḫu-um-ma a-na ša-lim-ÌR-dí ù a-lu-wa qí-bi₄-ma
target: From Ali-ahum to Šalim-wardī and Aluwa:

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-šu ša a-na-kam ra-dí-ú e-ta-wu-ú um-ma šu-nu-ma ṣú-ḫa-ru-kà ú-ṭá-tám a-ba-kam lá i-mu-ú
target: Why is it that the guides have been arguing here, saying: Your servants refuse to ship the grain.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša a-lim{ki} wa li ša ta-ḫu-ur-a wa-li-wa-li ḫa-ri-a ša šu-mì-a ÁŠ ta-aq-bi₄-a-šu-nu-tí um-ma a-tù-nu-ma a-na da-áš-e ú-ṭá-tám šu-da-a a-pu-tum iḫ-da-ma ú-ṭá-tám áb-kà-nim
target: Of the City <gap> Waliwali <gap> you (plur.) said to them as follows: "Haul the grain before spring! Urgent! - take care and ship the grain."

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-tí ú-ṭí-tim áb-kà-nim
target: Ship the rest of the grain here.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ba-kam lá a-ba-kam tí-ir-ta-ak-nu li-li-kam lá-li-kam
target: Send me word as to whether it is shipped or not. I shall come.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.3333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša a-na sú-sá-a aḫ-bu-lu
target: The 0.3333 mina of silver that I owed to Susaya,

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ṣé-er 0.3333 ma-na-e-a 0.25 GÍN áb-nam ta-ur
target: after 1 / 4 shekel has been added to the stone of my 0.3333 mina-weight.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na PUZUR₄-a-šur id-na-a ù i-ku-pí-a-šur qí-bi-ma um-ma šu-IŠTAR-ma
target: Say to Puzur-Aššur, Idnāya and Ikūn-pī-Aššur thus Šu-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na id-na-a qí-bi₄-ma 3 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am ḫa-bu-lá-at u₄-mu-kà 12 ḫa-am-ša-tim e-tí-qú
target: Say (in particular) to Idnāya: 3 minas of refined silver you owe (me), your term is 12 weeks overdue.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫi a-ta KÙ.BABBAR ú ṣi-ba-sú šu-qú-ul-ma a-na té-er-tí-a li-dí-nu
target: Please, my brother, pay the silver and its interest and let them give it to where I will instruct.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ša ki-ma i-a-tí qí-bi₄-ma i-ḫi-da-ma KÙ.BABBAR ú ṣi-ba-sú ša-áš-qí-lá-šu-ma a-na té-er-tí-a pá-ni-a
target: Say to my representatives: 'Take care to to make him pay the silver and the interest on it and transfer it to where I will instruct'.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ma-ma-ḫi-ir-ma a-na ba-zi-a šu-ḫu-bur ku-ul-ma-ku-ul-ma ú PUZUR₄.IŠTAR qí-bi₄-ma
target: From Man-mahir to Baziya, Šu-hubur, Kulma-kulma and Puzur-Ištar:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ku-nu-ki-a ša en-um-a-šur DUMU šál-ma-a-šur ub-lá-ku-nu-tí-ni a-ḫu-ú-a a-tù-nu i-zi-za-ma pì-ri-kà-ni dam-qú-tim ša-ma-ni-ma iš-tí a-li-ki pá-ni-im-ma šé-bi₄-lá-nim
target: As to the 3 minas of silver under my seal that Ennam-Aššur son of Šalim-Aššur brought to you, my dear brothers, stand up and buy good for me and send them with the very first transport.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ANŠE É tam-kà-ri-im sí-sí-a-nim i-na sí-sí-kà-at pì-ri-kà-ni šu-mì tám-kà-ri-im wa-dí-a
target: Ask for a donkey at a merchant's house. Indicate the name of the merchant on the hem of the .

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫu-a a-tù-nu i-iḫ-da-ma iš-tí a-li-ki-im pá-ni-im-ma áb-kà-nim
target: My dear brothers, take care to ship it with the very first transport.

source: translate Akkadian to English: e-zi-ib ša ṭup-pì-šu ḫa-ar-mì-im 1.6666 ma-na 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i-na li-bi ku-tí-bi-iš a-ḫa-ma
target: Apart from (what is mentioned in) his certified tablet Kutibiš owes 1.6666 mina 5 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na URUDU SIG₅ ša ša-du-we-šu a-na a-lu-a-ri-im ki-ra-nim ṭá-bi-im ša ma-ma-a a-na PUZUR₄-a-mu-ri-im DUMU ni-mar-IŠTAR a-ḫa-ma a-dí-in-šu
target: I furthermore gave 1 mina of good, native copper for an allu'āru-container of sweet wine from Mamma to Puzur-Amurrum son of Nimar-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB be-lá-nim DUMU šu-ku-bi-im KIŠIB a-gu₅-a DUMU dan-na-a-šur KIŠIB ú-ṣú-ur-ša-IŠTAR DUMU da-da-a
target: Seal of Belanum, son of Su-Kubum, seal of Agua, son of Dan-Assur, seal of Usur-sa-Istar, son of Dadaya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am i-ṣé-er bé-lá-nim DUMU šu-ku-bi-im ku-li-a DUMU a-lá-bi-im i-šu
target: 1 mina of refined silver Belanum, son of Su-Kubum, owes to Kulia, son of Ali-abum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ša-na-at ù 6 ITU.KAM KÙ.BABBAR i-ša-qal
target: He will pay within one year and six months.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma i-na ú-me-šu ma-al-ú-tim KÙ.BABBAR bé-lá-num lá iš-qú-ul ki-ma a-wa-at kà-ri-im 1.5 GÍN.TA a-na ma-na-im ṣí-ib-tám a-na ur-ḫi-im ú-ṣa-áb
target: If Belanum does not pay when his term is due in conformity with the rule of the karum he will add 1.5 shekel of interest per mina per month.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ITU.1.KAM áb-ša-ra-ni li-mu-um i-dí-sú-in DUMU i-dí-a-bi-im
target: Month V, eponymy of Iddin-Suen, son of Iddin-abum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB i-ku-pí-a DUMU pí-lá-aḫ-IŠTAR KIŠIB ili₅-ba-ni DUMU mu-ta-lim KIŠIB a-šur-SIPA DUMU ú-ṣú-ra-nim
target: Seal of Ikuppiya, son of Pilah-Istar, seal of Ili-bani, son of Mutalum, seal of Assur-re'i, son of Usuranum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 8 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am i-ṣé-er i-ku-pí-a DUMU pí-lá-aḫ-IŠTAR ku-li-a DUMU a-lá-bi-im i-šu-ú
target: 8 shekels of refined silver Ikuppiya, son of Pilah-Istar, owes to Kuliya, son of Ali-abum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na 6 ur-ḫé KÙ.BABBAR i-ša-qal
target: He will pay within 6 months.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma lá iš-qú-ul ki-ma a-wa-at kà-ri-im ṣí-ib-tám ú-ṣa-áb
target: If he does not pay he will add interest in conformity with the rule of the karum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR be-ú-lá-at ku-li-a DUMU a-lá-bi-im i-na-sú-in DUMU za-ar-ni-qí-im ú-ka-al iš-tí KÙ.BABBAR uk-ta-al
target: 10 shekels of refined silver, a loan belonging to Kuliya, son of Ali-abum, Ennam-Suen, son of Zarniqum holds; he is held by the silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma šu-ma a-e-ma ú-dá-pí-ir
target: If he goes away to somebody else, he will hire someone in his place and he will compensate the wages of the hireling.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ì-lí-ba-ni ù ku-li-a qí-bi-ma um-ma a-šùr-e-nam-ma
target: To Ilī-bāni and Kuliya, say, this is what Aššur-ennam says:

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na ša-lá-tí-wa-ar 0.8333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ku-nu-ki-šu ku-li-a i-dí-nam-ma
target: In Šalatiwar Kuliya gave me 0.8333 mina of silver under his seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na wa-aḫ-šu-ša-na a-na ṣé-ri-kà ub-lam-ma um-ma a-na-ku-ma
target: I brought it to Wahšušana to you and I said:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma KÙ.BABBAR i-na ku-nu-ki ša ku-li-a áp-qí-da-ku-um
target: Herewith I entrust to you the silver under the seals of Kuliya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ša a-šu-mì ku-li-a ša-du-a-tám kà-ra-am ta-pu-lu
target: It is the silver you promised to pay the as -tax on behalf of Kuliya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-ta-ma ke-na a-pu-ul
target: You said: "Yes, I promised it."

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR IGI a-šùr-lá-ma-sí DUMU a-šur-ma-lik ú šu-iš-ḫa-ra DUMU e-na-sú-in li-me-e ri-ik-sà-am áp-qí-da-kum
target: In the presence of Aššur-lamassī, son of Aššur-mālik and of Šu-Išhara, son of Ennam-Suen, I entrusted the packet to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-nam a-na É a-bi₄-a al-qé-ma a-ḫu-kà i-tù-ra-am
target: What did my paternal house that your brother came back on me?

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na al tí-im-ni-e ta-am-ḫu-ri-ma IGI e-na-sú-in DUMU i-sú-rik₁₃ ù IGI ú-zu-a DUMU ku-ku-lá-nim ta-áš-e-li-ma um-ma a-ta-ma
target: In Al-Timniyē you approached me and in the presence of Ennam-Suen, son of Issūrik, and of Uzua, son of Kukkulānum, you interrogated me, saying:

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-nu-mì KÙ.BABBAR ku-nu-ki ša a-ḫi-a tù-šé-bi₄-lá-ni ma-num li-mu-um
target: "When you had me bring the silver with my brother's seals, who was then ?"

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-na-ku-ma a-šùr-lá-ma-sí ú šu-iš-ḫa-ra li-mu-ú ù ma-aḫ-ri-šu-nu-ma KÙ.BABBAR áp-qí-da-kum
target: I answered: "Aššur-lamassī and Šu-Išhara were the, and it was in their presence that I entrusted you the silver."

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú-ṣur-ša-IŠTAR DUMU da-da-a i-na né-eḫ-ri-a aṣ-ba-at-ma 1 ma-na ší-a-ma-tí-šu a-na 4 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR i-tù-ur-šu-ma a-wa-at-ni
target: I seized Uṣur-ša-Ištar, son of Dadaya, in Nehriya and merchandise of his worth 1 mina had become 4 minas of silver for him and so our affair was .

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na pì-lá-aḫ-IŠTAR qí-bi₄-ma um-ma um-mì-iš-ḫa-ra-ma
target: Say to Pilah-Ištar, thus Ummī-Išhara:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-šu-mì li-ba-kà lam-nu-ma tù-ṣú-ú-ni
target: As for the fact that you left in anger

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša KÙ.BABBAR 10 GÍN i-na qá-tí-a lá i-šu-ú-ma lá tí-<gap> ú i-a-ú-um li-bi₄-i e-mu-ú-ma iš-tí-kà lá a-ta-wu-ú
target: and that I did not even have 10 shekels of silver available, so that you? and that my feeling too ran high and I did not exchange a word with you

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫi a-ta li-ba-kà lá tù-lá-ma-an a-lá-nu-kà a-ḫa-am ša-ni-a-am ú-lá i-šu
target: please, my brother, don't stay angry, you are the only brother I have!

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na pa-ni-tí-ma ḫa-ra-ni-tim 2 TÚG.ḪI.A SIG₅-tim a-na lí-ta-áb-ší-kà ú-šé-ba-lá-kum
target: With the next caravan I will send you two fine garments for your personal wear.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR 1 ma-na ša ší-im er-dí-im ša a-dí-nu a-lá-qé-ma AN.NA a-ša-am-ma ù-šé-ba-lá-kum
target: As for the 1 mina of silver, the price of the slave, whom I sold, if I collect it I will buy tin and send it to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ma li-ba-kà lá <gap> DINGIR-šu ú-na-zu-mu <gap>-a-<gap> i da <gap> šu <gap> ú ni-a-am li-ba-am ḫa-dí
target: Do by no means worry. and make us too happy!

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na i-ku-pí-a a-bu-a e-ri-ší-im ku-da-tim šu-IŠTAR ù en-na-sú-in qí-bi-ma um-ma en-um-a-šur-ma
target: To Ikūn-pīya, Abuwa, Erišum, Kudātum, Šu-Ištar and Enna-Suen from Ennam-Aššur;

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na en-na-sú-in qí-bi-ma a-šùr ù i-lá-a-bi-ni lu i-dí-a-kà a-na ša i-ir-tí a-bi-a a-na pá-ra-sí-a ta-zi-zi-ni
target: specifically to Enna-Suen: May Aššur and the god of our fathers reject you, since you stood ready to separate me from my father's breast!

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am iš-tù ITU.KAM ša ke-na-tim li-mì-im a-šur-na-da DUMU PUZUR₄-a-na ḫa-bu-lá-tí-ma ṭup-pá-kà ḫa-ar-ma-am ú-kà-al
target: You have owed 4 minas of refined silver since the month Ša-kēnātim, in the eponymy Aššur-nādā son of Puzur-Anna and I hold your certified tablet.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na 20 ḫa-am-ša-tim KÙ.BABBAR ša-qá-lam qá-bi-a-tí
target: You promised to pay the silver in 20 weeks.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.5 GÍN.TA i-na ITU.1.KAM-im a-na 1 ma-na-im ṣí-ib-tám tù-ṣa-ba-am
target: You will have to pay interest at the rate 1.5 shekel per month per mina.

source: translate Akkadian to English: u₄-mu-kà MU.4.ŠÈ e-tí-qú KÙ.BABBAR i-té-zi-ba-am
target: Your terms are exceeded by 4 years.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫa-ma a-na 1 ma-na-im KÙ.BABBAR ša i li-bi-kà iz-ku-ú iš-tù ITU.KAM ša sá-ra-tim li-mì-im <gap> 1.5 GÍN.TA i-na ITU.1.KAM tù-ṣa-ba-am
target: Further, for every mina of silver that they have cleared as owed by you - reckoned from the month Ša-sarrātim, eponymy <gap> you must pay interest at the rate 1.5 shekel per month.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam ṭup-pá-am ša 5 um-me-a-ni <gap> ú-kà-al
target: Here I hold a tablet of 5 investors <gap>.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na-um <gap> a-na 3.3333 ma-na i-<gap>-kum ú 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ma-na-aḫ-tám ta-ša-qá-lam e-zi-ib
target: per one mina <gap> 3.3333 mina <gap> and you must pay 0.5 mina of silver as expenditures; apart from <gap> minas of silver from Ikūnum's son and my available goods for which I sue him, say to my representatives: Seize him for all this silver and have him seal the silver and the accrued interest and send it (the resulting document) to me and to his representatives, so his representatives here may pay me the silver and the accrued interest; then I shall give his deed to his representatives.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša-al-ṭá-tí-a ša a-šé-e-ú-šu a-na ša ki-ma i-a-tí qí-bi-ma a-na mì-ma KÙ
target: To my representatives: My dear brothers, if Enna-Suen answers you <gap> send me his answer soon and let him travel here.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma i-ku-pí-a-ma a-na en-nam-a-šur lá-qé-pí-im <gap> a-na-a-na ù šu-<gap> qí-bi-ma
target: From Ikūn-piya to Ennam-Aššur, Lā-qēp, <gap> Anna-anna and Šu-<gap>:

source: translate Akkadian to English: <gap> AN.NA <gap> šu-ma <gap> AN.NA <gap> i-<gap> KÙ.BABBAR ša a-dí-<gap> 20 ma-na AN.NA ša-a-ma-nim ù 40 ma-na AN.NA ša li-bi-kà ra-dí-ma iš-té-ni-iš 1 GÚ AN.NA šé-bi-lam
target: buy 20 minas of tin for me and add 40 minas of tin in your possession and in all send me 1 talent of tin.

source: translate Akkadian to English: AN.NA lu ù <gap> 40 ma-na AN.NA ša li-bi-kà en-nam-a-šur li-ik-nu-uk
target: The tin should <gap> Ennam-Aššur should seal the 40 minas of tin in your possession.

source: translate Akkadian to English: AN.NA ša a-tù-nu ta-ša-a-ma-ni a-tù-nu iš-tí-šu ku-un-kà
target: The tin that you purchase yourselves, you personally must seal it together with him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ší-tí KÙ.BABBAR-pí-a TÚG.ḪI.A ša ta-al-ḫa-at ša-ma-nim
target: Buy textiles from Talhat for the rest of my silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma ša ta-al-ḫa-at lá-šu ší-ma-am ša ba-lá-ṭí-a ša-ma-nim
target: If there are none from Talhat, then make a profitable purchase for me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫu-ú-a a-tù-nu iḫ-da-ma {d}IM-pí-lá-aḫ ṭur₄-da-nim
target: My dear brothers, take care to send me Adad-pilah.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na en-nam-a-šur qí-bi-ma a-na ša ú-na-ḫi-du a-ḫi a-ta i-ḫi-id-ma ṣú-ḫa-ri ṭur₄-dam
target: To Ennam-Aššur: Pay heed to what I instructed you to do, my dear brother, and send my servant.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB a-ku-za DUMU šu-a-nim KIŠIB lá-qé-ep DUMU {d}AB-ba-ni KIŠIB ṣí-lu-lu DUMU ú-ku
target: Sealed by Akuza son of Šu-Anum, by Lā-qēp son of Illil-bāni, by Ṣilūlu son of Uku.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um kà-né-eš i-dí-ni-a-tí-ma
target: The Kanesh colony gave us for these proceedings.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI GÍR ša a-šùr i-na ba-áb DINGIR ṭup-pá-am ni-dí-in
target: We gave a tablet before Aššur's dagger in the Gate of the God.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ku-zi-a-ma a-na en-nam-a-šur qí-bi-ma
target: From Kuziya to Ennam-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: URUDU ku-nu-ki ša šu-zu-zu ni-ip-ṭù-ur
target: We broke open the copper sealed by Šu-Zuzu.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 51.5 ma-na URUDU SIG₅ ni-is-ni-iq-ma
target: We checked (the copper): 51.5 minas of good copper,

source: translate Akkadian to English: URUDU SIG₅ ku-nu-ki-kà ni-ip-ṭù-ur-ma 46 ma-na ni-is-ni-iq
target: and we broke open the good copper under your seal and checked 46 minas;

source: translate Akkadian to English: URUDU lá-mu-nam 37 ma-na ni-is-ni-iq
target: as for the bad copper we checked it (and found) 37 minas -

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠU.NÍGIN URUDU-i-kà lu SIG₅ lu lá-mu-num 2 GÚ 14.5 ma-na
target: total of your copper, both good and bad: 2 talents 14.5 minas;

source: translate Akkadian to English: ku-nu-ki-a ša-lim-wa-ar-dí na-áš-a-kum
target: Šalim-wardī brings that to you under my seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: SÍG.ḪI.A lu gám-ru-ma lu ni-is-ḫa-tum lu mu-ṭá-ú 4 GÚ LÁ 5 ma-na iz-ku-a-am
target: The wool - both expenses, import duty and deficit - has been cleared as 4 talents less 5 minas.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pí ku-nu-ki-kà na-áš-ú-ni-kum
target: They bring you my tablet with your seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am iš-tí a-šùr-na-da DUMU er-nu-id iš-tù a-lim{ki} i tù-a-ri-šu i-ša-qal šu-ma lá iš-qúl 1.5 GÍN.TA i ITU.KAM a-na ma-na-im ú-ṣa-áb
target: 1.5 mina of refined silver due from Aššur-nādā, son of Ernu'id; when he returns from the City he will pay; if he does not pay he will add 1.5 shekel per month per mina (as interest).

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.6666 ma-na LÁ 1 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ù me-nu-ni-a-nam KI nu-a-im a-na ITU.1.KAM i-ša-qal
target: 39 shekels of silver and a -textile due from the native; he will pay within one month.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pu-um i-ṣé-er a-šùr-ta-ak-lá-ku e-lá-ma i-šu iš-tù ḫa-muš-tim ša en-na-ma-nim 1.5 GÍN.TA i ITU.1.KAM a-na ma-na-im ú-ṣa-áb ṭup-pu-šu a-na-kam i-ba-ší
target: 2.5 minas of refined silver Aššur-taklāku owes to Elamma; from the week of Ennamānum he will add 1.5 shekel per month per mina; his tablet is here.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-im 2 TÚG.ḪI.A 0.3333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pu-um iš-tí a-mur-a-šùr DUMU ili₅-ba-ni
target: The price of 2 textiles, 0.3333 mina of refined silver, is with Amur-Aššur, son of Ilī-bāni.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 ma-ku-ḫu KI i-dí-a-šùr
target: 4 -textiles with Iddin-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR KI en-na-nim áš-li-kim
target: 4.5 shekels of silver with Ennānum, the fuller.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 15 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ù ku-sí-tám ma-al-ku-a-i-tám a-na ṣí-lá-{d}IŠKUR a-na TÚG.ḪI.A ša-a-mì-im a-dí-in ŠÀ.BA 1 TÚG ú-šé-bi₄-lam
target: 15 shekels of silver and a robe in the style of Malkua I gave to Ṣilli-Adad to buy textiles; thereof he sent me 1 textile.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4.25 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša a-wi-il₅-tim a-na da-a-a a-dí-in
target: 4 1 / 4 shekels of silver of the lady I gave to Dāya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.3333 ma-na 4 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am a-na en-um-a-šur DUMU ú-zu-a a-na ta-ad-mì-iq-tim a-dí-in
target: 24 shekels of refined silver I gave to Ennam-Aššur, son of Uzua, as a free loan.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR iš-tù bu-ru-uš-ḫa-tim i-na
target: 0.5 mina of silver Aššur-nādā will pay when the returns from Burušhattum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma i-na-a-ma a-na a-šur-DU₁₀ ú MAN-a-šur qí-bi-ma
target: From Innaya to Aššur-ṭāb and Puzur-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam ru-ba-um ù ru-ba-tum a-na ḫa-ra-na-tim ša pá-zu-ur-tim iš-pu-ru-ma um-ma šu-nu-ma
target: The king and queen here have written to the road-guards concerning smuggling, saying:

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša i ma-tim TÚG.ḪI.A ù AN.NA na-áš-ú ma ta-ma ra ni ṣa-áb-ta-ma AN.NA ú TÚG.ḪI.A a-tù-nu kà-i-lá-ma ra-ga am i-a-tí ri-id-a-am
target: Seize anyone you observe carrying textiles and tin in the land, and then withhold the tin and textiles and lead the criminal to me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú a-na ša ḫa-ra-an sú-ki-nim iš-ta-áp-ru
target: Also, they have written to the Narrow Track.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-pu-tum AN.NA ù TÚG.ḪI.A lá tù-pá-za-ra ú a-na ḫa-ra-an sú-ki-nim mì-ma lá ta-ša-kà-na
target: Urgent, do not smuggle tin and textiles and do not commit anything to the Narrow Track.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-pu-tum a-wa-tum da-na-at
target: Urgent, the orders are strict.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ma e šé-bi₄-lá-ma li-ba-ak-nu e im-ra-aṣ
target: Do not send anything lest you be sorry.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pá-am ší-ta-me-šu-ma a-na a-šur-DU₁₀ šé-bi₄-il₅-šu
target: Let him hear the letter and send it to Aššur-ṭāb.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB en-na-sú-in DUMU i-dí-a-bi-im KIŠIB a-šur-ta-ak-lá-ku DUMU i-ku-nim KIŠIB pí-lá-aḫ-IŠTAR DUMU a-šur-SIPA
target: Seal of Enna-Suen son of Iddin-abum, seal of Aššur-taklāku son of Ikūnum, seal of Pilah-Ištar son of Aššur-rēʾī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 6.8333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am i-ṣé-er pí-lá-aḫ-IŠTAR DUMU a-šur-SIPA DAM.GÀR i-šu-ú
target: Pilah-Ištar son of Aššur-rēʾī owes 6.8333 minas of refined silver to the merchant.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù ḫa-mu-uš-tim ša en-na-sú-in DUMU ku-ra-ra a-na 7 ḫa-am-ša-tim KÙ.BABBAR i-ša-qal
target: Reckoned from the week of Enna-Suen son of Kurara he will pay back the silver in 7 weeks.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma i-na ma-lá u₄-me-šu KÙ.BABBAR lá iš-qú-ul 1.5 GÍN.TA i-na ITU.1.KAM a-na 1 ma-na-im ṣí-ib-tám ú-ṣa-áb
target: If he has not paid back at the completion of his term, he will add interest at the rate 1.5 shekel per month per mina.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ITU.1.KAM áb-ša-ra-ni li-mu-um šu-sú-in DUMU ba-bi-lim
target: Month Ab-šarrāni, in the eponymy Šu-Suen son of Babilum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na šu-IŠTAR DUMU ma-li-ki-il₅-šu áš-qúl
target: I paid 3 shekels of silver to Šu-Ištar son of Malik-ilišu.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na a-lá-ni ša-ar-ša-ra-ni áš-qú-ul-ma a-na mu-za a-dí-in
target: I paid 2.5 shekels of silver for a -measure of acorns and gave them to Muza.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ší-im 2 iš-ra-tim a-na a-šur-ma-lik DUMU lu-zi-na
target: 2 shekels of silver, the price of 2 belts for Aššur-malik son of Luzina.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ma a-nim a-šu-mì ku-da-tim ú-ša-qí-il₅
target: All this I paid on behalf of Kudātum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma a-ší-it ša-al-ma-at <gap>
target: If Ašet is safe <gap>

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú-ṣa-áb ITU.KAM qá-ra-a-tim li-mu-um bu-zu-zu 20 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR i da-na-ma qá-tí a-ša-kà-an
target: Month Qarra'ātum, eponymy Buzuzu. He will give me 20 minas of silver and I shall lay claim to that.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-šur-GAL IGI a-šur-{d}UTU-ši IGI pí-lá-aḫ-a-šur
target: Witnessed by Aššur-rabi, by Aššur-šamšī, by Pilah-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pu-um iš-tí PUZUR₄-a-na ni-a-im iš-tù-i-ša-qal
target: 10 minas of refined silver is owed by our own Puzur-Anna.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ḫa-mu-uš-tim ša a-šur-ta-ak-lá-ku ù kà-sí-a a-na 30 ḫa-am-ša-tim šu-ma lá iš-qúl
target: Reckoned from the week of Aššur-taklāku and Kasiya he is to pay in 30 weeks. If he has not paid (in time),

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 GÍN.TA i-na ITU.KAM a-na 1 ma-na-im ṣí-ib-tám ú-ṣa-áb
target: he will add interest at the rate 1.5 shekel per month per mina.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ITU.KAM té-i-na-tim li-mu-um a-mur-a-šur IGI PUZUR₄-{d}IM DUMU i-dí-IŠTAR IGI du-um-qá-a DUMU kur-ub-a-a
target: Month Te'inātum, eponymy Amur-Aššur son of Karriya. Witnessed by Puzur-Adad son of Iddin-Ištar, by Dumqaya son of Kurub-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.8333 ma-na 6.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša sú-ḫu-ur-pì-a-lá a-na sú-e-ta-ta ḫa-bu-lu KÙ.BABBAR a-al-DU₁₀ iš-qú-ul
target: 56.5 shekels of silver, which Suhurpiyala owes to Suettata, that silver Āl-ṭāb has paid.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-al-DU₁₀ i-lá-ak-ma né-mu-lu-um i-ta-áb-ší i-né-mì-li-im i-lá-qé
target: Suhurpiyala will make a business trip and if there is profit, he will take it (the silver) from the profit.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma né-mu-lu-um lá-šu KÙ.BABBAR ù ṣí-ba-sú a-li-a ù ḫa-ar-ša a-na a-al-DU₁₀ i-ša-qú-lu
target: If there is no profit Aliya and harša will pay the silver and the interest on it to Āl-ṭāb.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI ší-il₅-ma-šu IGI šu-pu-nu-ma-an
target: In the presence of Šilmašu, of Šuppunuman.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4.3333 ma-na 4 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ù 3.3333 GÍN KÙ.GI i-ší-im TÚG-ba-tí-a iš-tù wa-aḫ-šu-ša-na ub-lu-nim
target: They brought me 4.3333 minas 4 shekels of silver and 3.3333 shekels of gold, the proceeds from my textiles, from Wahšušana.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṣú-ḫa-ru-ú a-sà-nim ša É ás-qú-dim ú pì-lá-aḫ-IŠTAR DUMU e-lá-ma ḫa-ra-nam iš-té-ni-iš i-li-ku-nim-ma i-na ḫu-ra-ma a-na É ku-bi-a iš-té-ni-iš e-ru-bu-ma
target: The servants of Asānum, who belongs to the house of Asqūdum, and Pilah-Ištar, son of Elamma, together went on a business trip and in hurama they together entered Kubiya's house.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ni-is-ḫa-tí-šu-nu É.GAL-lúm iš-té-ni-iš i-sú-ùḫ
target: The palace levied the import-tax from them together.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na wa-ar-ki-tim lu-qú-tum i-ṣí-bi-it-ma lu-qú-tám ša a-sà-nim É.GAL-lúm i-ta-ba-al
target: Afterwards merchandise was seized and the palace took away Asānum's merchandise.

source: translate Akkadian to English: AN.NA ša pí-lá-aḫ-IŠTAR É ku-bi-a ú-pá-zi-ru-ma i-na É ub-ri iš-lim-ma
target: The tin that Pilah-Ištar had hidden in Kubiya's house, was saved in the lodging.

source: translate Akkadian to English: be-lá-num i-li-kam-ma ki-ma pí-lá-aḫ-IŠTAR im-ṣí-ma AN.NA il₅-qé
target: When Belānum came he claimed the right to take the tin in Pilah-Ištar's name.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ku-bi₄-ma a-na bé-lá-nim DUMU šu-a-šur AN.NA ip-qí-id
target: Kubiya entrusted the tin to Bēlānum, the son of Šu-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma bé-lá-num-ma ma-ṣa-ku
target: Bēlānum declared: I take the responsibility!

source: translate Akkadian to English: a ma-lá ṭup-pí-im ša a-lim{ki} kà-ru-um ḫu-ra-ma ṣa-ḫe-er GAL i-dí-ni-a-tí-ma IGI GÍR ša a-šur ší-bu-tí-ni ni-dí-in
target: In accordance with the tablet of the City the plenary hurama colony made us available and we gave our testimony before Aššur's dagger.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-šur-ša-du-ì-lí IGI ir-ma-a-šur DUMU a-šur-ma-lik IGI a-bu-ša-lim DUMU šu-IŠTAR
target: Witnessed by Aššur-šadu-ilī, by Ir'am-Aššur, son of Aššūr-mālik, and by Abu-šalim, son of Šu-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠU.NÍGIN 2 ma-na 15.6666 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am i-nu-mì a-na ḫa-ḫi-im a-li-ku i-na ni-kà-sí a-šur-GAL iš-ku-nam-ma um-ma a-na-ku-ma
target: In all: 2 minas 15.6666 shekels of refined silver Aššur-rabi put down at the accounting when I went to hahhum, and I said:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2.6666 ma-na 4 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am i-ṣé-er ša-lim-a-ḫi-im ù šu-sú-in en-na-sú-in i-šu
target: A debt of 2 minas 44 shekels of refined silver Šalim-ahum and Šu-Suen owe to Ennam-Suen.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù SAG ITU.KAM ša ki-na-tim li-mu-um ša qá-té ì-lí-dan a-na ITU.KAM i-ša-qú-lu
target: From the beginning of month III, eponymy of the successor of Ilī-dān, they will pay in a month.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma lá iš-qú-lu 1.5 GÍN.TA a-na 1 ma-na-im i-na ITU.KAM ṣí-ib-tám ú-ṣú-bu
target: If they fail to pay they will add 1.5 shekel per mina per month as interest.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI IŠTAR.DINGIR-šu DUMU a-šur-ba-ni IGI a-da DUMU e-na-a-šur
target: In the presence of Ištar-ilšu, son of Aššur-bāni, of Ada, son of Ennam-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na e-lá-ma qí-bi-ma um-ma IŠTAR-pì-lá-aḫ-ma
target: Say to Elamma, thus Ištar-pilah:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 ma-na AN.NA ḫi-na-a i-na <gap> ú-kà-al-ma lá i-pá-ṭù-ru-nim li-bu-šu lá i-lá-mì-in
target: hinnāya holds 3 minas of tin and one must not open (the packet) lest he gets angry.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR 1.5 ma-na i-ḫi-id-ma šé-bi₄-lam
target: Take care to send me 1.5 mina of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lá ša áš-pu-ra-ku-ni um-ma ḫi-na-a-ma té-er-ta-kà li-li-kam-ma ú-šé-ba-la-am
target: That I did not write you (earlier) is because hinnāya said: 'If a message of yours arrives I will send it to you.'

source: translate Akkadian to English: áš-pu-ur-ma KÙ.BABBAR lá tù-ḫa-li-iq i-ḫi-id-ma KÙ.BABBAR šé-bi₄-lam
target: (But now) I wrote: 'Do not let the silver get lost, take care to send me the silver!'

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR 1 GÍN li-li-am
target: May at least some silver be produced!

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR lá KÙ.BABBAR-áp-šu šu-ut-ma KÙ.BABBAR i-dí-sú-in
target: The silver is not his silver, it is the silver of Iddin-Suen!

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-IŠTAR-ma a-na šu-ma-li-ib-ší Ì-lí-a-lim ù a-mur-IŠTAR qí-bi-ma
target: From Šu-Ištar to Šuma-libši, Ilī-ālum and Amur-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na šu-ma-li-ib-ší ù Ì-lí-a-lim qí-bi-ma
target: Specifically to Šuma-libši and Ilī-ālum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 14 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am ḫa-bu-lá-tù-nu
target: You owe 14 shekels of refined silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pá-ak-nu ḫa-ar-ma-am ú-kà-al
target: I hold your certified tablet.

source: translate Akkadian to English: u₄-mu-ku-nu ša-na-at e-tí-qú
target: Your terms are overdue by a year.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR i qá-qá-ad šál-mì-ku-nu ù ke-ni-ku-nu ra-ki-is
target: The silver (loan) was with joint liability.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR KÙ.BABBAR-áp tám-kà-ri-im a-ma-kam
target: The silver was merchant-silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ù ṣí-ba-sú a-na a-mur-IŠTAR šu-qú-ul
target: Pay the silver and its interest there to Amur-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-mur-IŠTAR qí-bi₄-ma a-pu-tum i-ḫi-id
target: To Amur-Ištar: Urgent, pay attention.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ú ṣí-ba-sú ša-áš-qí-il₅
target: Have the silver and its interest paid.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.6666 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ku-nu-ki-a a-na aḫ-ša-lim
target: 1.6666 mina of silver under my seal for Ah-šalim.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ku-nu-ki-a a-na i-dí-a-šur
target: 0.5 mina of silver under my seal for Iddin-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša 24 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR i-dí-a-bu-um a-na a-šùr-be-el-a-wa-tim ḫa-bu-lu
target: Concerning the fact that Iddin-abum owes 24 minas of silver to Aššur-bēl-awātim:

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ku-bu-um me-ra-šu É-tí ša ša-lim-a-šùr wa-áš-bu ik-nu-uk-ma am-tám ù ÌR-dí ú-šé-ṣí-ma
target: his son Šu-Kūbum has sealed the houses where Šalim-Aššur lives and taken out the maid and the slaves;

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na a-mu-tim ša É a-lim{ki} ša-lim-a-šur i-sí-ú-ma iš-tí i-dí-a-šùr DUMU a-šùr-ma-lik ad-mu-ma a-na kà-ni-iš ú-šé-bi₄-lu-ni-ni
target: but out of the iron that Šalim-Aššur claimed at the City Hall and invested in Iddin-Aššur son of Aššur-malik, and which they brought to Kanesh,

source: translate Akkadian to English: qá-tám ša ša-lim-a-šur šu-ku-bu-um DUMU a-šùr-be-el-a-wa-tim a-na ḫu-bu-ul i-dí-a-bi-im il₅-qé-ma
target: Šu-Kūbum son of Aššur-bēl-awātim has taken Šalim-Aššur's share to cover Iddin-abum's debt,

source: translate Akkadian to English: É-tí am-tám ù ÌR-dí-e a-na ša ki-ma ša-lim-a-šùr ú-wa-šé-er
target: and he will release the houses, the maid and the slaves to Šalim-Aššur's representatives.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um kà-ni-iš i-dí-ni-a-tí-ma
target: The Kanesh colony has given us for these proceedings

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-bu-tí-ni IGI GÍR ša a-šùr ni-dí-in
target: and we gave our testimony before the dagger of Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-ku-za IGI MAR.TU-ba-ni IGI lá-qé-pì-im
target: Witnessed by Akuza, by Amurrum-bāni, by Lā-qēpum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-tur₄-DINGIR DUMU a-mur-IŠTAR tap-pá-i-ni
target: Itūr-ilī son of Amur-Ištar was our (absent) partner.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-šùr-ša-dí-li-ma a-na ku-li-a ù a-šur-la-ma-sí a-na ku-li-a qí-bi-ma
target: Thus says Aššur-šad-ilī to Kuliya and Aššur-lamassī and in particular to Kuliya:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-šu-mì a-wa-tim ša É sà-ba-sí-a a-wu-tum ša ma-aḫ-ri-kà lá iz-ku-ú lu-qú-ut-kà ša i-na a-pí-im té-zi-bu-ma lá-ta-ra-ak iṣ-ba-at
target: Because of the affair of Sabasiya's house, the case that was not settled in your presence, Latarāk has seized your merchandise that you had left behind in Apum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: áš-me-ma ṭup-pá-am ša ší-bu-tim ú ší-ip-ra-am al-qé-ma a-na a-pí-im i-li-ik-ma lu-qú-tám ú-ší-ir-ma a-bi-we-du-um i-ra-dí-a-ku-um
target: When I heard it I availed myself of a tablet of the Elders and a messenger who went to Apum and obtained the release of the merchandise and Abī-wēdum is now leading that to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: be-et-kà URUDU KÙ.GI ú-ṣú-ra-num ta-da-nam lá i-mu-a um-ma šu-ut-ma ša-qú-ul
target: As for your house, Uṣurānum refuses to give either copper or gold saying: All has already been payed.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ba-pí-ra-am ša ša-ku-ul-tim ú ku-ku-ba-tim É DAM.GÀR ni-il₅-qé-ma a-na DAM ili₅-ba-ni ni-dí-in
target: From a merchant we borrowed beer bread for the banquet and for drinking flasks and we gave them to Ilī-bāni's wife.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ma li-ba-kà lá i-pá-ri-id
target: There is absolutely no reason to get nervous.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ki-ma a-wi-lu-tí-kà lu-qú-ut-kà a-na KÙ.BABBAR ta-e-er-ma tí-ib-a-ma a-tal-kam
target: Gentleman as you are, convert your merchandise into silver and come immediately here.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫi a-ta tí-de₈-e ki-ma KÙ.BABBAR 1 GÍN ša qá-tim a-na ša-ku-ul-tim
target: My dear brother, realize that every single shekel of silver at hand will be used for the banquet.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-šur-lá-ma-sí qí-bi₄-ma KÙ.BABBAR šé-bi₄-lá-ma li-ba-am dí-nam
target: Tell Aššur-lamassī: 'Send the silver (and so) encourrage us!'

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-im SIG₅ a-na a-šur-ṣú-lu-lí dí-in li-bu-šu lá tù-lá-ma-an
target: Let him give the yield of his textiles if good quality to Aššur-ṣululī. Do not make him angry.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2.5 TÚG ku-ta-ni i-li-a i-na-pá-al
target: 2.5 textiles Iliya will give as compensation.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i-lá-qé
target: He will get 1.5 shekel of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na 1.6666 GÍN kur-ub-IŠTAR i-na-pá-al
target: 31.6666 shekels Kurub-Ištar will give as compensation.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB e-la-lí DUMU i-ku-nim KIŠIB ša-lim-a-ḫi-im DUMU dan-a-šur KIŠIB en-na-sú-en₆ DUMU sú-kà-lí-a KIŠIB i-dí-a-šur DUMU a-šur-ma-lik
target: Seal of Elalī, son of Ikūnum, seal of Šalim-ahum, son of Dān-Aššur, seal of Ennam-Suen, son of Sukkalliya, seal of Iddin-Aššur, son of Aššur-mālik.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša 1 ma-na 1.5 GÍN i-ṣé-er DINGIR-šu-GAL DUMU bu-la-lí e-lá-ma i-šu
target: that Ilšu-rabi, son of Bulāli, owes 1 mina 1.5 shekel of silver to Elamma.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù ITU.KAM áb-ša-ra-ni li-mì-im šu-ḫu-bur a-na ITU.3.KAM i-ša-qal
target: From month V?, eponymy of Šu-hubur? he will pay within 3 months.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma lá iš-qúl ki-ma a-wa-at kà-ri-im ú-ṣa-áb
target: If he does not pay he will add (interest) in accordance with the rule of the colony.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR iš-ri-iq-ma kà-ru-um kà-ni-iš a-na šu-šál-šum i-dí-šu
target: He had stolen silver and the colony had convicted him to (pay) the triple.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.3333 ma-na 2 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-šu-mì ku-li-a DUMU a-lá-bi-im a-na a-šur-ma-lik DUMU ku-ra-ra-áš-qúl
target: 1.3333 mina and 2 shekels of silver on behalf of Kuliya, son of Ali-abum, I paid to Assur-malik son of Kurara.

source: translate Akkadian to English: DINGIR-li KÙ.GI ša ili₅-pì-ú-ṣur ú ṭup-pá-am ḫa-ar-ma-am ša 1.6666 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša ḫu-bu-ul ku-li-a a-mur-{d}UTU ú e-na-a-šùr a ša-pár-tim ú-kà-al
target: The golden gods of Ili-pi-usur and an encased tablet of 1.6666 mina of silver, being the debt of Kulia, Amur-Samas and Ennam-Assur I hold as pledge.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na a-lá-ak DUMU a-na-<gap> ú MAŠKIM ša ì-lí-pí-ú-ṣur KÙ.BABBAR i-ša-qú-lu-ni-ma i-li ú-ša-ar
target: When Ana-x's son and Ili-pi-usur's attorney come here they will pay me the silver and I will release the gods.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša DUB-pá-am i-mu-a-at
target: As for the tablet, it will be cancelled.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma KÙ.BABBAR lá iš-ta-aq-lu KÙ.BABBAR ú ṣí-ba-sú a-li ni-na-mu-ru ku-li-a i-ša-qá-lam
target: Should they not pay the silver, then Kuliya will pay me the silver and the interest on it, wherever we meet.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ITU.KAM kán-mar-ta li-mu-um a-šùr-SIPA DUMU ì-lí-e-mu-qí
target: Month IX, eponymy of Assur-re'i, son of Ili-emuqi.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-nu-mì KÙ.BABBAR áš-qú-lu e-na-a-šùr ú a-mur-{d}UTU DUMU ili₅-pì-ú-ṣur be-ru-ú i-zi-zu
target: When I paid the silver Ennam-Assur and Amur-Samas, son of Ili-pi-usur, acted as beru.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-šur-ma-lik IGI sú-kà-li-a IGI ma-num-ba-lúm-a-šur
target: In the presence of Assur-malik, of Sukkaliya, of Mannum-balum-Assur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ša-lim-a-šùr-ma a-na i-tur₄-DINGIR en-na-nim en-um-a-šùr ù a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi-ma
target: From Šalim-Aššur to Itūr-ilī, Ennānum, Ennam-Aššur and Alāhum:

source: translate Akkadian to English: ta-áš-pu-ra-nim um-ma a-tù-nu-ma 40 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣú-ḫa-ru i-dí-nu-ni-a-tí-ma i ku-nu-ki-ni i-ba-ší
target: You have written me, saying: The servants gave us 40 minas of silver and it is at hand under our seals.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-wa-tum ša lá-qé-ep a-dí-ni i-ṣé-ri-a na-dí
target: The affair with Lā-qēp is still hanging over me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR mì-ma a-na a-lim{ki} lá tù-šé-ba-lá
target: Do not send any silver to the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR a-na ṣú-ḫa-ri-a dí-na-ma i bé-tí-a li-bi-ší
target: Give the silver to my servants and let it remain in my house.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-sú-ri a-wa-tum e im-qú-ta-ma ma-ma-an a-na ba-áb DINGIR-lim e ú-ša-ak-ší-da-ma li-bi ù li-ba-ku-nu e im-ra-aṣ
target: God forbid that the matter descends on me so that someone makes me go to the Gate of the God and I and you too become unhappy.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ṣé-er KÙ.BABBAR a-nim ša i-ba-ší-ú 10 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR en-um-a-šur ú 10 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a-lá-ḫu-um lu-ra-dí-ú-ma KÙ.BABBAR dí-na-šu-nu-tí-ma a-na ma-lá ú-ša-ḫi-zu-šu-nu-ni le-pu-šu
target: Let Ennam-Aššur and Ali-ahum add each 10 minas of silver to this silver that is available, give them the silver and let them do as I have instructed them.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù 22 TÚG ṣú-ba-tù ša iš-tí a-lá-ḫi-im i-ba-ší-ú-ni a-na er-bi-a ḫa-áš-ḫa-ak-šu-nu a-ṣé-ri-a šé-bi-lá-ni-šu-nu
target: Also, the 22 textiles that are with Ali-ahum, I want them for my entrance gift. Send them to me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫu-a a-tù-nu a-na tí-ir-tí-a iḫ-da ù a-na a-dí ša um-me-a-ni-a ša a-ma-kam wa-áš-bu-ni-ma áš-pu-ra-ku-nu-tí-ni iḫ-da-ma
target: My dear brothers, pay heed to my message, and do take care concerning the affair of my investors who live there, as I wrote to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-mur-IŠTAR-ma a-na ku-li-a qí-bí-ma
target: Thus Amur-Istar, to Kuliya:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí ma-lá ú ší-ni-šu a-šu-mì {d}MAR.TU-ba-ni pá-ší-ri-a a-ša ší-im TÚG.ḪI-tí-a áš-pu-ra-kum
target: Several times I wrote you concerning my retailer Amurrum-bani because of the price of my textiles,

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ta mì-ma-ša-ma úz-ni lá ta-pá-té
target: but you have never sent me any information!

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-ku a-na-kam a-na ku-a-tim na-aḫ-da-ku
target: I here have concern for your interests,

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ta u₄-ma-kál ḫu-ša-ḫa-ka lá té-zi-ib-ma a-na i-a-tim lá ta-na-ḫi-id
target: but you have never, not even for a single day, sacrificed your own interests to care for mine!

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ší-im <gap> lu a-šur-e-nam <gap> šál-ma-a-šur <gap> lu {d}MAR.TU-ba-ni <gap> KÙ.BABBAR ša-áš-qí-il₅-ma ú {d}MAR.TU-ba-ni ṭur₄-dam
target: make both Assur-ennam, Salim-Assur, and Amurrum-bani pay that silver and send Amurrum-bani to me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma KÙ.BABBAR-pì i-ma-šu-ḫu té-er-ta-kà li-li-kam-ma úz-ni pí-tí
target: Send me a message if they try to rob me of my silver and keep me informed.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a-šùr-ba-ni DUMU i-dí-a-bi-im ḫa-bu-lam KÙ.BABBAR ša-áš-qí-il₅ šu-ma šé-bi₄-lam
target: Assur-bani, son of Iddin-abum, owes me 1 mina of silver, make him pay and send it to me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR i li-bi a-šùr-e-nam DUMU <gap>-mì-ma i li-bi-šu i-šu-ú {d}UTU-e-nam ṣú-ḫa-ri-im ša a-šùr-e-nam ù ša i li-bi šál-ma-a-šùr ša-áš-qí-il₅-šu-nu
target: One mina of silver is owed by Assur-ennam, son of <gap>, whatever is owed to me by him, by Samas-ennam, the servant of Assur-ennam, and what is owed by Salim-Assur, make them pay!

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi-ma um-ma zu-ku-a-ma a-ḫi a-ta eb-ri a-ta ú a-ta ki-ma a-ḫi-ú-tim úz-ni lá ta-pá-té
target: To Ali-ahum from Zukuwa: Although you are my brother and friend, as if we were strangers you do not inform me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: e ta-aq-bi um-ma a-ta-ma ša-zu-úz-tám iš-tí-a ú-ša-zi-iz
target: Do not say to yourself: He has appointed an agent (to function) together with me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ki-ma a-na ku-a-tí ta-ak-lá-ku-ni a-na a-mì-ú-tim a-ta-kà-al
target: Do I trust those others the way I trust you?

source: translate Akkadian to English: ki-ma a-na-ku a-na tí-ir-tí-kà na-ḫi-da-ku-ni ù a-ta a-na tí-ir-tí-a lá ta-ḫi-id
target: Although I personally pay attention to your instructions, you have not paid attention to my instructions.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí ḫa-am-ší-šu tí-ir-tí i-li-kà-kum
target: My instructions have come to you five times!

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-um ša 12 ma-na <gap>-ba-tim <gap> a-na-ku we-da-ku <gap> i-dí <gap> ša-áš-qí-il₅
target: The tablet concerning 12 minas of silver <gap> I am alone. <gap> have <gap> paid.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ki-ma ṭup-pá-am ta-áš-me-ú KÙ.BABBAR ša-qí-il₅ lá ša-qí-il₅ tí-ir-ta-kà a-na wa-aḫ-šu-ša-na li-li-kam-ma ší-ma-am šu-qú-ul
target: As you hear the letter send me word to Wahšušana whether or not the silver is paid, and pay the goods.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10.1666 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na e-me-er-tim
target: 10.1666 shekels of silver for Emmertum;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na ša-at-ì-lí ù na-ḫi-iš-tim
target: 3 shekels of silver for Šāt-ilī and Nahištum;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na ḫa-tim
target: 3 shekels of silver for hattum;

source: translate Akkadian to English: pá-ar-ší-kam a-na be-lá-sú-nu
target: a sash for Bēlassunu;

source: translate Akkadian to English: na-aḫ-lá-áp-tám a-na lá-ma-sí
target: a dress for Lamassī - all this I gave to Aššur-malik son of Usāriya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na ni-qé
target: 2 shekels of silver for sacrifices.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI ku-bi-a IGI a-šur-pí-lá-aḫ DUMU a-mur-a-šur
target: Witnessed by Kūbiya (and) Aššur-pilah son of Amur-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṣú-ba-tám a-na wa-ar-da-nim
target: A textile for Wardānum;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na a-mur-a-šur ù e-me-er-tim
target: 3 shekels of silver for Amur-Aššur and Emmertum;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na ni-qé-šu
target: 1.5 shekel of silver for his sacrifice - all this I gave to Ennam-Aššur son of Kurkurānum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI kàr-ri-a ša É sú-kà-li-a
target: Witnessed by Karriya from the family of Sukkalliya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma en-nam-a-šur-ma a-na a-šur-DU₁₀-ma iš-tù a-lim{ki} a-šur ú-lá iš-tí-kà ú-ṣa-am
target: Ennam-Aššur said to Aššur-ṭāb: I did not leave the City of Assur together with you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú-lá a-wi-it-ni iš-té-ni-iš ni-wi-ma a-ḫu-um a-na a-ḫi-šu ší-bi iš-ku-un
target: we shall not declare our consignment jointly but one has set witnesses for the other.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú-lá i kà-ri-im iš-té-ni-iš nu-ṣa-am
target: we did not leave the colony together.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú-lá i-dí-kà
target: I do not know you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ma-lá ṭé-em a-lim a-šur DUMU a-šur šu-um-šu a-šar ba-lá-ṭí-šu i-lá-ak
target: in accordance with the policy of the City of Assur any Assyrian will go where it is profitable for him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ta a-šar ba-lá-ṭí-kà ta-li-ik
target: you too went where it was profitable for you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú a-na-ku a ma-lá ṭé-em a-li-a a-šar ba-lá-ṭí-a a-li-ik
target: and I as well went where it was profitable for me in accordance with the policy of my city.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú ú-lá tap-pá-i a-ta
target: so, you are not my partner.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú-lá ri-ig-ma-tum ší-bu-tum
target: This is not a formal lawsuit but a witnessed statement.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-na-aḫ-ì-lí DUMU PUZUR₄-a-na IGI a-du-du-wa DUMU en-na-ma-nim IGI en-na-sú-in DUMU i-tur₄-DINGIR IGI šu-a-nim DUMU šu-sú-in
target: Witnessed by Anah-ilī son of Puzur-Anna, by Aduduwa son of Ennam-Anum, by Ennau-Suen son of Itūr-ilī, by Šu-Anum son of Šu-Suen.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ku-zi-zi-a lá-qé-ep ù a-na-a-na qí-bi-ma um-ma en-um-a-šùr-ma
target: To Kuziziya, Lā-qēp and Anna-anna from Ennam-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lá-ma a-na kà-tí-lá a-li-ku 5 na-ru-uq GIG ú 2 na-ru-uq ŠE-am e-lá-nu-ma e-zi-ba-ki-im
target: Before I went to Katila I left you 5 sacks of wheat and 2 sacks of barley in addition.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫa-ma 17 na-ru-uq 2 DUG GIG ú 17 na-ru-uq 2 DUG ŠE-am iš-tù tù-um-li-a iš-du-du-nim
target: Further, they carted 17 sacks 2 jars of wheat and 17 sacks 2 jars of barley from Tumliya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ma ú-ṭí-tim ú KÙ.BABBAR ša nu-a-e a-bi i-a-tí-ma e-ta-aṣ-ra-am
target: All the grain plus the silver from the natives my father had designated for me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-pu-tum a-na a-wi-il₅-tim lá ta-pá-ṭí-ri ú mì-ma lá ta-dí-ni-ší-im
target: Urgent, do not open it up for the lady and give her nothing.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú iš-tí e-wa-ri-mu-ša ta-ḫi-tám áš-pu-ur-ší-im
target: Also, I sent her directions with Ewarimuša.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫu-a a-tù-nu a-ma-kam na-ḫi-da-ší-ma i-na ḫu-ur-ší-a ší-lá-tum lá i-ba-ší-ma li-bi lá i-ma-ra-aṣ
target: My dear brothers, instruct her there so that there will be no wrongdoing in my storeroom to make me unhappy.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pí-a ú ú-tù-up-tí lu tù-ša-ṣí-ir
target: Do place my tablets and furniture under guard.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ma-lá ú-ṭù-tum a-bi-ki-tim i-gi₅-im-ru úz-ni pí-té-a
target: Inform me how much grain was spent for the mourning-ritual.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí bu-lá-tí ša a-bi-a a-ḫi ú-pá-ta-a-ni-ni a-sà-ḫu-ur
target: Until my brother reveals to me my father's assets I shall be delayed.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lá-ma a-li-kà-ni ma-ṣa-ar-tám a-lá-ḫu-um ip-té-té-e ú bu-lá-tí uš-té-ṣí-i
target: Before I came Ali-ahum had opened the strong-room and even taken out the assets.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu KÙ.BABBAR i ba-áb-tí-a lá-qé-ep im-ḫu-ur lu ša šé-ep e-wa-ru-mu-ša i-ri-iḫ lu 1.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ú 3.1666 GÍN K
target: Whether Lā-qēp has received silver from my outstanding claims or anything remains from Ewarimuša's transport, or the 1.5 mina of silver and 3.1666 shekels of gold that is with my maid.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB i-ku-pí-a DUMU a-šur-ba-ni
target: Seal of Ikūn-pīya son of Aššur-bāni;

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na en-um-a-šur i-dí-a-bi-im ù lá-qé-ep <gap>
target: to Ennam-Aššur, Iddin-abum and Lā-qēp <gap>

source: translate Akkadian to English: 22 ma-na 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am i-ṣé-er i-dí-a-bi₄-im a-šur-ma-lik i-šu
target: Iddin-abum owes 22 minas 10 shekels of refined silver to Aššur-malik.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-lá-ak šu-{d}EN.LÍL i-ša-qal
target: He is to pay before Šu-Illil arrives.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma lá iš-qú-ul 1.5 GÍN.TA i-na ITU.KAM a-na ma-na-im ú-ṣa-áb
target: If he has not paid (in time), he will add interest at the rate 1.5 shekel per month per mina.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-šur-e-mu-qí IGI en-nam-a-šur DUMU me-na-a
target: Witnessed by Aššur-emūqī, by Ennam-Aššur s. of Menaya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na en-um-a-šùr qí-bi-ma um-ma a-na-na-ma iš-tù a-bu-kà me-tù a-ḫu-kà a-na a-lim{ki} ṭup-pá-am ú-šé-bi-lá-ma mì-ma ú-nu-tám i-na É a-bi-kà i-ba-ší-ú i-na qá-at a-ḫi-kà a-na ki-dim tù-uš-té-ṣí
target: To Ennam-Aššur from Anna-anna: After your father died your brother sent a letter to the City and all the goods that were in your father's house you brought outside into your brother's hands.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ta a-na ú-nu-tim ša qá-at-kà ik-šu-du a-ta ki-ma ša-zu-úz-tám tù-ša-zi-zu-ú pá-al-ḫa-ku-ma mì-ma ú-lá e-pá-áš
target: As for you, for the goods that you got hold of - since you yourself appointed an agent, I am afraid and shall do nothing.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù mì-šu ša ta-áš-ta-na-pá-ra-ni um-ma a-ta-ma a-na <gap> na <gap> tí-ni <gap> 1 ma-na ú-lu 2 ma-na <gap> a-ta we-dí-kà <gap> tí-<gap> ma-a-ma we-dí-kà-ma a-na a-bi₄-kà lá-am-da-tí
target: Also, why do you constantly write to me, saying: For 1 or 2 minas you alone have been for your father.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù ri-ik-sà-am ša tù-šé-bi₄-lá-ni i-na ṭup-pí-kà a-na <gap> lá <gap> lá-pí-it <gap> 0.3333 ma-na <gap> a-na bi₄-ki-tim i-dí-nu i-na wa-ar-ki-tim <gap> tí bi <gap> áp-ra-am
target: Also, as to the bundle that you sent me, in your letter 0.3333 mina of silver they paid for the mourning ceremony.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 na-áš-pè-ra-tum ša ku-nu-uk sà-ak-li-a <gap> a <gap> UD i-na a-lim IGI ma-<gap>-im IGI-<gap>-na ṭá-áb-tim ša-ak-na
target: 3 missives sealed by Sakliya placed in the City with Ma<gap> and <gap>ki as witnesses.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-šùr-ba-ni-ma a-na šu-pé-e-nu-ma-an um-mì-iš-ḫa-ra a-ší-tí-šu ú ḫa-nu qí-bi₄-ma a-wa-tim lá dam-qá-tim ma-áš-ḫa-tim áš-me
target: From Aššur-bāni to Šuppi-numan, Ummī-Išhara, his wife and hanu: I have heard words that were not good but diminishing.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-pu-tum a-ma-kam É bé-tám ù ṭup-pé-e ú-lu mì-ma-a-ma ša-ṣí-ra
target: It is urgent that you guard the house, the tablets and anything else there!

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma a-<gap> a <gap> a-šùr-mu-ta-bi₄-il₅ ú a-šur-SIPA mì-ma-ša-ma lu ṭup-pè-e e-ri-šu-ku-nu a-pu-tum lá ta-da-na-šu-nu-šu
target: If A<gap>, Aššur-muttabbil or Aššur-rē’ī asks you for anything, also tablets, then it is imperative that you do not give them anything!

source: translate Akkadian to English: a ma-lá ḫa-nu ša-ḫu-zu-ni 1 GÍN.TA ma-lá ṭup-pè-e i-lá-qé-ú qá-sú ša ḫa-nu lá ta-kà-lá-a li-il₅-qé
target: As hanu has been instructed, every shekel that he receives in accordance with the tablets is hanu’s share. Do not hold it back! Let him receive it.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú šu-ma kà-lá ṭup-pè-e e-ri-iš-ku-nu lá ta-kà-lá-a-šu li-il₅-qé
target: Also, if he demands all the tablets from you, then do not hold him back but let him take them.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pá-am ša ni-pì-il₅-tí be-lá-nim DUMU šu-a-šur ša a-na um-mì-ni e-zi-bu ḫa-nu a pá-ni-a lu-ub-lá-šu
target: As for the tablet concerning the balance payment of Bēlānum son of Šu-Aššur that I left for our mother, hanu should bring that to me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-pu-tum ša-ṣí-ra-ma ṭup-pè-e qá-tí ḫa-nu li-iṣ-ba-at
target: It is urgent that you stand guard! As for the tablets, let hanu take them!

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pè-e qá-tí a-sà-nim DUMU šu-ḫu-bur ú a-ḫe-e-a e iṣ-ba-at-ma É a-bi₄-ni a-na a-wa-tim e ta-dí-a
target: He must not take the tablets in the hands of Asānum son of Šu-hubur or my brothers and you must not set our father’s house up for a lawsuit.

source: translate Akkadian to English: eṭ-lúm lá SIG₅ iḫ-da-ma ša-ṣí-ra
target: The young man is no good. Take care and stand guard!

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am i-ṣé-er PUZUR₄.IŠTAR DUMU dan-a-šur a-šur-iš-ta-kál i-šu
target: Puzur-Ištar son of Dan-Aššur owes 2.5 minas of refined silver to Aššuriš-takal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ITU.KAM ku-zal-le li-mu-um a-šur-i-mì-tí ma-lá-ḫu-um
target: Month Kuzallu, eponymy Aššur-imittī, the skipper.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na 3 ITU.KAM i-ša-qal
target: He is to pay within 3 months.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma lá iš-qú-ul ki-ma a-wa-at kà-ri-im ṣí-ib-tám ú-ṣa-áb
target: If he has not paid (in time) he shall add interest according to the rule of the colony.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR a-le-e ni-na-mu-ru-ú i-ša-qal
target: He is to pay the silver wherever we meet.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI ṣí-lu-šu-da-ga-an DUMU IŠTAR-pí-lá-aḫ IGI a-lá-ḫi-im DUMU ša-lim-a-šur
target: Witnessed by Ṣilluš-Dagān son of Ištar-pilah, by Ali-ahum son of Šalim-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù ḫa-mu-uš-tim ša a-lá-ḫi-im ù bu-sí-a
target: Reckoned from the week eponymy of Ali-ahum and Buṣiya

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-ša na-ra-am-ZU ù i-ku-nim KÙ.BABBAR ni-iš-qúl
target: we paid the silver during that of Naram-Suen and Ikūnum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na 14 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ni-is-ḫa-sú DIRI ša-du-a-sú ša-bu
target: 1 mina 14 shekels of silver, the excise on it extra, the transport fee for it paid;

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫa-ma 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ni-is-ḫa-sú DIRI ša-du-a-sú ša-bu ik-ri-bu ku-nu-ki ša DAM.GÀR en-um-a-šur a-na ir-ma-a-šur ip-qí-id-ma a-na a-lim{ki} a-na ší-a-ma-tim ú-bi-il₅
target: separately 0.5 mina of silver, the excise on it extra, the transport fee for it paid, temple funds, under the seals of, Ennam-Aššur entrusted to Ir'am-Aššur and he brought it to the City for making purchases.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-zu-ta-a DUMU e-me-me IGI ì-dí-ba-ni DUMU ir-ma-a-šur
target: In the presence of Azutāya, son of Ememê, of Idi-bāni, son of Ir'am-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-al-DU₁₀ a-na a-mur-a-šur iṣ-ba-at-ni-a-tí-ma
target: Āl-ṭāb seized us against Amur-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-al-DU₁₀-ma a-na a-mur-a-šur-ma KÙ.BABBAR a-ta ù šu-IŠTAR mì-iš-lá ša-qá-lá-am lá qá-bi-a-tù-nu
target: Āl-ṭāb said to Amur-Aššur: Have you and Šu-Ištar not promised (or: been ordered) to pay each half of the silver?

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-mur-a-šur-ma ke-na KÙ.BABBAR mì-iš-lá ša-qá-lá-am qá-bi-a-ni-ma
target: Amur-Aššur answered: "True, we have promised (or: been ordered) to pay each half of the silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù i-né-ma-li ša-li-ìš-tám ša-tim áš-du-na-da i-zu-a-az ù a-na i-bi-sà-e ša-li-ìš-tám i-za-az
target: and also (that) would receive as share one third of (so the envelope) the profit and that he (also) would be responsible for one third of the losses".

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-ta-tí-a IGI a-ḫu-waqar IGI a-šur-{d}UTU
target: In the presence of Atatiya, of Ahu-waqar, of Aššur-šamšī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-šu-mì sú-bi-ri-im ša ip-ṭí-re
target: Concerning Subārum / the Subaraean, of the ransom.

source: translate Akkadian to English: be-lá-nu-um a-na li-ip-it-IŠTAR DUMU lá-li-im iṣ-ba-at-ni-a-tí-ma
target: Bēlānum seized us against Lipit-Ištar, son of Lalum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma be-la-nu-um-ma a-na li-ip-it-IŠTAR-ma 1.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR iš-tù ḫa-muš-tim ša šu-IŠTAR DUMU a-šur-ba-ni a-na 6 ḫa-am-ša-tim ta-ša-qá-lam
target: Bēlānum said: to Lipit-Ištar: You will pay me 1.5 mina of silver within 6 weeks reckoned from the week eponymy of Šu-Ištar, son of Aššur-bāni.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma lá ta-áš-qú-lam 0.6666 GÍN 15 ŠE.TA a-na 1 ma-na-im i-na ITU.KAM-im ṣí-ib-tám tù-ṣa-ba-am
target: If you have not paid me you will add for me an interest of 3 / 4 shekel per mina per month.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma li-ip-it-IŠTAR-ma ú-ṣa-ba-ku-um
target: Lipit-Ištar answered: "I will add it for you".

source: translate Akkadian to English: ITU.KAM qá-ra-tim li-mu-um en-na-sú-in DUMU šu-IŠTAR
target: Month VIII, year eponymy of Ennam-Suen, son of Šu-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um ḫu-ra-ma i-dí-ni-a-tí-ma
target: For these words the hurama colony made us available.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI GÍR ša a-šur ší-bu-tí-ni ni-dí-in
target: Before Aššur's dagger we gave our testimony.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI šu-zu-zu DUMU a-šur-SIPA IGI en-um-a-šur DUMU e-lá-ma
target: In the presence of Šuzuzu, son of Aššur-rē'ī, of Ennam-Aššur, son of Elamma.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi-ma um-ma zu-ku-a-ma
target: To Ali-ahum from Zukuwa:

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-im an-ni-ki-kà a-dí a-na-ku a-na ša-lá-tù-wa-ar e-ru-bu KÙ.BABBAR lá i-ší-qí-il₅
target: As to the price for your tin, before I arrived at Šalatuwar the silver was not paid.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù u₄-mì-im ša e-ru-bu KÙ.BABBAR ú-ša-áš-qí-il₅
target: The day I arrived I had the silver paid.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 11 ma-na 12 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR e-zi-ib ša-du-e-tí-im ší-im AN.NA-ki-kà iz-ku-wa-ku
target: 11 minas 12 shekels of silver apart from the transport tariff was cleared for you as the proceeds from your tin, but before I came the tin was sold.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú lá-ma a-li-kà-ni AN.NA ta-dí-in
target: I questioned Ikūn-pīya and he said: "It was sold at the rate of 8 shekels minus 22.5 grains."

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-ku-pí-a áš-a-al-ma um-ma šu-ut-ma 8 GÍN LÁ 22.5 ŠE.TA ta-dí-in
target: 11 minas 12 shekels of silver (the price of) your tin, Man-mahir (and) Ikūn-pīya gave to Šukkutum and the son of Šalim-Adad brings it to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 11 ma-na 12 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR AN.NA-ki-kà ma-ma-ḫi-ir i-ku-pí-a a-na šu-ki-tim i-dí-nu-ma DUMU šál-ma-{d}IM na-áš-a-kum
target: I made Šukkutum pay 4 minas of silver from what is in his tablet.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na ša ṭup-pí-šu 4 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR šu-kà-tám ú-ša-áš-qí-il₅-šu
target: Šu-Hubur brings that under Šukkutum's seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ku-nu-ki ša šu-ki-tim šu-ḫu-bur na-áš-a-kum
target: The silver should pass overland in the name of Šukkutum to Kanesh.

source: translate Akkadian to English: GÁN-lam₅ a-šu-mì šu-ki-tim a-dí kà-ni-iš{ki} e-tí-qám
target: Total of your silver, both the proceeds from the tin and that from Šukkutum, 15 minas 12 shekels of silver, Šu-Hubur brings to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠU.NÍGIN KÙ.BABBAR-pí-kà lu ší-im AN.NA lu ša šu-ki-tim 15 ma-na 12 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR šu-ḫu-bur na-áš-a-kum
target: The rest of your silver, 2 minas owed by Šukkutum — is your silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-tí KÙ.BABBAR-pí-kà 2 ma-na ša li-bi šu-ki-tim KÙ.BABBAR-kà
target: Silver for purchases and he set down with Šu-Hubur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR a-na ší-a-ma-tim šu-ut ú ma tí iš-tí šu-ḫu-bur iš-ku-nu-ni
target: There in your possession I seized it from their silver so satisfy yourself with the silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-kam i li-bi-kà
target: As to the 8 minas of sealed tin and the šilipki'u that Ilī-ašrannī brought, in accordance with your instructions I have sold the tin and the textile to Šukkutum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na 5.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR KI ṣí-li-IŠTAR ša ší-na-ḫu-tim IGI ib-ni-{d}IM DUMU kà-a-a iš-pu-ra-ma
target: 0.5 mina 5.5 shekels of silver is owed by Ṣilli-Ištar from Šinahuttum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-lá-ḫi-im ù i-ku-pí-a-šùr qí-bi₄-ma um-ma za-li-dí-ma
target: To Ali-ahum and Ikūn-pī-Aššur from Zalidi:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.8333 ma-na 3 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am ù 0.5 ma-na a-ḫa-ma a-mu-ra-am a-na šu-a-šùr DUMU i-dí-a-šùr ḫa-bu-lá-ku
target: I owe 53 shekels of refined silver plus further 0.5 mina of checked (silver) to Šu-Aššur son of Iddin-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pá-am ša 4 <gap> ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša DAM.GÀR <gap>-ma a-na a-bi₄-ni ḫa-bu-lu a-na ša-pár-tim ú-kà-al
target: The tablet concerning 4 minas of silver which the agent <gap> owes to our father, he holds as security.

source: translate Akkadian to English: be-lí a-ta KÙ.BABBAR a-na šu-a-šùr šu-qú-ul-ma ṭup-pì šé-ṣí-ma iš-tí-kà li-ib-ší-ú
target: My dear lord, pay the silver to Šu-Aššur, get out my tablet and let it be with you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù té-er-ta-kà li-li-kam-ma lá-at-bi₄-a-ma lá-tal-kam
target: Also, send me word so I can set out and leave.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù a-dí ṭup-pì-im ša {d}UTU-ba-ni a-dí ma-lá ù ší-ni-šu ni-gi₅-ri-ma ša ki-ma ku-a-tí ṭup-pá-am ta-da-nam lá i-mu-ú
target: Also, with respect to Šamaš-bāni's tablet we sued both once and twice, but your representatives refuse to give the tablet.

source: translate Akkadian to English: té-er-ta-kà a-ṣé-er ša ki-ma
target: Send word to your (representatives <gap>)

source: translate Akkadian to English: 15 ma-na URUDU ma-sí-a-am i-na áb-na-tí-ni i-na ṣé-er ú-na-bi₄ ú a-ší-a-at lu-zi i-šu
target: Unabi and Ašiat owe 15 minas of washed copper, weighed with our stones, to Luzi.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù ḫa-mu-uš-tim ša a-mu-ru-um-ba-ni ú a-šur-na-da a-na 4 ḫa-am-ša-tim i-ša-qú-lu
target: Reckoned from the week of Amurrum-bāni and Aššur-nādā they must pay within 4 weeks.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma lá iš-qú-lu ki-ma a-wa-at kà-ri-im ṣí-ib-tám ú-ṣú-bu
target: If they have not paid (in time), they must add interest according to the rule of the colony.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na pu-ru-uš-ḫa-dim URUDU-am i-ša-qú-lu
target: They must pay the copper in Purušhaddum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ITU.KAM ḫu-bu-ur li-mu-um i-dí-a-bu-um IGI i-dí-a-bi₄-im DUMU i-tur₄-DINGIR
target: Month hubur, eponymy Iddin-abum. Witnessed by Iddin-abum son of Itūr-ilī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma kà-ru-um kà-ni-iš-ma a-na a-li-ki qí-bi-ma
target: Thus the Kanesh colony, say to the travelers:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam sú-en₆-SIG₅ im-ḫu-ur-ni-a-tí-ma um-ma šu-ut-ma li-ip-ta-num DUMU qar-da-a ú-ta-ra-am a-na ta-ú-ri-šu ma-aṣ-a-ku
target: Here Suen-damiq has appealed to us and he said: 'I want Liptānum, son of Qardaya, to be brought back; I take responsibility for bringing him back'.

source: translate Akkadian to English: DU₁₀-ṣí-lá-a-šùr ší-pár-ni
target: Ṭāb-šilli-Aššur is our messenger.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tí DU₁₀-ṣí-lá-a-šùr li-tù-ra-am
target: He must come back with Ṭāb-ṣilli-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-tù-nu lu e-mu-uq-šu
target: You must be his executive force.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-um ša 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša be-ú-lá-at a-bu-ša-lim DUMU PÚZUR.IŠTAR
target: A tablet about 10 shekels of silver, the working capital of Abu-šalim, son of Puzur-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-um ša ku-nu-uk PÚZUR-a-šur a-na 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR lá i-tù-ar
target: A tablet with Puzur-Aššur's seal, he will not come back on 10 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-um ša 0.3333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša be-ú-lá-at a-bi-a-a DUMU ú-zu-a
target: A tablet about 0.3333 mina of silver, the working capital of Abiaya, son of Uzua.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-um ša 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša DINGIR-ma-lik DUMU a-de₈-lá-at
target: A tablet about 10 shekels of silver of Ilī-mālik, son of Adad-ellat.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-um ša 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša i-na-sú-in DUMU za-ar-ni-qí-im ša be-ú-lá-tí-šu
target: A tablet about 10 shekels of silver of Ennam-Suen, son of Zarniqum, of his working capital.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú ṭup-pu-um ša 13.1666 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša e-nam-sú-in DUMU a-lá-bi-im
target: And a tablet of 13.1666 shekel of silver of Ennam-Suen, son of Ali-abum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-um ša 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša lá-qí-pì-im DUMU a-gu₅-a
target: A tablet about 10 shekels of silver of Laqēpum, son of Agua.

source: translate Akkadian to English: na-áš-pè-er-tum ša a-lá-ḫi-im ú DUMU ku-zi-zi-a
target: A letter of Ali-ahum and the son of Kuziziya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-um ša 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša šu-ma-a
target: A tablet of 0.5 mina of silver of Šumaya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠU.NÍGIN 9 ṭup-pu-ú i-na ta-ma-lá-ki-im ša i-ša-sú-ú ta-ba-ku-tum
target: In all 9 tablets in a tablet box, to be read and thrown away.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-šu-mì ša ḫu-lu-qá-e a-na-ku ku-ra ù šu-IŠTAR ni-pá-ḫu-ur-ma iš-té-ni-iš a-na pí-lá-aḫ-IŠTAR DUMU ú-zu-a a-wa-tám ni-da-an IGI lá-qé-ep IGI e-me-me IGI a-šur-i-dí
target: For the matter of the losses, I, Kura and Šu-Ištar will come together and together we will address Pilah-Ištar, son of Uzua, with Lā-qēp, Ememe and Aššur-idī as witnesses.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma ib-tù-a-ni-a-tí iš-tí-ni i-ra-ba-áš
target: Should he prevail over us, then he can present his claim together with us.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB a-šùr-DU₁₀ DUMU a-ḫu-wa-qar
target: Seal of Aššur-ṭāb, son of Ahu-waqar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB šu-a-nim DUMU a-ki-a-nim
target: Seal of Šu-Anim, son of Akiānum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB a-šur-du-gul DUMU im-da-ḫi
target: Seal of Aššur-dugul, son of Imdī-ahī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB a-šur-DU₁₀ DUMU i-dí-ba-ni
target: Seal of Aššur-ṭāb, son of Idi-bāni.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 12 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i-ṣé-er a-šùr-DU₁₀ DUMU i-dí-ba-ni en-na-sú-in i-šu
target: Ennam-Suen has a claim of 12 shekels of silver on Aššur-ṭāb, son of Idi-āni.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ITU.KAM na-ar-ma-ak-a-šur li-mu-um e-lá-li DUMU i-ku-nim
target: Month II / III, eponymy of Elalī, son of Ikūnum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṣí-ib-tám ki-ma a-wa-at kà-ri-im kà-né-eš ú-ṣa-áb
target: He will add interest according to the regulation of the Kanesh colony.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-dí-da a-lá-ḫi-im ú ú-ku qí-bi-ma um-ma PUZUR₄-a-šur-ma
target: To Adida, Ali-ahum and Uku from Puzur-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 13 TÚG ku-nu-ki-a ša É a-lá-ḫi-im e-zi-bu 20 TÚG ku-ta-ni dam-qú-tim 1 TÚG <gap> ku-nu-ki-<gap> a-na ší-mì-im dí-na-ma AN.NA ku-un-kà-ma a-na <gap> dí-na-ma a-na ṣé-ri-a lu-ub-lam
target: The 13 textiles under my seal that I left in Ali-ahum's house, 20 of good quality, 1 <gap> textile under my seal <gap> sell that and seal the tin and give it to <gap> and let him bring it to me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na 21 TÚG ša ša-lim-be-lí ú a-šur-pí-lá-aḫ na-áš-ú-ni-ku-nu-tí-ni 1 TÚG ša a-ki-dí-e a-na IŠTAR-lá-ma-sí dí-na
target: Of the 21 textiles that Šalim-bēlī and Aššur-pilah bring to you give 1 Akkadian textile to Ištar-lamassī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na ša-am-ší ṭup-pí ta-ša-me-a-ni TÚG ú-ma-kál lá ta-kà-lá
target: The very day you hear my letter do not hold back the textile a single day.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi-ma <gap> a-na qá-tí ú-ku dí-in <gap>-nu ku-nu-ki-a
target: To Ali-ahum: <gap> give <gap> to Uku <gap> under my seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.5 ma-na 2 GÍN i ṭup-pì-im lá-pì-it
target: For 1 mina 32 shekels he has been registered on the tablet.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.8333 ma-na a qá-tí-a ta-dí
target: 1.8333 mina you deposited as my share.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠU.NÍGIN 3 ma-na šu-mì ku-ni-lim É kà-ri-im lá-pí-it
target: In all 3.5 minas have been booked in Kūn-ilum's name in the colonial office.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-5 ku-ta-ni TA ša É kà-ri-im i-dí-ú-ni
target: Of the 5 -textiles each? that they deposited in the colonial office,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 TÚG ša ku-ni-lúm
target: 2 pieces belong to Kūn-ilum,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ.BA 0.5 TÚG i qá-tí ku-ni-lim ú-ṭá-ḫa
target: thereof I will transfer 0.5 textile from Kūn-ilum's share.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI iš-ma-{d}IŠKUR IGI bu-za-zu
target: Witnessed by Išme-Adad, by Buzāzu.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ša um-ma-ša a-na me-er-i-tí-ša i ba-áb-tim té-zi-bu a-na ḫu-bu-ul a-na a-ḫe-ša a-tù-nu ta-lá-qé-a
target: The silver that her mother left to her daughter as part of the outstanding claims, do you (plur.) want to take it for the debt, for her brothers?

source: translate Akkadian to English: ni-zi-iz-ma i-na a-wa-tim ni-bu-šu-nu-ma iš-tù gám-ru-um
target: We took action and rebutted them by our argumentation.

target: You have 3 shekels of silver, given by me, since the eponymy of Assur-malik, son of Su-Hanis.
