source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na-sú-in ki-ma a-šur-ma-lik DUMU a-lá-ḫi-im um-me-a-ni-šu a-wa-tim ú-ga-me-ru-ma
target: Enna-Suen settled the matter on behalf of his investor Aššur-malik son of Ali-ahum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša 20 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ú ṣí-ba-tí-šu a-lá-ḫu-um a-na iṣ-mì-dí-lim i-ḫi-ib-lu šu-ma ma-ma-an a-na a-lá-ḫi-im i-tù-a-ar i-na-sú-in ki-ma a-šur-ma-lik um-me-a-ni-šu a-na KÙ.BABBAR ù ṣí-ba-tí-šu a-lá-ḫa-am ú-bu-bu-ú
target: So that with respect to the 20 minas of silver plus interest for which Ali-ahum was indebted to Iṣmid-ilum - if anyone raises claim against Ali-ahum, Enna-Suen will clear Ali-ahum for the silver and interest on behalf of his investor Aššur-malik.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pá-am ša ku-nu-uk i-na-sú-in ša a-lá-ḫa-am a-na KÙ.BABBAR ù ṣí-ba-tí-šu ú-bu-bu-ú a-lá-ḫu-um a-na i-na-sú-in i-dí-in-ma i-du-uk
target: Ali-ahum gave a tablet sealed by Enna-Suen, stating that he will clear Ali-ahum for the silver and interest to Enna-Suen, and he has invalidated it.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù ṭup-pá-am ša 20 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ú ṣí-ba-tí-šu a-lá-ḫu-um a-na iṣ-mì-dí-lim i-ḫi-ib-lu i-na-sú-in ṭup-pá-am a-na a-lá-ḫi-im i-dí-ma i-du-uk
target: Also, the tablet stating that Ali-ahum owes 20 minas of silver plus interest to Iṣmid-ilum - Enna-Suen gave (that) tablet to Ali-ahum and he has invalidated it.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ma-na KÙ.KI <gap> DUMU sà-aḫ-ru-da-nim <gap> iš-tù ḥa-mu-uš-tim ša ḥi-na-a a-na 3 ḥa-am-ša-tim i-ša-qal
target: ? minas of <gap> owed by <gap> son of Sahrudannum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma i-na ma-lá u₄-me-šu lá iš-qúl 1.5 GÍN.TA i-na ITU.KAM a-na 1 ma-na-im ú-ṣa-áb
target: If he has not paid at the completion of his term he will add interest at the rate 1.5 shekel per month per mina.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na KÙ.GI 8 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ni-is-ḫa-at KÙ.BABBAR ù KÙ.GI i-na a-lim{ki} sú-in-na-da i-da-an
target: 1 mina of gold, 8 minas of silver - Suen-nādā will give the import duty for the silver and gold in the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša-du-a-sú ša-bu ša en-num-a-šur DUMU sú-in-na-da ša qá-tí ša-ak-na-at-ni a-na sú-in-na-da áp-qí-id-ma
target: Its transport tariff paid - belonging to Ennam-Aššur son of Suen-nādā, on which I have lodged a claim, I have entrusted to Suen-nādā.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ṣé-er Ì-lí-a ù en-num-a-šur ú-bi-il₅
target: And he brought it to Iliya and Ennam-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-ma-am i-ša-ú-mu-ma KÙ.BABBAR-pí uš-ta-ba IGI šu-ku-bi-im IGI PUZUR₄.SA.TU IGI a-šur-DU₁₀ DUMU en-na-ma-nim
target: They heard the report and the silver was brought before Šu-kubim, before Puzur-Satū, before Aššur-tukultī son of Enna-mānum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-dí-da a-la-ḫi-im ú ù-ku-ú qí-bi₄-ma um-ma PUZUR₄-a-šùr-ma
target: To Adida, Ali-ahum and Uku from Puzur-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na 21 ṣú-ba-tí ša li-bi₄-ni ub-la-ni 1 ṣú-ba-ta-am ša a-ki-dí-i a-na IŠTAR-la-ma-sí a-ša-at a-la-ḫi-im dí-na
target: Of the 21 textiles in our posession that he brought give 1 Akkadian textile to Ištar-lamassī, Ali-ahum's wife.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù-ku-ú na-áš-a-ku-nu-tí AN.NA-kam a-na ší-mì-im dí-na-ma šu-ma e-ma-ra-am iḫ-ta-ša-aḫ
target: Uku brings you 4 minas of tin under my seal. Sell the tin and buy him a donkey if he has asked for one.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša-ma-šu-um ṣú-ba-tí-ša ša li-bi₄-ni ub-la-ni 13 ṣú-ba-tí ša e-zi-bu-ú ku-nu-ki-a a-na ú-ku-ú dí-na-ma lu-ub-la-am
target: As to her textiles in our possession that he brought, the 13 textiles that they left, give them to Uku under my seal so he may bring them.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na 4 ma-na AN.NA-ki-im ša ú-ku-ú ub-la-ni e-ma-ra-am ša-ma-ma-a ší-ta <gap>-am me-nu-ni-a-ni ša ma-ma-a ú-ku-ú a-na dur₄-ḫu-mì-it lu-ub-lam
target: Buy a donkey with the 4 minas of tin that Uku brought and let Uku bring two <gap> menuniānus from Mamma to Durhumit.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3.1666 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-šur-i-dí DUMU a-mur-a-šur 2.3333 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša-pá-ar-tim ša a-da-da a ša e-zi-bu-ú 2 GÍN wa-al-dí-lu-um mì-ma a-ni-im a-na qá-tí-šu dí-na-šu-um
target: 3.1666 shekels of silver: Aššur-idī son of Amur-Aššur; 2.3333 shekels of silver, Adada's security for what they left; 2 shekels: Waldi-ilum - give him all this.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-bu-ni i-na bu-ul-ṭí-šu 9 TÚG.ḪI.A a-na be-et kà-ri-im na-dí
target: Our father deposited 9 textiles at the office of the colony while he was alive.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ.BA 2 TÚG.ḪI.A ta-áb-lu
target: Of that 2 textiles have been taken away.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 7 TÚG.ḪI.A a-na qá-tí a-bi-ni ṭá-ḫu-ú
target: 7 textiles are transferred to our father's account.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 TÚG.ḪI.A 38.5 ma-na URUDU SIG₅ ší-im-šu-nu a-lá-ḫu-um a-na qá-tí a-bi-ni i-dí
target: Ali-ahum deposited 3 textiles at the price of 38.5 minas of good copper on our father's account.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 20 ma-na URUDU SIG₅ 1.5 GÍN 22.5 ŠE KÙ.TA ù 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-lá-ḫu-um i-dí
target: Ali-ahum deposited 20 minas of good copper, at the rate in silver 1.5 shekel 22.5 grains, plus 10 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lá tù-šé-bi-lá-ma a-dí a-we-LAM ba-al-ṭù iš-tí-šu lá a-na-me-er
target: You sent to me and I shall not meet with the man while he is (still) alive.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu-qú-tí-kà ba-tí-iq ú-tù-ur a-da-a-ma ú KÙ.BABBAR ma-lá i-na ba-a-ba-tí-kà a-ma-ḫu-ru lá-li-kam-ma a-ma-kam e-né-kà lá-a-mu-ur
target: I shall sell your goods at any price and then I shall come (with) what silver I receive from your outstanding claims, and I shall see your eye there.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tí-kà lá+lá-<gap> ú i-na re-ší-kà lá-zi-iz
target: with you and serve you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ša URUDU ší-kam ú ma-sí-am né-pé-ša-am a-né-pé-ší-im ú-ru-ú-ni gi-mì-li-a ta-aḫ-bu-lu-šu-ni lá ša ší mu ni
target: Since they bring šikku-copper and washed copper, one package after another, you owe him favours for me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ku-li-a qí-bi-ma um-ma ḫu-na-ḫu-na a-na-aḫ-DINGIR ú PÚZUR-a-šur i-li-ku-nim
target: To Kuliya, thus says hunahuna: Anah-ilī and Puzur-Aššur came here.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR 1.3333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša a-na-aḫ-DINGIR i-ḫi-ib-lu PÚZUR-a-šur áš-ra-kam-ma 14 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ip-ta-an 1 ma-na 6 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na ša-ni-im pá-qí-id
target: As for the silver, 1.3333 mina of silver for which Anah-ilī had become indebted, over there Puzur-Aššur consumed (for) 14 shekels of silver, (the rest) 1 mina 6 shekels has been entrusted to somebody else.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-na-aḫ-ì-lí-ma DUB ša ku-nu-ki-a bi-lá-nim-ma KÙ.BABBAR li-qí-a DUB a-na-ku lá a-mu-a ú-šu-ra-am
target: Anah-ilī said: Bring me the tablet with my seal then take the silver. But I refused to release that tablet.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma en-na-na-tum ri-ig-ma-am lá ni-na-dí DUMU i-na-a lá i-ša-me-e ni-ip-lá-aḫ-ma e-na-na-tum ú a-na-ku ḫu-ur-šam ni-ip-té-e-ma i-na ta-ma-lá-ki-kà ṭup-pá-am ša ku-nu-ki-šu nu-šé-li-ma ni-dí-šu-um
target: Ennānātum said: We will not file a complaint lest Innaya's son hears about it. Since we became afraid, Ennānātum and I myself, we opened the storeroom and took out of your tablet coffer the tablet with his seal, which we gave him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na 6 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na-ku ú-kà-al
target: The 1 mina 6 shekels of silver I have in my possession.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 na-áš-pè-ra-tí-kà lá i-dí-nam ú a-na-ku DUB ša a-šur-DU₁₀ lá ú-šé-er-šu-um
target: Since he did not give me your two letters I also did not release to him the tablet of Aššur-ṭāb.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ma-ma-an i-na ša-zu-za-tí-kà lá i-zi-iz
target: Not one of your representatives came into action.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù ṣú-ḫa-ru-ú i-li-ku-ni-ni ur-ki KÙ.BABBAR e-na-na-tim i-sà-ḫu-ru-ú mì-ma i qá-tí-šu lá i-ba-ší 1 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ta-da-nam lá i-le-e
target: When the servants had come here, they were looking for the silver of Ennānātum, but he had absolutely nothing available (and) he was unable to give even 1 single shekel of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ma-lá-kà 4 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na-ku al-qé
target: It is now up to you. I myself obtained 4 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-be-lúm-ma a-na lá-qé-ep ú a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi-ma
target: From Šu-Bēlum to Lā-qēp? and Ali-ahum:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 15 TÚG ṣú-ba-tí wa-ší-ib-ru-ba-ni na-áš-a-ku-nu-tí 2 ma-áš-ku-nu
target: Wašibru-bāni brings you 15 textiles (and) 2 covers.

source: translate Akkadian to English: <gap>-5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ig-ri-šu dí-na-šu
target: Give him his wages, <gap>-5 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 20 ma-na SÍG.ḪI.A ša ša-zu-a a-na i-sú-ri-ik dí-na-ma a-na ḫu-ur-ší-kà lu-bi-il₅
target: Give 20 minas of wool belonging to Šazuwa to Issu-arik and let him bring it to your store-room.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša-lim-be-lí ša-dí-na
target: Make Šalim-bēli give 4 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR dì-na-ma sà-ḫi-ir-tám ša-ma-šu-um
target: Give 1 shekel of silver and buy small goods for him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ku-li-a qí-bi-ma um-ma a-sà-num-ma
target: To Kuliya, thus says Asānum:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-a dam-qá-tù-šu ša al-pì-lí ša i-na té-ga-ra-ma ú-ta-mì-ú pa-ar-sà-ti-kà a-wa-tim u-šé-ṣí-i
target: Really, this is the friendliness of Alpilī whom I made swear an oath in Tegarama - he has disclosed confidential matters of you,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú šu-um-ka SIG₅ ṭá-pu-ul ú a-na-ku iš-tí-kà-ma ṭá-pu-lá-ku
target: and also your good reputation has been besmirched and I have been besmirched together with you!

source: translate Akkadian to English: aq-bi-a-ku-um um-ma a-na-ku-ma a-wa-tí-kà al-pì-lí lá tù-lá-ma-ad
target: I had told you: Do not inform Alpilī about your affairs,

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-wa-sú ú-ZA-AD a-bi a-ta be-lí a-ta lá ta-qá-bi um-ma a-ta-ma i-qí-in-im a-šu-mì ta-pá-i-šu-ú na-áš-pè-er-tám uš-té-bi-lam
target: Please my father, my lord, do not think: "Out of jealousy he has sent me a letter about his partner!"

source: translate Akkadian to English: ma-di-iš li-bi-i im-ra-aṣ
target: He has really hurt me terribly.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tim ša a-áš-ta-me-ú a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim DINGIR lu i-de₈ a-na al-pì-lí
target: For the rumors I keep hearing, for these matters god be my witness against Alpilī!

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-ut-ma a-na am-tí-kà-ma <gap> lá i-ba-ší i-na <gap> 2-ší-ta a-ša-tám da-mì-iq-tám ku-li-a e-ḫa-az
target: He said to your maid: "There is no <gap> available. Of the two <gap> Kuliya will marry one as a fine wife."

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na <gap> am-tí-kà ka-lá-ší-na-ma tù-ba-lá-ku-um li-ba-kà lá i-na-ḫi-id
target: Of / with the <gap> if your maid, all of them(fem.) she will bring to you. Don't be worried."

source: translate Akkadian to English: e-lá-an 3 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR mì-ma wa-at-ra-am lá i-dí-ší-im
target: Apart from 3 shekels of silver he gave her nothing extra

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú ša a-da-<gap>-tim mì-ma lá i-dí-ší-im
target: and he also did not give he any <gap>

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú a-ma-tum ra-qá-ma uš-ba ú li-bi₄-ša ki-ma mì-ma lá i-dí-nu-ší-ni iš-té-né-ú-ma
target: Moreover, the slave-girls are idle and do nothing. And because he gave her nothing they keep looking for <gap>

source: translate Akkadian to English: LU a-na ku <gap> ú li-ba-ša da-ni-ša-ma ma-ri-i
target: and she is very angry.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ku-zi-zi-a a-šur-ma-lik ù a-mur-IŠTAR a-na a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi-ma
target: From Kiziziya, Aššur-malik and Amur-Ištar to Ali-ahum:

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na 20 TÚG.ḪI.A 5 TÚG.ḪI.A a-na 5 GÚ 50 ma-na URUDU ší-ki-im ù 1 TÚG a-na 3.3333 GÍN KÙ.GI ku-zi-zi-a i-dí-in
target: Kiziziya has sold 5 textiles out of the 20 textiles for 5 talents of 50 minas of šikku-copper and 1 textile for 3.3333 shekels of gold;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 TÚG.ḪI.A a-na 1 GÚ 10 ma-na URUDU ma-sí-im a-mur-IŠTAR i-dí-in
target: Amur-Ištar sold 2 textiles for 1 talent 10 minas of washed copper;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 6 TÚG.ḪI.A a-na 2.3333 ma-na 4 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ni-dí-in i-na ŠÀ.BA 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR šu-ḫu-bur ub-lá-ku-um 2.3333 ma-na 4 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ku-nu-ki-ni ù 3.3333 GÍN KÙ.GI ku-nu-ki ša ku-zi-zi-a
target: we sold 6 textiles for 2.3333 minas 4 shekels of silver under our seals and 3.3333 shekels of gold under Kuziziya's seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-zu na-áš-a-kum ší-tí URUDU 5 GÚ 12 ma-na URUDU
target: The rest of the copper is 5 talents 12 minas.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-mur-IŠTAR ú ì-lí-áš-ra-ni sú-ub-ra-am iš-ú-mu-ma a-na du-ur-ḫu-mì-it i-ta-al-ku
target: Amur-Ištar and Ilī-ašrannī has bought a slave and have left for Durhumit.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-kam lu-ba-li-ṭá-kum
target: He should credit it to you there.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 ma-na URUDU a-na ša TÚG.ḪI.A ub-lá-ni a-na ma-ri-it-ḫi-im a-mur-IŠTAR i-dí-in
target: Amur-Ištar gave 5 minas of copper to the one who brought the textiles to Marithum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-tí TÚG.ḪI-ba-tí-kà 6 a-zu na-áš-a-kum
target: Azu brings you the rest of your textiles: 6 pieces.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṣú-ba-tù-kà gám-ru-ni-kum
target: Your textiles have been sold for you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 GÚ URUDU ší-ku-um ší-im 4 TÚG.ḪI.A ša en-um-a-šur i-na li-bi₄ ku-zi-zi-a
target: 2 talents of šikku-copper, the price of 4 textiles belonging to Ennam-Aššur, is in Kuziziya's possession.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-zu
target: 2 shekels of silver: Azu

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR šu-ku-bu-um me-ra-šu
target: 4 shekels of silver: Šu-Kūbum, his son

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi₄-ma um-ma SIG₅-pí-a-šur ú PUZUR₄-a-šur-ma
target: To Ali-ahum from Damiq-pī-Aššur and Puzur-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam ki-ma ni-iš-ta-na-me-ú ma-tum da-al-ḫa-at-ni ú tí-ir-tí kà-ri-im da-na-at-ni
target: When we heard repeatedly here that the land is in uproar and that the orders of the colony are strict,

source: translate Akkadian to English: tí-ir-tí-ni a-dí ma-lá ú ší-ni-šu i-li-kà-ku-um
target: we sent word to you once or twice.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ta ú-za-ni-ma lá ta-áp-té-té-e
target: But you have not informed us.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-kam ki-ma ša-lu-um KÙ.BABBAR 1 ma-na.TA ša na-áš-a-ni-ni šu-ma ḫa-ra-an sú-ki-ni-im ša-al-ma-at tí-ir-ta-kà li-li-kam ú-za-ni pì-té
target: There, for the sake of the safety of every mina of silver that we bring, send us word and inform us whether the Narrow Track is safe.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu i-na ma-ṣa-ra-tim AN.NA 10 ma-na nu-šé-ra-ba-am tí-ir-ta-kà li-li-kam-ma a-na tí-ir-tí-ni i-ḫi-id
target: Send word whether we shall let some 10 minas of tin enter the guard-posts, and pay attention to our instructions.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a-na pá-ni-ni šé-bi₄-lá-am ú i-na qé-er-bi₄-ma 10 ma-na URUDU SIG₅ ša <gap> KÙ.BABBAR ṣí-pá-ra-tim <gap> e-ki-im za-áp-ru-tim šé-bi₄-lam
target: Send 2 minas of silver to us en route and send 10 minas of good copper included, for <gap> silver send bronze nails and zapru <gap>

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB du-du-li GAL ma-ḫi-ri-im
target: Seal of Duduli, head of the market,

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ma-ma-ḫi-ir-ma a-na en-nam-a-šur qí-bi₄-ma
target: From Man-mahir to Ennam-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 GÚ 20 ma-na URUDU ma-sí-am SIG₅ a-ni-na DUMU a-šur-be-el-a-wa-tim ub-lam
target: Annina son of Aššur-bēl-awātim brought 1 talent 20 minas of washed fine copper.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-šu a-na a-bi₄-kà e-zi-ib
target: He left his tablet for your father.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù a-na-ku 1 ma-na 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ḫa-bu-lá-ak-šu-um
target: Also, I personally owe him 1 mina 10 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ku-nu-ki-a šé-lu-um-ar-dí na-áš-a-kum
target: Šalim-wardī brings you the 1 mina 10 shekels of silver under my seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-kam a-ni-na URUDU ú ṣí-ba-sú li-iš-qú-lá-kum-ma
target: Have Annina pay you the copper and its accrued interest there,

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ú ṣí-ba-sú šu-qú-ul-ma URUDU
target: and the silver and its accrued interest, and the copper

source: translate Akkadian to English: ma-na GÍN KÙ.BABBAR SIG₅-pì-a-šur ù ku um-ma a-mur-IŠTAR-ma 1 TÚG ma-na.TA áš ku kà ni-dí-in
target: minas shekels of silver Damiq-pī-Aššur and Amur-Ištar said: We sold 1 textile worth mina

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-kam URUDU SIG₅-pì-a-šur li-iš-qú-lá-kum
target: Let Damiq-pī-Aššur pay you the copper there.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na {d}UTU-ši ṭup-pì ta-ša-me-ú tí-ib-a-ma a-tal-kam ù lu ni-iz-ku
target: The very day you hear my letter you should set out and come and then let us settle accounts.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša 11 GÚ URUDU SIG₅ ṭup-pu-šu ḫa-ar-ma-am ša DU₁₀-ṣí-lá-a-šur a-na a-bi₄-kà
target: For 11 talents of good copper the certified tablet that Ṭāb-ṣill-Aššur to your father

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 ma-na 8 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR e-lá-ma ù ša-lim-a-ḫu-um 0.5 ma-na 3.5 GÍN e-lá-ma i-na ILLAT id-na-a ì-lí-a-lim ù a-šùr-i-dí i-na É.GAL-lim na-ad-ú
target: 2 minas 8 shekels of silver (of) Elamma and Šalim-ahum, 93.5 shekels (of silver) of Elamma from the caravan of Idnaya, Ilī-ālum and Aššur-idī have deposited in the palace.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4.6666 ma-na e-lá-ma ù a-la-ḫu-um i-na ILLAT lá-qé-ep DUMU qá-a-tim na-ad-ú
target: 4.6666 minas Elamma and Ali-ahum have deposited in the caravan of Lā-qēp, son of Qa'atum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2.5 ma-na 8 GÍN e-lá-ma ḫi-na-a ù a-šùr-kà-ší-id i-na ILLAT šu-a-nim ad-mu-ú
target: 2 minas 38 shekels (of silver) Elamma, hinnāya and Aššur-kašid have as share in the caravan of Šu-Anum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 15.25 GÍN e-lá-ma i-na ILLAT a-lá-ḫi-im ù bu-zi-a a-dí-im
target: 15 1 / 4 shekels Elamma has as share in the caravan of Ali-ahum and Buṣiya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 ma-na 8 sa e-lá-ma i-na ILLAT a-zu-za ù a-šùr-iš-tí-kál a-dí-im
target: 2 minas 8 shekels Elamma has as share in the caravan of Azuza and Iliš-tikal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 ma-na LÁ 2 GÍN i-na ILLAT pu-šu-ke-en₆ ad-ma-ku
target: 4 minas minus 2 shekels I have as share in the caravan of Pūšu-kēn.

target: Say to Elamma, thus Aššur-rē'ī:

source: translate Akkadian to English: ta-áš-pu-ra-am um-ma a-ta-ma ṭup-pé-e na-áš-pá-ra-tim ša iš-tù a-lim{ki} tù-šé-ṣí-a-ni šé-bi-lam

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pé-e na-áš-pá-ra-tim ša da-dí-a ù en-um-a-šùr šu-mì-a-bi-a na-áš-a-kum
target: Šumi-abiya is on his way with the tablets with letters of Dadiya and Ennam-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-um ša ṣú-ḫa-ar-tim i-li-kam um-ma ší-it-ma a mì-nim ṭup-pá-am lá i-dí-na-kum a-ta <gap>-um a-lik-ma <gap>-tù at-wu-šu-um
target: A letter of the girl here in which she wrote: 'Why did you the tablet? You <gap> go and <gap> talk with him!'

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù ITU.3.KAM áš-pu-ra-kum um-ma a-na-ku-ma KÙ.BABBAR še-bi-lam
target: I wrote you three months ago asking, send me silver!

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma a-bi a-ta 1 ù 2 ma-na KI a-li-ki-im pá-nim-ma šé-bi-lam-ma šu-qá-al-kà lá i-pá-ṭá-ar-ma ù li-ba-kà lá i-lá-mì-in

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí a-lu-ku-ni-ma ṣú-ba-tí-a ú-za-kà-ni ú iš-tí a-we-el-tim a-za-zu-ma ù KÙ.BABBAR-áp-kà a ni-ir-tí-kà ú-qá-ra-áb
target: Before I leave and clear my textiles and also stand by the lady, then I shall have your silver delivered directly to your person.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí-i KÙ.BABBAR-pì-im a-ni-e-em a-na-kam sà-aḫ-ra-a-ku
target: Because of this silver I have been delayed here.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 me-at 73 ku-ta-nu i-na É.GAL-lim ur-du-nim
target: 173 -textiles (that) came down from the palace.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 7 TÚG ša li-wi-tim 1 TÚG ša ik-ri-bi₄-a ša DUMU šál-maḫ ub-lá-ni
target: 7 textiles as wrapping, 1 textile of my temple-fund, is what Šalim-ahum's son brought me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú-ra-dí 6 TÚG ša a-šur-mu-ta-pí-il₅ ub-lá-ni
target: I added 6 textiles that Aššur-mūtappil brought me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠU.NÍGIN me-at 97 TÚG
target: In all 197 textiles.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ.BA 7 TÚG ku-ta-ni la-ma-sú-tum ta-al-qé

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 TÚG ša be-ú-lá-at PUZUR₄-a-na
target: 3 textiles of the working capital of Puzur-Anna.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 TÚG ša be-ú-lá-at a-šur-ba-ni
target: 3 textiles of the working capital of Aššur-bāni.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 TÚG a-šur-mu-ta-pì-il₅ il₅-qé
target: 2 textiles Aššur-mūtappil took.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-tí TÚG.ḪI.A 1 me-at 80 TÚG
target: The rest of the textiles: 180 pieces.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ku-da-tum ú ma-ma-ḫi-ir-ma a-na e-nam-a-šur qí-bi₄-ma
target: From Kudātum and Man-mahir to Ennam-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-kam KÙ.BABBAR li-iš-qú-lá-ku-ma ú ṭup-pá-áš-nu dí-in
target: Have them pay the silver there to you and then give them their tablet.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ša-lim-a-šùr-ma a-na a-šùr-iš-tí-kál en-na-nim en-um-a-šùr DUMU ú-zu-a ù en-um-a-šùr qí-bi-ma
target: From Šalim-Aššur to Aššuriš-tikal, Ennānum, Ennam-Aššur son of Uzuwa and Ennam-Aššur:

target: When the price (for tin) stood at 1:17 I bought at 1:15; the tin is cleared.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù iš-tí ší-tí KÙ.BABBAR ša lu-qú-tí-a lu KÙ.BABBAR ša ba-a-ba-tí-a en-um-a-šùr lu-za-ki-a-ma
target: And let Ennam-Aššur clear it together with the rest of the silver from my goods and the silver from my outstanding claims.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ḫa-ra-ni er-sú-a-at
target: My caravan is ready.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫu-a a-tù-nu iḫ-da-ma ḫa-ra-nam a-na ṣú-ḫa-ri-im dí-na-ma ù i-a-tí ḫa-ra-nam dí-na-nim
target: My dear brothers, take care to give a caravan to the servant, and then give me a caravan as well.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 li-im 8 me-at 50 URUDU iš-tí ma-ar ša-té-a ú ru-tí-a ša zi-da-ni

target: Let Ennam-Aššur and Aluwa confirm (it to) him.

target: 1.5 mina of silver and 3 beads of gold owed by Nanahi on top of <gap>.

target: Concerning the 18 shekels of silver which Šamaš-ennam brought to you for Kukkulānum and Kutaya - further, 1.5 shekel for his sacrifice - in all, 0.3333 minas less 0.5 shekel of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ma lá tù-šé-ba-al-šu-um
target: Do not send him any silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-ma-am ša-a-ma a-na {d}UTU-e-nam dí-in-ma lu-ub-lam
target: Make purchases and give them to Šamaš-ennam so he may bring it.

target: Send me word how much silver Alulaya's representatives paid you.

target: As to my tablet which Kulumaya holds, if you have recovered it, then split (the envelope), seal it (again) and send it.

target: 20.6666 minas of tin, thereof 3 blocks their weight was 15 minas.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ma ú-lá na-ak-sá
target: Nothing was cut off.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú 1 li-um 4.66667 ma-na i-na ku-nu-ki-a kà-ni-ik
target: Also one ingot of 4.6666 minas was sealed by my seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-šu-mì a-ḫa-i ší-ta-am na-áš-ú-ni
target: On behalf of Aha'i they bring the rest.

source: translate Akkadian to English: pá-ḫi-ir-šu-ma ú-lá ak-nu-uk
target: gathered it but I did not seal it.

target: Šamaš-taklāku and Ennam-Aššur bring it to you.

target: I promised them 5 shekels as wages.

target: When they give you the tin, you then give them the silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na en-um-a-šur qí-bi₄-ma um-ma a-na-a-na-ma

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ša ag-mu-ru ŠÀ.BA lá-pu-ut
target: In it is noted the silver I spent.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ta-lá-né-en 2-ni-šu šu-ḫu-pá-ta-an mu-sà-ra-am 3-ší-šu ša-ḫi-ra-an 2 iš-ra-an ri-iš-tám qá-ar-nam ú <gap>-i 15 du-ul-ba-tum ú mu-lu-ḫu-um
target: 1 pair of two pairs of boots, 1 belt, 3 pairs of -shoes, 2 scarves, a first-class horn (of oil) <gap> 15 logs of plane tree and -wood.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ma a-nim ṣú-ḫa-ri ú-šé-bi₄-lam
target: All this I sent to you with my servants.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-tur₄-DINGIR ḫa-ra-šu a-na a-lim{ki} ek-pá-at
target: As for Itūr-ilī, his journey to the City is getting close.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma mì-ma ri-ik-sú-um É-tí-šu i-ba-ší tí-ir-tí-kà li-li-kam-ma ik áš-pu-ra-kum
target: Send me word whether there are any bundles in his house and make up your mind.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-na-ku-ma ki-ma ṣú-ḫa-ru e-ru-bu-ni-ni ma-ma-an i ša-ḫa-tí-a lá-šu
target: I wrote to you, saying: Since the servants have entered there is no one to assist me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-pu-tum i-na ša-am-ší ṭup-pì ta-ša-me-ú 5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ku-nu-uk-ma ku-nu-ki-kà 1 ṣú-ḫa-ru-um lu-ub-lam
target: Urgent, the very day you hear my letter, seal 5 minas of silver and let one servant bring it under your seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam nu-a-ú a ṣí-ib-tim e-ta-na-ri-šu-ni i-na-sú-in
target: Here the natives keep demanding (silver) at interest from me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i ḫu-ra-ma wa-ša-áb a-lá-ḫu-um a-ḫu-kà iš-tí-kà a-ša-áp-ru-sí-im i-za-az
target: Enna-Suen lives in hurama. Ali-ahum, your brother, is ready to separate (him) from you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: tí-ir-ta-kà a-wa-tim SIG₅-tim a-na a-mur-IŠTAR šé-bi₄-lam
target: Send word with good news to Amur-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma en-nam-IŠTAR-ma a-na en-nam-a-šùr qí-bi-ma
target: From Ennnam-Ištar to Ennam-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: ma-aḫ-ri-kà-ma i-na bu-ru-uš-ḫa-dim 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na a-šùr-DU₁₀ a-dí-in
target: In your presence in Burušhaddum I gave 10 shekels of silver to Aššur-ṭāb.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na kà-ni-iš iš-tí-in TÚG ku-ta-nam a-dí-šu-um
target: In Kanesh I gave him a single -textile.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR aṣ-ba-sú-ma ma-lá ú 2 ší-ni-šu um-ma šu-ut-ma me-ra-ki il₅-qé
target: I seized him for 2 shekels of silver, but once or twice he answered: Your son received it.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma KÙ.BABBAR tal-qé lá tal-qé té-er-ta-kà li-li-kam
target: Send me word whether or not you have received the silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ma-aḫ-ri-kà-ma a-na be-lu-ba-ni GÉME lá e-zi-ib
target: Also in your presence, did I not leave a slave-girl to Bēlum-bāni?

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR 10 GÍN a-ḫu-ur ṣa-ba-sú-ma KÙ.BABBAR ša-áš-qí-il₅-šu
target: 10 shekels of silver remain unpaid. Seize him and have him pay the silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma na-ḫi-iš-tum-ma a-na en-um-a-šùr
target: From Nahištum to Ennam-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: ku-da-tum ra-qá-tám na-áš-a-kum
target: Kudātum brings you a thin textile.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR da-mì-qá-am ší-im ra-qí-tim i-ší-ma-tim
target: Sell it profitably for me in silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša a-bi-kà a-ta a-lá-ḫu-um ú lá-ma-sí a-dí lá-ma-sí ba-al-ṭá-at-ni <gap> lá i-ša-ku-nu
target: The proceeds from the thin textile you, Ali-ahum and Lamassī should not claim in the context of the will of your father as long as Lamassī is alive.

source: translate Akkadian to English: TÚG ku-ta-nam ú iš-tí-it iš-ra-am a-šùr-DU₁₀ ub-lá-kum
target: Aššur-ṭāb brought you 1 -textile and a single belt.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB šu-be-lim KIŠIB a-šur-i-dí ša e-lá-ma šu-IŠTAR ba-áb ḫa-ra-ni-šu iṣ-bu-tù-ma
target: Seal of Šu-Bēlum, seal of Aššur-idī, (confirming) that Elamma seized Šu-Ištar when he was about to go on a journey.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma e-lá-ma-ma 12.5 ma-na 7.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am i-na e-ra-bi₄-kà i-na wa-aḫ-šu-ša-na šé-bi₄-lam
target: And that Elamma said to him: 12 minas and 37.5 shekels of refined silver you must send me when you enter Wahšušana.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù ša ší-ti AN.NA-ki-a i-na bu-ru-uš-ḫa-tim i-na e-ra-bi₄-kà-ma šé-bi₄-lam
target: And what (is due) for the remainder of my tin you must send me when you enter Burušhattum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma lá tù-šé-bi₄-lam <gap> a-na URUDU SIG₅ <gap>-kà a-lá-qé
target: If you fail to do so, <gap> for refined copper shall I take your <gap>?

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-IŠTAR-ma li-qé
target: Šu-Ištar answered: "Take it".

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠU.NÍGIN KÙ.BABBAR-pì-kà 15 ma-na 10 GÍN
target: Total of your silver: 15 minas 10 shekels.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu ša AN.NA ú ṣú-ba-tí-kà ku-nu-ki-ni ṣí-li-a na-áš-a-ku-um

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma e-lá-ma-ma a-na a-šùr-DU₁₀ qí-bi-ma

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam-ma ú-na-ḫi-id-kà um-ma a-na-ku-ma KÙ.BABBAR 1 ma-na ma-lá tù-tù-ú pá-ni-a-ma šé-bí-lam
target: It was here that I gave you the following instruction: 'Send me every mina of silver as soon as you find it.'

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ma-lá i qá-tí-kà i-ba-ší-ú <gap>-kà-ma a-ta ki-lá
target: All the silver you have already available you must retain.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 6 TÚG.ḪI.A káb-tù-tim SIG₅ <gap> ša šu-bi-ri-im ku-ni-lúm na-áš-a-kum
target: 6.3333 heavy textiles, of good quality, of Šubarean make, Kūn-ilum is bringing you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mu-dí-a-am ZI-lá-tí-a-am ṣa-ba-at-ma ṭù-ri-šu-nu lu-ša-dí-id-ma a-ni-ib-ra-re lu-sí-ma-ku-šu-nu-ma ma-lá KÙ.BABBAR 1 GÍN tù-šé-lu-ú
target: Get hold of a specialist from Zilat and let him stretch their yarns and make them suitable for you for / as -garments, so that you can realize at least some silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu-bu-šé ra-qá-tim ù šu-lu-up-ki-e iš-tí wa-ar-ki-ú-tim ú-šé-ba-lá-kum
target: With the next shipment I will send you garments, thin textiles and Šulupkian textiles.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu šu-ul-ḫu lu ma-ku-ḫu ša a-ma-kam ṭá-áb-ú-ku-um a-mu-ur-ma té-er-ta-kà li-li-kam-ma
target: Look out for - or -textiles over there that please you and let your report come to me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i ḫa-ra-an ḫa-ra-ma ta <gap> a-ta ANŠE <gap> li-ta-lu-ku-ni-ma KÙ.BABBAR 1 GÍN li-li-am
target: And let with every single caravan <gap> regularly come to me, so that at least some silver becomes available to me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB šu-ku-bi-im DUMU qá-a-tim

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB en-nam-a-šur DUMU ú-sà-ri-a
target: Seal of Ennam-Aššur, son of Uṣāriya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB šu-IŠTAR DUMU da-da-nim
target: Seal of Šu-Ištar, son of Dadānum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB a-šur-lá-ma-sí ša 1 me-at 5 TÚG ku-ta-nu 4 GÚ 20 ma-na AN.NA ku-nu-ki 40 ma-na AN.NA qá-tim 13 TÚG šu-ru-tum qá-dum ša li-wi-tim 6 ANŠE 4 TÚG ku-ta-ni ša kà-ṣa-ri 1 TÚG ku-ta-nu ša ì-lí-a mì-ma a-nim a-na lá-qé-pí-im ni-ip-qí-id
target: Seal of Aššur-lamassī, concerning 105 textiles, 4 talents 20 minas of tin under seals, 40 minas of loose tin, 13 dark textiles, including those for wrapping, 6 donkeys, 4 textiles of the transporters, 1 textile of Iliya - all this we entrusted to Lā-qēpum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na en-um-a-šùr da-dí-a ḫi-na-a i-dí-a-bi₄-im a-ku-a ù a-ta-a qí-bi₄-ma um-ma e-la-ma-ma
target: To Ennam-Aššur, Dadiya, hinnāya, Iddin-abum, Akūa and Ataya, say, thus Elamma:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na lu-qú-tí-ku-nu AN.NA ú TÚG.ḪI.A ša ì-lí-a-lúm ir-de₈-a-ni i-nu-mì ni-mì-ig-ru-ma AN.NA ú TÚG.ḪI.A al-qé-ú
target: As for your merchandise, tin and textiles, which Ilī-ālum brought here, when we had reached an agreement and I had taken the tin and textiles,

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma kà-ru-um ša-du-a-tám il₅-té-qé i-na KÙ.BABBAR-áp ì-lí-a i-na ša na-ru-qí-šu la-qé-ep lá-qá-am qá-bi-a-ku
target: I was authorized, if the colony levied the the -tax, to take it from Iliya's silver, that of his joint-stock fund (managed by?) La-qēp.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pá-ak-nu ḫa-ar-ma-am ú-kà-al
target: I have in my possession a valid record of yours (to that effect).

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam a-na kà-ri-im a-tù-ur um-ma a-na-ku-ma lu-qú-tum i-a-tum mì-šu-um ša-du-a-tám tù-ša-dí-a
target: Here I turned to the colony and I declared: 'The merchandise belongs to me, why have you levied -tax?'

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-nu-ma lu-qú-tum a-na ša ì-lí-a ša-ak-na-at-ma nu-ša-dí
target: They answered: 'The merchandise has been joined to that of Iliya and therefore we levied it.'

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-na-ku-ma lá-at-ma lu-qú-tum lu i-a-tù-ni ú a-le-ma a-na kà-ri-im ša-du-a-tám il₅-té-qé-ú ú-la ig-da-am-lu-ni
target: I said: 'I am ready to swear that the merchandise is truly mine!' But, wherever they collected the tax for the colony they have not obliged me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 36 ma-na AN.NA il₅-qé-ú ŠÀ.BA 6 ma-na ki-iš-da-at ku-ni-lim ú-ṣa-ḫe-er
target: They took 36 minas of tin from which I deducted 6 minas that were for Kūn-ilum's account.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫu-ú-a a-tù-nu 30 ma-na AN.NA ma-lá dá-tí-šu mu-ṭé-e-šu ú ni-is-ḫa-tí-šu i pá-ni-ma šé-bi₄-lá-nim-ma
target: Please, my brothers, send me with the first opportunity 30 minas of tin, as much as amounts to its road-tax, its underweight and the import-tax on it,

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam i KÙ.BABBAR-pì-ku-nu lá a-lá-qé mì-šu-um áš-ta-na-pá-ra-ku-nu-tí-ma šé-bu-lam l
target: so that I do not have to take it from your silver here. Why must I write you time and again, while you refuse to send it?

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB a-šur-e-mu-qí KIŠIB en-nam-a-šùr DUMU me-na-a KIŠIB i-dí-a-bi-im
target: Seal of Aššur-emūqī, seal of Ennam-Aššur s. of Menaya, seal of Iddin-abum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša ḫu-bu-ul i-dí-a-bi₄-im 13.3333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pu-um
target: Concerning Iddin-abum's debt of 13.3333 minas of refined silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: u₄-mu-šu ma-al-ú
target: His term has expired.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB šu-nu-nu DUMU a-mur-IŠTAR KIŠIB zi-ki-ki DUMU a-šur-SIPA KIŠIB a-bu-ša-lim DUMU PUZUR₄.IŠTAR
target: Seal of Šu-Nūnu son of Amur-Ištar, seal of Zikiki son of Aššur-rē'ī, seal of Abu-šalim son of Puzur-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 6 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am i-ṣé-er a-bu-ša-lim i-ri-šum i-šu
target: Abu-šalim owes 6 shekels of refined silver to Irišum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na bu-qú-nim i-ša-qal
target: He will pay at the shearing.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma lá iš-qúl 0.1666 GÍN.TA i-na ITU.KAM ú-ṣa-áb
target: If he has not paid, he will add 1 / 6 shekel per month.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-lá-ḫi-im ù a-ni-na qí-bi-ma um-ma a-šùr-ma-lik-ma
target: To Ali-ahum and Annina from Aššur-malik:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 8.6666 ma-na KÙ ku-nu-ki-a ú-ṣur-ša-a-šùr DUMU a-ta-ta na-áš-a-ku-nu-tí
target: Uṣur-ša-Aššur son of Atata brings you 8.6666 minas of silver under my seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR a-dí a-lá-kà-ni a-šar a-lá-ḫi-im li-ib-ší
target: The silver should remain with Ali-ahum until I arrive.

target: a textile <gap> they should bring to them.

target: To Abī-baštī, Mannumma, Bēliya and Ennam-Aššur from Ennam-Aššur and Anna-anna; specifically to Abī-baštī.

target: 2 leather bags of two talents each, and 9 leather bags of one talent each, in all 11 leather bags of (in all) 13 talents.

source: translate Akkadian to English: The washed copper had been packed, and my maid Anna-anna entrusted it to you (fem.) under her seal.
target: The washed copper had been packed, and my maid Anna-anna entrusted it to you (fem.) under her seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫa-ma 1 iš-té-et i-lá-am ku-nu-ki-a wa-ar-kà-num ub-lu-ni-ki-im
target: Moreover, later they brought you one leather bag under my seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú 45 ma-na URUDU SIG₅ ša a-ba-ba i-dí-na-ni ku-nu-ki-a a-na en-um-a-šur e-zi-ib
target: Also, the 45 minas of good copper that Ababa gave me I left under my seal for Ennam-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam KÙ.BABBAR-áp-šu ša-bu-ú-at
target: Here she has been paid its price in silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: URUDU-i-a 14 GÚ 45.5 ma-na i-na 13 i-lá-tim ku-nu-ki-ni a-na a-bi₄-ba-áš-tí ù en-um-a-šur me-er-i-ki né-zi-ib
target: We left my copper, 14 talents 45.5 minas in 13 leather bags, under our seals, for Abī-baštī and your son Ennam-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí tù-a-ar té-er-tí-ni a-ḫu-a a-tù-nu i-na ša-am-ší ṣú-ḫa-ru-a e-ru-bu-ni-ni URUDU sà-ni-qá-ma URUDU i-na i-lá-tim ma-aḫ-ri-ku-nu li-iš-ku-nu-ma a-na a-bi-ba-áš-tí ku-nu-ki-ku-nu ṣú-ḫa-ru-a lu-ub-lu-nim
target: Until our message is answered - my dear brothers - the very day my servants enter, you must check the copper and they should place the copper in the bags in front of you, and my servants should bring it to Abī-baštī under your seals.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú qú-ul-qú-li li-it-bu-lu-nim u₄-ma-kál lá i-bi₄-tù iḫ-da-ma ṭur-da-ni-šu-nu
target: Also, let them take away the . They should not spend one night. Take care and send them!

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na e-na-aḫ-DINGIR šu-a-šur ù en-um-a-šur qí-bi-ma um-ma ma-ma-ḫi-ir ù šu-ku-tum-ma
target: To Enah-ilī, Šu-Aššur and Ennam-Aššur from Man-mahir and Šukkutum:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 ma-na 15 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša šu-ku-tum a-na DAM.GÀR ḫa-bu-lu ša ṭup-pì-šu ḫa-ar-mì-im KÙ.BABBAR ku-nu-ki ša šu-ki-tim en-um-a-šur na-áš-a-ku-nu-tí
target: As to the 2 minas 15 shekels of silver that Šukkutum owes to the merchant, according to his certified tablet - Ennam-Aššur brings you the silver sealed by Šukkutum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pá-am ša ḫu-bu-li-šu am-ra-ma ma-lá u₄-mu-šu e-tí-qú-ni 2 ta-aḫ-sí-is-té-en₆ pá-tí-té-en₆ lu-up-ta-ma
target: Look at his debt-note and write two open memoranda about how much his terms are in arrears,

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tí-it e-na-aḫ-DINGIR lu-kà-il₅ iš-tí-it šu-a-šur lu-kà-il₅
target: and Enah-ilī should keep one while Šu-Aššur should keep the other.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-nu-mì šu-ku-tum iš-tí tám-kà-ri-im i-na-mu-ru-ú šu-ma li-bu-šu DAM.GÀR ma-lá u₄-mu-šu e-tí-qú-ni ṣí-ib-tám i-ṣé-er šu-ki-tim li-il₅-qé
target: When Šukkutum meets with the merchant, the merchant may, if he wishes to do so, charge interest from Šukkutum in accordance with how much his terms are overdue.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma ṣí-ib-tám lá i-lá-qé gi-mì-li a-na šu-ki-tim li-dí-ma li-ig-mì-il₅-šu
target: If he does not charge interest he will do Šukkutum a real favour.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ša ki-ma DAM.GÀR li-il₅-qé-ú-ma ṭup-pá-am ša ḫu-bu-ul šu-ki-tim šu-a-šur ù en-um-a-šur li-il₅-qé-ú
target: The representatives of the merchant should receive the silver, and Šu-Aššur and Ennam-Aššur must take Šukkutum's debt-note.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-dí-da-ma ù a-lá-ḫu-um-ma a-na lá-ma-sí qí-bi-ma mì-šu ša iš-tù ša-na-at ù ší-ta ša-na-at ni-iš-ta-na-pá-ra-ni-ma ù tí-ir-tám ša É a-bi-ni kà-ša-dam ú-lá ta-le-e-a-ni
target: From Adida and Ali-ahum to Lamassī: Why is it that although we have been writing for both one and two years, yet you are not able to reach a solution to the affair of our father's house?

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù šu-ma ša-zu-za-tum ša i-na ša-ḫa-tí-ki i-za-zu-nu ù a-na té-er-tí-ni ú-lá i-na-ḫi-du ša-ni-ú-tum ša ki-ma šu-nu-tí ú-lá i-ba-ší-ú
target: And if the agents who support you pay no attention to our messages, are there no others instead of them?

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù 3 ša-na-tim en-um-a-šùr lu me-et a-na-kam i-tur₄-DINGIR i-na ba-áb kà-ri-im ki-ma né-ší-im pá-ri-ik-ma ú-lá ni-le-e-ma ší-bi
target: It is in fact 3 years since Ennam-Aššur died. Here Itūr-ilī blocks the gate of the colony like a lion and we are incapable of setting witnesses for the man.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-lá-ḫi-im DUMU ša-lim-a-šur
target: To Ali-ahum son of Šalim-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB zu-ku-a DUMU a-šur-i-dí
target: Seal of Zukuwa son of Aššūr-idī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na i-sú-ri-ik qí-bi-ma um-ma šál-ma-a-šùr-ma
target: To Issu-arik from Šalim-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 15 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am ni-is-ḫa-sú DIRI ša-du-a-sú ša-bu-ú i-na li-bi lu-qú-tí-kà ša šé-ep pu-šu-ki-in ili₅-ba-ni ub-lá-kum
target: Ilī-bāni brought you 15 minas of refined silver, its import duty added, its transport tariff paid for, (the proceeds) from your goods transported by Pūšu-kēn.

source: translate Akkadian to English: AN.NA-kà ša i-ri-šu-um ù a-bu-ša-lim ir-de₈-ú-ni-ni
target: Your tin that Irišum and Abu-šalim conducted here,

source: translate Akkadian to English: e-ri-qá-tum <gap> a-na ma-lá <gap> tí-ir-tí-kà a-na bu-ur-uš-ḫa-dim ú-šé-ru-bu-ma
target: in accordance with your orders they will bring it into Burušhaddum,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR šé-bu-ul-tí en-nam-a-šùr <gap> lim <gap> ṣú-ḫa-ar-tim me-er-a-at-kà KI ma-áš-kà-tí-a ú-šé-ra-a-ku-um
target: and 10 shekels of silver, the consignment of Ennam-Aššur of the girl, your daughter I shall have conducted to you together with my deposits

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù lu-qú-at-kà ú-za-kà-a
target: and then I shall clear your goods.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma kà-ru-um kà-ni-iš-ma a-na ku-li-a ša-qí-il₅ da-tim kà-ri-im té-ga-ra-ma ù a-li i-dí-a-šùr DUMU ku-ku-lá-nim wa-áš-bu-ni qí-bi-ma
target: Thus karum Kanesh, speak to Kuliya, the datu-payers, karum Tegarama, and wherever Iddin-Aššur son of Kukulānum is staying.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ni-kà-sí ni-sí-ma 25 ma-na 4.25 GÍN da-tám ni-iš-qúl
target: We have settled accounts and we paid 25 minas and 4 1/4 shekels (of silver) as datum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-dí-a-šùr a-na ni-kà-sí kà-ší-id
target: Iddin-Aššur is liable for the settlement of accounts.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù 5 ša-na-tim a-na wa-aḫ-šu-ša-na ú dur₄-ḫu-mi-it ni-iš-ta-pár-šu-ma a-di u₄-mì-im a-nim i-ta-ba-al-ni-a-tí
target: Since five years we keep sending messages to him to Wahšušana and Durhumit, but until this very day he holds us in play.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-kam KÙ.BABBAR da-a-sú ša ga-me-er-tim ša-áš-qí-lá-šu
target: Make him pay the silver over there his datum for a full share.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma i-qá-bi₄ um-ma šu-ut-ma a-na ga-me-er-tim lá kà-áš-da-ku ša mì-iš-li ša-áš-qí-lá-šu
target: If he objects and says: I cannot match the full amount, make him pay for half the amount.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma um-ma šu-ut-ma a-na ni-kà-sí a-gi₅-me-er-tim ú mì-iš-li lá kà-áš-da-ku GÍR ša a-šur ta-mì-a-šu 40 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR lá ma-ṣú-ni 30 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR lá kà-áš-du-ni 20 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša mì-iš-li-šu lá i-šu-ú-ni KÙ.BABBAR lu ša ra-mì-ni-šu lu ša um-mì-a-ni-šu ša a-lim{ki} lu ša GÍN-lam₅ wa-áš-bu KÙ.BABBAR ma-lá na-áš-a-ku-ni lu wa-ar-ki-a e-zi-ib lu a-na pá-ni-a ú-šé-bi₄-il₅ a-na ni-kà-sí a-na ga
target: If he says: For the accounting I can match neither the full amount nor half of it, make him swear by Aššur's dagger that he has not enough for 40 minas of silver, that 30 minas of silver are too much for him, that he does not even have 20 minas of silver, half is due, that neither silver of himself, nor of his investors in the City nor of those who live in Anatolia, that "with whatever I carry with me or have left behind or have sent ahead, that for the accounting, I cannot match a full share or a half-share."

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ma-ma-ḫi-ir-ma a-na en-nam-a-šur qí-bi₄-ma
target: From Man-mahir to Ennam-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: AN.NA ša tù-šé-bi₄-lá-ni-ni a-lu-lá-a ú a-mur-IŠTAR 15.5 ma-na AN.NA <gap>-am-ku-nim
target: As to the tin you sent me, Alulaya and Amur-Ištar <gap> 15.5 minas of tin.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-im AN.NA-ki-kà 2 ma-na 12.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ku-nu-ki-a
target: The proceeds of your tin, 2 minas 12.5 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šé-ep-IŠTAR ú šé-lu-um-ar-dí na-áš-ú-ni-kum ù a-ni a-lá-ḫu-um iš-pu-ra-am um-ma šu-ut-ma
target: Šēp-Ištar and Šalim-wardī are bringing that to you under my seal. Also, now Ali-ahum wrote to me, saying:

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma i-na ša a-bi₄ i-dí-na-ku-ni mì-ma i li-bi₄-kà i-ší-a-at a-na a-ḫi-a lá tù-ša-ar
target: If any of what my father gave to you remains in your possession, do not release it to my brother.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma tù-ta-šé-er a-na-ku ú a-ḫa-tí a-na a-wa-tim ni-šé-e-kà
target: If you release it, then I and my sister will sue you in the matter.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú ša ki-ma šu-wa-tí ší-bi₄ iš-ku-nu-nim
target: Also, his representatives have set witnesses against me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na ba-áb ḫa-ra-ni-šu ša e-lá-ma um-ma pí-lá-aḫ-a-šùr-ma a-na e-lá-ma-ma lá-qé-ep DUMU i-li-a ku-nu-im AN.NA a-na 70 ḫa-am-ša-tim ú-kà-lam
target: When Elamma was about to set out on a journey Pilah-Aššur said to Elamma: Lā-qēp, the son of Iliya, who belongs to you(r firm), offers me tin with a credit term of 70 weeks.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma e-lá-ma-ma i-a-am AN.NA-ki le-qé-ma gi₅-im-lá-ni a-na 20 ḫa-am-ša-tim 8 GÍN.TA lá ta-ba-ta-qám
target: Elamma answered: "Take my own tin and do me a favor by giving me (for it) not less than 8 shekels per (shekel of silver) in 20 weeks."

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma pí-lá-aḫ-a-šur-ma 8 GÍN.TA AN.NA a-lá-qé-ma a-ta-BA mì-nam ta-da-nam
target: Pilah-Aššur said: "I will take the tin at the rate of 8 shekels, but you, what will you give me?"

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma e-lá-ma-ma ú a-na-ku iš-tù a-lim{ki} i-na tù-a-ri-a 15 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a-da-na-kum a-na a-lim{ki} tù-šé-ba-al ší-a-ma-tim i-ša-ú-mu-ni-kum ta-be-el-šu
target: Elamma answered: "And I, when I return from the City I will give you 15 minas of silver. You will send it to the City and one will make (with it) purchases for you, it will be at your disposal."

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI GÍR ša a-šur ší-bu-tí a-dí-in
target: Before Aššur's dagger I gave my testimony.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na ba-áb ḫa-ra-ni-šu ša e-lá-ma um-ma pí-lá-aḫ-a-šùr-ma 15 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am ni-is-ḫa-sú DIRI ša-du-a-sú ša-bu-ú a-dí-na-kum
target: When Elamma was about to set out on a journey Pilah-Aššur said: "I gave you 15 minas of refined silver, its excise added, its transport fee paid for."

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-lim{ki} i-na e-ra-bi-kà-ma 1 GÚ AN.NA ša-ma-am ú a ší-tí KÙ-pì-a TÚG.ḪI.A ša-ma-am iš-tí ANŠE-ri-kà pá-ni-im šé-bi₄-lam
target: "When you enter the City you must buy for me 1 talent of tin and for the rest of my silver buy textiles for me, send them to me with your next donkey transport."

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma e-lá-ma-ma ú-šé-ba-lá-kum
target: Elamma answered: "I will send them to you."

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI GÍR ša a-šur ší-bu-tí a-dí-in
target: Before Aššur's dagger I gave my testimony.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am iš-tí i-ku-pí-a-šur DUMU PUZUR₄.IŠTAR
target: 10 shekels of refined silver is owed by Ikūn-pī-Aššur son of Puzur-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù en-um-a-šur me-tù-ú 2 ma-na 15 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-ba-ba ra-bi-ṣú-um il₅-qé
target: After Ennam-Aššur died the attorney Ababa received 2 minas 15 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ITU.KAM ku-zal-li li-mu-um en-na-sú-in DUMU šu-a-šur
target: Month, eponymy Enna-Suen son of Šu-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI e-na-aḫ-DINGIR DUMU šu-a-šur IGI a-dí-da DUMU ÌR-ad-i-li-šu IGI id-na-a
target: Witnessed by Enah-ilī son of Šu-Aššur, by Adida son of Warad-ilišu, by Idnaya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ba-áb ḫa-ra-ni-šu ša a-šur-na-da a-šur-na-da DUMU aḫ-ša-lim ù a-bi₄-ì-lí ni-kà-sí i-sí-ú-ma
target: When Aššur-nādā was about to leave on a journey Aššur-nādā, son of Ah-šalim, and Abī-ilī settled accounts as follows:

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù a-lim{ki} i-na e-lá-i-šu 15 ma-na AN.NA a-šur-na-da a-na a-bi₄-ì-lí i-da-an-ma 2 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ú-lá i-ba-ta-aq-šum
target: When he comes up from the City Aššur-nādā will give 15 minas of tin to Abī-ilī, who will pay him not less than 2 minas of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ra <gap> i-na li-bi₄ a-bi₄-ì-lí a-šur-na-da ú-lá i-šu-ú
target: Abī-ilī does not owe anything to Aššur-nādā.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI en-na-sú-in DUMU a-šur-DU₁₀ a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um wa-aḫ-šu-ša-na i-dí-ni-a-tí-ma
target: In the presence of Ennam-Suen, son of Aššur-ṭāb. For these words the Wahšušana colony gave us.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI GÍR ša a-šur ṭup-pá-am ša ší-bu-tí-a a-dí-in sí-li-IŠTAR tap-pá-i
target: Before Aššur's dagger I gave the tablet with my testimony. Ṣilli-Ištar was my fellow witness.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 15 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ni-is-ḫa-sú DIRI ša-du-a-sú ša-bu ku-nu-ki-a a-na {d}IŠKUR-pì-lá-aḫ DUMU a-ni-nim áp-qí-id
target: 15 shekels of silver its excise added, his transport fee paid, under my seal I entrusted to Adad-pilah, son of Anīnum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI šu-IŠTAR DUMU šu-ki-tim IGI a-šur-ma-lik DUMU ša-ba-ḫa-nim
target: In the presence of Šukutum (and) of Aššur-mālik, son of Šabahānum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB a-la-bi-im DUMU sú-li-a KIŠIB ki-li-a DUMU en-na-nim
target: Seal of Ali-abum son of Ṣuliya, seal of Kiliya son of Ennānum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-um ša IGI GÍR ša {d}a-šùr
target: Tablet from before Aššur's dagger.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um dur₄-ḫu-mì-it i-dí-ni-a-tí-ma
target: The Durhumit colony gave us for these proceedings.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-bu-tí-ni ni-dí-in
target: We gave our testimony.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ma-na URUDU SIG₅ a-bu-um-DINGIR
target: minas of good copper: Abum-ilī;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 ma-na URUDU SIG₅ {d}UTU-ba-ni
target: 4 minas of good copper: Šamaš-bāni;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 ma-na URUDU SIG₅ DUMU i-ku-nim
target: 2 minas of good copper: Ikūnum's son;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i-dí-a-bu-um DUMU <gap>
target: 2 shekels of silver: Iddin-abum son of <gap>;

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB la-qé-pì-im DUMU i-li-a KIŠIB a-mur-{d}UTU DUMU mì-šu-ra-bi KIŠIB e-zé DUMU ša-ru-ki-in KIŠIB gal-da-a
target: Seal of Lāqēpum, son of Iliya; seal of Amur-Šamaš, son of Mīšu(r)-rabi; seal of Ezē, son of Šarrum-kēn; seal of Galdaya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša e-lá-ma ù gal-da-a ni-kà-sí i-sí-ú-ma lu gám-ru-um ša ḫa-ra-nim lu ú-ku-ul-tù-šu ba-ti-iq 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am i-ṣé-er gal-da-a DUMU na-ku e-lá-ma i-šu
target: (Witnessing) that Elamma and Galdaya settled accounts with the result that after both travel expenses and his food allowance have been deducted, Elamma (still) has a claim of 1 mina of refined silver on Galdaya, the son of Naku.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù ḫa-mu-uš-tim ša am-ri-a ù i-ku-nim 1.5 GÍN.TA a ma-na-im ú-ṣa-áb ITU.KAM ṣí-ip-im
target: From the week of Amriya and Ikūnum he will add 1.5 shekel per mina per month.

source: translate Akkadian to English: li-mu-um a-bi₄-a DUMU šu-da-ga-an
target: Month VII, year-eponymy of Abiya, son of Šu-Dagan.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫa-ma ṭup-pu-um ḫa-ar-mu-um ša be-ú-lá-ti-šu i-ba-ší
target: Separately, there still exists a valid record of his working capital.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim ni-ìš a-lim{ki} nu-ta-mì-šu-nu
target: We made them swear an oath by the City for these words.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am a-mur-IŠTAR DUMU da-mu-ma i-na ší-im SÍG.ḪI.A ša ú-ší-na-lam il₅-qé
target: Amur-Ištar son of Damuma has received 10 minas of refined silver from the proceeds of Ušinalam's wool.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-šùr-i-mì-tí DUMU du-dí-ki
target: Witnessed by Aššur-imittī son of Dudiki.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI tù-ur-a-šùr DUMU ú-zu-a
target: by Tūr-Aššur son of Uzuwa.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB ú-ra-a DUMU ma-na-na KIŠIB ì-lí-dan DUMU i-dí-a-šur KIŠIB ma-nu-um-ba-lúm-a-šur DUMU ib-ki-im
target: Sealed by Uraya son of Manana, by Ilī-dan son of Iddin-Aššur, by Mannum-balum-Aššur son of Ibkum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um kà-né-eš i-dí-ni-a-tí-ma
target: The Kanesh colony gave us for these proceedings.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI GÍR ša a-šur ší-bu-tí-ni ni-dí-in
target: We gave our testimony before Aššur's dagger.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR qá-dum ṣí-ba-tí-šu iš-tí en-na-sú-in ni-a-im il₅-qé
target: 10 minas of silver including its interest he received from our own Enna-Suen.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na e-la-ma qí-bi-ma um-ma PUZUR₄-a-na-ma a-la-nu-kà a-ba-am ú bé-la-am ú-la i-šu
target: Say to Elamma, thus Puzur-Anna: I have no father and lord but you!

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ša iš-tí-kà la uš-ta-me-ru li-ba-kà la tù-lá-ma-an
target: Don't be angry because I did not turn up with you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú-lá a-na ší-a-ma-tim a-la-ak
target: I cannot travel to make purchases (for you).

source: translate Akkadian to English: a té-er-tí É a-bi₄-ni a-la-ak
target: I must travel for an order of our paternal house.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-na-ku-ma i-kà-lá-a-ni-ma bi₄-il₅-tám ú-ša-ša-a-ni
target: I thought: 'He might detain me and force me to carry a load (for him).'

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ki-am la uš-ta-mi-er iš-tí-kà
target: (and) for that reason I did not turn up with you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tí lu-qú-tí-kà pá-ni-e-ma a-<gap>-re-a-am
target: But with your next lot of merchandise I will <gap>.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB e-na-a-šur DUMU <gap>
target: seal of Ennam-Aššur, son of <gap>

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma KÙ.BABBAR i-ša-<gap>
target: If they pay the silver <gap>

source: translate Akkadian to English: IŠTAR-lá-ma-sí ù ma-nu-ki-DINGIR i-zi-za-ma KÙ.BABBAR a-na ma-nu-ki-a-šur ú-lá a-na ša ki-ma ma-nu-ki-a-šur šu-uq-lá-ma
target: Ištar-lamassī and Mannum-kī-iliya and pay the silver to Mannum-kī-Aššur or to Mannum-kī-Aššur's representatives.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 20 GÚ SÍG.ḪI.A ù sí-kà-an-LUGAL ša a-na ša-pá-ar-tim ma-nu-ki-a-šur ú-kà-lu ki-ma KÙ.BABBAR ta-ša-qá-lá-ni a-šar ša-pár-tum kà-an-ku ku-nu-ki ma-nu-ki-ì-lí-a lu-dí-ma
target: As to the 20 talents of wool and the -stone that Mannum-kī-Aššur holds as security, when you pay the silver let him identify Mannum-kī-iliya's seal in case the security is sealed.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù ṭup-pá-am ša 3 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ú ṣí-ba-tí-šu šé-ṣí-a-ma ṭup-pá-am šu-a-tí ú sí-kà-LUGAL ku-un-kà-ma a-na IŠTAR-lá-ma-sí pí-iq-da
target: And then take out the tablet of the 3 minas of silver and its interest, and seal this tablet and the -stone and entrust it to Ištar-lamassī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú i-ša-qá-al KÙ.BABBAR ki-ma ša-áp-tum i-a-tù-ni ší-be šu-uk-na
target: Also, when the silver is paid set witnesses to prove that the wool is mine.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù ša-áp-tám a-na ša-lim-wa-ar-dí ù ma-nu-ki-ì-lí-a sà-ni-qá-ma ma-lá ša-áp-tám i-za-ku-a-ni ší-bé-e šu-uk-na-šu-nu-tí
target: Also, check the wool for Šalim-wardī and Mannum-kī-iliya, and set witnesses for them about how much wool is cleared.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ki-ma ša-áp-tum ú 7 ANŠE.ḪI.A ša en-um-a-šur ša-áp-tám kà-ni-kà-ma ku-nu-ki-ku-nu iš-tí lu-qú-tí-a-ma pí-iq-da-ma li-ir-dí-ú-nim
target: Stating that the wool and 7 donkeys belong to Ennam-Aššur, seal the wool and entrust it under your seals together with my other goods so they may conduct it here.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a ma-lá a-na-kam ša-lim-ar-dí nu-na-ḫi-du-ni le-pu-uš-šu-nu-tí
target: Šalim-wardī shall do for them what we instructed him to there.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma pí-lá-aḫ-IŠTAR-ma a-na en-um-a-šùr qí-bi-ma
target: From Pilah-Ištar to Ennam-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-šu-mì KÙ.BABBAR ša DAM.GÀR ša a-na-kam a-na a-lu-la-a tù-ša-zi-za-ni
target: Concerning the merchant's silver for which you made me guarantee here to Alulaya,

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-lu-lá-a wa-ar-ki-kà-ma ḫa-ra-šu i-ta-lá-ak
target: Alulaya later went on a trip after you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù 45 u₄-me KÙ.BABBAR im-qú-tá-ma i-ba-ší
target: 45 days ago the silver arrived and is ready.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma sá-aḫ-ra-tí tí-ir-ta-kà li-li-kam-ma a-šar ta-ša-pá-ra-ni KÙ.BABBAR lá-áš-qú-ul
target: If you are delayed, send word and I shall pay the silver where you write.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú-lá a-na ḫu-ša-ḫi-a KÙ.BABBAR lu-pá-ni
target: Otherwise let me set it aside for my own needs.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR lá kà-ṣú-ud
target: The silver should not be idle.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma en-um-a-šur-ma a-na a-lá-ḫi-im-ma e-ni-ma-ma na-áš-pé-er-tum ku-nu-ki-kà IGI 3 ší-be ú-kà-lim-kà-ma tù-kà-i-ni-ma šu-nu-tí-ma ni-ip-qí-sú
target: Ennam-Aššur said as follows to Ali-ahum: Now here I have shown you the missive sealed by you in front of 3 witnesses, and you have confirmed it and we have entrusted it to them.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma a-we-lu a-ni-ú-tum li-iš-me-ú a-ma ta-aḫ-sí-sá-tù-ni ku-nu-ku-ú-a ú ku-nu-ku-kà i-ki-ir ú-lá kà-i-in ša ni-kà-sí a-na-ku ú a-ta ni-sí-ú-ma ni-iz-ku-ú lá tù-na-ḫa-ni
target: Now, may these men listen - confirm or deny our memorandum with my seal and your seal, that you and I settled accounts and settled. Do not obstruct me!

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-lá-ḫu-um en-um-a-šur e-pu-ul um-ma a-lá-ḫu-um-ma ta-aḫ-sí-sá-tum ku-nu-ku-kà ú ku-nu-ku-ú-a ba-am 3 lu ni-iṣ-ba-at-ma a ma-lá ta-aḫ-sí-sá-tim ša i-na ku-nu-ki-ni kà-an-kà-ni lu ni-iz-ku
target: Ali-ahum answered Ennam-Aššur, saying: "It is the memoranda with your seal and my seal. Come on, let us seize three men and let us settle in accordance with the memoranda that are sealed with our seals.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ma-lá KÙ.BABBAR a-bu-ni i li-bi-a ú i li-bi₄-kà i-dí-ú-ma ṭup-pá-am a-bu-ni e-zi-bu-ma ṭup-pá-am um-me-a-nu a-bi-ni ú-kà-i-lu-ni-ma i-na IGI kà-ri-im ṣa-ḫi-ir GAL iš-ku-nu-šu-ma kà-ra-am a-na ra-bi₄-ṣí-im ip-qí-du-ni
target: As much silver as our father set down as owed by me and by you, and concerning which our father left a tablet and our father's investors held the tablet, which they deposited before the plenary assembly of the colony, and which the colony entrusted it to an attorney.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ba-am u₄-ma-am ma-lá KÙ.BABBAR i-na ṭup-pí-im lá-áp-ta-ni-ni lu nim-gu₅-ra-ma a ma-lá dí-in a-lim{ki} KÙ.BABBAR lu ni-ik-nu-uk-ma a-na a-lim{ki} lu ni-li-ik
target: Come on, even today let us agree how much silver we are booked for in that tablet, let us seal it in accordance with the verdict of the City, and let us go to the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 6.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR da-a-sú ša a-lu-wa áš-qúl
target: I paid 6.5 shekels of silver Aluwa's fees.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 9 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR na-áb-sú-in e-ma-ri <gap> i-na ḫu-ra-ma e-zi-bu-ni
target: 9 shekels of silver when Nab-Suen left the donkeys in hurrama.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ma a-nim ma-ma-ḫi-ir iš-qú-ul
target: All this Man-mahir paid.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi-ma um-ma SIG₅-pí-a-šur-ma
target: To Ali-ahum from Damiq-pī-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a ma-lá na-áš-pé-ra-tí-kà ša ta-dí-na-ni i-ša-ḫa-at a-ḫa-tí-kà ni-zi-iz-ma a-lam ni-im-ḫu-ur-ma
target: In accordance with your missives that you gave me we assisted your sister, confronted the City assembly and

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na DUB ša a-lim{ki} ša ni-il₅-qé-ú DUMU.MÍ šál-ma-a-šur ra-bi₄-ṣa-am ta-ṣa-ba-at-ma
target: according to the tablet of the City that we received, Šalim-Aššur's daughter will take an attorney, stating that

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu KÙ.BABBAR lu ṭup-pu-ú lu ṭup-pu-um ša šál-ma-a-šur i dur₄-ḫu-mì-it ša ḫu-bu-ul en-um-a-šur ú a-lá-ḫi-im ša um-me-a-nu a-na i-li-a ip-qí-du-ni
target: both the silver, the tablets and the tablet of Šalim-Aššur that the investors entrusted to Iliya in Durhumit concerning the debt of Ennam-Aššur and Ali-ahum -

source: translate Akkadian to English: ma-lá DUB šu-a-tí ša šál-ma-a-šur ú-lá-pí-tù en-um-a-šur ú a-lá-ḫu-um KÙ.BABBAR i-ša-qú-lu-ma a-na ra-bi₄-ṣí-im i-du-nu-ma KÙ.BABBAR a-na a-lim{ki} i-lá-ak
target: in accordance with this tablet that Šalim-Aššur wrote, Ennam-Aššur and Ali-ahum must pay the silver, give it to the attorney and the silver should go to the City -

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma me-eḫ-ra-at DUB ša-ni-im ú i ma-aḫ-ri-a-ma a-ba-ba ra-bi₄-ṣa-am ni-iṣ-ba-da-kum
target: now, copies of the second tablet (exist) and we have seized the attorney Ababa for you with me as witness.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša i-na ba-ri-ku-nu i-qá-bi₄-ú um-ma šu-ut-ma KÙ.BABBAR lá-áš-qú-ul i-na ša-ḫa-at ra-bi-ṣí-im i-za-az-ma ša lá iš-qú-lu ú-ša-áš-qal
target: He among you who says as follows: I shall pay the silver, he will assist the attorney, and he shall make the one who has not paid pay.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša ki-ma ku-a-tí ip-nu-ú-ni-ma um-ma šu-nu-ma a-wi-lu-um a-ḫu-kà KÙ.BABBAR a-na ig-ri ra-bi-ṣí-im šu-qú-ul
target: Your representatives turned to me and said: The man is your colleague. Pay silver for the hire of the attorney.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 12 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ší-im TÚG i li-be tí-za-ru-ma-an a-lá-ḫu-um i-šu
target: Tizar-uman owes 12 shekels of silver, the price of a textile, to Ali-ahum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB a-šur-i-dí KIŠIB en-num-a-šur KIŠIB en-num-a-šur
target: Seal of Aššur-idī, seal of Ennam-Aššur, seal of Ennam-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.6666 ma-na 5 GÍN AN.NA i-ṣé-er en-um-a-šur lu-zi i-šu
target: Ennam-Aššur owes 0.6666 mina 5 shekels of tin to Luzi.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù ḫa-mu-uš-tim ša i-tur₄-DINGIR ú PUZUR₄-ša-du-e a-na ITU.KAM i-ša-qal
target: Reckoned from the week of Itūr-ilī and Puzur-šadu'e he must pay in one month.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma lá iš-qú-ul 3 GÍN.TA a-na 1 ma-na-im ú-ṣa-áb
target: If he has not paid, he will add (interest) at the rate 3 shekels per mina.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ITU.KAM ku-zal-li li-mu-um {d}UTU-ba-ni
target: Month Kuzallu, eponymy Šamaš-bāni.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-lá-ḫi-im ù da-am-qá-a qí-bi-ma um-ma MAN-a-šùr-ma
target: To Ali-ahum and Damqaya from Puzur-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR šu-sú-in DUMU a-šùr-na-da DUMU ir-nu-id ku-nu-ki ša ki-ma i-a-tí <gap>-a KÙ.BABBAR iš-tí šu-sú-in il₅-qé
target: 0.5 mina of silver (belonging to) Šu-Suen son of Aššur-nādā, (grand)son of Irnuid, <gap> has received the silver from Šu-Suen under the seal of my representative.

source: translate Akkadian to English: <gap> ma <gap> KÙ.BABBAR iš-qú-lá-šu-nu-tí
target: <gap> he paid to them

source: translate Akkadian to English: <gap> ma-na 1 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-dí-da li-dí-na-ku-nu-tí
target: <gap> mina 1 shekel of silver Adida should give to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ma KÙ.BABBAR a-nim a-lá-ḫu-um li-il₅-qé-e
target: Ali-ahum should receive all this silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 ma-na AN.NA ú-ku ub-lá-kum
target: Uku brought you <gap> minas of tin.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-šu tí-ir-ta-kà ki-a-ma lá i-lá-kam
target: Why has word concerning this not come here from you?

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ta-ar-bi₄-tim ù-ku-ul-tí-im ù qú-bu-ri-im ša me-er-ú-at kà-áp-sí-a a-na AN.NA ta-ad-mì-iq-tim ša DUMU.MÍ ḫa-na-na DAM ḫa-na-na ú me-er-ú ḫa-na-na mì-ma a-na kà-áp-sí-a DAM a-lá-bi₄-im i-dí-nu-ni a-na kà-áp-sí-a ú-lá i-tù-ru
target: For the costs of upbringing, the food and the tomb of the daughters of Kapsiya, for the tin, the venture credit of the daughter of Hanana, Hanana's wife and sons will not raise claims against Kapsiya for anything they have given to Kapsiya, wife of Ali-abum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù kà-áp-sí-a DAM a-lá-bi₄-im a-na 1 ma-na 7 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ḫu-bu-ul pì-lá-aḫ-IŠTAR DUMU a-šur-SIPA 0.3333 ma-na 2.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša nu-a-im ša ša-<gap>-a lu ḫu-bu-lim ša ḫa-ri-im-tí-im kà-áp-sí-a DAM a-lá-bi₄-im a-na ḫu-dí-da ù me-er-e ḫa-na-na ú-lá i-tù-ar
target: And Kapsiya, wife of Ali-abum, for a silver debt of 1 mina and 7 shekels owed by Pilah-Istar, son of Assur-re'i, for 22.5 shekels of silver of the Anatolian of <gap>, and for the debt owed by Harimtum - Kapsiya, wife of Ali-abum will not raise claims against Hudida and the sons of Hanana.

source: translate Akkadian to English: e-10+5 GÍN ša na-ki-le-ed ú kà-nu šu-ma wa-at-ra-am KÙ.BABBAR ḫa-na-na iš-tí na-ki-le-ed i-le-e i li-bi₄-ša kà-áp-sí-a tí-šu IGI a-šùr-lá-ma-sí DUMU šu-ku-bi₄-im IGI en-na-nim IGI ú-ba-a IGI šu-mì-a-bi₄-a IGI a-mur-{d}UTU
target: If, apart from the 15 shekels, which Nakile'ed has to confirm, Hanana proves to have an additional claim in silver on Nakile'ed, Kapsiya will have a claim on her (Hudida) for the (figurines of the) gods. In the presence of Assur-lamassi, son of Su-Kubum, of Ennanum, of Ubaya, of Sumi-abiya, and of Amur-Samas.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma PUZUR₄-a-na ù a-šur-ra-bi-ma a-na šu-be-lim qí-bi-ma
target: Thus Puzur-Anna and Aššur-rabi, say to Šu-Bēlum:

source: translate Akkadian to English: ki-ma a-ta ta-ta-al-ku wa-ar-ki-kà-ma 1.3333 ma-na 3 GÍN KÙ.KI pá-šál-lam SIG₅ a ni-qí ša ta-mu-ru a-šur-ma-lik DUMU ìr-ra-a ù {d}IŠKUR-ṣú-lu-li a-ṣé-ri-kà a-na kà-ni-iš i-tab-ku
target: As soon as you had gone, after your departure, the 1 mina 23 shekels of fine quality -gold in the shape of rings, which you had spotted, Aššur-mālik, son of Erraya, and Adad-ṣulūlī have shipped to you, to Kanesh.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.3333 ma-na 2 GÍN KÙ.KI a šu-mì-šu-nu i-tur₄-DINGIR tal-qé
target: In their name Itūr-ilī took 0.3333? mina 2 shekels of gold?.

source: translate Akkadian to English: É kà-ri-im a-na ta-ú-ri-kà i-zi-zu-ma ni-im-ḫu-ur-šu-nu-ma 18 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša-du-a-at-kà ni-dí
target: When the colonial office took steps to make you come back, we appealed to them and deposited 18 shekels of silver, the šaddu'tu-tax you owe.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 8 GÍN.TA 13.5 GÍN KÙ.GI ší-im KÙ.KI 1.5 ma-na 6.5 GÍN KÙ.GI-ṣí ù ší-tí KÙ.GI-ṣí-kà 0.6666 ma-na 5.5 GÍN KÙ.GI pá-ša-lum iš-tí a-šur-ra-bi i-ba-ší
target: 13.5 shekels of gold at a rate of 8 shekels to 1 (yields) as price of the gold 1 mina 36.5 shekels (of silver), It is my gold and the rest of your gold, 45.5 shekels of ld, is with Aššur-rabi.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-<gap>-GA šu-up-ra am-ma <gap>-a-šu a kà-ni-iš lu-bi₄-il₅ ú-ul a mì-ša-am lu-šé-bi₄-lá-kum
target: Write to PN, that he may bring his <gap> to Kanesh or send it to you over there.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 30 ma-na AN.NA a-na i-tur₄-DINGIR mì-ma lá tù-šé-ba-lam
target: By no means send 30 minas of tin to Itūr-ilī!

source: translate Akkadian to English: pí-ri-kà-ni ša a-na-na 1 lu-bu-ša-am 1 TÚG ra-qá-tám a-na a-bu-ša-lim DUMU ṣí-lá-{d}IM a-dí-in
target: belonging to Anna-anna, 1 dress (and) 1 thin textile I gave to Abu-šalim son of Ṣill-Adad.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI ma-nu-ki-a-šur IGI ku-zi-zi-a
target: Witnessed by Mannum-kī-Aššur, by Kuziziya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-šu-mì a-zu e-mì-šu ša a-lu-wa mu-ṭá-e ú-ra-dí
target: 1.5 shekel of silver, underweight, I added in the name of Azu the brother-in-law of Aluwa.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na {d}MAR.TU-ba-ni a-šur-i-mì-tí i-tur₄-DINGIR ḫa-na i-na-aḫ-DINGIR ù en-um-a-šur qí-bi-ma um-ma ša-lim-a-šur-ma
target: To Amurrum-bāni, Aššur-imittī, Itūr-ilī, hana, Inah-ilī and Ennam-Aššur from Šalim-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-šur-i-mì-tí qí-bi-ma 40 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am ni-is-ḫa-sú DIRI ša-du-a-sú ša-bu-ú a-ḫa-ma 35.3333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša ik-ri-bi-a ni-is-ḫa-sú ù ša-du-a-sú ša-bu-ú mì-ma a-nim IGI pu-šu-ki-in ḫu-ra-ṣa-nim ù a-bi-a a-dí-na-kum
target: Specifically to Aššur-imittī: 40 minas of refined silver, its import duty added, its transport tariff paid, further, 35.3333 minas of silver from my votive offerings, its import duty and transport tariff paid - all this I gave to you with Pūšu-kēn, huraṣānum and Abiya as witnesses.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-ta-ma ú a-na-ku 40 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ú-ra-dá-ma a-ṣé-er a-bi-a ù ì-lí-dan DUMU šu-da-a i šé-ep a-bi-a ú-šé-ba-al
target: You said: I too will add 40 minas of silver and send it to Abiya and Ilī-dan son of Šudaya with Abiya as transporter.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR-áp-kà mì-ma ú-lá a-ḫu-ur
target: None of your silver is remaining.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ṣé-er 1 GÚ 15.3333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR i-a-im ú KÙ.BABBAR <gap> ku-a-im ša i šé-ep a-bi-a i-li-ku ki-ma ša 4.6666 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ḫu-sà-ra-am iš-ú-mu-ni-ku-um
target: On top of the 1 talent 15.3333 minas of my silver plus your silver that went with Abiya's transport, they bought lapis corresponding to 4.6666 minas of silver for you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú a-na KÙ.BABBAR-pì-ni AN.NA ú ṣú-ba-tí iš-ú-mu-nim-ma qá-dí-a-ma a-na 40 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR qá-tim ša-li-im-tim AN.NA ú ṣú-ba-tí ta-zu-úz
target: And for our silver they bought tin and textiles, and together with me you divided tin and textiles for a full share of 40 minas of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú i-na a-lim{ki} a-bi-kà ù ì-lí-dan IGI 5 ṣa-bi-im ú-kà-i-nu-ni ú tí-ir-tí a-bi-kà i-li-kà-kum
target: Also, in the City they confirmed your father and Ilī-dan before 5 men, and a message from your father came to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma i-dí-a-bu-um-ma a-na šu-ma-li-ba-a-šur ù en-um-a-šur qí-bi-ma
target: From Iddin-abum to Šumma-libbi-Aššur and Ennam-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na 2 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR li-té-e ḫi-la-tí-šu ku-nu-ki-a šu-ma-li-ba-a-šùr na-ší
target: 1 mina 2 shekels of silver, with exudations, Šumma-libbi-Aššur brings under my seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-kam 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am šu-ma-li-bi-a-šur a-ṣé-er 1 ma-na-im KÙ.BABBAR lu-ra-dí-ma 2 ma-na KÙ ku-un-kà-ma a-ṣé-er ku-lu-ma-a a-na a-li-ki pá-ni-ú-tim-ma dí-na-ma lu-ub-lu-ú
target: Let Šumma-libbi-Aššur add 1 mina of refined silver to the one mina of silver there, seal 2 minas of silver and give them to the first travellers so they may bring them to Kulumaya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-ta a-na wa-BI-im KÙ.BABBAR šu-uk-na
target: Set silver two for.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR i-na ra-mì-ni-kà dí-in-ma ṣí-ba-sú ša ITU.KAM-im iš-tí-in le-qé
target: Give 1 mina of silver of your own and take interest for a single month.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma KÙ.BABBAR a qá-tí-kà ù-la ma-qí-it É DAM.GÀR a ṣí-ib-tim le-qé-a-nim
target: If no silver has fallen into your hands, then take some at interest from a merchant-house.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí a-la-ki-a ṣí-ib-tám ša ITU.KAM iš-tí-in lá-áš-qúl
target: I shall pay interest for a single month until I arrive.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫu-ú-a a-tù-nu iḫ-da-ma KÙ.BABBAR šé-bi-lá
target: My dear brothers, take care to send the silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu-mu-un li-bi-im a ku-lu-ma-a lá a-ra-ší
target: Let me not have to face Kulumaya's anger.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na šu-a-šur ma-nu-kà-a-bi₄-a ù ì-lí-pì-ú-ṣur qí-bi-ma um-ma a-bu-ša-lim
target: To Šu-Aššur, Mannu-kī-abiya and Ilī-pī-uṣur, say, thus Abu-šalim:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ù 4.5 GÍN KÙ.GI ma-li-a-am ma-nu-kà-a-bi₄-a na-áš-a-ku-nu-tí
target: 1 mina of silver and 4.5 shekels of full ? gold Mannu-kī-abiya is bringing to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫu ú-a a-tù-nu i-na ša-am-ší im-ma ma-nu-kà-a-bi₄-a e-ra-ba-ni pí-ri-kà-ni ša-ma-nim-ma iš-tí pá-nim-ma šé-bi-lá-nim
target: Please, my brothers, buy on the very day Mannu-kī-abiya arrives in town -textiles and send them to me with the first opportunity.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na šu-a-šur qí-bi-ma ší-im KÙ.GI me-eḫ-ra-tim i-dí-ma pí-ri-kà-ni ša-ma-nim a-ta i-na ší-im KÙ.GI KÙ.BABBAR-áp-kà le-qé
target: Say to Šu-Anum: 'Make the equivalent of the yield of the gold available by buying -textiles for me'.

source: translate Akkadian to English: gi₄-mì-lam i-ṣé-ri-a šu-ku-un ù a-na-ku ga-ma-al-kà a-le-e
target: You yourself must take your silver from the yield of the gold.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma am-tum <gap>-e-ma té-ri-iš-kà dí-ši-ma ù té-er-ta-kà li-li-kà-ma KÙ.BABBAR lu-šé-bi₄-lá-kum
target: Do me this favor and (know that) I too can do you a favor! If the maid asks <gap> from you, give it her and let a report from you come here then I will send you the silver (for it).

source: translate Akkadian to English: 8 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am ni-is-ḫa-sú DIRI ša-du-a-sú ša-bu-ú KÙ.BABBAR ša DAM.GÀR a-na a-lim{ki} a-na ší-a-ma-tim ki-ma DAM.GÀR bé-lí-a DUMU DINGIR-ku-ru-ub a-na lá-qé-ep DUMU šu-a-šur i-dí-in-ma
target: 8 minas of refined silver - its import duty added, its transport tariff paid for - silver belonging to a merchant - Bēliya son of Ilī-kurub gave that on behalf of the merchant to Lā-qēp son of Šu-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ.BA ša 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ší-ma-am ša a-ki-dí-e SIG₅ a-na ší-tí 7 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR KÙ.BABBAR TÚG ku-ta-ni SIG₅ DIRI-tim iš-tù ša 12 GÍN.TA KÙ.BABBAR ù ša-áp-li-iš lá-qé-ep iš-tù a-lim{ki} i-na kà-ni-iš ú-šé-lá-a-ma a-na DAM.GÀR ṣú-ba-tí lá-qé-ep DUMU šu-a-šur i-da-an
target: Out of that Lā-qēp must bring up from the City to Kanesh for 1 mina of silver, a purchase of good Akkadian textiles, for the rest, 7 minas of silver, extra-fine textiles from 12 shekels of silver per piece or less, and Lā-qēp son of Šu-Aššur must give the textiles to the merchant.

source: translate Akkadian to English: GÁN-lam₅ a-na-nu-um ù a-lá-nu-um iš-tí tí-ir-tí-šu-ma ša lá-qé-ep a-šu-mì DAM.GÀR e-ti-iq
target: From here and from there (the shipment) goes overland in the name of the merchant together with Lā-qēp's own orders.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI DU₁₀-a-ḫi DUMU ir-bi-{d}IM IGI lá-qé-ep DUMU PUZUR₄-ša-du-e IGI en-um-a-šùr DUMU ša-lim-a-šur
target: Witnessed by Ṭāb-ahi son of Irbi-Adad, by Lā-qēp son of Puzur-šadue, by Ennam-Aššur son of Šalim-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na pu-šu-ki-in
target: 1.5 shekel of silver for Pūšu-kēn;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 na-ru-uq lu ŠE um lu ar-ša-tum ša a-we-el-tum i-ta-dí-nu-ma
target: For 5 sacks, both barley and wheat, which the lady delivered,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a-lá-ḫu-um il₅-qé
target: Ali-ahum received 1 mina of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma i-li-a a-šur-re-ṣí en-nam-a-šur ù da-dí-a-ma a-na e-la-ma qí-bi₄-ma
target: Thus Iliya, Aššur-rēṣī, Ennam-Aššur and Dadiya, say to Elamma:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.8333 ma-na LÁ 2 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša KÙ a-la-ḫi-im ša li-bi₄ na-ru-qí-kà ni-il₅-qé-a-šu-ma ší-ma-am ni-iš-a-ma ku-na-a ú-šé-bi₄-kum
target: 48 shekels of silver, which is silver of Ali-ahum that is part of your joint-stock fund, we took it and made purchases with it and Kunnaya has sent them to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lá 1 ma-na KÙ.GI ša a-na a-lá-ḫi-im a-ta ša-áp-kà-tí-ni 1.6666 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ni-il₅-qé-ma ší-ma-am ni-iš-a-ma a-šur-lá-ma-sí ú-šé-ri-a-kum
target: (As for) the 1 mina of gold you yourself have invested with Ali-ahum, we collected 1.6666 mina of silver and made purchases and Aššur-lamassī has brought them to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.3333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša ší-im ANŠE.ḪI.A ša a-na a-lá-ḫi-im tù-šé-bi₄-lá-ni a-na li-bi₄ lu-qú-tí-kà na-dí en-nam-a-šur ù šu-IŠTAR DUMU da-da-nim ú-šé-ṣí-ú-ni-kum
target: 0.3333 mina of silver of the price of the donkeys you sent to Ali-ahum has been added to your merchandise; Ennam-Aššur and Šu-Ištar, son of Dadānum, have shipped it off to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 20 ma-na URUDU iš-tí DINGIR-ba-ni 8 ma-na URUDU iš-tí aḫ-ma-a ni-il₅-qé-ma 4 TÚG šu-ru-tim ni-iš-a-ma en-nam-a-šur ù šu-IŠTAR DUMU da-da-nim ub-lu-ni-kum
target: We collected 20 minas of copper from Ilī-bāni and 8 minas of copper from Ahmaya and we bought (with it) dark textiles; Ennam-Aššur and Šu-Ištar, son of Dadānum, have brought it to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-šu-mì KÙ.BABBAR ša É A.BA ša na-ru-uq a-la-ḫi-im ša ta-áš-pu-ra-ni qá-at-kà ù qá-sú ša a-la-ḫi-im a-šur-DU₁₀ il₅-qé ší-ma-am iš-a-ma ú-šé-ṣí
target: As for the silver of the paternal house that is (in) the joint-stock capital of Ali-ahum, about which you wrote - Aššur-ṭāb took your and Ali-ahum's part (and) he made purchases (with it) and shipped them off.
