target: specifically to hadītum: Earlier I sent word to you with Man-mahir, saying:

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú-ṭá-tám ša a-na a-wi-lá-tim ša KÙ.BABBAR 2 ma-na a-na u₄-me ú-šé-ru-ma ku-a-tí ú ša-<gap> KÙ.BABBAR ší-im ú-ṭá-tim <gap> a-ṣé-ri-a ta-ú-<gap>
target: The grain that I released on terms to the ladies for 2 minas of silver and which for you and Ša<gap>, the silver, the price of the grain to me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-ku a-na <gap> a-dí ma-lá ú ší-ni-šu KÙ.BABBAR <gap> a-na lá-qé-ep <gap> dí-ni ú <gap> a-ḫa-ma li-bi-ší a-dí ḫa-ra-ni
target: I both once and twice the silver give to Lā-qēpum and let it remain apart until the journey.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na a-lá-ki-a li-bi mì-ma lá tù-ša-ni
target: Do not alienate me when I arrive.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú ú-ṭá-tám ša tù-um-li-a-im ú ša DUMU uš-ḫa-ta <gap> ma-lá i ša-nim ni-<gap> li-bi-ší
target: Also, the grain from the man from Tumliya and from Ušhata's son in the second it should remain.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a <gap> a-na ku-ku-a qí-bi-ma um-ma en-um-a-šur-ma
target: to Kukuwa from Ennam-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-im e-<gap> ṭup-pá-kà <gap> u₄-me-e áš-<gap> um-ma šu-bé-lúm-ma u₄-mu-kà ma-al-ú
target: The price of your tablet terms Šu-Bēlum said: "Your term is up."

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ša <gap> 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ší-im TÚG.ḪI.A iš-tí wa-al-dí-lim ṣa-áb-ta-šu-ma KÙ.BABBAR ša-áš-qí-lá-šu
target: Have him pay the silver. 0.5 mina of silver, the proceeds from the sale of my textiles is in Waldi-ilum's possession, so seize him and make him pay.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 25 na-ru-uq GIG kà-ar-ší-ni er-ša-ma i be-et en-na-nim li-bi₄-ší
target: Demand 25 sacks of wheat from Karšini, and let them be kept in Ennānum's house.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma um-me-a-an ša-lim-a-šur a-na AN.NA ù <gap> na ší TÚG ša en-na-nim <gap> zu ú en-um-a-šur a-na en-na-nim i-tù-ru
target: If Šalim-Ašsur's investors raise claim against Ennānum concerning tin <gap> textiles belonging to Ennānum concerning tin <gap> textiles belonging to Ennānum <gap> and Ennam-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ma-lá AN.NA ù TÚG ṣú-ba-tí ša qá-tim i-na ba-áb DINGIR-lim i-za-ku-ú iš-tí um-mì-a-an ša-lim-a-šur en-na-nam DUMU am-ri-a en-um-a-šur ú-ba-áb
target: Then Ennam-Aššur will release Ennānum son of Amriya with Šalim-Aššur's investors for as much tin and ordinary textiles as they clear at the gate of the God.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI tù-ur-a-a IGI lá-qé-ep
target: Witnessed by Turaya, by Lā-qēp.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša-lim-a-šùr a-na me-er-e i-dí-a-bi₄-im iṣ-ba-at-ni-a-tí-ma
target: Šalim-Aššur seized us in his case against the sons of Iddin-abum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ša-lim-a-šùr-ma a-na ṭup-pì-im ša a-lim{ki} ša ra-bi₄-ṣú-um ub-lá-ni ù ší-ma-tim mì-ma ta-tù-ra-nim ša 7 um-me-a-nu a-wa-tí-ni ig-mu-ru-ni
target: Šalim-Aššur said: Do you contest the tablet from the City assembly that the attorney brought as well as the testament according to which 7 investors concluded our case?

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma me-er-ú i-dí-a-bi₄-im-ma <gap> ša-lá-áš-tù-ma šu-nu a-na mì-ma šu-um-šu lá ni-tù-ra-kum
target: Iddin-abum's sons answered, all three of them: "We do not contest anything against you."

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-be-lúm-ma a-na lu-qú-tim ša É a-šùr-be-el-a-wa-tim a-na-ku a-šé-e-kà
target: Šu-Bēlum said: "I sue you for the goods from Aššur-bēl-awātim's house."

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-ḫu-šu-ma né-nu ú-lá ni-tù-ra-kum
target: His brothers said "As for us, we have no claims against you."

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ša-lim-a-šùr-ma ša ni-iš a-lim{ki} ta-mu-ú lu ú-kà-al ki-ma a-na a-wa-tim ga-am-ra-tim i-tù-ru
target: Šalim-Aššur said "Keep in mind what has been sworn by an oath by the City, since he (now) raises claim in a concluded case!"

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-be-lúm-ma zu <gap> a-ḫe-e-a KÙ.BABBAR ù ṣí-ba-sú tù-ma-li
target: Šu-Bēlum answered: "Have you paid in full <gap> of my brothers, the silver and its interest?"

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI PUZUR₄.SA.TU IGI EN.LÍL-ba-ni IGI a-šùr-GAL a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um kà-ni-iš i-dí-ni-a-tí-ma ší-bu-tí-ni ni-dí-in
target: Witnessed by Puzur-šadu'e, by Illil-bāni, by Aššur-rabi. The Kanesh colony gave us for these proceedings and we have our testimony.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na LUGAL-sú-en₆ qí-bi₄-ma um-ma a-šùr-GAL-ma
target: Say to the king, my lord: thus (says) Aššur-rabi.

source: translate Akkadian to English: TÚG pá-ra-kà-nu-kà ú ší-tí Ì.GIŠ a-na-kam a-dí-in
target: Your garment and the oil I have given here.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-ba-ší-ú ša ki-ma ša-zu-za-tí-kà a-mì-ša-am i-ta-al-ku-nim
target: There are those who, like your representatives, have come here.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam ni-ki-iš-tám ša kà-ri-im ša ki-ma a-na nu-a-im mì-ma ší-mì-im ma-ma-an lá i-du-nu
target: Here, we have made a settlement of the harbor, such that to the sailor no one gives anything.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.3333 ma-na 1 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ku-nu-ki-ni DU₁₀-ṣí-lá-a-šùr na-áš-a-kum
target: One-third mina and 1 shekel of silver, under our seal, I am bringing to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫi a-ta té-er-ta-kà a-ni-tum lá a-ni-tum li-li-kam
target: My brother, you, your letter, whether this or not, let it come.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR 1 GÍN lá a-kà-al
target: I will not eat (i.e., take) 1 shekel of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na e-lá-ma qí-bi-ma um-ma a-ḫu-qar ù a-šùr-iš-tí-kál-ma a-na-kam šu-be-lúm ni-iṣ-ba-at-ma ṭup-pá-am me-eḫ-ra-am ša lá-qé-ep nu-ša-áš-me-šu-ma
target: Say to Elamma, thus Ahu-waqar and Aššuriš-tikal: Here we seized Šu-Bēlum and we made him listen to the tablet, a copy, of Lā-qēp.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma né-nu-ma ší-bu-ta-kà dí-in
target: We said to him: 'Give your testimony!'

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-ut-ma iš-tù pá-na-ma a-na pí-lá-aḫ-a-šùr ší-bu-tí a-di-in KÙ.BABBAR a-na a-lim{ki} ša-ak-šu-dam lá qá-bi
target: He answered: 'Some time ago I already gave my testimony to Pilah-Aššur (that) no promise has been made to deliver the silver to the City'.

source: translate Akkadian to English: né-ru-ub-ma me-eḫ-re ša ba-áb DINGIR ša ší-bu-tí-šu ša a-na pì-lá-aḫ-a-šùr i-dí-nu ni-iš-me
target: We entered and listened to (the text of) the copies of his testimony drawn up in the gate of the god, that he had given to Pilah-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lá-qí-ip tap-pá-i a-ma me-eḫ-ri ší-me a-ma-kam ma-lá-kà
target: (And they read): 'Lā-qēp was my companion'. Here is my copy, listen to it; it is up to you there (what to do)'.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam ib-ni-lí DUMU a-šùr-{d}UTU-ši wa-ar-kà-sú nu-ša-il₅-ma ù e-ba-ru-uš-šu ku-ni-lúm ù i-dí-IŠTAR nu-ša-il₅-ma eṭ-lu-um ke-en₆ ú wa-ar-kà-tám i-šu
target: Here we questioned Ibni-ilī, son of Aššur-šamšī, about his record and we also questioned his friends, Kūn-ilum and Iddin-Ištar, and the result was: The man is reliable and has a (good) record.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṣú-ḫa-ar-tám ta-da-nam lá ta-da-nam té-er-ta-kà li-li-kam
target: Let your instruction come to me whether the girl must be given or not.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša ší-im 2 UDU iš-tí PUZUR₄-e-nam
target: 5 shekels of silver from the price of 2 sheep is owed by Puzur-Ennam.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na 15 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i li-bi ša-ri-ša a-lá-ḫi-nim
target: 1 mina 15 shekels of silver is owed by Šariša, the miller.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.6666 ma-na 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-ni i-ša-qal
target: He will pay 0.6666 minas 5 shekels of silver now.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a-na ša ú-sú-me-e i-ša-qal
target: 0.5 mina of silver he will pay at the festival of Usmû.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 GÚ 17 ma-na URUDU ù 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ki-iš-da-tí-a ša a-na a-šur-na-da ù ú-zu-a e-zi-bu
target: As to the 1 talent 17 minas of copper and 0.5 mina of silver, my earnings which I left with Aššur-nādā and Uzuwa.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 25 ma-na URUDU a-šur-na-da il₅-qé
target: Aššur-nādā took 25 minas of copper.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 ma-na a-lá-ḫu-um ku-ri-um il₅-qé
target: Ali-ahum, "Shorty", took 10 minas.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-tù-um iš-tí-šu-nu i-ba-ší
target: The remainder is with them.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 6 ma-na URUDU ší-im ep-ri a-na ú-zu-a e-zi-ib
target: I left 6 minas of copper, the price of rations, with Uzuwa.

source: translate Akkadian to English: DU₁₀-ṣí-lá-a-šur sí-ki-i šu-sú-in iṣ-ba-at-ma
target: Ṭab-ṣilli-Aššur seized Šu-Suen by his hem whereupon Šu-Suen said: Why are you holding me?

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-sú-en-ma a-na mì-nim tù-kà-la-ni
target: Ṭāb-ṣilli-Aššur answered: "For the expenses I hold you!"

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma DU₁₀-ṣí-lá-a-šur-ma a-na gám-ri-im ú-kà-al-kà
target: Šu-Suen declared: "I surely retain what is stated with an oath by the city, that he holds me although I do not owe him anything!"

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-sú-in-ma ša ni-ìš a-lim{ki} ta-mu-ú lu ú-kà-al ki-ma mì-ma lá ḫa-bu-lá-ak-šu-ni-ma ú-kà-li-ni
target: In the presence of Ennam-Suen, son of Aššur-ṭāb, In the presence of Ennam-Suen, son of Aššur-ṭāb, of Abu-šalim, son of Aššur-bēl-awātim.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša-lim-a-šùr ù šu-be-lúm iṣ-bu-tù-ni-a-tí-ma um-ma šu-be-lúm-ma a-na ša-lim-a-šùr-ma a-bi a-ta a-na É a-bi-a a-na mì-ma a-na a-wa-tí-kà ga-ma-ri-im a-li-kam i-a-tí i pá-ni a-ḫi-e-a KÙ.BABBAR ša ta-da-nim dí-nam
target: Šalim-Aššur and Šu-Bēlum seized us and Šu-Bēlum said to Šalim-Aššur: You are my father, I have come to conclude your case about everything relating to my paternal house.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ša-lim-a-šùr-ma 15 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a-ma i-na pá-ni a-ḫe-kà ta-lá-qé
target: Šalim-Aššur answered: "You will indeed receive 15 minas of silver before your brothers."

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma bu-zu-a qá-ta-tù-a
target: "Now, Buzuwa is my guarantor."

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ša-lim-a-šur-ma i-na ga-ma-ar a-wa-tim ki-ma ku-a-tí ma-nam tù-šé-ša-áb
target: Šalim-Aššur continued: "At the conclusion of the matter who will you have sit down on your behalf?"

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-be-lúm-ma bu-zu-a ù a-gi-a ki-ma i-a-tí ú-šé-ša-áb KÙ.BABBAR ša i pá-ni a-ḫe-e-a ta-da-na-ni KÙ.BABBAR 2 ší-na KÙ.BABBAR lu-ṣa-ḫi-ru-ni-kum
target: Šu-Bēlum answered: "I shall have Buzuwa and Agiya sit down for me. The silver that you will give me before my brothers, those two will deduct that silver for you."

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ša-lim-a-šùr-ma šu-ma-ba bu-zu-a ù a-gi-a i-na ga-ma-ar a-wa-tim lá tù-uš-té-ší-ib
target: Šalim-Aššur said: "And if indeed you have not had Buzuwa and Agiya sit down when the case is concluded?"

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-be-lúm-ma šu-ma bu-zu-a ù a-gi-a-a i-ga-ma-ar a-wa-tim lá uš-té-ší-ib a-na 5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša bu-zu-a e-pu-li-ni mì-ma lá ta-da-nam
target: Šu-Bēlum answered: "If I have not had Buzuwa and Agiya sit down at the conclusion of the case, you shall not give me anything for the 5 minas of silver that Buzuwa balanced for me."

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um kà-ni-iš i-dí-ni-a-tí-ma IGI GÍR ša a-šùr ší-bu-tí-ni ni-dí-in IGI en-na-nim IGI a-gi-a
target: The Kanesh colony gave us for these proceedings, and we gave our testimony before Aššur's dagger. Witnessed by Ennānum, by Agiya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ku-li-a qí-bi-ma um-ma a-sà-num-ma
target: To Kuliya, thus Asānum:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam i-qá-qá-ar ší-a-ma-tim wa-áš-ba-ku ú ší-mu-um ma-ad
target: I am staying here in an area of purchases and there is much for sale!

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-ma-am ša ta-šé-e-ú i li-bi-kà ša ba-lá-ṭí-kà ú ba-lá-ṭí-ni a-na-kam-ma ú-šé-lá
target: Purchases at which you are striving, which will secure you and us a profit, I can realize here.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šál-ma-ku mì-ma i li-bi₄-kà lá ta-na-ḫi-id
target: I am well, there is not reason to worry.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-ma-am šu-ra-am ša i-dí-ú i li-bi-i ma-tí-im ša ḫa-tim KÙ.BABBAR šé-bi-lá-ma
target: Send me silver then I will make purchases.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-ma-am lá-áš-a-am-ma a-pí-iš ku-ku-ú-ma e-ra-ba-ni lu-šé-ri-ba-am
target: Since Kukū is about to arrive, let him bring them in.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ki-ma KÙ.BABBAR ṭa-aḫ-dum i-na ḫa-tim i-né-pu-šu-ni ú li-ba-kà i-ḫa-du-ú
target: Take action so that an abundance of silver can be earned in hattum and you can rejoice.

source: translate Akkadian to English: e-pu-uš KÙ.BABBAR ú-lá tù-šé-bi-lam ší-ma-am ša ú-šé-ra-ba-ni ta-ma-ar li-ba-kà e im-ra-aṣ
target: Lest you will regret not having sent me silver, when you see what purchases I am bringing in!

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-bi-i a-ta be-lí a-ta
target: My father, my lord.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ša e-na-na-tum i-dí-na-ni i-na {d}UTU-ši ú-ṣa-ni ú-ku-ba-ku-ma KÙ.BABBAR lá ú-me-er
target: As for the silver that Enannātum have me, the day I left that I did not that silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR šé-bi-lam-ma iš-tí KÙ.BABBAR a-nim lu ší-pí-ir-šu
target: Send me silver and let him be the messanger coming with that silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR e-lá tù-šé-bi-lam-ma li-ba-kà ú li-bi-i e im-ra-aṣ
target: Do not fail to send silver lest both you and I will regret it!

source: translate Akkadian to English: ḫa-nu-ba a-na-kam ú-ta-za-am um-ma šu-ut-ma a-dí-i na-áš-pè-er-tám ša ku-li-a a-ša-me-ú a-ma-kam a-ma-tim lá
target: Here hanuba keeps complaining, saying: Until I hear from Kuliya I will not release the slave-girls over there.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 ma-na AN.NA ù 0.6666 ma-na KÙ i li-bi i-dí-a-bi₄-im
target: 5 minas of tin and 0.6666 minas of silver is owed by Iddin-abum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù šu-ut ú-ku-ul-tám ša iš-tù ḫa-ḫi-im a-dí kà-ni-iš
target: He also (owes for) the food for a trip from hahhum to Kanesh.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-dí-da ú a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi-ma um-ma SIG₅-pì-a-šur-ma
target: To Adida and Ali-ahum from Damiq-pī-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na {d}UTU-ši a-ba-a e-ra-ba-ni ANŠE-ri ú ṣú-ḫa-ru lá i-bi-tù ṭur₄-da-ni-šu-nu
target: The day Abaya arrives you must not let my donkeys and servants rest - send them!

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ší-im 1 ṣú-ba-tim ú URUDU li-ib-ší
target: Let the silver, the price of 1 textile and the copper stay.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṣú-ba-tám iš-tí-in ú ší-na dí-na-ma 1.5 ma-na <gap> šu tí pá-ni-ú-tim lá ta-dí-na ú-lá AN.NA
target: Sell a couple of textiles and send me 1.5 mina with Abaya for me to dispose over.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.3333 ma-na ṣa-ru-pá-am i-ṣé-er a-šùr-ma-lik DUMU ta-ḫa-zi-ra DU₁₀-ṣí-lá-a-šùr DUMU lu-lu i-šu
target: Aššur-malik son of Tahazira owes 0.3333 mina of refined (silver) to Ṭāb-ṣill-Aššur son of Lulu.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR a-na ITU.2.KAM i-ša-qal
target: He will pay the silver in 2 months.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma lá iš-qú-ul 1 GÍN.TA KÙ.BABBAR a-na <gap> i-na ITU.KAM ṣí-ib-tám ú-ṣa-áb
target: If he has not paid (in time) he will pay interest at the rate 1 shekel of silver per month.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ITU.KAM té-i-na-tim li-mu-um da-né-a DUMU a-bu-qar
target: Month Te'inātum, eponymy Dan-Ea son of Abu-waqar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: me-eḫ-ra-at ta-aḫ-sí-is-tim a-ni-tim ša ší-be-e-kà
target: A copy of this note with your witnesses:

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-šur-i-mì-tí DUMU a-mur-a-šùr IGI a-šùr-mu-ta-bi₄-il₅ DUMU en-um-a-šùr IGI ma-num-ba-lúm-a-šùr DUMU i-ku-nim
target: Witnessed by Aššur-imittī son of Amur-Aššur, by Aššur-muttabbil son of Ennam-Aššur, by Mannum-balum-Aššur son of Ikūnum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-šùr-mu-ta-bi-il₅ qí-bi-ma šu-ma KÙ.BABBAR lá iš-ta-qal na-áš-pè-ra-tim ta-ga-<gap>-tí
target: To Aššur-muttabbil: If he has not paid the silver, then you must <gap> the missives.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na e-lá-ma qí-bi-ma um-ma a-ḫu-wa-qar
target: Say to Elamma, thus Ahu-waqar:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí ṭup-pí-im ša ta-áš-pu-ra-ni um-ma a-ta-ma KIŠIB a-lá-ḫi-im a-na e-lá-ma lá-pí-it
target: As for the tablet about which you wrote me as follows: "'Seal of Ali-ahum, to Elamma' is written (on it)",

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-um i li-bi₄ ṭup-pé-kà i-ba-ší
target: that tablet is to be found among your tablets,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ḫa-na-a ù id-na-a ik-nu-ku-šu
target: hanāya and Idnāya have sealed it.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 15.3333 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ší-im URUDU
target: 15.3333 shekels of silver, the price of copper,

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na li-bi₄ ku-lu-ú DUMU a-šur-ma-lik IGI a-lá-ḫi-im kà-ṣa-ri-šu IGI ma-nu-um-ba-lum-a-šur DUMU a-šur-re-i
target: is owed by Kullu son of Aššur-malik.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am ma-áš-kà-tám i-ṣé-er a-sà-nim <gap> ṣú-ḫa-ri-šu ú ku-li-a DUMU a-lá-bi-im i-šu-ú
target: 10 minas of refined silver, on which a claim rests, is owed by Asanum, his servant, to Kuliya son of Ali-abum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ša-na-at KÙ.BABBAR i-ša-qal
target: He will pay the silver in one year.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ITU.1.KAM qá-ra-a-tum li-mu-um i-na-sú-in DUMU i-dí-a-bi-im

target: "27 shekels of silver of Assur, of the strong room and the house(s), I gave you four years ago.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-ta-ma a-ḫi-i i-na ma-a-ma a-ma-ḫa-ar-ma KÙ.BABBAR 3 ma-na na-ší ú KÙ.BABBAR-áp-kà ú-šé-ba-lá-ku
target: You (then) said: 'I will turn to my brother in Mamma who is carrying 3 minas of silver, and I will send you your silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú KÙ.BABBAR 1 GÍN a ni-na-ša ú-šé-ba-lá-ku
target: Moreover, I will send to you, to Nenassa every (possible) shekel of silver'.

target: Now, realize well that since four years you use the silver of Assur for trading purposes and that you have kept me waiting until this very day!

target: Get hold of the silver or what has been acquired with it during its journeys and give it to my representative(s).

target: As for the words you spoke, I too can listen to the words of colleagues and friends.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na en-nam-a-šur i-ku-nim DUMU e-lá-lí ù am-ur-IŠTAR DUMU <gap>
target: To Ennam-Aššur, Ikūnum son of Elāli and Amur-Ištar son of <gap>.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB a-šùr-ma-lik DUMU i-ku-pì-a
target: Sealed by Aššur-malik son of Ikūn-pīya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na i-dí-ku-bi-im a-na-aḫ-ì-lí ú PUZUR₄-a-šùr a-na a-na-aḫ-ì-lí qí-bi-ma um-ma ku-li-a-ma
target: To Iddin-Kūbum, Anah-ilī, and Puzur-Aššur, especially to Anah-ilī, thus says Kuliya:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.3333 ma-na ú ṣí-ba-tí-šu KÙ.BABBAR a-na a-bu-ša-lim DUMU en-na-sú-in ḫa-bu-lá-tí-ma
target: You owe to Abu-šalim, son of Ennam-Suen, 1.3333 mina of silver plus its accumulated interest.

source: translate Akkadian to English: na-áš-pé-er-tum ša a-šùr-DU₁₀ i-li-kam-ma a-na 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a-wa-at-kà i-gi₅-mì-ir
target: A letter of Aššur-ṭāb arrived here and for an amount of 1 mina of silver your affair has been settled.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR šu-a-tí-i a-na-ku a-pu-ul
target: I myself have guaranteed that amount of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫa-ma 0.3333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ba-áb DINGIR a-na a-bi₄-ni ta-dí-i
target: Moreover, you have 0.3333 mina of silver to our father in the Gate of the god.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-té-ni-iš ša 1.3333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṭup-pá-kà al-pu-ut
target: I drew up your tablet for a total of 1.3333 mina of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: na-áš-pé-er-tám ša ku-nu-ki-a ša 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR tù-kà-aal ú ša-ni-tám ša 0.3333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR tù-kà-aal
target: You have in your possession a letter with my seal (good) for 1 mina of silver and a second (good) for 0.3333 mina of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: táq-bi₄-a-am um-ma a-ta-ma a-li-ik-ma ṭup-pá-am ša ku-nu-uk a-šùr-DU₁₀ li-qí-a-am
target: You told me as follows: Go and obtain for me a tablet sealed by Aššur-ṭāb.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pá-am ša ku-nu-uk a-šùr-DU₁₀ al-qé-a-ku ša a-bu-šu ú šu-ut a-na ku-a-tí ú me-er-i-e-kà lá i-tù-ru-ni
target: I obtained for you a tablet sealed by Aššur-ṭāb stating that neither his father nor he himself will come back on you and your sons.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫi a-ta 1.3333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ku-nu-uk-ma a-na PUZUR₄-a-šùr pí-qí-id-ma lu-ub-lam
target: Please, my brother, put 1.3333 mina of silver under seal and entrust it to Puzur-Aššur to bring it here.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pá-am ša ku-nu-uk a-šùr-DU₁₀ ú ṭup-pá-am
target: Send me a message then I will give both the tablet sealed by Aššur-ṭāb and the one of 1.3333 mina of silver with your own seal to your representatives.

target: 2 talent 56.6666 minas of tin, including the loose tin, at 14 3 / 4 shekels per (shekel of silver), its price in silver: 11 minas 59.6666 shekels; 2.3333 minas of silver, the price of the textiles and the donkeys.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2.3333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ŠU.NÍGIN <gap> 14.3333 ma-na LÁ 0.3333 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR e-lá-ma is-ni-iq-ni-a-tí
target: In all 14 minas 19.6666 shekels of silver Elamma weighed out to us.

target: Let us go in accordance with the verdict of the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: qí-bi-ma a-ḫi a-ta
target: Say, my dear brother.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na {d}UTU-ši ṭup-pí ta-ša-me-ú tí-ib-a-ma a-tal-kam
target: The very day you hear my letter set out and leave.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lá a-kà-ṣa-ad
target: I shall not seize.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ša ki-ma i-a-tí qí-bi-ma
target: To my representatives say.

source: translate Akkadian to English: e-na-aḫ-DINGIR be-lá-num aḫ-ša-lim ù lá-qé-pu-um i mì-ig-ra-tí-šu-nu iṣ-bu-tù-ni-a-tí
target: Enah-ilī, Bēlānum, Ah-šalim and Lā-qēp seized us by joint agreement.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na u₄-mì-im ša e-na-aḫ-DINGIR be-lá-num ù aḫ-ša-lim KÙ.BABBAR ša ik-ri-be ša ma-za-zi-im ša šu-a-šur qá-sú-nu ma-lá i-ša-qú-lu-ni ù lá-qé-pu-um qá-sú i-ša-qal
target: On the day when Enah-ilī, Bēlānum and Ah-šalim pay their shares of the silver of Šu-Aššur's pledge, then Lā-qēp must also pay his share.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI PUZUR₄-a-na IGI a-lá-ḫi-im
target: Witnessed by Puzur-Anna, by Ali-ahum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 17 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am i-na ší-im SÍG.ḪI.A ša ú-ší-na-lam a-šùr-iš-tí-kál DUMU sú-kà-li-a il₅-qé
target: Aššuriš-tikal son of Sukalliya has received 17 minas of refined silver from the proceeds of Ušinalam's wool.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI en-um-a-šùr DUMU sú-in-na-da IGI a-šùr-i-mì-tí IGI iš-me-DINGIR IGI en-na-sú-in IGI i-<gap>-ni IGI a-lá+lá-<gap> a-ḫi-šu IGI e-lá-lí DUMU i-pí-li-is
target: Witnessed by Ennam-Aššur son of Suen-nādā, by Aššur-imittī, by Išme-ilum, by Enna-Suen, by I<gap>, by Alā<gap> his brother, by Elāli son of Ippilis.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi₄-ma um-ma PUZUR₄-a-šur-ma
target: To Ali-ahum from Puzur-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša a pá-ni-a a ḫu-ra-ma tù-šé-bi₄-lá-ni-ma
target: As to the 0.5 mina of silver that you sent to me in hurrama,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ku-nu-ki-a en-na-nu-um DUMU ku-zi-a na-áš-a-ku-um
target: Ennānum son of Kuziya brings you 0.5 mina of silver under my seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: na-áš-pè-ra-tum ša a-lim{ki} ša a-ṣé-ri-kà ub-lu-ni-ku-ni
target: The missives from the City that they brought to you,

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫi a-ta a ba-tí-qí-im pá-ni-im <gap> ub-lu
target: my dear brother, to the first express caravan <gap>

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-IŠTAR-ma a-na en-na-sú-in qí-bí-ma
target: Thus Šu-Ištar, say to Ennam-Suen:

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-šu ša ta-áš-pu-ra-ma um-ma a-ta-ma 0.5-ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ḫu-bu-lá-am a-ma-at-kà té-pu-uš
target: Why have you written me as follows: 'Your maid has contracted a debt of 0.5 mina of silver'.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ṣé-er ra-ga-at-ni ù ḫu-bu-lá-am a-na na-ša-a té-pá-áš
target: She is not only wicked, but is also contracting a debt for her <gap>

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 ma-na 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR šé-bu-lá-tim uš-té-bi₄-lá-ší-im
target: I have sent her consignments of silver amounting to 10 minas and 10 shekels!

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-kam a-ta ù-la ta-na-ṭá-al
target: Over there, you are not even looking!

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma i-a-tí-i ta-ṭá-ba-am
target: Is it really to me that you are being nice?

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-am-tám ḫa-li-iq a-na ta-al-ḫa-tim dí-i-ší a-na DUMU a-šùr lá ta-dá-ší
target: Get rid of the maid, sell her to a man from Talhat, do not sell her to an Assyrian!

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB en-nam-a-šur DUMU um-ma-sá a-šur-DÙL DUMU a-šùr-ša-dí-li ki-ma ku-li-a DUMU a-lá-bi₄-im a-na a-šur-e-mu-qí DUMU šu-ra-ma iṣ-ba-at-ni-a-tí-ma um-ma a-šur-DÙL-ma KÙ.BABBAR-áp be-lúm-ba-ni DAM.GÀR-ri-im ša ku-li-a tal-qé lá tal-qé-e IGI a-ni-e-ma i-ki-ir ú-ul kà-i-in
target: Seal of Ennam-Aššur, son of Ummassa. Aššur-ṣulūlī, son of Aššur-šād-ilī representing Kuliya, son of Ali-abum, seized us against Aššur-emūqī, son of Šu-rama, and Aššur-ṣulūlī said as follows: The silver of Bēlum-bāni, the agent of Kuliya, did you take it, yes or no? Deny or confirm before these men.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-šur-e-mu-qí-ma al-qé ú al-qé-ma ú u₄-ma-am a-lá-qé-ma a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um kà-ni-eš TUR.GAL i-dí-na-ni IGI GÍR ša a-šur ší-bu-tí a-dí-in a-šur-lá-ma-sí DUMU i-tur₄-a-num tap-pá-i
target: Aššur-emūqī said: I took it, yes I took it and today I would (again) take it! For this affair the plenary Kanesh 'gave' me (as witness) and before Aššur's dagger I gave my testimony. Aššur-lamassī, son of Itūr-Anum, was my companion.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB a-šùr-lá-ma-sí DUMU i-tur₄-a-num a-šur-DÙL DUMU a-šur-ša-dí-li ša ki-ma ku-li-a DUMU a-lá-bi₄-im a-na a-šùr-e-mu-qí DUMU šu-ra-ma iṣ-ba-at-ni-a-tí-ma um-ma a-šur-ANDUL-ma a-na a-šur-e-mu-qí-ma KÙ.BABBAR be-lúm-ba-ni DAM.GÀR-ri-im ša ku-li-a tal-qé lá tal-qé-e IGI a-ni-e-ma i-ki-ir ú-ul kà-i-in
target: Seal of Aššur-lamassī, son of Itūr-Anum. Aššur-ṣululī, son of Aššur-šād-ilē, who represents Kuliya, son of Ali-abum, seized us against Aššur-emūqī, son of Šu-rama, and Aššur-ṣululī said to Aššur-emūqī: Did you take the silver of Bēlum-bāni Kuliya's agent, yes or no? Deny or confirm it before these (witnesses)!

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-šur-e-mu-qí-ma al-qé ú al-qé-ma ú u₄-ma-am a-lá-qé-ma a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um té-ga-ra-ma TUR.GAL i-dí-na-ni-ma IGI GÍR ša a-š
target: Aššur-emūqī answered: I took it, yes I took it and today I would (again) take (it)! For this affair the plenary of Tegarama gave us and before Aššur's dagger I gave my testimony.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.3333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am i-na ší-im SÍG.ḪI.A ša ú-ší-na-lam šu-ku-bu-um DUMU e-na-ma-nim il₅-qé
target: Šu-Kūbum son of Ennam-Anum has received 1.3333 mina of refined silver from the proceeds of Ušinalam's wool.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI i-lá-áš-ra-ni DUMU sú-kà-li-a IGI en-na-sú-in DUMU i-dí-a-bi₄-im
target: Witnessed by Ilī-ašrannī son of Sukkalliya, by Enna-Suen son of Iddin-abum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ša-lim-a-šur qí-bi-ma um-ma ša-lim-a-šur-ma
target: To Šalim-Aššur from Šalim-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-šu-mì ili₅-ba-ni DUMU i-a-a a-dí ší-ni-šu tí-ir-tí i-li-kà-ku-um
target: I sent you word twice about Ilī-bāni son of Yaya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ki-ma lá-am-ni-iš e-ta-na-pu-šu iš-tù na-aḫ-ri-a tí-i-ir-tí a-šur-ma-lik DUMU šu-IŠTAR i-li-kam
target: Since he keeps behaving in an evil manner a message from Aššur-malik son of Šu-Ištar came from Nahriya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-ut-ma 8 TÚG.ḪI.A ili₅-ba-ni a-ṣé-ri-a im-tù-qú-ut
target: He said: Ilī-bāni has attacked me for 8 textiles.

source: translate Akkadian to English: TÚG.ḪI.A a-na ili₅-ba-ni ni-im-nu-ma šu-ut a-na a-šur-ma-lik im-nu-šu-nu
target: We counted the textiles for Ilī-bāni and he himself counted them for Aššur-malik.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 e-li-tám a-šur-ma-lik i-na pá-ni wa-ṣa-i-šu e-zi-ma ili₅-ba-ni il₅-qé-ší
target: Aššur-malik left one top-pack before his departure and Ilī-bāni took that.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-ṣé-er ṣú-ḫa-ri-im lá i-ma-qú-ut
target: He shall not attack the servant for anything.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-lim{ki} pá-nu-kà
target: You are planning to go to the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma li-ba-kà am-ma-kam lá i-za-ku-ru <gap> li-li-ku-nim
target: If you please, they should not formally state (it) there (<gap>) they should come.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam li-iz-ku-ú-ma a-šar i-bu-ra-ni KÙ.BABBAR-kà le-qé
target: They should clear the matter here and then take your silver where it appears.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR en-um-a-šùr DUMU ša-lim-a-šur a-na šu-IŠTAR DUMU šu-ki-tim i-nu-mì a-na a-lim{ki} i-lu-ku i-da-šu-ma
target: Ennam-Aššur son of Šalim-Aššur will give 1.5 mina of silver to Šu-Ištar son of Šukkutum when he goes to the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am i-na tù-wa-ri-šu šu-IŠTAR a-na en-um-a-šùr i-ša-qal
target: And on his return Šu-Ištar will pay 3 minas of refined silver to Ennam-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI šu-ma-bi-a DUMU a-mu-ra-a IGI la-qé-ep DUMU šu-a-šùr
target: Witnessed by Šumi-abiya son of Amuraya, by Lā-qēp son of Šu-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-šùr-ma-lik ša-lim-a-šur ù ì-lí-a-ma a-na ša-lim-a-šur qí-bi-ma
target: From Aššur-malik, Šalim-Aššur and Iliya to Šalim-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: la-ma a-šur-ša-du-e i-li-kà-ni la-ma ṭup-pí-kà ub-lá-ni ITU.2.KAM šu-be-lúm i pá-ni a-šur-ša-du-e i-li-kam-ma
target: Before Aššur-šadu'e arrived, before he brought your letter, Šu-Bēlum arrived two months before Aššur-šadu'e.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-be-lúm šu-ku-ba-am DUMU a-šur-be-el-a-wa-tim ù a-ḫi-šu iṣ-ba-at-ma a-na a-lim{ki} ir-de₈-šu-nu-ma
target: Šu-Bēlum seized Šu-Kūbum son of Aššur-bēl-awātim and his brother and conducted them to the City assembly.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù né-nu a-wa-tám nu-ta-er-ma um-ma né-nu-ma a-wa-tù-šu-nu ga-am-ra a-na ša ni-iš a-lim{ki} i-tù-a-ar
target: And then it was us who rebuffed the matter, saying: Their case is closed. He is reopening a matter that has been sworn by the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-lúm{ki} dí-nam i-dí-in-ma šu-be-lúm ù DUMU.MÍ i-sú-rik₁₃ a-na šu-ku-bi-im ù a-ḫi-šu la i-tù-ru
target: The City passed a verdict, stating that Šu-Bēlum and Issu-arik's daughter must not raise claim against Šu-Kūbum and his brother.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ku-bu-um a-na kà-ni-iš i-lá-ak-ma i-tur₄-DINGIR ù ku-a-tí a-na šu-be-lim ú-kà-an ki-ma lu-qú-tám ip-qí-da-ku-nu-tí-ni
target: Šu-Kūbum must go to Kanesh to make you and Itūr-ilī confirm to Šu-Bēlum that he entrusted the goods to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša a-na gám-ra-tim a-na ša ni-iš a-lim{ki} i-tù-ra-ku-ni ta-lá-kam-ma a-dí MU.1.ŠÈ a-wa-tám a-na É a-bi-kà ta-da-an
target: Since he has raised claim against you for everything that had been sworn by the City, you must come and open a case for your paternal estate within one year.

source: translate Akkadian to English: SAG ITU.1.KAM be-el-té-É.GAL-lim li-mu-um e-lá-lí DUMU i-ku-nim
target: Dated the beginning of the month Bēlat-ekallim, the eponymy of Elāli son of Ikūnum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-pu-tum ṭup-pí-kà ší-bi₄-kà da-a-a-ni-kà ga-me-er a-wa-tí-kà ša a-na a-lim{ki} i-la-kà-ni li-li-kam ša lá i-la-kà-ni ša-sí-ḫa-a
target: Urgent! As to your tablets, your witnesses, your judges, those who settled your affair - he who will come to the City should come; he who will not come you must extradite - confirm your tablets and your witnesses!

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tí ší-ip-ri-ku-nu a-na da-me-e ša a-ḫi-a šé-a-im a-ta-lá-ak
target: I left with your envoys to sue for blood-money for my brother.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tí ru-ba-im ta-am-ni-a-i-im ni-na-me-er-ma um-ma ší-ip-ru-ma a-ḫu-ni i-na ep-ri-kà me-et né-nu ù a-ḫu-šu a-ba-ú-kà iš-tí-ni da-me-e ša a-wi-lim šé-e
target: We met with the king of Tawniya and the envoys said: Our brother has died in your territory. We and his brothers are your fathers. Search for the blood-money for the man together with us.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ru-ba-ú-ma qá-i-a <gap> a-ma-ru-um am ri-<gap> a-ḫi-kà lá ú-ra-dí <gap> KÙ.BABBAR 5 ma-na ag-mu-ur
target: The king answered: Wait! <gap> I shall not add <gap> to your brother's <gap> I spent at least 5 minas of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ra-mì-ni i mu-tim áš-lu-ḫa-ma i kà-ni-iš áš-li-ma-ma um-ma a-na-ku-ma a-ḫi-i a šu-mì a-mu-tí-kà dí-ik KÙ.BABBAR ša šu-mì lá-qé-ep it-bu-lu <gap> KÙ.BABBAR a-mu-tim sú-re-e ša ta-dí-nu-šu-ni dí-ik a-li-ik-ma da-me-e ša a-ḫi-a šé-e
target: I myself escaped death and I arrived safely in Kanesh and said: My brother was killed because of your iron. The silver that he took away in the name of Lā-qēp - surely he was killed for the silver for the iron that you gave to him. Go and sue for the blood-money for my brother.

source: translate Akkadian to English: kà-ru-um iš-al-šu-ma um-ma kà-ru-ma a-wi-lúm a šu-mì a-mu-tí-kà dí-ik a-li-ik-ma da-me-e ša a-wi-lim šé-e
target: The colony questioned him saying: The man was killed because of your iron. Go and sue for the blood-money for the man.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-ut-ma ú-lá a-lá-ak ṭup-pá-am ša ḫu-bu-ul a-wi-lim ú-kà-al a-na a-mu-tim na-is-ḫa-ku
target: He answered: I shall not go. I have a tablet concerning the man's debt. Because of the iron I have been released of my responsibility.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a pì-i kà-ri-im ú-dí-e-ma ša a-dí-ni zi-bu-um ša a-bi₄-a lá i-ri-qú ù ṭup-pè-e lu e-mu-uq a-ḫi-a ša a-ḫi ú-kà-lu lá ú-za-ki-ú
target: In accordance with the colony I announced that so far my father's <gap> has not been idle, and he has not cleared the tablets, or the fortune of my brother, which my brother has.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ma-nu-ki-a-šùr ù a-ḫa-tim qí-bi-ma um-ma ú-ṣur-ša-a-šùr-ma
target: To Mannu-kī-Aššur and Ahātum from Uṣur-ša-Aššur; specifically to Mannu-kī-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫi a-ta šu-ma am-tum KÙ.BABBAR ta-aḫ-ta-ša-aḫ KÙ.BABBAR 2 GÍN dí-ší-im
target: My dear brother, if the maid wants silver, give her some 2 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam a-na a-wa-tim ša ki-ma um-me-a-ni-a i-ṣa-áb-tù-ni
target: The representatives of my investor have been seized here for a lawsuit.

source: translate Akkadian to English: wa-ar-ki ṭup-pí-im a-nim a-na ITU.1.KAM a-ma-qú-tám
target: I shall arrive one month after this letter.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na KÙ.BABBAR-pí-kà 2 GÍN ša a-na am-tim ta-du-nu-ni ší-a-ma-at a-lim{ki} a-šùr i pá-ni-a ú-ba-lá-kum
target: As for your silver, the 2 shekels that you will give to the maid, I shall personally bring you purchases from the city of Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ma am-tum a-ma-kam ḫu-bu-lam lá té-pá-áš
target: The maid must not make any debts there.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù ṭup-pè lu ša DAM.GÀR ša e-zi-bu lu ta-na-ṣú-ur
target: And she must guard the tablets of the customers that I left.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 TÚG KI ša-ḫa-ma
target: 1 textile owed by Šahama.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 TÚG KI sú-is-ḫa-ra šu wa-áb-ri-ni IGI a-šùr-ba-ni
target: 1 textile owed by Su-Ishara, our guest.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2.5 TÚG a-na ší-mì-im i-na É.GAL-lim il₅-qé-ú 1.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i-na-pu-lu-šum
target: 2.5 textiles in the palace they took for sale, they will balance him? 1.5 shekel of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ḫu-lu-qá-ú <gap> ik-šu-ud
target: To 1 0.5 shekel of silver the losses <gap> amounted.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-im 2.5 TÚG ku-ta-ni
target: The price of 2.5 tiles, 0.5 mina of silver, Aššur-ṣulūlī gave to Kūn-ilum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 GÍN AN.NA a šé-né-šu <gap>
target: Separately, 5 11 / 12 shekels of silver of his one-third-share Aššur-ṣulūlī took.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 GÚ 15 ma-na AN.NA ku-nu-ku 4 TÚG šu-ru-tum li-wi-tum 17 TÚG ku-ta-ni 17 ma-na AN.NA-ak qá-tim 2 ANŠE ṣa-lá-mu ŠU.NÍGIN
target: Thereof: 2 talents 10 minas of tin under seals applied in the City, 4 dark textiles, its wrapping, 12 -textiles, 2 black donkeys, and separately one -textile of Ku'uku.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 GÚ 18 ma-na AN.NA a-wi-it i-li-a iš-tù a-lim{ki} a-di kà-ni-iš{ki}
target: All this Ku'uku brought to hinnāya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 GÚ-tám 4 ma-na 6.25 GÍN.TA da-tum ik-šu-dam 15 GÍN.TA qá-qá-da-tù-um 17.5 ma-na 4 GÍN AN.NA áš-qúl
target: Of the (remaining) 1 talent of tin with its surplus that I entrusted here <<and>> 6 minas were (paid) as import-tax, for 3 talents of tin the -tax amounted to 34 minas of tin, 12.5 minas of tin Kūn-ilum took.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 16.6666 GÍN mu-ṭá AN.NA-ak qá-tim 4 ša bi-lá-tim iš-tù tí-mì-il₅-ki-a a-di ḫu-ra-ma 0.3333 ma-na 6 GÍN.TA 1.6666 ma-na 4 GÍN áš-qúl
target: 8 minas 31 shekels Ilī-ālum took, 2.8333 minas of tin from the deficiency of the loose tin we handed over to Ku'uku.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3.6666 ma-na 5 GÍN AN.NA ú-kúl-ti 2 ANŠE-re ù sá-ri-dim ù na-ab-ri-ta-šu-nu ANŠE-re i sí-kà-tim it-ru-ú-ma a-na pá-ṭá-ri-šu-nu 0.8333 ma-na AN.NA áš-qúl
target: Aššur-ṣulūlī represented to hinnāya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na LÁ 1 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-ḫa-ma 8 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ù 2.25 GÍN KÙ.KI ša DAM ku-ni-lim
target: 29 shekels of silver, separately 8 shekels of silver and 2 1 / 4 shekels of gold of Kūn-ilum's wife.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2.25 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ni-is-ḫa-tum ša a-šur i-li-a DUMU ku-ni-lim e-zi-ib
target: 2 1 / 4 shekels of silver, excise for Assur, Iliya, son of Kūn-ilum left behind.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR a-ni-um ša IŠTAR-lá-ma-sí DAM ku-ni-lim a-na na-áb-šé-em a-na lá-ma-sà-tim DAM e-lá-ma ta-dí-nu
target: This money, which Ištar-lamassī, Kūn-ilum's wife, had given in deposit to Lamassutum, Elamma's wife.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ki-ma me-er-e ku-ni-lim en-um-a-šur DUMU a-šur-dan ù šu-mì-a-bi₄-a DUMU e-mu-a ša-zu-uz-tum ša me-er-e ku-ni-lim KÙ.BABBAR ù KÙ.KI ik-nu-ku-ma a-na en-um-ì-lí DUMU ḫa-da-a ni-ip-qí-id-ma a-na a-lim{ki} a-ṣé-er DUMU.MÍ ku-ni-lim ú-ba-al
target: Acting for Kūn-ilum's sons Ennam-Aššur, son of Aššur-dān, and Šumi-abiya, son of Emua, the representatives of Kūn-ilum's sons, have sealed this silver and gold and we entrusted it to Ennam-ilī, son of hadāya, to bring it to the City, to the address of Kūn-ilum's daughter.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša-du-a-sú ša-bu
target: He has been paid his transport fee.

target: In the presence of Ippalu, son of Amur-Ištar, of Aššur-mālik, son of Amura, of Aššur-imittī, son of Anīnum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 TÚG ší-li-ip-ki-ú a-na DINGIR-ba-ni

source: translate Akkadian to English: 40 ma-na ni-ga-lu 30 ma-na sà-am-ru-a-tum 3.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR 30 ma-na AN.NA mì-ma a-nim a-na qá-tí en-um-a-šùr a-dí-in

target: All this - belonging to Innaya and the merchant - Ennam-Aššur will lead.

target: Witnessed by Babali, by Pilah-Ištar, by Bitaya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB šu-ku-bi-im DUMU a-šùr-i-dí KIŠIB i-dí-IŠTAR DUMU a-šùr-i-dí sú-in-na-da DUMU en-um-a-šùr tap-pá-i-ni
target: Sealed by Šu-Kūbum son of Aššur-idī, by Iddin-Ištar son of Aššur-idī; Suen-nādā son of Ennam-Aššur was our (absent) partner.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um kà-ni-iš ṣa-ḫe-er GAL i-dí-ni-a-tí-ma
target: The plenary assembly of the Kanesh colony gave us for these proceedings.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-bu-tí-ni IGI GÍR ša a-šùr ni-dí-in
target: We gave our testimony before Aššur's dagger.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-a ḫa-ru-mu-tum me-eḫ-ru-a ú ta-aḫ-sí-sà-tum
target: My certified tablets, my copies and memoranda.

target: To Innaya and <gap> from Ilī-bāni:

target: Of the 30 minas of silver that Balṭu-šar brought to Amur-Ištar's house: additions were 0.6666 mina 2.5 shekels - 0.3333 of a mina.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 GÚ LÁ 5 ma-na AN.NA 17 GÍN.TA KÙ.BI 17.3333 ma-na 1.3333 GÍN
target: 4 talents less 5 minas of tin at the rate in silver 1 to 17, its price in silver: 17.3333 minas 1.3333 shekels.

source: translate Akkadian to English: me-at ku-ta-nu qá-dí ša li-we-tim 8.5 ma-na 8 GÍN it-bu-lu
target: 100 including those from the wrapping cost 8.5 minas 8 shekels.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 ANŠE ṣa-lá-mu 1.5 ma-na 3.5 GÍN it-bu-lu
target: 5 black donkeys cost 1.5 mina 3.5 shekels.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 14 GÍN lu ú-nu-ut ANŠE.ḪI lu ú-ku-ul-tum
target: 14 shekels: both harness and fodder for the donkeys.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 GÍN ša sà-e-tim
target: 3 shekels: of the .

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na 1 GÍN be-ú-lá-at ḫa-ni ni-dí-šum
target: We gave 0.5 mina 1 shekel as the working capital of hani to him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na be-ú-lá-at ḫa-ni ša a-na ba-al-ṭù-šar ta-dí-na-ni 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR bu-lá-tí-šu-ma ni-il₅-qé
target: Of the working capital of hani that you gave to Balṭu-šar we received 10 shekels of silver as his own assets.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-ut-ma ḫa-ni 90 ku-ta-ni 2 GÚ 10 ma-na 4 ANŠE ṣa-lá-mì ú-nu-sú-nu {d}UTU.DU₁₀ DUMU ga-<gap>-ma-nim ú ḫa-ni i-ra-dí-ú-ni-ku-nu-tí
target: He said: as for hani<gap>" Šamaš-ṭāb son of Ga<gap>mannum and hani lead 90, 2 talents 10 minas (of tin), 4 donkeys and their harness to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ki-ma ḫa-ra-num na-áp-ta at-ni <gap> ma-na AN.NA <gap> ú e-li-tù-šu ku-<gap> ù i pá-ni-im-ma ni-ba-kam
target: As the road has become open <gap> minas of tin <gap> his top-pack <gap> we shall dispatch as soon as possible.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 25 ma-na <gap> kà {d}UTU.DU₁₀ ni-dí-in
target: 25 minas <gap> we gave (to) Šamaš-ṭāb.

source: translate Akkadian to English: be-ú-lá+lá-<gap>-in ší-a-ma-at 15 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR <gap> a-na i-na-a
target: <gap> purchase of 15 shekels of silver. <gap> give to Innaya."

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ma-ma-ḫi-ir lá-qé-ep a-lá-ḫi-im ù šu-IŠTAR qí-bi-ma um-ma en-um-a-šur-ma
target: To Man-mahir, Lā-qēp, Ali-ahum and Šu-Ištar from Ennam-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: ta-áš-pu-ra-nim um-ma a-tù-nu-ma um-me-a-nu a-bi-kà ma-lá i-na pá-ni-tim tù-<gap>-um ma-ag-ru-kà
target: You have written, saying: "Your father's investors have agreed with you as much as you suggested earlier."

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫu-a-tù-nu 4 a-tù-nu a-na ṣé-er um-me-a-ni a-bi-ni pu-nu-a-ma a-wa-tí-ni ga-me-ra-ma
target: My dear brothers, you four must turn to our father's investors, and conclude our entire case

source: translate Akkadian to English: URUDU-um ša ú-ṣú-ur-ša-a-šur il₅-qé-ú i-na KÙ.BABBAR-pí-šu li-iṣ-ḫi-ir
target: and as to the copper that Uṣur-ša-Aššur has taken, let it be deducted from his silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-<gap> ki-ma ra-mì-ni <gap> ki-ma i-<gap>-a-ma <gap>-ta-a a-na-ku ù a-lá-ḫu-um lu ni-iš-qú-ul
target: I and Ali-ahum should pay.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma um-me-a-nu a-bi-ni i-pá-lu-ḫu-ma ni-iš a-lim{ki} lá i-ta-mu-ú ma-lá a-wa-tim i-na pá-ni-tim ú-kà-i-lu a-wa-tum lu-up-ta
target: If our father's investors are afraid and do not swear the oath by the City, then write the words I earlier suggested.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-wa-tim ga-me-ra-ma ik-ri-bu-um i-na ba-ri-ku-nu li-qí-bi-ma i-na a-lá-ki-a a-na-ku ù a-lá-ḫu-um mu-ta-a KÙ.BABBAR lu ni-iš-qú-ul
target: Conclude the case and let an oath be sworn among you, so I and Ali-ahum may pay half the silver each.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫu-a a-tù-nu a-na pá-ni-a tí-ir-ta-ku-nu iš-tí ṣú-ḫa-ri-a a-ni-tum lá a-ni-tum li-li-kam-ma ṭé-mì-i lu ṣa-áb-ta-am
target: My dear brothers, send me word with my servant whether it is one or the other, so I can make up my mind.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a ba-ri-ku-nu i-na e-ra-bi₄-a a-wa-tí i-na a-ma-ri-a e i-ba-al-ku-ta-a-nim
target: Between you, when I arrive and consider the case, it must not be overturned for me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma a-tù-nu a-na ta-<gap> ta-ša-ḫu-ṭá a-dí a-lá-ki-a i
target: If you yourselves fear <gap> then let it be said between you so as not to transgress until I arrive.

source: translate Akkadian to English: DUB ḫa-ru-mu-tum ša nu-a-e
target: Certified tablets concerning Anatolians.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šál-ma-a-šùr a-ṣé-er a-mur-IŠTAR ú-ṭá-ḫi-ú-ni-a-tí-ma um-ma šál-ma-a-šur-ma a-na a-mur-IŠTAR-ma mì-šu-um ší-im TÚG-ba-tí-a URUDU ta-aṣ-ba-at
target: Šalim-Aššur made us approach Amur-Ištar, and Šalim-Aššur said to Amur-Ištar: Why have you seized the copper that was the proceeds from my textiles?

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-mur-IŠTAR-ma ke-na 4 GÚ lá-mu-nam aṣ-ba-at ba-lu-um ḫi-na-a ú ší-bé aṣ-ba-at
target: Amur-Ištar answered: Yes, I have seized 4 talents of poor copper. I seized it without hinnaya's permission and without witnesses.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ša-lim-a-šur-ma ḫa-bu-ra-ta-i-am tal-qé
target: Šalim-Aššur said: Did you take copper from haburat?

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-mur-IŠTAR-ma ša i qá-tim <gap>-ta-šu-šu al-qé
target: Amur-Ištar answered: I took what I could grab.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-mur-IŠTAR-ma a-ta lu-qú-tí ša 10 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ta-aṣ-ba-at
target: Amur Ištar continued: But did you not seize my merchandise worth 10 minas of silver?

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ša-lim-a-šur mì-ma lá aṣ-ba-at-ma
target: Šalim-Aššur answered: I have seized nothing.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-mur-IŠTAR-ma a ṣú-ḫa-ri-a a za-al-pá áš-ta-pár ṣú-ḫa-ri li-li-kam-ma lá-ta-wu
target: Amur-Ištar said: I have sent my servant to Zalpa. When my servant comes I shall discuss (further).

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-mur-IŠTAR-ma a-na-ku a-šé-e-kà ú-ul a-ta ta-šé-e-a-ni
target: Amur-Ištar continued: It is I who am suing you, not you who are suing me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI MAR.TU-ba-ni IGI pu-šu-ki-in a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um kà-né-eš i-dí-ni-a-tí-ma IGI GÍR ša a-šùr ší-bu-tí-ni ni-dí-in
target: Witnessed by Amurrum-bāni, by Pūšu-kēn. The Kanesh colony gave us for these proceedings and we gave our testimony before Aššur's dagger.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.3333 ma-na 1.3333 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am i li-bi šé-ep-IŠTAR 1 GÍN iš-tí e-wa-ri-mu-ša
target: 0.3333 mina 1.3333 shekel of refined silver is in Šēp-Ištar's possession.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-nu-mì zu-zu-a DUMU i-tur₄-DINGIR a-ša-sú e-ḫu-zu
target: When Zuzuwa son of Itūr-ilī married his wife.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na a-ší-tí-šu a-dí-in
target: I gave 3 shekels of silver to his wife.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 29 TÚG šu-ru-tum ša šu-IŠTAR 15 TÚG ša en-na-sú-in
target: 29 dark textiles of Šu-Ištar, 15 textiles of Ennam-Suen.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠU.NÍGIN 44 TÚG šu-ru-tum ša šu-IŠTAR ù en-na-sú-in
target: In all 44 dark textiles of Šu-Ištar and Ennam-Suen.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ.BA 4 TÚG i-na li-wi-tim 4 TÚG ni-is-ḫa-tum 4 TÚG i ší-mì-im
target: Thereof: 4 textiles used for wrapping, 4 textiles import-tax, 4 textiles by pre-emption.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-šur-SIG₅ qí-bi-ma um-ma ni-ni-ma a-na KÙ.BABBAR GAL a-ta-na-lá-ak-ma mì-ma ta-da-na-am lá i-mu-a-am
target: To Aššur-damiq from Nini: I keep going for silver but he refuses to give me anything.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-li-a KÙ.BABBAR ù ṭá-áb-tám la i-dí-na-a
target: Iliya has not given me silver or salt.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na kà-ni-ìš <gap> a-ṣé-er <gap> tim <gap> ri-im té-zi-bi₄-ni
target: In Kanesh that you left with me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-pu-tum URUDU ša e-me-ri-im šé-bi-lá-am
target: Urgent, send me copper belonging to Emmerum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na KÙ.BABBAR lá ta-da-gal
target: Do not expect silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ma lá i-da-na-am
target: He gives me nothing.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma be-lí a-ta KÙ.BABBAR ša nu-a-im ša-bi₄-i
target: If you are truly my lord, satisfy me with the silver from the Anatolian.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na en-nam-a-šur ù a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi₄-ma um-ma SIG₅-pí-a-šùr-ma
target: To Ennam-Aššur and Ali-ahum from Damiq-pī-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na LÁ 1 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ù sà-ḫi-ir-tám ku-nu-ki-kà na-ki-ru-um ub-lam
target: The brought me 29 shekels of silver and small goods under seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a-ni-na ú e-ni-iš-ta-ru-um ub-lá-ku-nu-tí
target: Annima and Eništārum brought you 10 minas of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ša tù-šé-bi-lá-ni a-na ni-ip-lá-tí-a áš-ta-qal
target: The silver you sent me I have paid to cover my balance payments.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú-mu-ú er-ša-sú-ma ILLAT kà-al-a-at
target: The weather <gap> and the caravan has been stopped.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫu-a a-tù-nu i-na lu-qú-tim ša tám-kà-ri-im ṣú-ba-tù an-ḫu-tù-um i-ba-ší-ú
target: My dear brothers, among the goods of the merchant there are some old textiles.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iḫ-da-ma mì-li-ik lu-qú-tí-im
target: Take care and decide about the goods.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-il₅-kà a-ḫu-a a-tù-nu KÙ.BABBAR ší-im AN.NA <gap> šé-bi-lá-ni-ma KÙ.BABBAR-pì <gap> i-na ṣé-ri-a šu-uk-na
target: My dear brothers, send me silver, the proceeds from the tin, and deposit my silver to my debit.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí tí-ir-ta-ak-nu i-lá-kà-ni ri-iš lu-qú-tim ú-kà-al
target: I hold on to the goods until your orders arrive.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ku-zi-zi-a IŠTAR-lá-ma-sí na-áb-sú-in a-na-na a-mur-IŠTAR ša-lim-ar-dí ma-nu-ki-DINGIR-a qí-bi-ma um-ma en-um-a-šur-ma
target: To Kuziziya, Ištar-lamassī, Nāb-Suen, Anna-anna, Amur-Ištar, Šalim-wardī (and) Mannum-kī-iliya from Ennam-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.5 ma-na 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ku-nu-ki ša ku-ku-wa ù ku-nu-ki-a ù 7 ANŠE.ḪI.A ṣa-lá-mì ú ú-nu-sú-nu mì-ma a-nim i-a-um ma-nu-ki-ì-lí-a na-áš-a-ku-nu-tí
target: 1 ½ mina 5 shekels of silver sealed by Kukuwa and by me plus 7 black donkeys with their harness - all this belonging to me, Mannum-kī-iliya brings to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ṣé-er KÙ.BABBAR a-nim ša ma-nu-ki-ì-lí-a na-áš-a-ku-nu-tí-ni a-na 3 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ú ṣí-ba-tí-šu ša ku-ku-wa a-na ma-nu-ki-a-šur DUMU MAN.IŠTAR ḫa-bu-lu-ni-ma 20 GÚ SÍG.ḪI.A a-na ša-pá-ar-tim ú-kà-lu-ni a-na ša ki-ma i-a-tí qí-bi-ma
target: In addition to this silver that Mannum-kī-iliya brings to you, for the 3 minas silver and its interest that Kukuwa owes to Mannum-kī-Aššur son of Puzur-Ištar, and for which he holds 20 talents of wool as security - say to my representatives:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-kam ma-lá KÙ.BABBAR IŠTAR-lá-ma-sí ù ma-nu-ki-ì-lí-a i-ḫa-šu-ḫu-ni KÙ.BABBAR lu i-na ša ba-áb-tí-a ta-am-ḫu-ra-ni lu KÙ.BABBAR ša a-na ṣé-er a-na-na ku-nu-ki-a ú-šé-bi₄-lá-ni a-na ṣí-ib-tim KÙ.BABBAR ki-ma a-wa-at kà-ri-im dí-na-šu-nu-tí-ma
target: Whatever silver Ištar-lamassī and Mannum-kī-iliya ask for there, lend them silver against interest according to the rate of the colony - from what silver you have received from my outstanding claims, or silver I sent to Anna-anna under my seal;

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pá-am ša IŠTAR-lá-ma-sí ù ma-nu-ki-ì-lí-a me-er-i-ša ša qá-qá-ad šál-mì-šu-nu lu-up-ta-ma a-na am-tí-a ṭup-pá-am dí-na-ma a-dí a-lá-kà-ni
target: then write a tablet for Ištar-lamassī and Mannum-kī-iliya, her son, with joint liability, and give the tablet to my maid so it may remain in her possession until I come.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ṣé-er a-šùr-UTU i-na ba-áb ḫa-ra-ni-šu né-ru-ub-ma
target: We entered with Aššur-šamšī when he was about to go on a journey.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma en-na-sú-in a-na a-šùr-UTU-ma a-pu-na lá-ma kà-sà-am ni-iš-tí-ú a-wa-tí-im lá-ta-wu-kum li-ba-tim lá ta-ma-lá
target: Ennam-Suen said to Aššur-šamšī: Please, before we drink from the cup I want to declare something to you, do not get angry!

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-nu-mì i-na wa-áš-ḫa-ni-a ú-kà-i-lu-ni-ni 2-ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a-ḫa-ti tù-šé-bi-lá-kà
target: When they detained me in Wašhaniya did my sister send you to me with 2 minas of silver?

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-šùr-UTU ke-na tù-šé-bi-lá-ni-ma ú-lá a-dí-na-kum
target: Aššur-šamšī answered: Sure, she sent me, but I did not give it to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma en-na-sú-in-ma u₄-ma-am a-ḫa-tí ta-tù-ra-am um-ma ší-it-ma ta-al-tám-nam KÙ.BABBAR ù ṣí-ba-tí ša iš-tù 8 ša-na-tim šé-ṣí-ma dí-nam
target: Ennam-Suen then said: Today my sister has come back here and she said: You have done me wrong! Produce the silver and its interest due since eight years and give it to me!

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-šùr-UTU-ma e-ni-ma-ma a-na šé-ep a-šur-i-mì-tí am-qú-ut a-ḫu-ú-a a-tù-nu a-ma KÙ.GI 15 GÍN ù 1 ma-na sà-am-tum ma-lá ta-le-a-ni É.GAL-lam ṭá-i-ba
target: Aššur-šamšī answered: I threw myself down at the feet of Aššur-imittī, saying: Please, my brothers, here are gold, 15 shekels, and 1 mina of carnelian, appease the palace as well as you can.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-šùr-UTU-ma a-na en-na-sú-in-ma šu-ma KÙ.BABBAR a-na ma-dí-im i-tù-ar al-kam-ma ší-bé-kà la-aṣ-ba-at-ma ma-lá e-pá-ší-im ep-ša-ni
target: Aššur-šamšī also said to Ennam-Suen: If the silver (due) has increased much then come here, let me seize your witnesses and do with me what you think best!

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma en-na-sú-in-ma a-na a-šùr-UTU-ma É.GAL-lúm KÙ.BABBAR ma-dam i-ṣé-ri-a i-šu
target: Ennam-Suen answered Aššur-šamšī as follows: The palace has a substantial silver claim on me.

target: When you are released (from the cold), then I shall send either myself or someone I can rely on, and I shall take a decision about the merchant's goods.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-šu ša ta-áš-pu-ra-ni um-ma a-ta-ma tí-ir-tí DAM.GÀR ḫi-mì-tum i-li-kam

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-ku sà-aḫ-ra-ku-ma a-na lu-qú-tim ša DAM.GÀR mì-li-ik-ša ma-lá-kam lá a-al-té-e
target: I have personally been delayed and been unable to take any decision about the merchant's goods.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ba-a-nim i-a-tí ta-ša-pá-ra-am a-pu-t

target: Ennam-Aššur answered the attorney and Ali-ahum, and Ennam-Aššur said to Ali-ahum: We are inheritors. We have not (finished) checking.

target: When our father in the City entrusted merchandise to you and (sent it) to his representatives - Iddin-abum son of Aššur-rabi, Itūr-ilī son of Amur-Ištar, Ennānum son of Amriya, Enah-ilī son of Šu-Aššur, myself and you together with them, in fact, we were the representation of Šalim-Aššur, our father - then apart from this merchandise transported by you, Šalim-Aššur did not send any other merchandise.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ma-lá lu-qú-tum a-ni-tám <gap> ša a-ta tù-šé-li-a-ni-ma lu-qú-tum ší-it i-na É-šu-nu iz-ku-a-ni li-bi ša-zu-úz-tí a-bi-ni ù li-bi-ni i-de₈
target: Our father's agents and we knew how these goods - that you yourself brought up here - that these goods were cleared in their house.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù me-ḫe-er-ni a-na a-lim{ki} a-na ṣé-er a-bi-ni iš-tù u₄-mì-im ša lu-qú-tám tù-šé-li-a-ni i-li-ik-šu-ma i-na a-lim{ki} i-ba-ší
target: Also our answer went to the City, to our father, the very day you brought the goods up here, and it is in the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na lu-qú-tim a-ni-tim qá-tí ša-zu-za-at a-bi-ni i-ta-dí-nu ni-a-tí-ma ma-lá lu-qú-tám i-a-tí i-šu-ru-ni-ni a-na KÙ.BABBAR ú-ta-er-ma KÙ.BABBAR ší-im
target: A claim to these goods has been made by our father's agents. As you well know, it was for our sake that I converted to silver the goods they took care of for me, and I paid the silver, the proceeds from the goods, to our father's representatives and to you, and they have sent the silver under their seals to the City to our father.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na šu-{d}DUMU.ZI e-lá-a a-dí-da lá-ma-sí ù en-nam-a-šùr qí-bi-ma um-ma en-nam-a-šùr ù a-lá-ḫu-um-ma

target: but they say: "Let us also take away the lapis lazuli, your father's votive offering."

target: Our dear fathers and lords, the men are ready to remove the lapis lazuli, our father's votive offering from us.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iḫ-da-ma a-lam mu-ùḫ-ra-ma ma-lá ik-ri-bu ša a-šùr lá i-ḫa-li-qú-ni ep-ša-ma ṭup-pá-am ša a-lim{ki} le-qé-a-ma ki-ma NA₄.ZA.GÌN a-na KÙ.BABBAR i-tù-ru-ma a-dí <gap> ik-ri-bu <gap> uš-té-ru-bu
target: Take care to confront the City and act so that the votive offerings for Aššur are not lost, get a tablet from the City stating that the lapis lazuli must be converted to silver and until the votive offerings are brought in.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù ra-bi-ṣa-am aḫ-za-nim-ma KI a-
target: Also, hire an attorney and have him leave together with Aluwa and save our lives.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na lu-lu-ú en-um-a-šur ù a-bu-ša-lim qí-bi-ma um-ma a-šur-DU₁₀-ma
target: Say to Lullu, Ennam-Aššur and Abu-šalim thus Aššur-ṭāb:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ša-me-ma a-šur-DU₁₀ lá li-bi₄ i-lí-ma me-et
target: I hear that Aššur-ṭāb has unfortunately died.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ba-ú-a be-lu-ú-a a-tù-nu i-na {d}UTU-ši ṭup-pì ta-ša-me-a-ni lu-qú-tám lu pá-ni-tám lu ur-ki-tám za-ki-a-ma ku-un-kà-ma
target: Please my fathers and lords, the very day you hear my letter you must clear both the earlier and the later merchandise and put it under seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tí pá-nim-ma a-bu-ša-lim ṭur₄-da-nim
target: and send Abu-šalim here with the first opportunity.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma URUDU mì-ma a-ḫu-ur ba-tí-iq ù wa-tù-ur dí-na-ma ab-kà-nim
target: If any copper is still unsold, sell it at any price and ship it(s yield) here.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ma KÙ.BABBAR 1 GÍN a-ma-kam lá i-kà-lá
target: Not a single shekel of silver must be retained there!

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB en-na-nim DUMU a-la-bi-im KIŠIB dan-a-šùr DUMU ir-nu-id KIŠIB bu-zu-a DUMU a-šùr-DU₁₀ KIŠIB a-du-da DUMU zu-ú-a
target: Sealed by Ennānum son of Ali-abum, by Dan-Aššur son of Irnuid, by Buzuwa son of Aššur-ṭāb, by Aduda son of Zuwa.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša 7 ma-na 7 GÍN AN.NA ša ni-ip-lá-tim ša ku-zi-a a-na ILLAT-tim ḫa-bu-lu
target: Concerning the 7 minas 7 shekels of tin from the balance payment that Kuziya owes to the caravan.

source: translate Akkadian to English: AN.NA dan-a-šùr iš-qú-ul
target: Dan-Aššur has paid the tin.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 7 GÍN.TA 1 ma-na 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am i-na KÙ.BABBAR-áp im-dí-dan iš-tí šál-ma-a-šùr dan-a-šùr il₅-qé
target: Reckoned at the rate 1:7 Dan-Aššur has received 1 mina 10 shekels of refined silver from Imdī-dan's silver from Šalim-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma ša ki-ma im-dí-dan ù ku-zi-a a-na šál-ma-a-šùr a-na 7 ma-na 7 GÍN AN.NA i-tù-ru dan-a-šùr DUMU ir-nu-id ú-ba-áb-šu
target: If Imdī-dan's representatives and Kuziya claim the 7 minas 7 shekels of tin from Šalim-Aššur, Dan-Aššur son of Irnuid will clear him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ITU.1.KAM ša sà-ra-tim li-mu-um i-dí-a-bu-um
target: Month Ša-sarrātim, eponymy Iddin-abum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-IŠTAR a-na PUZUR₄-a-šùr DUMU i-tù-ur-DINGIR iṣ-ba-at-ni-a-tí-ma
target: Šu-Ištar seized us against Puzur-Aššur, the son of Itūr-ilī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-IŠTAR-ma a-na PÚZUR-a-šùr-ma 4 GÍN KÙ.GI ša ša-at-a-šùr ḫa-bu-lá-tí-ni SIG₅ DIRI
target: Šu-Ištar said to Puzur-Aššur: The 4 shekels of gold, which you owe to Šāt-Aššur are of very good quality!

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma PÚZUR-a-šùr-ma ke-na ḫa-bu-lá-ku a-ša-qal
target: Puzur-Aššur answered: Indeed, I owe it, I will pay.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṣí-lu-lu ù da-da-a DUMU ub-ra-e-im IGI šu-ga-ri-a-im ša a-šùr DUB-pu-šu-nu i-dí-nu
target: Ṣilulu and Dadaya, son of the man from Ubra, gave their tablet before the emblem of Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-<gap> DUMU i-zi-za-am-ì-lí ù a-bi₄-a DUMU a-ta a pá-šu-nu iš-me-ú
target: Šu-<gap>, son of Izizam-ilī and Abiya, son of Ataya, heard their statement.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-lu-lá-a dan-a-šùr ù lá-qé-ep qí-bi-ma um-ma en-um-a-šùr-ma
target: To Alulaya, Dan-Aššur and Lā-qēp from Ennam-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am 3.1666 GÍN KÙ.GI ša áb-ni-šu ku-nu-ki-a 20 UDU.ḪI.A 1 GU₄.ḪI.A ù 1 ṣú-ub-ra-am mì-ma a-nim ša-lim-bé-lí ù e-wa-ri-mu-ša i-ra-dí-a-ku-nu-tí
target: 1.5 mina of refined silver, 3.1666 shekels of gold dust under my seal, 20 sheep, 1 ox and one slave - all this Šalim-bēlī and Ewarimuša lead to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR iš-tí am-tí-a ku-nu-ku-a li-ib-ší ú e-me-ri ú al-pá-am dí-na-ma KÙ.BABBAR-áp-šu-nu lu ša-li-iṭ
target: Let the silver stay with my maid under my seal, but sell the sheep and the ox, and the silver for them should be available.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na 15 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ú ṣí-ba-sú iš-tí en-na-nim mu-ša-ri-dim
target: 1 mina 15 shekels of silver plus its interest is owed by Ennānum, the ;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 GÚ 35 ma-na URUDU ma-sí-um iš-tí bé-lí-a
target: 3 talents 35 minas of washed copper is owed by Bēliya;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.6666 ma-na 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR KI ḫa-ta-aḫ-šu
target: 0.6666 mina 5 shekels of silver is owed by hatahšu;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 GÍN iš-tí i-lá-li-iš-kán na-pá-ḫi-im
target: 10 shekels is owed by Ilališkan, the smith.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫu-a a-tù-nu u₄-mu-šu-nu e-ta-at-qú KÙ.BABBAR ša-áš-qí-lá-šu-nu
target: My dear brothers, their terms are overdue. Make them pay the silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 9 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR KI šu-IŠTAR ni-a-im ša ki-ma ṣí-lá-bi₄-im KÙ.BABBAR iš-tù ḫa-na-ak-na-ak uš-té-bi₄-lam i ku-nu-ki-šu li-ib-ší
target: 9 shekels of silver is owed by our own Šu-Ištar, Ṣill-abum's representative; he has sent me the silver from hanaknak. Let it stay under his seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša 1.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR sà-ḫe-er-tám li-il₅-qé-ú-nim
target: Let them take small goods worth 1.5 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ma i me-er-e-a É-tí ma-ma-an iš-ta-am
target: Someone from among my sons bought the house.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lá-ma-sí i qé-er-bi₄-im tù-ša-áb
target: Lamassī lives in it.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma i-tur₄-DINGIR-ma a-na en-um-a-šur qí-bi-ma
target: From Itūr-ilī to Ennam-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 GÚ URUDU ma-as-a-am <gap>-bi₄ ša-ni-a-am i-na ḫa-ra-ni-a ša-a-ma a-ma-kam li-ni-dí
target: Buy 5 talents of washed copper <gap> another <gap> on my journey, and let it be deposited there.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na <gap> e-ma-<gap> ú-šé-ra-a-ma i-ta-pu-lu-ni-šu
target: I shall release, and they will balance it with him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 GÍN KÙ.KI i-ṣé-er i-dí-na-bi-im DUMU šu-IŠTAR a-lá-ḫu-um i-šu
target: Iddin-abum son of Šu-Ištar owes 2 shekels of gold to Ali-ahum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù ITU.1.KAM ḫu-bu-ur a-na ITU.2.KAM i-ša-qal
target: Reckoned from the month hubur he will pay in 2 months.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma lá iš-qú-ul ki-ma a-wa-at kà-ri-im ṣí-ib-tám ú-ṣa-áb
target: If he has not paid in time, he will add interest according to the rule of the colony.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI e-lá-lí DUMU i-pí-li-is IGI bi-sá-a IGI bé-lúm-ba-ni DUMU a-šur-be-el-a-wa-tim
target: Witnessed by Elāli son of Ippilis, by Bisaya, by Bēlum-bāni son of Aššur-bēl-awātim.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.6666 ma-na 3 GÍN KÙ.GI ša ib-na-a i-šu-ni ni-is-ḫa-tí-šu ni-dí-in-ma
target: For the 43 shekels of gold, which Ibnaya has in his possession, we paid the import-tax on it.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.6666 ma-na 0.6666 GÍN KÙ.GI ni-iš₆-am-ma 7.6666 GÍN.TA KÙ.BABBAR-áp-šu 5 ma-na 11.8333 GÍN
target: And the (remaining) 40.6666 shekels of gold we bought and at 7.6666 shekels (of silver) per (shekel of gold); its (equivalent) in silver was 5 minas 11.8333 shekels.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 ma-na LÁ 4 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša TÚG.ḪI.A ù AN.NA al-qé-ma
target: 3 minas 56 shekels of silver I took for textiles and tin.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-tí KÙ.BABBAR-pì-šu 1 ma-na 15.8333 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a ša ki-ma šu-a-tí a-dí-ma i-ša-qá-lam
target: And the rest of his silver, 1 mina 15.8333 shekels of silver, as much as that, until he pays.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 GÍN AN.NA a-na na-áb-ri-tim ša e-ma-ri ù ḫa-ar-lá i-na ra-mì-ni-a áš-qú-ul
target: 5 shekels of tin for the paddock for the donkeys and (for) harla I paid myself.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pu-um i-na ší-im SÍG.ḪI.A ša ú-ší-na-lam PUZUR₄-ša-du-we DUMU lá-qé-ep il₅-qé
target: Puzur-šadu'e son of Lā-qēp has received 5 minas of refined silver from the proceeds of Ušinalam's wool.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-šùr-GAL DUMU ma-nu-um-šu-um-šu IGI en-na-sú-in DUMU i-dí-a-bi-im IGI i-dí-a-šùr bu du ú
target: Witnessed by Aššur-rabi son of Mannum-šumšu, by Enna-Suen son of Iddin-abum, by Iddin-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 14 <gap> ma-na <gap> 8.6666 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ší-im AN.NA TÚG.ḪI.A ù ANŠE.ḪI.A
target: 14 minas <gap> 8.6666 shekels of silver is the price of tin, textiles and donkeys.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-la-ḫi-im qí-bi₄-ma um-ma PUZUR₄-a-šur-ma
target: To Ali-ahum from Puzur-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 48 TÚG ku-ta-ni dam-qú-tum 2 TÚG ša qá-tim 2 GÚ 10 ma-na AN.NA ku-nu-ki 18.5 ma-na AN.NA qá-tim 2 TÚG ša a-šur-be-el-a-wa-tim 3 ANŠE ṣa-lá-mu mì-ma a-nim a-ra-dí-a-kum
target: 48 good textiles, 2 ordinary textiles, 2 talents 10 minas of sealed tin, 18.5 minas of expense-tin, 2 textiles belonging to Aššur-bēl-awātim, 3 black donkeys - all this I lead to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: sá-ri-dam a-dí ḫa-ḫi-im a-na 17 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-gu₅-ur
target: I rented a driver until hahhum for 17 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na URUDU a-na pá-ni-a šé-bi₄-lam
target: Send 0.5 mina of copper to me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-té-en₆ i-na ṣú-ḫa-ri-kà a-na pá-ni-a ṭur₄-dam
target: Send one of your servants before (I come).

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫi a-ta be-li a-ta tí-ir-ta-kà li-li-kam-ma uz-ni pè-té
target: My dear brother and lord, send me word to inform me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma lá a-lá-ḫu-um DUMU du-dí-ki ma-ma-an ú-lá i-de₈-ú
target: They do not know anyone other than Ali-ahum son of Dudiki.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ut-ma ṭup-pá-am na-ší
target: It is he who brings the tablet.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ì-lí-dan-ma a-na en-nam-a-šur qí-bi-ma
target: From Ilī-dan to Ennam-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na e-ra-dí <gap> TÚG.ḪI.A <gap> šu-zu-zu DUMU e-ra-dí <gap> ma TÚG.ḪI.A <gap>-nu KÙ.BABBAR ma-la ta-áš-ú-mu a-na šu-zu-zu dí-in
target: Give what silver you have bought to Šu-Zuzu.

source: translate Akkadian to English: TÚG.ḪI.A ša LUGAL-{d}IM na-áš-ú-ni ŠÀ.BA 2 TÚG a-na a-šur-i-mì-tí DUMU a-mur-DINGIR i-a-ú-tum a-na dá-mì-iq-tim kà-an-ku
target: As to the textiles that Šar-Adad brings, of those 2 textiles for Aššur-imittī son of Amur-ilī, belonging to me, have been sealed as a favour.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3.3333 TÚG.ḪI ku-wa-tí kà-an-ku
target: 3.3333 textiles have been sealed for you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 TÚG pá-ni-am ša ku-wa-tí a-dí-na-ku-ni ù a-ni-ú-tim ba-tí-iq ù wa-tù-ur dí-ma ší-im-šu-nu šé-bi-lam
target: 1 previous textile that I gave to you plus these - sell them for any price and send me the proceeds.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na ANŠE ša LUGAL-{d}IM 1 ANŠE i-a-um ù ša a-šur-i-mì-tí
target: Of the donkeys of Šar-Adad 1 donkey belongs to me and to Aššur-imittī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ŠE-im ša pá-i a-dí-na-ku-ni KÙ.BABBAR šé-bi-lam-ma ŠE-am lá-áš-a-ma-kum ù a-šar i-ša-pu-ku wa-dí
target: With respect to the grain that I promised you, send me silver so I can buy grain for you, and explain where it is stored.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na en-nam-a-šur ù a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi₄-ma um-ma SIG₅-pí-a-šur-ma a-ḫu-a a-tù-nu a-dí ma-lá ù ší-ni-šu té-er-tí i-li-kà-ku-nu-tí
target: To Ennam-Aššur and Ali-ahum from Damiq-pī-Aššur: My dear brothers, once or twice I have sent word to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na ṣú-ba-tí ša tám-kà-ri-im ṣú-ba-tù an-ḫu-tù-um i-ba-ší-ú
target: Among the textiles belonging to the merchant there are some old textiles.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-ḫi-id-ma <gap> mì-li-ik ṣú-ba-tim mì-il₅-kà
target: Do take a decision concerning the goods.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 TÚG SIG₅ a-lu-a na-áš-a-ku-nu-tí
target: Aluwa is bringing you 1 fine textile.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-kam iš-tí ší-im AN.NA-ki-a KÙ.BABBAR šé-bi₄-lá-ni-ma gi-im-lá-ni
target: There you should send me silver together with the proceeds from my tin, thus doing me a favour.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na 17 ku-ta-ni ša i-na ba-at-na ḫa-al-qú-ni 1.3333 ma-na.TA AN.NA ILLAT-tum ú-ma-li-ni-a-tí
target: For the 17 textiles that were lost in Batna the caravan paid us a compensation of 1.3333 mina of tin per person.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša la-qá-im ku-ra il₅-ta-qé
target: Kura has successively obtained what he was entitled to.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.3333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR be-ú-lá-tí-šu ku-ra i-na a-lim{ki} il₅-qé
target: Kura has received 0.3333 mina of silver, his working capital, in the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a-na pá-ni-šu a-šur-ma-lik ú-šé-bi₄-il₅ i-na lu-qú-tim
target: 0.5 mina of silver Aššur-mālik sent to him en route.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša šé-ep kur-ub-IŠTAR 2 GÚ AN.NA ú li-wi-sú 15 ku-ta-ni 2 ANŠE.ḪI.A ṣa-lá-me kur-ub-IŠTAR ip-qí-dam
target: Of the merchandise shipped under Kurub-Ištar's responsibility Kurub-Ištar entrusted to me 2 talents of tin with its wrapping, 15 textiles and 2 black donkeys.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ.BA 1 šu-uq-lam ip-ṭur₄-ma 11 ma-na AN.NA il₅-té-qé
target: Of this load he has broken the seals of one packet and has taken 11 minas of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-wa-tù-šu-nu ša šál-ma-a-šùr šu-bé-lúm ki-ma DAM i-sú-rik₁₃ DUMU.MÍ i-sú-rik₁₃ ù DUMU.MÍ i-dí-a-bi-im ra-bi-ṣum ù šu-be-lúm KI ša-lim-a-šur ni-iš a-lim{ki} it-mu-ú-ma a-wa-tù-šu-nu gám-ra <gap>
target: Their case concerning Šalim-Aššur - Šu-Bēlum for the wife of Issu-arik, the daughter of Issu-arik and the daughter of Iddin-abum, the attorney and Šu-Bēlum (on his own) swore an oath on the City with Šalim-Aššur and their case was concluded.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù a-ḫu-šu i-lu-ku-ni-ma ša-lim-a-šùr a-na lu-qú-tim AN.NA ú TÚG.ḪI.A ša-lim-a-šùr ú-kà-nu-ni
target: Šu-Kūbum and his brother will come and confirm Šalim-Aššur for the goods, the tin and textiles.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-šùr-ta-ak-lá-ku ra-bi-ṣú-um a-na lu-qú-tim a-ni-tim
target: Aššur-taklāku was the attorney.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-be-lúm a-ša-at i-sú-rik₁₃ DUMU.MÍ i-sú-rik₁₃ ù DUMU.MÍ i-dí-a-bi-im a-na ša-lim-a-šùr šu-ku-bi₄-im ù a-ḫi-šu ú-lá i-tù-ru
target: Šu-Bēlum, the wife of Issu-arik, the daughter of Issu-arik and the daughter of Iddin-abum must not raise claim to these goods against Šalim-Aššur, Šu-Kūbum or his brother.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma i-tù-ru šu-be-lúm ù MAŠKIM ú-bu-bu-šu-nu
target: If they do raise claim, Šu-Bēlum and the attorney will clear them.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI {d}MAR.TU-ba-ni IGI a-šùr-i-dí IGI šu-ku-bi-im IGI šu-ma-li-ba-a-šùr
target: Witnessed by Amurrum-bāni, by Aššur-idī, by Šu-Kūbum, by Šumma-libbi-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na 16.8333 ma-na ḫu-sà-ri-im ša ik-ri-bi ša a-šùr SAG.BA 1 ma-na 5.5 GÍN a-na i-tur₄-DINGIR a-dí-in-ma
target: Of the 16 ⅚ minas of lapis lazuli from the votive offerings for Aššur, thereof I gave 1 mina 5 ½ shekels to Itūr-ilī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ší-a-ma-tim a-na tí-me-el-ki-a a-la-ba-am ú-šé-bi-il₅
target: And he sent Ali-abum to Timelkiya to make purchases.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 ma-na 15.5 GÍN a-na ší-a-ma-tí-ma DAM.GÀR a-na šu-IŠTAR DUMU šu-ki-tim i-dí-in
target: The merchant gave 2 minas 15 ½ shekels, also for purchase, to Šu-Ištar son of Šukkutum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-tí ḫu-sà-ri-im 13.3333 ma-na 9 GÍN iš-tí en-um-a-šùr i-ba-ší
target: The rest of the lapis lazuli, 13 ⅓ minas 9 shekels, is with Ennam-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ša-lim-a-šùr-ma a-na i-dí-a-bi-im i-tur₄-DINGIR en-na-nim e-na-aḫ-DINGIR ù en-um-a-šùr-ma
target: From Šalim-Aššur to Iddin-abum, Itūr-ilī, Ennānum, Enah-ilī and Ennam-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí ša ta-áš-pu-ra-ni-ni um-ma a-tù-nu-ma a-na kà-ri-im er-ba-ma bé-et-kà a-šu-ur-ma ù iš-tí me-er-e-kà zu-ku-ma qá-qá-ad-kà lá ta-ta-na-dí
target: As to what you wrote to me about, saying: Enter the colony and bring your house in order, and then, clear the affairs with your sons and do not hang your head all the time.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ki-ma ṣú-ḫa-ru-a a-dí u₄-mì-im a-nim iš-lu-ṭù-ni-ma a-ṣé-er SIG₅-pí-a-šur lá e-tí-qú-ni-ma lu-qú-tí a-na KÙ.BABBAR lá ú-ta-e-ru-ni
target: Since my servants have acted high-handedly until this day and have not travelled to Damiq-pī-Aššur, and have not converted my goods to silver - for that reason I became worried, and since my textiles are infested with moths, I thought: "Let me enter with my goods and collect my assets, so that I may receive some 10 minas of silver that may be collected from my customers.
