source: translate Akkadian to English: ILLAT šu-nu-nu i-na za-al-pá ni-kà-sí i-sí-ú-ma
target: Šu-Nūnu's caravan settled accounts in Zalpa,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 7 ma-na 3 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ni-pí-il-tí <gap> a-šu-mì <gap> ša <gap> ku-<gap> ILLAT <gap> DUMU <gap> ú-ša-<gap> a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um kà-ni-iš i-dí-ni-a-tí-ma IGI GÍR ša a-šur ṭup-pá-am ni-dí-in IGI dan-a-šur DUMU ša-lim-a-ḫi-im IGI pí-lá-aḫ-a-šur bi-lu-um IGI šu-IŠTAR DUMU da-da-nim
target: and 7 minas 3 shekels of silver, the balance <gap>

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša-lim-a-šùr a-ṣé-er a-mur-IŠTAR ú-ṭá-ḫi-ni-a-tí-ma um-ma ša-lim-a-šùr-ma a-na a-mur-IŠTAR-ma mì-šu-um ší-im ṣú-ba-tí-a URUDU ta-aṣ-ba-at
target: Šalim-Aššur made us approach Amur-Ištạr, and Šalim-Aššur said to Amur-Ištar: Why have you seized the copper that was the proceeds from my textiles?

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-mur-IŠTAR-ma 4 GÚ URUDU lá-mu-na-am ke-na aṣ-ba-at ba-lu-um ḫi-na-a ù ší-bi aṣ-ba-at
target: Amur-Ištar answered: Yes, I have seized 4 talents of poor copper. I seized it without hinnaya's permission and without witnesses.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ša-lim-a-šùr-ma ḫa-bu-ra-ta-i-a-am tal-qé
target: Šalim-Aššur said: Did you take copper from haburat?

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-mur-IŠTAR-ma ša i-na qá-tim aḫ-ta-šu-šu al-qé a-ta lu-qú-tí ša 10 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR lá ta-aṣ-ba-at
target: Amur-Ištar answered: I took what I could grab. But did you not seize my merchandise worth 10 minas of silver?

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ša-lim-a-šùr-ma mì-ma ú-lá aṣ-ba-at
target: Šalim-Aššur answered: I have seized nothing.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-mur-IŠTAR-ma a-na ṣú-ḫa-ri-a a-na za-al-pá áš-ta-pá-ar ṣú-ḫa-ri li-li-kam-ma lá-ta-wi
target: Amur-Ištar said: I have sent my servant to Zalpa. When my servant comes I shall discuss (further).

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-mur-IŠTAR-ma a-na-ku a-šé-e-kà ú-ul a-ta ta-šé-e-a-ni
target: Amur-Ištar continued: It is I who am suing you, not you who are suing me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI MAR.TU-ba-ni IGI pu-šu-ki-in a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um kà-ni-iš-ki i-dí-ni-a-tí-ma ší-bu-tí-ni IGI GÍR ša a-šùr ni-dí-in
target: Witnessed by Amurrum-bāni, by Pūšu-kēn. The Kanesh colony gave us for these proceedings and we gave our testimony before Aššur's dagger.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma lá-ma-sí-ma a-na en-nam-a-šur ú a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi₄-ma
target: From Lamassī to Ennam-Aššur and Ali-ahum:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-bu-ni-i i-mu-ut
target: Our father has died.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 40 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ni-is-ḫa-sú DIRI ša-du-a-sú ša-bu en-um-a-šùr a-na a-lu-a ù e-ni-ša-ru-um i-na ša-la-tù-ar ku-nu-ki ip-qí-id
target: 40 minas of silver, its import duty added, its transport tariff paid for, Ennam-Aššur entrusted to Aluwa and Enišārum in Šalatuwar under seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-ut-ma a-na a-lim{ki} a-na ša-lim-a-šur a-bi-a bi-lá
target: He said: Bring it to my father Šalim-Aššur in the City!

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na qá-tí-šu-nu i-dí-in
target: He also gave 5 shekels of silver for their expenses.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um wa-aḫ-šu-ša-na i-dí-in-ni-a-tí-ma IGI GÍR ša da-šùr ší-bu-tí-ni ni-dí-in
target: The Wahšušana colony gave us for these proceedings and we gave our testimony before Aššur's dagger.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI ili₅-ba-ni DUMU a-mur-a-šur IGI a-ḫu-waqar DUMU šu-IŠTAR tù-ra-am-ì-lí DUMU e-dí-in-a-šur tap-pá-i-ni
target: Witnessed by Ilī-bāni son of Amur-Aššur, by Ahu-waqar son of Šu-Ištar; Tūram-ilī son of Eddin-Aššur was our (absent) partner.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma i-dí-sú-in-ma a-na en-na-sú-in qí-bi₄-ma
target: Thus Iddin-Suen, say to Ennam-Suen:

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṣú-ḫa-ṣú-ra-am ga-lá-ba-am ḫa-dí-a-šu <gap>-ra-de₈-am dí-šu-ma <gap> li-qí KÙ.BABBAR ku-šu-ud
target: The boy who is a barber Hadiaššu is leading to you. Sell him and collect ?, (and so) obtain silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 ku-ta-ni ù TÚG a-bar-ni-am ša ta-ak-lu-ú a-na ḫa-dí-a-šu dí-in-ma lu-ub-lam
target: The 3 -textiles and the Abarnian one that you held back, give them to Hadiaššu to bring them to me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí a-ma-kam wa-áš-ba-tí-ni sí-ku-šu kà-il₅
target: As long as you stay there you must hold him by his hem.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma lá i-lá-kam kam
target: If he does not come <gap>

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma la-ma-sí-ma a-na a-la-ḫi-im qí-bi₄-ma
target: From Lamassī to Ali-ahum:

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-šu ša iš-tù ra-bi₄-ṣú-um i-li-kà-ni-ma ú ṭup-pì ta-áš-ta-na-pá-ra-ni-ma ù a-dí u₄-mì-im a-nim la ta-la-kà-ni-ma
target: Why is it that since the attorney arrived and indeed that you keep sending me letters, yet until this day you do not come,

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-wa-at É a-bi₄-kà la ta-la-kà-šu-du-ma ù É a-bi₄-ku-nu la tù-za-kà-a-ni-ma
target: to organise the affairs of your father's house and so do not clear your father's house,

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na u₄-mì-im ša ṭup-pì ta-ša-me-ú tí-ib-a-nim-ma al-kà-nim-ma É a-bi₄-ku-nu za-ki-a-ma
target: the very day you hear my letter you (plur.) must set out and come and clear your father's house -

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù a-tù-nu a ra-ma-ku-nu za-ki-a-ma KÙ.BABBAR ša É a-lim{ki} lá i-ma-id
target: so that you yourselves may then clear yourselves and the debt in silver to the City Hall does not grow large.

source: translate Akkadian to English: tí-ib-a-nim-ma a-tal-kà-nim
target: Set out and come!

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-mu-ur-ša-ra-sà ù pé-ru-wa qí-bí-ma um-ma IŠTAR-pí-la-aḫ-ma
target: To Amur-šarrassa and Peruwa from Ištar-pilah; to Peruwa:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na pé-ru-wa qí-bí-ma ṭup-pá-am ša tám-kà-ri-im ša i-na ḫu-ra-ma a-dí-na-ku-ni
target: As to the tablet of the merchant that I gave you in hurrama,

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma KÙ.BABBAR iš-tí tám-kà-ri-im ta-al-qé KÙ.BABBAR a-na a-mu-ur-ša-ra-sà dí-in
target: if you have received the silver from the merchant, then give it to Amur-šarrassa.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma KÙ.BABBAR lá ta-al-qé ṭup-pá-am ša tám-kà-ri-im ḫa-ar-ma-am a-na a-mu-ur-ša-ra-sà dí-in
target: If you have not received the silver, then give the certified tablet of the merchant to Amur-šarrassa.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí ma-lá ú ší-ni-šu áš-pu-ra-ku-ma ṭup-pá-am lá ta-dí-in
target: I have written you once or twice but you have not given me a reply.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫi a-ta gi₅-mì-lá-am i-na ṣé-ri-a šu-ku-un
target: My dear brother, do me a favour!

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ku-zi-zi-a a-lá-ḫi-im <gap>-ni-im ù ša-at-a-na qí-bi₄-ma um-ma ma-ma-ḫi-ir-ma
target: To Kuziziya, Ali-ahum, <gap>num and Šāt-Anna from Man-mahir:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 6.5 GÚ URUDU SIG₅ be-li-a DUMU DINGIR-kur-ub ša tí-iš-mur-na ḫa-bu-lam
target: Bēliya son of Ilī-kurub from Tišmurna owes me 6.5 talents of good copper.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pè-a pè-té-a-ma ṭup-pu-šu šé-li-a-ma a-ma-kam URUDU ù ṣí-ba-sú ša-áš-qí-il₅-šu
target: Open for my tablets, produce his tablet and have him pay the copper and its interest there.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù a-ḫa-ma 25 ma-na URUDU SIG₅ ší-im ANŠE šu-ut-ma ḫa-bu-lam
target: Also, he furthermore owes me 25 minas of good copper, the price of a donkey.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù u₄-mì-im ša ṭup-pá-am al-pu-tù-ni a-na <gap> ITU.KAM i-ša-qal
target: He is to pay within <gap> months from the day I wrote the tablet.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma lá iš-qú-ul a-na ṣí-ib-tim ki-ma a-wa-at kà-ri-im i-lá-ak-šu-um
target: If he has not paid (in time), interest will accrue for him in accordance with the rules of the colony.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṣa-áb-ta-šu-ma URUDU ù ṣí-ba-sú ša-áš-qí-lá-šu
target: Seize him and have him pay the copper and its interest.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí tí-ir-tí i-lá-kà-ni URUDU É iš-tí-in i ba-ri-ku-nu ku-un-kà-ma li-bi₄-ší
target: Until my instructions arrive, seal it in a house belonging to one of you and let it remain there.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma <gap> a ṣí-ib-tim ú-ša-ḫa-at-ku-nu ú-lá 20 ú-lá 30 TÚG ku-ta-ni dí-na-šu-ma lig-mì-lá-ni ù URUDU a-na TÚG li-iš-qú-lam
target: If he clears you for the interest, then give him either 20 or 30 -textiles and let him do me a favour and so let him pay the copper for the textiles.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na {d}UTU-ši ṭup-pá-am ú-lá-pì-ta-ku-nu-tí-ni a-na wa-aḫ-šu-ša-na a-ta-lá-ak
target: The very day I wrote the letter to you I left for Wahšušana.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ki-ma ṭup-pí ta-áš-me-a-ni <gap> šu <gap> i <gap> li-li-kam
target: When you have heard the letter <gap> should come here.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-mur-a-šur a-ḫu-ni na-áš-a-ku-nu-tí
target: Amur Aššur our colleague brings you 1 shekel of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-šur-ni-im-ri ù a-lá-ḫi-im DINGIR-ba-ni qí-bi-ma um-ma šu-zu-zu-ma
target: To Aššur-nimrī and Ali-ahum (and) Ilī-bāni from Šu-Zuzu:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-kam ṭup-pí-a pé-té-a-ma ṭup-pá-am ša 40 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ù ša-ni-am ṭup-pá-am ša 20 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša ḫu-bu-li DINGIR-ba-ni dí-na-šu-um
target: Open for my tablets there and give to Ilī-bāni a tablet concerning 40 minas of silver plus a second tablet concerning 20 minas of silver, the debt of Ilī-bāni.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù ṭup-pé-e ša ku-nu-ki-a ša ú-kà-lu li-dí-na-ku-nu-tí
target: Also, let him give you the tablets with my seal that he holds.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí ṭup-pé-e ša ku-nu-ki-a ša ṭup-pu-šu ša e-li-ú-ni sá-ru-ni i-da-na-ku-nu-tí-ni ṭup-pu-šu lá tù-ša-ra-šu-um
target: Until he gives you the tablets with my seal, stating that any tablet of his that may appear is invalid, you must not release his tablet to him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pè-e ša ku-nu-ki-a ša i-da-na-ku-nu-tí-ni ki-lá-šu-nu-ma i li-bi₄ ṭup-pì-a šu-uk-na
target: Keep the tablets with my seal that he gives to you and put them among my other tablets.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-lá-ḫi-im DUMU šál-ma-a-šur
target: To Ali-ahum son of Šalim-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB MAN-a-šur DUMU a-šur-dan
target: Seal of Puzur-Aššur son of Aššur-dan.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-nu-mì ša-ap-li i ḫa-muš-tim 1.25 GÍN a-na UDU
target: During the bottom end of the week-eponymy 1 1/4 shekel for a sheep.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.6666 GÍN 15 ŠE a-na 3 bi₄-il₅-té-en
target: 3/4 shekel for 3 double loads of firewood.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.3333 GÍN 15 ŠE a-na um-zi-im
target: 5/12 shekel for dried meat.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.6666 GÍN a-na Ì.NUN
target: 1.6666 shekel for butter.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2.5 GÍN a-na UDU i-nu-mì li-ma-ni
target: 2.5 shekels for a sheep at the time of our eponymy.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.5 GÍN a-na pá-šu-ri ù ḫa-ša-le
target: 1.5 shekel for tables and gap.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 22.5 ŠE a kà-ni-im ša IGI ku-ṣí-im
target: 22.5 grains for a pot-stand which is in front of the chair.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.5 GÍN a-na e-ṣé ša ni-ib-sí-im
target: 1.5 shekel for wood of the gap.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2.6666 GÍN a-na-ru-uq ŠE-im
target: 2.6666 shekels for a sack of barley.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 GÍN a-na 2 DUG GIG i-wa-li-ba-ni-ma
target: 2 shekels for two jars of wheat also in Walibani.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.3333 GÍN 15 ŠE a-na 3 bi₄-lá-tim e-ṣí ša-qí-il₅
target: 5/12 shekels paid for 3 loads of firewood.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.5 GÍN a-na 4 ki-ra-tim áš-qúl
target: 1.5 shekel I paid for 4 jars of beer.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 DUG GIG 2.1666 GÍN 2 DUG ŠE-um 2.3333 GÍN ša-qí-il₅ i ḫa-muš-tim áš-qúl
target: For 2 jars of wheat 2.1666 shekels; for 2 jars of barley 2.3333 shekels was paid; I paid it during the week-eponymy.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2.3333 GÍN a-na-ru-uq ŠE-im áš-qúl
target: I paid 2.3333 shekels for a sack of barley.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 DUG GIG 2.3333 GÍN áš-qúl
target: For 2 jars of wheat I paid 2.3333 shekels.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.3333 GÍN 15 ŠE a-na 3 bi₄-lá-tim áš-qúl
target: I paid 1 shekel 75 grains for 3 loads.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.3333 GÍN a ni-qí ša ú-ṭí-tim e-pu-šu
target: 0.3333 shekel for the grain offering that I made.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 GÍN a qá-nu-e i-wa-li-ba-ni áš-qúl
target: 0.5 shekel I paid for reed in Walibani.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 na-ru-uq ŠE-am 2.3333 GÍN áš-qúl
target: For 0.5 sack of barley I paid 2.3333 shekels.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 DUG GIG 3.5 GÍN áš-qúl
target: For 3 jars of wheat I paid 3.5 shekels.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.3333 GÍN a-na UDU
target: 1.3333 shekel for a sheep.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.5 GÍN e-ṣí ša ni-ib-sí-im i ša pár-kà
target: 1.5 shekel for firewood of gap during the festival of Parka.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.1666 GÍN a-ni-ib-ší-im
target: 1/6 shekel for gap.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-šur-ni-im-ri ù a-lá-ḫi-im DUMU šál-ma-a-šur
target: To Aššur-nimrī and Ali-ahum son of Šalim-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB šu-zu-zu DUMU a-šur-SIPA
target: Seal of Šu-Zuzu son of Aššur-rē'ī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na {d}MAR.TU-ba-ni a-šùr-i-mì-tí ṣí-lu-lu šu-ku-bi₄-im en-nu-um-DINGIR a-šùr-dan ili₅-ba-ni en-na-sú-in LUGAL-{d}IM ù zi-ki-ki qí-bi-ma um-ma ša-lim-a-šùr-ma
target: To Amurrum-bāni, Aššur-imittī, Ṣilūlu, Šu-Kūbum, Ennam-ilī, Aššur-dan, Ilī-bāni, Enna-Suen, Šar-Adad and Zikiki from Šalim-Aššūr:

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pá-am ša kà-ri-im bu-ru-uš-ḫa-dim ṣa-ḫe-er GAL ù ṭup-pá-am ša ú-ší-na-lam DUB.SAR ša kà-ri-im bu-ru-uš-ḫa-dim DUMU i-ba-a ú ṣú-ḫa-ru-um ša ú-ší-na-lam a-na kà-ri-im kà-ni-iš ṣa-ḫe-er GAL a-šu-mì a-bu-ša-lim ÌR ub-lu-nim
target: The scribe of the Burušhaddum colony, Ibaya's son and a servant of Ušinalam have brought a tablet from the plenary assembly of the Burušhaddum colony and a tablet from Ušinalam to the plenary assembly of the Kanesh colony concerning the slave Abu-šalim.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-nu-ma 16 li-me-e 40 ma-na URUDU ší-im SÍG.ḪI.A a-bu-ša-lim ÌR a-na ú-ší-na-lam ḫa-bu-ul
target: They said: The slave Abu-šalim owes 16,040 minas of copper, the price of wool, to Ušinalam.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 30 li-me-e URUDU ša nam-e-dim ša É.GAL-lúm ḫa-bu-lu ú-ší-na-lam ú-ṣa-li-im
target: As to the 30,000 minas of copper from the others that they owe to the palace, he angered Ušinalam.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-nu-ma a-bu-ša-lim li-li-kam šu-ma a-bu-ša-lim lá-šu bé-el-šu le-tí-qám
target: They went on: "Abu-šalim must come. If Abu-šalim is absent, his master must travel."

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam a-na na-áp-ša-tí-ni ù KÙ.BABBAR-áp a-bu-ša-lim ni-ša-ḫu-ut
target: Here we fear for our lives and Abu-šalim's silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-ip-ru ša a-lim{ki} ku-lu-šu-nu-ma ù kà-ru-um kà-ni-iš ṭup-pí-šu-nu iš-ta-me-ú-ma um-ma šu-nu-ma ú-ší-na-lam tù-ṭá-áb
target: When all of the envoys from the City and the Kanesh colony had heard their letters, they said: "You will have to satisfy Ušinalam."

source: translate Akkadian to English: a qá-tí ili₅-ba-ni DUB.SAR kà-ri-im bu-ru-uš-ḫa-dim ù ṣ
target: They handed me to Ilī-bāni, the scribe of the Burušhaddum colony and Ušinalam's servant together with my merchandise that had come up from the City, and they said: "Go! Satisfy Ušinalam!"

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na PÚZUR-a-na qí-bi-ma um-ma lá-ma-sí-ma ù aḫ-ba-áš-tí-ma
target: Say to Puzur-Anna, thus Lamassī and Ah-bāštī:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na É a-lim{ki} ni-ta-na-lá-ak-ma lá ú-šu-ru-ni-a-tí
target: We keep going to the City Hall, but they yield us nothing.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ta-ak-ší-tum i-na a-lim{ki} lá-šu
target: There is no way of making profit in the City!

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-šu-um lá ta-ša-ra-ni-a-tí
target: Why do you not care for us?

source: translate Akkadian to English: lá tí-dí-e ki-ma i-na é-be-tim ra-qí-im té-zi-bu-ni-a-tí
target: Don't you realize that you left us behind in an empty house?

source: translate Akkadian to English: me-ra-lí 1 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR né-ri-šu-ma lá i-dí-ni-a-tí
target: We asked Merali for one single shekel of silver, but he did not give it to us.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ku-lu-ni nu-ta-ni-iḫ-ma šál-ma-ni
target: All of us have been toiling, but we are now well.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú-ru-za-na-tim me-ra-lì ša ub-lá-ni lá i-mu-a ta-da-nam
target: The .'s of Merali, which he brought, he refused to give (us).

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ku-ṣí-im ni-mu-a-at
target: We will be dead before the winter!

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tí a-li-ki-im <gap> pá-né-e-em-ma a-šu-ur-ni-a-tí
target: Send goods to provide for us with the next caravan!

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-šu-um iš-tù ša-am-ší-im ša tù-ṣú-ni lá ta-ša-ra-ni-a-tí
target: Why is it that since the day you went away you fail to provide for us?

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na na-áb-sú-in en-um-a-šur ZU-re-i ú a-šur-iš-tí-kál qí-bi₄-ma um-ma iš-ma-a-šur-ma
target: Say to Nab-Suen, Ennam-Aššur, Suen-rē'ī, and Aššuriš-tikal, thus Išme-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: áš-pu-ra-ku-nu-tí um-ma a-na-ku-ma DAM ḫa-lá-bi₄-im me-ta-at
target: I wrote you as follows: 'The wife of hali-abum is dead.'

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ma té-zi-bu pá-ḫi-ra-ma a-na ḫu-ur-ší-im iš-té-en šé-ri-ba-ma ki-ma i-a-tí ku-un-kà
target: Collect everything she left behind and bring it into one single storeroom and seal it in my name'.

source: translate Akkadian to English: áš-ta-na-me-ma ma-ma-na am-tám a-na a-ḫa-zi-im i-za-az
target: I hear by rumor that somebody intends to marry the maid.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša-i-lá-ma lu DUMU a-šur lu nu-a-um ší-be-e šu-uk-na-šu-um lá e-ḫa-sí
target: Make inquiries and whether it is an Assyrian or an Anatolian, set witnesses against him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ma té-zi-bu lu ba-áb-tám ṣa-bi₄-sí
target: Seize everything she left behind, also outstanding claims.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫu-ú-a a-tù-nu i-iḫ-da <gap> a-wi-lum KÙ.BABBAR ma-dam i-ta-ba-al
target: Please, my brothers, take care, (for) the man may take along a lot of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: bu-lá-tí-a šar-ší-a-ni
target: Make me obtain my assets!

source: translate Akkadian to English: 15 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am i-ṣé-er ma-lá-ba en-na-sú-in i-šu
target: 15 shekels of refined silver Malaba owes to Ennam-Suen.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù ITU.KAM ḫu-bu-ur li-mu-um šu-da-a DUMU en-na-nim a-na 3 ḫa-am-ša-tim i-ša
target: From month VI, eponymy of Šudaya, son of Ennānum he will pay within 3 weeks.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma lá iš-qúl ki-ma a-wa-at kà-ri-im ṣí-ib-tám ú-ṣa-áb
target: If he does not pay he will add interest according to the regulation of the colony.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma DUMU a-šùr-DU₁₀ a-na ma-lá-ba i-tù-ru en-na-sú-in ú-ba-áb-šu
target: If the sons of Aššur-ṭāb raise a claim against Malaba Ennam-Suen will clear him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI PUZUR₄-a-šùr IGI a-šùr-du-gu₅-ul
target: Before Puzur-Aššur, before Aššur-dugul.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na e-lá-ma qí-bi-ma um-ma a-šùr-i-mì-tí-ma
target: Say to Elamma, thus Aššur-imittī:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ku-nu-ki-kà bu-ur-sú-in ub-lam-ma a-na-ku ù a-šur-na-da nu-sà-ni-iq-ma 2 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR im-ṭí
target: 5 minas of silver under your seal Būr-Suen delivered and I myself and Aššur-nādā we checked it and it proved to be 2 shekels too little.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a-na SÍG.ḪI A ša É kà-ri-im ni-iš-qú-ul
target: We paid 3 minas of silver for wool of the colonial office.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša ILLAT-at i-na-a ú šu-nu-nu a-na 10 TÚG.TA bi-it-qá-tum i-bi-ší-a-ma 0.3333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR i-na É kà-ri-im lá ni-ta-dí-ma 0.6666 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR i-na KÙ.BABBAR-pì-kà áš-qúl
target: As for the caravan of Innāya and Šu-Nunu, there occurred deficits amounting to 10 textiles per (trader?), so that we could not deposit 0.3333 mina of the silver in the colonial office, but I paid 0.6666 mina of silver from your own silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 ma-na 6 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na 6 ANŠE <gap> ni-iš-qú-ul
target: I paid 2 minas 6 shekels of silver for 6 donkeys.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 12 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ší-im KÙ.BABBAR-pí-kà i-na li-bi-a i-ba-ší
target: 12 shekels of silver, the price of your silver, is still due by me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na-NA₄.GÌN-za-ku-nu ša ub-lu-ni-ni 0.8333 ma-na 3 GÍN a-na iš-ra-tim il₅-qé-ú
target: Of your lapis lazuli, which they brought here, they took 53 shekels as tithe.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na 2 GÍN a-na ší-mì-im a-na ša-na-ú-um il₅-qé-ú
target: 32 shekels (of lapis lazuli) they bought at a rate of 2 : 1.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-im ḫu-sà-ri-ku-nu ku-nu-ki-ni bu-ur-sú-in na-áš-a-ku-um
target: With the price of your lapis lazuli under our seal Būr-Suen is on his way to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na šál-ša-tí ša ILLAT i-na-a ú a-šùr-ta-ak-lá-ku <gap> ma-na 13 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ta-lá-qé
target: From the 'one third parts' of the caravan of Innāya and Aššur-taklāku you will receive <gap> minas 13 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-té-en ṣú-ḫa-ra-am a-na lu-ḫu-sà-dí-a ṭur₄-da-ma e-ma-ra-am i-lá-qé-ú
target: Send one servant to Luhusaddiya and let them take the / a donkey.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a ba-zi-a
target: 2 minas of silver for Baziya;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ù ṣí-ba-sú ša dan-a-šur
target: 1 mina of silver with the interest on it of Dān-Aššur;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR É kà-ri-im
target: 1 mina of silver of the colonial office;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR wa-wa-li a-šur-i-mì-tí
target: 0.5 mina of silver Wawali (and) Aššur-imittī -

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ.BA 2.5 ma-na 0.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ir-ma-a-šur i-lá-qé
target: Of this Ir'am-Aššur will take 2 minas 30.5 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ma a-nim a-na ir-ma-a-šur e-zi-ib
target: All this I left to Ir'am-Aššur,

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI šu-IŠTAR DUMU da-da-nim IGI sà-ba-sí-a
target: in the presence of Šu-Ištar, son of Dadānum, and of Sabasiya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma i-na-sú-in a-na dan-a-šur-ma
target: Enna-Suen said to Dan-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: me-er me-tim a-na-ku
target: I am an heir.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pá-am tù-kà-li-mì-ma
target: You have shown me a tablet

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na ṭup-pì-im ša 12 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša tù-kà-li-mì-ni šu-mì a-bi₄-kà PÚZUR-a-šur ú-lá ú-du ú šu-mì ma-ma-na ú-lá ú-du-ú
target: and in the tablet concerning 12 minas of silver that you have shown me the name of your father Puzur-Aššur was not indicated, nor was anybody's name indicated.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lá tù-ba-a-ra-ni
target: You do not provide proof for me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu a-ni-a-ma me-er-e me-tim a-na-ku
target: May it be like this: I am the heir.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫe-e ma-du-tim i-šu-ú
target: I have many brothers.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pá-am lu ni-il₅-qé-ma
target: Let us take the tablet

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma a-bu-kà PÚZUR-a-šur i-ṣé-er i-dí-a-bi₄-im a-bi₄-a i-šu-ú
target: and if your father Puzur-Aššur had any claim on my father Iddin-abum,

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ṣé-er ku-nu-uk a-bi-a ù a-na-ku lá+lá-<gap> qá-dí a-ḫe-a-ma a-na-ku-ma a-za-za-ku-um
target: then on top of my father's seal I too shall <gap> I shall personally stand up for you together with my brothers.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-bi₄-kà lá-aṣ-ba-at-ma
target: I shall seize your witnesses.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB a-ku-za DUMU šu-a-nim KIŠIB MAR.TU-ba-ni DUMU ma-na-na KIŠIB lá-qé-ep DUMU PUZUR₄.IŠTAR
target: Sealed by Akuza son of Šu-Anum, by Amurrum-bāni son of Manana, by Lā-qēp son of Puzur-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um kà-ni-iš-ki i-dí-ni-a-tí-ma
target: The Kanesh colony gave us for these proceedings.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI GÍR ša a-šùr ší-bu-tí-ni ni-dí-in
target: We gave our testimony before Aššur's dagger.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-tur₄-DINGIR DUMU a-mur-IŠTAR tap-pá-i-ni
target: Itūr-ilī son of Amur-Ištar was our (absent) partner.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB ma-num DUMU kà-bi-a KIŠIB a-šur-DU₁₀ DUMU šu-IŠTAR KIŠIB a-ḫu-šu DUMU a-šur-i-dí KIŠIB šu-{d}EN.LÍL DUMU ma-nu-ki-a-šur
target: Seal of Manum, son of Kabiya, seal of Aššur-ṭāb, son of Šu-Ištar, seal of Ahušu, son of Aššur-idī, seal of Šu-Ellil, son of Mannu-kī-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR li-tám dam-qám i-ṣé-er šu-{d}EN.LÍL DUMU ma-nu-ki-a-šur iš-ma-a-šur DUMU ḫi-na-a i-šu
target: 5 minas of good quality silver Šu-Elil, son of Mannu-kī-Aššur, owes to Išme-Aššur, son of hinnāya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù ḫa-muš-tim ša ku-lu-ma-a ITU.KAM áb-ša-ra-ni li-mu-um sá-ma-a a-na <gap> ḫa-am-ša-tim i-ša-qal
target: From the week of Kulumaya, month V, year eponymy of Samaya, he will pay within <gap> weeks.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma lá iš-qúl ki-ma a-wa-at kà-ri-im 1.5 GÍN.TA i-na ITU.KAM-im a-na 1 ma-na-im ṣí-ib-tám ú-ṣa-áb
target: If he does not pay he will add in accordance with the regulation of the colony an interest of 1.5 shekel per month per mina.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB PUZUR₄-a-na DUMU i-dí-{d}IM KIŠIB a-mur-a-šur DUMU a-šur-be-el-a-wa-tim KIŠIB en-um-a-šur ŠEŠ-šu KIŠIB i-ku-pì-a-šur DUMU ḫi-na-a
target: Seal of Puzur-Anna, son of Iddin-Adad, seal of āmur-Aššur, son of Aššur-bēl-awātim, seal of Ennam-Aššur, his brother, seal of Ikūn-pī-Aššur, son of hinnāya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 GÚ URUDU ma-sí-am i-ṣé-er a-mur-a-šur DUMU a-šur-be-el-a-wa-tim ù en-um-a-šur a-ḫi-šu li-ip-it-IŠTAR i-šu
target: 5 talents of refined copper āmur-Aššur, son of Aššur-bēl-awātim, <and> Ennam-Aššur, his brother, owe to Lipit-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na MU.5.ŠÈ i-ša-qú-lu
target: They will pay in 5 years.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma lá iš-qú-lu 1.5 ma-na.TA i-na ITU.KAM-im ṣí-ib-tám ú-ṣú-bu
target: When they do not pay they will add 1.5 mina per (talent) per month as interest.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-ku-pì-a-šur DUMU ḫi-na-a qá-ta-tum
target: Ikūn-pī-Aššur, son of hinnāya, is guarantor.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ITU.KAM ṣí-ip-im li-mu-um bu-zu-ta-a
target: Month VII, eponymy year of Buzutaya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na <gap>-ar <gap> i zu <gap> ra <gap> ṭup-pí-a a-na ḫu-bu-ul i-dí-a-bi-im a-na qá-ta-tí-šu ṭup-pí-a ú-lá-pí-tù
target: They wrote my tablets for Iddin-abum's debt for his guarantor.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša-lim-a-šùr iṣ-ba-at-ni-a-tí-ma um-ma šu-ut-ma a-na šu-bé-lim ù en-na-sú-in-ma KÙ.BABBAR 1 GÚ ù 2 GÚ a-na ḫu-bu-ul a-bi-ku-nu i-na na-ru-qí-a ú-ša-qí-il₅
target: Šalim-Aššur seized us and said to Šu-Bēlum and Enna-Suen: I have paid some 1 or 2 talents of silver for your father's debt out of my joint-stock capital.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ba-a-nim ṭup-pé-e ša ḫu-bu-ul a-bi-ku-nu am-ra-ma KÙ.BABBAR-pí šu-uq-lá-nim
target: Come on, look at the tablets concerning your father's debt and pay me my silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-nu-ma ṭup-pu ú ma-aḫ-ru-ú ša a-bi-ni i-na ku-nu-uk šu-{d}EN.LÍL a-mur-IŠTAR ù šu-a-nim kà-an-ku-ma i-na a-lim{ki} i-ba-ší-ú
target: They said: "Our father's tablets and copies were sealed with the seals of Šu-Illil, Amur-Ištar and Šu-Anum, and they are in the City."

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma-ba i li-bi a-bi-ni ta-áb-tù-ra-am šál-ma-am i-na a-lim{ki} la-qá-am la ta-mu-a
target: If indeed you can establish anything as owed by our father, will you refuse to take the full amount in the City?

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ša-lim-a-šùr-ma a-na šu-be-lim KÙ.BABBAR ša GÁN-lim a-na-ku pá-ḫu-ra-am qá-bi-a-ku
target: Šalim-Aššur answered Šu-Bēlum: "I have personally promised to collect the silver that is abroad."

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-šu-um iš-tí DUMU da-da KÙ.BABBAR i ḫa-ḫi-im tal-qé
target: Why have you taken silver from Dada's son in hahhum?

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-be-lúm-ma ke-na al-qé
target: Šu-Bēlum answered: "Yes, I took it."

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù en-na-sú-in iš-a-al-ma um-ma šu-ut-ma mì-šu-ú i tí-me-el-ki-a KÙ.BABBAR tal-qé
target: So he asked Enna-Suen, saying: "Why have you taken silver in Timel-kiya?"

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-ut-ma šu-ma al-qé a-da-gal-šu lá i-ba-ší
target: He answered: "I shall look whether I took any, but there is nothing."

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um kà-ni-iš i-dí-ni-a-tí-ma IGI GÍR ša a-šùr ší-bu-tí-ni ni-dí-in
target: The Kanesh colony gave us for these proceedings and we gave our testimony before Aššur's dagger.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-ku-za IGI lá-li-im IGI šu-ku-bi-im IGI a-šùr-i-mì-t
target: Witnessed by Akuza, by Lalum, by Šu-Kūbum, by Aššur-imittī, by Itūr-ilī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3.5 ma-na URUDU SIG₅ ú 1 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na PUZUR₄-a-mu-ri-im DUMU ni-mar-IŠTAR a-dí-in
target: I gave 3.5 minas of good copper plus 1 shekel of silver to Puzur-Amurrum son of Nimar-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ì-lí-e-mu-qí šu-ta-mu-zi a-bi-a-a e-lá-a ù lá-ma-sí qí-bi-ma um-ma a-dí-da ù a-lá-ḫu-um-ma
target: To Ilī-emūqī, Šu-Tammuzi, Abiya, Elaya and Lamassī from Adida and Ali-ahum:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3.3333 ma-na KÙ.GI ša-lim-a-šur a-na a-šur-iš-tí-kál DUMU sú-kà-lí-a a-dí-im
target: Šalim-Aššur invested 3.3333 minas of gold in Aššuriš-tikal son of Sukkalliya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša-lim-a-šur i-na ba-áb ḫa-ra-ni-šu um-ma šu-ut-ma a-na šu-ta-mu-zi a-dí-da ù e-lá-a-ma a-ḫu-a-tù-nu
target: When Šalim-Aššur was about to leave he said to Šu-Tammuzi, Adida and Elaya: My dear brothers,

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR a-na li-mì-im a-mur-a-šur ḫa-bu-lá-ku
target: I owe silver to the eponym Amur-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na ṭup-pí-im ša a-šur-iš-tí-kál en-na-nim ù ḫa-na-a qá-tí li-mì-im a-mur-a-šur ú qá-at-ku-nu šu-uk-na
target: Lay claim on behalf of the eponym Amur-Aššur and of yourselves to the tablet concerning Aššuriš-tikal, Ennānum and hannaya;

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ù né-ma-al-šu li-iš-qú-lu-ma li-ma-am a-mur-a-šur ṭá-i-ba-a
target: they should pay the silver and the accrued profit and then satisfy the eponym Amur-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-tí KÙ.BABBAR-pì-im a-na DAM.GÀR-ri-a li-zi-iz
target: The rest of the silver should stand available for my customers.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam a-šur-iš-tí-kál ú ì-lí-e-mu-qí ni-ṣa-na-ba-at-ma um-ma né-nu-ma
target: We keep seizing Aššuriš-tikal and Ilī-emūqī here, saying:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3.3333 ma-na KÙ.GI ša-lim-a-šur
target: Šalim-Aššur has invested 3.3333 minas of gold.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na URUDU a-na da-di-a a-šu-mì il₅-ba-ni áš-qúl
target: 1 mina of copper I paid to Dadiya in the name of Ilī-bāni.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ma-na a-na il₅-ba-ni a-dí-in
target: I gave mina(s) to Ilī-bāni.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ma-na 5 GÍN ší-im a-ri-im
target: mina 5 shekels as payment for a hide.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ma-na i-na mu-ṣí-šu áš-qúl
target: mina(s) in his exit fee, I paid.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na šu-ša-lu ŠÀ.BA 3.6666 ma-na 5 GÍN ḫa-bu-lá-ak-šu-um
target: 1 mina thereof I am indebted to him for 3 minas 45 shekels.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša i-dí-a-bu-um a-na kà-ri-im iḫ-bu-lu 1 ma-na-um 4 GÍN ni-iṣ-ḫi-ir-ma 9.3333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am iš-tí ša-lim-a-ḫi-im i-dí-a-šùr DUMU ba-bi₄-lim ù PUZUR₄-a-šùr li-ma-an il₅-qé-ma
target: Of the 10 minas of silver that Iddin-abum owes to the colony we deducted 4 shekels per mina and the two eponyms, Iddin-Aššur son of Babilum and Puzur-Aššur, received 9.3333 minas of refined silver from Šalim-ahum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù ḫa-mu-uš-tim ša a-ku-za 1.5 GÍN.TA i-na ITU.KAM a-na 1 ma-na-im ú-ṣa-áb
target: And reckoned from the week of Akuza he will pay interest at the rate 1.5 shekel per month per mina.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-šur-{d}UTU-ši IGI i-dí-a-šur DUMU a-šur-ma-lik
target: Witnessed by Aššur-šamšī, by Iddin-Aššur son of Aššur-malik.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na šu-ta-mu-zi e-lá-a a-šùr-ma-sú-wi ù en-um-a-šùr a-na a-šur-ma-sú-wi qí-bi₄-ma um-ma en-um-a-šùr-ma
target: To Šu-Tammuzi, Elaya, Aššur-massuʾī and Ennam-Aššur; specifically to Aššur-massuʾī from Ennam-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam a-dí 5-ší-šu ù iš-ri-šu ta-áp-nu-a-ma um-ma a-ta-ma a-ḫi a-ta i-na qá-tim e-ri-tim lá wa-áš-ba-ku-ma lá a-ḫa-li-iq
target: Here you confronted me five or ten times, and you said: My dear brother, let me not stay with empty hands and perish!

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR 2 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ú e-li-iš dí-na-ma e-en₆ a-šur ù e-en₆ a-ḫa-tí-a kà-li-mì-ma ú a-dí ba-al-ṭá-ku-ni ú-lá a-ma-ší-kà
target: Give me at least 2 minas of silver, preferably more, show me Aššur's eye and the eye of my sister, then as long as I live I shall never forget you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ke-na a-wa-tum ša IGI a-šur ù i-li a-ba-e-ni ta-ta-ma-a-ni-ni
target: Yes, these were the words you swore to me before Aššur and our fathers' god.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na ku-ur-ṣí-im áp-ṭù-ur-ma ù i-a-tí iš-tí ṣa-bi-im 5 ú e-li-iš tù-uš-ta-ar-ší-a-ni-ma
target: I released you from your bonds, but then it was me you made to suffer with 5 men or more.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma um-me-a-ni a-bi-a sí-ki ú-kà-lu-ú a-na É-bé-tí-kà ú-lá ú-ta-ší-ru-ni
target: Now, my father's investors detain me! They have not granted me access to your house.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-ut-ma i-na tù-wa-ar sí-kà-tim KÙ.BABBAR-pì-šu ú-lá KÙ.KI-šu ú-šé-ba-al-šu-um
target: He answered: "When the sikkātum returns I shall send him his silver or his gold."

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí sí-kà-tim i-tù-ra-ni-ni a-na ša-lá-tù-wa-ar a-ṣé-er i-na-a <gap> e-ru-<gap>
target: Until the sikkātum returns, <gap> to Šalatuwar to Inaya <gap>

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am ni-is-ḫa-sú DIRI ša-du-a-sú ša-bu ša e-lá-ma a-lá-ḫu-um a-na ku-da-dim ip-qí-id-ma a-na èr-ra-ili₅ ú ku-da-dim a ší-a-ma-tim a-na AN.NA ša-a-mì-im ú-<gap>-bi₄-il₅
target: 10 minas of refined silver, its excise added, his transport fee paid, belonging to Elamma, Ali-ahum has entrusted to Kudādum and he has brought it to Erra-ilī and Kudādum for making purchases, to buy tin.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ša e-lá-ma
target: The silver belongs to Elamma.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ni-is-ḫa-sú DIRI ša-du-a-sú ša-bu ša e-lá-ma a-lá-ḫu-um a-na a-lá-bi₄-im ip-qí-id-ma a-na a-lá-ḫi-im šu-lí ú èr-ra-ili₅ ú-bi₄-il₅
target: 10 minas of silver, its excise added, his transport fee paid for, belonging to Elamma, Ali-ahum entrusted to Ali-abum and he brought it to Ali-abum!, Šuli and Erra-ilī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI šu-ku-bi₄-im DUMU qá-a-tim IGI a-šur-na-da DUMU a-šur-i-dí
target: In the presence of Šu-Kūbum, son of Qa'atum, of Aššur-nādā, son of Aššur-idī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 12 TÚG e-lá-ma a-na a-lá-ḫi-im a ta-ad-mì-iq-tim i-dí-in IGI a-šur-na-da IGI lá-qé-ep
target: 12 textiles Elamma gave to Ali-ahum as a free loan in the presence of Aššur-nādā (and) of La-qēp.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB a-mur-IŠTAR DUMU mì-šar-GAL KIŠIB la-qé-ep DUMU kà-a-tim KIŠIB i-dí-a-bi-im DUMU i-sú-rik₁₃
target: Seal of Amur-Ištar son of Mīšar-rabi, seal of Lā-qēp son of Kayātum, seal of Iddin-abum son of Issu-arik.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša ḫu-bu-ul i-dí-a-bi-im
target: Concerning the debt of Iddin-abum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am i-ṣé-er i-dí-a-bi-im a-šur-{d}UTU-ši i-šu
target: Iddin-abum owes 5 minas of refined silver to Aššur-šamši.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù ḫa-mu-uš-tim ša a-mur-IŠTAR a-na 23 ḫa-am-ša-tim i-ša-qal
target: Reckoned from the week of Amur-Ištar he must pay within 23 weeks.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma i-na ma-lá u₄-me-šu la iš-qú-ul 1.5 GÍN.TA i ITU.KAM a-na ma-na-im ú-ṣa-áb
target: If he has not paid within his stipulated term he must pay interest at the rate 1.5 shekel per month per mina.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi-ma um-ma PÚZUR-a-šur tí-ir-tí i-li-kà-kum
target: To Ali-ahum from Puzur-Aššur: I already sent you my instructions.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na 2 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na e-na-nim DUMU a-bi-a i-na pu-ru-uš-ḫa-dim e-zi-ib
target: I left 0.5 mina 2 shekels of silver with Ennānum son of Abiya in Purušhaddum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma e-na-num wa-ša-áb KÙ.BABBAR ša-áš-qí-il₅-šu-ma šé-bi₄-lam
target: If Ennānum is present make him pay the silver and send it here.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma lá-šu 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR i-na ra-mì-ni-kà a-na ṣú-ḫa-ri-kà ù e-lá-li pì-qí-id-ma lu-ub-lu-nim
target: If he is absent, entrust 1 mina of silver of your own to your servant and Elāli so they can bring it here.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na sà-ḫe-er-tim e-lá-li na-áš-a-kum
target: Elāli brings you 2.5 shekels of silver for small goods.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 šé-né-en ša sí-ni-iš-tim SIG₅ šé-bi₄-lam
target: Send me 3 pairs of good women's shoes.

source: translate Akkadian to English: sí-pá-ra-tim lá tù-šé-ba-lam
target: Do not send me bronze pins.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.5 SÌLA ri-iš-tám iš-ru-um ù mu-sà-ru-um ù a-da-aḫ-ší kà-al-kà IR na-áš-a-kum
target: The slave Kalka brings 1.5 litre of first-quality (oil), a belt and a girdle and -spice to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-lá-ḫu-um ra-bi-ṣa-am a-ba-ba e-pu-ul-šu um-ma a-lá-ḫu-um-ma us-kà-i-in a ṭup-pí-im ša a-lim{ki} ù ra-bi-ṣí-im ša be-li-a tí-ma-li-ma
target: Ali-ahum answered the attorney Ababa, saying: I submit to the tablet of the City and the attorney of my lord.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ta-áš-a-lá-ni-ma a-pu-ul-kà um-ma a-na-ku-ma al-kam ba-a-am ma-lá a-bi KÙ.BABBAR i ṭup-pì-im il₅-pu-tí-ni lá-áš-qúl-ma ù a-na a-lim{ki} lu ni-lik
target: Yesterday you questioned me and I answered you, saying: 'Come along, let me pay as much silver as my father noted me for in the tablet, and then let us go to the City.'

source: translate Akkadian to English: al-kam u₄-ma-ma KÙ.BABBAR lá-áš-qúl-ma ù ba-a-ba-tim ša a-bi-ni lu-kà-li-ma i ša-ḫa-tí-a i-zi-iz-ma KÙ.BABBAR lu nu-ša-áš-qí-il₅-ma a ma-lá ṭup-pí-im ša a-lim{ki} a-na a-lim{ki} lu ni-lik
target: Come, let me pay the silver even today and then show you the outstanding claims of our father, so you may assist me and we can have the silver paid and go to the City in accordance with the tablet of the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pá-am ša a-lim{ki} ú ra-bi-ṣa-am ša be-li-ni lá nu-na-aḫ
target: We shall not obstruct the tablet of the City and the attorney of our lord.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na en-na-nim a-dí-da ù a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi-ma um-ma be-lúm-ba-ni-ma
target: To Ennānum, Adida, and Ali-ahum from Bēlum-bāni:

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na li-bi₄ URUDU-i-a 1 GÚ URUDU a-na ša-lim-a-šur dí-na-ma ú ší-be šu-uk-na-šu-um
target: Give 1 talent of my copper to Šalim-Aššur and set witnesses for him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ki-ma i-na wa-aḫ-šu-ša-na 1 GÚ URUDU-i ú-ta-ra-ni mì-šu ša áš-ta-na-me-ú-ma šu-ku-bu-um e-ta-wu-ku-nu um-ma šu-ut-ma u₄-mu-a a-ḫu-ru
target: Since he is to return my 1 talent of copper to me in Wahšušana, why is it that I keep hearing that Šu-Kūbum is arguing with you, saying: My terms are still running.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù ITU.KAM té-i-na-tim li-mu-um a-šur-ma-lik a-na <gap> ḫa-am-ša-tim a-dí-šu-um u₄-mu-šu 2 ITU.KAM e-tí-qú
target: I gave it to him for <gap> weeks from the month Teʾinātum, eponymy Aššur-malik. His terms are overdue by two months.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṣa-áb-ta-šu-ma <gap> 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša-áš-qí-lá-šu
target: Seize him and make him pay <gap> 0.5 mina of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma mì-ma i-qá-bi₄ a-na <gap> ma-nu <gap> pá-na a-na-ku-ma <gap> ki-ma lá ga ma <gap> a-wa-tum a <gap> ša mì-ma a-ni-<gap> ší ù <gap> ša-áš-qú-lá <gap> ša ší <gap>
target: If he objects, <gap> all this <gap> make <gap> pay <gap>

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 SÌLA Ì.GIŠ ša ḫa-ḫi-im
target: 1 litre of oil from hahhum

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na li-bi a-zu-ta-a-a DUMU e-me-me iš-tí pá-nim-ma ú-šé-ba-lam
target: owed by Azutaya son of Ememe

source: translate Akkadian to English: 20 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am <gap> i-ṣé-er i-dí-a-bi₄-im šu-{d}EN.LÍL i-šu
target: Iddin-abum owes 20 minas of refined silver to Šu-Illil.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù ḫa-mu-uš-tim ša li-ba-a a-na 13 ḫa-am-ša-tim i-ša-qal
target: Reckoned from the week of Libbaya he must pay in 13 weeks.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma lá iš-qú-ul 1.5 GÍN.TA i-na ITU.KAM a-na 1 ma-na-im ú-ṣa-áb
target: If he has not paid (in time), he must add interest at the rate 1.5 shekel per month per mina.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma lá-ma u₄-me-šu ṭup-pu-šu i-lá-pu-tù 5 ma-na KÙ.GI šu-mì šu-{d}EN.LÍL i-lá-pá-at
target: If they write his tablet before his term is up, he shall book 5 minas of gold in the name of Šu-Illil.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-mur-IŠTAR IGI en-nam-a-šùr
target: Witnessed by Amur-Ištar, by Ennam-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR šu-ku-bu-um ni-a-um i-na ša li-bi₄ ḫu-bu-li-šu iš-qú-lam
target: Our own Šu-Kūbum paid me 1 mina of silver as part of his debt.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma i-dí-a-šùr-ma a-na e-la-ma ù a-la-ḫi-im qí-bi₄-ma a-na a-la-ḫi-im qí-bi-ma
target: Thus Iddin-Aššur, say to Elamma and Ali-ahum, in particular to Ali-ahum:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša ṭup-pá-am ša sí-li-a ta al-pu-tù 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR sá-li-a li-dí-na-ku-ma
target: 1 mina of silver for which you drew up Saliya's debt-note, let Saliya give you that 1 mina of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù ší-tí KÙ.BABBAR ṭup-pì-i am-ra-ma a-na ar-be-e-šu a-na sà-li-a e-sí-ir-ma lu nu-ša-bi₄-kà
target: And as for the rest of the silver inspect my tablet to (discover) that I have already dunned Saliya four times, in order to be able to pay you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫi a-ta gi₅-mì-lam i-ṣé-ri-a ù me-er-e-a šu-ku-un
target: Please my brother, do me and my sons this favor.

source: translate Akkadian to English: DAM.GÀR i-šu a-ma-ma-an i-pì-kà lá ú-ṣí-i
target: I have a creditor, (so) let nobody hear (about it) from your mouth!

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na i-dí-a-bi-im i-tur₄-DINGIR en-na-nim ù i-na-aḫ-DINGIR qí-bi-ma um-ma en-nam-a-šur-ma
target: To Iddin-abum, Itūr-ilī, Ennānum and Inah-ilī from Ennam-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 GÚ AN.NA ú <gap> ša a-bi-ni a-ma-kam <gap> e-zi-bu-ma a-<gap> a-na ḫa-na-a a-<gap> ta-dí-na-ni-ma
target: 4 talents of tin and <gap> belonging to our father they left there and <gap> to hanaya <gap> you gave to me and <gap>

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù pu-ru-uš-ḫa-dim ú-šé-ba-lá-ku-nu-tí
target: I shall send it to you from Purušhaddum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam i-nu-mì e-ri-qá-tim a-na pu-ru-uš-ḫa-dim iš-tí dan-a-šur DUMU PUZUR₄-a-šur a-bu-ku tí-ir-tí a-na ṣé-er ḫa-na-a i-dí-ku-bi-im ú dan-a-šur <gap> áš-pu-ur-ma
target: Here, when I shipped the wagons to Purušhaddum with Dan-Aššur son of Puzur-Aššur, I sent my instructions to hanaya, Iddin-Kūbum and Dan-Aššur,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 25 ma-na <gap> ú-ša-ak-ni-ku-šu-nu <gap> iš-tí i-dí-da-gán <gap> ù a-ṣé-er ša ki-ma <gap> ú tí-ir-tí ša ki-ma <gap> um-ma šu-nu-ma <gap> iš-tí wa-ar-ki-ú-tim <gap> nu-šé-ba-al-šu-um
target: and they made them seal 25 minas of <gap> with Iddin-Dagān <gap> and to the representatives of <gap> also, the instructions of the representatives <gap> They said: We shall send it to him with the next transport.

source: translate Akkadian to English: be-lu-a a-tù-nu KÙ.BABBAR li-iš-<gap> šu-ma ta-da-ga-lá-ma ḫa-ra-num a-na ú-ša pá-tí-at-ma a-pu-tum KÙ.BABBAR šé-bi-lá
target: My dear lords, let the silver <gap> If you observe that the road to Ušša is open, then please send silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-kam a-tù-nu mì-il₅-kà a-lu-wa ṭù-ur-da lá i-sà-ḫu-ur
target: You yourselves make up your minds there! Send Aluwa. He should not delay.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a ma-lá dí-in kà-ri-im kà-ni-iš TUR GAL en-um-ì-lí DUB.SAR iṣ-ba-at-ni-a-tí-ma
target: In accordance with the verdict of the plenary Kanesh colony Ennam-ilī, the scribe, seized us.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na É e-lá-ma né-ru-ub-ma ku-nu-ki ša ma-ak-na-ki-im ni-iš-ru-ma
target: We entered Elamma's house and broke the seals of the sealed room.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na ma-ak-na-ki-im 10 né-zi-ib
target: We left (them) in the sealed room.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na 2-šé-ni-šu ta-ma-lá-ki-šu ša ṭup-pè a-gu₅-ú-a DUMU <gap> il₅-qé
target: Two boxes with tablets Akūa, son of Baziya took.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI ma-sà-a DUMU a-šùr-ni-im-ri IGI ma-ṣí-ì-lí DUMU bu-zu-zi-im IGI a-mur-a-šùr DUMU a-šùr-DU₁₀
target: Witnessed by Masaya, son of Aššur-nimrī, by Maṣi-ilī, son of Buzuzum, by Amur-Aššur, son of Aššur-ṭāb.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB da-dí-a DUMU ba-za-za KIŠIB i-di-a-bi₄-im DUMU i-dí-sú-in KIŠIB IŠTAR-il₅-šu DUMU a-zu-za-a KIŠIB a-šur-{d}UTU-ši DUMU ì-lí-tù-ra-am
target: Seal of Dadiya, son of Bazaza; seal of Iddin-abum; seal of Aššur-šamsī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.6666 ma-na 1 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am i-ṣé-er IŠTAR-il₅-šu DUMU a-zu-za-a a-šur-DU₁₀ DUMU e-lá-ma i-šu
target: 0.6666 mina 5 shekels of refined silver Ištar-ilšu, son of Azuzaya, owes to Aššur-ṭāb, son of Elamma.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù ḫa-mu-uš-tim ša ḫu-ra-ṣa-nim ù a-šur-ma-lik li-mu-um a-lá-ḫu-um DUMU i-na-aḫ-DINGIR 1.5 GÍN.TA a-na 1 ma-na-im ṣí-ib-tám ú-ṣa-áb
target: From the week of hurāṣānum and Aššur-mālik, eponymy of Alī-ahum, son of Īnah-ilī, he will add 1.5 shekel per mina as interest.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ig-re ag-ri-im a-bi-a-a DUMU ú-zu-a ú-ma-lá 2 GÍN lu-bu-šu ša-bu
target: the wages of the hireling Abiaya, son of Uzua, will compensate; he has been paid 2 shekels (of silver) as his clothing allowance.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB en-um-a-šur DUMU i-ku-pí-a KIŠIB a-ni-na-a DUMU DIRI-im KIŠIB e-na-a-šur DUMU šu-ul-mì-ša-a-šùr
target: Seal of Ennum-Assur, son of Ikuppiya, seal of Aninaya, son of Watrum, seal of Ennam-Assur, son of Sulmi-sa-Assur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 12 ma-na URUDU ší-kam i-ṣé-er en-um-a-šùr DUMU i-ku-pí-a DAM.GÀR i-šu iš-tù SAG ITU.KAM tí-i-na-tim a-na ITU.KAM i-ša-qal
target: 12 minas of copper Ennum-Assur, son of Ikuppiya, owes to the creditor. Reckoning from month <gap> he will pay in one month.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma lá iš-qú-ul a-na 10 ma-na na-e 0.5 ma-na.TA i-na ITU.KAM ṣí-ib-tám ú-ṣa-áb
target: If he does not pay he will add an interest of 0.5 mina per 10 minas per month.

source: translate Akkadian to English: li-mu-um da-dí-a DUMU šu-{d}NIN.ŠUBUR wa-bi₄-il₅ ṭup-pì-im šu-ut DAM.GÀR
target: Eponymy of Dadiya, son of Su-Ilabrat. The bearer of the tablet is the creditor.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB ḫi-ta-ni DUMU DINGIR-na-da KIŠIB en-um-a-šùr DUMU <gap> KIŠIB a-mur-a-šùr DUMU i-šar-ki-it-a-šùr KIŠIB ku-na-na-a
target: Seal of Hitani, son of Ili-nada, seal of Ennum-Assur, son of <gap>, seal of Amur-Assur, son of Isar-kitti-Assur, seal of Kunnanaya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 GÚ 10 ma-na URUDU ší-kam i-na a-ba-an ma-tim i-ṣé-er ku-na-na-a ku-li-a DUMU a-lá-bi₄-im i-šu iš-tù ITU.KAM qá-ra-a-tim
target: 2 talents 10 minas of copper, by the local weight standard, Kunnanaya owes to Kuliya, son of Ali-abum. Reckoning from month VIII.

source: translate Akkadian to English: li-mu-um a-šùr-SIPA DUMU ì-lí-e-mu-qí ki-ma a-wa-at kà-ri-im 1.5 ma-na.TA a-na 1 GÚ-tim i-na ITU.KAM ṣí-ib-tám ú-ṣa-áb
target: eponymy of Assur-re'i, son of Ili-emuqi, in conformity with the rule of the karum, he will add an interest of 1.5 mina per talent per month.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ÌR a-bi₄-ì-lí ù ri-ki-sú a-na 3.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR SAḪAR.BA ku-a-li DUMU a-lá-bi₄-im iš-tí {d}UTU
target: The slave Abi-ili with his fetter, Kuliya, son of Ali-abum, bought from Samas-dugul, son of Ibni-Adad for 3.5 shekels of 'dust silver'.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 50 NINDA i li-bi₄ a-lá-ḫi-nim ša-áp-li-im ša tù-um-li-a ki-ma NINDA 1 DUG ar-ša-tim i-da-nam
target: 50 loaves of bread owed by the lower miller of Tumliya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-la-ḫu-um a-šur-re-ṣí en-nam-a-šùr ú da-dí-a-ma a-na e-la-ma qí-bi₄-ma
target: Thus Ali-ahum, Aššur-rēṣī, Ennam-Aššur, and Dadiya say to Elamma:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 24.3333 ma-na 4 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ŠÀ 1 ma-na 1 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ni-is-ḫa-tim ni-di-in
target: 24 minas 24? shekels of silver, thereof we gave 61 shekels of silver as excise;

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-tí KÙ.BABBAR-pí-kà 23.3333 ma-na 4 GÍN
target: the rest of your silver is 23! minas and 24 shekels.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na 3 GÍN KÙ.GI a-šùr-DU₁₀ ub-lam
target: 33 shekels of gold Aššur-ṭāb brought us,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ 1.3333 GÍN 7.5 ŠE ni-is-ḫa-tim ni-dí-in
target: thereof we gave as excise 1 3 / 8 shekel.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.3333 GÍN i-na sà-na-qí-ni im-ṭí
target: It was 0.3333 shekel less when we checked it,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-ti KÙ.GI 0.5 ma-na 1.3333 GÍN
target: (so) the rest of the gold is 31.3333 shekels,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5.25 GÍN.TA KÙ.BABBAR-áp-šu 2.6666 ma-na 5 GÍN
target: its equivalent in silver at 1: 5 1 / 4 is 2 3 / 4 minas.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠU.NÍGIN KÙ.BABBAR-áp-kà ù ší-im KÙ.GI 26 ma-na 9 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR
target: Total of your silver, including the yield of the gold: 26 minas 9 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 GÚ 20 ma-na 8 GÍN AN.NA ku-nu-ku
target: 4 talents 20 minas 8 shekels of tin under seals,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 30 ma-na AN.NA-ak qá-tim
target: 30 minas hand tin,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 17.25 GÍN.TA KÙ.BABBAR-áp-šu 16.6666 ma-na 9 GÍN
target: at 17 1 / 4 shekels per (shekel of silver), its (price in) silver, 16 minas 49 shekels;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 36 TÚG ku-ta-nu 5.8333 GÍN.TA
target: 36 tiles at 5.8333 shekels apiece,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR-šu-nu
target: their (price in) silver 3.5 minas;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 33 šu-ru-tum qá-de₈ ša li-wi-tim
target: 33 dark textiles including those for wrapping,

target: From Ikūn-pīya to Ennam-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma a-ni-ša-am ḫa-ra-kà al-kam-ma lu ni-iz-ku
target: If your journey takes you here, then come and let us clear accounts.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma sà-aḫ-ra-tí tí-ir-ta-kà li-li-kam
target: If you are delayed, then send word.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-mì-ša-am ḫa-ra-ni
target: My journey will take me there.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma i-ku-pì-a-ma a-na en-nam-a-šur qí-bi-ma
target: From Ikūn-pīya to Ennam-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: na-áš-pár-tám ša a-šur-ma-lik gu₅-ba-áb-tám ša ma-ḫu-ra-at É ku-ra ša-áš-me-ma
target: Make the priestess who lives opposite Kura's house hear the missive from Aššur-malik;

source: translate Akkadian to English: ta-as-kà-ri-nam lu ta-dí-na-ší-ma
target: also, do give her the boxwood log;

source: translate Akkadian to English: a ma-lá ta-aḫ-sí-is-tám a-dí-na-ku-ni uq-ru-a-tim e-pu-uš-ma
target: since I gave you a memorandum, make the jewelry and

source: translate Akkadian to English: na-áš-pár-tum ša a-we-lim lu ša É ub-ri-ni i-li-kam a-ma-kam ša-il₅-ma šé-bi₄-lam
target: ask there whether the missive from the man or from our guest-house has come, and send it to me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫi a-ta a tí-ir-tí-a i-ḫi-id
target: My dear brother, pay heed to my message.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ša-lim-a-šùr qí-bi-ma um-ma en-um-a-šur-ma
target: To Šalim-Aššur from Ennam-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na me-eḫ-ri-im ša ba-a-ba-tí-kà ša té-zi-ba-ni 5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR iš-tí ì-lí-dan al-qé
target: From the copy of your outstanding loans that you left with me I have received 5 minas of silver from Ilī-dan;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3.8333 ma-na 5 GÍN iš-tí a-mur-{d}UTU 1 0.5 ma-na ša da-dí-a al-qé
target: I received 3.8333 minas 5 shekels from Amur-Šamaš, 10.5 mina from Dādiya;

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na 4 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša en-na-sú-in ḫa-bu-lá-ku-ni 2.5 ma-na ṣí-ib-tám 0.5 ma-na ma-na-aḫ-tám ŠU.NÍGIN 7 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR iš-tí en-na-sú-in al-qé
target: for 4 minas of silver that Enna-Suen owed to you (I got) 2.5 minas as interest and 0.5 mina as expenditures - in all I received 7 minas of silver from Enna-Suen;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.6666 ma-na 8 GÍN iš-tí i-tur₄-DINGIR 1.3333 ma-na iš-tí ku-ku-wa 7 ma-na iš-tí tù-um-li-a-i-im 1 ma-na iš-tí DUMU uš-ḫa-ta ŠU.NÍGIN KÙ.BABBAR-pí-kà 27.5 ma-na 3 GÍN ša i-na ba-áb-tí-kà al-qé-ú
target: 0.6666 mina 8? shekels owed by Itūr-ilī, 1.5 mina owed by Kukuwa, 5 minas owed by the man of Tumliya, 1 mina owed by Ušhata's son - total of your silver: 27.5 minas 3 shekels that I received from your outstanding loans.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ.BA 10.5 ma-na 5 GÍN a-na É a-zu áš-qúl
target: Thereof I paid 10.5 minas 5 shekels to Azu's firm;

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša 3 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ší-ma-am áš-am-ma TÚG ṣú-ba-tí a-na É kà-ri-im qá-at-kà a-ta-dí-ma 5.5 ma-na 7.5 GÍN É kà-ri-im al-pu-ut-kà
target: I made purchases for 3 minas of silver, and I have deposited textiles on your account in the colony office, and I have booked you for 5.5 minas 7.5 shekels in the colony;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 12 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR da-a-tám ša-li-im-tám ú-ša-áš-qí-lu-kà-ma 5.5 ma-na 7.5 GÍN ú-ṣa-ḫi-ir-ma 6.3333 ma-na 2.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am ú-ša-áš-qí-lu-ni
target: they made you pay 12 minas of silver, the complete fees, and I deducted 5.5 mina 7.5 shekels so they made me pay 6.3333 minas 2.5 shekels of refined silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-šùr-iš-tí-kál i-ku-pí-a ù i-dí-a-bi-im qí-bi-ma um-ma en-um-a-šur-ma a-na i-ku-pí-a qí-bi-ma
target: To Aššuriš-tikal, Ikūn-pīya and Iddin-abum from Ennam-Aššur; specifically to Ikūn-pīya:

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-nu-mì a-na-kam tù-uš-bu 5 GÚ URUDU ma-sí-am SIG₅ ša-bu-ra-am <gap>-ri-<gap> aḫ-bu-lá-kum
target: When you stayed here I lent you 5 talents of washed, good, broken copper <gap>

source: translate Akkadian to English: ki-ma a-bi-a ta-ba-ší-ma ú-lá ú-ba-áš-kà-ma qá-at-kà ú-lá am-ḫa-aṣ
target: You are like a father to me, I shall not put you to shame and I have not refused you anything.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam PUZUR₄-{d}UTU DUMU šu-nu-nu a-na 15 u₄-me-e URUDU ša-qá-li-im tù-ša-zi-za-am-ma a-dí u₄-mì-im a-nim URUDU mì-ma ú-lá iš-qú-lam
target: Here you appointed Puzur-Šamaš son of Šu-Nūnu for me in order to pay the copper in 15 days, but until today he has not paid any copper to me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù i-na ma-ḫa-ar ṣú-ḫa-ri-kà-ma a-dí ḫa-am-ší-šu ú iš-ri-šu iš-tí-šu a ṣí-bi-it-ma ṣú-ḫa-ru-kà i-da-gu₅-lu
target: Also, in the presence of your own servants I have quarrelled with him five or ten times, and your servants observe this.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-na-ku-ma URUDU PUZUR₄-{d}UTU lu-ša-áš-qí-il₅-ma gi-mì-lam i-ṣé-er a-wi-LAM lá-áš-ku-un-ma a ša a-na-aḫ-tí ša 2 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a-da-nu-šu-ni ú a-ni-um lu gi₅-mì-lam šu-a-tí-ma li-bu-šu-ma lu i-de₈
target: I said: Let Puzur-Šamaš have the copper paid so I can do the man a favour, and since I shall give him the earnings from 2 minas of silver may this man indeed know about this favour!

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam PUZUR₄-{d}UTU ú-ni-ḫa-ni-ma a-na kà-ri-im ir-dí-a-ni-ma KÙ.BABBAR 5 GÍN uš-ta-ag-me-ra-ni-ma ṭup-pá-am ša ší-bi-a al-té-qé
target: Puzur-Šamaš has troubled me here, led me to the colony and put me to an expense of at least 5 shekels of silver, so I got hold of a tablet with my witnesses.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša i-na lá i-dí-im šu-um-kà IGI ṣa-ḫe-er GAL a-<gap>
target: stating that without reason he spoke your name <gap> before the plenary assembly.

source: translate Akkadian to English: dan-a-šùr DUMU ša-lim-ma-ḫi-im ANŠE ša ba-ri-ni ša-lim-a-šùr il₅-qé
target: Dan-Aššur son of Šalim-ahum, Šalim-Aššur has taken a donkey owned by us both.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.3333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR i ra-mì-ni-šu
target: He has 0.3333 mina of silver of his own funds.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na ku-ta-ni ša šu-IŠTAR DUMU da-da-nim ir-dí-a-ni
target: Of the that Šu-Ištar son of Dadānum conducted here.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 6 ku-ta-ni ki-ma šu a-tí pu-šu-ki-in i-dí-nam
target: Pūšu-kēn has given me 6 on his own.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-du-da ú šu-IŠTAR ú-šé-bi₄-il₅
target: Aduda and Šu-Ištar sent them.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ili₅-ba-ni DUMU i-a-a ù a-bu-ša-lim ÌR i-na bu-ru-uš-ḫa-dim a-na ni-kà-sí ša-sá-im iṣ-bu-tù-ni-a-tí-ma
target: Ilī-bāni son of Yaya and the slave Abu-šalim seized us in Burušhaddum in order to settle accounts.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ì-lí-ba-ni-ma a-na-ku ki-ma ša-lim-a-šùr al-kam i-na IGI a-we-li a-ni-ú-tim ší-sí ṭup-pí-šu-nu ša maš-kà-na-tim ma-aḫ-ri-ni iš-ku-nu-ma
target: Ilī-bāni said: I act on behalf of Šalim-Aššur. Come on, settle with these men as witnesses. They placed their tablets concerning deposits before us.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ili₅-ba-ni-ma lu-qú-ut 5 GÚ KÙ.BABBAR ù e-li-iš a-we-lam tù-ús-ta-ri-ir ù i-na a-wa-tí-ma a-ni-tim pá-ni ṣa-al-mu-tim a-we-lam tù-uš-ta-ar-ší
target: Ilī-bāni said: You cheated the boss for goods worth 5 talents of silver or more. Consequently, on this very matter you have made the boss very angry.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ni-kà-sí i-na ma-aḫ-ri-ni im-šu-ḫu-ma um-ma ili₅-ba-ni-ma ma-lá-ma li-bi-kà ší-ta-kà-an
target: They took away the accounts in our presence, and Ilī-bāni said: Submit whatever you have in your possession.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-bu-ša-lim-ma a-lá-an 40 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR mì-ma i-na li-bi-a ù-lá i-ší-tám
target: Abu-šalim answered: Apart from 40 minas of silver there is nothing left in my possession.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ili₅-ba-ni-ma a-ma i-na ṭup-pí-šu ša 5 GÚ KÙ.BABBAR ù e-li-iš la lá-pu-ta-kum
target: Ilī-bāni said: Now, were goods worth 5 talents of silver or more not booked for you in his tablet?

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-bu-ša-lim i-ṣú-ra-tum ù-šé-ṣí-a-ma um-ma a-bu-ša-lim-ma a-ma lá i-ṣú-ra-tù-šu ša É a-am-ku-a-i-tim a-ḫa-at ru-ba-im ša-ša-sá-ma-i-im ù tí-ra-at e-kál-lim a-na-kam a-qú-ul-ší-na le-qé-a-ma a-tù-nu-ma ša-dí-na
target: Abu-šalim produced -documents and said: Here, are they not his -documents from the house of the queen of Amkuwa, the sister of the king of Šašasama? Also, I have listened to the orders of the palace here. Take them so that you yourselves can have them sold.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ili₅-ba-ni-ma ša ni-iš a-lim{ki} ta-
target: Ilī-bāni answered: I shall keep in mind what was sworn by the City, that the accounts have been removed and I have not settled anything.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na en-nam-a-šur ù a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi₄-ma um-ma SIG₅-pí-a-šur-ma
target: To Ennam-Aššur and Ali-ahum from Damiq-pī-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-šu-mì DUMU sá-da-a ú-ša-il₅
target: and I questioned (them) concerning the son of Sadaya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na pí-la-aḫ-IŠTAR DUMU a-šùr-SIPA ú a-mur-IŠTAR ni-a-im
target: To Pilah-Ištar son of Aššur-rēʾī and our own Amur-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB en-um-a-šùr DUMU ša-lim-a-šùr
target: Seal of Ennam-Aššur son of Šalim-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na en-nu-um-a-šur qí-bi-ma um-ma a-mur-IŠTAR-ma
target: To Ennam-Aššur from Amur-Ištar:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a ma-lá té-er-tí-kà ša ta-áš-pu-ri-ni a-na-kam ma-ma-ḫi-ir a-dí ma-lá ú ší-ni-šu ú-pá-tí-šu-ma
target: In accordance with your instructions that you sent me I have here once or twice informed Man-mahir,

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-ut-ma me-er-ú a-we-lim ma-da-tù-nu en-nu-um-a-šur le-tí-qá-ma KÙ.BABBAR-ku-nu le-qé-a-ma
target: and he said: You are many sons of the man. Let Ennam-Aššur come, take your silver

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú ṭup-pá-am ša ku-nu-ki-ku-nu a en-na-nim ša ki-ma <gap>-šu-ba-ì-lí ú a-na i-a-tim a-ṭá-ḫi-ma <gap>-kà-ni ma-lá lá a-ša-<gap>
target: and then I shall transfer the tablet with your seals to Ennānum, the representative of <gap> ilī <gap> and to what is mine and <gap>

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.3333 ma-na 3 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ku-nu-ki-a šu-lu-um-ur-dí na-áš-a-kum
target: 23 shekels of silver Šalim-wardī brings to you under my seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i li-bi a-lá-ḫi-im
target: 3 shekels of silver, owed by Ali-ahum;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2.5 ma-na ma-sí-am dam-qá-a
target: 2.5 minas of washed (copper): Damqaya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-bi a-ta be-lí a-ta šu-ma lá ku-a-tí a-bi₄ ša-ni-am ú-lá i-šu
target: My dear father and lord, if it were not for you I would have no father.

source: translate Akkadian to English: et-qám-ma KÙ.BABBAR 1 ma-na bu-lá-tí-kà a-ni qá-at-kà li-iṣ-ba-at
target: Travel here so you personally now may seize hold of every mina of silver of your assets.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 ma-na URUDU a-na ḫa-nu a ší-a-ma-tim a-dí-in
target: I gave 10 minas of copper to hanu for purchases.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam URUDU lá ak-šu-dam
target: I did not obtain copper here.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-ut-ma i du-ur-ḫu-mì-it lá-dí-in
target: He said: "I shall sell it in Durhumit."

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 ma-na URUDU ma-sí-am <gap>
target: 10 minas of washed copper <gap>

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ki-ma 4 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR lá ku-nu-ku ša qí-ip-tim
target: 2 minas of silver instead of 4 minas of unsealed silver from the entrusted goods

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša iš-tí e-<gap> al-qé-ú
target: that I received from E<gap>

source: translate Akkadian to English: e-lá-ma ú ga-al-dá-a ni-kà-sí i-sí-ú-ma lu ú-ku-ul-tù-šu lu ga-am-ru-um ša ḫa-ra-nim mì-ma šu-um-šu ba-tí-iq 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am i-ṣé-er ga-al-dá-a e-lá-ma i-šu
target: Elamma and Galdaya settled accounts with the result that after both travel expenses and his food allowance have been deducted, Elamma (still) has a claim of 1 mina of refined silver on Galdaya, the son of Naku.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù ḫa-mu-uš-tim ša am-ri-a ù i-ku-nim 1.5 GÍN.TA i-na ITU.KAM-im a-na 1 ma-na-im ú-ṣa-áb
target: From the week of Amriya and Ikūnum he will add 1.5 shekel per mina per month.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ITU.KAM ṣí-ip-im li-mu-um a-bi-a DUMU šu-da-ga-an
target: Month VII, year-eponymy of Abiya, son of Šu-Dagan.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim ni-iš a-lim{ki} it-mu-ma IGI ša-lim-{d}IŠKUR IGI lá-qé-pí-im IGI a-mur-{d}UTU IGI e-zé-e
target: We made them swear an oath by the City for these words.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-um ša bé-ú-lá-ti-šu a-ḫa-ma i-ba-ší
target: Separately, there still exists a valid record of his working capital.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB a-de₈-lá-at KIŠIB ir-am-{d}a-šùr DUMU i-dí-ba-ni KIŠIB pí-lá-aḫ-IŠTAR DUMU i-bi₄-sú-a
target: Seal of Adad-ellat, seal of Ir'am-Aššur, son of Idi-bāni, seal of Pilah-Ištar, son of Ibisua,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša 12 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-al-DU₁₀ a-na kur-ub-sú-in ḫa-bu-lu-ma en-na-sú-in qá-ta-tù-ni
target: to the effect that Āl-ṭāb owes 12 shekels of silver to Kurub-Suen and Ennam-Suen is guarantor

source: translate Akkadian to English: 12 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ki-ma <gap>
target: The 12 shekels of silver instead of <gap>

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma i-ku-pí-a dan-a-šùr ša-lim-wa-ar-du ù šu-nu-nu-ma a-na en-nam-a-šùr qí-bí-ma 50 TÚG (ḪI)ku-ta-ni 25 ma-na AN.NA 0.3333 ma-na 0.6666 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR 2 ANŠE ṣa-lá-mu mì-ma a-nim tù-šé-bi₄-lam
target: From Ikūn-pīya, Dan-Aššur, Šalim-wardī and Šu-Nūnu to Ennam-Aššur: 50 -textiles, 25 minas of tin, 0.3333 mina 0.6666 shekel of silver, 2 black donkeys - all this you sent.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ.BA 25 ku-ta-nu 13 ma-na.TA ta-ad-nu 25 ku-ta-nu 12 ma-na.TA ta-ad-nu 18 ma-na AN.NA 10 ma-na.TA 4 ma-na LÁ 15 GÍN 9 ma-na.TA ta-dí-in
target: Thereof 25 were sold at 13 minas each, 25 were sold at 12 minas each, 18 minas of tin at 10 minas each, 4 minas less 15 shekels at 9 minas each were sold.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-tí AN.NA-ki-kà 3 ma-na 15 GÍN na-áš-ú-ni-kum
target: the rest of your tin, 3 minas 15 shekels, they bring to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 55 ma-na ší-im ANŠE.ḪI-kà 31 ma-na ší-im KÙ.BABBAR ša li-bi₄ dan-a-šùr
target: 55 minas was the price of your donkeys, 31 minas the price of the silver in Dan-Aššur's possession.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠU.NÍGIN URUDU-i-kà 20 GÚ 24.6666 ma-na URUDU ma-sí-um
target: the total of your copper: 15 talents 24.6666 minas of washed copper.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ.BA 6 GÚ šu-nu-nu i pá-ni-tim ub-lá-kum
target: Thereof Šu-Nūnu earlier brought you 6 talents.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 8 GÚ URUDU ma-sí-am ša-lim-wa-ar-dí ù šu-nu-nu ku-nu-ki-ni na-áš-ú-ni-kum
target: Šalim-wardī and Šu-Nūnu bring you 8 talents of washed copper under our seals.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 18 ma-na SIG₅ ša-du-a-at URUDU-i-kà ù ANŠE.ḪI-kà ni-iš-qúl
target: 18 minas good copper we paid as the transport tariff on your copper and your donkeys.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 GÚ-tum 1 ma-na.TA i-na ša-bu-ri-im im-ṭí
target: 1 mina per talent was lost during the breaking up.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2.5 ma-na URUDU SIG₅ i li-bi₄ URUDU-i-kà ni-dí a-na ta-ší-a-at URUDU ša áb-ša-lim ù dan-a-šùr a-na áb-ša-lim ni-dí-in
target: 2.5 minas of good copper we deposited out of your copper and gave to Ab-šalim for the carriage of Ab-šalim's and Dan-Aššur's copper.

source: translate Akkadian to English: gám-ra-am ù ú-ku-ul-tám mì-ma ú-lá ni-dí-šu-nu-tí
target: We did not give them anything for expenses and food.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi-ma um-ma a-mur-IŠTAR-ma
target: To Ali-ahum from Amur-Ištar:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí ḫu-ma ša áš-pu-ra-ku-ni u₄-mu-a ITU.1.KAM a-na a-wa-tim ta-da-nim a-ḫu-ru-ú ú me-eḫ-ra-am ša ší-bi-a ta-áš-ta-na-pá-ra-am
target: Concerning huma about whom I wrote to you, my terms for starting a legal case have one month to run, but you keep sending me a copy of my witnessed tablet.

source: translate Akkadian to English: tí-ir-ta-kà i-na ša-am-ší na-áš-pé-er-tí ta-ša-me-ú tí-ir-ta-kà li-li-kam
target: Your message should - on the very day you hear my missive - your message should come.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-zu u₄-ma-kál lá i-sà-ḫu-ur tí-ir-ta-kà li-li-kam
target: Azu must not be delayed a single day! - your message should come!

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma a-wa-tim ta-da-na-am lá-dí-in
target: If it is a matter of engaging in a legal case, I shall do it!

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma É-tám kà-ba-sà-am lá-ak-bu-us
target: If it is a matter of remitting the house, I shall do it!

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-wa-tim a-ni-na i-de₈
target: Annina knows the matter.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 GÚ 30 ma-na URUDU ṣa-lá-ma-am É a-šur-iš-tí-kál DUMU ḫi-na-a na-dí
target: 4 talents 30 minas of black copper is deposited in the house of Aššuruš-tikal son of hinnaya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: té-i-ra-tum ša ú-kà-lu-ma té-er-ta-kà li-li-kam
target: Send me word about the orders that he holds.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na 6 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am i-ṣé-er e-la-ma im-dí-DINGIR i-šu ITU.KAM kán-wár-ta li-mu-um šu-da-a DUMU en-na-nim
target: 1 mina 6 shekels of refined silver Elamma owes to Imdī-ilim, month IX eponymy of Šudāya, son of Ennānum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma e-la-ma-ma 1 ma-na 6 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR-ap-kà a-na a-mur-IŠTAR ub-lu-nim
target: Elamma declared: One has brought the 1 mina 6 shekels, your silver, to Amur-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na im-dí-lim a-mur-IŠTAR e-la-ma ú-kà-an-ma šu-ma i-na li-bi₄ a-mur-IŠTAR KÙ.BABBAR uk-ta-in KÙ.BABBAR ù ṣí-ba-tí-šu a-mur-IŠTAR a-na im-dí-lim i-ša-qal
target: Elamma will confirm Amur-Ištar('s liability) for Imdī-ilum and if he has confirmed that Amur-Ištar has the silver in his possession, Amur-Ištar shall pay the silver and the interest on it to Imdī-ilum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma e-la-ma a-na im-dí-lim a-mur-IŠTAR la uk-ta-in KÙ.BABBAR ù ṣí-ba-tí-šu e-la-ma a-na im-dí-lim i-ša-qal
target: If Elamma fails to confirm Amur-Ištar('s liability) for Imdī-ilum, Elamma will pay the silver and the interest on it to Imdī-ilum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-mur-{d}UTU IGI la-qé-pí-im
target: In the presence of Amur-Šamaš, of Lā-qēpum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ku-li-a DUMU a-lá-bi₄-im DUB i-dí-na-bi₄-im DUMU šu-IŠTAR GUDU₄ ša IŠTAR a-na ku-li-a qí-bi-ma um-ma i-dí-na-bu-um-ma
target: To Kuliya, son of Ali-abum, tablet of Iddin-abum, son of Šu-Ištar, priest of Ištar. Say to Kuliya. Thus says Iddin-abum:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša ÌR ṣú-ḫa-ri-ni ú e-nu-mì-ili₅ a-na PÚZUR-a-šur DUMU a-ḫu-wa-qar i-ḫi-ib-lu-ni
target: 10 shekels of silver for which Urdum, our servant, and Ennum-ilī had become indebted to Puzur-Aššur, son of Ahu-waqar -

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma na-áš-pè-er-tí ša a-ta-a ša ta-sí-ú-ma KÙ.BABBAR ta-al-qé-ú a-ta-áb-lá-ku-um na-áš-pè-er-tám ša ku-nu-ki-a tù-ša-ra-am
target: if I deliver to you a letter of Ataya, stating that you have settled accounts and have collected that silver, will you then release to me the letter with my seal?

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ku-li-a-ma šu-ma na-áš-pè-er-tám lá ta-ta-áb-lam 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ta-ša-qá-lam
target: Kuliya answered: "If you do not deliver to me that letter you shall pay me 10 shekels of silver."

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am ú-zu-bi-iš-kum DUMU šu-a-nim i-na ší-im SÍG.ḪI.A ša ú-ší-na-lam il₅-qé
target: Uzub-iškum son of Šu-Anum has received 5 minas of refined silver from the proceeds of Ušinalam's wool.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI i-dí-ku-bi IGI a-lá-bi-im DUMU šu-a-šùr IGI en-na-sú-in
target: Witnessed by Iddin-Kūbī, by Ali-abum son of Šu-Aššur, by Enna-Suen.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ir-ma-a-šur ù {d}UTU-ba-ni a-na ir-ma-a-šur qí-bi-ma um-ma en-nam-a-šur-ma
target: To Ir'am-Aššur and Šamaš-bāni, and in particular to Ir'am-Aššur, say as follows, thus Ennam-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 ma-na LÁ 3 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i pá-ni-tim iš-tù ḫa-tim iš-tí šu-sú-en₆ ú-šé-bi-lá-ku-ma
target: Previously I sent you 2 minas 57 shekels of silver from hattum with Šu-Suen.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-na-ku-ma a-bi šu-ut i-lá-ak-ma iš-tù a-lim{ki} AN.NA 10 ma-na ú-šé-ba-lá-ma li-ba-am i-da-nam
target: I thought: 'He is my father, he will go and send me from the City at least 10 minas of tin and thereby encourage me.'

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù KÙ.BABBAR 1 GÍN e-li-a-ma KÙ.BABBAR a-na DAM.GÀR-ri-a a-na ša ṭup-pì-a ú-šé-ba-al
target: And when some silver becomes available for me I will then be able to send silver to my creditor on the basis of my tablet'.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ta um-ma a-ta-ma KÙ.BABBAR a-ḫa-at-kà ta-aḫ-ša-aḫ-ma a-na ša ṭup-pì-kà a-tí-dí-ší-im
target: But you said: 'Your sister needed the silver, so I gave it to her on the basis of your tablet'.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ur-ki-tim i ba-áb ḫa-ra-ni-kà um-ma a-ta-ma KÙ.BABBAR 1 GÍN i-šu qá-tí-kà dí-na-ma AN.NA 10 ma-na lá-áš-a-ma lu-šé-bi₄-lá-ku-ma KÙ.BABBAR li-li-a-ku-ma li-ba-am ri-ší
target: Later, when you were about to set out on a journey, you said: 'Give me every single shekel of silver you have available then I will buy for you and send you tin, 10 minas, so that you can obtain silver and gather courage!'

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-ta-ma ù a-na TÚG.ḪI-tí-a a-na-aḫ-ma a-šar ša-la-ḫi-im šu-lu-ùḫ-šu-nu TÚG.ḪI-tù lá i-ḫa-li-qú
target: You also said: 'You must also exert yourself for my textiles and salvage them as well as you can. The textiles must not get lost!'

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-nu-mì ta-tal-ku lá tí-dí-e ki-ma ḫa-ra-na-tum ù É.GAL-lu da-nu-ni
target: When you left, did you not know that the roads and the palaces were causing difficulties?

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí TÚG.ḪI.A áš-lu-ḫu ITU.7.KAM i-na li-bi ma-tim as-ḫu-ur
target: Until I had salvaged the textiles I stayed seven months in the interior.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 TÚG.ḪI.A a gám-ri-im ša ḫa-ra-nim i-gi₅-im-ru-ma TÚG.
target: Three textiles were spent for the expenses of the trip, but I managed to ship the textiles under Kulumaya's seals to your representatives.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-IŠTAR ù en-na-sú-in iṣ-bu-tù-ni-a-tí-ma
target: Šu-Ištar and Ennam-Suen seized us.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma en-na-sú-in-ma KÙ ša qá-ta-at a-al-DU₁₀ a-šu-mì ki-li-ri-e ni-il₅-tap-tù KÙ šu-qú-ul
target: Ennam-Suen said: The silver for which we had ourselves registered as guarantors of Al-ṭāb concerning the Kilirians, pay that silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-IŠTAR-ma a-na 6 ITU.KAM ki-ma a-wa-at a-li-a a-lá-kam-ma a-wa-tám a-dá-na-kum
target: Šu-Ištar answered: Within 6 months, in accordance with the ruling of my city, I will come and render account to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma en-na-sú-in-ma šu-ma a-na 6 ITU.KAM a-na ta-wi-ni-a lá ta-lá-kam-ma a-wa-tám lá ta-dí-nam ba-lum dí-nim ba-lúm ma-mì-tim KÙ ú ṣí-ba-tí-šu lá ta-dá-nam
target: Ennam-Suen said: If you do not come to Tawiniya within 6 months and do not render account to me, will you then not give me the silver and its interest without resorting to legal action or oath?

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-IŠTAR-ma lá-dí-na-kum
target: Šu-Ištar answered: I will give it to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um ta-wi-ni-a i-dí-ni-a-tí-ma IGI GÍR ša a-šur ṭup-pá-am a-ni-am ni-dí-in
target: For these words the Tawiniya colony made us appear in court and before Aššur's dagger we gave this tablet.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI IŠTAR-ba-ni IGI ší-ma-ta-nim IGI zu-NI-a ma-num-ba-lúm-a-šur DUMU du-ni-a ra-bu-ni
target: Witnessed by Ištar-bāni, by Šimatānum, by Zul / niya; Mannum-balum-Aššur, son of Dunniya, was our fourth man.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB i-dí-a-šur DUMU ì-lí-dan KIŠIB a-šur-SIPA DUMU i-dí-da KIŠIB e-lá-ma DUMU i-dí-sú-en₆ KIŠIB PUZUR₄.IŠTAR DUMU a-šur-ma-lik
target: Seal of Iddin-Aššur, son of Ilī-dān, seal of Aššur-rē'ī, son of Idida, seal of Elamma, son of Iddin-Suen, seal of Puzur-Ištar, son of Aššur-mālik.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-ma-at i-dí-a-šur DUMU ì-lí-dan
target: Testament of Iddin-Aššur, son of Ilī-dān.

source: translate Akkadian to English: be-el ší-ma-tí-a a-na ba-áb DINGIR lá ú-šé-ru-du
target: They shall not lead my testamentary executors down to the Gate of the God.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša ú-šé-ru-du 10 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR i-ša-qal
target: Who does lead them down shall pay 10 minas of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na 3 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ší-im a-ma-tim i-na li-bi <gap>-an i-na tù-wa-ri-šu KÙ.BABBAR i-ša-qal
target: 0.5 mina 3 shekels of silver, the price of slave-girls, is owed by <gap>an.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na 1-ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša a-na a-lim{ki} a ší-a-ma-tim be-lá-num ú-šé-bi-lá-ni
target: From the 1 mina of silver which I had Bēlānum bring to the City for making purchases,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ.BA 0.6666 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a-na ik-ri-bi₄-a ša a-šur i-lá-ak
target: 0.6666 mina silver thereof will go to my belonging to Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-šur-du-ri DUMU PUZUR₄.IŠTAR
target: Before Aššur-dūrī, son of Puzur-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi₄-ma um-ma MAN-a-šur-ma
target: To Ali-ahum from Puzur-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 7 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ku-lu-ma-a li-dí-na-ku-um
target: Kulumaya should give you 7 shekels of silver;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 12 GÍN AN.NA šu-be-lúm DUMU ku-ta-a li-dí-na-ku-um
target: Šu-Bēlum son of Kutaya should give you 12 shekels of tin;
