source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ú 2 GÍN AN.NA šu-sú-in DUB.SAR li-dí-na-kum
target: Šu-Suen, the scribe, should give you 1 shekel of silver and 2 shekels of tin;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 19 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR lá-qé-ep DUMU MAN.SA.TU li-dí-na-kum
target: Lā-qēp son of Puzur-šadūʾe should give you 19 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša 1 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR šé-né-en ša sí-ni-iš-tim
target: Buy for 1 shekel of silver women's shoes,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša 1 GÍN ša ṣú-ùḫ-ri-im ša-ma-ma šé-bi₄-lam
target: for 1 shekel shoes for children and send them.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šé-né-en a-na šé-pì-a šé-bi₄-lam
target: Send me shoes for my own feet.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-tí KÙ.BABBAR šé-bi₄-lam
target: Send the rest of the silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 TÚG SIG₅ ku-lu-ma-a na-áš-a-kum ší-im-šu šé-bi₄-lam
target: Kulumaya brings you 1 fine textile; send me the proceeds from it.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-šùr-gi-im-lí-ma a-na a-zu-ú iš-ta-aḫ-šu ú ni-wa-la qí-bi₄-ma
target: From Aššur-gimlī to Azu, Ištahšu and Niwala:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 GÍN AN.NA a-lu-wa na-áš-a-ku-nu-tí
target: Aluwa brings you 10 shekels of tin.

source: translate Akkadian to English: na-aḫ-lá-áp-tám ša ṣú-uḫ-ri-im a-mur-a-šur ub-lá-ku-nu-tí
target: Amur-Aššur brought you a children's dress.

source: translate Akkadian to English: tí-ir-tí ma-lá ú 2 ší-ni-šu i-li-kà-ku-nu-tí
target: I sent you word once or twice,

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-tù-nu šu-lu-um-ku-nu ma-tí-ma lá i-li-<gap>-kam
target: (but) (as for?) you, no greeting whatever came from you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú šu-ma ša-ḫi-re-en lá tù-šé-lá-nim tí-ir-ta-ak-nu-ma li-li-kam
target: However, send me word if you do not bring the boots up here.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tí a-li-ki-im pá-ni-im-ma ki-ma ṭup-pá-am ta-áš-me-a-ni tí-ir-ta-ak-nu li-li-kam
target: Send me word with the very first transport, as soon as you have heard the letter.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú ší-né-en <gap> a-na ma-ḫa-tí-a šé-bi₄-lá-nim
target: Also, send me shoes <gap> for my aunt.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi-ma um-ma PUZUR₄-a-šur-ma áš-pu-ra-ku a-dí ma-lá ù ší-ni-šu um-ma a-na-ku-ma 0.8333 ma-na 1 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-dí-da li-dí-na-ku
target: To Ali-ahum from Puzur-Aššur: I have written to you both once and twice saying: Adida should give you 0.8333 mina 1 shekel of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na ma-nu-ba 0.3333 ma-na 1 GÍN a-lá-ḫu-um ša É pá-na-kà KÙ.BABBAR i-dí-nu-ni-ku lá i-dí-nu-ni-ku tí-ir-ta-kà ma-tí-ma lá i-li-kam
target: As to 0.5 mina from Manuba, 0.3333 mina 1 shekel from Ali-ahum of Panaka's firm, no message ever came from you as to whether or not they gave it to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫi a-ta KÙ.BABBAR ša-áš-qí-il₅-šu-nu-ma ù tí-ir-ta-kà li-li-kam
target: My dear brother, make them pay the silver and send me word.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3.3333 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-šur-i-dí DUMU a-mur-a-šur ḫa-bu-lam e-ri-šu-ma pí-ri-kà-nam a-na am-tim ša-a-am
target: Aššur-idī son of Amur-Aššur owes me 3.3333 shekels of silver; demand it from him, and buy a for the maid.

source: translate Akkadian to English: tí-sà-ba-am ṣú-ba-sà a-zu a-na li-ta-áb-ší-a lu-ub-lam mì-šál sà-ar-dam a-zu lu-ub-lam
target: Azu should bring her -textile for my dress. Azu should bring half (a jar?) of olives.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-ku-pí-a a-na i-dí-a-šur iṣ-ba-at-ni-a-tí-ma
target: Ikūn-pīya seized us against Iddin-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma i-ku-pì-a-ma a-na i-dí-a-šùr-ma
target: Ikūn-pīya said to Iddin-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 40 GÚ URUDU SIG₅ ša um-me-a-nu i li-bi₄-kà iṣ-bu-tù-ni
target: Concerning the 40 talents of good copper that the investors seized in your possession,

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-ku a-ḫu-a ù É a-bi₄-a ú-lá ni-tù-ra-kum
target: neither I nor my brother nor my paternal house will raise further claim against you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um dur₄-ḫu-mì-it ni-dí-in
target: The Durhumit colony gave us for these proceedings, and we gave our testimony before Aššur's dagger.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI ba-ba-zu-a IGI DU₁₀-ṣí-lá-a-šur IGI šu-IŠTAR
target: Witnessed by Babazua, Ṭāb-ṣill-Aššur, by Šu-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša 5 ḫa-me-eš qá-ta-tim ša i-tur₄-DINGIR ù en-na-nim 13 GÚ.TA SÍG 65 GÚ SÍG.ḪI.A ù 56 maš-ku-TA ŠU.NÍGIN 2 me-at 80 maš-ku
target: Of the five shares belonging to Itūr-ilī and Ennānum: 13 talents of wool each, (giving) 65 talents of wool; and 56 fleeces each share - in all: 280 fleeces.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ma a-nim am-ḫu-ur
target: I received all this.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ 1 GÚ SÍG.ḪI.A a-na i-tur₄-DINGIR
target: Thereof: 1 talent of wool for Itūr-ilī;

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma i-ku-pí-a-ma a-na PUZUR₄-ša-du-e qí-bi-ma
target: From Ikūn-pīya to Puzur-šadue:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 ku-ta-ni ša a-dí-na-ku-ni a ší-mì-im dí-in-šu-nu-ma i-na ší-mì-šu-nu 6 ma-na URUDU SIG₅ ù 2 ma-na ni-ga-li ša-a-ma
target: As to the 2 I gave you, sell them and buy 6 minas of good copper and 2 minas of sickles for the proceeds from them.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú ri-iḫ-tí KÙ.BABBAR tí-ri kà-in-ma
target: and then confirm the -silver for the rest.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tí a-li-ki-im pá-nim-ma ṣú-ḫa-ra-am ù KÙ.BABBAR a-na DUMU um-me-a-nim pì-qí-id-ma lu-ub-lam
target: and with the very first caravan you should entrust a servant and the silver to an affiliated trader so he may bring it.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša 0.3333 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR šu-um-ki ù du-uk-li ša-a-ma šé-bi₄-lam
target: Buy onions and for 0.3333 shekel of silver and send it to me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫi a-ta a-na ša-zu-úz-tí-a i-ḫi-id
target: My dear brother, pay attention to my agent!

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù me-eḫ-ra-at ša-áp-ra-tim ša na-ad-a-ni KÙ.BABBAR en-um-a-šùr DUMU šál-ma-a-šùr e-ri-iš-ma li-dí-na-ku-ma
target: and then demand in silver from Ennam-Aššur son of Šalim-Aššur what corresponds to the pledges that have been deposited, so he may give it to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR lu ší-im TÚG.ḪI-tí-a lu me-eḫ-ra-at ša-áp-ra-tim ša i-du-nu-ni-ku-ni i pá-ni-kà bi₄-lam
target: and bring personally the silver, both the proceeds in silver from my textiles and the corresponding amount for the pledges that they give to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-pu-tum ki-ma ṭup-pá-am ša sá-ra-tim ta-áš-me-ú tí-ib-a-ma a-tal-kam
target: Urgent, set out and come since you have heard a letter with falsehoods.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 DUG GIG 3.6666 GÍN 15 ŠE áš-qúl
target: For 3 jars of wheat I paid 3 3 / 4 shekels.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 na-ru-uq še-im <gap> 3 GÍN áš-qúl
target: For 1 sack of barley 3 shekels.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.5 GÍN a-na UDU 0.5 GÍN a qá-nu-e ša šu-ru-up-tim áš-qúl
target: 1.5 shekel for a sheep; 0.5 shekel I paid for reed used a fuel.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 GÍN a-na bi-lá-tim e-ṣé áš-qúl
target: 0.5 shekel I paid for a few loads of firewood.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.1666 GÍN a Ì.NUN áš-qúl
target: 1 / 6 shekel I paid for two jars of barley.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.5 GÍN a-na še-im 2 DUG áš-qúl
target: 1 1 / 4 shekel I paid for 1 jar of wheat.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.3333 GÍN a-na e-ṣé bi-lá-tim áš-qúl
target: 0.3333 shekel I paid for a few loads of firewood.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-lu-lá-a ú a-mur-IŠTAR-ma a-na en-um-a-šur qí-bi₄-ma ta-áš-pu-ra-am um-ma a-ta-ma ší-im URUDU KÙ.BABBAR ma-ma-ḫi-ir li-dí-na-ku-nu-tí
target: From Alulaya and Amur-Ištar to Ennam-Aššur: You have written and said: Man-mahir shall give you the silver proceeds from the copper.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma né-nu-ma a-ḫu-um ku-a-tí a-wa-tum ša um-me-an a-bi₄-šu-nu ga-am-ra-at KÙ.BABBAR 10 ma-na ú 20 ma-na šé-bi₄-il₅-šu-ma IGI um-me-an a-bi₄-šu li-iš-ku-un-ma li-ik-bi₄-it
target: We said (to him): "He is a brother for you. The matter of the investors of their father has been cleared up. Send him some 10 or 20 minas of silver so he can place them before his father's investors and he will be respected."

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-ut-ma ú-lá ú-šé-ba-al-šu-um a-dí i-a-tám i-du-nu-ni ni-ip-nu-šu-ma
target: He answered: "I shall not send him anything until they sell my things."

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma né-nu-ma a-ḫu-ni a-ta a-ta ú en-nam-a-šur lá ša a-wa-tim šu-ma lá qé-pu-tum ḫu-sà-ra-am kà-il₅ ú né-nu lu ni-pu-ul-kà
target: We confronted him and said: "Our dear brother, you and Ennam-Aššur are not men of strife. If the things are not entrusted goods, then keep the lapis lazuli. We shall then answer for you."

source: translate Akkadian to English: a ma-lá DUMU-e šál-ma-a-šur ta-šé-e-ú i ba-áb ḫa-ra-nim nu-qí-ip-ma
target: We guaranteed when the journey began for as much as you are suing Šalim-Aššur's sons for."

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-ut-ma KÙ.BABBAR 10 ma-na ú-šé-ba-al
target: So he said: "I shall send some 10 minas."

source: translate Akkadian to English: wa-ar-ki-tám na-áš-pè-er-tum ša a-ḫi-kà i-li-kà-ma um-ma šu-ut-ma i-a-tí a-na a-wa-tim i-tù-ra-am
target: Later your brother's missive arrived, in which he said: "It is against me he has raised claim."

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú-lá ší-ba-am a-na URUDU ú ḫu-sà-ri-im mì-ma li-ba-kà lá i-pá-ri-id
target: (He has) no witness. Do not in any way worry about the copper and the lapis lazuli.

source: translate Akkadian to English: al-kà-ma a-ta ú ma-ma-ḫi-ir na-me-ra-ma za-ku-sà ší-im AN.NA-kà 2 ma-na 22.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR šé-lu-um-ar-dí ú
target: Come so you and Man-mahir may meet and Šalim-wardī and Šēp-Ištar bring the final account for the proceeds from your tin, 2 minas 22.5 shekels of silver to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.6666 ma-na 6 GÍN KI šu-nu-nu DUMU pá-zu-zu
target: 0.6666 mina 6 shekels owed by Šu-Nūnu son of Pazuzu.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IŠTAR-lá-ma-sí ší-im-ta-ša ta-ší-im-ma i-na 1 ma-na LÁ 3 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša i-ba-ší-ú-ni 0.5 ma-na 7 GÍN ì-lí-a i-lá-qé
target: Ištar-lamassī made her will as follows: Of the 57 shekels of silver that are available, Iliya will take 37 shekels.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.3333 ma-na {d}NIN.ŠUBUR-ba-ni i-lá-qé
target: Ilabrat-bāni will take 20 shekels.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2.25 GÍN KÙ.GI ù 7.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ù ku-nu-kam a-na DUMU.MÍ-i-a gu₅-ba-ab-tim ú-šé-bu-lu
target: 2 1/4 shekels of gold and 7.5 shekels of silver plus the seal one will send to my daughter who is a priestess.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša É-tù uk-ta-lu 15 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-lá+lá-<gap> É-tù ša uk-ta-lu ṭup-pu-šu-nu a-na ì-lí-a i-za-zu
target: 0.5 mina of silver, for which the house is held (as security), 15 shekels of silver, her house is held (as security), the relevant tablets belong to Iliya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu-qú-tum ša a-bi-šu-nu a-na ki-lá-le-šu-nu i-za-zu
target: The merchandise of their father belongs to the two of them.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ID-<gap> ša-bu-a-at <gap> ta-lá-qé qá-áb-li-tám ša 1 ma-na ì-lí-a i-lá-qé mu-ša-lam ù šu-ga-ri-a-am {d}NIN.ŠUBUR-ba-ni i-lá-qé
target: A bowl weighing 1 mina Iliya will take. The mirror and the Ilabrat-bāni will take.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI ma-ṣí-ì-lí IGI PUZUR₄.IŠTAR IGI en-um-a-šur
target: In the presence of Maṣi-ilī, of Puzur-Ištar, of Ennam-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB a-šur-ták-lá-ku DUMU i-ku-nim KIŠIB ki-nam-a-šùr DUMU ba-ba-lim KIŠIB a-šur-na-da DUMU ḫa-pu-a-lá
target: Seal of Assur-taklaku, son of Ikunum, seal of Kinam-Assur, son of Babalum, seal of Assur-nada, son of Happuala.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša ḫu-bu-ul a-šùr-na-da DUMU ḫa-pu-a-lá 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR SAḪAR.BA i-ṣé-er a-šùr-na-da DAM.GÀR i-šu
target: Of the debt of Assur-nada, son of Happuala, 10 shekels of 'dust silver' Assur-nada owes to the creditor.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ITU.1.KAM ḫu-bu-ur li-mu-um ša qá-té a-bu-ša-lim DUMU ì-lí-a-lim
target: Month VI, eponymy of the successor of Abu-salim, son of Ili-alum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ITU.6.KAM i-ša-qal šu-ma lá iš-qúl 1.5 GÍN.TA KÙ.BABBAR i-na ITU.1.KAM-im ṣí-ib-tám a-na 1 ma-na-im ú-ṣa-áb
target: He will pay within 6 months, if he does not pay he will add 1.5 shekel of silver per month as interest per mina.

source: translate Akkadian to English: wa-bi-il₅ ṭup-pí-im šu-ut DAM.GÀR-ru-um
target: The bearer of this tablet is the creditor.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-kam tù-ur-IŠTAR DUMU zu-ma-<gap> be-lá-a-wa-tim ša-i-il₅-šu
target: Over there Turi-Istar, son of Zuma-x, (is) the litigant, ask him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB ni-mar-IŠTAR DUMU ba-lá
target: Seal of Nimar-Ištar, son of Bala,

source: translate Akkadian to English: <gap> 9.3333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pì-im <gap> i-dí-a-bi-im li-mu-um iš-tí ša-lim-a-ḫi-im il₅-qé-ú
target: 9.3333 minas of refined silver of Iddin-abum the eponym(s) received from Šalim-ahum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù ḫa-mu-uš-tim ša a-ku-za ṣí-ib-tám a-na 1 ma-na-im i ITU.KAM 1.5 GÍN.TA i-dí-a-bu-um ú-ṣa-áb
target: Reckoned from the week of Akuza Iddin-abum must pay interest at the rate 1.5 shekel per mina per month.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi-ma um-ma <gap>
target: To Ali-ahum from <gap>:

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma ta-dá-gal <gap> ni-sà-ri-dam-ma lá ni-ba-ri <gap>
target: If you observe <gap> we shall pack and we shall not stay <gap>

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-ta-ma <gap> KÙ.BABBAR ša-qá-lam₅ lá i-mu-a i-<gap>
target: You said: He will not pay the silver." <gap>

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ša-áš-qí-il₅-šu <gap>
target: Make him pay the silver <gap>

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù za-al-pá i-lá-kà-kum ù-lá a-na-ku-ma e <gap> ur kam
target: he will come to you from Zalpa <gap>"

source: translate Akkadian to English: 15 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR iš-tù ḫa-muš-tim ša <gap> ITU.KAM áb-ša-ra-ni É DAM.GÀR 1 GÍN.TA a ṣí-ib-tim al-qé-ma a-dí-šu-um
target: 15 shekels of silver from the week-eponymy of <gap>, in month V, I borrowed at the house of a merchant at an interest of 1 shekel per (month) and I gave it to him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-ḫa-ma ú-ku-ul-tí ÌR a-šar ú-kà-i-lu-šu-ni a-dí-in
target: 0.5 shekel of silver I gave separately as food for the slave, where he held him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ur-ki-tám ÌR i qá-tí ú-ṣú-ur-pì-a-šur e-bu-ut-ma 3 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na É nu-a-im áš-qúl ÌR ú-šé-ṣí-am
target: Later the slave escaped from Uṣur-pī-Aššur's grip and I paid 3 shekels of silver to the house of the Anatolian (and) I obtained the release of the slave.

source: translate Akkadian to English: GÉME-tám ša ṣú-ḫa-ar-tim ša i-dí-in kà-ri-im ta-da-nam lá qá-bi-ú-ni ú-ṣú-ur-pì-a-šur ú-da-bi-sí-ma it-bi-ma i-lá-ak
target: The female slave belonging to the girl, whose sale was forbidden by a verdict of the colony, Uṣur-ša-Aššur has <gap>, whereupon he got up and went away.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na en-um-a-šùr qí-bi₄-ma um-ma tù-ta-a-ma
target: To Ennam-Aššur from Tutaya:

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-ra-am ša a-na um-ma-za ta-dí-na-ni-ni a-na-ku ù šu-ut i-na ga-bar-tí ḫa-ra-nim ni-mì-ḫi-ir-ma iš-ra-am lá a-dí-šu-um
target: As to the belt you gave me for Ummaza, when I and he met at the conclusion of the journey, I did not give him the belt.

source: translate Akkadian to English: té-er-ta-kà li-li-kam-ma a-šar pá-nu-im pá-ni-ší
target: Send me a word and dispose of it wherever possible.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫi a-ta ar-ša-tim kà-ar-pá-at a-na qá-tí-im dí-in
target: My dear brother, give a pot of wheat to dispose over.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na PUZUR₄-a-na a-lá-ḫi-im ù ma-nu-ki-a-šur a-na a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi-ma um-ma zu-ku-a-ma
target: To Puzur-Anna, Ali-ahum and Mannum-kī-Aššur; specifically to Ali-ahum from Zukuwa:

source: translate Akkadian to English: ta-áš-pu-ra-am um-ma a-ta-ma KÙ.BABBAR ša li-bi-kà šé-bi-lam
target: You have written, saying: Send me the silver in your possession.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na 0.75 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ŠÀ.BA 0.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na qá-tí ì-lí-áš-ra-ni a-dí-in
target: 1 mina less 1 / 4 shekel of silver, of which I gave 0.5 shekel silver to Ilī-ašrannī's expenses,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ku-nu-ki-a a-lá-ḫu-um DUMU a-šur-ba-ni na-áš-a-kum
target: Ali-ahum son of Aššur-bāni brings to you under my seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ta-ma-lá-kam ŠÀ.BA 1.6666 ma-na kà-sà-tum ša KÙ.BABBAR ú 5.5 GÍN i-lu-ú ša KÙ.KI mì-ma a-nim ku-nu-ki-a a-na na-áb-ší-e-em e-zi-ba-kum
target: 1 container in which there was 1.6666 mina, cups of silver plus 5.5 shekels, the golden gods, all this I entrusted to you for safe-keeping under my seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ša-me-ma a-na a-lim{ki} ḫa-ra-kà
target: I hear that you are going to the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na u₄-mì-im ša a-na a-lim{ki} ta-ta-lu-ku ta-ma-lá-kà-am ku-nu-ki-a šu-ma ma-nu-ki-a-šùr sá-ḫe-er a-šar šu-a-tí e-zi-ba
target: The very day you depart you must leave the container under my seal with Mannum-kī-Aššur - if he is delayed;

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma ma-nu-ki-a-šùr lá sá-ḫe-er a-šar ta-dá-ga-lá-ni-ma DUMU um-me-a-nim ke-nim lá ša ša-ḫa-tim wa-áš-bu ta-ma-lá-kà-am ku-nu-ki-a pí-iq-da
target: if Mannum-kī-Aššur is not delayed, then entrust the container under my seal where you observe there lives an affiliated trader who is reliable and not to be nervous about.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫu-ú-a a-tù-nu i-na u₄-mì-im ša a-šar ta-ma-lá-kà-am ku-nu-ki-a té-zi-ba-ni tí-ir-ta-ku-nu li-li-kam-ma úz-ni pé-té-a
target: My dear brothers, the same day send me word about where you have left the container under my seal and inform me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi-ma ṣú-ba-tám ša tù-šé-bi-lá-ni a-dí ma-l
target: To Ali-ahum: I have shown the textile you sent me once or twice.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na DUMU.MÍ ḫi-na-a
target: 5 shekels of silver for hinnāya's daughter.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 GÍN a-na DUMU.MÍ a-šur-ni-šu
target: 10 shekels of silver for Aššur-nišū's daughter.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 GÍN a-na DUMU.MÍ i-dí-na-bi-im DUMU ba-la
target: 3 shekels for the daughter of Iddin-abum, son of Bala.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 GÍN a-na lá-ma-sí ša IŠTAR-pu-úz-ri
target: 1 shekel for Lamassī of Ištar-puzrī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.6666 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR šé-bu-ul-ta-ša a-na lá-ma-sí DUMU.MÍ a-šur-{d}UTU-ši a-dí-in
target: 0.6666 mina of silver, her consignment, I gave to Lamassī, daughter of Aššur-šamšī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5.5 GÍN a-na um-mì-iš-ḫa-ra
target: 5.5 shekels for Ummī-išhara.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 ri-ik-sú ku-nu-ki-a a-na É a-lá-ḫi-im ù zi-kur-ì-lí mì-ma a-nim IGI da-dí-a áp-qí-id
target: Four packets with my seals for the house of Ali-ahum and Zikur-ilī - all this I entrusted (for transport) in the presence of Dadiya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 ri-ik-sí ša šu-be-lim DUMU a-šur-be-el-a-wa-tim na a-ḫa-ti-šu ù DUMU.MÍ-tí-šu IGI a-ta-a áp-qí id
target: Two packets of Šu-Bēlum, son of Aššur-bēl-awātim, for his sister and his daughter I entrusted (for transport) in the presence of Ataya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na i-tur₄-DINGIR qí-bi-ma um-ma ḫa-na-a ú a-bu-mì-lúm-ma
target: To Itūr-ilī from hanaya and Abum-ilum:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 20 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ku-nu-ki-kà ḫa-na-a ub-lam
target: hanaya brought 20 minas of silver under your seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ni-is-ni-iq-šu-ma 5 GÍN im-ṭí
target: We checked it and 5 shekels were missing.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 me-at <gap> TÚG 6.3333 ma-na 7 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR it-bu-lu
target: 129 textiles cost 6.3333 minas 7 shekels of silver;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2.5 GÚ 5 ma-na AN.NA 9.8333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR 15.75 GÍN.TA it-ba-al
target: 2.5 talents 5 minas of tin cost 9.8333 minas of silver at the rate 15 3 / 4 to 1;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 GÚ 10 ma-na AN.NA ku-nu-ki 25 ma-na AN.NA AN.NA-ak qá-tim
target: (this consisted of) 2 talents 10 minas of sealed tin, 25 minas of tin for expenses;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 ANŠE.ḪI.A ṣa-lá-mu 1.3333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR it-bu-lu
target: 4 black donkeys cost 1.3333 mina of silver;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 GÍN ú-nu-ut ANŠE ú ú-ku-ul-ta-áš-nu
target: 10 shekels: the harness for the donkeys plus their fodder;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na 4 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR bé-ú-lá-at 2 kà-ṣa-ri a-mur-IŠTAR il₅-qé
target: Amur-Ištar received 1 mina 4 shekels of silver, the working capitals of 2 harnessors;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 GÍN wa-ṣí-tum
target: 10 shekels: export duty;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.5 GÍN ša sà-i-tim <gap> GÍN 2 a-bar-ni-e
target: 1.5 shekel: of the ; <gap> shekels: 2 -textiles.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR-áp-kà gám-ra-ku-um
target: Your silver has been spent for you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ma a-nim a-mur-IŠTAR i-ra-dí-a-kum
target: All this Amur-Ištar leads to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu-qú-ut-kà ša-al-ma-at-ma iš-tí ma-sú-e ša ú-nu-ut-kà a-bu-kà-ni ša-lim-a-ḫu-um i-li-kam
target: Your merchandise is safe, and Šalim-ahum came with the leaders with whom I dispatched your goods.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na 5 ma-na ṭup-pá-am ša <gap> bu-<gap>-kum ì-lí-dan ù šu-{d}EN.LÍL
target: for 5 minas a tablet of Ilī-dan and Šu-Illil

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša 2.3333 ma-na 4.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR SÍG.ḪI.A 1 ma-na 10 GÍN AN.NA 6 ANŠE ṣa-lá-mu ù ú-nu-sú-nu mì-ma a-nim a-na a-mur-ša-ra-sà a-dí-in-ma
target: Wool worth 2.3333 minas 4.5 shekels of silver, 1 mina 10 shekels of tin, 6 black donkeys and their harness - all this I gave to Amur-šarrassa

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ku-bu-ur-na-at ú-bi-il₅
target: and he brought it to Kuburnat

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-di-da IGI a-ba-ba IGI dam-qá-a
target: Witnessed by Adida, by Ababa, by Damqaya

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i li-bi šu-li-i
target: 3 shekels of silver is in the possession of Šuli

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-la-ḫi-im DUMU šál-ma-a-šur
target: To Ali-ahum son of Šalim-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB PUZUR₄-a-šur DUMU a-šur-dan
target: Seal of Puzur-Aššur son of Aššur-dan.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma en-um-a-šur-ma a-na a-na-a-na qí-bi-ma
target: From Ennam-Aššur to Anna-anna:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam a-ba-ru-um ša i-tur₄-DINGIR iḫ-li-iq-ma
target: Itūr-ilī's lead has been lost here,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 GÍN 15 ŠE KÙ.BABBAR a-na ša-lim-bé-lí ṣú-ḫa-ri-šu a-dí-in
target: and I gave 1 shekel 15 grains of silver to Šalim-bēlī, his servant.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-kam KÙ.BABBAR ša-lim-bé-lí li-dí-na-ki-im
target: Let Šalim-bēlī give you the silver there.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-pu-tum a-ma-kam lu a ba-ba-tí lu a-na É-be-tí-a lá ta-ša-li-ṭí
target: Urgent, do not act rashly there with regard to either the outstanding claims or my house.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-wa-tí ša ì-lí-dan i-dí-a-šur ù šu-IŠTAR al-té-qé
target: I have accepted the proposal of Ilī-dan, Iddin-Aššur and Šu-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ḫa-ra-ni a-ta-lá-kam
target: I shall come on my trip.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma iš-tù a-lim{ki} i-ta-ṣa-am úz-ni pé-té-a
target: and inform (plural) me if he has left the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-lá-a-ma ù šé-ep-IŠTAR-ma a-na tám-kà-ri-im qí-bi₄-ma 6.8333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ší-im-tám ni-il₅-qé
target: From Alaya and Šēp-Ištar to the merchant: We took the agreed amount of 6.8333 minas of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫa-ma ṣí-ib-tám 0.6666 ma-na 1 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša 4 ḫa-am-ša-tim 12 GÍN ki-ib-sà-tim ša 6 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR 5.25 GÍN ŠÀ.BA ab-num ša É kà-ri-im
target: Further, interest of 0.6666 mina 1 shekel of silver; for 4 weeks 12 shekels: deductions; on 6 minas of silver: 5 1/4 shekels.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠU.NÍGIN 0.8333 ma-na 8.25 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-ṣé-er ší-im-tim iṭ-ḫi-i i-na ke-ni-im
target: Specified with the colony's weight stone. In all, 0.8333 mina 8 1/4 shekels of silver he transferred to the agreed amount.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na KÙ.BABBAR ša li-bi₄-kà 0.3333 ma-na 4.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR pì-lá-aḫ-IŠTAR DUMU a-šur-SIPA ik-lá
target: Truly, Pilah-Ištar son of Aššur-rēʾī held 0.3333 mina 4.5 shekels back on the silver in your possession.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-lá-a-ma 0.3333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a-na ḫu-bu-li-kà a-na en-um-a-šur DUMU šu-{d}EN.LÍL áš-qúl
target: From Alaya: I have paid 0.3333 mina of silver on your debt to Ennam-Aššur son of Šu-Illil.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR šé-ep-IŠTAR il₅-qé
target: Šēp-Ištar took 5 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-kam lu-ba-li-ṭá-ku-um
target: Let him make it up to you there.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 7 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ku-nu-ki-ni a-šur-e-nam DUMU {d}UTU-ba-ni na-áš-a-ku-um
target: Aššur-ennam son of Šamaš-bāni brings you 7 minas of silver under our seals.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫi a-ta ki-ma KÙ.BABBAR ta-al-qé-ú-ni ṭup-pá-am ša ḫu-bu-li pì-lá-aḫ-IŠTAR a-na a-šur-e-nam dí-in-ma
target: My dear brother, when you have received the silver give the tablet concerning the debt of Pilah-Ištar to Aššur-ennam.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pá-am a-ṣé-ri-a šu-up-ra-nim-ma ṭup-pu-ú KI ki-lá-lá+lá-<gap> li-mu-tù
target: Send the tablet to me so I can nullify the tablet with them both.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú KÙ.BABBAR a-šu-mì pì-lá-aḫ-IŠTAR GÁN-lam₅ e-tí-iq
target: Also, the silver passed overland in the name of Pilah-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma en-nam-a-šur-ma a-na a-lá-ḫi-im-ma me-er-ú me-tim né-nu mì-šu-um DAM.GÀR-ru a-bi-ni sí-ki-ni ú-kà-lu
target: Ennam-Aššur said to Ali-ahum: We are inheritors. Why do our father's customers detain us?

source: translate Akkadian to English: ba-a-am a-na DAM.GÀR a-bi-ni lu nu-sà-li-ma DAM.GÀR a-bi-ni lu nu-ṭá-i-ib
target: Come, let us plead with our father's customers and please our father's customers.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lá tù-ú-na-a-ni ù sí-ki-ni lá ú-kà-lu
target: Do not cheat me lest they detain us.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí ḫa-am-ší-šu ù iš-ri-šu a-ḫa-am eb-ra-am nu-šé-ší-ib-ma a-ta qá-tám ta-am-ta-na-ḫa-aṣ ú tù-ú-na-a-ni
target: Five or ten times we have had a colleague and friend sit down to negotiate, but you have rejected everything; so, you cheat me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù-ma ša a-ḫi-im ù eb-ri-im lá ta-ša-me-ú ba-a a-na ṣé-er 4 um-me-a-ni ša ki-ma a-bi-ni lu ni-li-ik-ma lu-šé-ší-ru-ni-a-tí-ma DAM.GÀR-ri a-bi-ni lu nu-ṭá-ib-ma
target: Since you do not hear what brother and friend say, then come, let us go to the four investors who represent our father, let them set us straight and let us please our father's customers.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù a-na a-lim{ki} a-ṣé-er a-ḫa-tí-ni gu₅-ba-áb-tim lu ni-li-ik-ma a-na ma-lá ší-ma-at a-bi-ni ša a-lim{ki} lu ni-iz-ku
target: And after that let us go to the City to our sister, the priestess, and clear the matter in accordance with our father's will that is in the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lá tù-na-ḫa-ni ù KÙ.BABBAR 1 GÍN lá tù-ša-ag-ma-ra-ni
target: Do not obstruct me and do not let me waste a single shekel of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lá ri-ig-ma-tum ší-bu-tum
target: This is not a formal court case, it is a statement before witnesses.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na en-um-a-šùr ù šu-ku-bi-im DUMU en-na-ma-nim
target: to Ennam-Aššur and Šu-Kūbum son of Ennam-Anum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na {d}MAR.TU-ba-ni a-šùr-i-mì-tí ku-zi-zi-a ú en-um-a-šùr qí-bi-ma um-ma ša-lim-a-šur-ma
target: To Amurrum-bāni, Aššur-imittī, Kuziziya and Ennam-Aššur from Šalim-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 šu-lu-up-kà-e SIG₅ 2 ra-qá-ta-an SIG₅ ša lu-bu-ší ša a-bi₄-ni iš-tí lu-bu-ší ša <gap> iš-tí en-um-a-šùr ku-zi-zi-a i-na <gap> ep-ša-ku-ni
target: 2 -textiles of good quality, 2 thin textiles of good quality for clothing for our father with the clothes <gap> with Ennam-Aššur Kuziziya in <gap> as I have been made.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫu-a a-tù-nu iḫ-da
target: My dear brothers, take care.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ni-kà-sí ma-aḫ-ri-ni i-dí-a-bu-um ù ša-lim-a-šùr i-sí-ú-ma
target: Iddin-abum and Šalim-Aššur settled accounts with us as witnesses.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na mu-lá 10 ma-na KÙ.GI ší-ip-kà-at i-sú-rik₁₃ ša a-na ša-lim-a-šùr ša-áp-ku
target: As compensation for 10 minas of gold, Issu-arik's investment that had been invested in Šalim-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: É áš-du ù wa-ar-kà-sà i-dí-a-bu-um ki-ma i-sú-rik₁₃ a-na ša-lim-a-šùr i-dí-in
target: Iddin-abum gave on behalf of Issu-arik Ašdu's house and its legacy to Šalim-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: É áš-du ù wa-ar-kà-sà ša ša-lim-a-šùr IGI lá-qé-ep IGI a-ku-za
target: Ašdu's house and its legacy belongs to Šalim-Aššur. Witnessed by Lā-qēp, by Akuza.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um kà-ni-iš i-dí-ni-a-tí-ma IGI GÍR ša a-šùr ší-bu-tí-ni ni-dí-in
target: The Kanesh colony gave us for these proceedings and we gave our testimony before Aššur's dagger.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma <gap>-ma a-na ḫa-nu ù a-<gap> qí-bi-ma
target: From <gap> to hanu and A<gap>; to hanu:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 ku-ta-ni a-na 0.6666 ma-na LÁ 2 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-dí-na-kum
target: I sold you 5 for 0.6666 mina less 2 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ki-ma 0.3333 ma-na LÁ 2 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-bu-kà i-dí-nam
target: Of that your father gave me 0.3333 mina less 2 shekels of silver;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.3333 ma-na a-na É kà-ri-im i-dí-in
target: he gave 0.3333 mina to the office of the colony.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-kam a-na a-bi-kà ta-er
target: Raise it with your father there.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫa-am-ma 1 ku-sí-tám SIG₅ iš-tù MU.1.ŠÈ a-dí-na-kum
target: I furthermore gave you a year ago 1 fine robe.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.3333 ma-na 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ší-im-ša
target: Its price was 0.3333 mina 5 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i li-bi e-wa-ri-mu-ša
target: shekels of silver owed by Ewarimuša;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i li-bi a-mur-IŠTAR
target: 10 shekels of silver owed by Ṣilli-Ištar;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i li-bi a-lu-wa
target: 10 shekels of silver owed by Aluwa;

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ḫa-nu-nu li-ip-tí-IŠTAR ú-ṣur-ša-IŠTAR-ma a-na a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi-ma
target: From Hanunu, Lipit-Ištar (and) Usur-ša-Ištar to Ali-ahum:

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na 11 ma-na 7.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR-pí-kà ša iš-tù pu-ru-uš-ḫa-dim ub-lu-ni-ni a-na ma-la tí-ir-tí-kà a-na ṭup-pì-kà ša 7.3333 ma-na 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša a-na zu-ku-a ḫa-bu-lá-tí-ni
target: Of the 11 minas 7.5 shekels of your silver that they brought from Purušhaddum--in accordance with your instructions for your tablet concerning 7.3333 minas 5 shekels of silver which you owed to Zukuwa--

source: translate Akkadian to English: u₄-mu-kà 3 ITU.KAM i-tí-qú-ma i-na-aḫ-DINGIR i-dí-ku-ba-am ú-ša-ḫi-it-ma
target: your terms were exceeded by 3 months and Enah-ilī cleared Iddin-Kūbum,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša 2 ITU.KAM ú ša-pá-tim 17.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṣí-ib-tim il₅-qé 2 GÍN.TA a-na ma-na-im ki-ib-sá-tim il₅-qé
target: so he took interest for two-and-a-half months: 17.5 shekels of silver; he took 2 shekels per mina as deducted amounts.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pá-am ša ku-nu-ki-kà nu-šé-ṣí-a-ma ni-il₅-té-šu-ma i li-bi ṭup-pí-kà i-na É i-na-aḫ-DINGIR ni-iš-ku-un
target: We produced the tablet with your seal and opened it and put it among your tablets in Enah-ilī's house.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-tí KÙ.BABBAR-pí-kà 3 ma-na 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a ma-lá tí-ir-tí-kà É i-na-aḫ-DINGIR nu-šé-ṣí-a-ma
target: The rest of your silver, 3 minas 10 shekels, we brought out of Enah-ilī's house according to your instructions,

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na 5 GÚ URUDU ša tù-šé-bi-lá-ni ŠÀ.BA 13 ma-na URUDU a-na gám-ri-im ša ḫa-ra-nim ú-ku-ul-tí ANŠE.ḪI ir-nu-id il₅-qé
target: and of the 5 talents of copper that you sent, Irnuid took 13 minas copper to cover transport expenses (and) fodder for the donkeys.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-im 4 GÚ 47 ma-na URUDU-i-kà 0.6666 GÍN 15 ŠE KÙ.BABBAR-áp-šu 3.5 ma-na 5 GÍN 0.5 ma-na 2 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ší-im 2 ANŠE.ḪI-kà
target: The proceeds from your 4 talents 47 minas of copper, at the rate 0.6666 shekel 15 grains silver (per mina) was 3.5 mina 5 shekels; 0.5 mina 2 shekels of silver: the price of 2 your donkeys.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 21 GÚ 51.5 ma-na a-wi-it i-na-a ù DAM.GÀR-ri-im
target: 21 talents 51.5 minas: the consignment-value of Innaya and the merchant.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 ma-na LÁ 4 GÍN.TA da-tum iš-tù a-lim{ki} a-dí kà-ni-iš-ki ik-šu-ud
target: The fees from the City to Kanesh amounted to 5 minas less 4 shekels per talent.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-dí-sú-in DUMU i-ba-a ša a-na ša-lim-a-šùr DUMU i-sú-rik₁₃ ra-bi-ṣa-am e-ḫu-za-ni ù ṭup-pá-am ša a-lim a-na ša-sú-ḫi-šu il₅-qé-a-ni
target: Iddin-Suen son of Ibaya who had hired an attorney against Šalim-Aššur son of Issu-arik, and had received a tablet from the City assembly about his extradition.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-mì-ig-ru-ma ni-iš a-lim{ki} i-na kà-ni-iš it-mu-ú
target: (those two) settled (their differences) and swore an oath by the City in Kanesh.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-dí-sú-in ki-ma a-ḫa-tí-šu a-ḫi-šu ù a-ḫa-at a-bi-šu i-dí-sú-in it-ma
target: Iddin-Suen swore on behalf of his sister, his brother and his father's sister.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša-lim-a-šùr a-na ḫu-bu-ul i-ba-a-a lá i-tù-ar-šu-nu-tí
target: Šalim-Aššur must not raise claim against them for Ibaya's debt.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫu-um a-na a-ḫi-im lá i-tù-ar
target: The two must not raise claim against each other.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim ni-iš a-lim it-mu-ú
target: For this matter they swore the oath by the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ITU.1.KAM ḫu-bu-ur li-mu-um a-lá-ḫu-um
target: Month hubur, eponymy Ali-ahum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI en-na-nim DUMU a-lá-bi-im IGI a-šur-na-da DUMU ar-nu-id IGI kà-ta-tim DUMU ma-lá-ba IGI nu-ur-sú-in DUMU {d}MUŠ-mu-ta-bi-il₅ ù KIŠIB i-dí-sú-in DUMU i-ba-a-a ŠU.ḪI
target: Witnessed by Ennānum son of Ali-abum, by Aššur-nādā son of Irnuid, by Katātum son of Malaba, by Nūr-Suen son of Nirah-muttabbil, and sealed by Iddin-Suen son of Ibaya, the barber.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB IŠTAR-pá-li-il₅ DUMU šu-ku-bi₄-im KIŠIB ni-mar-IŠTAR DUMU ba-la KIŠIB a-bu-ša-lim DUMU ì-lí-a-lúm
target: Seal of Ištar-pālil, son of Šu-Kūbum, seal of Nimar-Ištar, son of Bala, seal of Abu-šalim, son of Ilī-ālum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am i-ṣé-er IŠTAR-pá-li-il₅ DUMU šu-ku-bi₄-im DAM.GÀR-ru-um i-šu
target: 0.5 mina of refined silver Ištar-pālil, son of Šu-Kūbum, owes to the creditor.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù ḫa-muš-tim ša {d}EN.LÍL-ba-ni ITU.KAM ṭí-i-na-tim 1 GÍN.TA i-na ITU.KAM a-na KÙ.BABBAR a-nim ṣí-ib-tám ú-ṣa-áb
target: From the week-eponymy of Ellil-bāni, month X, he will add 1 shekel per month for this silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB IŠTAR-pá-li-il₅ DUMU šu-ku-bi₄-im KIŠIB a-šùr-iš-ti-kál DUMU ḫi-na-a KIŠIB a-lá-ḫi-im DUMU sú-sà-a-a KIŠIB PÚZUR.IŠTAR DUMU šu-ku-bi₄-im KIŠIB be-lúm-ba-ni DUMU ga-zi-a KIŠIB áb-ša-lim DAM a-lá-ḫi-im
target: Seal of Ištar-pālil, son of Šu-Kūbum, seal of Aššuriš-tikal, son of hinnāya, seal of Ali-ahum, son of Susāya, seal of Puzur-Ištar, son of Šu-Kūbum, seal of Bēlum-bāni, son of Gaziya, seal of Ab-šalim, the wife of Ali-ahum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am i-ṣé-er IŠTAR-pá-li-il₅ áb-ša-lim DAM a-lá-ḫi-im ù DUMU-e a-lá-ḫi-im DAM.GÀR i-šu
target: 0.5 mina of refined silver Ištar-pālil, Ab-šalim, the wife of Ali-ahum, and the sons of Ali-ahum owe to the creditor.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù ḫa-mu-uš-tim ša ḫa-na-a ITU.KAM kán-war-ta 1.5 GÍN.TA ṣí-ib-tám i-na ITU.KAM a-na 1 ma-na-im ú-ṣú-bu
target: From the week-eponymy of hanāya, month IX, they will add 1.5 shekel as interest per month per mina.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR i qá-qá-ad šál-mì-šu-nu ú ke-ni-šu-nu ra-ki-is
target: The silver is bound on the one of them who is solvent and reliable.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i ša-ḫa-at áb-ša-lim ú me-er-e a-
target: Bēlum-bāni, son of Gaziya, assisted Ab-šalim and the sons of Ali-ahum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: A tablet of 24 minas and 35 shekels of tin, on the name of 'creditor', has been deposited as pledge.
target: A tablet of 24 minas and 35 shekels of tin, on the name of 'creditor', has been deposited as pledge.

source: translate Akkadian to English: This silver was taken in the name of Ali-ahum.
target: This silver was taken in the name of Ali-ahum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: Seal of Aššur-taklāku, son of Qardāya, seal of Ṭāb-ṣilli-Aššur, son of Aššur-balāṭī, seal of Dadāya, son of Nimar-Ištar.
target: Seal of Aššur-taklāku, son of Qardāya, seal of Ṭāb-ṣilli-Aššur, son of Aššur-balāṭī, seal of Dadāya, son of Nimar-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 24 minas 35 shekels of -tin (and) 4 textiles Dadāya, son of Nimar-Ištar, owes to the creditor.
target: 24 minas 35 shekels of -tin (and) 4 textiles Dadāya, son of Nimar-Ištar, owes to the creditor.

source: translate Akkadian to English: From the week eponymy of Aššur-taklāku, son of Ali-ahum, he shall pay within 16 weeks.
target: From the week eponymy of Aššur-taklāku, son of Ali-ahum, he shall pay within 16 weeks.

source: translate Akkadian to English: If, when his term is due, he has not paid, he will add an interest of 1.5 shekels per month.
target: If, when his term is due, he has not paid, he will add an interest of 1.5 shekels per month.

source: translate Akkadian to English: Month XI, year eponymy of Maṣi-ilī.
target: Month XI, year eponymy of Maṣi-ilī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: He will pay the full amount of tin without (deducting) fees and transport costs.
target: He will pay the full amount of tin without (deducting) fees and transport costs.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ša 2.5 ma-na <gap> KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pì-im ú ṣí-ba-tí-šu ša a-da-da ḫa-bu-lá-ku-ni ni-kà-sí ni-sí-ma <gap> ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am ú 1 ku-ta-nam i-na pì ṭup-pí-šu a-na a-lá-ḫi-im i-da-an
target: Concerning the 2.5 minas of refined silver and its interest that Adada owes to you, we settled accounts and he must give <gap> mina refined silver and 1 in accordance with the text of his tablet to Ali-ahum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫa-ma a-na 1 ma-na 7 GÍN ša ší-ta ta-aḫ-sí-sà-tí-a a-za-kà-ar-šu-ma i-ša-qá-lam₅
target: Further, I shall formally state to him the 1 mina 7 shekels from my two memoranda, and he must pay.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI i-tur₄-DINGIR DUMU a-mur-IŠTAR IGI a-ta-ta ḫa-pu-dim IGI a-lu-lá-a DUMU i-sá-li-a
target: Witnessed by Itūr-ilī son of Amur-Ištar, by Atata the blind one, by Alulaya son of Isalia.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR iš-tí a-lu-lá-a ù <gap>{d}UTU al-qé-ú
target: I received 1 mina 10 shekels of silver from Alulaya and <gap>-Šamaš.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 6 TÚG.ḪI.A qá-dum 1 TÚG ša e-na-aḫ-DINGIR i-dí-nu-ni a-na É kà-ri-im a-na mì-iš-li ša a-bi-ni
target: I deposited at the office of the colony as a half-share of our father 6 textiles, including Enah-ilī's textile.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí-i ma-lá ta-az-me-ru-ni šu-mì a-bi-ni i-na É kà-ri-im lu-up-ta-ma
target: Write our father's name in the office of the colony for what you account for them.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú mì-iš-li ša a-bi-a i-dí-IŠTAR ù en-na-num li-ta-dí-ú
target: and then Iddin-Ištar and Ennānum may deposit my father's (other) half-share.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ba-ú-a bé-lu-a a-tù-nu ú ší-tí KÙ.BABBAR ša i É kà-ri-im i-ší-tù iḫ-da-ma ša-dí-na-šu-nu
target: My dear fathers and lords, also, the remainder of the silver, whatever is left in the office of the colony - take care to make them pay that!

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am a-ḫa-ma 1 ṭup-pu-um ša 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR i-na É i-<gap>
target: 4 minas of silver, further, 1 tablet concerning 1 mina of silver in the house of <gap>.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu-lu en-nu-um-be-lúm pu-šu-ki-in sá-sí-a en-um-a-šùr DUMU a-ni-nim a-lá-ḫu-um DUMU sú-kà-li-a i-dí-ku-bu-um DUMU a-šùr-ma-lik ú-ṣú-ur-ša-a-šùr DUMU a-gu-a i-lá-áš-ra-ni {d}EN.LÍL-ba-ni DUMU za-za a-ba-sí-a DUMU {d}li-i-ba-a a-ku-ku tù-ur-a-šùr DINGIR-na-da DUMU a-šùr-na-da sú-in-na-da mì-ma a-wi-lu a-ni-ú-tum i-na pu-ùḫ-ri-im i-na kà-ri-im bu-ru-uš-ḫa-dim uš-bu-ú
target: Lulu, Ennam-Bēlum, Pūsu-kēn, Sasiya, Ennam-Aššur son of Anninum, Ali-ahum son of Sukkalliya, Iddin-Kūbum son of Aššur-malik, Uṣur-ša-Aššur son of Aguwa, Il-ašrannī, Illil-bāni son of Zaza, Abasiya son of Libbaya, Akuku, Tūr-Aššur, Ilī-nādā son of Aššur-nādā, Suen-nādā - all these men sat in the assembly in the Burušhaddum colony.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-nu-ma ṣú-ba-tám šu-um-šu mì-ma a-na ú-ší-na-lam lá ta-da-an
target: And they said: Do not sell a single textile to Ušinalam!

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 TÚG ma-ku-ḫa-an iš-tí šu-ku-bi-im
target: 2 textiles due from Šu-Kūbum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 TÚG na-aḫ-lá-áp-tám a-na be-el a-lim a-na bu-zu-li-a ú-kà-il₅
target: 1 cloak for the lord of the town I offered to Buzuliya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 20 ma-na URUDU iš-ti ib-ni-{d}UTU ša a-mur-{d}UTU
target: 20 minas of copper due from Ibni-Šamaš the of Amur-Šamaš.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 8.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR iš-tí sú-e-ta-ta
target: 8.5 shekels of silver due from Suettata.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 TÚG ku-ta-nam šu-li DUMU PUZUR₄-a-bé-eḫ a-lá-ḫa-am a-ḫu-šu a-na e-lá-ma ú-kà-a-an
target: Šuli, son of Puzur-Abeh, will bring proof that Ali-ahum, his brother, owes 1 -textile to Elamma.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma lá ú-kà-i-in KÙ.BABBAR 0.5 ma-na šu-li a-na e-lá-ma i-ša-qal
target: If he does not bring proof Šuli will pay 0.5 mina of silver to Elamma.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù ḫa-mu-uš-tim ša a-šùr-ma-lik ṣa-lá-mì-im ki-ma a-wa-at kà-ri-im a-na 1 ma-na-e-em ṣí-ib-tám ú-ṣa-áb
target: Starting from the week eponymy of Assur-mālik, the black one, he will add interest per mina according to the regulation of the colony.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lí-mu-um ša qá-té ba-zi-a DUMU šé-pá-lim ITU.KAM na-ar-ma-ak-a-šur ša ki-na-tim
target: Eponymy of the successor of Baziya, son of Šēp-ālum, month III.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI ir-ma-a-šùr IGI na-ar-me-a IGI en-nam-{d}IŠKUR IGI ri-ma-nim
target: Witnesses: Ir'am-Aššur, Nar'am-Ea, Ennam-Adad, Rimānum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 31 TÚG ku-ta-nu ša i-dí-sú-in
target: 31 textiles of Iddin-Suen.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 30 TÚG ku-ta-nu ša aḫ-ša-lim
target: 30 textiles of Ah-šalim.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 46 TÚG ku-ta-nu ša ḫi-na-a ù ú-ṣú-ra-nim
target: 46 textiles of hinnāya and Uṣurānum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 21 TÚG ku-ta-nu ša a-šur-SIPA
target: 21 textiles of Aššur-rē'ī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 36 TÚG ku-ta-nu ša u-IŠTAR
target: 36 textiles of Šu-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 28 TÚG ku-ta-nu ša en-na-sú-in
target: 28 textiles of Ennam-Suen.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 24 TÚG ku-ta-nu ša lá-qé-ep
target: 24 textiles of Lā-qēp.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 18 TÚG ku-ta-nu ša DAM.GÀR
target: 18 textiles of the merchant.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 7 TÚG ku-ta-nu ú-lá kà-an-ku
target: 7 textiles without seals.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 17 TÚG a ší-mì-im
target: 17 textiles as pre-emption.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ku-li-a qí-bi-ma um-ma a-ba-ba-a-ma
target: Say to Kuliya, thus says Ababaya:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ma-lá pì-i na-áš-pár-tí-kà pá-ni-tim 3 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a-na e-na-na-tim a-dí-in
target: Exactly as your previous letter stated I have given 3 minas of silver to Ennanatum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-pu-tum mì-nu-um ša a-na e-na-na-at-a-šùr KÙ.BABBAR tù-ší-ru-ú
target: Please, what is this, that you released silver to Ennanat-Assur?

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na lá-ni-šu ta-tí-ki-il₅ lá É-tám lá ša-ra-am i-šu ú KÙ.BABBAR tù-ší-ir
target: You put trust in his outward appearance, but he has neither house nor child and still you released the silver!

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-pu-tum a-na me-ra um-mì-a-nim <gap>-be <gap> ma-na-aḫ-tí bur-IŠTAR ša-i-il₅
target: Please, to an independent trader <gap>. <gap> as for my misery / expenses, ask Bur-Istar (about it).

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ma ša a-dí-nu-šu-i-ni a-na a-šur-ṣú-lu-li i-na ṭup-pì-im ša i-is-ku-ri-im lá-pu-ut
target: All I gave him for Assur-sululi has been registered on a wax tablet.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-pu-tum lá ta-ša-lá-aṭ
target: Please do not act highhandedly.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pá-am ša É bé-lúm-ba-ni na-áš-pár-ta-kà li-li-kam lu nu-šé-ṣí-šu
target: As for the tablet of / in the house of Belum-bani - when your letter comes we will obtain its release.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫa-at-kà a-na a-bi-kà ma-da-tí-ma ta-ta-wu i-na li-bi a-bi-kà tù-šé-ṣa-kà
target: Your sister talks a lot to your father and she tries to make him forget you!

source: translate Akkadian to English: lá ta-ša-lá-aṭ mì-ma lá ta-pá-lá-aḫ e-lá-nu-kà a-bu-kà lá i-šu
target: Do not act highhandedly, you have nothing to fear since your father has nobody but you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-pu-tum a-ni-qí ša a-mu-tim <gap> ù KI.DU-ra-am a-šùr-ṣú-lu-li <gap> lu-ub-lam
target: Please, the rings of meteoric iron <gap> and the <gap>, let Assur-sululi take them along to bring (them) to me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù sà-ḫe-er-tám ša ḫa-tim a-na ḫa-ra-an sú-ki-nim a-na e-ra-bi-ni li ik nim
target: and let him small goods from hattum to the Narrow Track when we arrive.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-bu-a MAŠKIM ù tám-kà-ru ú-ṣú-ur-ša-a-šur DUMU a-šur-ma-lik iṣ-bu-tù-ni-a-tí-ma a-na É ú-ṣú-ur-ša-a-šur ú-šé-ri-bu-ni-a-tí-ma
target: Abuwa, the attorney, and the customers of Uṣur-ša-Aššur son of Aššur-malik seized us and led us into Uṣur-ša-Aššur's house.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ma-ṣa-ar-tí ú-ṣú-ur-ša-a-šur tám-kà-ru-šu i-na ma-aḫ-ri-ni ip-té-ú-ma ṭup-pì-šu ḫa-ru-mu-tim ú-šé-ṣí-ú-ni-ma
target: His customers opened Uṣur-ša-Aššur's strong room with us as witnesses, took out his certified tablets.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na li-bi₄ ṭup-pì-šu ṭup-pá-am ḫa-ar-ma-am ša 6 GÚ AN.NA ku-nu-ki ša a-lim{ki} ú 45 TÚG ku-ta-ni ša-lim-a-šur a-na a-šur-i-dí DUMU sá-da-a i-da-an-ma 1 GÚ KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am a-šur-i-dí a-na ša-lim-a-šur i-ša-qal
target: And (selected) from his tablets one certified tablet stating that Šalim-Aššur shall give 6 talents of tin sealed in the City and 45 -textiles to Aššur-idī son of Sadaya, and that Aššur-idī shall pay 1 talent of refined silver to Šalim-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma a-šur-i-dí DUMU sá-da-a lá-šu AN.NA ù TÚG ṣú-ba-tí a-na ša ki-ma a-šur-i-dí ša-lim-a-šur i-da-an
target: If Aššur-idī son of Sadaya should be absent, Šalim-Aššur shall give the tin and the textiles to Aššur-idī's representatives.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-um ḫa-ar-mu-um ša ḫu-bu-ul a-šur-i-dí i-na É ú-ṣú-ur-ša-a-šur DUMU a-šur-ma-lik i-na li-bi₄ ṭup-pì-šu e-li-a-ma ù a-na a-šur-ma-lik DUMU a-lá-ḫi-im ip-qí-du-šu
target: This certified tablet concerning Aššur-idī's debt appeared in the house of Uṣur-ša-Aššur son of Aššur-malik among his tablets, and thereafter they entrusted it to Aššur-malik son of Ali-ahum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um kà-né-eš i-dí-ni-a-tí-ma IGI GÍR ša a-šur ší-bu-tí-ni ni-dí-in
target: The Kanesh colony gave us for these proceedings and we gave our testimony before Aššur's dagger.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 GÚ URUDU iš-tí ku-ur-zi-a ù šu-ni-sà-ba iš-tù ḫa-mu-uš-tim ša a-bi-ì-lí a-na 4 ḫa-am-ša-tim i-ša-qú-lu
target: 5 talents of copper is owed by Kurziya and Šu-Nisaba.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma lá iš-qú-lu ki-ma a-wa-at kà-ri-im ṣí-ib-tám ú-ṣú-bu
target: If they have not paid (in time) they are to add interest according to the rule of the colony.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ITU.KAM a-lá-na-tim li-mu-um a-al-DU₁₀
target: Month Allanātum, eponymy Ali-ṭāb.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 GÚ 23 ma-na URUDU iš-tí ì-lí-iš-ta-kál
target: 3 talents 23 minas of copper is owed by Iliš-tikal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 GÚ URUDU iš-tí ku-ra u₄-mu-šu 1 ITU.KAM e-tí-qú
target: 5 talents of copper is owed by Kura. His terms are overdue by 1 month.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 GÚ URUDU KI a-šur-i-mì-tí iš-tù ḫa-mu-uš-tim ša ku-lu-uk-lu a-na 3 ḫa-am-ša-tim i-ša-qal
target: 4 talents of copper is owed by Aššur-imittī. Reckoned from the week of Kuluklu he is to pay within 3 weeks.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma lá iš-qúl ki-ma a-wa-at kà-ri-im ṣí-ib-tám ú-ṣa-áb
target: If he has not paid (in time) he is to add interest according to the rule of the colony.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ITU.KAM ša sà-ra-tim li-mu-um ša i qá-tí a-al-DU₁₀ il₅-qé-ú
target: Month Ša-sarrātim, eponymy he who took over from Ali-ṭāb.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša mì-ma a-we-li a-ni-ú-tim ṭup-pì-šu-nu ḫa-ru-mu-tim a-na a-ta-ta DUMU LUGAL-sú-in e-zi-ib
target: With respect to all these men I have left their certified tablets with Atata son of Šar-Suen.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-šur-i-mì-tí IGI a-al-DU₁₀ IGI aḫ-ša-lim DUMU i-dí-IŠTAR
target: Witnessed by Aššur-imittī, by Ali-ṭāb, by Ah-šalim son of Iddin-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na lu-zi-na ù li-ip-ta-nim qí-bi₄-ma um-ma a-šur-GAL-ma
target: To Luzina and Lipit-Anum from Aššur-rabi.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na lu-zi-na qí-bi₄-ma 0.6666 ma-na 6.25 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR iš-tù li-mì-im šu-sú-in i-na li-bi-kà a-dí-i
target: To Luzina: I placed 0.6666 mina 6 1 / 4 shekels of silver in your possession in the eponymy Šu-Suen.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-šur-GAL DUMU a-sú-a IGI šu-sú-in a-ḫi-kà IGI ša-lim-a-ḫi-im i-na É-tí-kà ni-kà-sí ni-sí KÙ.BABBAR
target: Witnessed by Aššur-rabi son of Asuwa, Šu-Suen, your brother, and Šalim-ahum we settled accounts in your house.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na li-ip-ta-nim dí-in-ma ší-ma-am ša ba-lá-ṭí-a li-il₅-qé-am
target: Give the silver to Lipit-Anum and let him acquire a profitable purchase for me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ḫa-nu-nu ṣa-áb-ta-ma 1 ma-na 1 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša-áš-qí-lá-šu ú-mu-šu ma-al-ú
target: Seize hanunu and have him pay 1 mina 1 shekel of silver. His terms are complete.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB šu-be-lim DUMU i-dí-a-bi₄-im
target: Sealed by Šu-Bēlum son of Iddin-abum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na i-ku-nim DUMU {d}UTU-ba-ni e-ni-iš-ta-ri-im ù a-lu-wa
target: To Ikūnum son of Šamaš-bāni, Eništarum and Aluwa.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 62 ku-ta-ni a-na ir-i-bi-im ù šé-ep-IŠTAR e-zi-ib
target: I left 62 kutānus with Ir'ibum and Šēp-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ.BA 30 ku-ta-ni a-na šu-pu-nu-ma-an ni-dí-in
target: We gave thereof 30 kutānus to Šuppunuman.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 TÚG a-na ra-dí-im iš-ḫi-a-ni-tí-im
target: 5 textiles for the guide from Išhianit.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 11 ku-ta-ni i-na na-ru-qá-tim du-ur-kà-ma a-šu-mì da-dí-a e-ez-ba a-dí tí-ir-tí i-lá-kà-ni
target: Pack 11 kutānus in the sacks and leave them in Dādiya's name until my instructions arrive.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-tí ku-ta-ni-a 16 TÚG i-ší-tù-nim
target: The rest of my kutānus - 16 textiles remain.

source: translate Akkadian to English: wa-ar-ki-a-ma a-na ší-tí-im ma-lá ta-du-nu-šu-ni a-ṣé-ri-a šé-bi-lá-šu-nu
target: After I left, with respect to the remainder, send me as much as you will sell.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 19 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR SAḪAR.BA ší-im 1.8333 ma-na LÁ 2 GÍN AN.NA ša kà-nu-tim i li-bi a-mur-IŠTAR DUMU i-da-a a-na ITU.1.KAM i-ša-qal
target: 19 shekels of 'dust silver', the price of 1 mina and 48 shekels of tin, which Kannutum has as claim on Amur-Istar, son of Idaya - within one month he will pay.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ITU.KAM qá-ra-tum IGI šál-ma-{d}IŠKUR nu-a-ri-im IGI i-dí-sú-in DUMU a-ta-na-aḫ
target: Month VIII. In the presence of Salim-Adad, the musician, of Iddin-Suen, the son of Atanah.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 me-at NINDA a-šur-i-mì-tí DUMU a-ta-a
target: 100 breads Aššur-imittī, son of Ataya

source: translate Akkadian to English: 50 NINDA DUMU ḫa-lá-bi₄-im
target: 50 breads the son of hali-abum

source: translate Akkadian to English: 50 NINDA en-nam-a-šur DUMU a-ḫi-a
target: 50 breads Ennam-Aššur, son of my brother

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi-ma um-ma SIG₅-pí-a-šur-ma
target: To Ali-ahum from Damiq-pī-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí tí-sú-bi ša e-na-nim 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša ILLAT-tim ša IGI ú-ṣú-ra-nim iz-ku-a-ni
target: Concerning Ennānum's additions, the 10 shekels of silver from the caravan that became available to me with Uṣurānum as witness,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i-na KÙ.BABBAR-pì-a a-na-ku-ma ta-aṣ KÙ ta-lá-qé
target: pay him 10 shekels of silver out of my silver that I left with you and then set witnesses for him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB da-da-a DUMU šu-ku-bi-im KIŠIB ì-lí-TAB.BA DUMU a-šùr-DU₁₀ KIŠIB a-šur-SIPA DUMU a-šur-iš-tí-kál
target: Seal of Dadaya son of Šu-Kūbum, seal of Ilī-tappā'ī son of Aššur-ṭāb, seal of Aššur-rē'ī son of Aššuriš-tikal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR i-ṣé-er a-šur-SIPA DUMU a-šur-iš-tí-kál a-lá-ḫu-um i-šu
target: Aššur-rē'ī son of Aššuriš-tikal owes 1 mina of silver to Ali-ahum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ITU.1.KAM ša sà-ra-tim li-mu-um ša qá-tí a-šur-i-mì-tí ma-lá-ḫi-im
target: Month Ša-sarrātim, eponymy after that of Aššur-imittī the skipper.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.3333 ma-na.TA i-na ša-tim i-ša-qal
target: He will pay 0.3333 mina per year.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma i-na ma-lá u₄-me-šu 0.3333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR lá iš-qú-ul 0.5 GÍN.TA a-na 0.3333 ma-na-im ṣí-ib-tám i-na ITU.1.KAM ú-ṣa-ab
target: If he has not paid 0.3333 mina of silver when his term is up, he will add interest at the rate 0.5 shekel per 0.3333 mina per month.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB ku-ku-a DUMU ma-nu-ki-ì-lí-a KIŠIB da-da-a DUMU bu-zi KIŠIB ì-lí-dan DUMU i-dí-a-šùr
target: Seal of Kukuwa son of Mannum-kī-iliya, seal of Dadaya son of Buzi, seal of Ilī-dan son of Iddin-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 21 GÚ ša-áp-tám ša kà-né-eš ša É.GAL-lim en-um-a-šùr DUMU šál-ma-a-šur a-na ì-lí-dan i-na ku-bur-na-at i-ša-qal-ma
target: Ennam-Aššur son of Šalim-Aššur shall give 21 talents of wool from Kanesh, from the palace, to Ilī-dan in Kuburnat.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṣú-ḫa-ru ša en-um-a-šùr ša-lim-ar-dí 21 GÚ SÍG.ḪI.A i-na ku-bur-na-at ú-sà-na-aq-šu-ma
target: Ennam-Aššur's servant Šalim-wardī shall check the 21 talents of wool in Kuburnat.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ANŠE.ḪI.A ša en-nam-a-šur SÍG.ḪI.A a-na tù-ku-ub-tù ú-šé-ru-ú
target: On Ennam-Aššur's donkeys they will have brought the wool to Tukubtu.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na ri-iš SÍG.ḪI.A ša i-ša-qú-lu-šu-ni 6.6666 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR li-tí SIG₅ ì-lí-dan DUMU i-dí-a-šur a-na en-um-a-šur i-ša
target: From the capital on the wool that they are going to pay him, Ilī-dan son of Iddin-Aššur shall give 6.6666 minas of good silver to Ennam-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ša-lim-a-šùr-ma a-na en-nam-a-šur ù a-la-ḫi-im qí-bi-ma
target: From Šalim-Aššur to Ennam-Aššur and Ali-ahum:

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR 1 GÍN bu-lá-tù-ni ma-lá a-ma-kam i-ba-ší-ú lu KÙ.BABBAR 1 GÍN ša li-bi-kà ú li-bi a-lá-ḫi-im ù-lá na-ṭù-ma a-na a-lim{ki} ú-lá ni-ša-ma
target: As for every shekel of silver of our funds as much as is there, as well as every shekel of silver in your possession and in Ali-ahum's - it is not a good idea for us to send it to the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR 1 GÍN ú-lá e-li ù-lá a-na ṣí-ib-tim ni-da-šu-ma KÙ.BABBAR 1 GÍN e-li a-na-kam ší-a-ma-tum-ma
target: Either a single shekel will accrue, or we should give every shekel of silver as interest-bearing loans, so a profit of some shekels of silver will accrue.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.3333 ma-na 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR KÙ.BABBAR 1 GÍN pá-ḫi-ra-ma a-na-kam
target: Here purchases are possible and of 1.3333 mina 5 shekels of silver <gap> Collect every shekel of silver so here <gap>

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR 10 ma-na
target: at least 10 minas of silver <gap>

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na en-nam-a-šur qí-bi-ma lu AN.NA lu ṣú-ba-tù ma-la e-li-ú-ni-ku-ni a-na ší-a-ma-tim i-ba-ší
target: To Ennam-Aššur: Tin as well as textiles, what accrues to you is available for purchases.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 ma-na ša-am-ší i ta-šu-ma ru-ni ma-lik-DINGIR-šu tù-qá-a
target: 2 minas <gap> you await Malik-ilišu.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 TÚG ṣú-ba-tum ša i-ba-ší-ú a-na a-lá-ḫi-im ù a-lu-a dí-in-ma lu-ub-lu-nim
target: Every textile that is available give that to Ali-ahum and Aluwa so they may bring it.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na da-áš-i-šu ba-a-nim lu iš-té-ni-ú-tù-ma KÙ.BABBAR lu ší-im ḫu-sà-ri lu ší-im ṣú-ba-tí
target: Leave in the spring. May for the very first time the silver, the proceeds from the lapis lazuli or from the textiles.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-šur-DU₁₀-ma a-na a-na-na qí-bi-ma
target: From Aššur-ṭāb to Anna-anna:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 16 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša tù-šé-bi-lá-ni ší-im li-bi₄-šu šu-ut-ma iš-a-am la iš-e-li sà-áp-tí-nu-um
target: As to the 16 shekels of silver that you sent me, he made purchases after his own will without asking me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na ra-mì-ni-a ú-ba-la-am
target: I personally bring you a .

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša a-lá-ḫi-im i li-be a-ni-na
target: 10 shekels of silver belonging to Ali-ahum is owed by Annina.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 21.3333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ku-nu-ki-ni a-na ḫi-na-a ni-ip-qí-id
target: We entrusted 21.3333 minas of silver under our seals to hinnaya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ku-zi-zi-a-ma a-na ku-ku-a ú en-um-a-šùr
target: From Kuzizya to Kukuwa and Ennam-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša ma-nu-um-ki-ì-lí ub-lá-ni KÙ.BABBAR ma-sú-ùḫ nu-ṣa-id-ma 5 GÍN im-ṭí-ma
target: Concerning 1 ½ mina of silver that Mannum-kī-ilī brought - the silver was of inferior quality.

source: translate Akkadian to English: We melted it down and 5 shekels were lost,
target: We melted it down and 5 shekels were lost,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ṭup-pu-um ša 2.6666 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR 1 ṭup-pu-um ša 0.3333 ma-na 2.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša ma-nu-um-ki-ì-lí ma-nu-um-ki-a-šùr lá-šu-ma ša ki-ma šu-a-tí 0.3333 ma-na 2.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṣí-ib-tám il₅-qé-ú
target: and the tablet about 2 ⅔ minas of silver and a tablet about ⅓ mina 2 ½ shekels of silver belonging to Mannum-kī-ilī - Mannum-kī-Aššur was absent so his representatives took as interest ⅓ mina 2 ½ shekels of silver;

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠU.NÍGIN 3.3333 ma-na 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i-ší-qí-il₅
target: in all 3 ⅓ minas 5 shekels of silver was paid.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ.BA 2 ma-na LÁ 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na-na a-ma-at en-um-a-šùr ta-áš-qú-ul
target: Thereof Anna-anna, Ennam-Aššur's maid, paid 2 minas less 5 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ.BA 0.8333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pu-um a-na ma-lá tí-ir-tí-ku-nu ṭup-pu-um ša IŠTAR-lá-ma-sí ù ma-nu-um-ki-ì-lí ni-il₅-pu-ut iš-tù ḫa-mu-uš-tim ša i-na-a DUMU a-mu-ra-a ITU.1.KAM a-lá-na-tim
target: Of that, we wrote a debt-note for Ištar-lamassī and Mannum-kī-ilī for ⅚ mina of refined silver in accordance with your instructions - from the week of Innaya son of Amuraya, month Allanātum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-um a-na a-na-na a-dí-in
target: I gave the tablet to Anna-anna.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 20 bi₄-lá-tim SÍG.ḪI.A É ma-nu-ki-a-šur nu-šé-ṣí-a-ma a-na ma-lá tí-ir-tí-ku-nu a-mì-ša-am na-áš-ú-ni-ku-nu-tí

target: 28.6666 minas of copper I gave to you in Kuburnat as a working capital - under my seal. As to the <gap> minas of good copper that you promised to pay now - without asking (permission) you have left.

target: in all 41 minas of silver, its import duty added, its transport tariff paid, we entrusted to Aššur-imittī son of Amur-ilī, under seal, in order to make purchases in the City.

target: Further, 7 minas 13 shekels of refined silver from Šalim-Aššur's silver Aššur-imittī received,

target: and you received 50 sacks of grain, half thereof wheat, (and) 7.8333 minas 2.5 shekels of tin, his share of Aššur-malik's caravan.

target: He received 1 mina of silver when Nikur and Tali brought (it) to you.

target: When I returned from Mamma you sent me <gap>, and I paid 11 shekels of silver to the servant.

target: He did not give you the slave-girl, but returned and

target: Abu-šalim's customers have seized 1.5 mina 6 shekels of silver from his brother Aššur-idī here.

target: And I have personally seized silver before 2 witnesses together with the customers.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù a-na kà-ri-im tám-kà-ru-šu i-li-ú-ma um-ma šu-nu-ma KÙ.BABBAR a-na-kam-ma ni-lá-qé
target: Then his customers went up to the colony and said: We shall take the silver here.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na dí-in kà-ri-im KÙ.BABBAR a-na kà-ni-iš KÙ.BABBAR iš-tí a-šur-i-dí i-lá-ak-ma a-na ṭup-pì-šu e-ta-ú
target: According to the verdict of the colony the silver will go to Kanesh with Aššur-idī and they will discuss on the basis of his tablet.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù i-a-tí 0.6666 ma-na 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ḫa-bu-lam mì-ṣí-ma KÙ.BABBAR le-qé
target: Also, to me he owes 0.6666 mina 5 shekels of silver. Take the silver on your own responsibility.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam ṭup-pá-am ša ší-bi₄-a ḫa-ar-ma-am ú-kà-al
target: I hold a certified tablet with my witnesses here.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ša-lá-tù-ar <gap>-nu u₄-ma-kál lá a-sà-ḫu-ur
target: I must not be delayed a single day.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tí ṣú-ḫa-ri a-ta-lá-kam
target: I shall come with the servants.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-me-a-nu šu-lá-ba-an ku-ku-lá-num MAŠKIM ša šu-lá-ba-an DU₁₀-a-šùr ù MAŠKIM-ṣú a-na É i-na-aḫ-DINGIR e-ru-bu-ma ṭup-pì ta-ma-lá-ki lu-qú-tí ù ta-aḫ-sí-sà-tim ù na-áš-pè-ra-tim ša i-na-aḫ-DINGIR ša a-ṣé-er šu-lá-ba-an a-na bu-ru-uš-ḫa-dim a-dí lu-qú-tí-šu uš-té-bi₄-lu-šu-ni
target: Šu-Laban's investors, Kukkulānum, the attorney of Šu-Laban, Ṭāb-Aššur and his attorney entered Inah-ilī's house, and they took note of the tablets, containers, goods and tablets as well as the missives that Inah-ilī had sent to Šu-Laban in Purušhaddum concerning his goods.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu ṭup-pè lu ta-aḫ-sí-sà-tim ša a-ḫi-ú-tim ṭup-pè-e il₅-ta-mu-du-ma um-ma um-me-a-nu-ma mu-ta-tim ša šu-lá-ba-an ša iš-tù pu-ru-uš-ḫa-dim MAN-a-šur ku-nu-ku ša ki-ma um-me-a-ni ú šu-lá-ba-an mu-ta-tí ú-šé-ṣí-ú-ni
target: The investors said: (These are) the half-packs belonging to Šu-Laban that Puzur-Aššur brought out from Purušhaddum under the seals of the representatives of the investors and Šu-Laban.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ku-nu-ki ša šu-lá-ba-an ú ša ki um-me-a-ni um-me-a-nu ú-dí-ú-ma ù ta-ma-lá-ki ku-nu-ki ša ki-ma um-me-a-ni um-me-a-nu ú-dí-ú-ma ṭup-pè-e ib-ri-ú-ma
target: The investors identified the sealings of Šu-Laban and the representatives of the investors, and the investors identified the containers sealed by the representatives of the investors, and they investigated the tablets.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma i-na-aḫ-DINGIR-ma KÙ.BABBAR a-nim ší-im AN.NA-ki a-lá-qé-šu
target: Inah-ilī said: "I shall take this silver, the price of the tin."

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma um-me-a-nu-ma KÙ.BABBAR-áp-kà ma-lá i-NIM tap-pá-ú-ni nam-ú-dum lá-šu a-dí 3 u₄-me lu né-ru-ba-ma lu ni-iz-ku
target: The investors answered: "As to your silver, the majority of our partners are not here. Within 3 days we shall enter and clear it."

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma MAN-a-šùr-ma ù MAŠKIM-ṣú-ma 7 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR i li-bi₄
target: Puzur-Aššur said together with his attorney: "7 minas of silver is deposited in a package. It belongs to my sister Šāt-Adad. Šāt-Adad is the merchant. Give me the package."

source: translate Akkadian to English: en-um-a-šur a-šur-ba-ni DUMU i-du-a a-na 18 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša i-na li-bi-kà i-šu-ú KÙ.BABBAR šu-uq-lá-am
target: Ennam-Aššur (said to) Aššur-bāni son of Iduwa: With respect to the 18 shekels of silver that you owe to me - pay me the silver!

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-šùr-ba-ni-ma KÙ.BABBAR a-na ša ki-ma ku-a-tí áš-qú-ul-ma šu-um-kà az-ku-ur
target: Aššur-bāni answered: "I have paid the silver to your representative and I mentioned your name."

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma en-um-a-šur-ma a-šar KÙ.BABBAR a-na ša ki-ma i-a-tí lá ta-áš-qú-lu-ma ù šu-mì lá ta-az-ku-ru šu-ša-al-ša-am a-na KÙ.BABBAR-pí-a lá ta-ša-qá-lam₅
target: Ennam-Aššur said: "In my case you have not paid the silver to my representative and have not mentioned my name, will you then not pay three times the amount of my silver?"

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-šùr-ba-ni-ma a-ša-qá-lá-kum
target: Aššur-bāni answered: "I shall pay you."

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-ni-na DUMU a-šùr-be-el-a-wa-tim IGI a-šur-ba-ni DUMU i-dí-a-bi₄-im úz-na-tí-ni il₅-pu-ut
target: Witnessed by Annina son of Aššur-bēl-awātim, by Aššur-bāni son of Iddin-abum. He touched our ears.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 16 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am i-ṣé-er i-ku-nim DUMU ili₅-ba-ni ITU.1.KAM áb-ša-ra-ni li-mu-um šu-ḫu-bur DUMU e-lá-lí a-na MU.10.ŠÈ KÙ.BABBAR i-ša-qal
target: 16 minas of refined silver owed by Ikūnum son of Ilī-bāni. Month Ab-šarrāni, eponymy Šu-hubur son of Elāli. He will pay in 10 years.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫa-ma 1.3333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pu-um iš-tí-šu-ma a-na ba-áb ḫa-ra-ni-a i-ša-qal
target: Further, 1.3333 mina of refined silver is owed by him as well; he will pay at the start of my journey.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 12 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am i-ṣé-er a-ta-a-a DUMU šu-IŠTAR en-um-a-šùr i-šu-ú ù ša-lim-a-šùr qá-ta-tum ITU.1.KAM ša ke-na-tim li-mu-um ša qá-tí PUZUR₄-ni-ra-aḫ a-na 46 ḫa-am-ša-tim i-ša-qal
target: Ataya son of Šu-Ištar owes 12 minas of refined silver to Ennam-Aššur, and Šalim-Aššur is guarantor. Month Ša-kēnātim, eponymy after that of Puzur-Nirah. He will pay in 46 weeks.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫa-ma 1.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am i-ṣé-er a-ta-a-a-ma a-na 20 ḫa-am-ša-tim i-ša-qal
target: Further, 1.5 mina of refined silver is owed by Ataya as well; he will pay in 20 weeks.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù 0.6666 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR bé-ú-lá-tù-šu iš-tí KÙ.BABBAR-pí-ma uk-ta-al
target: Also, 0.6666 mina of silver is his working-capital; he is held in service by the silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 12 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pu-um i-ṣé-er i-ri-ší-im a-na 16 ḫa-am-ša-tim i-ša-qal
target: 12 minas of refined silver is owed by Erišum. He will pay in 16 weeks.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫa-ma 2.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pu-um i-ṣé-er i-ri-ší-im-ma a-na 12 ḫa-am-ša-tim i-ša-qal
target: Further, 2.5 minas of refined silver is owed by Erišum as well; he will pay in 12 weeks.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pu-um i-ṣé-er e-ri-ší-im ù ili₅-ba-ni a-ḫi-šu a-na 4 ḫa-am-ša-tim i-ša-qú-lu
target: 1.5 mina of refined silver is owed by Erišum and his brother Ilī-bāni; they will pay in 4 weeks.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šál-ma-a-šur ù a-mur-IŠTAR iṣ-bu-tù-ni-a-tí-ma
target: Šalim-Aššur and Amur-Ištar seized us,

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-mur-IŠTAR-ma a-na šál-ma-a-šùr-ma DUMU me-tim a-na-ku
target: and Amur-Ištar said to Šalim-Aššur: I appear as heir.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR 3 a-tù-nu a-na a-bi₄-a ḫa-bu-lá-tù-nu
target: You three owe 3 minas of silver to my father.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pá-ak-nu ḫa-ar-ma-am ša ḫu-bu-li-ku-nu a-bi₄ e-zi-ba-am
target: My father left me your certified tablet concerning your debt.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú-lá šu-ma ša-ba-e tí-šu ṭup-pá-am <gap> ú-ra <gap> ṭup-pá-kà lá-du-uk
target: Or, if you have a quittance <gap> a tablet <gap> so I can invalidate your tablet.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šál-ma-a-šur-ma ke-na 3 né-nu KÙ.BABBAR ni-ḫi-bi₄-il₅
target: Šalim-Aššur answered: "Yes, we three became indebted for the silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ni-nam a-ṣé-er a-šur-ma-lik ù šál-ma-a-šur ša ki-ma i-a-tí KÙ.BABBAR ú-šé-bi₄-il₅-ma a-na ša ki-ma a-bi₄-kà KÙ.BABBAR iš-qú-lu
target: I sent Anninum to Aššur-malik and Šalim-Aššur, my representatives, with the silver, and they paid the silver to your father's representatives.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù iš-tù KÙ.BABBAR iš-qú-lu-ni iš-tí a-bi₄-kà a-na-me-er
target: Also, after they paid the silver, I met with your father.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI e-dí-na-a IGI ṣí-lá-{d}IM
target: Witnessed by Eddinaya, by Ṣill-Adad.

source: translate Akkadian to English: kà-ru-um kà-ni-iš i-dí-ni-a-tí-ma ší-bu-tí-ni ba-áb i-lim IGI pá-aṭ-ri-im ša a-šur ṭup-pá-am ni-dí-in
target: The Kanesh colony gave us and we gave our testimony in the Gate of the God before Aššur's dagger on a tablet.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na e-na-nim ù a-lá-ḫi-im
target: To Ennānum and Ali-ahum

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB PUZUR₄-a-šur DUMU a-šur-dan
target: seal of Puzur Aššur son of Aššur-dan

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 né-pí-šu-um 10 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ni-is-ḫa-sú DIRI ša-du-a-sú ša-bu i-a-um a-na um-mì-a-ni-a AN.NA i-ša-ú-mu-nim
target: 1 packet of 10 minas of silver, its excise added, his transport fee paid, belonging to me, for my investors; they will buy (with it) tin for me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a-ḫa-ma ni-is-ḫa-sú DIRI ša-du-a-sú ša-bu ša DAM.GÀR ku-ta-ni i-ša-ú-mu-nim
target: Separately 5 minas of silver, its excise added, his transport fee paid, belonging to . They will buy -textiles for me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ri-ik-sú-um ší-im 2 ku-ta-ni-šu a-na ḫa-ti-a
target: One bundle (of silver), the price paid for 2 of his, for hatiya;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ri-ik-súm 0.5 ma-na 5 GÍN ší-im ku-ta-nim a-na i-li-a
target: one bundle (containing) 35 shekels (of silver), the price paid for a, for Iliya;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ri-ik-súm 0.3333 ma-na a-na né-er-am-tim
target: 1 bundle containing 0.3333 mina for Ner'amtum;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ri-ik-súm 0.3333 ma-na a ší-ma-at-IŠTAR
target: one bundle containing 0.3333 mina for Šīmat-Ištar;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 13 GÍN a-na kur-ub-IŠTAR
target: 13 shekels (of silver) for Kurub-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ma a-nim a-na a-šur-lá-ma-sí áp-qí-id IGI a-mur-IŠTAR IGI a-šùr-na-da
target: All this I entrusted to Aššur-lamassī, in the presence of Amur-Ištar, (and) of Aššur-nādā.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-nu-pí-a ki-ma me-er-e šál-ma-a-šùr a-na ga-al-ga-li-a ù ḫa-ar-šu-nu-ma-an iṣ-ba-at-ni-a-tí-ma ṭup-pá-am ša 10 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša ḫu-bu-li-šu-nu iš-me-ú
target: Representing the sons of Šalim-Aššur Anupiya seized us against Galgaliya and haršumnuman, and they heard a tablet concerning 10 minas of silver, their debt.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-nu-pí-a-ma ṭup-pu-um la ku-nu-ku-kà
target: Anupiya said: Does the tablet not bear your seals?

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ga-al-ga-li-a-ma ku-nu-ku-a
target: Galgaliya answered: They are my sealings.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-nu-pí-a-ma me-er-ú me-tim né-nu lu a-na šál-ma-a-šùr KÙ.BABBAR ta-áš-qú-ul lu a-na me-er-e šál-ma-a-šùr ta-áš-qú-ul a-na a-né-e-ma ru-a-am
target: Anupiya said: We are inheritors. Produce evidence for this, that you have either paid the silver to Šalim-Aššur or have paid to the sons of Šalim-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ḫa-ar-šu-nu-ma-an-ma KÙ.BABBAR a-na-ku ša ṭup-pí-ni šál-ma-a-šùr ú-ša-bi a-na i-id a-ša-kà-na-ku-nu-tí
target: haršumnuman said: I personally satisfied Šalim-Aššur with the silver of our tablet. I am willing to go to the River for you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-um ša ba-áb DINGIR ša kà-nu-tim a-ša-at ili₅-ba-ni
target: A tablet of sworn deposition (lit. "of the gate of the god") of Kannutum, the wife of Ili-bani;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 na-áš-pé-er-tum ša a-ta-ta DUMU ma-num-ba-lúm-a-šùr a-na ṣé-ri-a ù a-ṣé-er a-šùr-e-nam DUMU ku-bi-a
target: 2 (unopened) letters of Atata, son of Mannum-balum-Assur, addressed to me and to Assur-ennam, son of Kubiya;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 na-áš-pè-er-tum ša a-bi-ni a-na bé-lúm-ba-ni DUMU šu-bé-lim
target: two (unopened) letters of our father to Belum-bani, son of Su-Belum;

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-um ša PÚZUR-a-šùr a-na i-a-tí a-bi-a-a ú a-šùr-ták-lá-ku lá i-tù-ru-ú
target: a tablet (with the seal) of Puzur-Assur (son of Ahuqar), that he will not come back on me, Abiya and Assur-taklaku;

source: translate Akkadian to English: na-áš-pè-er-tum ša a-bi-ni a-na šál-ma-a-šùr
target: a letter of our father to Salim-Assur (son of Ili-bani);

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-um ša a-lim{ki}
target: a tablet of the City;

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-um ša ni-pí-il₅-tí-a
target: a tablet about a balance payment due to me;

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-um ša 1-ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša a-šùr-ták-lá-ku DUMU a-šùr-ma-lik
target: a tablet about 1 mina of silver of Assur-taklaku, son of Assur-malik;

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-um ša a-šùr-ták-lá-ku DUMU da-da-nim
target: a tablet of Assur-taklaku, son of Dadanum;

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-um ša a-da-a ša ší-im bé-tim
target: a tablet about Adaya about the price paid for a house;

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-um ša 0.3333 ma-na 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša a-bu-ša-lim ú e-dí-na-a a-ḫi-šu
target: a tablet about 0.3333 (and 5 shekels) of silver of Abu-salim and his brother Edinaya;

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-um ša 15 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša a-dí-da ú me-er-i-ša
target: a tablet about 15 shekels of silver Adida and her son;

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-um ša 12 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša a-zi-da DUMU šál-ma-a-šur
target: a tablet about 12 shekels of silver of Azida, son of Salim-Assur;

source: translate Akkadian to English: DUB ša 12 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša a-lá-ḫi-im DUMU a-šùr-SIG₅
target: a tablet about 12 shekels of silver of Ali-ahum, son of Assur-damiq;

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-um ša 8 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša i-ku-pí-a ṣa-al-mì-im
target: a tablet about 8 shekels of silver of Ikuppiya, the one of Salmum;

source: translate Akkadian to English: na-aš-pé-er-tum ša na-ki-le-ed DUMU
target: a letter of Nakile'ed, son of Hanana;

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma dan-a-šur ša-lim-wa-ar-dí-e ú šu-nu-nu-ma a-na en-nam-a-šur qí-bi-ma
target: From Dan-Aššur, Šalim-wardī and Šu-Nūnu to Ennam-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na lu-qú-tim pá-ni-tim 3 GÚ URUDU SIG₅ šu-nu-nu ub-lá-kum
target: In the previous merchandise Šu-Nūnu brought you 3 talents of good copper;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.5 GÚ URUDU SIG₅ ŠU.NÍGIN 4.5 GÚ
target: (plus) 1.5 talents of good copper - in all 4.5 talents

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí lu-qú-tim ša a-ḫi-kà a-na-kam sà-li-a ni-iṣ-ba-at-ma
target: We seized Salliya here concerning the goods belonging to your brother,

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-ut-ma na-áš-pé-er-ta-am a-lá-ḫu-im bi-lá-nim-ma lu-qú-ta-am lu-šé-ra-ku-nu-tí
target: and he said: Bring me a missive then I shall release the goods to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam a-dí ša a-ḫi-kà sà-li-a ni-iṣ-ba-at
target: Here we seized Salliya concerning your brother

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma né-nu-ma a-na kà-ni-iš pá- a-dí 10 u₄-me im-ta
target: and we said: To Kanesh within 10 days

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ta ma-lá-kà
target: Make up your mind.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na i-tur₄-DINGIR qí-bi₄-ma um-ma en-na-sú-in-ma
target: To Itūr-ilī from Enna-Suen:

source: translate Akkadian to English: áš-pu-ra-kum um-ma a-na-ku-ma ṭup-pu-a a-šar a-lá-ḫi-im DUMU šál-ma-a-šur i-ba-ší-ú ṭup-pu-a le-qé-ma a-šar ku-wa-tí li-ib-ší-ú
target: I wrote you and said: My tablets are with Ali-ahum son of Šalim-Aššur. Take my tablets and let them be with you.
