source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma ṭup-pu-a a-šar ku-wa-tí i-ba-ší-ú ṭup-pu-a ku-nu-ki-a pè-té-ma 6 GÍN a-mu-tum ku-nu-ku ša DUMU PUZUR₄-sú-in i-na qé-ra-áb ṭup-pè-a na-ad-a-at
target: If my tablets are with you, then open for the seal on my tablets, and (you will see that) six shekels of iron sealed by Puzur-Suen's son is placed with my tablets.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-bi₄ a-ta be-li a-ta DUMU um-me-a-ni-im ke-ni-im a-gu₅-ur-ma a-mu-tám a-ṣé-ri-a lu-ub-lu-nim
target: My dear father and lord, hire a reliable affiliated trader and have him bring me the iron.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù i-na ri-iš a-mu-tim ší-be šu-ku-un ki-ma a-šu-mì DUMU PUZUR₄-sú-in a-mu-tám GÁN-lam₅ e-tí-qú
target: Also, set witnesses for the amount of iron to the fact that the iron must pass overland in the name of Puzur-Suen's son.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam um-me-a-nu-um ke-nu-um lá ša ša-ḫa-tim i-na KÙ.BABBAR-pì-a e-pu-lá-ni
target: Here a reliable affiliated trader who is not to be feared guaranteed for my silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-bi₄ a-ta be-li a-ta a-dí en-um-a-šur úz-ni pè-té
target: My dear father and lord, do inform me with respect to Ennam-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: kà-ru-um ṣa-ḫe-er GAL dí-nam i-dí-in-ma
target: The plenary assembly of the colony passed a verdict,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša-lim-a-šùr ù šu-be-lúm u₄-ma-ma ú-za-ku-ru-ma
target: stating that Šalim-Aššur and Šu-Bēlum on this very day must make declarations,

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-šar i-ma-gu₅-ru-ni e-ta-wu
target: and they must discuss in order to come to an agreement;

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú ṭup-pá-am ša a-lim{ki} ù ša be-el mì-ig-ra-tí-šu-nu IGI da-a-a-ni i-ša-ku-nu
target: further, they must deposit the tablet from the City assembly and of the men who settled their affair before the judges.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 13 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am i-ṣé-er ili₅-ba-ni DUMU a-šur-UTU-ši lá-ma-sà-tum tí-šu iš-tù ḫa-muš-tim ša i-tur₄-DINGIR <gap> ITU.1.KAM ša sà-ra-tim li-mu-um ša qá-té a-šùr-i-mì-tí ma-lá-ḫi-im
target: 13 shekels of refined silver Ilī-bāni, son of Aššur-šamšī, owes to Lamassutum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na 5 ḫa-am-ša-tim i-ša-qal
target: Reckoned from the week-eponymy of Itūr-ilī, month II, year-eponymy of the successor of Aššur-imttī, the boatman, within 5 weeks he will pay.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma lá iš-qúl a-na 1 ma-na-im 1.5 GÍN.TA i-na i-na ITU.1.KAM-im ṣí-ib-tám ú-ṣa-áb
target: If he does not pay he will add per mina, per month 1.5 shekel as interest.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-šur-be-el-a-wa-tim DUMU i-dí-da-gán IGI a-šùr-e-mu-qí DUMU ku-zi-zi-a
target: In the presence of Aššur-bēl-awātim, son of Iddin-Dagan, of Aššur-emūqī, son of Kuziziya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 12 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am ni-is-ḫa-sú DIRI ša-du-a-sú ša-bu ku-nu-ki ša tám-kà-ri-im a-ḫa-ma 10 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am ik-ri-bu ša a-šur ni-is-ḫa-sú DIRI ša-du-a-sú ša-bu ku-nu-ki ša tám-kà-ri-im a-na kà-ar-wa-a ni-ip-qí-id
target: We entrusted 12 minas of refined silver, its import duty added, its transport tariff paid for, sealed by the merchant, and further, 10 minas of refined silver, votive offerings for Aššur, its import duty added, its transport tariff paid for, sealed by merchant, to Karwaya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i-na li-bi₄ ili₅-me-ta-ak
target: 2 shekels of silver owed by Ilī-wēdāku.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na ku-bu-ur-na-at a-na ša-lim-wa-ar-dí i-ša-qal
target: He will pay to Šalim-wardī in Kuburnat.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR iš-tí ma-ma-ḫi-ir i-na ri-ik-sí-im 2 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR al-pu-ut
target: 10 shekels of silver owed by Man-mahir.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma <gap>-nu-<gap> a-na a-mur-{d}UTU qí-bi-ma
target: From <gap> to Amur-Šamaš:

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na {d}UTU-ši ṭup-pì-i ta-ša-me-ú
target: The very day you hear my letter

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 i-na ša kà-ri-im ú a-ta lu ṭup-pè-e lu ú-tù-ub-tám ša É a-bi-ni ku-un-kà-ma
target: 5 men from those of the colony and yourself must seal both the tablets and the movables of the house of our father,

source: translate Akkadian to English: É-tám a-na <gap> šu-IŠTAR ú a-bi-<gap> dí-na-ma
target: and give the house to <gap>, Šu-Ištar and Abī-<gap>,

source: translate Akkadian to English: <gap> a-na <gap>-tí-a i-<gap> 3.6666 ma-na 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša i-ṣé-er i-tur₄-DINGIR il₅-qé-ú-ni
target: and <gap>3.6666 minas 5 shekels of silver that they have taken on Itūr-ilī’s account,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10-tum ša a-na-kam lá-šu a-ḫi a-ta a-wa-tám qá-ri-ib-ma
target: since the ten-man board here is not present, my dear brother, address (him)

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ú-ṣa-aḫ-ra-ma ki-ma ta-mu-ú a qá-tí-a lu-ṭa-ḫi-ú
target: so he deducts the silver and let them transfer it to my account as you will.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-lá-ḫi-im-ma a-šur-re-ṣí en-um-a-šur ù da-dí-a a-na e-lá-ma qí-bi-ma
target: Thus Ali-ahum, Aššur-rēṣī, Ennam-Aššur and Dadiya, say to Elamma:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a ma-lá té-er-tí-kà 30 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR É tám-kà-ri-im a-na ṣí-ib-tim ni-il₅-qé-a-ku-um
target: In accordance with your instruction we borrowed for you at interest 30 minas of silver at a merchant's office.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ṣé-er É ša ta-am-gu₅-ru mì-ša-al šu-ub-tí-im nu-ṭa-ḫi-ma 3 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ni-iš-qú-ul
target: We added half a to the surface of the house plot about which you had reached an agreement and we paid 3 minas of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-ḫi-id-ma KÙ.BABBAR a-na ṣí-ib-tim i-lá-ak KÙ.BABBAR šé-bi₄-lá-am
target: Realize well that the silver is interest bearing, so send the silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-mu-um ša-i-im a-šur-mu-ta-pì-il₅ i-na pá-ni-ú-tim ni-ṭá-ra-dá-am
target: The purchases have been made, we will send Aššur-mūtappil off to you with the next opportunity.

source: translate Akkadian to English: da-a-nu u₄-me ŠÈ.2.MU iš-ku-na-ku-um u₄-mu-ú e im-lu-ú-ma i-na ṭup-pì-kà e ú-ki-šu-kà
target: The judges have set you a term of two years, don't exceed that term lest they disavow you on the basis of your tablet.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-ḫi-id ṭup-pá-am ša me-ra a-zu-a šé-bi₄-lam
target: Take care to send the tablet of the son of Azua.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ili₅-ba-ni-ma a-na en-nam-a-šur qí-bi-ma
target: From Ilī-bāni to Ennam-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-im KÙ.BABBAR 41.5 ma-na URUDU té-zi-ba-am
target: You left the price in silver for 41.5 minas of copper.

source: translate Akkadian to English: be-el KÙ.BABBAR i ša-am-ší ta-ta-al-ku i-li-kam-ma um-ma šu-ut-ma URUDU 45.5 ma-na
target: The owner of the silver came here the very day you had left, and he said: It was 45.5 minas of copper.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-ḫu-um eb-ru-ma iš-tù-ma a-we-lúm i-tal-ku a-wa-tum lá e-ri-ik ta-mì-šu ú-ta-mì-šu-ma
target: Brother and friend answered: "Since the man has left, the matter should not be long-drawn-out. Make him swear."

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 ma-na URUDU a-na-ku a-dí a-ḫi a-ta KÙ.BABBAR-áp-šu a-na ma-ma-ḫi-ir dí-in-ma a-ṣé-er KÙ.BABBAR ša be-ú-lá-tí-a li-dí
target: I made him swear and I personally deposited 4 minas of copper. My dear brother, Give the silver for it to Man-mahir so he can add it to the silver of my working capital.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-i-tim ba-lu-a ta-ak-bu-ús
target: Why have you suppressed (it) without me?

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-lá-ḫu-um-ma a-šu-mì e-li-tí-a ù e-li-tí-kà la ḫa-a-tim ak-bu-ús
target: Ali-ahum answered: In order to prevent my and your extra share from being inspected I have suppressed it.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma e-la-ma-ma e-li-tí-ma-mì-in lu-bé-il-ma i-na É a-bi-a zi-tí lá-zu-úz-ma KÙ.GI 1 GÚ a-na u₄-mì-im a-nim kà-áš-da-ku-mì-in
target: Elamma answered: "If only I could have taken along my own extra share and had obtained my share in my father's estate, then by this day I would have had at my disposal one talent of gold!

source: translate Akkadian to English: ki-ma ik-bu-sa-ni-ni ša ni-iš a-lim{ki} ta-mu-ú lu ú-kà-al
target: That he repressed me, I wish to retain as (a statement) made with an oath by the City!

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI e-dí-na-a IGI en-um-a-šùr
target: In the presence of Eddināya, and of Ennum-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na en-nam-a-šur ù a-lá-ḫi-im
target: for Ennam-Aššur and Ali-ahum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am i-ṣé-er i-ku-pí-a MAN-a-na i-šu
target: Ikūn-pīya owes 2 minas of refined silver to Puzur-Anna.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR a-na a-lim ú-ša-ak-ša-sú-um
target: He must let the silver reach him in the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma KÙ.BABBAR a-na a-lim{ki} lá uš-ta-ak-ší-sú-um 1 ma-na-um 0.5 ma-na 3 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR i-na ṭup-pì-a i-ṣa-ḫe-er
target: If he has not let the silver reach him in the City, 3 minas of silver will be deducted from my tablet at the rate 0.5 mina per mina.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI i-ku-pì-a DUMU ili₅-mì-šar IGI ba-ba-lá DUMU a-šur-DU₁₀ IGI a-šur-DU₁₀ DUMU ḫu-ra-ṣa-nim
target: Witnessed by Ikūn-pīya son of Ilī-mīšar, by Babala son of Aššur-ṭāb, by Aššur-ṭāb son of huraṣānum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na 3 šál-šu ta-lá-né-en ša wa-aḫ-šu-ša-na ù sà-ḫe-er-tám
target: 4 shekels of silver for 3 pairs of tallānu from Wahšušana plus small goods.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ma a-nim i li-bi i-tur₄-DINGIR DUMU PUZUR₄-a-na 2 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i li-bi a-ki-a
target: All this is owed by Itūr-ilī son of Puzur-Anna.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma i-ku-pì-a-ma a-na PUZUR₄.IŠTAR ù en-um-a-šur qí-bi-ma
target: From Ikūn-pīya to Puzur-Ištar and Ennam-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na u₄-mì-im ša ṭup-pí ta-ša-me-a-ni
target: On the day you hear my letter

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na URUDU 2 ma-na ù 3 ma-na <gap> i-kà-šu-du
target: for 2 or 3 minas copper they have arrived.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ṣé-er en-na-sú-in šu-up-ra-ma li-tal-kam
target: Write to Enna-Suen that he should come.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma DAM.GÀR-šu ma-ma-an ú-kà-al-šu
target: If any of his creditors holds him back,

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR a-na DUMU um-me-a-nim ke-nim li-ip-qí-id-ma lu-šé-bi-lam
target: then let him entrust the silver to a trustworthy affiliated trader and send it to me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma en-nam-a-šùr ù da-dí-a-ma a-na e-lá-ma qí-bi-ma
target: Thus Ennam-Aššur and Dadiya, say to Elamma:

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na 1 GÚ 5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR-pí-kà ša ILLAT-at a-lá-ḫi-im i-li-kà-ni 10.3333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR i-ri-ḫa-am
target: Of the 65 minas of your silver that arrived here with Ali-ahum's caravan, 10.3333 minas of silver remained.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5.3333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ší-ip-kà-tí-kà iš-tí a-lá-ḫi-im ni-il₅-qé
target: We received 5.3333 minas from what you invested with Ali-ahum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ.BA 1.3333 ma-na 8 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR lá-qé-ep il₅-qé
target: Thereof: 1.3333? mina 8 shekels Lā-qēp took;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.5 ma-na LÁ 1 GÍN té-ṣú-bu ša 1 GÚ 5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR-pí-kà
target: 1 mina 29 shekels additional payment for your 65 minas of silver;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.8333 ma-na LÁ 2 GÍN a-šùr-i-mì-tí il₅-qé
target: 48 shekels of silver Aššur-imittī took;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-ta-a-a il₅-qé
target: 35 shekels of silver Ataya took;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 6 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṣú-ḫa-ar-tum tal-qé
target: 6 shekels the girl took.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ší-tí KÙ.BABBAR-pí-kà 96 TÚG.ḪI.A a-na 8 ma-na ni-iš-a-ma-kum
target: For the rest? of your silver we bought 96? textiles for 8? minas (of silver);

source: translate Akkadian to English: 16 ma-na AN.NA qá-tim 12.5 GÍN.TA 1.5 ma-na LÁ 2 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR it-ba-al
target: 16.6666 minas of loose tin at 12.5 : 1 cost 1 mina 28 shekels of silver;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 ANŠE ṣa-lá-mu 1 ma-na 15 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR it-bu-lu
target: 4 black donkeys cost 75 shekels of silver;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR bé-ú-lá-at a-šùr-lá-ma-sí DUMU en-um-a-a 2 GÍN lu-bu-šu
target: 0.5 mina the working capital for Aššur-lamassī, son of Ennumāya, 2 shekels his clothing allowance;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ú-nu-ut ANŠE i-na NÍG.KA-sí
target: 10 shekels of silver for donkey harness.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 15 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i-té-ra-ma 2 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ú-ku-ul-tí ANŠE ni-dí-in
target: When at the accounting there was a surplus of 15 shekels of silver we paid 2 shekels of silver for food for the donkeys

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša 11 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR 2.5 ma-na AN.NA ni-iš-a-ma-kum
target: (and) for 11 shekels of silver we bought for you (an additional) 2.5 minas of tin.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-dí-da ù a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi-ma um-ma PUZUR₄-a-šur-ma
target: To Adida and Ali-ahum from Puzur-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na 0.8333 ma-na LÁ 1 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša li-bi₄-kà a-na a-lá-ḫi-im dí-in
target: As to the 0.8333 minas less 1 shekel of silver which is in your possession, give (that) to Ali-ahum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR šu-sú-in ḫa-bu-lam ša-áš-qí-il₅-ma a-na <gap> e-li-tám a-na ma-nu-ba e-zi-ib
target: Šu-Suen owes me 0.5 mina of silver; make him pay and to <gap> I left with Manuba.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù na-áš-pè-er-tí šu-sú-in ú-ta-e-ra-am
target: Also, he returned Šu-Suen's missive to me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-kam 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ma-nu-ba li-iš-qú-lá-ku-nu-tí
target: Have Manuba pay you 0.5 mina of silver there.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2.5 GÚ URUDU SIG₅ iš-tí ga-nu-nu
target: 2.5 talents refined copper due by Ganunu.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 GÚ URUDU SIG₅ iš-tí ga-nu-nu-ma
target: 3 talents of refined copper also by Ganunu.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 GÚ URUDU SIG₅ iš-tí a-šur-DU₁₀ DUMU a-mur-na-ḫu-uš
target: 1 talent of refined copper due by Aššur-ṭāb, son of Amur-Nahuš.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 GÚ 30 ma-na URUDU SIG₅ iš-tí a-šùr DU₁₀ DUMU a-mur-na-ḫu-uš-ma
target: 1 talent 30 minas of refined copper due by the same Aššur-ṭab, son of Amur-Nahuš.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 GÚ 20 ma-na URUDU SIG₅ iš-tí a-du-dum
target: 3 talents 20 minas of refined copper due by Adūdum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 GÚ URUDU SIG₅ iš-tí PUZUR₄-{d}MAR.TU
target: 1 talent refined copper due by Puzur-Amurrum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 GÚ 40 ma-na URUDU la-mu-nam iš-tí en-na-sú-in DUMU i-ku-a
target: 2 talents 40 minas of bad copper due by Ennam-Suen, son of Ikūa.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 15 ma-na URUDU SIG₅ iš-tí en-na-sú-in DUMU i-ku-a
target: 15 minas of refined copper due by Ennam-Suen, son of Ikua.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 28 ma-na URUDU SIG₅ iš-tí i-ku-pì-a DUMU en-um-a-šur
target: 28 minas of refined copper due by Ikūn-pīya, son of Ennam-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 GÚ URUDU SIG₅ iš-tí PUZUR₄-we-er
target: 3 talents of refined copper due by Puzur-Wēr.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am iš-tí ur-ší-ší
target: 1.5 mina of refined silver due by Uršiši.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am iš-tí ur-ší-ší-ma ša qá-ta-tí-šu e-lá-ma ù a-mur-IŠTAR a-na ì-lí-<gap> li-tap-tù-ni
target: 1.5 mina of refined silver due by the same Uršiši, as whose guarantors Elamma and Amur-Ištar were registered on behalf of Ilī-<gap>.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR be-ú-lá-ti-šu iš-tí ur-ší-ší-ma
target: 0.5 mina of silver, his working capital, due by the same Uršiši.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 23.3333 ma-na ḫi-na-a qá-sú i-dí
target: 23.3333 minas hinnāya has deposited as his share.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša 3 TÚG 0.3333 ma-na.TA 1 ma-na qá-sú i-dí
target: For 3 textiles at 0.3333 mina apiece he deposited 1 mina as his share.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5.5 TÚG.TA 10 GÍN.TA
target: 5.5 textiles at 10 shekels apiece.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 TÚG ša ik-ri-bi₄-kà 10 GÍN.TA iš-ku-nu-nim
target: (for) 3 textiles of your temple-fund they submitted 10 shekels apiece.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠU NÍGIN 25 ma-na 15 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša a ni-kà-sí-kà na-ad-a-tí-ni
target: In all: 25 minas 15 shekels of silver, which you have as deposit on your account.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na 15 GÍN ša tá-na-pu-lu ša ni-kà-sí-ku ša ḫi-na-a
target: 1 mina and 15 shekels you have to balance are of (for) hinnāya's account.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 TÚG.ḪI.A ku-ta-ni ša šu-IŠTAR DUMU lu-zi-ni a-na 27 ma-na URUDU ma-sí-im li-ip-ta-num a-na i-dí-a-šùr DUMU dan-a-šùr i-dí-in
target: Two textiles belonging to Šu-Ištar, son of Luzini, Liptānum gave to Iddin-Aššur, son of Dān-Aššur, for 27 minas of refined copper.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um wa-aḫ-šu-ša-na i-dí-ni-ma IGI šu-ga-ri-a-im ša a-šùr ší-bu-tí a-dí-in
target: For these words the Wahšušana colony made me available and before the symbol of Aššur I gave my testimony.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI bu-za-zu DUMU pu-šu-ke-en₆
target: In the presence of Buzāzu, son of Pūšu-kēn.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-šùr-du-ri DUMU PUZUR₄.IŠTAR tap-pá-i
target: Aššur-dūrī, son of Puzur-Ištar was my fellow witness.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 56 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR i-na KÙ.BABBAR-áp a-šur-i-dí DUMU sá-ta-a ú-ṣú-ur-ša-a-šur ù a-šur-DU₁₀ a-na šál-ma-a-šur iš-qú-lu-ma
target: Uṣur-ša-Aššur and Aššur-ṭāb have paid 56 minas of silver from the silver of Aššur-idī son of Sadaya to Šalim-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR i-ší-ta-ma
target: but 4 minas of silver remain (unpaid).

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pá-am ša ú-ṣú-ur-ša-a-šur ù a-šur-DU₁₀ šál-ma-a-šur il₅-pu-ut-ma
target: and Šalim-Aššur has written a debt note for Uṣur-ša-Aššur and Aššur-ṭāb.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pá-am ša 1 GÚ KÙ.BABBAR ša ḫu-bu-ul a-šur-i-dí DUMU sá-da-a šál-ma-a-šur a-na a-šur-DU₁₀ ú ú-ṣú-ur-ša-a-šur ú-ší-ir
target: and he has released the (old) tablet concerning 1 talent of silver from the debt of Aššur-idī son of Sadaya to Aššur-ṭāb and Uṣur-ša-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um kà-ni-iš ṣa-ḫe-ra-bi₄ i-dí-ni-ma
target: The plenary assembly of the Kanesh colony has given me for these proceedings.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pá-am IGI GÍR ša a-šur a-dí-in
target: and I gave a tablet before Aššur's dagger.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-da-da a-šur-i-mì-tí DUMU a-ta-a ù PUZUR₄-tí-a-am-tim tap-pá-ú-a
target: Witnessed by Adada; Aššur-imittī son of Ataya and Puzur-Ti'amtum were my (absent) partners.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi-ma um-ma SIG₅-pì-a-šur-ma
target: To Ali-ahum from Dami-pī-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na KÙ.BABBAR ša <gap>-tí ḫa-bu-lá-ni <gap> e <gap>-um ḫa <gap>-na zi <gap> iš <gap> ù šál-ma-ni <gap> tám-kà-ri-im e-pu-šu
target: With respect to the silver that PN owes <gap> We are well <gap> they made for the merchant.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na ṣé-ri-kà e a-ru-kum a-ḫi a-ta a-ḫi
target: I must not be alienated from you. My dear brother, my dear brother,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 17.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ší-im e-ri-im KÙ.BABBAR pá-ni 0.5 ma-na ù 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR sà-ḫi-ir-tám ki-ma na-áš-pè-er-tí a-dí sú-ki-ni-im na ḫa-ḫi-im li-bi
target: the son of Kuzuzarum owes me 17.5 shekels of silver, the price of copper. Your brother Amur-Ištar is his guarantor. Make him pay the silver and send it to me. As you hear my missive send me small goods worth 0.5 mina 5 shekels of silver to hahhum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ki-ma ša-lu-um KÙ.BABBAR ša DAM.GÀR
target: Concerning the matter of the Narrow Track, if it is not feasible, send me word in hahhum, then I shall act so as to bring the silver of the merchant safely on.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ku-li-a qí-bi₄-ma um-ma al-pì-lí ú a-šur-lá-ma-sí
target: To Kuliya, thus say Alpilī and Aššur-lamassī:

source: translate Akkadian to English: šál-ma-ni i ta-wi-ni-a wa-áš-ba-ni
target: We are well, we are staying in Tawiniya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ni-iš-ta-na-me wa-áš-bu-tum ša wa-aḫ-šu-ša-na i-ta-ṣú-nim
target: We hear rumours that the residents of Wahšušana have left the city.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí u₄-me-e za-ku-sà ni-ša-me-ma a-le ni-pá-nu-ú ni-ša-pá-ra-ku-um
target: Within two days, when we hear more details, we will inform you by letter where we are heading.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ta-ma-lá-ke ša qá-tí-kà al-pì-lí ú-ša-al
target: As for the coffers under your control, Alpilī will make enquiries.

source: translate Akkadian to English: li-ba-kà lá i-pá-ri-id
target: Do not get afraid!

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 na-ru-uq ŠE-um 3 GÍN.TA KÙ.BABBAR a-na na-ru-qí-im ŠE-im 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ší-im-šu a-ḫa-ma 4 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ší-im 1 na-ru-uq GIG mì-ma a-nim iš-tí ša-ta-na DUMU.MÍ ḫi-pá
target: 10 sacks of barley at 3 shekels of silver per sack, their price 0.5 mina of silver; further, 4 shekels of silver as the price of 1 sack of wheat - all this is owed by Šāt-Anna, the daughter of hipa.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 na-ru-uq ŠE-um 10.6666 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ší-im-šu iš-tí zu-na-na-dí DAM ili₅-ba-ni ḫa-wi-li-im
target: 4 sacks of barley, priced at 10.6666 shekels of silver, are owed by Zunanadi, the wife of Ilī-bāni, the hawīlum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 7 GÍN ší-im 2 na-ru-uq ŠE-im 3 DUG GIG KI DAM a-šùr-i-mì-tí
target: 7 shekels, the price of 2 sacks of barley and 3 pots of wheat, is owed by the wife of Aššur-imittī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 12 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ší-im 2 na-ru-uq ŠE 1 na-ru-uq 2 DUG GIG KI tù-ur-ḫa-lá ú a-ší-tí-šu
target: 12 shekels of silver, the price of 2 sacks of barley and 1 sack 2 pots of wheat, is owed by Turhala and his wife.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 9 GÍN ší-im 2 na-ru-uq ŠE 3 DUG GIG KI i-lá-li-iš-kán gu₅-ba-áb-tim
target: 9 shekels, the price of 2 sacks of barley and 2 pots of wheat is owed by Ilališkan, the priestess.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 GÍN iš-tí na-na-a
target: 3 shekels is owed by Nanaya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 DUG GIG 2 DUG ŠE 4.5 GÍN ší-im-šu iš-tí DAM šu-iš-ḫa-ra na-na qá-ta-tum
target: 3 pots of wheat 2 pots of barley, priced at 4.5 shekels, is owed by Šu-Išhāra's wife; Nana is the guarantor.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 9.75 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ší-im 3 na-ru-uq 1 DUG ŠE-im iš-tí ta-ri-iš-ma-tim ni-a-tim
target: 9 3 / 4 shekels of silver, the price of 3 sacks 1 pot of barley, is owed by our own Tarīš-mātum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ší-im 1 na-ru-uq ŠE-im iš-tí e-ma-at en-na-nim DUMU am-ri-a
target: 3 shekels of silver, the price of 1 sack of barley is owed by the mother-in-law of Ennānum son of Amriya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 9 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ší-im 2 na-ru-uq 1 DUG GIG iš-tí DUMU.MÍ a-lá-ḫi-im DUMU sú-ḫu-ki-im
target: 9 shekels of silver, the price of 2 sacks 1 pot of wheat, is owed by the daughter of Ali-ahum son of Sukuhum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ší-im 3 DUG GIG iš-tí DAM ṣí-li-a
target: 3 shekels of silver, the price of 3 pots of wheat, is owed by Ṣillia's wife.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 DUG iš-tí a-šùr-DU₁₀ ŠU.N
target: 1 pot is owed by Aššur-ṭāb.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-la-ḫi-im lu-lu ù en-um-a-šùr a-na en-um-a-šùr qí-bi-ma um-ma PUZUR₄-a-šùr-ma
target: To Ali-ahum, Lulu and Ennam-Aššur; specifically to Ennam-Aššur from Puzu-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 13 ma-na AN.NA ku-nu-ki-a i-na za-al-pá a-dí-na-ku-um
target: I gave you 13 minas of tin under my seal in Zalpa,

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-na-ku-ma a-na kà-né-eš šé-ri-ba-šu
target: and I said: Lead it into Kanesh.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-šùr-ba-ni DUMU ku-ta-a IGI en-nam-sú-in DUMU AḪ.ME-ša-sú-in
target: Witnesses were Aššur-bāni son of Kutaya, Ennam-Suen son of the Suen-priest.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫi a-ta AN.NA ku-nu-ki-a a ša ki-ma i-a-tí pí-qí-id
target: My dear brother, entrust the tin under my seal to my representatives.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ša ki-ma i-a-tí qí-bi-ma a-ḫu-ú-a a-tù-nu AN.NA ša-dí-na-ma a-na KÙ.BABBAR ta-e-ra-šu
target: To my representatives: My dear brothers, have the tin sold and converted to silver,

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ku-un-kà-ma li-ib-ší
target: seal the silver and let it be.

source: translate Akkadian to English: gi-im-lá-ni ù a-na-ku a-we-el gi-mì-lim
target: Do me a favour. I too am a man able to do favours.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na i-tur₄-DINGIR qí-bi-ma um-ma en-um-a-šur-ma
target: To Itūr-ilī from Ennam Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a ma-lá tí-ir-tí-kà ta-áš-bi-it KÙ.BABBAR <gap>-ma-na 15 GÍN <gap> ša-zu-úz-ta-kà <gap> ší-mì <gap> dí e <gap> i-na e-lá-i-a
target: In accordance with your instructions <gap> your reprisentatives <gap> the final payment of the silver, <gap> minas 15 shekels <gap> when I come up.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma ma-ma-an <gap>-ku-ra-am na-<gap> li-ba-kà <gap> a-bi a-ta <gap> ša <gap> 2 ma-na <gap> 2 ma-na <gap> 2 ma-na <gap> a-na <gap> tám a-le-e-ú <gap> ša e-kà i-<gap>
target: If anyone <gap> my dear father <gap>

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša šu-IŠTAR be-lum-ra-bi₄ iṣ-ba-at
target: 4.5 shekels of silver, belonging to Šu-Ištar, Bēlum-rabi seized.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma be-lum-ra-bi₄-ma a-na a-wa-at šu-IŠTAR ma-ṣa-ku
target: Bēlum-rabi declared: I take the responsibility vis-à-vis Šu-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI en-na-sú-in IGI PUZUR₄-lá-aḫ IGI ku-ra
target: Before Ennam-Suen, before Puzur-lah before Kura.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma i-ku-pì-a-ma a-na šu-ma-li-ba-a-šur en-um-a-šur ú be-kà-a qí-bi₄-ma
target: From Ikūn-pīya to Šumma-libbi-Aššur, Ennam-Aššur and Bekaya; specifically to Ennam-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.6666 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ḫa-bu-lá-kum
target: I owe you 1.6666 mina of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša 1 ma-na 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša-áp-ra-tim e-zi-ba-kum
target: I left surety worth 1 mina 10 shekels of silver with you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 GÚ 0.5 ma-na URUDU e-zi-ba-kum
target: I left 1 talent 0.5 mina of copper with you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na i-tur₄-DINGIR KIŠIB en-na-sú-in
target: To Itūr-ilī; seal of Enna-Suen.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na DAM.GÀR-ri-im ù e-lá-lí KIŠIB in-ba-a-šùr
target: To the merchant and Elāli; sealed by Inib-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-šu ša ma-tí-ma té-er-ta-kà lá i-lá-kam
target: Why doesn't any message ever come from you?

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 me-at sí-pá-ra-tum 18 šé-na-tum 34 šé-na-tum ša ṣú-ùḫ-ri-im a-na 15 šé-ri-šu ma-ar-šu a-na 2 ší-ni-šu ša za-ak-ri-im 10 ku-li-ta-nu 30 mu-uš-ṭá-tum 0.5 SÌLA sà-ar-dum
target: 400 bronze pins, 18 shoes, 34 children's shoes, 15 sets of straps, twice for men, 10 vessels, 30 combs, ½ litre of olive oil.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ma a-nim a-na a-bi-ni en-um-a-šur ú a-lá-ḫu-um i-dí-nu
target: All this Ennam-Aššur and Ali-ahum gave to our father.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫa-ma 6 na-ru-uq ŠE.TA mì-iš-lam GIG mì-iš-lam ŠE-am iš-tí wa-li-iš-ra
target: Further, 6 sacks of grain, half wheat half barley is owed by Wališra.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma AN.NA dam-qú-um um-ma a-na ku-ma <gap> ma-na lá ta-ba-ta-aq-šum
target: if (there is) good tin, I said: Do not cut off <gap> mina for him!

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-ut-ma ú-lá a-ba-ta-aq-súm
target: He answered: "I shall not cut it off for him."

source: translate Akkadian to English: pí-ri-kà-ni-kà a-na a-lá-ni nu-uš-té-ri
target: We had your pirikannus led to the villages.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na u₄-me a-nim ší-im pí-ri-kà-ni wa-dí-i-ma TÚG a-na ša-lá-tù-wa-ar iš-tí-in i ṣú-ḫa-ri-kà a-ṣé-er <gap> šu-pu-ur-ma ú tí-ir-ta-kà lu-za-ki-ú-ni-kum
target: Until this day indicate the price of the pirikannus and send one of your servants to Šalatuwar to <gap> with the textiles, and then I shall clear your orders for you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: e ta-áš-lu-ut-ma lá ta-áš-pu-ur
target: Do not act on your own authority since you have not written.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú a-dí PUZUR₄-a-šur ša ta-áš-pu-ra-ni lá ak-šu-da-a-šu
target: Also, concerning Puzur-Aššur, about whom you wrote, I have not caught up with him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam GÉME-tí-šu ú-ša-i-il₅-ma um-ma šu-nu-ma 44 GÚ URUDU ma-sí-a-am ší-ta e-ri-qá-tim e-pu-<gap>
target: I questioned his maid here, and they said: "He <gap> 40 talents of washed copper and two wagons <gap>"

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-dí-da ú a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi-ma um-ma dá-mì-iq-pì-a-šur-ma
target: To Adida and Ali-ahum from Damiq-pī-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 24 TÚG i-na 6 na-ru-qá-tim i-na ḫu-ur-ší-im ku-nu-ki-a e-zi-ib
target: I left 24 textiles in 6 sacks in the storeroom under my seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ.BA 12 TÚG dam-qú-tum 8 TÚG tár-dí-ú-tum 4 TÚG ša uš-ma-a
target: Thereof: 12 good textiles, 8 second quality textiles, 4 textiles belonging to Ušmaya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma ḫu-ur-šu-um lá ša-ṣú-ur TÚG-ba-tí-a a-šar ša-ṣú-ru-ú šu-uk-na
target: If the store-room is not guarded, then place the textiles where they will be under guard.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫu-ú-a a-tù-nu TÚG-ba-tí-a dí-na-ma KÙ.BABBAR li-im-ḫu-ra-ni
target: My dear brothers, sell my textiles so that the silver is ready for me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ba-áb-tám lá a-ra-ší a-na i-ta-aṭ-li-im dí-na
target: I should not have any outstanding claims. Sell for cash on delivery.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.3333 ma-na 1 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR 21 ma-na 10 GÍN URUDU SIG₅ ša e-zi-ba-ku-ni-tí-ni URUDU a-na KÙ.BABBAR dí-na-ma KÙ.BABBAR ku-un-kà-ma li-ib-ší
target: As to 0.3333 mina 1 shekel of silver (and) 21 minas 10 shekels of copper of good quality that I left with you - sell the copper for silver, seal it and let it remain.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR 1 SÌLA Ì.GIŠ e-ma-ṣa-am i-na ḫu-ur-ší-im le-qé-a-ma iš-tí ša-lim-be-lí ú DU₁₀-ṣí-lá-a-šur šé-bi-lá-nim
target: Take 10 shekels of silver (and) 1 litre of oil (in) an -container in the store-room and send it with Šalim-bēlī and Ṭāb-ṣill-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṣú-ba-tí ša ša-lim-be-lí ú-šé-ra-ba-ni li-ib-ší
target: Let the textiles which Šalim-bēlī will bring in remain.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-dí-da qí-bi₄-ma i-na TÚG-ba-tí-kà 1 ra-qá-tám 1 bu-ra-um ša ma-i
target: To Adida: In your textiles buy for me 1 thin one and 1 waterproof ʾ.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR <gap> ṣa-ru-pá-am ku-nu-ki-a ú ša 3 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR sà-ḫi-ir-tám mì-ma a-nim ku-nu-ki-a a-na ili₅-tù-ra-am ÌR ša É a-zu ù ša-lim-a-šur tap-pá-i-šu áp-qí-id-ma
target: 0.5 mina of refined silver under my seal plus small goods worth 3 shekels of silver - all this, under my seal, I entrusted to Ilī-tūram, the slave from Azu's firm, and his partner Šalim-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: <gap>-ba-ni SIG₅-pí-a-šur DUMU ÌR-ì-lí-šu ú-šé-bi-il₅-šu IGI šu-IŠTAR DUMU šu-ki-tim IGI lá-qé-ep DUMU šu-a-šùr
target: I sent it to <gap>-bāni, Damiq-pī-Aššur son of Warad-ilišu.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-lá-ḫi-im be-lúm-ba-ni a-ni-na ú a-šur-ma-lik qí-bi-ma um-ma zu-ku-a-ma
target: To Ali-ahum, Bēlum-bāni, Annina and Aššur-malik from Zukuwa:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.3333 ma-na 7 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR e-zi-ba-ku-nu-tí um-ma a-na-ku-ma 10.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-lá-ḫu-um lu-ra-dí-ma 0.5 ma-na 7.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na i-dí-a-šur šu-uq-lá
target: I left you 0.3333 mina 7 shekels of silver, and I said: Let Ali-ahum add 10.5 shekels of silver and pay 0.5 mina 7.5 shekels of silver to Iddin-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ta-áš-pu-ra-nim um-ma a-tù-nu-ma KÙ.BABBAR a-na i-dí-a-šur nu-kà-i-il₅-ma lá-qá-am lá i-mu-a
target: You then wrote and said: "We offered the silver to Iddin-Aššur, but he would not take it."

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù u₄-mì-im ša tù-kà-i-lá-šu-ni ta-aḫ-sí-is-tám i-dá ḫa-mu-uš-tám ú ITU.1.KAM wa-dí-a
target: Note on a memorandum the day when you offered it to him. Indicate the week and the month.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.3333 ma-na 7 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša e-zi-ba-ku-nu-tí-ni a-na i-dí-a-šur šu-uq-lá
target: Pay the 0.3333 mina 7 shekels of silver that I left with you to Iddin-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú ma-lá ta-áš-ta-aq-lá-ni KÙ.BABBAR a-na a-lá-ḫi-im a-dí tí-ir-tí i-lá-kà-ni li-dí-in
target: Also, what you have paid, let him give the silver to Ali-ahum until my instructions arrive.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫu-a-tù-nu a-dí ma-lá ú ší-ni-šu tí-ir-tí i-li-kà-ku-nu-tí-ma a tí-ir-tí-a iḫ-da
target: My dear brothers, I sent word to you once or twice, so do pay attention to my instructions.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pí ša nu-a-e ša e-lá-nu e-zi-ba-ku-nu-tí-ni be-lúm-ba-ni i ša-ḫa-tí-ku-nu li-zi-iz-ma iḫ-da-ma KÙ.BABBAR a-wi-li ša-áš-qí-lá
target: As to the tablets concerning Anatolians that I also left with you, have Bēlum-bāni assist you and take care to have the men pay the silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša-tum ša-na-at KÙ.BABBAR ma-lá nu-a-e tù-ša-áš-qá-lá-ni a-na be-lúm-ba-ni dí-na
target: A year has gone by. The silver you make the Anatolians pay, give that to Bēlum-bāni.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù ša-lá-tù-wa-ar KÙ.BABBAR a-na a-lim{ki} a-ta-na-ší a-li-ik
target: I went from Salatuwar silver to the City I use to carry.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR li-tí i-ṣé-er a-šur-ta-ak-lá-ku DUMU a-a-a šu-be-lúm i-šu
target: 4 shekels of silver Aššur-taklāku son of A'aya owes to Šu-Bēlum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù ḫa-mu-uš-tim ša a-šur-ta-ak-lá-ku ù e-me-me a-na ITU.KAM i-ša-qal
target: Reckoned from the week of Aššur-taklāku and Ememe he will pay within a month.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma i-na ú-mì-šu ma-al-ú-tim lá iš-qúl 22.5 ŠE KÙ.BABBAR i-na ITU.KAM ú-ṣa-áb
target: If he does not pay when his term is due he will add 1 / 8 shekel of silver per month.

source: translate Akkadian to English: li-mu-um a-šur-na-da IGI a-šur-i-dí
target: Year eponymy of Aššur-nādā. Witnessed by Aššur-idī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na DINGIR-mu-ta-bi-il₅ qí-bi-ma um-ma en-um-a-šùr-ma a-na-kam a-na-ku ù lá-qé-ep DUMU šu-a-šùr i-na ma-aḫ-ri-kà ù IGI lá-qé-ep DUMU PUZUR₄-ša-du-e i-na É kà-ší-im ni-kà-sí ni-sí-ma 12.5 ma-na 7 GÍN ṣa-ru-pá-am e-zi-ib KÙ.BABBAR e-li-tí-ni i-na li-bi lá-qé-ep iš-tù ḫa-muš-tim ša i-tur₄-DINGIR a-na KÙ.BABBAR ku-a-tí ú-ša-zi-iz
target: To Ilī-mutabbil from Ennam-Aššur: Here I and Lā-qēp son of Šu-Aššur settled accounts in the house of the official with you and Lā-qēp son of Puzur-šadu'e as witnesses, and 12.5 minas 7 shekels of refined silver — apart from the silver of our caravan — is owed by Lā-qēp.

source: translate Akkadian to English: Reckoned from the week of Itūr-ilī.
target: Reckoned from the week of Itūr-ilī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: With respect to the silver it was you I designated.
target: With respect to the silver it was you I designated.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na pu-ru-uš-ḫa-dim i-na e-ra-bi-šu-ma KÙ.BABBAR ú-šé-ba-lam
target: On his arrival in Purušhaddum, he should send the silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR i-na pu-ru-uš-ḫa-dim i-na e-ra-bi-šu-ma a-na ma-lá a-wa-tí-ni a-na KÙ.BABBAR ša ú-ša-zi-za-ku-ni-ma KÙ.BABBAR lá iš-ta-aq-lu a-ta ṭup-pu-šu ta-al-pu-ut-ma u₄-me-e ta-áš-ku-šu-um
target: When he arrived in Purušhaddum in accordance with our agreement you write a tablet for him for the silver for which I had designated you and which he did not pay, and you set a term for him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù a-ṣé-er ša ki-ma i-a-tí ù ku-a-tí a-na KÙ.BABBAR ša-áš-qú-lim áš-ta-pá-ra-šu-ma KÙ.BABBAR a-na ša ki-ma i-a-tí ù ku-a-tí a-dí u₄-mì-im a-nim lá iš-ta-qá-lá-ni
target: Also, I kept writing to my representatives and you to have the silver paid, but until this day he has not paid the silver to my representatives or to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù iš-tù a-na-ku a-lá-kà-ni KÙ.BABBAR i-ta-ri-šu-ma i-ta-ri-šu-ma KÙ.BABBAR ta-da-nam ú-lá i-mu-a
target: Also, after I personally arrived, he demanded and demanded the silver repeatedly, but he would not pay the silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-ut-ma ṭup-pì DINGIR-mu-ta-bi-il₅ il₅-pu-ut a-na ṭu
target: He said: "Ilī-mutabbil wrote my tablet. Send for my tablet, let them bring my tablet and then take your silver."

source: translate Akkadian to English: <gap> 2 ší-na <gap>-a a-<gap> ku-nu-ki ša ḫa-nu <gap> a-na-ku <gap> i-na tí-me-el-ki-a a-na a-lá-bi-im DUMU a-šur-e-mu-qí e-zi-ib
target: I personally left two sealed by hanu in Timelkiya with Ali-abum son of Aššur-emūqī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: tí-ir-ta-kà a-ṣé-er a-lá-bi-im li-li-ik-ma TÚG li-dí-na-kum
target: Send word to Ali-abum so that he may give the textiles to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na en-na-sú-in ú a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi-ma um-ma MAN-a-šur-ma
target: To Enna-Suen and Ali-ahum from Puzur-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na 2 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ku-nu-ki-a i-na pu-ru-uš-ḫa-dim a-na en-na-nim DUMU a-bi₄-a e-zi-ib
target: I left 0.5 mina 2 shekels of silver under my seal in Purušhaddum with Ennānum son of Abiya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na ḫa-ra-nim ni-mì-ḫi-ir-ma um-ma a-na-ku-ma KÙ.BABBAR ša a-dí-na-ku-ni dí-nam
target: We met each other on the road, and I said: Give me the silver I gave to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-ut-ma a-ta-a-a a-na ṣé-ri-kà ú-šé-bi-lam
target: He answered: I sent it to you with Ataya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam a-ta-a-a aṣ-ba-at-ma um-ma a-na-ku-ma KÙ.BABBAR ša en-na-num ú-šé-bi₄-lá-kà-ni KÙ.BABBAR dí-nam
target: I seized Ataya here and said: The silver that Ennanum sent to me with you, give me that silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-ta-a-a-ma mì-ma KÙ.BABBAR en-na-num ú-lá i-dí-nam a-šar i-dí-na-ni ší-bi₄ lu-šé-li-a-ma 1.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a-ša-qá-lá-ku-um
target: Ataya said: Ennānum did not give me any silver. Let him produce witnesses that he gave it to me, then I shall pay you 1.5 mina of silver!

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-kam en-na-nàm ṣa-áb-ta-ma 0.5 ma-na 2 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ku-nu-ki-a li-dí-na-ku-nu-tí
target: Seize Ennānum there and have him give you the 0.5 mina 2 shekels of silver under my seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma en-na-num KÙ.BABBAR ta-da-nam lá i-mu-a-ku-nu-tí da-na-at-ku-nu qí-bi₄-a-šu-um
target: If Ennānum refuses to pay you the silver, then state to him your harsh conditions.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma um-ma en-na-num-ma a-na a-ta-a-ma a-dí-in ší-bi-šu li-iz-ku-ra-ku-nu-tí-ma i ša-ḫa-tí-šu i-zi-za-ma ṭup-pá-am ša ší-bi₄-šu KÁ DINGIR le-qé-a-nim lu-šé-tí-qám
target: If Ennānum says: I did give it to Ataya! then have him swear in his witnesses to you, assist and take the tablet with his witnesses in the Gate of God. Let him bring it overland to me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ša en-na-nim iš-té-ni-iš ku-un-kà-ma a pá-ni
target: Seal silver of Ennānum's jointly and send it to me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ša-lim-ma-ma a-na šu-IŠTAR ù a-na a-šùr-i-mì-tí qí-bi-ma
target: Thus Šalimma, say to Šu-Ištar, and Aššur-imittī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-šùr-i-mì-tí qí-bi-ma me-er-i a-ta ta-ma-lá-ki ša ṭup-pé-a pí-tí-a-ma ṭup-pá-am ša ḫu-bu-ul ili₅-ba-ni šé-li-a-ma
target: Especially to Aššur-imittī: Please, my son, open my tablet coffer and take out of it the tablet of the debt of Ilī-bāni.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-IŠTAR lu-ub-lá-šu a-na-kam
target: Let Šu-Ištar bring it here.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṣa-al-tám iš-tí-a e-pu-uš-ma li-bi₄-i da-ni-iš uš-ta-am-ri-iṣ
target: Here he has started a fight with me and has offended me seriously.

source: translate Akkadian to English: me-er-ú-a a-tù-nu iḫ-da
target: Please, my sons, pay attention!

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i li-be ṣú-li-a a-lá-ḫu-um i-šu
target: Ṣulliya owes 3 shekels of silver to Ali-ahum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ḫa-ra-ni a-ku-ša-am
target: my journey was disrupted

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù ma-tí-ma šé-bu-ul-tí lá i-li-kà-ki-im
target: and my shipment never did come to you (fem.)

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-nu-mì i-dí-a-bu-um a-na mu-a-tim ta-ad-nu-ma É a-šùr-be-el-a-wa-tim wa-áš-bu
target: When Iddin-abum was dying and was staying in Aššur-bēl-awātim's house.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša ki-ma ili₅-ba-ni ÌR ù DAM.GÀR-ru-šu e-ru-bu-ma
target: The representatives of Ilī-bāni, Wardum and his customers, came in(to the house).

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ša ki-ma ili₅-ba-ni-ma ni-kà-sí iš-tí-ni ší-sí
target: Ilī-bāni's representatives said: Settle accounts with us!

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma i-dí-a-bu-um-ma ṭup-pí-ku-nu kà-i-lá ù ṭup-pu-a lá-pu-tù-ma i-ba-ší-ú
target: Iddin-abum answered: Keep your tablets, for my tablets are written and available.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša-lim-a-šùr a-ḫi li-li-kam-ma iš-tí-šu ší-sí-a
target: Let my brother Šalim-Aššur come, and then settle with him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù am-ma ša ki-ma i-a-tí šu-{d}EN.LÍL ù a-mur-IŠTAR i-ša-ḫa-at a-ḫi-a li-zi-zu
target: Then my own representatives, Šu-Illil and Amur-Ištar may assist my brother.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí a-ḫi i-lá-kà-ni ma-ma-an ṭup-pí-a lá i-pá-té
target: Until my brother arrives no one may open my tablets.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um kà-ni-iš i-dí-ni-a-tí-ma
target: The Kanesh colony gave us for these proceedings.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI GÍR ša a-šùr i ba-áb DINGIR-lim ṭup-pá-am ni-dí-in
target: We gave our testimony before Aššur's dagger in the Gate of the God.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-ku-za IGI lá-qé-ep IGI ṣí-lu-lu
target: Witnessed by Akuza, by Lā-qēp, by Ṣilūlu.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 18 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ší-im ku-ta-nim a-na sà-li-a áš-qúl
target: I paid 18 shekels of silver as the price for a kutānu to Salliya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-nu-nu-a ù ib-na-{d}IM
target: Witnessed by Anunuwa and Ibni-Adad.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na-sú-in a-na dan-a-šur ir-gu₅-um
target: Enna-Suen lodged a complaint against Dan-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma i-na-sú-in-ma a-na dan-a-šur-ma ša a-bu-kà i-ṣé-er a-bi-a lá i-šu-ú ù šu-mì a-bi-kà i ṭup-pì-im lá wa-du-ú
target: Enna-Suen said to Dan-Aššur: Although your father has no claim on my father and your father's name is not indicated on the tablet.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ta a-na 12 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ù ṣí-ba-tí-šu sí-ki tù-kà-al
target: Yet you detain me for a claim of 12 minas of silver and its interest.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù a-ša qá-ta-tim ta-ta-na-dí-na-ni ù ku-tù-a-tí-a tù-kà-ta
target: And you turn me over to a guarantor and also take things as security from me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu a-ni-a-ma a-ḫe-e i-šu ṭup-pá-am li-dí-šu-ma šu-ma a-bu-kà i-ṣé-er a-bi₄-a i-šu KÙ.BABBAR-ma ḫu-bu-ul a-bi₄-a-ma qá-dí a-ḫi-a-ma a-za-za-ku-um
target: So may it be like this: I have brothers. Let him give him the tablet and if your father had a claim on my father, then I shall stand up for you with respect to the silver, my father's debt, together with my brothers.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lá tù-na-ḫa-ni ù KÙ.BABBAR ma-dam lá tù-ša-ag-ma-ra-ni
target: Do not cause me trouble and make me spend a lot of silver!

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.8333 ma-na 1 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ší-im 5 šu-ul-ḫi ù 3 ša qá-tim
target: 0.8333 mina 1 shekel of silver, the price of 2 šulhus and 3 ordinary (textiles),

source: translate Akkadian to English: i li-bi a-we-el-tim tù-um-li-a-i-tim
target: is owed by the lady of Tumliya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na ḫa-ra-nim ni-lá-ak-ma um-ma da-da-a-ma a-na a-šur-na-da-ma ṭup-pu-um ša ḫu-bu-li-kà É wa-áb-ri-a i-ba-ší ù qá-dí ṭup-pí-kà ša KÙ.BABBAR 10 ma-na ṭup-pu-ú ša e-ri-ší-im É wa-áb-ri-a i-ba-ší
target: We will go on a trip and Dadaya said as follows to Aššur-nādā: The tablet concerning your debt is in my guest-house and together with your tablet concerning some 10 minas of silver the tablets concerning Erišum are in my guest-house.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR 0.5 ma-na dí-na-ma ṭup-pá-kà du-uk
target: Give me at least 0.5 mina of silver and invalidate your tablet.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-šur-na-da-ma <gap> ša me-er-ú i-a-a ù me-er-ú e-ri-ší-im lá i-ma-ḫu-ru-ni-ni ṭup-pá-am ša ku-nu-ki-kà ta-da-nam ù KÙ.BABBAR 0.5 ma-na lá-dí-na-ku-um
target: Aššur-nādā answered: "As the sons of Yaya and the sons of Erišum do not approach me <gap> give me the tablet under your seal, then I shall give you at least 0.5 mina of silver."

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um kà-ni-iš i-dì-ni-a-tí-ma IGI GÍR ša a-šùr ší-bu-tí-ni ni-dí-in
target: The Kanesh colony gave us for these proceedings and we gave our testimony before Aššur's dagger.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI id-na-a DUMU i-ba-a IGI <gap>-a-šur DUMU a-šur-i-mì-tí
target: Witnessed by Idnaya son of Ibaya, by <gap> son of Aššur-imittī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ḫi-na-a-ma a-na e-lá-ma ú a-šur-ṣú-lu-li qí-bi-ma
target: Thus hinnāya, say to Elamma and Aššur-ṣulūlī:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 né-pí-šu-ú KÙ.BABBAR 40 ma-na šu-qú-ul-ta-šu-nu ù 2 ma-na KÙ.GI i ḫu-ur-ší-a-ni ša a-na i-lim e-ru-ba-at-ni na-dí-i ku-nu-ki-a a-šur-DU₁₀ DUMU a-šur-kàr-wa na-áš-a-ku-nu-tí
target: 3 packets with silver, weighing 40 minas, and 2 minas of gold - it is in a container that has been placed inside the bag - Aššur-ṭāb, son of Aššur-karwa, is bringing you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ku-nu-ki-a a-šur-DU₁₀ li-ip-qí-da-ku-nu-tí-ma i-lúm ša ḫu-ur-ší-a-num ša-ak-na-at-ni i-na ku-nu-ki-a É e-lá-ma li-bi₄-ší
target: Aššur-ṭāb must entrust it to you under my seal and the bag in which the is placed must remain in Elamma's house under my seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.5 DUG a-lá-ni <gap> DUG ra-bi-tim ù 22 ma-na URUDU SIG₅ i li-bi a-lá-ni na-dí-i ku-nu-ki-a i-lá-li-ú-ma-an na-áš-a-ku-um
target: 1.5 jar of acorns of a big jar, with 22 minas of refined copper, put there between the acorns, Ilaliuman is bringing to you under my seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: DUG a-ḫa-ma a-lá-ni ku-nu-ki ša-ak-tù-nu-a na-áš-a-ku-um
target: Separately a jar with acorns with the seals of Šaktunua he is bringing you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-lá-ni ku-nu-ki-a li-ip-qí-du-ni-ku-ma i-na ku-nu-ki-a li-bi-ší
target: The acorns he must entrust to you under my seal and they must remain under my seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma <gap> ILLAT-tám e-ta-ar-ba-a-am <gap> li-li-kà-nim
target: Should the caravan have already arrived, the must come here.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam iš-tí kà-ri-im na-am-gu₅-ra-ku
target: Here I have reached an agreement with the colony.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma TÚG.ḪI.A i-šé-ru-nim šé-bi₄-lá-nim
target: If the textiles to you, send them here.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù šu-ma lá-ma sú-ku-ur-tim e-ru-bu-nim <gap>
target: and if they arrive.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma <gap> ù lá-ma-sí-ma a-na <gap> a-dí-da a-ba-ba ù a-la-ḫi-im qí-bi₄-ma
target: From <gap> and Lamassī to Adida, Ababa and Ali-ahum:

source: translate Akkadian to English: ta-áš-pu-ra-nim-ma i-na na-áš-pè-er-tí-ku-nu um-ma a-tù-nu-ma a-lu-wa u₄-ma-kál lá i-sà-ḫu-ur a pá-ni-a a ḫa-ra-ni li-ik-šu-dam
target: You have written and in your missive you said: Aluwa must not delay a single day. Let him catch up with me on the journey.

source: translate Akkadian to English: u₄-ma-am iš-tù ITU.3.KAM a-lu-wa ni-iṭ-ru-da-ma ù a-na u₄-mì-im a-nim mì-ma ša <gap> lá ni-iš-me
target: Today it is 3 months since we sent Aluwa and until this day we have heard nothing concerning <gap>

source: translate Akkadian to English: ku-nu-ki ša a-bi₄-ni IGI a-lá-ḫi-im DUMU e-lá-lí IGI i-dí-a-šur DUMU dan-a-šùr IGI ṣí-lu-uš-da-gan ni-sú-ùḫ-ma URUDU nu-sá-ni-iq-ma 47 GÚ URUDU ṣa-lá-mu-um
target: We removed our father's sealings before Ali-ahum son of Elāli, Iddin-Aššur son of Dan-Aššur, and Ṣilluš-Dagān, and we checked the copper, and there were 47 talents of black copper.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ.BA 7 GÚ URUDU a-qú-bu-ur a-bi-ni ga-me-er
target: Thereof 7 talents of copper was used for our father's grave.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-wi-lu a-ni-ú-tum-ma ik-nu-ku
target: These men sealed it.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 TÚG zi-ri 1 TÚG a-bar-ni-um 1 TÚG i-na É.GAL-lim 1 ANŠE SIG₅ ni-da-an-ma me-at sá-da-li ší-im-šu-nu i-na a-ba-an É.GAL-lim ni-lá-qé
target: 2 -textiles, 1 Abarnian textile, 1 textile in the palace, 1 good donkey - we sold (this), and we shall receive 100 -ingots as the price of these things measured with the weight-stone of the palace.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB en-na-sú-in DUMU i-ku-a KIŠIB sà-li-a DUMU i-dí-a-šùr KIŠIB a-šùr-na-da DUMU en-um-a-šùr KIŠIB SIG₅-pí-a-šùr KIŠIB ma-ma-ḫi-ir DUMU a-mur-IŠTAR
target: Sealed by Enna-Suen son of Ikuwa, by Salliya son of Iddin-Aššur by Aššur-nādā son of Ennam-Aššur, by Damiq-pī-Aššur, by Man-mahir son of Amur-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 30 GÚ URUDU sá-ḫi-ra-am ša dur₄-ḫu-mì-it i-ṣé-er ma-ma-ḫi-ir DUMU a-mur-IŠTAR šál-ma-a-šur i-šu
target: Man-mahir son of Amur-Ištar owes 30 talents of -copper from Durhumit to Šalim-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na e-ra-bi-šu-ma a-na ša-lá-tù-wa-ar ITU.1.KAM i-lá-ak-ma KÙ.BABBAR a-na ša ki-ma šu-a-tí ú-šé-ba-lam-ma URUDU i-ša-qú-lu
target: On his arrival at Šalatuwar one month will pass, and then he will send silver to his representatives, and they will pay the copper.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma lá iš-qú-lu ki-ma a-wa-at kà-ri-im ṣí-ib-tám ú-ṣa-áb
target: If they have not paid, he will add interest in accordance with the tariff of the colony.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB šu-ma-bi-a DUMU i-bi₄-ZU KIŠIB šu-be-lim DUMU DINGIR-ku-ru-ub KIŠIB sà-li-a DUMU i-dí-a-šur KIŠIB
target: Sealed by Šum-abiya son of Ibbi-Sīn, by Šu-Belum son of Ilī-kurub, by Salliya son of Iddin-Aššur, by Enna-Suen son of Ikuwa, by his daughter haditum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tí tù-ta-a šé-bi₄-lá-šu
target: Send him with Tutaya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma a-ma-kam mu-ta-er a-wa-tí-kà i-na pu-ùḫ-ri-im i-ta-áb-ší
target: If there has appeared an opponent of your case there in the assembly.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ta-mu-zi e-lá-a ù a-dí-da ša i-na ší-ma-at a-bi-a a-ma-kam na-lu-ni-ma i-na ku-nu-ki-šu-nu ší-ma-at a-bi-a kà-an-kà-at-ni a-na pu-ùḫ-ri-im šu-du-da-ma
target: Then drag Šu-Tammuzi, Elaya and Adida, who have been lying on my father's testament there, and with whose seals my father's testament has been sealed, drag them to the assembly.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-lim{ki} pí-šu-nu li-ip-té-ú-ma ki-ma a-wa-at ṭup-pí-im ša a-na-kam pá-aq-du e-pu-uš
target: Have them open their mouths before the City assembly and act in accordance with the words of the tablet that has been entrusted here.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-bi a-ta i-ḫi-id
target: My dear father, be careful!

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5.8333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša a šu-mì a-mur-a-šur DUMU ba-ba-lá-nim zu-ku-a a-lá-ḫu-um e-pu-lu
target: 5.8333 minas of silver that Zukuwa (and) Ali-ahum balanced on behalf of Amur-Aššur son of Babalānum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2-ší-ta na-áš-pé-ra-tum lá pá-tí-a-tum ša a-ta-ta DUMU ma-num-ba-lum-a-šùr a-ṣé-ri-a ú a-ṣé-er a-šùr-e-nam DUMU ku-bi-a
target: 2 (unopened) letters of Atata, son of Mannum-balum-Assur, addressed to me and to Assur-ennam, son of Kubiya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2-ší-ta na-áš-pé-ra-tum ša a-bi₄-ni lá pá-tí-a-tum a-na be-lúm-ba-ni DUMU šu-be-lim
target: Two (unopened) letters of our father to Belum-bani, son of Su-Belum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-um ša ku-nu-uk PÚZUR-a-šur DUMU a-ḫu-qar ša a-na i-a-tí a-šùr-ták-lá-ku ù a-bi-a-a lá i-tu-ru
target: A tablet (with the seal) of Puzur-Assur (son of Ahuqar), that he will not come back on me, Abiya and Assur-taklaku.

source: translate Akkadian to English: na-áš-pé-er-tum ša a-bi₄-ni a-na šál-ma-a-šur DUMU ili₅-ba-ni
target: A letter of our father to Salim-Assur (son of Ili-bani).

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-um ša ni-pì-il₅-tí-a
target: A tablet of the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-um ša 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša be-ú-lá-at a-šùr-ták-lá-ku DUMU a-šùr-ma-lik DUMU a-ri-a
target: A tablet about 1 mina of silver the working capital of Assur-taklaku, son of Assur-malik, son of Ariya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-um ša 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša be-ú-lá-at a-šur-ták-lá-ku DUMU da-da-nim
target: A tablet about 1 mina of silver, the working capital of Assur-taklaku, son of Dadanum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-um ša ba-áb i-lim ša ka-nu-tim
target: A tablet about the <gap> of the wife of Adaya about the price paid for a house.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-um ša 0.3333 ma-na 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša be-ú-lá-at a-bu-ša-lim ú e-dí-na-a a-ḫi-šu
target: A tablet about 0.3333 (and 5 shekels) of silver the working capital of Abu-salim and his brother Edinaya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-um ša 12 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša a-zi-da-a DUMU šál-ma-a-šur
target: A tablet about 12 shekels of silver of Azida, son of Salim-Assur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-um ša 8 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša i-ku-pí-a DUMU ša ṣa-al-me-e
target: A tablet about 8 shekels of silver of Ikuppiya, the son of Salme.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-šùr-ni-im-ri ù a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi-ma um-ma a-ḫi-a-ma
target: To Aššur-nimrī and Ali-ahum from Ahiya:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 ṭup-pé-en ša a-šùr-ták-lá-ku DUMU ma-lá-kà-a 1 ṭup-pu-um ša 2 ma-na 10 GÍN ù ša-ni-um ša 5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša ta-ar-ki-is-tim i-na li-bi₄ ṭup-pè-e i-ba-ší-ú
target: 2 tablets concerning Aššur-taklāku son of Malakaya, 1 tablet concerning 2 minas 10 shekels and a second one concerning 5 minas of silver, a debt-note - are among the tablets.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-ú ku-nu-ku ša i-na ḫu-ur-ší-im ša li-pì-it-IŠTAR i-na ma-ak-ni-ki-im i-na e-ra-bi-ku-nu-ma a-na ṣé-ri-šu qá-at-ku-nu lu ša-ak-nu
target: As to the sealed tablets that are in Lipit-Ištar's safe in a sealed container, right when you arrive your claim should be made to them.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú ṭup-pì-a i-na ku-nu-ki-ku-nu ku-un-kà ṭup-pí ki-lá-li-ma ku-un-kà
target: and seal my tablets with your seals. Seal both of the tablets;

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú i ṣí-li-a-ni šé-ri-a-šu-nu-ma a-na {d}UTU.SIPA dí-na-ma lu-ub-lam
target: also, take them in the containers and give them to Šamaš-rē'ī so he may bring them.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam a-na ṭup-pì-a a-tí-ki-il₅-ma lu-qú-ut a-šùr-ták-lá-ku aṣ-ba-at-ma ù sí-ku-šu ú-kà-al
target: Confident of my tablets I seized Aššur-taklāku's goods here and I also detain him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ut ṭup-pè-e i-tí-ki-ir ù um-ma šu-ut-ma šu-ma ṭup-pì-a lá ta-tab-al a ma-lá ta-ar-gu₅-ma-ni ta-ša-qá-al
target: He, on the other hand, contests the tablets, so he says: If you do not bring my tablets, you will pay in accordance with what you claimed from me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-pu-tum ṭup-pè-e šé-bi₄-lá-ni-im
target: Urgent, send the tablets.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pì e ták-lá-a-ma a-wi-lúm É a-bi₄-a e it-ba-al
target: Do not hold back the tablets lest the man ruins my father's house.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ba-ú-a be-lu-ú-a a-tù-nu u₄-um e-ṭá-ri-im iṭ-ra-ni
target: My dear fathers and lords, save me while I can still be saved.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-dí-a-šùr qí-bi-ma um-ma en-um-a-šur-ma
target: To Iddin-Aššur from Ennam-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: GÚ URUDU SIG₅ ša ki-ma a-bi-ni a-ma-kam ta-pu-lu-ni
target: talents of good copper that you balanced there on behalf of our father

source: translate Akkadian to English: 9 GÚ 20 ma-na URUDU SIG₅ a-na i-dí-a-šùr ù li-lá a-na-ku-ma qá-dum sà-ḫi-ri-im e-zi-ib-šu-nu-tí-ma
target: 9 talents 20 minas of good copper I personally left to Iddin-Aššur and Lila together with the -copper,

source: translate Akkadian to English: URUDU 20 GÚ 40 ma-na URUDU a-lá-ḫu-um i-dí-a-šur e-zi-ib-ma ú-ṣa-ḫi-ir-šu i-na ma-ṣa-ar-tim na-dí
target: Ali-ahum (with) Iddin-Aššur left 20 talents 40 minas of copper and he debited him for it. It is desposited in the safe.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na ŠÀ URUDU ša e-zi-bu GÚ 5 ma-na URUDU SIG₅ ma-ma-ḫi-ir
target: Of the copper that he left talents 5 minas of good copper Man-mahir

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ma-ma-ḫi-ir ú SIG₅-pí-a-šur-ma a-na a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi-ma
target: From Man-mahir and Damiq-pī-Aššur to Ali-ahum:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 GÚ 10 ma-na AN.NA ku-nu-ki-kà SIG₅-pí-a-šur ub-lam
target: Damiq-pī-Aššur brought 1 talent 10 minas of tin under your seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 7 GÍN.TA ni-dí-in-šu-ma 1 ma-na AN.NA ni-ik-bu-us
target: We sold it at the rate 7:1, and we subtracted 1 mina of tin.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 7 ma-na 14 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ú 16.75 GÍN KÙ.GI ší-im AN.NA-ki-kà iz-ku-am-ma
target: 7 minas 14 shekels of silver and 17 less 1 / 4 shekels of gold was cleared as the price of your tin,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 15 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša-du-at AN.NA ú e-ri-ib-tim a bé-et kà-ri-im ni-dí-in
target: and we gave 15 shekels of silver as the transport tariff and the entrance fee for the tin to the colony office.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 12 GÚ URUDU SIG₅ ú 1 GÚ lu-lu-um SIG₅-pí-a-šur ub-lam
target: Damiq-pī-Aššur brought 12 talents of good copper and 1 talent of .

source: translate Akkadian to English: URUDU nu-sá-ni-iq-ma 1 GÚ-tum 1 ma-na.TA im-ṭí
target: We checked the copper, and one mina was missing on each talent.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú-ma-am ku-nu-ki-kà ni-is-ni-iq-ma 8 GÍN im-ṭí
target: Today we checked your seal, and 8 shekels were missing.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na.TA URUDU-kà 1 GÍN.TA a-na KÙ.BABBAR ni-dí-šu
target: We sold your copper for one shekel of silver per mina.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.8333 ma-na 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ší-im lu-lu-im
target: The price of the was 55 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠU.NÍGIN KÙ.BABBAR-pí-kà lu ší-im URUDU lu ší-im lu-lu-im 12.8333 ma-na 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR iz-ku-am-ma
target: The total of your silver, both the price of the copper and of the was cleared as 12.8333 minas 5 shekels of silver,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ.BA 1 ma-na 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ma-ma-ḫi-ir il₅-qé
target: and of that Man-mahir took 1 mina 10 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 22 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR SIG₅-pí-a-šur il₅-qé
target: Damiq-pī-Aššur took 22 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 17 GÍN lu ša-du-ú-tum lu e-ri-ib-tum a-na É kà-ri-im ni-dí-in
target: 17 shekels was either the transport tariff or the entrance fee - we paid it to the office of the colony.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-tí KÙ.BABBAR-pí-kà 11 ma-na 6 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am ku-nu-ki-ni SIG₅-pí-a-šur na-áš-a-kum
target: The remainder of your silver, 11 minas 6 shekels of refined silver, under our seals, Damiq-pī-Aššur brings to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma e-la-ma-ma a-na la-qé-ep qí-bi-ma
target: Thus Elamma, say to Lā-qēpum:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 24.3333 ma-na 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ù 0.5 ma-na 3 GÍN KÙ.GI i-na pá-ni né-pí-ší-im na-dí ku-nu-ki-a šu-ku-bu-um DUMU šu-sú-in na-áš-a-kum
target: 24 minas 25 shekels of silver, with 33 shekels of gold placed at the top of the packet, under my seals, Šu-Kūbum, son of Šu-Suen, is on his way to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KI a-li-ki-im pá-ni-im-ma a-na DUMU um-me-a-nim <gap> pí-qí-id-ma a-na ṣé-er um-me-a-ni-a ú a-na ša ki-ma i-a-tí a-na a-lim{ki} lu-ub-lu
target: Entrust it to an affiliated trader so that one may bring it with the next caravan to my investors and representatives to the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 15 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na i-li-a 2.3333 ma-na a-na en-um-a-šur 0.3333 ma-na a-na da-dí-a
target: 15 shekels of silver for Iliya, 2.3333 minas for Ennam-Aššur, 0.3333 mina for Dadiya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR <gap> áš-qúl <gap> a-<gap> i-na ḫu-ur-ší-a-nim kà-an-ku šu-ku-bu-um na-áš-a-kum a-na ṣé-er da-dí-a ú en-nam-a-šur šé-bi-il₅-šu-nu
target: are under seal in a -container, Šu-Kūbum is bringing you; send them to Dadiya and Ennam-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 ma-na ku-nu-ki-a {d}UTU-ba-ni DUMU A-ki tim ub-lá-kum
target: 5 minas (of silver) under my seal Šamaš-bāni, son of Akutum, brought you,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša ša-lim-a-ḫi-im KÙ.BABBAR ša-bi-ma ší-tí KÙ.BABBAR iš-tí-kà li-ib-ší
target: satisfy with that silver the claim of Šalim-ahum and keep the rest with you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma TÚG.ḪI.A-tí ší-tap-ku-um i-ba-ší ú-ul KÙ.BABBAR ší-tap-kum i-ba-ší ŠÀ.BA qá-tí i-ta-dí-a
target: If there is a possibility to invest textiles or to invest silver, deposit my share by taking it from (this shipment).

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma ḫa-ra-kà a-na bu-ru-uš-ḫa-tim i-ba-ší ṣú-ḫa-ru-um iš-tí-kà-ma li-li-ik lá té-zi-ib-šu
target: Should your trip to Burušhattum, take place, then let the boy go with you, do not leave him behind.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-mur-a-šur DUMU ì-lí-ba-ni ṣa-ba-at-ma KÙ.BABBAR <gap> ša-á
target: Seize Amur-Aššur, son of Ilī-bāni, and make <him> pay the silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: TÚG šu-ra-am a-na 11 GÍN a-na É kà-ri-im a-dí-i
target: one dark colored textile I deposited for 11 shekels at the colonial office.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na 2 ma-na 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša i-na ni-kà-sé a-na e-lá-ma i-na-pu-lu-ni-im
target: Of the 2 minas 10 shekels of silver that one will balance to Elamma at the accounting,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ.BA 1.3333 ma-na 3 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR al-qé
target: 1 mina 23 shekels thereof I took;

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-tí KÙ.BABBAR 0.6666 ma-na 7 GÍN KI a-šùr-ma-lik ì-lí-a-lim ù la-qé-ep a-lá-qé
target: the rest of the silver, 47 shekels, I will collect from Aššur-mālik, Ilī-ālum and Lā-qēp.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 ma-na 14 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i-na ša a-šur-be-el-a-wa-tim
target: 2 minas 14 shekels of silver from what belongs to Aššur-bēl-awātim,

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ma-nu-um-ba-lúm-a-šùr qí-bi-ma um-ma ab-ša-lim-ma
target: To Mannum-balum-Aššur from Ab-šalim:

source: translate Akkadian to English: É en-na-ma-nim iš-tù MU.1.ŠÈ ṣú-ḫa-ar-tám iṭ-ru-du-nim-ma ki-ma DUMU.MÍ lá a-ší-ri e-ta-áp-šu-ší
target: A year ago Ennam-Anum's house chased out the girl, and they have treated her like a daughter who has no one to care for her.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-bu-kà-ma a-na a-we-lim-ma 40 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR maš-kà-tum ša me-er-i-a a-na be-tí-kà i-li-kam
target: Your father said to the man: A deposit of 40 minas of silver came to your house from my son.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 GÚ ZABAR ŠE-um na-áš-pu-kum ša me-er-i-a i-na bé-tí-kà i-ba-ší
target: 1 talent of bronze (and) stores of grain belonging to my son are in your house.

source: translate Akkadian to English: GÍR ša a-šùr a-na a-we-lim ta-mu-im i-za-az
target: He is ready to swear by Aššur's dagger against the man.

source: translate Akkadian to English: É a-bi-kà ḫu-ra-áš-kà a-na lá-ma-dim i-lu-ku ù ṭup-pí-kà a-na šé-ṣú-im i-za-zu
target: They will come to your father's house to learn about your store, and they stand ready to take out your tablets.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭé-em a-bi-kà ù ni-ší-kà a-ta-ma tí-dí-e
target: You yourself know the opinion of your father and your people.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma ṭup-pé-e ša a-bi₄-kà ta-ki-li na-áš-ú-ni-kum
target: Indeed they bring you your father's letter with slander.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ta-ki-li ša a-bi-kà lá ta-ša-me
target: Do not listen to your father's slander!

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma i-na pí-i-kà ṣú-ḫa-ar-tum ṭá-ar-da-at ma a-wa-tum ku-a-a-tum šu-up-ra-ma lu i-di
target: Write me in your own words whether the girl was chased out by your order, so I may know.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 ṭup-pè-e ú-šé-bi₄-lá-kum
target: I have sent you 10 letters.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-šu-um ma-tí-ma ṭup-pá-kà lá i-lá-kam
target: Why does no letter ever come from you?

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-dí-a-bu-um É-tí ša bu-ri-im a-šar ša-lim-a-šùr wa-áš-bu iš-tí tù-ud-ḫa-li-a a-ḫu tù-li iš-a-am
target: Iddin-abum has bought the houses by the well, where Šalim-Aššur is living, from Tudhiliya the brother of Tuli.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um kà-ni-iš i-dí-ni-a-tí-ma ṭup-pá-am ší-bu-tí-ni IGI GÍR ša a-šùr ni-dí-in
target: The Kanesh colony gave us for these proceedings, and we gave a tablet with our testimony before the dagger of Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-ku-za IGI ú-ra-a IGI a-šùr-ba-ni
target: Witnessed by Akuza, by Uraya, by Aššur-bāni.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na šu-ta-mu-zi e-lá-a a-šùr-ma-sú-i ku-da-tim a-dí-da lá-ma-sí ù en-um-a-šur qí-bi-ma um-ma en-um-a-šur-ma
target: To Šu-Tammuzi, Elaya, Aššur-massu'ī, Kudātum, Adida, Lamassī and Ennam-Aššur from Ennam-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-nu-mì lá li-bi DINGIR-ma a-bi-i i-mu-tù iš-tí ku-da-tim áš-pu-ra-ku-nu-tí um-ma a-na-ku-ma
target: When sadly my father died I wrote to you with Kudātum, saying:

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na u₄-mì-im ša a-bi-i ú-ṣa-ni ší-im-tù-šu i-na ma-aḫ-ri-ku-nu i-ší-ma i-ṣú-ra-tim ú-ṣí-ir-ni-a-tí
target: On the day that my father left (Assur) he declared his testament with you as witnesses, and he drew up -documents for us.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ba-ú-a bé-lu-a a-tù-nu ma-lá a-bi-i i-ší-mu-ni-a-tí-ni me-eḫ-ra-at ší-ma-tim ša a-bi₄-a šu-ba-al-ki-ta-ni-ma ṭup-pá-am šu-a-tí za-ku-sà a-na a-lu-wa dí-na-ma iš-tí ba-tí-qí-im pá-ni-im-ma ṭù-ur-da-ni-šu
target: My dear fathers and lords, have a copy made of my father's will, what he decided for us, and give this cleared tablet to Aluwa and send him with the first express caravan.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pí-ku-nu ú-qá-a na-áš-pè-ra-tí-ku-nu lá-áš-ta-me-ma lá-li-kam-ma e-in a-šur ù e-ni-ku-nu lá-mu-ur-ma É a-bi-a lu-bi-ib
target: I am waiting for your letter. Let me hear your missives, so I can come, see Aššur's eye and your eyes and clear my father's house (of claims).

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú ku-nu-tí lu nu-ša-ḫi-it-ku-nu
target: And as for you, let us settle your affairs.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ba-ú-a bé-lu-a a-tù-nu a-na-kam um-me-a-nu ú-nu-ú-ni ú bu-lá-tí ša a-bi-i e-zi-bu i-ṣa-áb-tù
target: My dear fathers and lords, the investors are pressuring us here and they have seized the assets that my father left.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-kam KÙ.BABBAR ša a-na É a-lim{ki} a-bu-ni ḫa-bu-lu-ni-ma ṭup-pá-am ša dí-in a-lim{ki} tal-qé-a-ni ú ša-ni-am ṭup-pá-am ša dí-in a-lim(k
target: There you have received a tablet with a verdict of the City concerning the silver our father owes to the City Hall, plus a second tablet with a verdict of the City with regard to the lapis lazuli of the votive offering for Aššur that we wrote to you about.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 ma-na <gap> GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša a-we-el-tim wa-al-dí-DINGIR i-dí-na-am
target: Waldi-ilum gave me 2 minas <gap> shekels of silver belonging to the lady.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú TÚG.ḪI.A ša na-áš-a-ku-ni ú-lá ša li-tab-ší-kà
target: Also, the textiles I am bringing are not for your clothes.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-du-um ša a-gi₅-a ša ta-áš-pu-ra-ni
target: Concerning the matter of Agiya that you wrote about,

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma KÙ.BABBAR uš-ta-áš-qí-il₅-šu iš-tí DUMU um-me-a-nim a-kà-na-ak-ma ú-šé-ba-lá-kum
target: if I have been able to make him pay the silver I shall seal together with an affiliated trader and send it to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma KÙ.BABBAR lá uš-ta-áš-qí-il₅-šu na-pá-al-tù-šu ma-lá e-pí-li-ni tí-ir-tí i-lá-kà-kum
target: If I have not been able to make him pay the silver, my messages shall come to you with his answer that he gives to me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: en-nu-a-šur DUMU šu-EN.LÍL a-na en-nu-a-šur ù la-qé-ep iṣ-ba-at-ni-a-tí-ma
target: Ennam-Aššur son of Šu-Illil seized us against Ennam-Aššur and Lā-qēp.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma en-nu-a-šur DUMU šu-EN.LÍL-ma a-na en-nu-a-šur ù la-qé-ep-ma mì-šu sí-ki tù-kà-lá KÙ.BABBAR 1 GÍN ša DAM.GÀR ù ú-nu-tí i-ta-la-ak
target: Ennam-Aššur son of Šu-Illil said to Ennam-Aššur and Lā-qēp: Why do you detain me? Every single shekel of silver of the merchant's has gone as well as my goods.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma en-nu-a-šur ù la-qé-ep ma-aṣ-a-ni nu-kà-al-kà KÙ.BABBAR ša i-tur₄-DINGIR šu-qú-lam-ma URUDU-kà šé-ṣí
target: Ennam-Aššur and Lā-qēp answered: We hold you back on our own responsibility. Pay the silver of Itūr-ilī and produce your copper.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma en-nu-a-šur URUDU lá-šu KÙ.BABBAR IGI 2 ša-bu-a-tù-nu ša ni-iš a-lim{ki} uz-na-tí-ni pu-tù-ú
target: Ennam-Aššur answered: There is no more copper. As for the silver, before two witnesses you were paid in full. They touched our ears with what was sworn by the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI šál-maḫ IGI a-zu-na-a IGI DU₁₀-ṣí-li-a-šur a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um dur₄-ḫu-mì-it i-dí-ni-a-tí-ma ṭup-pá-am IGI GÍR ša a-šur ša ší-bu-tí-ni ni-di-in
target: Witnessed by Šalim-ahum, by Azunaya, by Ṭāb-ṣill-Aššur. The Durhumit colony gave us for these proceedings, and we gave a tablet with our testimony before Aššur's dagger.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ḫa-ra-ni a kà-ni-iš mì-in tù-kà-lá-ni
target: Had my journey gone to Kanesh, would you then hold me back?

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.6666 ma-na 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i-ṣé-er GAL <gap>-ri ša lu-ḫu-za-tí-a a-lá-ḫu-um i-šu
target: The overseer of <gap> in Luhuzattiya owes 45 shekels of silver to Ali-ahum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 15 na-ru-uq mì-iš-lam ŠE-am mì-iš-lam ar-ša-tim ŠE-am ar-ša-tim ú KÙ.BABBAR a-na ḫa-ar-pé-e a-ni-ú-tim i-da-an
target: 15? sacks of grain, half barley half wheat (are interest). He will pay the barley, the wheat and the silver at this (coming) harvest.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 TÚG ku-ta-num SIG₅ i li-bi-šu-ma
target: He also owes 1 -textile of good quality.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 17 ma-na LÁ 7.5 GÍN i-ṣé-er na-áb-sú-en i-sú-rik₁₃ i-šu
target: Nab-Suen owes 17 minas less 7.5 shekels (of silver) to Issu-arik.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù ḫa-mu-uš-tim ša sú-kà-li-a a-na 13 ḫa-am-ša-tim KÙ.BABBAR i-ša-qal
target: Reckoned from the week of Sukkalliya he must pay the silver in 13 weeks.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ù KÙ.GI i-na bi-ti-a i-ba-ší
target: The silver and gold is in my house.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI en-nam-a-a IGI en-nam-a-šur DUMU da-da IGI a-šur-na-da DUMU a-mur-lu-ṣú
target: Witnessed by Ennamaya, by Ennam-Aššur son of Dada, by Aššur-nādā son of Amur-luṣu.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na i-na-aḫ-DINGIR ù a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi-ma um-ma a-ba-ba-ma
target: To Inah-ilī and Ali-ahum from Ababa:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 8 ANŠE ṣa-lá-mu 1.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR 6 GÍN KÙ.GI ša en-um-a-šur a-mì-ša-am a-na ší-a-ma-tim a-na SÍG.ḪI.A ša-a-mì-im ša-lim-a-ar-dí ù e-ni-ša-ru-um ub-lu-nim
target: 8 black donkeys, 1.5 mina silver and 6 shekels of gold belonging to Ennam-Aššur Šalim-wardī and Enišarum have brought there for purchases of wool.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-kam ANŠE.ḪI.A ù lu-qú-sú i-wa-ṣa-i-šu-nu e-na-tim i-dá-ma ṣa-áb-ta
target: Pay close attention and seize the donkeys and his goods there when they leave.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tí ì-lí-dan a-wa-tám ni-ib-tù-uq
target: We have dropped the matter with Ilī-dan;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR iš-qú-ul-ni-a-tí
target: he has paid us 5 minas of silver;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a-na 45 ḫa-am-ša-tim nu-ZA-mì-il₅-šu-um
target: we did him a favour (to lend him) 5 minas of silver to be paid in 45 weeks.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.6666 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a-na 15 ḫa-am-ša-tim i-ša-qal
target: He is to pay 1.6666 mina in 15 weeks,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.6666 ma-na ša-ni-tám ma-áš-qá-al-tám a-na 15 ḫa-am-ša-tim i-ša-qal
target: 1.6666 mina, his second installment, he will pay in 15 weeks (after that),

source: translate Akkadian to English: ta-áš-bi₄-it KÙ.BABBAR a-na 45 ḫa-am-ša-tim i-ša-qal
target: and the full amount of silver he will pay in 45 weeks.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫu-kà i-na pu-úz-ri-im iš-tí ì-lí-dan ul-ta-ḫi-iš-ma gi₅-mì-li i-na ṣé-er ì-lí-dan i-dí-ma a-na-ku ú-lá i-de₈
target: Your brother secretly whispered with Ili-dan and showed a favour towards Ilī-dan, without my knowledge:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 21 GÚ SÍG.ḪI.A a-ḫu-kà a-na ì-lí-dan i-da-an-ma 6 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR i-na ri-iš SÍG.ḪI.A-ma ì-lí-dan a-na a-ḫi-kà i-ša-qal
target: your brother is to give 21 talents of wool to Ilī-dan, and Ilī-dan will pay 6 minas of silver immediately to your brother for the wool.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-pu-tum a-ma-kam lu-qú-tám ṣa-áb-ta
target: Urgent, seize the goods there.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-dí-sú-in DUMU i-ba-a-a ša a-na ša-lim-a-šur DUMU i-sú-rik₁₃ ra-bi-ṣa-am e-ḫu-za-ni ù ṭup-pá-am ša a-lim{ki} a-na ša-sú-ḫi-šu il₅-qé-a-ni
target: Iddin-Suen son of Ibaya who had hired an attorney against Šalim-Aššur son of Issu-arik, and had received a tablet from the City assembly about his extradition.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-mì-ig-ru-ma ni-iš a-lim{ki} i-na kà-ni-iš it-mu-ú
target: (those two) settled (their differences) and swore an oath by the City in Kanesh.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-dí-sú-in ki-ma a-ḫa-tí-šu a-ḫi-šu ù a-ḫa-at a-bi-šu i-dí-sú-in it-ma
target: Iddin-Suen swore on behalf of his sister, his brother and his father's sister.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù ša-lim-a-šur a-na ḫu-bu-ul i-ba-a-a a-bi-šu-nu a-na i-dí-sú-in ù a-ḫi-šu DUMU i-ba-a-a ù-lá i-tù-wa-ar-šu-nu-tí
target: And Šalim-Aššur must not raise claim against Iddin-Suen or his brother for the debt of their father Ibaya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫu-um a-na a-ḫi-im ù-la i-tù-wa-ar
target: The two must not raise claim against each other.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim ni-iš a-lim{ki} it-mu-ú
target: For this matter they swore the oath by the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ITU.1.KAM ḫu-bu-ur li-mu-um a-lá-ḫu-um DUMU i-na-aḫ-DINGIR
target: Month hubur, eponymy Ali-ahum son of Inah-ilī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI ḫu-ra-ṣí DUMU šé-ep-a-lim-ki IGI {d}MAR.TU-ba-ni DUMU ma-na-na IGI ṣí-lu-lu DUMU ú-ku IGI a-ta-dí-a DUMU en-na-nim IGI a-šur-iš-ta-kál DUMU a-šur-SIPA IGI en-nam-a-šur DUMU me-ra-ni <gap> DUMU ni-zi-im
target: Witnessed by hurāṣī son of Šēp-Alum, by Amurrum-bāni son of Manana, by Ṣilūlu son of Uku, by Atadiya son of Ennānum, by Aššuriš-takal son of Aššur-rē'ī, by Ennam-Aššur son of Merani, (by <gap>) son of Nizum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ṣé-er ḫu-bu-ul a-bi₄-šu it-bu-lu ú 3.3333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša-lim-a-šur a-na i-dí-sú-in DUMU i-ba-a i-na ga-ma-ar a-wa-tim i-ša-qal
target: Not only did he remove his father's debt, but Šalim-Aššur must pay 3.3333 minas of silver to Iddin-Suen son of Ibaya for the settlement of the matter.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-we-li a-ni-ú-tim a-wa-tum a-ni-a-tum i-gi₅-im-r
target: This case was settled before these men.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na šu-{d}EN.LÍL ù a-zu-ú KIŠIB a-mur-IŠTAR
target: To Šu-Illil and Azu; sealed by Amur-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ša-lim-a-šùr-ma a-na i-dí-a-bi-im lá-qé-pì-im e-na-aḫ-DINGIR ù en-um-a-šùr qí-bi-ma
target: From Šalim-Aššur to Iddin-abum, Lā-qēp, Enah-ilī and Ennam-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-nu-mì kà-ar-wa-a ù pu-šu-ke-en₆ kà-ru-um <gap> a-na ší-ip-ru-tim a-šu-mì da-me ša DUMU a-lá-ḫi-im ù KÙ.BABBAR ḫu-lu-qá-e a-na bu-ru-uš-ḫa-dim iš-pu-ru
target: When the colony sent Karwaya and Pūšu-kēn as envoys to Burušhaddum because of the blood-money for Ali-ahum's son and the lost silver,

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na pu-ùḫ-ri-im me-er-e <gap> ú-ša-zi-iz
target: I had the sons of <gap> stand up in the assembly.

source: translate Akkadian to English: en-um-a-šùr <gap> ší-bé-e lá i-ša-kà-an ù a-wa-tám lá i-ga-ma-ar
target: Ennam-Aššur <gap> he will not set witnesses and will not conclude the matter.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-nu-mì a-na a-lim{ki} pá-<gap>-a-ni IGI ú-ra-a IGI MAR.TU-ba-ni en-na-nam aṣ-ba-at-ma
target: When we decided to go to the City I seized Ennānum with Uraya and Amurrum-bāni as witnesses,
