source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-na-ku-ma a-na a-na ku-be <gap> šu-ma a-wa-tám ta-ga-ma-ar al-kam gu₅-mu-ur
target: and I said: <gap> If you can conclude the matter, then come and conclude it!

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma lá ki-a-am iš-tí me-er-e-a ù iš-tí ša ki-ma i-a-tí lá ta-ma-ga-ar
target: If that is not the case, then you will not agree with my sons or with my representatives.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša ni-iš a-lim{ki} uz-na-tí-šu-nu al-pu-ut
target: I made clear to them what was sworn by the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫu-ú-a a-tù-nu a-wa-tám i-na lá i-dim i-<gap> ú-ra-a ù MAR.TU-ba-ni a-na ba-áb DINGIR-lim <gap> li-<gap>
target: My dear brothers, for no reason he <gap> the matter <gap> Let Uraya and Amurrum-bāni go down to the Gate of the God <gap>.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am i-nu-mì KÙ.BABBAR a qá-tí a-šur-ni-im-ri i-ma-qú-tù a-na a-lá-ḫi-im i-da-an-ma ITU.2.KAM i-bé-el
target: As to the 4 minas of refined silver, when the silver falls into Aššur-nimrī's hands he will give it to Ali-ahum, and he will dispose of it for 2 months.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma i-ma-lá u₄-me-šu KÙ.BABBAR lá iš-qú-ul 0.6666 GÍN 15 ŠE ṣí-ib-tám ú-ṣa-áb
target: If he has not paid when his term is up, he will pay an interest of 0.6666 shekels 15 grains.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.6666 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR SAḪAR.BA i-ṣé-er ku-li-a DUMU a-lá-bi₄-im a-mur-{d}UTU DUMU be-lá-nim ú e-na-a-šur DUMU šu-ul-mì-im-ša-a-šur a-šur-ma-lik DUMU ku-ra-ra i-šu
target: 1.6666 mina of 'silver dust' Kuliya, son of Ali-abum, Amur-Šamaš, son of Bēlānum, and Ennam-Aššur, son of Šulmim-ša-Aššur, owe to Aššur-mālik, son of Kurara.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na 1 ma-na-im 1.5 GÍN.TA KÙ.BABBAR i-na ITU.1.KAM ṣí-ib-tám ù-ṣú-bu
target: Per mina they will add 1.5 shekel of silver per month as interest.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR i qá-qá-ad šál-mì-šu-nu ú ke-ni-šu-nu ra-ki-is
target: Who of them is financially sound and available is liable for the silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ITU.1.KAM ku-zal-lí li-mu-um a-bu-ša-lim DAM.GÀR DUMU ì-lí-a-lim
target: Month XI of the eponymy of Abu-šalim, the trader, son of Ilī-ālum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 20 i-lu-ú mu-nu-tám ša KÙ.KI ša ili₅-pì-ú-ṣú-ur a-na ša-pár-tim na-du-ú
target: Golden (figurines of) gods, to the number of 20, belonging to Ilī-pī-uṣur, have been deposited as pledge.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-lu-ú i ku-nu-uk 3 be-re-e kà-an-ku
target: The gods have been put under the seals of the 3.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-nu-mì KÙ.BABBAR il₅-qé-ú-ni DU₁₀-a-šùr DUMU ili₅-pì-ú-ṣur ḫu-du-be-lí IR-sú 3 be-ru-ú li-ip-ta-num DUMU qar-da-a e-na-a-šur DUMU i-ku-pì-a-šur ù a-mur-{d}UTU DUMU pì-lá-aḫ-a-nim i-na ša-ḫa-tí-šu-nu i-zi-zu
target: When they received the silver Ṭāb-Aššur, son of Ilī-pī-uṣur, Hudu-bēlī, his slave, and 3, Liptānum Qardaya, Ennam-Aššur, son of Ikuppi-Aššur, and Amur-Šamaš, son of Pilah-Anum, assisted them.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-šur-e-nam DUMU bur-sú-in IGI e-na-a-šur DUMU e-nu-um-a-šur IGI e-na-a-šur DUMU pì-lá-aḫ-IŠTAR
target: In the presence of Aššur-ennam, son of Bur-Suen, of Ennam-Aššur, son of Ennum-Aššur, of Ennam-Aššur, son of Pilah-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 li-im 2 me-at 80 ma-na URUDU i-ṣé-er ku-li-a DUMU a-lá-bi₄-im a-mur-{d}UTU DUMU be-lá-nim ù e-na-a-šur DUMU šu-ul-mu-ša-a-šur a-šu
target: 1280 minas <of copper> Kuliya, son of Ali-abum, Amur-Šamaš, son of Bēlānum, and Ennam-Aššur, son of Šulmu-ša-Aššur owe to Aššur-mālik, son of Kurara.

source: translate Akkadian to English: en-um-a-šùr a-na a-lá-ḫi-im iṣ-ba-at-ni-a-tí-ma ṭup-pá-am na-áš-pé-er-tám la pá-tí-tám ú-kà-li-im-šu-ma
target: Ennam-Aššur seized us against Ali-ahum and showed him a missive that was not opened.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma en-um-a-šùr-ma ṭup-pu-um a-num ku-nu-ku-kà-a lá ku-nu-ku-kà-a
target: Ennam-Aššur said: Is this tablet under your seal or not?

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-lá-ḫu-um iš-ta-al-ma e-pu-ul-šu um-ma a-lá-ḫu-um-ma ke-na ku-nu-ku-a
target: Ali-ahum answered, having investigated it, saying: Yes, it is my seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ša ki-ma a-bi₄-ni ša ki-ma i-a-tí ú ku-a-tí ú-šé-bi₄-il₅-kà-ma mì-šu-um lá tù-kà-li-im-ší-ma a-dí u₄-mì-im a-nim tù-kà-il₅-ší
target: I sent it with you to our father's representatives and my own and yours, so why have you not shown it but kept it until today?

source: translate Akkadian to English: na-áš-pé-er-tám lá pá-tí-tám en-um-a-šur a qá-tí-ni iš-ku-un
target: Ennam-Aššur placed the unopened missive in our hands.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um kà-ni-iš i-dí-in-ni-a-tí-ma IGI GÍR ša a-šur ší-bu-tí-ni ni-dí-in
target: The Kanesh colony gave us for these proceedings and we gave our testimony before Aššur's dagger.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-šur-na-da IGI ḫa-da-a IGI šu-IŠTAR
target: Witnessed by Aššur-nādā, by hadaya, by Šu-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: pí-lá-aḫ-a-šur a-na e-lá-ma iṣ-ba-at-ni-a-tí-ma
target: Pilah-Aššur seized us against Elamma.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma pí-lá-aḫ-a-šur-ma a-na e-lá-ma-ma a-na AN.NA-ki-kà ša ta-dí-na-ni a-ga-mì-il₅-kà 8 GÍN.TA KÙ.BABBAR a-na a-lim{ki} ú-ša-ak-ša-da-kà
target: Pilah-Aššur said to Elamma: With respect to your tin that you gave me, I will do you a favor: I will supply you in the city silver at a rate of (1 shekel) per 8 shekels (of tin).

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma pí-lá-aḫ-a-šur-ma a-na e-lá-ma-ma ù i-nu-mì a-na-ku a-na a-lim{ki} a-lu-ku 15 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ta-da-nam-ma a-bé-e-el
target: Pilah-Aššur also said to Elamma: And when I go to the City will you then give me 15 minas of silver for my free disposal?

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma e-lá-ma-ma a-da-na-kum
target: Elamma answered him: I will give it to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI lá-qé-pí-im šu-be-lim ù LUGAL-{d}IM tap-pá-ú-a a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um kà-ni-iš i-dí-ni-ma IGI GÍR ša a-šur ší-bu-tí a-dí-in
target: In the presence of Lā-qēpum; Šu-Bēlum and Šarrum-Adad, were my fellow witnesses. For these words the Kanesh colony made me available and I gave my testimony before Aššur's dagger.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 40 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ni-is-ḫa-sú DIRI ša-du-a-sú ša-bu-ú en-um-a-šùr a-na a-lu-a ù e-ni-ša-ri-im i-na ša-lá-tù-ar ku-nu-ki ip-qí-id
target: 40 minas of silver, its import duty added, its transport tariff paid for, Ennam-Aššur entrusted to Aluwa and Enišārum in Šalatuwar under seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-ut-ma a-na a-lim{ki} a-na ša-lim-a-šùr a-bi-a bi-lá-a
target: He said: Bring it to my father Šalim-Aššur in the City!

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na qá-tí-šu-nu i-dí-in
target: He also gave 5 shekels of silver for their expenses.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um wa-aḫ-šu-ša-na i-dí-ni-a-tí-ma IGI GÍR ša a-šùr ší-bu-tí-ni ni-dí-in
target: The Wahšušana colony gave us for these proceedings and we gave our testimony before Aššur's dagger.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI ì-lí-ba-ni DUMU a-mur-a-šùr IGI a-ḫu-waqar DUMU šu-IŠTAR tù-ra-mì-ili₅ DUMU e-dí-in-a-šùr tap-pá-i-ni
target: Witnessed by Ilī-bāni son of Amur-Aššur, by Ahu-waqar son of Šu-Ištar; Tūram-ilī son of Eddin-Aššur was our (absent) partner.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 GÍN KÛ.BABBAR iš-tí eb-lá-i-im ša SÍG.ḪI.A il₅-qé-ú
target: 3 shekels of silver due from the man from Ebla, who took wool.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 me-at ŠE.AM i-na ṣí-im-dim ša-bu-tim a-lam šu-ut-ma ú-ma-lá iš-tí en-nam-a-šur
target: 200 measures of barley - by the 3-measure of <gap> he himself will complement (it in?) the City - are with Ennam-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 me 50 BANEŠ ŠE-am i-na ṣí-im-dim ša-bu-tim a-lam šu-ut-ma ú-ma-lá iš-tí a-ba-a
target: 250 3-measure of barley - by the 3-measure of <gap> he himself will complement (it in?) the city - are with Abaya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 42 ŠE-am i-na ṣí-im-dim ša-bu-tim iš-tí a-šur-ta-ak-lá-ak
target: 42? measures of barley, by the 3-measure of <gap>, are with Aššur-taklāk.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 me-at 4 BANEŠ ŠE.AM i-na ṣí-im-dim ša-bu-tim a-lam šu-ut-ma ú-ma-lá iš-tí a-ba-a
target: 104 3-measures of barley - by the 3-measure of <gap> - he himself will complement (it in?) the city - are with Abaya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-né-ma i-ma-da-ad
target: He shall measure it out now.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 8 BANEŠ ŠE-am KI e-wa-ar-nim
target: 8 3-measures of barley with Ewarnum;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 50 BANEŠ ŠE-am a-lam₅{ki} šu-ut-ma ú-ma-lá KI en-nam-{d}IM DUMU šu-na-a
target: 50 3-measures of barley - he himself will complement (it in?) the city - are with Ennam-Adad, son of Šunāya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB kà-ri-im ḫa-ḫi-im
target: Sealed by the hahhum colony.

source: translate Akkadian to English: kà-ru-um dí-nam i-dí-in-ma
target: The colony passed a verdict:

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma šu-be-lúm ù en-na-sú-in me-er-ú i-dí-a-bi₄-im lá i-li-ku-ú-ma iš-tí šál-ma-a-šùr lá i-na-me-ru-ú-ma a-li i-ma-gu₅-ru-ni lá e-ta-wu-ú
target: If Šu-Bēlum and Enna-Suen, Iddin-abum's sons, do not leave and meet with Šalim-Aššur and do not discuss in order to come to an agreement,

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu-qú-tám a-na šál-ma-a-šùr ú-šu-ru-ú
target: then they must release the goods to Šalim-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ba pá-šé-er a-wa-tim
target: Aba was the arbitrator.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫa-ma 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i-na li-bi₄ šu-be-lim i-nu-mì <gap> KÙ.BABBAR a-na šu-be-lim áš-qúl
target: Further, 5 shekels of silver is owed by Šu-Bēlum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na KÙ.GI i-na na-ru-qí-šu ša a-la-ḫi-im ni-a-im ad-ma-ku
target: 1 mina of gold I have as investment share in the joint-stock capital of our Ali-ahum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 ma-na LÁ 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am i-a-am a-šùr-ma-lik DUMU a-šùr-{d}UTU ki-ma i-a-tí a-na ḫi-na-a ú-šé-bi₄-il₅-ma
target: 3 minas and 50 shekels of refined silver, belonging to myself, I had Aššur-mālik, son of Aššur-šamšī, in my name bring to hinnāya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù i-na té-er-tí-a um-ma a-na-ku-ma a-na ḫi-na-a-ma a-na na-ru-qí-kà le-qé-šu-ma KÙ.GI lu-up-ta-am
target: and then I also told hinnāya in my instruction: Take it for your joint-stock capital and book the gold as being mine.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na KÙ.GI ad-ma-ak-šu-um
target: I have now an investment share with him of 1 mina of gold.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 12 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i li-bi sá-li-a a-lá-ḫu-um i-šu
target: Salliya owes 12 shekels of silver to Ali-ahum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2.5 ma-na ṣí-ba-ra-tum qá-dum ša a-bi₄-e-dim
target: 2.5 minas of <gap> including those of Abi-wedum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.3333 ma-na a-na ú-ra-ḫa-zi ša 1 ma-na ul-ga-tim zi-ga-an-LUGAL
target: 1.3333 mina for <gap> For 1 mina <gap> zigan-sarru.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 6 ma-na a-lu-li-tám ša 3.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR
target: 6 minas alulitum worth 3.5 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR AN.NA
target: for 10 shekels of silver tin.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ṣé-er e-ni-ša-ri-im a-dí AN.NA-ki-kà ú-ṣú-ur-ša-IŠTAR áš-ta-pá-ar
target: I have sent Uṣur-ša-Ištar to Enišārum concerning your tin.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù za-al-pá i-tù-ru-nim a-lá-ḫa-am a-ṭá-ra-dam
target: When they come back from Zalpa, I shall send Ali-ahum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am ú ša 3 GÍN sà-ḫi-ir-tám ku-nu-ki-a ili₅-tù-ra-am ú-šé-bi₄-lá-kum-ma
target: I sent Ilī-tūram to you with 0.5 mina of refined silver and small goods worth 3 shekels under my seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 17 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am ku-nu-ki-a ší-im ṣú-ba-tí-kà id-na-a ú a-lu-wa na-áš-ú-ni-kum
target: Idnaya and Aluwa are bringing you 17 shekels of silver under my seal, the proceeds from your textiles.

source: translate Akkadian to English: e-ma-ru-kà lu ak-lu
target: Your donkeys should be fed.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-lá-ḫi-im ú-ṣur-ša-IŠTAR ú zu-ku-a qí-bi-ma um-ma SIG₅-pí-a-šur-ma
target: To Ali-ahum, Uṣur-ša-Ištar and Zukuwa from Damiq-pī-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 15 ma-na AN.NA ku-nu-ki-a ú-ṣur-ša-IŠTAR ú ṣí-li-a na-áš-ú-ni-ku-nu-tí
target: Uṣur-ša-Ištar and Ṣilliya bring you 15 minas of tin under my seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ.BA 5 ma-na AN.NA ik-ri-bu ša a-šur
target: Of that 5 minas of tin are votive offerings for Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫu-ú-a a-tù-nu a ma-lá ta-le-e-a-ni la-ma ILLAT-tum e-ru-ba-ni AN.NA-ki a-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pì-im dí-na-ma
target: My dear brothers, sell my tin for refined silver as well as you can before the caravan arrives,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-im 5 ma-na AN.NA ša ik-ri-be KÙ.BABBAR lu ša-li-iṭ
target: and the proceeds from the 5 minas of tin from the votive offering must be available in silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a ší-tí KÙ.BABBAR-pí-a pì-ri-kà-ni na-ar-bu-tim wa-as-mu-tim ša-ma-ma li-ib-ší
target: Buy, soft and pleasant, for the rest of my silver and let them be.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma pí-ri-kà-nu lá-šu KÙ.BABBAR i ku-nu-ki-šu li-ib-ší
target: If there are no, then let the silver remain under seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ša-lim-a-šur-ma a-na i-dí-a-bi₄-im en-na-nim i-na-aḫ-DINGIR a-dí-da en-um-a-šùr a-lá-ḫi-im ù a-mur-IŠTAR qí-bi-ma
target: From Šalim-Aššur to Iddin-abum, Ennā-num, Inah-ilī, Adida, Ennam-Aššur, Ali-ahum and Amur-Ištar:

source: translate Akkadian to English: AN.NA-ki ù TÚG.ḪI-tù-a iš-tù ILLAT-at DUMU a-ni-nim i-li-kà-ku-nu-tí
target: My tin and my textiles have come to you from the caravan of Anninum's son.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na qé-er-bi₄-im KÙ.BABBAR mì-ma ú-lá tù-šé-bi₄-lá-nim
target: You have not sent me any silver from that!

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫu-ú-a be-lu-a a-tù-nu ṭup-pé-e-a ḫa-ru-mu-tim am-ra-ma i-na DAM.GÀR-ri-a ša ta-na-ṭá-lá-ni a-šar nam-gu₅-ri-im nam-am-gi₅-ra
target: My dear brothers and lords, check my certified tablets and reach an agreement where possible with those of my customers you see.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-šar u₄-MU-e ša-kà-nim šu-uk-na-ma KÙ.BABBAR-pì qá-ri-ba-nim
target: Set terms where you are able to, so you produce my silver for me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: u₄-ma-kál ú ší-na u₄-me-e ku-ša-ḫi-ku-nu ez-ba-ma ba-ab-tí za-ki-a-nim
target: Set aside your own needs for just one or two days and clear my outstanding loans.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 8 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR iš-tí tù-um-li-a-i-im 2 ma-na.TA KÙ.BABBAR ù 80 na-ru-uq ŠE-am mì-iš-lúm ŠE-um mì-iš-lúm GIG ṣí-ib-tám i-na ša-tim ú-ṣa-ba-am
target: 8 minas of silver owed by the man from Tumliya - at the rate 2 minas in silver and 80 sacks of grain, half barley, half wheat, he will pay interest annually.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù MU.4.ŠÈ KÙ.BABBAR-pì ú-kà-al
target: He has held the silver for 4 years.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na iš-tí šu-pu-na-aḫ-šu 20 na-ru-uq ŠE-am i-na ša-tim ú-ṣa-ba-am
target: 1 mina owed by Šuppun-ahšu - he will pay interest of 20 sacks of grain annually.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-šu ša a-na kur-ub-IŠTAR DUMU a-lá-ḫi-im tap-pá-i-a KÙ.BABBAR ṣí-ba-sú ù ší-im ŠE-im KÙ.BABBAR ša ṣí-ba-tí-šu ša tù-um-li
target: Why is it that interest on the silver and the price of grain in silver from his interest from the man of Tumliya has come to my partner Kurub-Ištar son of Ali-ahum, but nothing has come to me?

source: translate Akkadian to English: 30 ma-na 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pu-um 13 ANŠE.ḪI.A 31 i-lu-ú 41 ú-kà-pu 11 ma-as-ra-du 21 e-ba-al sí-ki-tim ú ma-at-li-iḫ-šu
target: 30 minas 10 shekels of refined silver, 13 donkeys, 31 bags, 41 saddlecloths, 11 packsaddles, 21 ropes with pegs and packing-racks.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na AN.NA šu-ut-ma i-dí-šu-um
target: He gave him 0.5 mina of tin.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ir-ma-a-šùr DUMU ni-dí-ba-ni PUZUR₄-a-šùr iṣ-ba-at-ma
target: Puzur-Aššur seized Irma-Aššur son of Nide-bāni.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma PUZUR₄-a-šur-ma a-na ir-ma-a-šùr-ma a-ma a-wi-lu-ú a-ni-ú-tum lu i-de₈-ú a-na 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša i tí-me-el-ki-a en-nam-a-šùr qá-ta-at a-mur-IŠTAR il₅-tap-tù-ni a-na en-nam-a-šur lá ta-tù-wa-ar
target: Puzur-Aššur said to Irma-Aššur: Look, may these men know that you must not raise claim against Ennam-Aššur for the 1 mina of silver for which Ennam-Aššur was booked as guarantor in Timelkiya for Amur-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ir-ma-a-šùr-ma lá a-tù-wa-ar
target: Irma-Aššur answered: I shall not raise claim.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI šu-IŠTAR DUMU da-da-nim IGI šu-ku-bi₄-im DUMU ú-zu-ú-a
target: Witnessed by Šu-Ištar son of Dadānum, by Šu-Kūbum son of Uzuwa.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ir-ma-a-šùr-ma a-na i-ku-pí-a-šùr lá-ma-sà-tim ù en-um-a-šùr qí-bi-ma
target: Thus Ir'am-Aššur, say to Ikūn-pī-Aššur, Lamassutum and Ennam-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ku-nu-ku-a ša sú-en₆-na-da a-ma-kam a-na šu-lá-ba-an ù ku-ra-ra dí-na-šu ù ší-bé šu-uk-na ki-ma KÙ.BABBAR ša sú-en₆-na-da il₅-qé-ú-ni
target: 1 mina of silver under my seals, belonging to Suen-nādā, you must give there to Šu-Labān and Kurara and you must set witnesses that they received Suen-nādā's silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša DAM.GÀR ku-nu-ku-a a-na ṣé-er a-šur-GAL {d}EN.LÍL-ba-ni DUMU ḫa-na-nim ú-šé-bi-lam
target: With 3 minas of silver of the trader, under my seals, I sent Ellil-bāni, son of hannānum, to Aššur-rabi.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ša-me-ma a-dí-ni a-ma-kam wa-ša-áb šu-ma a-na pá-ni a-šur-GAL lá i-li-ik KÙ.BABBAR pu-uṭ-ra-ma AN.NA lu 9 GÍN.TA lu ma-lá ta-le-e-a-ni ša-ma-ma {d}EN.LÍL-ba-ni ù {d}UTU-e-nam KI a-li-ki-im pá-nim-ma ṭur₄-da-nim
target: I hear that he is still staying there and if he has indeed not left to meet Aššur-rabi, then unpack the silver and buy for me tin at 9 shekels per (shekel of silver) or as favorably as you can and send Ellil-bāni and Šamaš-ennam here with the first caravan.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-šu-mì ṭup-pé-a ša a-na i-na-a DUMU e-lá-lí en-na-sú-en₆ DUMU šu-IŠTAR ù a-šur-ma-lik DUMU qá-a-tim KÙ.BABBAR a-ḫi-ib-lu KÙ.BABBAR ú-šé-bi-lá-šu-nu-tí ša-bu-ú
target: As for my tablets recording that I became indebted for silver to Innāya, son of Elālī, to Ennam-Suen, son of Šu-Ištar and to Aššur-mālik, son of Qa'ātum, I have sent them the silver, they are satisfied.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pé-a iš-tí lá-ma-sà-tim i-ba-ší-ú lu ma-ma-an i-na ša-zu-uz-tí-a ú-kà-al-šu-nu
target: Are my tablets with Lamassutum or does someone from my representatives have them in his possession?

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí ma-lá ú ší-ni-šu áš-pu-ra-ku-nu-tí
target: I have written you several times.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-šu-um ma-tí-ma té-er-ta-ku-nu lá i-li-kam-ma úz-ni lá ta-pá-tí-
target: Why has no report of yours ever reached me and do you not keep me informed?

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-lá-ḫi-im DUMU šál-ma-a-šur ù zu-ku-a
target: To Ali-ahum son of Šalim-Aššur and Zukuwa.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB PUZUR₄-a-šur DUMU a-šur-dan
target: Seal of Puzur-Aššur son of Aššur-dan.

source: translate Akkadian to English: en-um-a-šur ša ki-ma i-ku-pí-a DUMU a-šùr-ba-ni e-pu-ul um-ma en-um-a-šur-ma a-na ša ki-ma i-ku-pí-a-ma
target: Ennam-Aššur answered the representatives of Ikūn-pīya son of Aššur-bāni, saying to Ikūn-pīya's representatives:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am i-ku-pí-a i-ḫi-ib-lá-ma
target: Ikūn-pīya has become indebted to me for 5 minas of refined silver,

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na DUMU šu-ku-bi-im <gap> ga bi <gap> ù ṣí-ba-sú ḫa <gap> TÚG ku-ta-ni ú 6 TÚG <gap> ša i-tur₄-DINGIR i-na wa-aḫ-šu-ša-na a-dí-šu-um
target: and to Šu-Kūbum's son <gap>the silver and its interest <gap> -textiles and 6 <gap>-textiles belonging to Itūr-ilī I gave him in Wahšušana.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pá-am ša 1 ma-na 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša ḫu-bu-ul en-nu-re-ṣí-im e-zi-ib-šu-um
target: I left him a tablet concerning 1 mina 5 shekels of silver, of Ennam-rēṣum's debt;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 GÚ 46.5 ma-na URUDU-i ší-kam É kà-ri-im <gap> a-ḫa-ma mì-<gap> KÙ.BABBAR-pí <gap> ma <gap>
target: 1 talent 46 ½ minas of -copper <gap> in the office of the colony <gap>

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma bu-zu-a DU₁₀-ṣí-lá-a-šur ù a-lá-bu-um-ma a-na en-um-a-šùr ù a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi-ma
target: From Buzuwa, Ṭāb-ṣill-Aššur and Ali-abum to Ennam-Aššur and Ali-ahum:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a ma-lá tí-ir-tí-ku-nu TÚG-ṣú-ba-tí-ku-nu nu-na-pì-iš-ma TÚG-ṣú-ba-tù-ku-nu šál-mu
target: In accordance with your instructions we aired your textiles and your textiles are in order.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 ku-ta-ni 12 ša a-ki-dí-e ku-nu-ki ša šál-ma-a-šùr ṣú-ḫa-ru-kà na-áš-ú-ni-ku-nu-tí
target: Your servants are bringing you 4 and 12 Akkadian ones sealed by Šalim-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 ku-ta-ni 1 ša a-ki-dí-e 1 ra-qá-tám a ma-lá tí-ir-tí-kà a-na a-lá-bi₄-im ù i-dí-a-šùr ni-ip-qí-id
target: We entrusted 2, 1 Akkadian one and 1 thin textile to Ali-abum and Iddin-Aššur in accordance with your instructions.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-tí TÚG-ba-tí-kà 14 mu-ta-tum 2 e-li-té-en ku-nu-ki ša šé-ep-IŠTAR ù ša-lim-wa-ar-dí
target: The rest of your textiles: 14 half-packs and 2 top-packs sealed by Šēp-Ištar and Šalim-wardī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: DINGIR-pì-lá-aḫ lá-šu-ma a-na DAM DINGIR-pì-lá-aḫ IGI 3 me-er-e um-mì-a-ni ni-ip-qí-id-ma
target: Ilī-pilah is not here so we entrusted them to Ilī-pilah's wife witnessed by 3 affiliated traders.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša tù-šé-bi₄-lá-ni SÍG.ḪI.A ni-iš-a-ma-kum
target: For 1 mina of silver that you sent we bought wool for you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.6666 ma-na 4.25 GÍN it-ba-al
target: It cost 0.6666 mina 4 1 / 4 shekels.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 pá-li-lu 10.6666 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR it-bu-lu
target: 5 cost 10.6666 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-tí KÙ.BABBAR-pì-kà 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-ma-kam lu pá-li-li lu SÍG.ḪI.A ṣú-ḫa-ru-kà na-áš-ú-ni-kum
target: The rest of your silver is 5 shekels of silver. Your servants there bring you both the and the wool.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-šar TÚG-tù-kà ša-ak-nu-ni a-dí ma-lá ù ší-ni-šu a pá-lá-ší-im i-zi-iz-ma
target: Wherever your textiles were placed, he stood ready once or twice to make a break-in.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ta ma-lá-kà i-ḫi-id-
target: Make up your own mind. Take care and make a decision concerning your entrusted goods.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 13 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am i-ṣé-er i-dí-a-bi₄-im a-mur-IŠTAR ù a-šur-i-mì-tí i-šu-ú
target: Iddin-abum owes 13 minas of refined silver to Amur-Ištar and Aššur-imittī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù ḫa-mu-uš-tim ša kàr-ri-a a-na 36 ḫa-am-ša-tim i-ša-qal
target: Reckoned from the week of Karriya he must pay in 36 weeks.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma la iš-qú-ul 1.5 GÍN.TA i-na ITU.KAM-im a-na ma-na-im ú-ṣa-áb
target: If he has not paid (in time), he must add interest at the rate 1.5 shekel per month per mina.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-šur-e-mu-qí IGI en-nam-a-šur DUMU me-na-a
target: Witnessed by Aššur-emūqi, by Ennam-Aššur son of Menaya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na e-lam-ma qí-bi-ma um-ma šu-be-lúm-ma
target: Say to Elamma, thus Šu-Bēlum:

source: translate Akkadian to English: DUMU.MÍ a-šur-dan DUMU zi-zi-im ra-bi₄-ṣa-am iš-tù a-lim{ki} ta-aṣ-ba-at-ma ú-ṣa-am a-ma-kam wa-ša-áb
target: The daughter of Aššur-dān, son of Zizum, has obtained an attorney from the City, who has left (and) is staying over there.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma KÙ.BABBAR lu URUDU ša ú-šé-lá-ku-ni ší-ma-am a-dí-ni la ta-áš-a-am
target: If with the silver or copper that I sent up to you you have not yet made purchases,

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR šé-ṣí-ma a-šar ku-wa-tí lí-ib-ší
target: then remove the silver and let it stay where you are.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma ma-ma-an a-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ba-tim ir-ta-ag-ma-kum KÙ.BABBAR KÙ.BABBAR kà-ri-im
target: Should anybody raise a claim against you in order to seize that silver, the silver belongs to the colony.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma a-na am-tim ú-la É-tí ú-ṭá-ḫi be-tù ù a-ma-tum ša a-wi-il₅-tim
target: If he makes an attempt at a slave-girl or the house, the house and the slave-girls belong to the lady!

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ni-ší a-wi-il₅-tim qí-ib-a-ma iš-tí-šu-nu le-ta-wu
target: Say to the personnel of the lady that he must negotiate with them.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na i-dí-a-bi-im i-tur₄-DINGIR en-na-nim ù a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi-ma um-ma en-nam-a-šur-ma
target: To Iddin-abum, Itūr-ilī, Ennānum and Ali-ahum from Ennam-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-šu-mì lu-qú-tim ša a-bi-ni a-na ša-lá-ḫi-ša ta-áš-pu-ra-ni-ni
target: You have written me about dispatching our father's goods.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam a-da-da iš-tí a-šur-DU₁₀ DUMU a-zu-za-a i ša-lá-aḫ-šu-wa i-mì-ig-ru-ma
target: Here Adada agreed with Aššur-ṭāb son of Azuzaya in Šalahšuwa.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ku-ša-ra a-da-da a-na a-wi-lim ta-mu-im e-tí-tí-iq
target: Adada has travelled to Kuššara to have the man swear an oath.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ma-mì-tám iš-tí a-wi-lim i-lá-qé-ma ú lu-qú-tám ša DUMU a-zu-za-a-ma ḫa-ra-an sú-qá-ni-ma i-ša-lá-aḫ
target: He will get an oath from the man and then he will dispatch the goods of Azuzaya's son on the Narrow Track.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ba-ú-a bé-lu-a a-tù-nu šu-ma a-ma-kam a-wa-at kà-ri-im ù e-kál-lim da-na-ma lu-qú-tum a-mì-ša-am lá nu-šé-ra-ba-ší
target: My dear fathers, if the orders of the colony and the palace are strict there, then we shall not let the goods enter for that destination.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR 1 ma-na tí-ri i-na KÙ.BABBAR-áp a-bi-ni le-qé-a-ma iš-tí ba-tí-qí-im ú-lá iš-tí ṣú-ḫa-ri-a šé-bi₄-lá-nim-ma lu-qú-ut a-bi-ni a-šar šu-ul-mì-im li-ší-li-iḫ
target: Get every mina of -silver from our father's silver and send it here with an express caravan or with my servant, so our father's goods may be dispatched safely.

source: translate Akkadian to English: bé-lu-a a-tù-nu iḫ-da-ma ṣú-ḫa-ri-a ṭù-ur-da
target: My dear lords, take care to send my servant.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-nu-mì i-dí-a-bu-um a-na mu-a-tim ta-ad-nu-ma É a-šùr-bé-el-a-wa-tim wa-áš-bu
target: When Iddin-abum was dying and was staying in Aššur-bēl-awātim's house.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša ki-ma ili₅-ba-ni ÌR ù tám-kà-ru-šu e-ru-bu-ma
target: The representatives of Ilī-bāni, Wardum and his customers, came in(to the house).

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ša ki-ma ili₅-ba-ni-ma ni-kà-sí iš-tí-ni ší-sí-ma
target: Ilī-bāni's representatives said: Settle accounts with us!

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma i-dí-a-bu-um-ma ṭup-pí-ku-nu kà-i-lá ù ṭup-pu-a lá-pu-tù-ma i-ba-ší-ú
target: Iddin-abum answered: Hold your tablets ready, for my tablets are written and available.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša-lim-a-šur a-ḫi li-li-kam-ma iš-tí-šu ší-sí-a
target: Let my brother Šalim-Aššur come, and then settle with him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù am-ma ša ki-ma i-a-tí šu-{d}EN.LÍL ù a-mur-IŠTAR i-ša-ḫa-at a-ḫi-a li-zi-zu
target: Then my own representatives, Šu-Illil and Amur-Ištar may assist my brother.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí a-ḫi-i i-lá-kà-ni ma-ma-an ṭup-pí-a lá i-pá-té
target: Until my brother arrives no one may open my tablets.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um kà-ni-iš i-dí-ni-a-tí-ma
target: The Kanesh colony gave us for these proceedings.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI GÍR ša a-šùr ba-áb DINGIR-lim ší-bu-tí-ni ni-dí-in
target: We gave our testimony before Aššur's dagger in the Gate of the God.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-ku-za IGI lá-qé-ep IGI ṣí-lu-lu
target: Witnessed by Akuza, by Lā-qēp, by Ṣilūlu.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB <gap>-a-šur KIŠIB a-šur-ta-ak-lá-ku KIŠIB qá-ta-tim
target: Seal of <gap>-Aššur, seal of Aššur-taklāku, seal of Qatātum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4.1666 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR <gap> i-ṣé-er ga-ta-tim DAM.GÀR i-šu

target: He answered: "But I have sent him the silver. Those who carried the silver were Būr-Suen and his brother Ali-abum."

target: He continued: "It was those who brought it to him, and as the silver was (sent) in the name of Šukkutum, we seized Šukkutum here and said: Pay the silver for the donkey we have borrowed in the house of a merchant, and for which the silver and interest has grown heavy on our certified tablet."

target: Assist Lā-qēpum in accordance with our missive that we sent to Lā-qēpum and Ešu-bāni, and take care to react at the first assembly-meeting and confront the City, turn back to the City concerning the joint-stock capital since the orders of the City are strict, and the tablet abroad has been superseded.

target: Get a tablet with a verdict of the City stating that since the will of Šalim-Aššur of the City lies around, the tablet of Šalim-Aššur in which he spoke his will when he passed away, and which was entrusted to Iliya son of Elāli, that this tablet will be invalid.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pá-am ša dí-in a-lim{ki} le-qé-a-nim-ma ša ki-ma ṭup-pu-um ša a-na i-li-a
target: Get a tablet with a verdict of the City stating that the tablet which was entrusted to Iliya is invalid.

target: If you did not give it to Ataya, then give the silver to Ali-ahum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3.6666 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a-na ma-ma-i-im a-šu-mì a-šur-ta-ak-lá-ku LUGAL-sú-in iš-qúl
target: Šarrum-Suen paid 3.6666 minas of silver to the king of Mamma on behalf of Aššur-taklāku.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR iš-tí ur-ší-ší
target: 5 minas of silver is owed by Uršiši.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 6.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR kur-ub-a-šur ù en-nam-a-šur DUMU ṣí-li-IŠTAR
target: 6.5 minas of silver: Kurub-Aššur and Ennam-Aššur son of Ṣilli-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na 6 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR iš-tí ì-li-ma-lik
target: 1 mina 6 shekels of silver is owed by Ilī-malik.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR iš-tí DINGIR-na-da DUMU ì-lí-e-mu-qí
target: 1 mina of silver is owed by Ilī-nādā son of Ilī-emūqī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR iš-tí iš-pu-na-aḫ-šu
target: 2 minas of silver is owed by Išpun-ahšu.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 30 TÚG šu-ul-ḫi iš-tí a-mur-a-šur DUMU i-dí-lim
target: 30 šulhu-textiles are owed by Amur-Aššur son of Iddin-ilum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 32 TÚG šu-ul-ḫu a-ḫa-ma iš-tí sú-in-il₅-šu
target: 32 šulhu textiles are also owed by Suen-ilšu.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10.5 GÍN KÙ.GI pá-ša-lúm ta-ki-tám i-na áb-ni-šu iš-tí šu-sú-in
target: 10.5 shekels of pašallu-gold, confirmed (weight), ore, is owed by Šu-Suen.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi-ma um-ma SIG₅-pí-i-a-šur-ma ù MAN-a-šur
target: To Ali-ahum from Damiq-pī-Aššur and also Puzur-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na ḫa-ḫi-im ú-nu-ut-ni nu-ša-li-ḫa-ku-ni
target: In Hahhum we set aside our goods for you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na za-al-pá ù a-na-kam ni-iš-ta-na-me-ma ḫa-ra-an sú-ki-nim dan-na-at
target: In Zalpa and here we keep hearing that the Narrow Track is difficult.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lá na-ṭù-ma lá né-ra-áb
target: It is not a good idea for us to enter it.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫu-ni a-ta ki-ma AN.NA 10 ma-na <gap> ù 10 TÚG
target: Our dear brother, advise us whether we should dispatch to there (where you are) some 10 minas of tin and 10 textiles that we bring.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na 4 GÚ AN.NA a-wi-it e-lá-ma 4 ma-na 15 GÍN.TA da-tum 17 ma-na AN.NA ik-šu-sú
target: On 4 talents of tin, the declared value of Elamma('s merchandise), the road-tax at 4 minas 15 shekels tin per (talent) amounted for him to 17 minas of tin.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 ma-na AN.NA a-na ANŠE me-tim ku-na-a iš-ku-ni-a-tí
target: 5 minas of tin Kunnāya charged us for a donkey that had died.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.3333 ma-na 7.5 GÍN a-na ta-ší-a-tim áš-qúl
target: I paid 27.5 shekels (of tin) as costs of transport.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 ma-na ú-ku-ul-tum 15 GÍN qá-qá-dum ik-šu-sú
target: 2 minas (of tin) for food and fodder, the head-tax amounted for him to 15 shekels.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ta-ší-a-at 10 TÚG.ḪI.A wa-at-ru-tim 1.5 ma-na AN.NA il₅-qé
target: As costs of transport of 10 extra textiles he (the harnesser) took 1.5 mina of tin.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR bé-ú-la-tù-šu
target: 0.5 mina of silver was his working capital.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.3333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša a-na pá-ni-šu tù-šé-bi₄-lu 10 GÍN.TA a-na AN.NA ŠA-dí-in-ma mì-ma a-nim ga-am-ru-um
target: The 0.3333 mina of silver you sent him en route, was sold for tin at a rate of 10 : 1 and this is the total of the expenses.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2.5 ma-na AN.NA ni-pu-ul-šu-um
target: We made him a balance payment of 2.5 minas of tin.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR nu-ku-ra-im ù 1.5 ma-na AN.NA ta-ší-a-tim ša il₅-qé-ú da-ni-tí a-qá-bi₄-šu-um
target: For the 5 shekels of silver that were disputed and the 1.5 mina of tin he took as transport costs I will state him my harsh conditions.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR iš-tí i-tur₄-DINGIR DUMU PUZUR₄-a-na
target: 2 shekels of silver owed by Itūr-ilī son of Puzur-Anna.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 ší-ni-šu ší-né-en ša wa-aḫ-šu-ša-na SIG₅ iš-tù wa-aḫ-šu-ša-na ú-šé-ba-lam
target: From Wahšušana he must send two pairs of good shoes from Wahšušana.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma lá ú-šé-bi₄-lam 6 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i-ša-qá-lam
target: If he has not sent it he is to pay 6 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI kà-ba-tim DUMU a-šùr-GAL
target: Witnessed by Kabātum son of Aššur-rabi.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na tám-kà-ri-im qí-bi-ma um-ma šu-IŠTAR-ma
target: To the merchant from Šu-Ištar:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 9 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am ku-nu-ki-a ša ší-im lu-qú-tim ša ṭup-pì-a ḫa-ar-mì-im na-áb-sú-in ù e-ri-mu-ša na-áš-ú-ni-ku-um
target: Nab-Suen and Ewarimuša bring you 9 minas of refined silver under my seal, from the proceeds from the goods (mentioned) in my certified tablet.

source: translate Akkadian to English: SAG.BA 1.5 ma-na 1.6666 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ší-im ḫu-sà-ri-im
target: Of that 1.5 mina 1.6666 shekel of silver was the price of lapis lazuli.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na 8.5 GÍN ḫu-sà-ru-um a ší-mì-im ta-dí-in
target: 0.5 mina 8.5 shekels of lapis lazuli was offered for sale.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫi a-ta be-li a-ta a-ša ak-lu-ú li-ba-kà lá tù-lá-ma-na-kum
target: My dear brother and lord, do not be angry with me because I held back.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-we-lúm lá da-am-qú-um i-na e-ni-kà a-na ba-ú-ší-a i-za-az
target: A man who is no good stands ready to defame me in your eyes.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i lá i-dim URUDU 7 GÚ É kà-ri-im uš-ta-aṣ-bi₄-it
target: Without reason he made the colony seize some 7 talents of copper.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí ki-zi ak-lá iš-tí kà-ri-im ú-ta-na-na-an-ma a-ta-be-a-ma a-ta-lá-kam
target: I held back until I keep imploring the colony, and I shall set out and come.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB zu-ba DUMU en-na-nim KIŠIB PUZUR₄-{d}IŠKUR DUMU i-dí-IŠTAR
target: Seal of Zuba, son of Ennānum, seal of Puzur-Adad, son of Iddin-Ištar;

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-lá-bu-um DUMU zi-a tap-pá-i-ni
target: Ali-abum, son of Ziya, was our companion.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um kà-né-eš i-dí-ni-a-tí-ma
target: For these words the Kaneš colony made us available and

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pá-am IGI IGI GÍR ša a-šùr ší-bu-tí-ni ni-dí-in
target: this tablet we gave as our testimony rendered before Aššur's dagger.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 ma-na AN.NA ku-nu-ki ša i-ku-pí-IŠTAR DUMU i-ku-a-a a-na ì-lí-a-LIM DUMU sú-kà-li-a áp-qí-id IGI šu-ku-bi-im DUMU qá-a-tim IGI a-šur-ma-lik DUMU a-lá-ḫi-im
target: Three minas of tin under the seals of Ikūn-pī-Ištar, son of Ikū'aya I entrusted to Ilī-ālum, son of Sukkalliya, in the presence of Šu-Kūbum, son of Qa'atum (and) of Aššur-mālik, son of Ali-ahum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 7 ma-na AN.NA ša ku-ni-lim a-šur-DU₁₀ ú-bi-il₅
target: Seven minas of tin belonging to Kūn-ilum Aššur-ṭāb brought away.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-šu-šu-um um-ma i-na-aḫ-DINGIR-ma KÙ.BABBAR šu-qú-ul
target: Inah-ilī said: Pay the silver!

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-we-lúm KÙ.BABBAR ú-ša-áš-<gap>-qá-lá-ni
target: The man wants to make me pay the silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam šu-IŠTAR ù IŠTAR-lá-ma-sí ik-ta-na-lu-ú-ni um-ma šu-nu-ma KÙ.BABBAR a-ḫi-kà lá ta-ša-qá-al-ma lu-mu-ul-li-bi₄-im a-na a-ḫi-kà lá ta-ra-ší
target: Šu-Ištar and Ištar-lamassī keep holding me back here, saying: "Do not pay your brother's silver and incur his anger!"

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma i-na-aḫ-DINGIR-ma KÙ.BABBAR 10 ma-na té-pu-uš-ma tù-ub-lam
target: Inah-ilī said: "You have made and brought here some 10 minas of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR a-na ma-lá ṭup-pí-kà ḫa-ar-mì-im šu-qú-ul
target: Pay the silver in accordance with your certified tablet."

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma a-dí 10 u₄-me-e lá ta-tal-kam ú-lá tí-ir-ta-kà a-na ṣé-er ša ki-ma ku-wa-tí lá i-tal-kam KÙ.BABBAR a-na i-na-aḫ-DINGIR a-ša-qal
target: If you have not come within 10 days or have sent word to your representatives, I shall pay the silver to Inah-ilī."

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ša ki-ma ku-wa-tí-ma a-na en-um-a-šur qí-bi₄-ma
target: From your representatives to Ennam-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 21 GÚ 40 ma-na URUDU 1 GÚ 28 ma-na URUDU SIG₅ ku-nu-ki-ni ša-lim-wa-ar-dim i-ra-dí-a-kum
target: Šalim-wardī leads 21 talents 40 minas of copper and 1 talent 28 minas of good copper under our seals to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 21 GÚ 30 ma-na URUDU i-na ma-ṣa-ar-tim nu-šé-ṣí
target: We brought out 21 talents 30 minas of copper from the safe.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 GÚ URUDU ší-kam ša-lim-wa-ar-dim i-dí-ni-a-tí
target: Šalim-wardī gave us 3 talents of copper.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ma-lá i-na ba-áb-tí-kà il₅-ta-qé-ú a-ma-kam lu-ba-li-ṭá-kum
target: He will credit you there with as much as he received from your outstanding claims.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a ma-lá na-áš-pè-er-tí-ni pá-ni-tim URUDU ša ma-ṣa-ar-tim 20 ma-na i-tí-ir
target: In accordance with our previous missive about the copper from the safe 20 minas were in excess.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a ma-lá tí-ir-tí-kà ni-iš-ta-al-ma na-áš-pè-er-ta-kà ša a kà-ri-im tù-šé-bi₄-lá-ni ki-ma i-na ṭup-pì-kà a-wa-tum 2 ší-ta ú 3-áš da-na-tim ta-al-pu-ta-ni lá nu-uš-ta-áš-me-ší
target: In accordance with your instructions, we took counsel, and as for your missive that you sent to the colony, since you wrote 2 or 3 harsh words in your letter, we have not let it be heard.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma né-nu-ma sú-ra-am e nu-ša-al-qé-šu-nu
target: We thought: We must not allow them to take offense!

source: translate Akkadian to English: na-áš-pè-er-ta-kà i-ba-ší i-na a-lá-ki-kà e-na-na-tim e-ri-iš-ma e-nu-nu-ni-kum
target: Your missive is still here. When you come, ask for clemency, and they will be lenient with you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša-áp-ra-tum ša DUMU PUZUR₄-a-na a-šar šu-IŠTAR i-ba-ší-a tí-ir-ta-kà li-li-kam
target: The pledges from Puzur-Anna's son are with Šu-Ištar. Send word.

source: translate Akkadian to English: qá-tum a-na 1 GÚ 10 ma-na ta-dí-in
target: The share has been sold for 1 talent 10 minas.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-šur-ma-sú-wi-ma a-na a-šur-na-da ù en-nam-a-šùr qí-bi₄-ma
target: From Aššur-massuʾī to Aššur-nādā and Ennam-Aššur; specifically to Ennam-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-šùr-na-da lu-ṭá-ib-kà
target: Aššur-nādā should satisfy you with regard to the wife.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na lu-bu-ší-ša ù ep-ri-ša a-na mu-lá i-ta-dí-ší-im
target: Give regularly 5 shekels of silver for her clothes and her provisions to Mula.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma ša šé-bu-lim ú-šé-ba-lá-ku-um-ma KÙ-áp-kà šu-ta-bi₄
target: I shall send what there is to send to you, so you can be satisfied with the silver you are entitled to.

source: translate Akkadian to English: té-er-ta-kà za-ku-tám iš-tù a-lim a-ša-pá-ra-kum
target: I shall send you a complete report from the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na šu-pè-e-nu-ma-an DUMU ma-lá <gap> a <gap>
target: to Šuppinuman son of Mala<gap>

source: translate Akkadian to English: 36 GÚ SÍG.ḪI.A ša ì-lí-dan ša i-na É ir-i-bi₄-im i-ba-ší-ú en-um-a-šur iṣ-ba-at
target: Ennam-Aššur has seized 36 talents of wool belonging to Ilī-dan that was in Irʾibum's house.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-ut-ma lá tù-šar
target: He said: You must not release it.

source: translate Akkadian to English: tù-šar-ma i-na É-tí <gap>
target: If you release it, in the house<gap>

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.3333 ma-na <gap> KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pu-um KI a-we-lá-tim <gap> ITU.KAM be-el-té-kà-lim li-mu-um <gap> nu <gap> ma ni <gap> IGI DUG-ṣí-li-a-šur IGI a-šùr-ba-ni za <gap> IGI ba-ba-li IGI be-lí-a DUMU DINGIR-ba-ni i-na 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ù ṣí-ib-tí-šu ša li-bi₄ šu-ku-bi-im ŠÀ.BA-<gap>-GÍN KÙ.BABBAR 0.3333 ma-na 2 <gap> ší-im UD <gap> 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR <gap> a-na <gap> ni-<gap> 12.5 GÍN <gap> lá ḫi-ri <gap>
target: 0.3333 mina <gap> of refined silver is owed by the ladies.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB ib-ni-{d}IM KIŠIB id-na-a KIŠIB a-zu-za-a
target: Seal of Ibnī-Adad, seal of Idnaya, seal of Azuzaya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša be-ú-lá-at PUZUR₄-ša-du-e ṭup-pu-um ša e-li-a-ni sà-ar ša ku-nu-ki ša i-ri-ší-im
target: Concerning Puzur-šadu'e's working capital: any tablet that may appear is invalid - one with Irišum's seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10.75 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i-ṣé-er a-li-li tù-mì-li-a-i-im a-lá-ḫu-um i-šu
target: Alili, the man from Tumlia, owes 11 minus 1 / 4 shekels of silver to Ali-ahum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù ḫa-mu-uš-tim ša kà-ší-im 1 GÍN.TA ṣí-ib-tám i-na ITU.1.KAM-im ú-ṣa-áb
target: Reckoned from the week of the -official he will pay interest at the rate of 1 shekel per month.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ITU.1.KAM be-el-té-kà-lim li-mu-um ša qá-tí a-šùr-i-mì-tí ma-lá-ḫi-im
target: Month Bēlat-ekallim, in the eponymy after that of Aššur-imittī, the skipper.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI wa-al-dí-DINGIR IGI i-na-ar
target: Witnessed by Waldi-ilum, by Inar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 8 ma-na KÙ ṣa-ru-pá-am i-ṣé-er i-dí-a-bi₄-im ku-la i-šu
target: Iddin-abum owes 8 minas of refined silver to Kula.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù ḫa-mu-uš-tim ša ḫa-pì-aḫ-šu ù sú-kà-lí-a a-na 25 ḫa-am-ša-tim a-na a-lim{ki} i-lá-ak-ma iš-tí um-me-a-ni-šu 2 ma-na KÙ.GI šu-mì ku-lá i-lá-pá-at
target: Reckoned from the week of happi-ahšu and Sukkalliya he must go to the City within 25 weeks and together with his investors he must book Kula's name for 2 minas of gold.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma i-na ma-lá u₄-me-šu a-na a-lim{ki} lá i-ta-lá-ak KÙ.BABBAR a-na-ku lá i-ša-qal
target: If he has not left for the City within his stipulated term, he must repay the silver to Kula.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma lá iš-qú-ul a-na 1 ma-na-im 1.5 GÍN.TA i-na 1 ITU.KAM ú-ṣa-áb
target: If he has not paid (in time), he must pay interest at the rate 1.5 shekel per mina per month.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-šùr-ba-ni IGI i-dí-sú-in
target: Witnessed by Aššur-bāni, by Iddin-Suen.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pá-am ša bi-zi-lá ù IŠTAR-lá-ma-sí qá-sá ša IŠTAR-lá-ma-sí
target: (Of) 1 tablet of Bizila and Ištar-lamassī, the share of Ištar-lamassī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 qá-áb-li-a-tim ša 1 ma-na.TA KÙ.BABBAR iš-té-et a-ḫu-úz-tum mu-ša-lá-am ša ZABAR ù ma-az-li-ki mì-ma a-nim a-na ḫu-bu-ul {d}NIN.ŠUBUR-ba-ni a-na lu-lu áp-qí-id
target: 2 -containers of 1 mina silver each, one with inlay; a bronze mirror and some 's. All this I entrusted to Lullu for the debt of Ilabrat-bāni.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-na-ku-ma a-na É a-bi-a ù um-mì-a a-na mì-ma šu-um-šu ú-lá ta-tù-ar lu i-na ší-im bé-tim lu i ši-im TÚG.ḪI.A lu i ší-im qá-áb-li-a-tim mu-ša-li-im ù ma-az-li-ki iš-tù nu-a-am ḫu-bu-ul {d}NIN.ŠUBUR-ba-ni tù-ša-bu-ú
target: You shall not again claim anything from the house of my father and mother, neither from the price of the house, nor from the price of textiles, nor from the price of 's, the mirror, and the 's.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-tum KÙ.BABBAR mì-ma i-na li-bi-kà i-ší-tù i-le-e i-na li-bi-kà i-šu-ú
target: After you will have paid the Anatolian the debt of Ilabrat-bāni, for the rest of the silver, whatever you still owe me, I have the gods as claim on you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na ṭup-pí-im pá-qá-dim bi-za-lá a-na qá-tí-ša ta-zi-iz
target: When the tablet was handed over Bizala took responsibility for her share.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI dan-a-šur IGI a-mur-DINGIR IGI ma-ṣí-ì-lí IGI a-šur-iš-ta-ki-il₅ IGI ḫa-pu-a-šu ša SÍG.ḪI.A IGI PÚZUR.IŠTAR
target: In the presence of Dān-Aššur, of Amur-ili, of Maṣi-ilī, of Aššuriš-takil. of Happuaša, the wool-trader, and of Puzur-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB i-pí-lí-is KIŠIB a-šur-na-da DUMU a-mur-lu-sú KIŠIB la-qé-pí-im
target: Seal of Ippilis, seal of Aššur-nādā, son of Amur-ilūssu, seal of Lā-qēpum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša e-la-ma ù id-na-a ma-aḫ-ri-ni ni-kà-sé i-sí-ú-ma
target: That Elamma and Idnāya settled accounts in our presence (with the following result).

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pu-um ù 13.5 ma-na URUDU SIG₅ i-lí-bi na-a
target: 35 shekels of refined silver and 13.5 minas of refined copper are due by Idnāya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù ḫa-mu-uš-tim ša am-ri-a ù e-lá-lí ki-ma a-wa-at kà-ri-im a-na ṣí-ib-tim i-lá-ak-šum
target: They become interest-bearing for him at the rate stipulated by the colony from the week-eponymy of Amriya and Elālī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣí-ib-tum pá-ni-tum 0.8333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR gám-ru-um ša iš-ta-pu-ru-šu-ni i li-bi₄-šu-ma
target: 1.5 mina of silver, an earlier interest, (and) 0.8333 mina of silver, expenses, about which he wrote him repeatedly, he also owes.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5.5 ma-na URUDU SIG₅ a-na a-we-el-tim tù-um-li-a-tim wa-al-dí-DINGIR ú-bi-il₅
target: Waldi-ilum brought 5.5 minas of good copper to the lady from Tumliya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša ni-iš a-lim{ki} ù ru-ba-im ta-mu-ú kà-i-lá ma-nu-ba-lu-um-a-šur a-ša-a-al-kà ṭup-pá-am ša 5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ú ṭí-ba-tí-šu ša a-šur-ták-lá-ku a-na PUZUR₄-a-na a-ḫi-šu ḫa-bu-lu-ú ṭup-pá-am PUZUR₄-a-na a-na na-áb-ší-im lu a-na a-bi-kà e-zi-ib lu ku-a-tí e-zi-ba-ku-um ik-re-e ú-lá kà-i-ni
target: Keep in mind what was sworn by the City and the king! Mannum-balum-Aššur, I question you: The tablet concerning 5 minas of silver and its interest that Aššur-taklāku owes to his brother Puzur-Anna, did Puzur-Anna leave the tablet for safekeeping with your father, or did he leave it with you yourself? Deny or confirm it!

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú-la ri-ig-ma-tù-um ší-bu-tù-um en-um-a-šur KÙ.BABBAR tám-kà-ri-šu i-šé-e ma-num-ba-lúm-a-šur ša ki-ma en-um-a-šur e-pu-ul um-ma ma-num-ba-lúm-a-šur-ma a-na ša ki-ma en-um-a-šur-ma 4 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR PUZUR₄-a-na DUMU šu-{d}EN.LÍL ḫa-bu-lam ṭup-pu-šu ḫa-ar-ma-am ú-kà-al
target: This is not a formal lawsuit but a witnessed statement. Ennam-Aššur sues for the silver of his merchant. Mannum-balum-Aššur answered, saying to Ennam-Aššur's representative: 'Puzur-Anna son of Šu-Illil owes me 4 minas of silver. I have his certified tablet.'

source: translate Akkadian to English: PUZUR₄-a-na GÁN-lam i-lá-ak-ma um-ma a-na-ku-ma ša-zi-za-am ša KÙ.BABBAR-pí-i-kà um-ma PUZUR₄-a-na-ma ma-nam lu-ša-zi-za-ku-um a-ma ṭup-pu-um ḫa-ar-mu-um ša 5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša ḫu-bu-ul a-šur-ták-lá-ku DUMU šu-{d}EN.LÍL le-qé-ma qá-at-kà lu ša-ak-na-at-ma a-šùr-ták-lá-ku ša-áš-qí-il₅-ma KÙ.BABBAR ù ṭí-ba-sú le-qé-ma ù KÙ.BABBAR a-na-ku
target: Since Puzur-Anna would go overland, I said: 'Appoint someone responsible to me for your silver.' Puzur-Anna answered: 'Who shall I appoint for you? Here, take a certified tablet worth 5 minas of silver, the debt of Aššur-taklāku son of Šu-Illil, lay claim to it and make Aššur-taklāku pay, take the silver and the accrued interest paid, and then I personally shall take the silver.'

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3.3333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša iš-tù li-mì-im DINGIR-ba-ni a-bu-ni a-na PUZUR₄-sú-in a-na e-bu-ṭim i-dí-nu
target: The 3.3333 minas of silver that our father gave to Puzur-Suen as an investment-loan in the eponymy Ilī-bāni.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 ma-na 4 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ù me-at 80 sà-am-ru-a-tim a-na a-zu-za a-bu-ni a-na e-bu-ṭim <gap>
target: The 4 minas 4 shekels of silver and 180 nails that our father gave to Azuza as an investment-loan.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma be-lu-lu-ma a-na aḫ-ša-lim qí-bi-ma
target: From Belulu to Ah-šalim:

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-nu-mì tù-uṣ-ú-ni 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a-dí-na-kum
target: When you left I gave you 1 mina of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša ṣú-ba-tim ša NA₄ GUG ša 1 ma-na pár-zi-lim be-<gap> DINGIR-ba-ni
target: Of the textiles, of the carnelian, of 1 mina of iron <gap>

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-nu-mì i-na pá-ni-tim uṣ-ú 1.5 TÚG a-dí-in
target: When <gap>-bāni left earlier I gave (him) 1.5 textile.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-na-ku-ma a-na aḫ-ša-lim dí-in
target: I said: Give it to Ah-šalim!

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-ut-ma a-na ì-lí-a a-dí-in
target: He said: "I gave it to Iliya."

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.3333 ma-na 2.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR 20 NINDA i-ṣé-er tù-wa-ra-a-aḫ-šu a-lá-ḫu-um i-šu
target: Tuwar-ahšu owes 0.3333 mina 2.5 shekels of silver (and) 20 loaves of bread to Ali-ahum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 34 TÚG ku-ta-ni i-na-pu-lu-nim 3.8333 ma-na ša mì-ší-tim
target: For 34 kutānu-textiles they will balance me 3.8333 minas of the holding.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.8333 ma-na 3.5 GÍN ša šál-ša-tim i-na pá-nim-ma a-la-qé
target: 1 mina 53.5 shekels of the one-third parts I will take in the first instance.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 TÚG ku-ta-ni pu-šu-ke-en₆ i-na-pá-lam ša ILLAT-at pì-lá-aḫ-IŠTAR DUMU ú-zu-a
target: 2 kutānu-textiles Pūšu-kēn will balance me of the caravan of Pilah-Ištar, son of Uzua.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-be-lúm DUMU i-dí-a-bi₄-im a-na PUZUR₄.IŠTAR DUMU da-da iṣ-ba-at-ni-a-tí-ma
target: Šu-Bēlum son of Iddin-abum seized us in his case against Puzur-Ištar son of Dada.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-bé-lúm-ma a-na PUZUR₄.IŠTAR-ma 16 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ù ṣí-ba-sú a-na a-bi-a ḫa-bu-lá-tí
target: Šu-Bēlum said to Puzur-Ištar: You owe 16 minas of silver and its interest to my father.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ù ṣí-ba-sú im-tí-da-kum 1 ma-na-um 0.3333 ma-na i ša-tim tù-ṣa-áb
target: The silver and the interest on it has become a great sum for you: You pay 0.3333 mina per mina per year as interest.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma PUZUR₄.IŠTAR-ma a-bu-kà maš-ke-e il₅-ta-qé-ma KÙ.BABBAR ša-bu
target: Puzur-Ištar answered: Your father has already received hides so he has been paid the silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ki-ma šu-bé-lim nu-ší-ib-ma ni-iš a-lim{ki} it-mu-ú-ma a-na 6 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR i-mì-ig-ru
target: We sat down (to negotiate) on behalf of Šu-Bēlum and they swore an oath by the City and agreed on 6 minas of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI ni-mar-IŠTAR IGI en-nam-a-šùr a-šùr-na-da DUMU šu-{d}EN.LÍL tap-pá-i-ni a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim
target: Witnessed by Nimar-Ištar, by Ennam-Aššur; Aššur-nādā son of Šu-Illil is our (absent) partner.

source: translate Akkadian to English: kà-ru-um kà-né-eš i-dí-ni-a-tí-ma IGI GÍR ša a-šùr ší-bu-tí-ni ni-dí-in
target: The Kanesh colony gave us for these proceedings and we gave our testimony before Aššur's dagger.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB šu-nu-nu DUMU a-mur-IŠTAR KIŠIB zu-zu DUMU en-um-ì-lí KIŠIB {d}MAR.TU-ba-ni DUMU šu-lá-áb-ra-at KIŠIB šu-be-lim DUMU ili₅-ba-ni
target: Seal of Šu-Nūnu son of Amur-Ištar, seal of Zuzu son of Ennam-ilī, seal of Amurrum-bāni son of Šu-Ilabrat, seal of Šu-Bēlum son of Ilī-bāni.

source: translate Akkadian to English: <gap> ma-na KÙ.BABBAR i-ṣé-er šu-bé-lim DUMU ili₅-ba-ni i-ri-šum i-šu
target: Šu-Bēlum son of Ilī-bāni owes <gap> minas of silver to Irišum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na 2 ITU.KAM i-ša-qal
target: He will pay within 2 months.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ITU.KAM na-ar-ma-ak a-šur ša ke-na-tim li-mu-um ša qá-tí a-mur-a-šur DUMU kà-ri-a
target: Month Narmak-Aššur-ša-kēnātim, eponymy after that of Amur-Aššur son of Karriya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma lá iš-qú-ul 3 GÍN.TA i-na ITU.KAM ṣí-ib-tám ú-ṣa-áb
target: If he has not paid he will add interest at the rate 3 shekels per month.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ṣé-er-ša ki-ma DAM.GÀR bi₄-il₅-ma a ma-lá tí-ir-tí DAM.GÀR ší-mu-um li-ší-i-ma šé-ṣí-a-am
target: Bring to the merchant's representatives and let a purchase be carried out in accordance with the merchant's instructions, and have it brought out.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 18 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am en-um-a-šùr DUMU sú-kà-lí-a i-na ší-im SÍG.ḪI.A ša ú-ší-na-lam il₅-qé
target: Ennam-Aššur son of Sukkalliya has received 18 minas of refined silver from the proceeds of Ušinalam's wool.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-šùr-i-mì-tí DUMU du-dí-ki
target: Witnessed by Aššur-imittī son of Dudiki.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI <gap> DUMU en-na-nim
target: by <gap> son of Ennānum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 ta-ma-la-ku ša ṭup-pí ḫa-ru-mu-tim
target: 5 tablet containers with certified tablets;

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫa-ma 2 ta-ma-lá-ku ša i-dí-a-bi-im
target: further, 2 containers belonging to Iddin-abum

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù iš-té-en ta-ma-lá-kum ša i-dí-a-šùr
target: and one container belonging to Iddin-Aššur;

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫa-ma i-na iš-té-en ta-ma-lá-ki-im ṭup-pu-um ša É pu-šu-ke-en₆
target: further in one container is the tablet concerning Pūšu-kēn's house

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ṭup-pu-um ša É šu-a-nim
target: and one tablet concerning Šu-Anum's house.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠU.NÍGIN 11 ta-ma-lá-ki
target: In all: 11 tablet containers;

source: translate Akkadian to English: qá-dum ša me-eḫ-ri-šu ù na-áš-pé-ra-tim a-šur-ma-sú-i i-na É-bé-tí-šu e-zi-ib
target: Aššur-massu'ī left them together with those of his copies and missives in his house.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 GÍN a-na en-nam-a-šur DUMU e-lá-ma a-dí-in
target: I gave 2 shekels to Ennam-Aššur son of Elamma;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na ra-bi₄-ṣí-šu a-dí-in
target: I gave 1 shekel of silver to his attorney;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na PUZUR₄-a-šùr DUMU a-šùr-da-an a-dí-in
target: I gave 2 shekels of silver to Puzur-Aššur son of Aššur-dan;

source: translate Akkadian to English: GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i-ṣé-er ga-lu ù ku-lu-ma-an pé-ru-wa i-šu
target: 18 shekels of silver Galu and Kuluman owe to Peruwa.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na ša-tim ša-tim 6 GÍN.TA KÙ.BABBAR i-ša-qú-lu
target: In successive years they will pay each time 6 shekels.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI ki-li-nu-ma-an
target: In the presence of Kilinuman.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pá-am ša 3 ma-na 15 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša ḫu-bu-ul a-nu-li a-na a-gi-a DUMU PUZUR₄-a-šur pá-qí-id
target: A tablet concerning 3 minas 15 shekels of silver, the debt of Anuli, has been entrusted to Agiya son of Puzur-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB ba-ba-zu-a DUMU šu-a-nim
target: Seal of Babazua son of Šu-Anum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB DU₁₀-ṣí-li-a-šur DUMU a-li-li
target: Seal of Ṭāb-ṣill-Aššur son of Ali-ilī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB šu-IŠTAR DUMU a-šùr-lá-ma-sí
target: Seal of Šu-Ištar son of Aššur-lamassī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um du-ur-ḫu-mì-it i-dí-ni-a-tí-ma
target: The Durhumit colony gave us for these proceedings.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI GÍR ša a-šur ší-bu-tí-ni ni-dí-in
target: We gave our testimony before Aššur's dagger.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 GÚ 20 ma-na URUDU SIG₅ ša tí-iš-mur-ur-na a-na šu-zu-zu aḫ-bu-ul-šum URUDU ša-bu-ra-am ú-ta-ra-am IGI en-na-sú-in DUMU uš-ḫa-dí
target: I owe 1 talent 20 minas of good copper from Tišmurna to Šuzuzu.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.5 GÚ 0.6666 ma-na 5 GÍN AN.NA iš-tù ni-is-ḫa-tim ni-dí-nu ni-is-ni-iq
target: We checked 1.5 talent 0.6666 minas 5 shekels of tin after we gave the import duty.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-dí-da ú a-lá-ḫi-im ù ku-ku-lá-nim qí-bi-ma um-ma MAN-a-šur-ma
target: To Adida, Ali-ahum and Kukkulānum from Puzur-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma a-da-a IR ša a-bu-bu en-na-sú-in me-ra-šu a-na ší-mì-im i-ša-qal IR-dam le-qé-a-ni-šu
target: If - with respect to Adaya, Abubu's slave - his son Enna-Šuen is ready to sell him, then take him (as) slave.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na qá-tí ša-ni-im qá-áb-li-tám e-ri-a
target: Empty the into the hands of another.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma da-da lá i-mu-a a-na ṣé-ri-a li-li-kam
target: If Dada refuses, then let him come to me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR 1 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ù 2 GÍN ig-ri-a ša-al-ma a-na ša-ni-ú-tim lá a-ta-na-dí-in
target: Inquire about my wages of 1 or 2 shekels of silver so I do not squander it to others.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫu-ú-a a-tù-nu le-qé-a-ni-šu
target: My dear brothers, take him for me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.6666 ma-na 2.83334 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i li-bi₄-šu-nu a-ḫu-ur
target: 42.8333 shekels of silver is still due by them.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4.5 GÚ URUDU SIG₅ 1 GÚ 20 ma-na URUDU lá-mu-nu-um i-na ma-ṣa-ar-tim ša a-mur-a-šur a-šur-na-da e-lá-ma ù a-šur-SIPA ú-šé-ṣí-ú
target: 4.5 talents of refined copper, 1 talent and 20 minas of poor copper Aššur-nādā, Elamma and Aššur-rē'ī brought out of the strong-room of Amur-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-šur-na-da ki-ma KÙ-pí-šu e-ru-ub
target: Aššur-nādā entered on account of his own (claim on) silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: e-lá-ma ù a-šur-SIPA ki-ma um-mì-a-ni e-ru-bu
target: Elamma and Aššur-rē'ī entered in the name of the investors.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-šur-ni-šu ki-ma ku-ra e-ru-ub
target: Aššur-nišū entered representing Kura.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-šur-na-da IGI zi-kà-i IGI ar-ši-aḫ IGI ku-ku-lá-nim IGI e-lá-li-a
target: Witnessed by Aššur-nādā, Zikayi, Arši-ah, Kukkulānum, and Elāliya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pí-šu ib-ri-ú-ma ù šu-nu-ma ik-nu-ku-ma a-na ma-ṣa-ar-tim ú-šé-ri-bu
target: They inspected his tablets and they were also the ones who sealed them (again) and brought them (again) into the strong-room.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi-ma um-ma SIG₅-pí-a-šur MAN-a-šur ú ṣí-li-a-ma
target: To Ali-ahum from Damiq-pī-Aššur, Puzur-Aššur and Ṣilliya:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí DUMU ḫi-na-a ša ta-áš-pu-ra-ni a-na-kam DUMU ḫi-na-a ni-iṣ-ba-at-ma um-ma né-nu-ma KÙ.BABBAR ša a-lá-ḫi-im šu-qúl
target: With respect to hinnaya's son about whom you wrote, we seized hinnaya's son here and said: Pay Ali-ahum's silver!

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-ut-ma a-ni-na a-na kà-ni-iš ḫa-ra-šu KÙ.BABBAR i-ša-qal-šum
target: He answered: "Annina is on his way to Kanesh. Annina will pay him the silver in Kanesh."

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-lá-ḫi-im a-na-ku na-kam ni-iṣ-ba-at-ma um-ma
target: Have Annina pay you the silver there. We questioned Annina, saying: "About the silver, is it you who will pay?"

source: translate Akkadian to English: kà-ru-um kà-ni-ìš dì-nam i-dì-in-ma
target: The Kanesh colony has passed a verdict,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša-lim-a-šùr ù DUMU a-mur-IŠTAR ší-bi-šu-nu i-šé-e-ú-ma
target: stating that Šalim-Aššur and Amur-Ištar's son shall seek out their witnesses,

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ITU.10.KAM a-le-e i-ma-gu₅-ru-ni e-ta-wu
target: and within 10 months they shall negotiate where they agree.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ITU.1.KAM kán-wa-ar-ta-an li-mu-um ku-bi-e-a
target: Month Kanwartan, eponymy Kūbiya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 24.3333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ù ša 3 TÚG 1 ma-na 7.5 GÍN <gap> ša ANŠE <gap> ša 12 TÚG 4 ma-na ša 1 TÚG ku-ta-nim ša ku-ni-lim 11 GÍN e-la-ma
target: 24.3333 minas of silver and 1 mina for 3 textiles, 7.5 shekels for a donkey, for 12 textiles 4 minas, for 1 textile of Kūn-ilum 11 shekels - Elamma.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 23.8333 ma-na ú ša 3 TÚG 1 ma-na šu-ku-bu-um
target: 23.8333 minas and 1 mina for 3 textiles - Šu-Kūbum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na 15 GÍN ḫi-na-a i-na-pá-al <gap> e-la-ma <gap> 2 ma-na 10 GÍN šu-ku-bu-um i-na-pá-lam iš-tù
target: 1 mina 15 shekels will balance Elamma, 2 minas 10 shekels Šu-Kūbum will balance to me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ni-ip-lá-tum ša ḫi-na-a ú šu-ku-bi₄-im ba-at-qá-ni 0.6666 ma-na 2 GÍN a-na kà-ri-im a-na-pá-al
target: After the balance payments by hinnāya and Šu-Kūbum have been deducted I will balance 42 shekels to the colony.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na ṣí-ba-at ṭup-pí-im
target: on the additional tablet

source: translate Akkadian to English: 12 ma-na ḫa-bu-lá-ku
target: I owe 12 minas

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú iš-ta- mì-nam lá-dí-na-kum
target: What shall I give you?

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na en-um-a-šùr qí-bi-ma um-ma lá-qé-ep-ma
target: To Ennam-Aššur from Lā-qēp:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 20 2 GÚ SÍG.ḪI.A šé-ep-IŠTAR ù ša-lim-ar-dí ú-sá-ni-qú-ni-a-tí
target: Šēp-Ištar and Šalim-wardī checked 22 talents of wool for us.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù 94 maš-ki im-nu-ú
target: and they counted 94 fleeces.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ku-nu-ki-ni a ma-lá tí-ir-tí-kà šé-ep-IŠTAR ú ša-lim-ar-dí na-áš-ú-ni-kum
target: In accordance with your instructions Šēp-Ištar and Šalim-wardī bring you 0.5 mina of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù 10 ANŠE ṣa-lá-mì ú ú-nu-sú-nu i-ra-dí-ú-ni-kum
target: They also lead 10 black donkeys and their harness to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na URUDU a-na qá-tí-šu-nu ni-dí-in
target: We gave 1 mina of copper for their expenses.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na a-šur-ma-lik
target: 1.5 shekel of silver for Aššur-malik;

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na en-nam-a-šur qí-bi₄-ma um-ma a-lá-ḫu-um ù a-mur-IŠTAR-ma
target: To Ennam-Aššur from Ali-ahum and Amur-Ištar:

source: translate Akkadian to English: lá li-bi i-li-ma a-bu-ni me-et
target: Sadly, our father has died.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lá šál-ma-a-šur a-bu-ni a-ta a-bu-ni
target: It is not Šalim-Aššur who is our father, it is you who are our father.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-kam a-na tí-ir-tí a-bi₄-ni i-ḫi-id-ma za-ki-i a-ni-ša-am mì-ma
target: Take care there of our father's instructions and clear up the affairs.

source: translate Akkadian to English: tí-ir-tí a-bi₄-ni lá tù-pá-na-am a-na-kam
target: You shall not transfer any consignment of our father's to this place.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-té-en ù ší-na i-na um-me-a-ni-ni wa-áš-bu
target: One or two of our investors are staying here.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-bu-ni a-ta be-el-ni a-ta za-ki
target: Our dear father and lord, clear it up.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na a-wa-at {d}IM mì-ḫu-um ù sá-as-qí-um
target: By Adad's order: mihhu-beer and flour offerings.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 e-ma-re-e a-na 0.5 ma-na 3 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR
target: 2 donkeys for 33 shekels of silver,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 e-ma-re a-na 0.3333 ma-na 5.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR
target: 2 donkeys for 25.5 shekels of silver,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i-na ší-im TÚG-ba-tim ša a-na a-ší-tí-šu tí-sà-ba-am iš-ú-mu-ú
target: 1.5 shekel of silver from the price of a textile, when he bought a tisabu-garment for his wife —

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠU.NÍGIN 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR i-na li-bi a-lu-ta-ni ḫu-ša-na-lim IGI ḫu-na-da-du-a e-me-šu ú ší-ší-im ša a-lu-ta-ni IGI ba-za-za-a
target: in all 1 mina of silver due from Alutani Husanalum, witnessed by Hunadadu'a, his son-in-law and the <gap> of Alutani, and Bazazaya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.6666 ma-na 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ší-im 2-ší-na e-ma-re áš-du-na-ni ḫu-ša-na-lim ḫa-bu-ul IGI ḫu-na-da-du-a IGI ḫu-ur-du-na-ni IGI ba-za-za-a
target: 45 shekels of silver, the price of 2 donkeys Asdunani Husanalum owes, witnessed by Hunadadu, by Hurdunani, by Bazazaya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ší-im 2 e-ma-re-e i li-bi na-na-li-i ù ú-ba-ar-za-a a-ḫi-šu-ú IGI ú-šu-bu-ḫa-ma-za-a IGI du-me-ni IGI ḫu-na-da-du-a IGI ba-za-za-a-a
target: 0.5 mina of silver, the rprice of 2 donkeys owed by Nanali and Ubarzaya, his brother, witnessed by Usubuhamazaya, by Dumeni, by Hunadadu'a, by Bazazaya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.3333 ma-na 4 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ší-im 2 e-ma-re-e i li-bi₄ ku-li-a pá-ší-ri-im IGI ba-za-za-a IGI ḫu-na-da-du-a IGI ú-a-na-me-a tap-pá-i-šu-ú IGI ḫa-šu-ta-a-li-i
target: 24 shekels of silver the price of 2 donkeys, owed by Kuliya, the retailer, witnessed by Bazazaya, by Hunadaduam, by U'anamea, his partner, and by Hasutayali.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ší-im 2 e-ma-re i li-bi ba-za-za-a IGI ur-dim IGI a-li-a
target: 0.5 mina of silver, the price of 2 donkeys, owed by Bazazaya, witnessed by Urdum, by Aliya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠU.NÍGIN 3 ma-na 9 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR-áp-kà i da-áš-e i-ša-qú-lu
target: All together: 3 minas and 9 shekels, your silver, they will pay in spring.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 ú-kà-pu-ú e-dí-ú tum ša iš-tí du-du-ú a-na kà-ar-pá-at ú na-bi-it ṭá-áb-tim al-qé-ú
target: 2 saddlecloths which I acquired from Dudu for one jar and a quantity of salt.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù e-ma-sú-um ša 10 qé-e iš-tí en-um-a-šùr DUMU ší-ip-ri-im i-na té-ga-ra-ma i-ba-ší
target: And one emasum with a capacity of 10 quarts is with Ennum-Assur, the son of the messenger, in Tegarama.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša {d}UTU-ba-ni i li-bi a-sà-nim 1 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i tù-a-ri-šu i-da-šum
target: 0.5 shekel of silver of Samas-bani is due from Asanum, when he comes back he will give him 1 shekel of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-nu-mì i-dí-a-bu-um a-na a-lim{ki} i-lu-ku 2 ma-na KÙ.GI i-na na-ru-qí-šu KI um-me-a-ni-šu šu-mì i-ku-pí-a-šùr i-la-pá-at
target: When Iddin-abum goes to the City he will book 2 minas of gold in his joint-stock capital together with his investors in the name of Ikūn-pī-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ša-bu-ú
target: He has been paid the silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ni-is-ḫa-sú DIRI ša-du-a-sú ša-bu KI wa-ar-ki-ú-tim ú-šé-ba-lam
target: 4 minas of silver, its import duty added, its transport tariff paid for, he will send with the next transport.

source: translate Akkadian to English: GÁN-lam a-dí a-lim{ki} a-šu-mì ku-ra e-tí-iq
target: It will pass overland until the City in Kura's name.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu-qú-sú iš-tù a-lim{ki} a-šu-mì ki-lá-li-ma GÁN-lam e-tí-qám
target: The goods purchased will pass overland from the City in the names of both.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-ku-za IGI šu-a-nim
target: Witnessed by Akuza, by Šu-Anum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-nu-mì i-dí-a-bu-um a-na a-lim{ki} i-lu-ku qá-dí na-ru-qí-šu-ma e-tí-iq
target: When Iddin-abum goes to the City it will go along together with his joint-stock investments.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-šur-{d}UTU-ši ù da-da-a-ma a-na a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi-ma
target: From Aššur-šamšī and Dadāya to Ali-ahum:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ma-lá tí-ir-tí-kà a-wa-tí-šu ša šu-{d}EN.LÍL nu-ga-me-er-ma
target: In accordance with your instructions we have concluded the matter with Šu-Illil,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR šu-{d}EN.LÍL DUMU ma-nu-ki-a-šur e-pu-ul-ni-a-tí
target: and Šu-Illil son of Mannum-kī Aššur has balanced 3 minas of silver with us.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR šu-{d}EN.LÍL iš-tù lu-ḫu-za-tí-a i tù-a-ri-šu i-ša-qal
target: Šu-Illil will pay 1 mina of silver when he returns from Luhuzattiya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-{d}EN.LÍL DUMU ma-nu-ki-a-šur 3 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR né-ri-šu-ma um-ma šu-ut-ma a-na ṭup-pì-a ḫa-ar-mì-im al-qé-šu
target: When we asked Šu-Illil son of Mannum-kī-Aššur for the 3 minas of silver he said: I took it in accordance with my certified tablet.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma né-nu-ma ša ṭup-pì-kà ḫa-ar-mì-im a-mur-ša-ra-sà ú-ša-bi-kà-ma e-ṣú-ma a-ḫu-ur
target: We answered: "Amur-šarrassa paid you in accordance with your certified tablet. Very little remains."

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-ut-ma mì-ma a-mur-ša-ra-sà KÙ.BABBAR lá ú-ša-bi-a-ni KÙ.BABBAR i-tí-ki-ir
target: He said: "Amur-šarrassa paid me no silver." He contested the silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma né-nu-ma šu-ma a-mur-ša-ra-sà ú-ša-bi-kà-ma e-ṣú-ma a-ḫu-ur ma-na-um pá-ra-aṣ lá ta-ša-qá-al
target: We said: "In case Amur-šarrassa did pay you and only little remains, will you then not pay <gap> on the mina?"

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-ut-ma a-ša-qal
target: He answered: "Then I shall pay."

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-bé-e da-nu-tim ni-šu-šu-um a-mur-ša-ra-sà KÙ.BABBAR ú-ša-bi-šu
target: We have strong witnesses against him. Amur-šarrassa did pay him the silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-bé-e da-nu-tim ni-šu-šu-um a-ta a-ma-kam ma-lá-kà
target: We have strong witnesses against him. You must make up your mind there.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ku-nu-ki-ni ḫa-nu na-áš-a-ku-um
target: hanu brings you 1 mina of silver under our seals.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-tí KÙ.BABBAR 1 ma-na 15 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ni-qí-am nu-ṭá-
target: The rest of the silver, 1 mina 15 shekels of silver, we transferred as a sacrifice and wrote his tablet about 1 mina 15 shekels for a year - 3 months ago.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-lá-ḫi-im DUMU šál-ma-a-šur
target: to Ali-ahum son of Šalim-Aššur

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ma-nu-ki-a-šùr DUMU a-šùr-DU₁₀ ù a-ḫa-tim DUMU ší-na-na-tim
target: To Mannu-kī-Aššur son of Aššur-ṭāb and Ahātum daughter of Šinanātum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB ú-ṣur-ša-a-šùr DUMU šu-ku-bi₄-im
target: Sealed by Uṣur-ša-Aššur son of Šu-Kūbum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ku-li-a qí-bi-ma um-ma a-ba-ba-a-a-ma
target: Say to Kuliya, thus says Ababaya:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam 1.3333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša a-na mu-lá-e-i ša É sà-ba-sí-a ni-il₅-qé-e-ú
target: Here, as for the 1.3333 mina of silver which we borrowed to suppliment the amount of Sabasiya's house / firm,

source: translate Akkadian to English: be-el qá-ta-tí-a ša iš-tí-a i-zi-zu-i-ni 5-šu-nu i-na-zu-mu-ú um-ma šu-nu-ma ṭup-pá-am ša ku-nu-ki-ki dí-ni-ni-a-tí ša KÙ.BABBAR a-na ṣí-it ku-li-a i-ší-iq-lu-i-ni
target: my guarantors, which assisted me, all five of them, are complaining. They say: Give us a tablet with your seal to the effect that the silver has been paid for Kuliya's expenses;

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR 1 ma-na-um 7 GÍN ni-il₅-qé
target: we have borrowed the silver at an interest of 7 shekels per mina.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-pu-tum 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-bu-kà a-šu-ur ù ni-ší-kà 1 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR TA a-šu-ur ù ta-zi-ma-tí-ší-na lá áš-ta-na-me-e
target: Please, provide your father with 5 shekels of silver and each of your folks with one shekel of silver and let me no longer hear their complaints!

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-pu-tum ša a-wi-lu-tí-kà e-pu-uš
target: Please act as the gentleman you are!

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-pu-tum KÙ.BABBAR a-na a-šùr-ṣú-lu-li dí-in-ma lu-ub-lam
target: Please give silver to Aššur-ṣululī to bring to me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam ú-ša-aḫ-du-ru-ni
target: Here they are frightening me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: en-um-a-šur a-na i-na-aḫ-DINGIR iṣ-ba-at-ni-a-tí-ma
target: Ennam-Aššur seized us against Inah-ilī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma en-um-a-šur-ma a-na i-na-aḫ-DINGIR-ma a pu-tí a-lá-ḫi-im a-ḫi-a <gap> a pu-tí a-ḫi-a lu ta-za-za-am
target: Ennam-Aššur said as follows to Inah-ilī: In front of Ali-ahum, my brother, yes, in front of my brother you must stand.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ma ú-la ḫa-bu-lá-kum ú-lá ša-qú-ra-kum
target: I do not owe you anything; I am not held in esteem by you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí ma-lá ú ší-ni-šu <gap>-am gám-ri <gap> ra-bi₄ <gap> ga <gap> qá-tí lá a-bi a-ta <gap> ma <gap> a-we-lu a-ni <gap> ú iš-tù <gap> nim ta-ma <gap> ma <gap> i-na <gap> im a-ma-ḫa-aṣ <gap> da-mu-kà
target: Once or twice <gap> your blood-money <gap>.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša ni-iš a-lim{ki} kà-i-lá a-na a-lim{ki} ù bé-li-a a-wa-tí bi-lá
target: Keep in mind what was sworn by the City! Bring my case before the City and my lord.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-šur-iš-tí-kál DUMU sú-kà-li-a IGI a-ta-ta DUMU <gap>
target: Witnessed by Aššuriš-tikal son of Sukalliya, by Atata son of <gap>.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 ma-na 16.1666 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ki-ma a-šùr-ma-lik DUMU lu-zi-na a-šùr-GAL DUMU ma-nu-um-šu-um-šu i-na ší-im SÍG.ḪI.A ša ú-ší-na-lam il₅-qé
target: Aššur-rabi son of Mannum-šumšu has received 3 minas 16.1666 shekel of silver on behalf of Aššur-malik son of Luzina from the proceeds of Ušinalam's wool.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI i-lá-áš-ra-ni DUMU sú-kà-li-a
target: Witnessed by Ilī-ašrannī son of Sukkalliya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI en-na-sú-in DUMU i-dí-a-bi₄-im
target: By Enna-Suen son of Iddin-abum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4.3333 ma-na 5 GÍN.TA AN.NA bi₄-il₅-tám a-dí za-al-pá ik-šu-dam
target: 4.3333 minas 5 shekels accrued (as fees) until Zalpa on each talent of tin.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.6666 ma-na 5 GÍN AN.NA ta-ší-a-tum ša ša-du-im
target: 0.6666 mina 5 shekels of tin were the cost of carriage in the mountains.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 ma-na AN.NA ni-is-ḫa-tum ša É.GAL i-na ša i-sú-rik₁₃ ša i-ri-šum ub-lá-ni
target: 4 minas of tin: the import duty of the palace - from Issu-arik's goods that Irišum brought.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a ma-lá ṭup-pì-šu ú-sà-ni-iq-šu-ma bi₄-il₅-tum 2.5 ma-na im-ṭí i-na AN.NA ša šé-ep i-ri-ší-im
target: I checked it in accordance with his letter, and 2.5 minas were missing on each talent.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2.3333 ma-na AN.NA i-na i-šé-ra-tim ša É a-lim{ki} i-tí-ra-ma ša-lim-a-šur il₅-qé-šu
target: Of the tin transported by Irišum 2.3333 minas of tin from the of the City Hall was in excess, and Šalim-Aššur took it.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI i-sú-ri-ik IGI i-ri-ší-im
target: Witnessed by Issu-arik, witnessed by Irišum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ni-kà-sí ma-aḫ-ri-ni i-dí-a-bu-um ù ša-lim-a-šùr i-sí-ú a-na mu-lá-a
target: Iddin-abum and Šalim-Aššur settled accounts with us as witnesses.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 ma-na KÙ.GI ší-ip-kà-at i-sú-rik₁₃ ša a-na ša-lim-a-šùr ša-ap-ku
target: As compensation for 10 minas of gold, Issu-arik's investment that had been invested in Šalim-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: É áš-du ù wa-ar-kà-sà i-dí-a-bu-um ki-ma i-sú-rik₁₃ a-na ša-lim-a-šùr i-dí-in
target: Iddin-abum gave on behalf of Issu-arik Ašdu's house and its legacy to Šalim-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: É áš-du ù wa-ar-kà-sà ša ša-lim-a-šùr IGI lá-qé-ep IGI a-ku-za
target: Ašdu's house and its legacy belongs to Šalim-Aššur. Witnessed by Lā-qēp, by Akuza.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um kà-ni-iš i-dí-ni-a-tí-ma IGI GÍR ša a-šùr ší-bu-tí-ni ni-dí-in
target: The Kanesh colony gave us for these proceedings and we gave our testimony before Aššur's dagger.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB lá-qé-ep DUMU šu-a-šur KIŠIB ku-ra DUMU i-dí-a-šur KIŠIB a-šur-lá-ma-sí <gap>
target: Seal of Lā-qēp son of Šu-Aššur, seal of Kura son of Iddin-Aššur, seal of Aššur-lamassī<gap>

source: translate Akkadian to English: 12.5 ma-na 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am i-ṣé-er lá-qé-ep DUMU šu-a-šur DAM.GÀR-ru-um i-šu
target: Lā-qēp son of Šu-Aššur owes 12.5 minas 5 shekels of refined silver to a merchant.
