source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù ḫa-muš-tim ša ku-da-tim ITU.KAM té-i-na-tim li-mu-um a-šur-ma-lik DUMU a-lá-ḫi-im
target: Reckoned from the week of Kudātum, month Tē'inātum, eponymy Aššur-malik son of Ali-ahum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: DINGIR ša-pá-tám i-li-ik-ma i e-ra-bi₄-šu-ma i kà-né-eš ITU.2.KAM i-lá-ak-ma KÙ.BABBAR i-ša-qal
target: When the (moon-)god reached the fifteenth day, he will pay the silver 2 months after his arrival in Kanesh.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma lá iš-qú-ul 1 ma-na-im 1 GÍN.TA ṣí-ib-tám i-na ITU.KAM-im ú-ṣa-áb
target: If he has not paid in time, he must add interest at the rate of 1 shekel per mina per month.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša-ni-um ṭup-pu-šu KIŠIB DINGIR-mu-ta-bi₄-il₅ DUMU a-mur-IŠTAR KIŠIB lá-qé-ep DUMU PUZUR₄-ša-du-e KIŠIB lá-qé-ep DUMU šu-a-šur
target: His second tablet: Seal of Ilī-muttabbil son of Amur-Ištar, seal of Lā-qēp son of Puzur-šadu'e, seal of Lā-qēp son of Šu-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am i-ṣé-er lá-qé-ep DUMU šu-a-šur DAM.GÀR-ru-um i-šu
target: Lā-qēp son of Šu-Aššur owed 10 minas of refined silver to a merchant.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù ḫa-muš-tim ša i-tur₄-DINGIR DUMU a-mur-IŠTAR ITU.KAM bé-el-té-kà-lim li-mu-um ša qá-tí šu-sú-in
target: Reckoned from the week of Itūr-ilī son of Amur-Ištar, month Bēlat-ekallim, eponymy after Šu-Suen.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR a-na 12 ḫa-am-ša-tim i-ša-qal
target: He must pay the silver within 12 weeks.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma i ma-lá u₄-me-šu KÙ.BABBAR lá iš-qú-ul ki-ma a-wa-at kà-ri-im ṣí-ib-tám a-na ma-na-im i-na ITU.KAM-im ú-ṣa
target: If he has not paid the silver within his stipulated term, he must add interest in accordance with the rule of the colony per mina per month.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-šur-ma-lik DUMU {d}UTU-na-ṣí-ir pí-šu iš-me
target: Aššur-malik son of Šamaš-nāṣir heard his statement

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-šur-ta-ak-lá-ku DUMU a-<gap> tap-pá-ú-šu
target: Aššur-taklāku son of A<gap> was his partner

source: translate Akkadian to English: 20 2 GÚ SÍG.ḪI.A 94 maš-ku 10 ANŠE.ḪI.A ṣa-lá-mu a-ḫa-ma 12 ú-kà-pu ša qá-ra-bi-tim ú ú-nu-sú-nu mì-ma a-nim ku-nu-ki-a a-na ša-lim-ar-dí ù šé-ep-IŠTAR áp-qí-id
target: 22 talents of wool, 94 hides, 10 black donkeys, further 12 saddle-cloths from inside the house plus their harness - all this under my seal I entrusted to Šalim-wardī and Šēp-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫa-ma 8 GÍN AN.NA 40 sí-pá-ra-tim 10 šé-ni-in ša ṣú-ùḫ-ri-im lu ša sí-ni-iš-tim 8 ma-ar-šu 10 mu-uš-ṭá-tum 2 ša ta-as-kà-ri-ni 50 ki-bu-na-nu ša 0.3333 GÍN e-ba-du-ni 6 ku-li-ta-nu ú ša 0.3333 GÍN du-ug-li mì-ma a-nim a-na qá-tí-šu-nu a-dí-in
target: Further, 8 shekels of tin, 40 bronze pins, 10 pairs of shoes, for children and for women, 8 straps, 10 combs (2 of boxwood), 50, worth 0.3333 shekel, 6 -vessels and for 0.3333 shekel - all this I gave for them to dispose over.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma en-nam-a-šur-ma ù da-dí-a-ma a-na e-lá-ma qí-bi₄-ma
target: Thus Ennam-Aššur and Dadiya, say to Elamma:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 30-ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša {d}a-šur-SIPA ub-lá-ni ni-is-ḫa-sú DIRI 2 GÚ 10 ma-na AN.NA ku-nu-ki 25 ma-na AN.NA qá-tim 14.25 GÍN.TA 10.8333 ma-na 3 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR it-ba-al
target: 30 minas of silver that Aššur-rē'ī brought here, its excise added, (thereof): 2 talents 10 minas of tin under seals (and) 25 minas of tin for expenses at 14 1 / 4 shekels : 1 cost 10 minas and 53 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 85 TÚG.ḪI.A 5.8333 ma-na ù 7 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR it-bu-lu
target: 85 textiles cost 5 minas and 57 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 ANŠE ṣa-la-mu 1 ma-na 13 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR it-bu-lu
target: 4 black donkeys cost 1 mina and 13 shekels of silver,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10.3333 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ú-nu-ut ANŠE
target: 10.3333 shekels of silver the harness of the donkeys,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 9 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR wa-ṣí-tám
target: 9 shekels of silver export tax,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša sá-e-tim
target: 3 shekels of silver for <gap>

source: translate Akkadian to English: 30 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša a-šur-SIPA ub-lá-ni 1.3333 GÍN ù 3 ŠE.TA té-ṣú-bu 0.6666 ma-na 0.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ni-dí-in
target: The 30 minas of silver that Aššur-rē'ī brought entailed additions of 1 shekel 63 grains per (mina, so that) we paid 40.5 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.3333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR be-ú-lá-at kur-ub-IŠTAR
target: 20 shekels of silver the working capital of Kurub-Ištar,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR lu-bu-šu
target: 2 shekels his clothing allowance;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 TÚG.ḪI.A ša kur-ub-IŠTAR 1 TÚG ša da-dí-a 1 TÚG ša en-nam-a-šur
target: 3 textiles of Kurub-Ištar, 1 textile of Dadiya, 1 textile of Ennam-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ma a-nim a-šur-SIPA na-áš-a-ku-um
target: All this Aššur-rē'ī is bringing to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-tí KÙ.BABBAR iš-tí wa-ar-ki-ú-tim nu-šé-ba-lá-kum
target: (What we will buy with) the rest of the silver we will send you with a later caravan.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB ḫa-nu-nu-DUB.SAR li-ip-tí-IŠTAR DUMU lá-li-im ù ú-ṣur-ša-IŠTAR
target: Seal of hanunu, scribe, of Lipit-Ištar son of Lālum and of Uṣur-ša-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-la-ḫi-im DUMU šál-ma-a-šur
target: To Ali-ahum son of Šalim-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB en-um-a-šur DUMU IŠTAR-lá-ma-sí KIŠIB in-ba-a-šur DUMU pì-lá-aḫ-sú-in KIŠIB PUZUR₄.IŠTAR DUMU DINGIR-na-da
target: Seal of Ennam-Aššur, son of Ištar-lamassī, seal of Inib-Aššur, son of Pilah-Suen, seal of Puzur-Ištar, son of Ilī-nādā.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i-ṣé-er PUZUR₄.IŠTAR DUMU DINGIR-na-da DAM.GÀR i-šu
target: 3 shekels of silver Puzur-Ištar, son of Ilī-nādā owes to the creditor.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù ḫa-mu-uš-tim ša šu-ku-bi-im ú ka-zi-a 22.5 ŠE i-na ITU.KAM ṣí-ib-tám ú-ṣa-áb
target: From the week of Šu-Kūbum and Kaziya he will add 1 / 8 shekel per month as interest.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ITU.KAM ma-ḫu-ur-DINGIR li-mu-um ša qá-té {d}IŠKUR-ba-ni
target: Month IV, eponymy of the successor of Adad-bāni.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-gi-a na-áš-a-ki-im
target: Agia brings you (fem.) 3 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR PUZUR₄-a-šùr na-áš-a-ki-im
target: Puzur-Aššur brings you (fem.) 3 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na IŠTAR-lá-ma-sí qí-bi₄-ma ší-im pí-ri-kà-ni iš-tí ṣú-ḫa-ri-ku-nu
target: To Ištar-lamassī: The proceeds from the (will come) with your servant.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 15 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i-na li-bi₄ i-ri-ší-im DUMU a-mur-{d}UTU
target: 15 shekels of silver is owed by Irišum son of Amur-Šamaš.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù ḫa-mu-uš-tim ša i-na-a DUMU e-lá-li
target: Reckoned from the week of Innaya son of Elāli

source: translate Akkadian to English: ki-ma a-wa-at kà-ri-im ṣí-ib-tám ú-ṣa-áb
target: he will add interest in accordance with the rule of the colony.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB ì-lí-áš-ra-ni DUMU a-šur-DU₁₀ KIŠIB šu-sú-in DUMU da-dí-im KIŠIB e-nu-bé-lúm ša ší-tí ša ḫu-bu-ul ir-ma-a-šur
target: Seal of Ilī-ašranni, son of Aššur-ṭāb, seal of Šu-Suen, son of Dadum, seal of Ennam-Bēlum, of the remainder of the debt of Ir'am-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na ITU.1.KAM bé-el-tí-É.GAL li-mu-um ša qá-té a-šur-na-da a-na <gap> nim i-ša-qal
target: In month I, eponymy of the successor of Aššur-nādā, to / within <gap> he will pay.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma lá iš-qúl 1.5 GÍN.TA 1 ma-na-um ki-ma a-wa-at kà-ri-im ṣí-ib-tám i-na ITU.KAM-im ú-ṣa-áb
target: If he does not pay 1.5 shekels per mina, in accordance with the regulation of the colony he will add as interest per month.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ku-du-du-ma a-na mu-za ù en-nam-a-šur qí-bi₄-ma
target: From Kududu to Muza and Ennam-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 17 ma-na URUDU ší-kam a-na kà-na-a kà-ṣa-ri-ni a-dí-in-ma
target: I gave 17 minas of copper to our harnessor Kanaya

source: translate Akkadian to English: pu-úz-ra-am i ṣa-at a-ma-kam ṣa-ba-sú-ma
target: but he has gone into hiding.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2.5 ma-na.TA a KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ba-at-ma
target: Seize him there and take hold of 2.5 minas of silver (per talent)

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ša-áš-qí-il₅-šu
target: and make him pay the silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na ni-ga-li ku-nu-ki-a a-na mu-za a-šur-GAL na-ší
target: Aššur-rabi brings 1 mina of sickles under my seal for Muza.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ku-nu-ki-a pì-it-ḫa-na ub-lá-ku-um
target: Pithana has brought you 2 shekels of silver under my seal;

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫa-ma 5.6666 ma-na URUDU SIG₅ ig-ri-šu šu-a-tí-ma a-dí-šu-um
target: further, I gave 5.6666 minas of good copper as his salary to him as well.

source: translate Akkadian to English: AN.NA-ki-ma ni-iṣ-ba-at-ma 7 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR nu-ša-ak-ni-ik
target: We seized my own tin and had 7 minas of silver sealed.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-lu-a-ma ni-ip-qí-id
target: We entrusted it to Aluwa;

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ṣé-ri-kà ù a ší-bu-tí KÙ.BABBAR a-ma-kam i ri-iš ṭup-pì-a <gap>
target: for you and for the witnesses the silver there as soon as you have my tablet.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a-na a-šur-ma-lik dí-in-šu-ma i-na ša na na-ru-qí-im i-na ša li-bi₄-ni nu-ṣa-ḫa-ar
target: Give 1 mina of silver to Aššur-mālik and we will deduct it from the assets of the joint-stock capital that we control.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a-na ta-ad-mì-iq-tim a-na ku-da-nim i-dí-in
target: Give 2 minas of silver as a free loan to Kudānum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na KÙ a-na ku-lu-ma-a <gap>
target: 0.5 mina of silver for Kulumāya <gap>.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 GÍN a-na ra-qí-tim ša lá-ma-sí
target: 10 shekels for a thin textile of Lamassī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB a-šùr-e-mu-qí KIŠIB en-nam-a-šùr DUMU me-na-a KIŠIB i-dí-a-bi-im
target: Seal of Aššur-emūqi, seal of Ennam-Aššur son of Menaya, seal of Iddin-abum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša ḫu-bu-ul i-dí-a-bi-im 13 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am
target: Concerning the debt of Iddin-abum of 13 minas of refined silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù ḫa-mu-uš-tim ša kàr-ri-a a-na 36 ḫa-am-ša-tim i-ša-qal
target: Reckoned from the week of Karriya he must pay within 36 weeks.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma lá iš-qú-ul 1.5 GÍN.TA i-na ITU.KAM a-na ma-na-im ú-ṣa-áb
target: If he has not paid (in time), he must pay interest at the rate 1.5 shekel per month per mina.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša a-mur-IŠTAR ù a-šùr-i-mì-tí
target: Concerning Amur-Ištar and Aššur-imittī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ku-ku-zi-a lá-qé-ep ù a-na-a-na qí-bi-ma um-ma en-um-a-šùr-ma
target: To Kukuziya, Lā-qēp and Anna-anna from Ennam-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a ma-la ú-ša-ḫi-zu-ku-nu-tí-ni
target: As I instructed you,

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma a-lu-wa ù a-šé-e iš-tù ḫa-na-ak-na-ak i-ta-ṣú-nim
target: if Aluwa and Ašeʾe have left hanaknak,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ma-lá KÙ.BABBAR ú-šé-ri-ú-ni-ni pí-ri-kà-ni na-ar-bu-tim ú-lá ší-ma-am ša ki-ma ta-da-ga-lá-ni-ma KÙ.BABBAR 1 GÍN e-li-ú ša-ma-ma
target: then buy soft for what silver they conduct; or make the best purchase you can see will realise every shekel of silver,

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí a-lá-kà-ni ší-mu-um li-ib-ší
target: and until I come the purchase should remain.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ḫa-ra-ni i-ṣé-er
target: I am on my way.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ḫu-ur-ší-a e-ku-nu li-li-ik
target: Keep an eye on my store-room.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ší-im-tum ša ṭup-pí-šu ḫa-ar-mì-im
target: 2 minas of silver, the agreed amount of his certified tablet,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 12 GÍN ù 2 sú-pu-ú SIG₅ ṣí-ba-sú iš-tí-i ḫa-pí-a-aḫ-šu DUMU zi-il₅-pu-ri-a
target: 12 shekels and 2 fine suppū-sheep, its interest, owed by happi-ahšu son of Zilpuriya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.6666 ma-na 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ku-nu-ki ša šu-ḫu-bur a-na a-lá-ḫi-im e-zi-bu
target: Concerning the 1.6666 mina 5 shekels of sealed silver that Šu-hubur left with Ali-ahum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ki-ma a-šùr-be-el-ša-du-e KÙ.BABBAR a-ni-na il₅-qé
target: Annina has received the silver on behalf of Aššur-bēl-šadu'e.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma a-na KÙ.BABBAR a-nim ma-ma-an a-na a-lá-ḫi-im i-tù-a-ar a-ni-na DUMU MAN-a-na ú-ba-áb-šu
target: If anyone raises claim against Ali-ahum for this silver, Annina son of Puzur-Anna will clear him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-šur-ba-ni DUMU ku-ta-a IGI ili₅-ba-ni DUMU a-mur-IŠTAR
target: Witnessed by Aššur-bāni son of Kutaya, by Ilī-bāni son of Amur-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma i-ku-pí-a-ma a-na en-um-a-šùr i-dí-a-bi-im ù lá-qé-ep qí-bi-ma 10 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ku-nu-ki-a en-um-a-šùr na-áš-a-ku-nu-tí
target: From Ikūn-pīya to Ennam-Aššur, Iddin-abum and Lā-qēp: Ennam-Aššur brings you 10 minas of silver under my seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ṣé-er 40 ma-na AN.NA ša en-um-a-šùr ú-šé-ba-lá-ni ú i-na KÙ.BABBAR-pí-a ša 2 ma-na AN.NA-ak-šu a-ṣé-er ma-na-im ša-a-ma a-dí <gap> ší-mì ta-ša-a-ma-ni
target: In addition to 40 minas of tin which Ennam-Aššur will send, add my silver and buy worth 2 minas of his tin - in addition to the one mina, and until you will make purchases for me <gap>.

source: translate Akkadian to English: AN.NA na-ší-ra-ma iš-tí pá-ni-im-ma šé-bi-lá-nim
target: set aside the tin and send it as soon as possible.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí a-lá-ak ṣú-ḫa-ri-a ší-tí KÙ.BABBAR-pí-a sà-áp-tí-ni <gap>-bi SIG₅ ša tal-ḫa-at pì-ri-kà-ni na-ar-bu-tim ší-ma-am ša ba-lá-ṭí-a ša-ma-nim-ma šé-bi-lá-nim
target: Until my servant arrives, with the rest of my silver make a profitable purchase of good from Talhat, (and) soft and send them to me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša-lim-a-šùr ù šu-be-lúm DUMU i-dí-a-bi₄-im ni-kà-sí ma-aḫ-ri-ni i-sí-ú-ma
target: Šalim-Aššur and Šu-Bēlum son of Iddin-abum settled accounts before us.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 GÚ 13 ma-na URUDU lá-mu-nam i-ṣé-er šu-be-lim ša-lim-a-šùr i-dí
target: Šalim-Aššur set down 1 talent 13 minas of bad copper as a claim on Šu-Bēlum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ša-lim-a-šùr-ma a-na šu-be-lim-ma i pì i-sú-SUD a-bi₄-a qá-ta-at a-bi₄-kà al-ta-pá-at
target: Šalim-Aššur said to Šu-Bēlum: On the orders of Issu-arik, my father, I wrote myself as your father's guarantor.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu i ba-a-ba-tí-šu KÙ.BABBAR al-qé-ma a-na ḫu-bu-li-šu ú-ša-qí-il₅
target: I took silver from his outstanding claims and paid to cover his debt.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu i-na na-ru-qí-a KÙ.BABBAR ma-da-ma a-na ḫu-bu-ul a-bi₄-kà ú-ša-qí-il₅
target: I paid a great deal of silver from my joint-stock capital for your father's debt.

source: translate Akkadian to English: al-kam ṭup-pì-a lu-kà-li-im-kà-ma
target: Come! Let me show you my tablets!

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-be-lúm-ma mì-nam we-dam i-a-tí tù-lá-ma-da-ni qá-dí a-ḫi-a-ma šé-a-ni
target: Šu-Bēlum answered: "Why do you inform only me? Sue me together with my brothers."

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI PUZUR₄-a-šur IGI en-na-nim
target: Witnessed by Puzur-Aššur, by Ennānum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um kà-ni-iš i-dí-ni-a-tí-ma IGI GÍR ša a-šur ni-dí-in
target: The Kanesh colony gave us for these proceedings and we gave (our testimony) before the dagger of Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am iš-tù ḫa-mu-uš-tim ša {d}UTU-ba-ni ù a-šur-ma-lik a-na ḫa-mu-uš-tim ša ta-la-kà-ni ú-šé-ba-lam
target: 10 shekels of refined silver he will send to me reckoned from the week eponymy of Šamaš-bāni and Aššur-mālik not later than the coming week-eponymy.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma lá uš-té-bi₄-lam 15 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i-ša-qal
target: Should he not send it to me then he will pay 15 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI en-na-nim IGI a-šùr-mu-ta-pí-il₅
target: In the presence of Ennānum, of Aššur-mutappil.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-dí-a-bu-um É-tí ša bu-ri-im a-šar ša-lim-a-šùr wa-áš-bu iš-tí tù-ud-ḫa-li-a a-ḫu tù-li iš-a-am
target: Iddin-abum has bought the houses by the well, where Šalim-Aššur is living, from Tudhaliya the brother of Tuli.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um kà-ni-iš i-dí-ni-a-tí-ma ṭup-pá-am ší-bu-tí-ni IGI GÍR ša a-šùr ni-dí-in
target: The Kanesh colony gave us for these proceedings, and we gave a tablet with our testimony before the dagger of Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-ku-za IGI ú-ra-a IGI a-šùr-ba-ni
target: Witnessed by Akuza, by Uraya, by Aššur-bāni.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB DINGIR-na-da DUMU ba-zi-a
target: Seal of Ilī-nādā, son of Baziya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB ki-ta-a ša 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am ša e-lá-ma ki-ta-a i-bé-el
target: Seal of Kitaya, that Kitaya will manage 0.5 mina of silver belonging to Elamma.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tí KÙ.BABBAR uk-ta-al
target: He is held by the silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma a-e-ša-ma ú-da-pí-ir 1 GÍN.TA i-na ITU.1.KAM i-ma-nu-šu
target: If he goes away to somewhere else, he will charge him 1 shekel per month.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na en-um-a-šur qí-bi-ma um-ma lá-qé-ep-ma a-na-ku ú en-na-num a-na É ḫu-ur-ší-kà né-ru-ma UD.KA.BAR-kà ù ṭup-pì-kà nu-šé-ṣí-ma i-na É i-tur₄-DINGIR i-ba-ší-ú
target: To Ennam-Aššur from Lā-qēp: I and Ennānum entered your storeroom and brought out your bronze and the tablets, and they are in Itūr-ilī's house.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ma li-ba-kà lá i-pá-ri-id
target: Do not worry at all.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú ša-lim-{d}a-šùr ik-ri-ba-am pu-ta ú pu-i bu-ma-ni a-na a-lim{ki} ḫa-ra-ni ek-pá-at
target: Also, Šalim-Aššur <gap> the votive offering <gap> My journey to the City is approaching.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma KÙ.BABBAR a-na qá-tí-kà ma-qí-it KÙ.BABBAR a-na ṣé-er ša ki-ma ku-a-tí šé-bi₄-lá-ma li-ip-qí-du-ni-šu-ma ú lá-ag-mì-il₅-kà
target: If any silver has fallen into your hands, send it to your representatives so they can sell it on credit and I can do you a service.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma KÙ.BABBAR i-na qá-tí-kà lá ma-qí-it a-ni-tám lá a-ni-tám tí-ir-ta-kà li-li-kam
target: Send me word whether or not any silver has fallen into your hands.

source: translate Akkadian to English: e a-ta-lá-ak-ma li-ba-kà e tù-lá-mì-nam i-ḫi-id-ma tí-ir-ta-kà li-li-kam
target: If I do not depart, do not be angry with me. Take care to send me word.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša a-mur-{d}UTU ú-šé-bi-lá-ni ku-nu-ki-šu ni-ip-ṭur₄-ma
target: We broke the seals for 4 minas of silver that Amur-Šamaš sent.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4.3333 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR im-ṭí IGI i-tur₄-DINGIR IGI a-šur-ma-lik DUMU kà-a-tim IGI en-na-nim DUMU am-ri-a
target: And (discovered that) 4.3333 shekels of silver were missing.

source: translate Akkadian to English: da-a-a-nu dí-nam i-dí-nu-ma
target: The judges passed the following verdict:

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù li-mì-im a-šùr-i-mì-tí ma-lá-ḫi-im 1 ma-na-um 0.5 ma-na i-na ša-tim ṣí-ib-tám tù-ṣú-bu
target: and for which from the eponymy of Aššur-imittī, the boatman, she would add an interest of 0.5 mina per mina per year -

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ki-a DUMU PUZUR₄-a-šùr <gap> {d}UTU-ba-ni DUMU en-na-sú-in ma-nu-um-ki-a-šùr DUMU a-ḫu-wa-qar a-wi-lu a-ni-ú-tum da-a-nu
target: Akiya, son of Puzur-Aššur, Šamaš-bāni, son of Ennam-Suen, (and) Mannum-kī-Aššur, son of Ahu-waqar - these gentlemen were the judges.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na sú-ú-a-a ù en-um-a-šur
target: To Sūaya and Ennam-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na kur-ub-IŠTAR i-ku-pì-a šu-IŠTAR a-dí-da ù a-mur-IŠTAR qí-bi-ma um-ma ša-lim-a-šùr-ma
target: To Kurub-Ištar, Ikūn-piya, Šu-Ištar, Adida and Amur-Ištar from Šalim-Aššur;

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na kur-ub-IŠTAR qí-bi-ma a-ḫi a-ta be-lí a-ta
target: specifically to Kurub-Ištar: My dear brother and lord,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ḫu-sà-ru-um ik-ri-bu ša a-šùr ḫa-al-qú
target: the lapis lazuli that was the votive offering to Aššur has been lost.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pá-am ša dí-in a-lim{ki} a-ta ù ILLAT-kà ší-im-a-ma
target: You and your caravan must listen to the tablet with the verdict of the City assembly,

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na ša-ḫa-at ra-bi-ṣí-im ù ṣú-ḫa-ri-im i-zi-za-ma
target: assist the attorney and the servant,

source: translate Akkadian to English: a ma-lá dí-in a-lim{ki} ú-nu-tám ša en-na-sú-in na-dí-dá-ma
target: and search Enna-Suen's goods in accordance with the verdict of the City,

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma ḫu-sà-ru-um e-ta-li-a-am ku-un-kà-šu-ma
target: and if the lapis lazuli appears, then place it under seal

source: translate Akkadian to English: a ma-lá dí-in a-lim{ki} ḫu-sà-ra-am ù en-na-sú-in ta-i-ra-nim
target: and return the lapis lazuli and Enna-Suen in accordance with the verdict of the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a ma-lá dí-in a-lim{ki} a-li ra-bi₄-ṣú-um i-pá-li-lu lu-ta-me ù ú-nu-tám lu-na-dí-id
target: According to the verdict of the City wherever the attorney interrogates, he may impose an oath and search the goods.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù šu-ma ba-tí-qum ma-ma-an e-tí-iq ra-bi₄-ṣú-um le-tí-iq-ma ú-nu-tám ša ba-tí-qí-im lu-na-dí-id
target: Also, if anyone has departed with an express caravan, the attorney will travel and search the goods of the express caravan.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫu-ú-a be-lu-a a-tù-nu a-na u₄-mu-ú e-ṭá-ri-im eṭ-ra-ni
target: My dear brothers and lords, save me while I can still be saved.

source: translate Akkadian to English: gi-mì-lam i-ṣé-er a-šùr ù i-ṣé-ri-a šu-uk-na
target: Do this favour for Aššur and for me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma e-la-ma ù a-šur-dan-ma a-na a-mur-IŠTAR a-šur-na-da ù ku-ni-lim qí-bi₄-ma
target: Thus Elamma and Aššur-dān, say to Amur-Ištar, Aššur-nādā, and Kūnilum:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 7 ma-na 12 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i-dí-IŠTAR ub-lam nu-sà-ni-iq-šu-ma 7 GÍN im-ṭí 13 GÍN i ma-sà-im im-ṭí
target: 7 minas 12 shekels of silver Iddin-Ištar brought here. We checked it and it was 7 shekels less, 13 shekels loss by purifying.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a pá-ni IŠTAR-pì-lá-aḫ ra-dí ú-nu-tim ša ḫi-na-a nu-šé-bi₄-il₅
target: We sent 1.5 mina silver to meet Ištar-pilah, the transporter of hinnāya;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a-na DUMU a-ḫa-tim ra-dí ú-nu-tim ša ku-ni-lim nu-šé-bi₄-il₅
target: 1.5 mina of silver we sent for the son of Ahātum, the transporter of Kūn-ilum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na a-na bur-sú-in ra-dí ú-nu-tim ša DAM.GÀR-ri-im e-lá-ma ú-šé-bi₄-il₅
target: Elamma sent 1 mina for Būr-Suen, the transporter of the ;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na a-na a-šur-dan ra-dí ú-nu-tim ša ḫi-na-a e-lá-ma-ma ú-šé-bi₄-il₅
target: 0.5 mina of silver for Aššur-dān, the transporter of hinnāya. Elamma also sent;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na 3 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na i-dí-sú-in kà-ṣa-ar kàr-wa-a i-na a-wa-tim i-bu-ni-a-tí-ma ni-dí-šum ša ni-ip-lá-tim ša ILLAT-at a-šur-iš-ta-kál DUMU sú-kà-li-a ù 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša li-bi₄-šu a-ni-pì-il₅-tí-šu-ma e-ta-kál
target: 33 shekels of silver for Iddin-Suen, the harnesser of Karwāya - we gave it to him because he over us in a conflict, - from the balance payment of the caravan of Aššuriš-tikal, son of Sukkalliya, and 10 shekels of silver he owes, (for) he used it for his own balance payment.

source: translate Akkadian to English: kà-ṣa-ru-um ša ḫi-na-a ša iš-tù a-lim{ki} is-ri-da-ni 3 TÚG-tí-šu a-na bé-ú-lá-tí-šu ú-ša-qí-il₅-ni-a-tí-ma 4 GÍN 22.5 ŠE KÙ.BABBAR ni-pu-ul-šum
target: As for hinnāya's harnessor who took care of the transport from the City, he (hinnāya) paid us (for) his 3 textiles, his working capital, and we balanced him 4 1 / 8 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.3333 ma-na 0.5 GÍN KÙ
target: 20.5 shekels of silver for fodder for hinnāya's donkeys, we fed (them) this fodder.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 8.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR KI en-na-nim na-pá-ḫi-im
target: 8.5 shekels of silver due from Ennānum, the blacksmith.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na NINDA ša-a-mì-im a-dì-na-kum
target: 1 shekel of silver for buying bread I gave to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.75 GÍN mu-sú-ḫa-am a-dì-na-kum
target: 3 / 4 shekel of bad quality (silver) I gave you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ.BA 10 ma-na SÍG.ḪI.A ú 5 GÍN AN.NA ta-dí-na-am
target: Thereof you have given me 10 minas of wool and 5 shekels of tin.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am a-ḫa-ma 1 GÍN ša-du-a-sú mì-ma a-nim a-na i-tur₄-DINGIR DUMU a-mur-IŠTAR a-dí-in-ma
target: 0.5 mina of refined silver and further 1 shekel, its transport tariff - all this I gave to Itūr-ilī son of Amur-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR šu-a-tí ku-nu-ki-šu ù ku-nu-ki <gap> DUMU a-lá-ḫi-im a-na id-na-a DUMU da-<gap>-za ù a-lu-wa ip-qí-du
target: and this silver, sealed by him and sealed by <gap> son of Ali-ahum, they entrusted to Idnaya son of Da<gap>za and Aluwa.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB šu-ku-bi-im KIŠIB šu-IŠTAR KIŠIB a-mur-a-šur
target: Seal of Šu-Kūbum, seal of Šu-Ištar, seal of Amur-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša 2 GÚ AN.NA i-na e-lá AN-NA-ki-šu e-lá-ma a-na šu-IŠTAR a-na bu-ru-uš-ḫa-tim ú-šé-ba-al
target: That, when his tin comes up (from Assur) Elamma will send 2 talents of tin to Šu-Ištar in Burušhattum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma i-na ma-ḫi-ir i-za-zu 1 GÍN.TA šu-IŠTAR ú-ma-lá-šum-ma KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am i-na e-ra-áb AN-NA-ki-šu i-ša-qal
target: And that Šu-Ištar will deliver in full to him 1 shekel (of silver) per (shekel of tin) above the current rate of exchange and that he will pay purified silver on the arrival of his tin.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 18 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i-ṣé-er ki-da-aḫ-šu ù me-er-i-šu a-lá-ḫu-um i-šu
target: Kid-ahšu and his sons owe 18 shekels of silver to Ali-ahum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 6 na-ru-uq mì-iš-lam ŠE-um mì-iš-lam₅ ar-ša-tum i-na ḫa-ar-pé-e i-ma-da-ad
target: He will measure out 6 sacks (of grain), half barley, half wheat at harvest time.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 15 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR iš-tí ḫa-ar-šu-um-nu-ma-an
target: 15 shekels of silver is owed by haršumnuman.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 na-ru-uq mì-iš-lúm ŠE-um mì-iš-lam₅ ar-ša-tim i ḫa-ar-pé-e i-ma-da-ad
target: He will measure out 5 sacks (of grain), half barley, half wheat, at harvest time.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR a-ni-am wa-al-dí-DINGIR i-dí-in
target: Waldi-ilum gave this silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI ḫa-pu-a-šu IGI ma-nu-ba-lúm-a-šur
target: Witnessed by happu-aššu, by Mannum-balum-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 15 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR en-nam-a-šùr a-na ú-ṣú-ur-pì-a-šur i-dí-in
target: 15 shekels of silver Ennam-Aššur gave to Uṣur-pī-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma i-na a-lim{ki} ṭup-pá-am ša ku-nu-ki-šu ša ú-ṣú-ur-pì-a-šur i-na a-lim{ki} um-mì-iš-ḫa-ra a-ḫa-sú-nu gu₅-ba-áb-tum ša a-na wa-ar-kà-at lá-ma-sà-tim um-mì-ša ú wa-ar-ki-tí-ša lá i-tù-ru
target: If in the City a tablet with the seal of Uṣur-pī-Aššur in the City their sister Ummī-Išhara has, to the effect that he will not claim what her mother Lamassutum had inherited and what had been left behind by her.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 15 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ú-ṣú-ur-pì-a-šùr ú-ta-ar
target: then Uṣur-pī-Aššur will give back the 15 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI i-na-aḫ-DINGIR IGI ša-lim-IŠTAR IGI a-šùr-<gap> IGI ma-sà-a-a IGI a-šùr-ma-lik
target: In the presence of Ēnah-ilī, of Šalim-Ištar of Aššur-<gap> of Mas(s)āya, of Aššur-mālik.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 17 ma-na ḫu-sá-ru-um 21 GÚ URUDU SIG₅ 8 ANŠE ṣa-lá-mu ù ú-nu-sú-nu 20 ma-na ší-ku-um 1 me-at 10 ṣí-pá-ra-tum a-na iš-ri-šu ší-na-tum mì-ma a-nim a-na ma-ma-ḫi-ir ša-lim-a-šùr ip-qí-id
target: 17 minas of lapis lazuli, 21 talents of good copper, 8 black donkeys and their harness, 20 minas of šikku-copper, 110 bronze pins, 10 sets of teeth — all this Salim-Aššur entrusted to Man-mahir.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ší-a-ma-tim <gap> ma-ma-ḫi-ir ú-bi-il₅
target: Man-mahir brought it away for purchases.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI en-na-sú-en DUMU i-ku-a IGI sá-li-a DUMU i-dí-a-šùr IGI SIG₅-pì-a-šùr IGI a-šùr-na-da DUMU en-um-a-šùr
target: Witnessed by Enna-Suen son of Ikuwa, by Salliya son of Iddin-Aššur, by Damiq-pi-Aššur, by Aššur-nada son of Ennam-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na e-lá-ma ù kur-ub-IŠTAR qí-bi-ma um-ma i-dí-a-šur-ma
target: Say to Elamma and to Kurub-Ištar, thus Iddin-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 GÚ 10 ma-na AN.NA ku-nu-ki 50 TÚG ku-ta-ni qá-de₈ ša li-wi-tim 3 ANŠE ṣa-lá-me-e mì-ma a-nim e-na-aḫ-DINGIR ip-qí-dam
target: 2 talents 10 minas of tin under seals, 50 -textiles, including those for wrapping (the tin), 3 black donkeys - all this Ēnah-ilī entrusted to me (for transport).

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-li-ik lu-qú-tí-ku-nu mì-il-kà
target: Consider what to do with your merchandise.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 GÚ 42 ma-na URUDU iš-tí i-dí-{d}MAR.TU
target: 4 talents 42 minas of copper with Iddin-Aurum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na bé-ú-la-at ki-ta-a
target: 0.5 mina of silver, working capital of Kitaya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 8 ma-na KI šu-li DUMU PUZUR₄-a-bi₄-iḫ
target: 8 minas of silver with Šuli, son of Puzur-Abeh.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 ma-na 3.83334 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR KI id-na-a
target: 4 minas 3.8333 shekels of silver with Idnāya, month IV, eponymy of Šudāya; he will add 1 1 / 4 shekel per (mina per month) as interest.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 8 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR KI i-ku-mì-šar
target: 8 shekels of silver with Ikūn-Mīšar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 ma-na 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-šùr-du-ri li-mu-um ip-ḫu-ru-um 1.5 GÍN.TA ṣí-ib-tám ú-ṣa-áb
target: 2 minas 10 shekels of silver with Aššur-dūrī, year eponymy of Iphurum. He will add 1.5 shekel per (mina per month).

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR KI ba-al-ṭù-im
target: 0.5 mina of silver with Balṭu'um.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.3333 ma-na 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR be-ú-lá-at da-da-a
target: 25 shekels (of silver) working capital of Galdaya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR KI gal-da-a
target: 1 mina of silver with Galdaya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na 0.8333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ù 0.3333 ma-na 5 GÍN ša ší-im ku-ta-nim SIG₅ ša i-na li-bi i-dí-a-bi-im i-šu-ú
target: Of the 0.8333 mina of silver and 0.3333 mina 5 shekels from the proceeds of a fine textile, which I have as a claim on Iddin-abum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ.BA 1 GÚ 23.5 ma-na URUDU 0.6666 GÍN 15 ŠE.TA i-dí-nam
target: Thereof he has given me 1 talent 23.5 minas of copper, reckoned at the exchange rate 1:40 1/12.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na i-sú-rik₁₃ qí-bi-ma um-ma ša-lim-a-šur-ma 1.3333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am ší-im NA₄.GUG-tí-kà a-mur-a-a wa-bar-ni ù a-ḫa-at-ni ug-ba-áb-tám ú-ša-áš-qí-il₅-ma ku-nu-ki-a du-du na-áš-a-kum
target: To Issu-arik from Šalim-Aššur: I made our guest Amuraya and our sister, the priestess, pay 1.3333 mina of refined silver, the proceeds from your carnelian, and Dudu is bringing it to you under my seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2.5 ma-na 0.5 GÍN KI i-<gap> 0.5 ma-na KI ku-za-zi-im 0.5 ma-na KI a-šur-be-el-a-wa-tim mì-ma a-nim KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pu-um ša ší-im NA₄.GUG-tí-kà ša a-we-li a-ni-ú-tim du-du i-na ḫa-ḫi-im ú-ba-lá-kum
target: 2.5 minas 0.5 shekel owed by I<gap>, 0.5 mina owed by Kuzāzum, 0.5 mina owed by Aššur-bēl-awātim, all this, refined silver, from the proceeds of your carnelian, from these men, Dudu will bring to you in hahhum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 ma-na LÁ 3 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR-áp-kà 5 GÍN i-a-am
target: 2 minas less 3 shekels is your silver, 5 shekels belong to me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú 2 <gap> ú 2 GÍN 2 ma-na 3 GÍN qá-dum ša-du-a-tí-šu im-dí-DINGIR ub-lá-kum
target: Also, 2 <gap> and 2 shekels, Imdī-ilum brought you 2 minas 3 shekels including its transport tariff.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša 7 ma-na <gap> KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pu-um ší-im NA₄.GUG-tí-kà šu-ma ṣí-ib-tám i-ṣé-er <gap> tám-kà-ri-kà il₅-qé ší-ma-am a ma-lá ṭup-pì-im ša du-du lu-ba-li-ṭa-kum
target: About the 7 minas of refined silver, the proceeds of your carnelian - if he has taken interest from your merchant, then in accordance with the tablet of <gap> let Dudu credit you for the price.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3.5 GÍN KÙ.GI ša áb-nim ku-nu-ki-a šé-bu-ul-tám du-du na-áš-a-kum
target: 3.5 shekels of gold ore sealed by me as a shipment is being brought to you by Dudu.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2.5 GÍN KÙ.GI a-ni-<gap> ṣú-ḫa-ru-um ša ki-<gap> a-bi₄ a-ta i-ḫi-id-ma lu-qú-tí áb-kà-ma <gap>-im <gap>-ri-na tí-ir-ta-kà za-ku-tum i-na pá-nim
target: 2.5 shekels of gold Ani<gap> the servant <gap> My dear father, take care and ship my goods to me, and <gap> May a final report from you come as soon as possible.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-šur-SIG₅ qí-bi₄-ma um-ma a-bu-ša-lim-ma
target: To Aššur-damiq from Abu-šalim:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam áš-kà-pu ša a-na lú-ùḫ-ra-aḫ-na ḫa-bu-lu-ni maš-kà-am ša GU₄ iš-tí a-mu-ri-e il₅-qé-ú-ma
target: The leatherworkers here who owe <gap> to Luhrahna have received the hide of an ox from the Amorites,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.5 ma-na 5 GÍN URUDU a-na-ku qá-ta-tù-um
target: and I am the guarantor for 1 ½ mina 5 shekels of copper.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù ší-ni-am i-a-tí iq-bi₄-ú-nim mì-ma la i-dí-nu-nim
target: Also, they promised <gap> for me, (but) they have given me nothing.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam a-mu-ri-ú ma-aḫ-ri-kà-ma iṣ-bu-tù
target: Here the Amorites seized (them) with you as witness.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-kam ṣa-ba-sú-nu-ma URUDU li-dí-nu-ni-ku-um
target: Seize them there and have them give you the copper.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na URUDU {d}EN.LÍL-ba-ni lu-šé-bi₄-lam
target: Illil-bāni should send me ½ mina of copper.

source: translate Akkadian to English: pá-šu-um a-na ša-pá-ar-tim na-dí
target: An ax has been deposited as security.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a-na i-dí-a-šur
target: 0.5 mina of silver for Iddin-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.6666 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a-na aḫ-ša-lim
target: 1.6666 mina of silver for Ah-šalim.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ.BA 0.3333 ma-na a-na lu-zi ÌR ša a-lá-ḫi-im
target: Of which 0.3333 mina is for Luzi, the slave of Ali-ahum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.3333 ma-na a-na ku-da-tim kà-ṣa-ar a-šur-ma-lik
target: 0.3333 mina for Kudādum, the harnesser of Aššur?-mālik.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na té-er-tí-a i-da-an-šu-nu-tí
target: He will give it to them by my instruction.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša 3 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR sí-ba-ra-tim a-na aḫ-ša-lim
target: For 3 shekels of silver for Ah-šalim.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 14 GÚ URUDU SIG₅ ša-bu-ra-am i-ṣé-er i-dí-a-šur DUMU dan-a-šur PUZUR₄.IŠTAR a-ḫi-šu ù i-ku-pí-a DUMU a-šur-i-mì-tí iš-ma-a-šur i-šu
target: Iddin-Aššur son of Dan-Aššur, Puzur-Ištar, his brother, and Ikūn-pīya son of Aššur-imittī owe 14 talents of good broken copper to Išim-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù ITU.KAM ku-zal-lu li-mu-um a-šur-i-mì-tí 1.5 ma-na.TA i-na ITU.KAM a-na GÚ ṣí-ib-tám ú-ṣú-bu
target: Reckoned from the month Kuzallu, eponymy Aššur-imittī, they will pay interest at the rate 1.5 mina per month per talent.

source: translate Akkadian to English: URUDU i-na qá-qá-ad šál-mì-šu-nu ù ke-ni-šu-nu ra-ki-is
target: They are jointly liable for the copper.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-mur-a-šur DUMU a-šur-be-el-a-wa-tim IGI sú-in-SIPA DUMU a-mur-IŠTAR
target: Witnessed by Amur-Aššur son of Aššur-bēl-awātim, by Suen-rē'ī son of Amur-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma tù-ra-mì-il₅-ma a-na en-um-a-šùr ù šu-ku-bi-im qí-bi-ma
target: From Tūram-ilī to Ennam-Aššur and Šu-Kūbum; specifically to Ennam-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na en-um-a-šùr qí-bi-ma <gap> 0.6666 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR i li-bi <gap> 0.3333 GÍN KÙ.KI ILLAT šu-ku-bi-im
target: <gap> 0.6666 minas of silver owed by <gap> 0.3333 shekels of gold: Šu-Kūbum's caraban;

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫa-ma <gap> GÍN KÙ.KI a-nim <gap> KÙ.BABBAR a-nim <gap> ša li-bi <gap>
target: further, these <gap> shekels of gold <gap> this silver <gap>

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-la-ḫi-im a-ni-na ù a-šur-ma-lik qí-bi-ma um-ma zu-ku-a-ma
target: To Ali-ahum, Annina and Aššur-malik from Zukuwa:

source: translate Akkadian to English: ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ni-is-ḫa-sú DIRI <gap> 0.5 GÍN ša ik-ri-bi ku-nu-ki šu-ḫu-bu-ur na-áš-a-ku-nu-tí
target: <gap> minas of silver, its import duty added, and <gap>-0.5 shekel from votive offerings, under seal, Šu-hubur brings to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR a-šu-mì <gap> GÁN-lam₅ e-tí-iq
target: The silver passes overland in the name of <gap>.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ḫu-bur <gap> li-dí-na-ku-nu-tí-ma ú a-tù-nu ṭup-pí-a pí-it-a-ma a-šar a-lá-ḫi-im ṭup-pu-šu dí-na-šu-um ú ṭup-pá-am ša šu-ḫu-bu-ur i-da-na-ku-nu-tí-ni i-na li-bi ṭup-pí-a šu-uk-na-ma i-na ku-nu-ki-ku-nu ku-un-kà ú ri-ik-sú-um i-na ku-nu-ki-a a-dí tí-ir-tí i-lá-kà-ni a-šar a-lá-ḫi-im li-ib-ší
target: Šu-hubur should give you <gap>-3 minas 2.3333 shekels of silver under my seal and a certified tablet with my seal, and then you (plural) must open for my tablets, give him his tablet from Ali-ahum's (house) and place the tablet that Šu-hubur gives to you among my other tablets and seal (the box) with your seals. And the bundle should remain with Ali-ahum under my seal until I arrive.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-šu-mì KÙ.BABBAR ša i-dí-a-šur a-dí ḫa-am-ší-šu tí-ir-tí i-li-kà-ku-nu-tí ú a-tù-nu mì-ma-ša-ma lá ta-áš-pu-ra-nim-ma úz-ni la ta-áp-tí-a
target: Five times I have sent word to you concerning Iddin-Aššur's silver, but you have written nothing to me to inform me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ú ṣí-ba-sú iš-qú-lá-ku-nu-tí ú-lá iš-qú-lá-ku-nu-tí tí-ir-ta-ak-nu lá i-li-kam-ma uz-ni lá ta-áp-tí-a
target: You have not sent me word to inform me whether he has paid the silver and its interest or not.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma KÙ.BABBA
target: If he has not paid the silver I shall write so they can make him pay the silver and its interest, and as for you, with the first transport <gap>

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-šùr-ša-dí-DINGIR a-mur-IŠTAR DU₁₀-ṣí-lá-a-šùr ì-lí-a-LIM a-nu-pí-a ù a-ba-ba-a-a-i a-na ku-li-a qí-bi-ma
target: Thus Aššur-šad-ilī, Amur-Ištar, Ṭāb-ṣilli-Aššur, Ilī-anum, Anuppiya, and Ababayai, say to Kuliya:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-wa-tí-kà ša É sà-ba-sí-a qá-du-um ša u₄-mu-kà ša-ak-nu-ni ni-ig-mu-ur-ma
target: We have settled your affair concerning Sabasiya's house, including the setting of a term for you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ṣé-er KÙ.BABBAR ù KÙ.KI ša té-zi-bu 1.3333 ma-na iš-tí DU₁₀-a-šur DUMU DU₁₀-ì-lí 1 ma-na-um 7 GÌN a-na ṣí-ib-tim ni-il₅-qé-ma
target: And in addition to the silver and gold you had left behind we borrowed 1.3333 mina from Ṭāb-Aššur, son of Ṭāb-ilī, at an interest of 7 shekels per mina.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR nu-ša-bi₄-šu-nu-ma 3 ṭup-pé-e ša a-lim{ki} 1 ṭup-pá-am ša 1.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša ḫu-bu-li-kà ú-šé-ru-ni-a-tí
target: And with that silver we have satisfied them, whereupon they released to us 3 tablets of the City (and) 1 tablet recording a debt of yours of 1.5 mina of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ša-at-kà iš-tí-ni kà-an-kà-at ITU.1.KAM ma-ḫu-ur-ì-lí li-mu-um da-ni-a
target: Your wife has sealed (the debt-note) together with us, (dated to) the IVth month of the eponymy of Dān-Ea.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-pu-tum ki-ma ṭup-pí-i ta-áš-me-ú KÙ.BABBAR ù ṣí-ba-sú šé-bi₄-lá-ma ṭup-pá-am ša ku-nu-ki-ni ù ku-nu-uk a-ší-tí-kà lu né-du-uk
target: Please, as soon as you have heard the letters, send the silver with the interest on it and then we will cancel the tablet with our seals and the seal of your wife.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a ma-lá na-áš-pé-er-tí-kà iš-me-{d}IŠKUR DUMU i-tur₄-a-a ni-iṣ-ba-at-ma um-ma né-nu-ma 5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a-na ší-a-ma-tim ša PUZUR₄-a-šur DUMU a-ḫu-wa-qar tù-ub-lam kà-i-na-ni-a-tí-ma a-ta-ma ší-ma-am ša-am-ma qá-at-ni lu ni-iš
target: In accordance with your written instructions we seized Išme-Adad, son of Itūraya, and told him: You brought 5 minas of silver, meant for making purchases, belonging to Puzur-Aššur, son of Ahu-waqar. Confirm our claim on it, then it is you who can make the purchases and we will establish our claim on them.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB {d}MAR.TU-ba-ni DUMU šu-{d}NIN.ŠUBUR
target: Seal of Amurrum-bāni son of Šu-Ilabrat.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-um ša ší-bu-tí-a ša IGI šu-ga-ri-a-e ša a-šur
target: The tablet with my testimony before the šugarri'ā'u of Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: wa-bar-tum ša ša-mu-ḫa i-dí-ni-ma ší-bu-tí a-dí-in
target: The station at Šamuha gave me and I gave my testimony.

source: translate Akkadian to English: <gap> ma-na ší-kam ig-ri ša bi₄-il₅-tim a-dí ša-lá-tù-a-ar a-dí-in
target: I gave <gap> minas of -copper as wage of a porter until Šaladuwar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 20 ma-na ší-kam i-na ša-lá-tù-a-ar ú-ša-qí-il₅
target: 20 minas of -copper I paid in Šaladuwar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 ma-na a É ub-ri a-dí-in
target: 3 minas I gave to the inn.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 ma-na URUDU a-na ša bi₄-lá-tim a-dí-in
target: 10 minas of copper I gave to porters.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 7 ma-na URUDU a-tár-ku-a a-dí-in
target: 7 minas of copper I gave to Tarkua.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 ma-na URUDU a-dí pu-ru-uš-ḫa-tim ag-mur
target: 3 minas of copper I spent until Burušhattum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i-na bu-ru-uš-ḫa-tim a-na kà-ri-im ša-du-a-tám a-dí-i
target: 3 shekels of silver in Burušhattum I deposited for the as -tax.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 ma-na URUDU a gám-ri-im a-dí uš-bu-ga-tim
target: 3 minas of copper for expenses until Ušbugattum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a É ub-ri i-na bu-ru-uš-ḫa-tim a-dí-in
target: 3 shekels of silver I paid to the inn in Burušhattum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.5 ma-na URUDU iš-tù pu-ru-uš-ḫa-tim a-dí ša-lá-tù-a-ar ik-šu-dí
target: 1.5 mina of copper from Burušhattum until Šaladuwar I incurred (as expenses).

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 ma-na URUDU a-dí i ša-lá-tù-a-ar úṣ-a-ni ga-me-er
target: 10 minas of copper were spent until I left Šaladuwar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: <gap> ma-na URUDU i na-áb-ri-tim i-na wa-aḫ-šu-ša-na lu É ub-ri ga-me-er
target: <gap> minas of copper were spent when (the donkeys) were stabled in Wahšušana and at the inn.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.5 ma-na URUDU a-dí tuḫₓ pì-a ik-šu-dí
target: 1.5 mina of copper I incurred until Tuhpiya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 ma-na URUDU a-dí tur₄-ḫu-mì-it ik-šu-dí
target: 3 minas of copper I incurred until Durhumit.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù tur₄-ḫu-mì-it a-dí kà-ni-iš-ki 5 ma-na SIG₅ ik-šu-da-ni
target: from Durhumit until Kanesh I incurred expenses of 5 minas of refined (copper).

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 ma-na URUDU a-dí wa-aḫ-šu-ša-na ag-mur
target: I spent 3 minas of copper until Wahšušana.

source: translate Akkadian to English: <gap> 4 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR sà-ḫe-er-tám al-qé-ma ga-me-er
target: I acquired and spent small wares for a value of 4 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am ša i-ṣé-er šu-IŠTAR ni-mar-IŠTAR ù bu-zi-a a-šur-ma-lik i-šu-ú
target: As for the 3 minas of refined silver that Šu-Ištar, Nimar-Ištar and Buziya owed to Aššur-malik,

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ki-ma a-šur-ma-lik šu-IŠTAR il₅-qé
target: on behalf of Aššur-malik Šu-Ištar has received the silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma a-šur-ma-lik a-na bu-zi-a i-tù-ar šu-IŠTAR ú-ba-áb-šu
target: If Aššur-malik raises claim against Buziya, Šu-Ištar will clear him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.3333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša a-we-el-tim ú 17 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša DINGIR-kur-ub
target: As to the 0.3333 mina of silver belonging to the lady and the 17 shekels of silver belonging to Ilī-kurub,

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma a-na bu-zi-a i-tù-ru šu-IŠTAR ú-ba-áb-šu
target: if they raise claim against Buziya, Šu-Ištar will clear him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI da-dí-a IGI {d}UTU.DU₁₀ IGI tù-ta-a {d}UTU-e-nam
target: Witnessed by Dādiya, by Šamaš-ṭāb, by Tutaya. Šamaš-ennam.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB ma-ma-ḫi-ir DUMU a-mur-IŠTAR a-na en-nu-um-a-šur
target: Sealed by Man-mahir son of Amur-Ištar; to Ennam-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma dan-a-šur ù en-na-sú-in-ma a-na ir-ma-a-šur qí-bi₄-ma
target: Thus Dān-Aššur and Ennam-Suen, say to Ir'am-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 TÚG.ḪI.A ku-nu-ki ša ku-lu-ma-a en-um-a-šur ub-lam
target: 10 textiles with the seals of Kulumāya Ennam-Aššur brought us.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ.BA 2 TÚG a-bar-ni-ú 1 TÚG na-ma-šu-ḫu-um
target: Two of these are Abarnian ones, one is -textile.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ki-ma a-na-kam ší-mu-um lá-šu-ú ù TÚG.ḪI-tù sá-sà-am lá-áp-tù
target: Since there was no possibility to sell them here and these textiles are affected by moth,

source: translate Akkadian to English: en-um-a-šur a-na ša-lá-du-a-ar ú-šé-ri-ib-šu-nu-ma 15 GÍN.TA ší-im-šu-nu i-dí-ni-a-tí-ma
target: Ennam-Aššur brought them into Šaladuwar and he gave us 15 shekels apiece, the price made for them,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ku-nu-ki-ni en-um-a-šur na-áš-a-ku-um
target: and Ennam-Aššur is not on his way to you with 2.5 minas of silver under our seals.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-kam a-na TÚG.ḪI.A a-al-DU₁₀ i-dí-nim iš-tí-kà li-iz-ku
target: Over there let Āl-ṭāb get a judicial clearance with you concerning these textiles.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 22 ma-na É a-šur-i-mì-tí ù ḫu-ni-a
target: 22 minas: the house of Aššur-imittī and hunniya;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 ma-na LÁ 15 GÍN šu-ku-bu-um
target: 10 minas less 15 shekels: Šu-Kūbum;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 13 ma-na É šu-{d}EN.LÍL
target: 13 minas: the house of Šu-Illil;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 13 ma-na DUMU a-mur-IŠTAR
target: 13 minas the son of Amur-Ištar;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 13.6666 ma-na 5 GÍN ša lá-qé-pí-im DUMU kà-a-tí-im
target: 13.6666 minas 5 shekels belonging to Lā-qēp son of Kayatum;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 6.5 ma-na a-šùr-ma-lik DUMU en-um-{d}IM
target: 6.5 minas: Aššur-malik son of Ennam-Adad;

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠU.NÍGIN 1.5 GÚ 8.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša na-ru-qí-a qá-dum ša ta-ad-mì-iq-tí-šu-nu ša um-me-a-nu-a i-na ṣé-ri-a i-dí-ú-ni
target: in all: 1.5 talent 8.5 minas of silver from my joint-stock capital, including the which my investors have charged to me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ša-al KÙ.BABBAR u₄-mu-šu-nu ma-al-ú
target: For half the silver the terms have expired.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ša-al KÙ.BABBAR a-na MU.4.ŠÈ i-ša-qal
target: For half the silver payment must be made in 4 years.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na 10 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša ta-ad-mì-iq-tí-šu ša ṭup-pì-a ḫa-ar-mì-im ša šu-ku-bi₄-im <gap> DUMU e-lá-lí 5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR il₅-qé
target: Of the 10 minas of silver from his in my certified tablet belonging to Šu-Kūbum son of Elāli he has received 5 minas of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-ší-tí-šu IGI me-er-i-tí-šu gu₅-ba-áb-tim IGI e-lá-lí me-er-i-šu
target: Witnessed by his wife, by his daughter, the priestess, by Elāli, his son.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ra-bi-ṣú-um ša ša-lim-a-šùr a-na en-um-a-šùr ú a-lá-ḫi-im me-er-e ša-lim-a-šùr iṣ-ba-at-ni-a-tí-ma
target: Šalim-Aššur's attorney seized us against Ennam-Aššur and Ali-ahum, Šalim-Aššur's sons.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ra-bi-ṣú-ma ṭup-pá-am ša a-bu-ku-nu KÙ.BABBAR i-na li-bi-ku-nu i-dí-ú-ni-ma ṭup-pá-am um-me-a-nu a-bi-ku-nu ú-kà-i-lu-ni-ma i-na ma-ḫa-ar kà-ri-im um-me-a-nu iš-ku-nu-šu-ni
target: Your father's investors kept the tablet stating which silver your father set down as owed by you, and the investors placed it in front of the colony.

source: translate Akkadian to English: kà-ru-um i-a-tí ip-qí-id-šu ba-a-nim a ma-lá ṭup-pí-im ša a-lim{ki} KÙ.BABBAR ma-lá i-na li-bi-ku-nu <gap>-ma tí-ni <gap> KÙ.BABBAR šu-uq-lá-ma ku-un-kà-ma a-na a-lim{ki} al-kà lá tù-na-a-ni
target: The colony entrusted it to me. Come, in accordance with the tablet of the City pay the silver for which you were noted in the tablet, seal it and go to the City. Do not cheat me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-lá-ḫu-um-ma ba-a-am ma-lá a-bu-ni i-na li-bi-ni KÙ.BABBAR i-dí-ú-ni lu ni-iš-qú-ul-ma ú iš-té-e ra-bi-ṣí-im lá-li-kà
target: Ali-ahum answered: "Come, let us pay what silver our father set down as owed by us and then let me go with the attorney."

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma en-um-a-šùr-ma a-na ra-bi-ṣí-im-ma a-na pu-tí-a-ma ša-lá-ni-ma ú lá-pu-ul-kà-ma ú a-pu-tí-a-ma lá-li-ik
target: Ennam-Aššur answered the attorney: "Question me right here, and then I shall answer you and I shall leave right now."

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um kà-ni-iš i-dí-ni-a-tí-ma IGI GÍR ša a-šùr ší-bu-tí-ni ni-dí-in
target: The Kanesh colony gave us for these proceedings and we gave our testimony before Aššur's dagger.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI PUZUR₄-<gap> DUMU a-šùr-DU₁₀ IGI šu-a-šùr DUMU šu-sú-in
target: Witnessed by Puzur-<gap> son of Aššur-ṭāb, by Šu-Aššur son of Šu-Suen.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma la-LA-sí-ma a-na a-la-ḫi-im qí-bi₄-ma
target: From Lamassī to Ali-ahum:

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù MU.1.ŠÈ ṭup-pì-kà ù da-na-tí-kà ra-bi₄-ṣú-um ub-lam-ma
target: A year ago the attorney brought your tablets and your strict commands,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù a-tù-nu a-dí u₄-mì-im a-nim sà-aḫ-ra-tù-nu
target: but as for you (pl.), you have delayed until this day!

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-am u₄-ma-am tù-qá-a la ta-lá-ka-nim-ma É a-bi₄-ku-nu lá tù-za-kà-a
target: Which day are you waiting for? You (plur.) do not come and clear the affairs of your paternal house,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù a-na-kam li-mu-um É-tám ik-ta-na-na-ak
target: and the eponymn tries to seal up the house.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-pu-tum šu-ma a-ḫi a-ta a-ma-kam lá ta-áš-ta-na-me-e ki-ma da-nu-tù-ni
target: Urgent, if you are truely my brother, don't you keep hearing there that conditions here are harsh?

source: translate Akkadian to English: ki-ma a-bu-ni e-zi-bi₄-ni ú-ku-ul-tí nu-ḫa-bu-lu-ma ni-ku-lu
target: Do you not know that our father left me in an empty house, so we have to borrow money for food for the household to have something to eat?

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR 1 GÍN šu-mì a-ḫi a-na-ku-ba a ma-nim da-nu-tum a-lim{ki}
target: Why do you not send me a single shekel silver in my name in a shipment? If you are truly my brother - as for me, whom can I look to apart from you? Conditions are harsh in the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ki-ma ṭup-pì za-ki-a-nim-ma É iṭ-ra-a a-na be-ú-lá-tim dí-šu-ma be-ú-lá-tí ra-qá-tám ar-be i-na-mì-tim ru-pu-ša ga be im <gap>
target: Urgent, as you hear my letter, clear yourselves, set out and come and save your father's house. If Aluwa attends to you there, let him do so - or if that is not the case - hand him over for a working capital and send me the working capital . Also, he owes me 13 shekels of silver - seize him and have him pay the silver and send it. Adida brings you a thin textile, four cubits wide and ten long, under my seal. <gap> Adida.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 40 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ni-is-ḫa-sú DIRI ša-du-a-sú ša-bu en-um-a-šùr a-na a-lu-a ù e-ni-ša-ru-um i-na ša-la-tù-ar ku-nu-ki ip-qí-id
target: 40 minas of silver, its import duty added, its transport tariff paid for, Ennam-Aššur has entrusted to Aluwa and Enišārum in Šalatuwar under seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-ut-ma a-na a-lim{ki} a-na ša-lim-a-šur a-bi-a bi-lá
target: He said: Bring it to the City to my father Šalim-Aššur!

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na qá-tí-šu-nu i-dí-in
target: He also gave them 5 shekels of silver for expenses.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um wa-aḫ-šu-ša-na i-dí-in-ni-a-tí-ma IGI GÍR ša da-šùr ší-bu-tí-ni ni-dí-in
target: The Wahšušana colony gave us for these proceedings and we gave our testimony before Aššur's dagger.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI ili₅-ba-ni DUMU a-mur-a-šur IGI a-ḫu-wa-qar DUMU šu-IŠTAR tù-ra-am-ì-lí DUMU e-dí-in-a-šur tap-pá-i-ni
target: Witnessed by Ilī-bāni son of Amur-Aššur, by Ahu-waqar son of Šu-Ištar; Tūram-ilī son of Eddin-Aššur was our (absent) partner.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-lim{ki} lu ni-lik
target: let us go to the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: tí-ma-li-ma áš-a-al-ku-nu-ma um-ma a-na-ku-ma KÙ.BABBAR ma-lá i li-bi₄-ku-nu a-bu-ku-nu i-dí-ú šu-uq-lá-ma ú a-na a-lim{ki} lu ni-lik
target: Yesterday I questioned you, saying: Pay the silver that your father has set down as owed by you, and then let us go to the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-lá-ḫu-um-ma a-ḫu-kà-ma ba-a-nim ma-lá a-bi₄ KÙ.BABBAR i ṭù-pì-im il₅-pu-tí-ni lá-áš-qúl-ma ù a-na a-lim{ki} lu ni-lik
target: Ali-ahum, your brother, answered: 'Come on, I shall pay the silver that my father wrote for me in the tablet, and then let us go to the City.'

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ta ki-ma KÙ.BABBAR ša-qá-li-im da-na-tim ta-ta-na-pá-lá-ni ù KÙ.BABBAR ša-qá-lam lá ta-mu-a lá tù-na-ḫa-ni
target: But you, instead of paying the silver keep answering me harshly, and you are unwilling to pay the silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù a-šar ba-a-ba-tum ša a-bi₄-ku-nu i-ba-ší-ú kà-li-ma-ni-ma i-ša-ḫa-tí-ku-nu lá-zi-iz-ma KÙ.BABBAR lu-ša-áš-qí-il₅-ma a-na a-lim{ki} lu ni-lik
target: Do not obstruct me, but show me where your father's outstanding claims are, so I can assist you in having the silver paid, so we can go to the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫu-kà a-lá-ḫu-um KÙ.BABBAR ma-lá a-bu-šu i ṭù-pì-im il₅-pu-tù-šu KÙ.BABBAR ú-kà-al
target: As for your brother Ali-ahum, I hold the silver that his father wrote for him in the tablet.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ta KÙ.BABBAR ma-lá a-bu-kà i ṭù-pì-im il₅-pu-tù-kà ša-qá-lam lá ta-mu-a ù tù-na-ni-a
target: But you, you refuse to pay the silver that your father wrote in the tablet. So you cheat me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: al-kam ba-a-nim ma-lá a-bu-k
target: Come, move, and pay the silver that your father wrote for you in the tablet, in accordance with the verdict of the City, and then let us go to the City. Do not obstruct me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 12 ma-na URUDU SIG₅ a-šu-mì sú-e-im ša la-ba-ar-ša a-na ša-pá-ar-tim i-dí-a-ší-ni
target: As to the 12 minas of good copper that Labarša deposited for her as security because of the mill-stone.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù sú-am a-la-ḫu-um e-ri-šu-ma ù-ḫa-li-qú-ší URUDU-am áš-qúl
target: When Ali-ahum demanded it from him and they had destroyed it, I paid the copper.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù KÙ.BABBAR a-na DUMU lá-qé-ep DUMU {d}AB-ba-ni áš-qúl
target: Also, I paid silver to the son of Lā-qēp son of Illil-bāni.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na a-lu-ra-ni 3 GÍN a-na e-ṣí qá-at-nu-tim 3 GÍN a-na ab-na-tim 2 GÍN ig-ri i-tí-ni-im
target: 10.5 shekels of silver for the ; 3 shekels for the thin wood; 3 shekels for the stones; 2 shekels, the wages of a builder.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ma a-nim a-na ṣí-tim ša É A.BA ù-ša-qí-il₅
target: All this I paid out for the expenses on the father's house.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ša-lim-a-šur-ma a-na en-nam-a-šur ù a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi-ma
target: From Šalim-Aššur to Ennam-Aššur and Ali-ahum:

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na ṣú-ḫa-ri-a ša i-na re-ší-ku-nu i-za-zu-ni KÙ.BABBAR ša da-da-nim a-na qá-tí-šu dí-na-ma
target: Give the silver from Dadānum (to) one of my servants who are assisting you for his disposal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: e-nam-<gap> a-na <gap> ak-li-im ú-lá i-šu-ma
target: he does not have of bread.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ut ri <gap> ša-ḫi-ra-tim ú ší-na a-na ṣú-ḫa-ri
target: sandals, and two for the servants.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 40 i-lá-tim SIG₅ ša-ma-ni-ma
target: Buy 40 good bags.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-lá-ḫu-um ù a-lu-a lu-ub-lu-nim
target: Let Ali-ahum and Aluwa bring them.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a-na lá-ma-sí šé-bi-lá-ni-im
target: Send 0.5 mina of silver to Lamassī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ma-na KÙ.BABBAR i-ṣé-er šu-IŠTAR šu-sú-in i-šu
target: Šu-Ištar owes <gap> mina of silver to Šu-Suen.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KI KÙ.BABBAR šu-IŠTAR uk-ta-al
target: Šu-Ištar is held in service by the money.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI ša-lim-a-šùr IGI i-dí-IŠTAR
target: Witnessed by Šalim-Aššur, by Iddin-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-dí-da ù a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi-ma um-ma SIG₅-pì-i-a-šur
target: To Adida and Ali-ahum from Damiq-pī-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 14 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-mur-IŠTAR ni-a-um ḫa-bu-lam
target: Our own Amur-Ištar owes me 14 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ša-áš-qí-lá-šu-ma šé-bi₄-lá-nim
target: Make him pay the silver and send it to me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 TÚG SIG₅ zu-zu-a na-áš-a-ku-nu-tí
target: Zuzuwa brings you 1 good textile.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṣú-ba-tám dí-na-ma KÙ.BABBAR ku-un-kà-ma šé-bi-lá-nim
target: Sell the textile, seal the silver and send it to me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: zu-zu-a lá i-sà-ḫu-ur
target: Zuzuwa must not delay.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 ṣú-ba-tí-šu na-ší
target: He carries 2 textiles of his.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṣú-ba-tí-šu dí-na-ma lá i-sà-ḫu-ur
target: Sell his textiles and send him without delay.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭur₄-da-ni-šu a-ḫu-a a-tù-nu i-iḫ-da-ma lu ší-im ṣú-ba-tí-a lu ša a-mur-IŠTAR KÙ.BABBAR ku-un-kà-ma šé-bi₄-lá-nim
target: My dear brothers, take care to seal both the proceeds from my textiles and those of Amur-Ištar in silver and send it to me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-pu-tum we-da-ku i-dí-in-{d}MAR.TU iš-tí zu-zu-a ṭur₄-da-nim
target: Urgent, I am alone. Send Iddin-Amurrum together with Zuzuwa.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na i-dí-a-bi-im DUMU na-ar-me-a
target: to Iddin-abum son of Narmea

source: translate Akkadian to English: 22 ma-na URUDU i-ṣé-er a-al-DU₁₀ ša tù-ùḫ-pì-a a-al-DU₁₀ DUMU a-šùr-DU₁₀ i-šu
target: 22 minas of copper Āl-ṭāb from Tuhpiya owes to Āl-ṭāb, son of Aššur-ṭāb.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI {d}IŠKUR-ba-ni lá-qé-ep URUDU a-na mì-šu-GAL iš-qú-ul
target: In the presence of Adad-bāni La-qēp paid the copper to Mīšur-rabi.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na en-nam-a-šur i-ku-nim ù a-mur-IŠTAR qí-bi-ma um-ma a-šur-ma-lik-ma
target: To Ennam-Aššur, Ikūnum and Amur-Ištar from Aššur-malik:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-kam be-lí-DU₁₀ ṣa-áb-ta-ma šé-ri-a-nim
target: Seize Bēlī-ṭāb there and conduct him here.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma a-lá-kam lá i-mu-a ší-pí-a-šu-ma ù a-na ig-ri li-mur
target: If he refuses to come, question him and then let him look for hire (with others).

source: translate Akkadian to English: dí-nam lam-nam i-ṣé-er i-ku-pì-a šu-uk-na
target: Impose a heavy verdict on Ikūn-pīya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ur-dum lá i-ḫa-liq
target: The slave must not be lost.

source: translate Akkadian to English: GÚ SÍG.ḪI.A <gap> 5 maš-ku <gap> 22 na-ru-qá-tum 4 ANŠE ṣa-la-mu 3.TA ú-kà-pu ù ú-nu-sú-nu
target: x talents of wool, 5 hides, 22 sacks, 4 black donkeys, 3 saddle-rugs for each, plus their harness.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ma a-nim a-na e-wa-ri-mu-ša a-dí-in
target: All this I gave to Ewarimuša.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 TÚG ku-ta-nu 10 GÍN KÙ
target: 2 -textiles (cost) 10 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 TÚG lu-bu-šu 2 TÚG ra-qá-ta-an 2 TÚG šu-lu-up-kà-ú 1 ma-na 9 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR it-bu-lu-ú
target: 4 garments, 2 thin textiles (and) 2 Šulupkaean textiles cost 1 mina 9 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 24 ma-na AN.NA 1.5 ma-na 7 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR it-ba-al
target: 24 minas of tin cost 97 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 TÚG lu-bu-šu 1 TÚG ra-qú-tum 1 TÚG ku-ta-nu 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a-na qá-tí-a ṭá-ḫi
target: 5 garments, 1 thin textile (and) 1 -textile (for) 1 mina of silver have been booked as my share.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 TÚG ku-ta-nu DIRI-tum 3 TÚG ša ṣú-ùḫ-ri-im ša a-bu-ša-lim iš-ú-mu
target: 4 kutānu-textiles of very fine quality, 3 garments for youngsters which Abu-šalim bought.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša 48 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR 2 ma-na KÙ.GI ša-du-a-tám a-šur-i-mì-tí
target: For 48 minas of silver (and) 2 minas of gold the -fee of Aššur-imittī <I paid?>.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 16 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR KI a-šur-i-mì-tí
target: 16 shekels of silver are due from Aššur-imittī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 ma-na 5 GÍN ḫa-da-ú-ni
target: 2 minas 5 shekels (due from?) hada'uni.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na dam-qá-a qí-bi-ma um-ma ša-at-a-na-ma
target: To Damqaya from Šāt-Anna:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša a-dí-na-ku-ni ta-áš-pu-ra-ma um-ma a-ta-ma iš-tí ša bé-ú-lá-tí-a ší-ma-am áš-a-ma a-na pu-ru-uš-ḫa-dim ú-šé-bi-il₅
target: You wrote concerning the 10 shekels of silver that I gave to you, saying: I made purchases together with the money from my working capital and sent it to Purušhaddum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-ma-am ša té-pu-šu a-na a-lim{ki} ṭá-ba-tum-ma šé-bi-lam
target: Be so kind as to send the purchase you made to the City,

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫi a-ta ú a-na-ku ga-ma-al-kà
target: for you are my brother and I can do you favors.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ša ki-ma i-a-tí ù bé-lá-nim
target: To my representatives and Bēlānum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB i-ku-pí-a DUMU e-dí-na-a KIŠIB i-ri-ší-im DUMU a-mur-{d}UTU KIŠIB {d}UTU.DU₁₀ DUMU am-ri-a
target: Seal of Ikūn-pīya son of Eddinaya, seal of Irišum son of Amur-Šamaš, seal of Šamaš-ṭāb son of Amriya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: <gap> ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am i-ṣé-er {d}UTU.DU₁₀ ḫu-dí-da tí-šu iš-tù ḫa-muš-tim ša pu-šu-ke-en₆ ù PUZUR₄-a-šur a-na 3 ḫa-am-ša-tim i-ša-qal
target: Šamaš-ṭāb owes <gap> minas of refined silver to hudida. Reckoned from the week of Pūšu-kēn and Puzur-Aššur he must pay within 3 weeks.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma lá iš-qú-ul ki-ma a-wa-at kà-ri-im ṣí-ib-tám ú-ṣa-áb
target: If he has not paid, he must add interest in accordance with the rule of the colony.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ITU.KAM ṣí-ip-im li-mu-um e-lá-lí
target: Month Ṣip'um, eponymy Elāli.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ša DAM.GÀR-ri-im
target: The silver belongs to a merchant.

source: translate Akkadian to English: <gap> ma-na 17 GÍN a-šur-DÙL
target: <gap> mina(s) 17 shekels Aššur-ṣulūlī,

source: translate Akkadian to English: <gap> ma-na LÁ 1.5 GÍN en-na-ma-núm
target: <gap> mina(s) minus 1.5 shekel Ennamānum,

source: translate Akkadian to English: <gap>-2 ma-na 2 GÍN a-mur-IŠTAR
target: <gap>+2 minas 2 shekels Amur-Ištar,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2.8333 ma-na 7 GÍN a-zu-a
target: 2 minas 57 shekels Azua,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 ma-na 7 GÍN ku-ra
target: 3 minas 7 shekels Kura,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 ma-na i pá-ni-ú-tim ni-kà-sé ku-ra
target: 3 minas from an earlier settlement of accounts Kura,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 6 ma-na 12 GÍN ì-lí-a-lúm
target: 6 minas 12 shekels Ilī-ālum,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2.8333 ma-na a-šur-ma-lik DUMU ú-sà-ni-im
target: 2.8333 minas Aššur-mālik, son of Usānum,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 ma-na 12 GÍN DUMU i-tur₄-DINGIR
target: 2 minas 12 shekels the son of Itūr-ilī,

source: translate Akkadian to English: <gap> ma-na i-nu-mì <gap>-a ú ku-ra a-na ba-at-na i-li-ku-ni ni-dí-šu-nu-tí
target: <gap> mina(s) when <gap>a and Kura went to Batna we gave to them.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na 75 ku-ta-ni ša en-na-sú-in ša i-na a-lim{ki} a-na lá-ta-a ip-qí-du-ni ŠÀ.BA 6 ku-ta-ni i-na tí-me-el-ki-a e-zi-ib
target: Of the 75 kutānus belonging to Enna-Suen that they entrusted to Lataya in the City, thereof he left 6 kutānus in Timelkiya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na ba-áb ḫa-ra-ni-šu ša en-na-sú-in um-ma né-nu-ma IGI en-na-sú-in a-na a-šur-iš-tí-kál-ma KÙ.BABBAR-ma a-wa-tum i-gi₅-im-ra
target: When Enna-Suen was about to leave on a journey we said as follows to Aššuriš-tikal with Enna-Suen as witness: "As to the silver the matter has been concluded."

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù ma-lá KÙ.BABBAR a-na a-dí-da i-ma-ta a <gap> taq-bi-ú-ni KÙ.BABBAR šu-qú-ul-ma lu <gap> nu nu tám a-na en-na-sú-in lu ni-ip-qí-id-ma
target: Also as much silver as you promised to Adida <gap> pay the silver and <gap> we shall entrust the silver to Enna-Suen.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na li-mì-im a-mur-a-šùr KÙ.BABBAR li-ší-qí-il₅-ma ṭup-pá-am ša 3.3333 ma-na KÙ.KI li-mu-um a-mur-a-šur ù be-el tám kà-ru-tim ša šál-ma-a-šur a-na ša ki-ma ku-a-tí lu-šé-ru-ú
target: so the silver will be paid to the eponym Amur-Aššur and the eponym Amur-Aššur and the boss of the customers of Šalim-Aššur will release the tablet concerning 3.3333 mina of gold to your representatives.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-we-lúm ša-ni-iš i-dí-ma KÙ.BABBAR ú-lá i-tí-dí-ni-a-tí
target: The man decided otherwise and the silver was not given to us.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-kam a-na a-lim{ki} al-kà-ma en-na-sú-in ù a-lá-ḫu-ma pí-šu-nu a-na a-lim{ki} li-ip-té-ú ki-ma KÙ.BABBAR ta-da-nam lá i-mu-ú
target: Go to the City there and let Enna-Suen and Ali-ahum make a statement to the City, that he refuses to give the silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-bi-i 13 ma-na.TA ni-kà-sí a-na É a-bi₄-šu a-na ì-lí-a-lim i-dí-in
target: My father settled accounts with Ilī-ālum for his father's house at a rate of 13 minas each.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ut KÙ.BABBAR-áp a-bi₄-a iš-tù MU.30.ŠÈ i-ma-kàr KÙ.BABBAR ul i-šu-ú
target: It is he who manages my father's silver after 30 years, (yet) they do not have any silver (to show for it).

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-kam li-mu-um i ša-ḫa-tí-ku-nu li-zi-iz-ma ki-ma 13 ma-na.TA a-na um-me-a-ni-šu i-dí-nu ù šu-ut 13 ma-na.TA a-na li-mì-im li-dí-in
target: Have the eponym assist you there and since he gave 13 minas each to his investors he should also give 13 minas each to the eponym.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-lá-ḫi-im ú i-ku-pì-a-šur qí-bi-ma um-ma a-li-a-ma
target: To Ali-ahum and Ikūn-pī-Aššur from Aliya:

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-ú ša a-bi₄-ni iš-té-en-<gap> ta-ma-lá-kum ku-nu-ku-a ù ku-nu-ku-ú ša a-gu₅-a
target: The tablets belonging to our father, one single tablet-container under my seal and Aguwa's seal;

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-šur-re-ṣí da-dí-a ù en-nam-a-šur qí-bi₄-ma um-ma e-la-ma-ma
target: Say to Aššur-rēṣī, Dadiya and Ennam-Aššur, thus Elamma:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 24 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am ni-is-ḫa-sú DIRI ša-du-a-sú ša-bu ku-nu-ki-a dan-a-šur na-áš-a-ku-nu-tí
target: Dān-Aššur is on his way to you with 24 minas of refined silver, its excise added, his transport fee paid.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma AN.NA 15 GÍN.TA ù e-li-iš 2 GÚ AN.NA ša-ma-nim
target: If the rate of the tin is 15:1 or even more, then buy 2 talents of tin;

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma la ki-a-am ku-ta-nim ša-ma-ni-im 11.6666 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR TÚG lu-bu-šé ra-qá-tim ù šu-lu-up-ki-e ša ma-nim-ma iš-tí pá-ni-e-ma šé-bi₄-la-nim
target: if not, then buy -textiles. Use 11.6666 minas of silver to buy -garments, thin textiles and Šulupkian ones and send them with the next caravan.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR be-ú-la-at be-lúm-ba-ni šu-ut-ma na-ší
target: Half a mina of silver, the working capital of Bēlum-bāni, he himself has with him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma i-nu-mì lu-qú-tum a-ni-tum ú-ṣí-a-ni u₄-mu-ú kà-ṣú a-bu-ša-lim iš-tí ma-ma-an i-na a-ḫe-ni ša ú-ša-lá-ma-šu-nu pì-iq-da-šu-ma lu-ṣa-am
target: If, when this merchandise leaves, the weather is cool, then entrust Abu-šalim to the care of one of our brothers who will bring them here safely, then he can leave.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma u₄-mu-ú e-mu-ú la ú-ṣí-a-am
target: If the weather is hot he must not leave.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša ik-ri-bi₄-a a-na dan-a-šur a-dí-in
target: I gave 5 shekels of silver of my to Dān-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 8.3333 ma-na 4.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša ILLAT pu-šu-ki-in a-šur-ta-ak-lá-ku il₅-qé
target: Aššur-taklāku received 8.3333 minas 4.5 shekels of silver from the caravan of Pūšu-kēn.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 13.3333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR i-na ILLAT pu-šu-ki-in LUGAL-sú-in na-dí
target: Šar-Suen deposited 13.3333 minas of silver in Pūšu-kēn's caravan.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 8 GÚ 16.5 GÍN AN.NA a-wi-it i-dí-sú-in
target: 8 talents 16.5 shekels of tin the declared value of Iddin-Suen('s merchandise).

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ.BA 41 ma-na 15 GÍN AN.NA qá-dì ša ú-ku-ul-tim
target: Thereof: 41 minas 15 shekels of tin, including expenses for fodder.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ù 2 GÍN AN.NA iš-tù tí-mì-il₅-ki-a ANŠE i-mì-ḫi-iṣ-ma áš-qúl
target: 2 shekels of silver and 2 shekels of tin I paid from Timilkiya because a donkey suffered a stroke.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 6 GÍN AN.NA iš-tù ḫu-ra-ma a-dí kà-ni-iš áš-qúl
target: 6 shekels of tin I paid from hurama until Kanesh.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3.75 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na tí-ib-nim i-na kà-ni-eš áš-qúl
target: 3 3 / 4 shekels of silver I paid in Kanesh for straw.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ma a-nim a-šu-mì i-dí-sú-in áš-qúl
target: All this I paid in the name of Iddin-Suen.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ.BA 34.5 ma-na AN.NA a qá-tí-a i-dí-nu-nim 3.6666 ma-na 7 GÍN.TA bi-il₅-tám ik-šu-dam
target: 34.5 minas of tin they had given me for expenses, which amounted to 3 minas 47 shekels per talent.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB PUZUR₄-a-šur DUMU i-ku-pí-a KIŠIB dan-a-šur DUMU PUZUR₄-a-šur KIŠIB pè-ru-a DUMU šu-up-ip-ra KIŠIB pè-ru-a DUMU a-ra-wa KIŠIB za-ba DUMU ḫa-nu KIŠIB lu-lu DUMU ḫa-bi
target: Seal of Puzur-Aššur, son of Ikūn-pīya, seal of Dān-Aššur, son of Puzur-Aššur, seal of Peruwa, son of Šuppibra, seal of Peruwa, son of Arawa, seal of Zaba, son of hanu, seal of Lullu, son of hapi.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu-lu DUMU ḫa-bi ša IŠTAR-lá-ma-sí DAM ku-ni-lim e-ḫu-zu
target: That is Lullu, son of hapi, who had married Ištar-lamassī, wife of Kūn-ilum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù a-wi-il₅-tum me-ta-at-ni a-wa-tù-šu-nu i-gi₅-im-ra-ma
target: After the lady had died, their affairs were settled.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu gám-ra-am ša a-na a-wi-il₅-tim ig-mu-ru lu a-na ì-lí-a ša a-na ki-šar-ší-im i-ni-id-ú lu-lu gám-ra-am ig-mu-ru
target: For the expenses made for the lady, and those made for Iliya, who had been thrown into jail and whose expenses Lullu had paid.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu ša a-wi-il₅-tim lu a ša ì-lí-a a-na mì-ma šu-um-šu a-na me-er-e ḫa-ni-im lu-lu DUMU ḫa-be lá i-tù-ar
target: For both those made for the lady, and those made for Iliya, Lullu, son of hapi, will not raise any claims against the sons of hanum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma i-ku-pí-a-ma dan-a-šur ù ša-lim-wa-ar-dí-ma a-na en-um-a-šur qí-bi-ma
target: From Ikūn-pīya, Dan-Aššur and Šalim-wardī to Ennam-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 GÚ URUDU SIG₅ dan-a-šur iš-qú-ul-ni-a-tí
target: Dan-Aššur has paid us 2 talents of good copper.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 ša-áb-ra-tim lá iš-bi-ir-ma 15 GÍN ša-qá-lá-am qá-bi
target: He did not break the 3 blocks, and he promised to pay 15 shekels.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 GÚ URUDU SIG₅ i ší-im AN.NA-kà ù TÚG.ḪI-tí-kà 5 GÚ URUDU SIG₅ ku-nu-ki-ni šu-nu-nu na-áš-a-ku-um
target: Šu-Nūnu brings you 3 talents of good copper from the proceeds from your tin and your textiles, (in all) 5 talents of good copper under our seals.

source: translate Akkadian to English: URUDU ša ki-ma sá-li-a né-ri-iš-ma ta-dá-na-am lá i-mu-ú
target: We asked for copper from Salliya's representatives but they would not give it.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-du-um lu-lá-im ša ta-áš-pu-ra-ni lu-lá-um lá-šu
target: As to the you wrote about, there is no none.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí 5 u₄-me ša-lim-wa-ar-dí i-za-ku-ma ni-ṭá-ra-dam
target: Within 5 days Šalim-wardī will be cleared and we shall send him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 ma-na URUDU a qá-tí-šu ni-dí-in
target: We gave him 3 minas of copper to dispose of.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṣú-ḫa-ar-kà SÍG il₅-qé
target: your servant received the wool.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ku-nu-ki-kà li-dí-nam
target: Let him give me the silver under your seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma da ni ik-šu-da-ni KÙ.BABBAR ú-ta-e-ra-kum-ma
target: If reached me I shall return the silver to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù a-na ku-ša-ra e lá ší-ta e tám
target: and then to Kuššara.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 ma-na AN.NA ša ik-ri-bi₄-a a-na ší-a-ma-tim a-na a-mur-IŠTAR IGI a-šùr-i-mì-tí a-dí-in
target: I gave 3 minas of tin from my votive offering for purchases to Amur-Ištar with Aššur-imittī as witness.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3.6666 ma-na 2 GÍN AN.NA i li-bi₄ a-šur-SIPA
target: 3 minas 42 shekels of tin owed by Aššur-rē'ī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-šur-dan IGI ir-ma-a-šur
target: In the presence of Aššur-dān, of Ir'am-Aššūr.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-ú ša ḫu-bu-ul i-dí-a-bi₄-im ni-a-im
target: Tablets concerning our Iddin-abum's debts.

source: translate Akkadian to English: PUZUR₄-a-šùr ù ir-ma-a-šur i-na a-lim{ki} iṣ-bu-tù-ni-a-tí-ma
target: Puzur-Aššur and Ir'am-Aššur seized us in the city.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ir-ma-a-šùr-ma a-na PUZUR₄-a-šùr-ma ṭup-pé-a i-na wa-aḫ-šu-ša-na ta-áp-té-ma ṭup-pá-am ša 0.6666 ma-na 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša pí-lá-ḫa-a-nim DUMU da-nu-um-ì-lí tal-qé ṭup-pá-am ša 15 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša kà-as-kà-nu-i-il₅ tal-qé
target: Ir'am-Aššur said to Puzur-Aššur: You gained access to my tablets in Wahšušana and you took a tablet of 45 shekels of silver of Pilahānum, son of Dannum-ilī, (and) you took a tablet of 15 shekels of silver of Kaskanu'i.l.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma PUZUR₄-a-šur-ma ke-na al-qé
target: Puzur-Aššur answered: "Indeed, I took (them)."

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša-zu-uz-ti a-ta ù PUZUR₄ {d}UTU DUMU šu-nu-nu ší-sí-a lá-lik-ma me-eḫ-ri-a ù ta-aḫ-sí-sà-ti-a lá-mur-ma
target: You, as my representative, and Puzur-Šamaš, son of Šu-Nunu, must then I will go to inspect my copies and memos.

source: translate Akkadian to English: na-áš-a-kum a-ṣé-er <gap> ma-na 1.3333 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR-pì-kà 1 ma-na ú-ra-da-ma ú-šé-ba-lá-ku-ma ù i-na e-lá-i-kà lu ni-iz-ku
target: To your <gap> mina 1.3333 shekel of silver I will add 1 mina and send it to you and when you come here, we must clear accounts.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um kà-ni-iš-ki i-dí-ni-ma IGI GÍR ša a-šùr ší-bu-tí a-dí-in
target: For these words the Kanesh colony made me available and before the dagger of Aššur I gave my testimony.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI bu-za-zu DUMU pu-šu-ki-in li-ip-tí-IŠTAR DUMU iš-ma-a-šur tap-pá-i
target: In the presence of Buzāzu, son of Pūšu-kēn; Lipit-Ištar, son of Išme-Aššur was my companion.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi₄-ma um-ma SIG₅-pí-a-šur ù MAN-a-šur
target: To Ali-ahum from Damiq-pī-Aššur and Puzur-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam i-na ma-ṭá KÙ.BABBAR MAN-a-šur e-pu-lu
target: They satisfied Puzur-Aššur here for the deficit on the silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ša SIG₅-pì-a-šur
target: The silver belongs to Damiq-pī-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫu-ni a-ta a-ma-kam ší-gi₅-is-ma KÙ.BABBAR <gap> wa-li-a kà-ṣa-ru-um ša a-šur-be-el-ša-du-i KÙ.BABBAR a-dí ša-ḫu-tí-a e-pu-lu
