target: Our dear brother, exert yourself there and make Waliya, Aššur-bēl-šaduʾe's packer pay the silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR šu-mì ṭá-ḫu
target: The silver must not go missing.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ki-ma tal-qé-ú ir-ta-kà a-šar
target: Send me word to where I am staying when you have recieved the silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi-ma um-ma a-li-a-ma i pá-ni-tí áš-pu-ra-kum um-ma a-na-ku-ma ṭup-pu-um ša 4 ma-na 12 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na šu-a-šur a-na 1.3333 ma-na 3 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na ša-pár-tim ti-dí-i KÙ.BABBAR šu-qú-ul-ma ù tí-ir-ta-kà li-li-kam-ma lá-tal-kam
target: To Ali-ahum from Aliya: I wrote you before, saying: As for the tablet concerning 4 minas 12 shekels of silver - you know (it was given) as a pledge to Šu-Aššur for 1.3333 mina 3 shekels of silver - pay the silver and then send me word so I may come.

source: translate Akkadian to English: be-lí a-ta a-ṣé-er ṭup-pí-im ša i-ṭí-áb-ší-na-tí ša iš-tí-kà i-ba-ší-ú ù ṭup-pu-um ša ḫu-bu-ul i-ṭí-ib-ší-na-tí-ma ša 3 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša iš-tù li-mì-im ib-ni-{d}IM i ša-tim 0.5 ma-na.TA ú-ša-qú-lu a-na-ku ú-kà-al
target: My dear lord, apart from the tablet of Iṭiab-šināti that is with you, I have the tablet concerning Iṭab-šināti's debt of 3 minas of silver, that he is to pay (in instalments) of 0.5 mina per year reckoned from the eponymy of Ibni-Adad.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ta-ta me-ra-šu iš-tí a-mur-ša-ra-sà a-mì-ša-am i-ta-al-kam
target: His son Atata came there with Amur-šarrassa.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR 1 ma-na ù 2 ma-na SIG₅-<gap> i-ra-dí
target: Damiq-<gap> will lead some one or two minas of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-nu-mì i-dí-a-bu-um a-wa-sú iq-bi-ú
target: When Iddin-abum spoke his will

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a-na ša-lim-a-šùr i-dí-in
target: he gave 10 minas of silver to Šalim-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-ut-ma i-na ṣí-ba-at KÙ.BABBAR-pí-a li-il₅-qé
target: He said: He may take it out of the interest on my silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI šu-{d}EN.LÍL IGI ṣí-lu-lu
target: Witnessed by Šu-Illil, by Ṣilūlu.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.6666 ma-na 5 GÍN pá-šu-um ù be-lá-sú 0.5 ma-na pá-ag-ru-um mì-ma a-nim a-na šu-ma-a ša ḫa-na-ak-na-ak a-dí-in IGI šu-{d}EN.LÍL
target: 0.6666 mina 5 shekels, an aze and its biltu.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù wa-aḫ-šu-ša-na a-dí kà-né-eš da-tum 1.3333 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ik-šu-dí
target: From Wahšušana until Kaneš the road-tax amounted for me to 1.3333 shekel of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 GÍN a-na kà-ší-im i-na kà-né-eš áb-ri-ma
target: 1 shekel (of silver) for the official. (Since) I passed some time in Kanesh,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-ku-ul
target: I consumed 10 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na É wa-áb-ri i-na ḫu-ru-ma
target: 1 shekel of silver for the inn in hurama;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i-na tí-mì-il₅-ki-a a-na É wa-áb-ri
target: 1 shekel of silver in Timilkiya for the inn;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i-na ḫa-ḫi-im a-na É wa-áb-ri
target: 2 shekels of silver in hahhum for the inn;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i-na bu-ru-lim a-na É wa-áb-ri
target: 1 shekel of silver in Burullum for the inn;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR iš-tù kà-né-eš a-di a-lim{ki} a-na ú-ku-ul-tí-a ag-mu-ur
target: 10 shekels of silver from Kanesh until the City I spent on my food.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi-ma um-ma PUZUR₄-a-šur
target: To Ali-ahum from Puzur-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na 2 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ku-nu-ki-a a-na e-na-nim DUMU a-bi₄-a i-na pu-ru-uš-ḫa-dim e-zi-ib
target: I left 0.5 mina 2 shekels of silver under my seal for Ennānum son of Abiya in Purušhaddum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ku-nu-ki-a li-dí-na-kum
target: Have him give you the silver under my seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na É-tí-kà li-ib-ší
target: Let it remain in your house.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.5 SÌLA ri-iš-tám iš-ra-am ù mu-sà-ra-am a-da-aḫ-ší mì-ma a-ni-im kà-al-kà wa-ar-du-um ša šu-sú-in DUB.SAR na-áš-a-kum
target: 1.5 litre of fine oil, a belt and a girdle (and) -spice - all this Kalka, the slave of the scribe Šu-Suen brings to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-la-ḫi-im qí-bi-ma um-ma a-dí-<gap>-a-ma
target: To Ali-ahum from Adi<gap>:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí ša a-dí u₄-mì-im a-nim <gap> na-ru <gap> lu-mu-un li-bi₄-im la ta-ra-ší-am
target: As to the fact that until this day <gap> you do not feel anger towards me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: <gap> ma-na 15 GÍN <gap> ni <gap> ú <gap> tal-qé <gap>-a-šùr ú <gap>-ma-ma a-dí 5 u₄-me-e a-ta-be-am-ma a-ta-lá-kam
target: Within five days I shall set out and come.

source: translate Akkadian to English: be-lí a-ta a-ṣé-er ru-ba-im ṭup-pá-am lá-pì-ta um-ma a-ta-ma KÙ.BABBAR i-na be-tí-a ḫa-lá-aq
target: My dear lord, write a letter to the king in which you say: The silver was lost in my house.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-šu-um ta-as-tù-pu-ma lá ta-šu-ur
target: Why have you kept silent and not taken action?

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-um ša en-na-sú-en₆ DUMU i-dí-a-bi-im
target: Tablet concerning Enna-Suen son of Iddin-abum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na en-um-a-šùr DUMU ša-lim-a-šùr ú šu-ku-bi-im DUMU e-na-ma-nim
target: to Ennam-Aššur son of Šalim-ahum and Šu-Kūbum son of Ennam-Anum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 ma-na SÍG.ḪI.A i-nu-mì 1 ma-na SÍG.ḪI.A a-na nu-a-im ša-a-al i-ṣú-ra-tim a-dí-nu
target: 3 minas of wool when I gave 1 mina of wool to the native of 'Birds-town'.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 ma-na SÍG.ḪI.A ša iš-tù té-ga-ra-ma a-ni-iš-ú
target: 5 minas of wool which I had brought from Tegarama.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 ma-na SÍG.ḪI.A ša É-be-et kà-ri-im
target: 5 minas of wool of the karum-office.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.5 ma-na SÍG.ḪI.A ni-qí-a-am ša a-na sú-in a-qí-ú
target: 1.5 mina of wool, a gift which I offered to Suen.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2.5 ma-na SÍG.ḪI.A ni-qí-a-am ša a-na a-na-a a-qí-ú
target: 2.5 minas of wool a gift which I offered to Anna.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 9 ma-na SÍG.ḪI.A i-na ša en-um-a-šùr i-dí-na-ni
target: 9 minas of wool from what Ennum-Assur had given me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠU.NÍGIN 21 ma-na a-na am-tim e-zi-ib
target: In all 21 minas I left to the maid.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-lá-ḫi-im a-ni-na be-lúm-ba-ni a-šur-ma-lik a-na be-lúm-ba-ni qí-bi-ma um-ma zu-ku-a-ma
target: To Ali-ahum, Annina, Bēlum-bāni (and) Aššur-malik; specifically to Bēlum-bāni from Zukuwa:

source: translate Akkadian to English: ma-na 8 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR 6 iš-qú-ul
target: mina 8 shekels of silver concerning him

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.25 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i ba du
target: 1 / 4 shekel of silver

source: translate Akkadian to English: 42 TÚG pì-ri-kà-ni -kà ú-nu-sú-nu
target: 42 -textiles their harness

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ṣé-er ša ša-lá-tù-ar ma-na 5.5 GÍN ù ḫa-ar-mì-im ša 2.6666 ma-na -tim -qú-ul
target: to Šalatuwar mina 5.5 shekels and a certified tablet 2.6666 minas

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ma-na-im ṣí-ib-tám ú-ṣa-áb ma-lá u₄-mu-šu e-tí-qú KÙ.BABBAR ú ṣí-ba-sú ša-áš-qí-lá-šu lá ta-ša-ḫu-ta
target: per mina he will add as interest. As his term is exceeded, make him pay the silver and its interest. Do not fear

source: translate Akkadian to English: ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša am-tim ša i li-bi-šu ù šu-a-tí ša-dí-na-šu
target: mina of silver belonging to the maid which is in his possession and make him give that too.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na 0.25 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR iš-tù 2 ša-na-at a-dí-in a-ni i-na kà-ni-ìš aṣ-ba-sú-ma um-ma a-na-ku-ma KÙ.BABBAR-pì dí-nam um-ma šu-ut-ma a-na ṣé-er i-ku-pì-a ša-zu-úz-tí-kà ta-áš-pu-ra-ma a-dí-in um-ma a-na-ku-m
target: 0.5 mina 1 / 4 shekel of silver I gave 2 years ago; now I seized him in Kanesh and said: Give me my silver! He said: You wrote to Ikūn-piya, your agent, and I gave it. I answered: In case you have not given it to Ikūn-pīya, will you not pay per 0.5 mina 1 mina 7 shekels? He answered: I shall pay you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5.25 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i ṣí-ba-at 5 ma-na-im KÙ.BABBAR a-ḫu-ur
target: 5 1/4 shekels of silver from the interest on 5 minas is still due.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 13.25 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ší-im ḫu-sà-ri-ni ša i šu-pì-lu-li-a a-dí-nu iš-tí kà-ri-im tur₄-ḫu-mì-it
target: 13 1/4 shekels of silver, the price of our lapis lazuli, which I sold in Šuppiluliya, is due from Durhumit colony.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na 1 me-at 30 TÚG ku-ta-ni e-zi-ib ša kà-ṣa-ri ù ta-ad-mì-qá-tim ša iš-tù e-kál-lim ur-da-ni-ni-ma 65 TÚG.TA qá-ta-tim ik-šu-ud-ni-a-tí
target: Of the 130 textiles minus those of the packers and the loans that came down from the palace, 65 textiles resulted for each of us as shares.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ.BA 43 TÚG ku-ta-ni a-na en-um-a-šur a-dí-in
target: Thereof I gave 43 kutānu-textiles to Ennam-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-tí ṣú-ba-tí-kà 22 TÚG a-ḫu-ru
target: The rest of your textiles: 22 textiles remain.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na 10 ku-ta-ni SIG₅ ša ba-ri-ni ŠÀ.BA 4 TÚG en-um-a-šur il₅-qé
target: Of the 10 fine textiles that are owned jointly by us, of that Ennam-Aššur has received 4 textiles.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 TÚG.ḪI.A a-na ba-ri en-na-nim ù en-um-a-šur i-za-zu
target: 2 textiles stand as joint property of Ennānum and Ennam-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI tù-ur-a-a IGI lá-qé-ep DUMU šu-a-šur
target: Witnessed by Turaya, by Lā-qēp son of Šu-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: LUGAL-sú-in <gap>-mu iz-me-ru-ma
target: Šarrum-Suen they have computed and

source: translate Akkadian to English: li-mì 80.8333 ma-na URUDU <gap> LUGAL-sú-in <gap>-dí-im <gap>
target: thousands 80.8333 minas of copper Šarrum-Suen

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.3333 ma-na 2.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i li-bi₄ a-al-wa-na a-na ḫa-ar-pé a-ni-ú-tim i-ša-qal IGI kà-ar-ší-ni
target: 0.3333 mina 2.5 shekels of silver is owed by Alwana.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 14 ma-na KÙ ṣa-ru-pá-am i-ṣé-er i-dí-a-bi₄-im a-mur-IŠTAR i-šu-ú
target: Iddin-abum owes 14 minas of refined silver to Amur-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù ḫa-mu-uš-tim ša da-la-áš ù du-ùḫ-ni-iš a-na 43 ḫa-am-ša-tim i-ša-qal
target: Reckoned from the week of Dalaš and Duhniš he must pay in 43 weeks.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma i-ma-lá u₄-me-šu lá iš-qúl 1.5 GÍN.TA i ITU.KAM a-na 1 ma-na-im ú-ṣa-áb
target: If he has not paid at the completion of his term, he must add interest at the rate 1.5 shekel per month per mina.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5.6666 ma-na 5 GÍN ša a-šùr-e-mu-qí
target: 5.6666 minas 5 shekels belong to Aššur-emūqī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-šùr-i-mì-tí IGI šu-a-nim
target: Witnessed by Aššur-imittī, by Šu-Anum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-šé-ra-tim wa-ar-ki-a-tim i-ma-ar
target: He will await the coming.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-šur-i-mì-tí qí-bi-ma um-ma a-šur-ba-ni-ma mì-nu-um ša a-na KÙ.BABBAR ta-áš-ta-na-pá-ra-ni um-ma a-ta-ma KÙ.BABBAR šé-bi-lam
target: To Aššur-imittī from Aššur-bāni: Why do you keep writing me about silver? You say: “Send me silver!”

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-nu-mì ta-ta-al-ku 15 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR té-zi-ba-ma a-dí kur-ub-IŠTAR iš-tù ta-wi-ni-a i-tù-ra-ni ga-me-er
target: When you went away you left me 15 shekels of silver, and that was spent before Kurub-Ištar returned from Tawiniya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-ta-ma a-lá-ak ṭup-pé-e ša KÙ.BABBAR 10 ma-na ú-šé-ba-lá-kum-ma KÙ.BABBAR ša-áš-qí-il₅-ma tí-ib-a-ma a-tal-kam
target: You said: “Go! I shall send you tablets worth some 10 minas of silver, so you can have the silver paid, then set out and leave.”

source: translate Akkadian to English: ki-ma ṭup-pé-e šé-bu-lim a-na ṭup-pí-ni ša i-ma-ta DAM.GÀR iḫ-ri-mu tù-uš-ta-na-e-dí
target: Instead of sending me tablets you warn me constantly whenever the merchant certified our tablets.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù a-ta-ma tí-de₈-e ki-ma a-ka-al-tám 30 té-zi-ba-ni
target: And you know yourself that you left only 30 portions of food for me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na qá-qí-ri-im da-nim a-nim a-a-kam lá-al-qé-ma lu-ša-ki-il₅
target: From where shall I get anything so I can feed anyone under these harsh conditions?

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-ku wa-dí a-ma DUMU šu-IŠTAR am-tám ù ÌR ša ú-ša-ku-lu ù ú-ra-bu-ú-ni lá tù ša-ki-li-ni-ma KÙ.BABBAR 1 ma-na a-na ú-ku-ul-tí É be-tim a-ta-aḫ-ba-al
target: And I, as you know, I must feed and raise the son of Šu-Ištar, the maid and the slave, (and) you do not feed me, so I have become indebted for at least 1 mina of silver for the food for the household.

target: I said this to Ušinalam before your envoys and the plenary assembly of the Burušhaddum colony, but he refused.

source: translate Akkadian to English: My dear lords, <gap> the tablet from the Burušhaddum colony and the tablet from Ušinalam that Ibaya's son and Ušinalam's servant brought, that the envoys from the City and the plenary assembly of the Kanesh colony heard, and on the basis of which tablets they led me away and I satisfied Ušinalam - both those two earlier tablets which the envoys of the City and the plenary assembly of the Kanesh colony heard and which have been entrusted (for safe-keeping), plus the tablet, a missive from the plenary assembly of the Burušhaddum colony, that Ilī-bāni and huraṣānum bring to the plenary assembly of the Kanesh colony - those three tablets you must seal for Buziya, the envoy from the City, and entrust them so that he brings them to the City.
target: My dear lords, the tablet from the Burušhaddum colony and the tablet from Ušinalam that Ibaya's son and Ušinalam's servant brought, that the envoys from the City and the plenary assembly of the Kanesh colony heard, and on the basis of which tablets they led me away and I satisfied Ušinalam - both those two earlier tablets which the envoys of the City and the plenary assembly of the Kanesh colony heard and which have been entrusted (for safe-keeping), plus the tablet, a missive from the plenary assembly of the Burušhaddum colony, that Ilī-bāni and huraṣānum bring to the plenary assembly of the Kanesh colony - those three tablets you must seal for Buziya, the envoy from the City, and entrust them so that he brings them to the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: If Buziya has left, then entrust them to a reliable affiliated trader.
target: If Buziya has left, then entrust them to a reliable affiliated trader.

source: translate Akkadian to English: You gave me a tablet, saying: "Go and confirm the witnesses, so either in the Kanesh colony or in the Burušhaddum colony <gap> the price of the wool of Ušinalam<gap>."
target: You gave me a tablet, saying: "Go and confirm the witnesses, so either in the Kanesh colony or in the Burušhaddum colony the price of the wool of Ušinalam."

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 TÚG a-bar-ni-a-am 1 TÚG bu-ra-a-am a-na ku-ku-zi DUMU sà-aḫ-ri-ì-lí ša ša-lá-tù-a-ar a-na ší-a-ma-tim a-dí-in
target: I gave 1 Abarnian textile, 1 burā'u-textile to Kukuzi son of Sahri-ilī from Šalatuwar for purchases.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 41 ma-na 11.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am ku-nu-ki ša ki-ma ku-a-tí ù ku-nu-ki-a 3 né-pì-šu
target: 41 minas 11.5 shekels of refined silver, sealed by your representatives and by me - in three packages;

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫa-ma 0.6666 ma-na 1 GÍN ša-du-a-sú mì-ma a-nim a-na šu-nu-nu ù i-lá-áš-ra-ni áp-qí-id-ma a-na ṣé-er ša-lim-a-šùr a-bi₄-ni a-na ma-lá tí-ir-tí-šu ub-lu
target: further 0.6666 mina 1 shekel, its transport tariff - all this I entrusted to Šu-Nūnu and Ili-ašrannī, and they have brought it to Šalim-Aššur, our father, in accordance with his orders.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫa-ma 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na ú-kúl-tí-šu-nu a-dí-šu-nu-tí
target: Furthermore, I gave them 5 shekels of silver for their food.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-ḫu-qar DUMU zu-ur-zu-ur IGI a-šùr-ták-lá-ku DUMU qar-du-um-{d}IM
target: Witnessed by Ahu-waqar son of Zurzur, by Aššur-taklāku son of Qardum-Adad.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫa-ma 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na bé-a-lim a-na šu-nu-nu a-dí-in
target: Furthermore, I gave 10 shekels of silver for a working-capital to Šu-Nūnu.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 7 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na bé-a-lim a-na i-lá-áš-ra-ni a-dí-in ma-aḫ-ri-šu-nu-ma
target: 7 shekels of silver I gave as a working-capital to Il-ašrannī witnessed by the same men.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10.6666 GÍN a-šùr-ma-lik i-lá-qé
target: 10.6666 shekels Aššur-mālik will take

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 ku-ta-ni ša qá-tim 3 TÚG tí-sà-bi ša na-aḫ-ri-a 5 TÚG ni-ib-ra-ru ša za-al-pá 3 ma-na AN.NA 1 pí-ri-kà-nu-um ša kà-ni-iš mì-ma a-nim tám-kà-ru-um a-na šu-IŠTAR
target: 4 of ordinary quality, 3 textiles from Nahria, 5 textiles from Zalpa, 3 minas of tin, 1 from Kanesh - all this the merchant gave to Šu-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI ku-ra IGI a-šur-{d}UTU-ši a-ḫa-ma
target: Witnessed by Kura, by Aššur-šamšī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 ší-it-ru 4.5 TÚG wa-dí-ú-tum ša a-na-na a-na šu-IŠTAR a-na ší-a-ma-tim ta-dí-in
target: Further, 2 undergarments, 4.5 textiles belonging to Anna-anna were given to Šu-Ištar for purchases.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-wi-li a-ni-ú-tim
target: Witnessed by these men.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma la-ma-sí-ma a-na en-nam-a-šùr ù a-la-ḫi-im qí-bi-ma ta-áš-pu-ra-nim um-ma a-tù-nu-ma ra-bi-ṣa-am aḫ-za-nim ù ṭup-pá-am ša a-lim{ki} le-qé-a-nim
target: From Lamassī to Ennam-Aššur and Ali-ahum: You have written, saying: Hire an attorney for me and get hold of a tablet from the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ra-bi₄-ṣa-am ni-ḫu-za-ku-nu-tí ù ṭup-pá-am ša a-lim{ki} ni-il₅-qé
target: We have hired an attorney for you and we got hold of a tablet from the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-kam ki-ma ša bu-lu-uṭ a-bi-ku-nu la tù-uš-té-ṣa-a-ma ša-li-um i-ṣé-er É a-bi₄-ku-nu lá i-ša-lá
target: Just as when your father was still alive do not quarrel there so no evildoer may do harm to your father's house.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu ší-ta-am a-tù-nu-ma KÙ.BABBAR-áp a-bi-ni ma-lá a-wi-lu-tí-ku-nu pá-ḫi-ra-ma ù pu-ut a-bi-ni ù É-et a-bi₄-ni e-bi-ba-ma ša-li-um i-ṣé-er É-et a-bi₄-ni lá i-ša-lá lá tù-uš-té-ṣa-a
target: As for the rest, it is you who must collect our father's silver as true gentlemen, and clear our father and our father's house of claims, and so no evildoer can do harm to our father's house you must not quarrel.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-pu-tum šu-ma a-ḫu-a a-tù-nu ra-bi₄-ṣú-um e-ku-ša-ku-nu-tí KÙ.BABBAR 10 ma-na ma-lá a-wi-lu-tí-ku-nu lu da-pu-ur-tí É a-bi₄-ni ù É a-bi-ni e-bu-bi-im ep-ša-ma ù ra-ma-ku-nu za-ki-a-nim tí-ib-a-nim-ma a-tal-kà-nim-ma ú iš-tí DAM.GÀR ù um-me-a-ni a-bi₄-ku-nu zu-ku-a
target: Urgent, if you are truly my brothers, the attorney has gone to you - act so that you make at least 10 minas of silver as true gentlemen, by clearing both the satisfaction? of our father's house and our father's house itself, and then clear yourselves, set out and come here so that you may clear matters with the customers and investors of your father.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-pu-tum šu-ma a-ma-kam a-tù-nu ša-tám iš-té-et sà-aḫ-ra-tù-nu za-lu-ar-tám a-šar 1 ma-na ù 2 ma-na-e KÙ.BABBAR a-bu-ni ḫa-bu-lu
target: Urgent, if you are delayed there for a single year, then send <gap> where our father owes 1 or 2 minas of silver, and then let us pay it.

source: translate Akkadian to English: kà-ru-um ḫa-ḫu-um dí-nam i-dí-in-ma
target: The hahhum colony has passed a verdict:

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma šu-be-lúm ù en-na-sú-in me-er-ú i-dí-a-bi₄-im <gap> a-na kà-ri-im kà-ni-iš{ki} lá i-li-ku-ma
target: If Šu-Bēlum and Enna-Suen, Iddin-abum's sons, do not go to the Kanesh colony

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tí šál-ma-a-šùr lá i-na-me-ru-ú-ma
target: and do not meet with Šalim-Aššur

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-li i-ma-gu₅-ru-ni lá e-ta-wu-ú
target: and do not discuss in order to come to an agreement,

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu-qú-tám a-na šál-ma-a-šùr ú-šu-ru-ú
target: then they must release the goods to Šalim-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ba pá-šé-er a-wa-tim
target: Aba was the arbitrator.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-be-lúm-ma a-na en-na-sú-in ú a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi₄-ma
target: From Šu-Bēlum to Enna-Suen and Ali-ahum:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 11 TÚG qá-du-um ša ṣú-ḫa-ri-im ú ší-na ma-áš-ku-nu zu-ba ù {d}IM-ba-ni mu-pá-zi-ru-ú na-áš-ú-ni-ku-nu-tí
target: Zuba and Adad-bāni, the smugglers, bring you 11 textiles, including those belonging to the servant, and two covers.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ig-ri-šu-nu dí-na-šu-nu-tí
target: Give them their wages, 10 shekels of silver;

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR <gap> a-dí šé-bi₄-lá <gap>-bu-ma ṣú-ḫa-ru-um lá i-sà-ḫu-ur ṭù-ur-da-ni
target: also, send 10 shekels of silver <gap> and the servant must not be delayed - send him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša 1 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ší-ni-in ú šé-na-tim ša sí-ni-iš-tim ša-ma-ma šé-bi₄-lá-nim
target: Buy shoes for 1 shekel of silver and some shoes for women and send them.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-pu-tum TÚG.ḪI.A ma-lá ta-le-e-a-ni dí-na-šu-nu
target: Urgent, as for the textiles, sell them as well as you can.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫu-ú-a a-tù-nu lu-lu TÚG.ḪI.A a-ḫi-ú-tim uš-té-né-ra-áb ú a-tù-nu iš-tí-šu nam-gi₅-ra-ma
target: My dear brothers, Lulu keeps having textiles belonging to strangers brought in, so you must reach an agreement with him

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tí ṣú-ḫa-ri-im ṣú-ḫa-ar-šu le-tí-qám-ma TÚG.ḪI.A lu 50 lu lu-šé-tí-qám
target: that his servant travels here with the servant, so he may send 20 or 30 textiles here.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na <gap> ù <gap> qí-bi₄-ma um-ma i-dí-a-bu-um-ma
target: To <gap> and <gap> from Iddin-abum:

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša lá-ma-sú-tum a-na-na ù áb-ša-lim a-na ḫa-šu-ú-ma-an i-ḫi-ib-lá-ni-ma ṭup-pì ša a-bi₄-ni a-na ša-pá-ar-tim i-dí-a-šu-ni
target: for the 1 mina of silver for which Lamas-sutum, Anna-anna and Ab-šalim have become indebted to haššu-uman, and for which they have given him tablets belonging to our father as security,

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI ḫa-nu-nu šu-IŠTAR ù a-šur-ma-lik a-wa-tí-ší-na ag-mu-ur-ma a-na i-dí ṭup-pì ša a-bi₄-ni <gap> i a-na KÙ.BABBAR a-pu-ul-šu-ma ša-bu-ma ší-tí KÙ.BABBAR <gap> li <gap>
target: I have concluded their matter with hanunu, Šu-Ištar and Aššur-malik as witnesses, and I reimbursed him for the tablets of our father, and he has been paid, and the rest of the silver <gap>

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na DUMU ḫa-šu-ú-ma-an šu-uq-lá-ma ú ṭup-pá-am ša ku-nu-ki-šu ú ku-nu-uk um-mì-šu ù a-ḫi-šu ḫi-ir-ma-ma ki-ma a-we-lá-tim ú ṭup-pì ša a-bi₄-ni ú-šé-ṣí-a-ni-ma KÙ.BABBAR a ḫu-bu-ul a-we-lá-tim a-na-ku i-na ra-mì-ni-a áš-qú-lu
target: Pay <gap> to haššu-uman's son and then certify a tablet with his seal and the seals of his mother and brother, stating that I have redeemed the women and our father's tablets, and that I have personally out of my own funds paid silver to cover the debt of the women.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫu-a a-tù-nu be-lu-a a-tù-nu iḫ-da-ma ṭup-pá-am da-na-am le-qé-a-nim ki-ma KÙ.BABBAR 1 GÍN lá i-ru-qí-ni-ma a-ma-kam a-na a-ḫi-a <gap>-tim dí-na
target: My dear brothers and lords, take care and get hold of a strong tablet, so that not a single shekel of silver will elude me, and there give <gap> to my brothers <gap>

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 GÚ 58 ma-na a-wi-it šu-IŠTAR 24 ma-na 10 GÍN qá-dum ú-ku-ul-tim ú-ša-qí-il₅
target: 4 talents 58 minas (of tin) the declared value of Šu-Ištar('s shipment), 24 minas 10 shekels (of tin), including the fodder, I paid.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 6.5 GÍN iš-tù a-al kà-ni-ší-i a-di tí-mì-il₅-ki-a
target: 6.5 shekels (of tin) from the Town of the Kaneshites until Timilkiya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ù 2 GÍN AN.NA ig-re ANŠE iš-tù tí-mì-il₅-ki-a a-dí ḫu-ra-ma áš-qúl
target: 2 shekels of silver and 2 shekels of tin the hire of a donkey from Timilkiya until hurama I paid.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ù 4.5 GÍN AN.NA ig-re ANŠE ù sá-ri-dí-im iš-tù ḫu-ra-ma a-dí kà-ni-iš áš-qúl
target: 4.5 shekels of silver and 4.5 shekels of tin the hire of a donkey and a donkey-driver from hurama until Kanesh I paid.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ma a-nim a-šu-mì šu-IŠTAR ú-ša-qí-il₅
target: All this I paid for the sake of Šu-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-zu-ú iš-ta-aḫ-šu ú ni-wa-lá
target: to Azu, Ištahšu and Niwala

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na lá-ma-sà-tim ú ša-lim-ma qí-bi-ma um-ma um-mì-iš-ḫa-ra-ma
target: To Lamassutum and Šalimma, thus says Ummī-Išhara:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí-i na-áš-pé-er-tim ša ta-áš-pu-ri-ni um-ma a-tí-ma mì-šu-um ma-ma-an lá i-ṭa-ra-dam
target: As for the letter you sent me, in which you wrote: 'Why does he not send someone to me?'

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-pá-ar-šu i-li-kam-ma a-na-ku aṭ-ru-ud
target: a messenger of his did arrive, but it was me who sent him away.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí ma-lá ú ší-ni-šu aq-bi-šu-ma li-bu-šu i-ta-na-aṣ-ra-áp um-ma šu-ut-ma a-dí ma-lá ú ší-ni-šu na-áš-pé-er-tí i-li-ik-ší-im-ma a-lá-kam lá ta-mu-a
target: I talked to him several times, but every time he bursts out, saying: 'Several letters of mine went to her, but she refused to come here!'

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša a-ša-pá-ru-ší-ni-BA i-ṣé-er na-áš-pé-ra-tí-a iš-té-et ú ší-ta ša i-li-kà-ší-ni
target: Could what I write her (now) really surpass the messages that already reached her several times?

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-wi-lúm a-wa-tim i-ta-aḫ-dar um-ma šu-ut-ma iš-tù a-lá-kam lá ta-mu-ú lá ta-tù-ri-ma lá ta-qá-bi-im
target: The gentleman has become very annoyed by the matter and said: 'Because she refuses to come, you must not again speak to me!'

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma a-ḫa-tí a-tí a-wa-tim sà-ra-tim lá ta-áš-ta-na-pá-ri-im a-na KÙ.BABBAR mì-ma lá ta-ša-pá-ri-šu-um
target: If you are my sister, do not keep writing me things that are not true and certainly do not write him for silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-šu-mì KÙ.BABBAR aq-bi-šu-ma um-ma šu-ut-ma ma-lá-ma-a KÙ.BABBAR 0.5 ma-na gám-ri-ša gi₅-mì-lam₅ i-ṣé-er um-mì-ša ú-ul a-ḫi-ša lá-áš-ku-un
target: I talked to him because of the silver and he said: 'Should I really oblige her mother or her brothers for no less than half a mina of silver for her expenses?'

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú-ul i-na ba-áb-tí-a KÙ.BABBAR 10 GÍN lá i-ba-ší ú šu-ma i-na ba-áb-tí-a lá-šu KÙ.BABBAR 10 GÍN ma-lá gám-ri
target: Are there no ten shekels of silver available from my outstanding claims? And if they are not let her ask ten shekels of silver for her expenses from her mother or her brothers, which I promise to pay back here if only she leaves for here'.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na e-na-aḫ-DINGIR
target: 3 shekels of silver for Enah-ilī;

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-bé-lúm-ma a-na a-la-ḫi-im qí-bi₄-ma
target: From Šu-Bēlum to Ali-ahum:

source: translate Akkadian to English: ma-la i-na kà-ni-iš ú-na-ḫi-du-kà-ni um-ma a-na-ku-ma a-lik-ma i-na a-lim{ki} a-ḫa-tí ap-lam lu tal-qé-a-am
target: As I instructed you in Kanesh when I said: Go and (see to it that) my sister acquires an heir for me in the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù i na-áš-pé-er-tí-a iš-tí a-ḫa-tí-a ku-a-tí ù na-bi-ZU al-pu-ut-ku-nu
target: so I wrote in my missive to you and Nabi-Suen together with my sister.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫi a-ta šu-ma a-ḫa-tí-a i-na a-lim{ki} ap-lam tal-qé-a-am tí-ir-ta-kà za-ku-tum iš-tí a-zu-ú wa-bi-il₅ ṭup-pí-im li-li-kam-ma li-bi li-iḫ-du
target: My dear brother, if my sister has acquired an heir in the City, then let an exhaustive report come here with Azu, the one who brings (this) letter, so I shall be happy.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-šur ù {d}IM i-li-a-bi-ni lá-ak-ru-ba-kum
target: I shall pray for you to Aššur and Adad, the gods of our father.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma i-na-sú-in-ma a-na a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi-ma
target: From Enna-Suen to Ali-ahum:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.3333 GÍN 10 5 ŠE KÙ.KI ša áb-ni-šu i li-bé-e da-da-a i-na kà-ni-iš i-ša-qal
target: 1.3333 shekel 15 grains of gold dust, owed by Dadaya; he is to pay in Kanesh.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI {d}IM-ba-ni IGI a-mur-IŠTAR ni-a-im
target: Witnessed by Adad-bāni, by our own Amur-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.KI a-ma-kam li-iš-qú-lá-ku-ma a-dí a-lá-kà-ni li-ib-ší
target: Have him pay the gold there to you and let it remain there until I come.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma i tí-ki-ir-kà a-na da-ni-tim pí-kà dí-šu-um
target: If he contests it with you, then give him a harsh talking-to.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.3333 ma-na 6 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i pá-ni-tim ḫa-ta-a-ni ù e-wa-ri-mu-ša ub-lu-nim
target: Hatāni and Ewarimuša brought previously 1.3333 mina 6 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫa-ma 1 ma-na 19 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i ša-ni-tim šé-pí-šu-nu
target: Further, 1 mina 19 shekels of silver in their second transport.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ší-im sú-ub-ri-im pá-ni-tim ù wa-ar-ki-ú-tim ša ir-dí-ú-ni-ni i-dí-nu-nim
target: They gave 1 mina of silver, the price of the first slave and the earlier ones which they conducted here.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ.BA 5.25 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR iš-tí nu-ki-ri-bi-im a-ḫu-a-šu
target: Thereof: 5 1/4 shekels of silver owed by the gardener Ahuašu.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ú 15 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṣí-ba-sú a-na a-šur-ma-lik áš-qúl
target: 1.5 mina of silver and 15 shekels of interest I paid to Aššur-malik.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.8333 ma-na a-na kà-tù-ú áš-qúl
target: I paid 0.8333 mina to Katu.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.3333 ma-na 5 GÍN a-na eb-lá-i-im áš-qúl
target: I paid 0.3333 mina 5 shekels to the man from Ebla.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ma a-nim a-šu-mì a-mur-{d}UTU áš-qúl
target: I paid all this in the name of Amur-Šamaš.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫa-ma 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR i-ší-im sú-ub-ri-im pá-tim ki-ma i-a-tí i-tur₄-DINGIR il₅-qé
target: Further, Itūr-ilī took on my behalf 1 mina of silver from the price of the first slave.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša-lim-a-šùr iṣ-ba-at-ni-a-tí-ma um-ma šu-ut-ma a-na šu-be-lim ù en-na-sú-in-ma KÙ.BABBAR 1 GÚ ù 2 GÚ a-na ḫu-bu-ul a-bi₄-ku-nu i-na na-ru-qí-a ú-ša-qí-il₅
target: Šalim-Aššur seized us and said to Šu-Bēlum and Enna-Suen: I have paid some 1 or 2 talents of silver for your father's debt out of my joint-stock capital.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ba-a-nim ṭup-pè-e ša ḫu-bu-ul a-bi₄-ku-nu am-ra-ma KÙ.BABBAR-pì šu-uq-lá-nim
target: Come on, look at the tablets concerning your father's debt and pay me my silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-nu-ma ṭup-pu me-eḫ-ru ša a-bi₄-ni i-na ku-nu-uk šu-{d}EN.LÍL a-mur-IŠTAR ù šu-a-nim kà-an-ku-ma i-na a-lim{ki} i-ba-ší-ú
target: They said: "Our father's tablets and copies were sealed with the seals of Šu-Illil, Amur-Ištar and Šu-Anum, and they are in the City."

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma-ba i li-bi₄ a-bi₄-ni ta-áb-tù-ra-am ša-al-ma-am i-na a-lim{ki} lá-qá-am lá ta-mu-a
target: If indeed you can establish anything as owed by our father, will you refuse to take it complete in the City?

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ša-lim-a-šùr-ma a-na šu-be-lim-ma KÙ.BABBAR ša eq-lim a-na-ku pá-ḫu-ra-am qá-bi₄-a-ku
target: Šalim-Aššur answered Šu-Bēlum: "I have personally promised to collect the silver that is in Anatolia."

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-šu-um iš-tí DUMU da-da KÙ.BABBAR i-na ḫa-ḫi-im tal-qé
target: Why have you taken silver from Dada's son in hahhum?

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-be-lúm-ma ke-na al-qé
target: Šu-Bēlum answered: "Yes, I took it."

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù en-na-sú-in iš-al-ma um-ma šu-ut-ma mì-šu-um i tí-me-el-ki-a KÙ.BABBAR tal-qé
target: So he asked Enna-Suen, saying: "Why have you taken silver in Timel-kiya?"

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-ut-ma šu-ma al-qé a-dá-gal-šu lá i-ba-ší
target: He answered: "I shall look whether I took any, but there is nothing."

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um kà-ni-iš i-dí-ni-a-tí-ma ší-bu-tí-ni IGI GÍR ša a-šùr ni-dí-in
target: The Kanesh colony gave us for these proceedings and we gave our testimony before Aššur's dagger.

source: translate Akkadian to English: dan-a-šùr sí-ki e-na-sú-in DUMU i-dí-a-bi₄-im ú-kà-al-ma a-na ḫa-nu DUMU i-tur₄-DINGIR a-na qá-ta-tim i-dí-šu
target: Dan-Aššur detains Enna-Suen son of Iddin-abum and he gave him to hanu son of Itūr-ilī as guarantor.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma dan-a-šùr-ma a-wi-lam tù-ta-ra-am
target: Dan-Aššur said: You will return the man.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma a-wi-lam lá tù-ta-e-ra-am a-na 12 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ù ṣí-ba-tí-šu ša ṭup-pì-im ḫa-ar-mì-im ša ḫu-bu-ul a-bi-šu ta-za-za-am
target: If you have not returned the man you will be responsible for 12 minas of silver and its interest in accordance with the certified tablet concerning his father's debt.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma e-na-sú-in-ma ša a-na ma-nim ḫa-bu-lu
target: Enna-Suen said: For his debt to whom?

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma dan-a-šùr-ma lu a-na a-bi-a lu a-na DAM.GÀR-ri-im ḫa-bu-ul
target: Dan-Aššur said: He is indebted either to my father or anonymously.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù šu-ma ṭup-pá-am ša ša-ba-e tí-šu bi-lam-ma ṭup-pá-am du-uk
target: But if you have a quittance, then bring it and invalidate the tablet.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um kà-ni-ìš i-dí-ni-a-tí-ma ší-bu-tí-ni IGI GÍR ša a-šùr ni-dí-in
target: The Kanesh colony gave us for these proceedings and we gave our testimony before Aššur's dagger.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI na-zi IGI PUZUR₄-a-na IGI aḫ-ša-lim
target: Witnessed by Nazi, by Puzur-Anna, by Ah-šalim.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i-ṣé-er en-um-a-šur lu-zi-i i-šu
target: Ennam-Aššur owes 5 shekels of silver to Luzi.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 TÚG ku-ta-na-am a-na ša-na-at iš-tù a-lim{ki} ša 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ú-šé-lá-am
target: He will bring one textile worth 5 shekels of silver up here from the City within one year.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma a-dí ša-na-at ku-ta-na-am iš-tù a-lim{ki} ú-lá uš-té-li-am 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na-kam i-ša-qal
target: If he has not brought a textile up here from the City in one year, he must pay 10 shekels of silver here.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ITU.KAM té-i-na-tim li-mu-um e-lá-lí sà-an-gu₅-um IGI a-ta-ta IGI lá-qé-ep
target: Month Tē'inātum, eponymy Elāli, the high priest. Witnessed by Atata, by Lā-qēp.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.6666 GÍN ša da-at 5 ni-a-tí
target: 1.6666 shekel for the road-tax of the five of us.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.3333 GÍN a-na NINDA i-na ta-wi-ni-a
target: 0.3333 shekel for bread in Tawiniya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 ma-na URUDU i-na pá-ṭí ša tí-iš-mur-na ik-lu-ú-ni-ma a-dí-in
target: I gave 2 minas of copper in the territory of Tišmurna where they held (us) back.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.3333 GÍN 15 ŠE KÙ.BABBAR ša 1 UDU ša a-na mu-ṣí ni-il₅-qé-ú a-na lá-dí-a áš-qúl
target: 5 / 12 shekel of silver for one sheep that we acquired for the -official I paid to Ladiya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na URUDU SIG₅ 10 GÍN AN.NA a qá-tí ṣú-ḫa-ri-ša
target: 1 mina of refined silver (and) 10 shekels of tin into the hands of her servant.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR sà-ḫe-er-tám a-dí-šu-nu-tí
target: For a value of 1 shekel of silver I gave them sundries.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na Ì.GIŠ 0.3333 GÍN ú-ku-ul-tí ANŠE
target: 1 shekel of silver for oil 0.3333 shekel fodder for the donkey.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na i-dí-sú-en DUMU en-na-ni-im a-dí-in
target: 10 shekels of silver I gave to Iddin-Suen, son of Ennānum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 me-at 7 ma-na URUDU ší-kam ša i-ṣé-er i-tur₄-DINGIR ù e-lá-li DUMU me-er-e PUZUR₄-a-na šál-ma-a-šur i-šu-ú
target: 207 minas of šikku-copper that Itūr-ili and Elāli sons of Puzur-Anna owe to Šalim-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: URUDU ki-ma šál-ma-a-šur en-um-a-šur me-ra-šu il₅-qé
target: On behalf of Šalim-Aššur his son Ennam-Aššur has received the copper.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-um ša 2 me-at 7 ma-na URUDU ša e-li-a-ni sà-ar IGI šu-bé-lim DUMU šu-IŠTAR IGI a-šur-re-ṣí DUMU LUGAL-sú-in IGI zu-ku-a DUMU a-šur-i-dí
target: Any tablet concerning 207 minas of copper which may turn up is invalid.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI šu-bé-lim DUMU šu-IŠTAR IGI a-šur-re-ṣí DUMU LUGAL-sú-in IGI zu-ku-a DUMU a-šur-i-dí
target: Witnessed by Šu-Bēlum son of Šu-Ištar, by Aššur-rēṣī son of Šar-Suen, by Zukuwa son of Aššur-idī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-šur-UTU-ši-ma a-na en-nam-a-šur qí-bi-ma
target: From Aššur-šamšī to Ennam-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ma-lá ú ší-ni-šu áš-pu-ra-kum um-ma a-na-ku-ma ṭup-pá-am ša a-šur-re-ṣí šé-bi-lá-am
target: Once or twice I wrote to you, saying: Send me Aššur-rēṣī's tablet.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ta tí-ir-ta-kà-ma lá i-lá-kam
target: But as for you - you do not send me word.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ma-lá-ma KÙ.BABBAR 10 GÍN ba-áš-tám ú-lá ar-ta-áš-a-kum
target: Have I not acquired dignity for you worth just 10 shekels of silver,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù gi₅-mì-lá-kà ta-ú-ra-am ú-lá al-té-e
target: and have I not been able to return your favours?

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-šur ù i-lu-ú e-ba-ru-tim li-ṭù-lá
target: May Aššur and the gods of friendship be my witnesses:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na KÙ.BABBAR a-mì-im ša KÙ.BABBAR 5 ma-na a-wa-at-kà ša-ma-a-am lu a-le-e
target: For that silver, for at least 5 minas of silver I was able to listen to your words

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù gi₅-im-mì-lá-kà ta-ú-ra-am <gap>
target: and I was able to return your favours!

source: translate Akkadian to English: ki-ma ṭup-pí <gap> a-nim ta-ša-me-ú ṭup-pá-am <gap> ša ṣú-ḫa-ri-im a-na DUMU lá-li-im dí-in-ma lu-ub-lam
target: When you hear this letter, the tablet of the servant give it to Lalūm's son so he may bring it.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-wi-lu-tum-ma
target: That is indeed gentlemanly behavior.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ku-ku-a en-na-sú-in ù ú-ṣú-ur-ša-a-šur qí-bí-ma um-ma šu-IŠTAR-ma
target: Say to Kukua, Ennam-Suen and Uṣur-ša-Aššur, thus Šu-Ištar:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-kam a-am-tám sà-ni-qá-ma i-na ú-zi-ni-im e té-pu-uš-ma nu-a-am e ta-al-pu-ut
target: Keep the maid there under control and let her not operate in Uzinum and not affect the native Anatolian.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ni-ša-am ta-áš-pu-ra-am um-ma ší-it-ma šu-up-ra-ma ší-me-a ma-ma-an li-il₅-qé
target: She wrote me here as follows: 'Send (somebody) to collect the price due to me'.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫu-a-tù-nu a-ma-kam am-tám sà-ni-qá-ma ú sí-li-a-ší-ma um-ma a-tù-nu-ma a-na ṣé-er be-li-ki-i i-ra-de₈-ú-ki lu sà-ḫe-er-tí-ki lu KÙ.BABBAR 1 GÍN tí-šu-i pá-ḫi-ri-ma KI a-li-ki-im pá-ni-ma a-na ṣé-er be-li-ki-i ta-li-ki
target: May dear colleagues, keep the maid there under control and cheat her by telling her: 'One will conduct you to your lord. Collect your small goods and any silver you have and then you will go to your lord with the first caravan!'

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-ma tù-pá-ḫu-ru-ni ṣú-ba-sà-a ù ša qá-qí-dí-ša-a eṭ-ra-ma a-na ta-al-ḫa-tí-i-im dí-na-ší
target: And as soon as she is gathering her belongings deprive her of her garment and her head-dress and sell her to somebody from Talhat.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na DUMU a-šùr ù DUMU kà-né-eš lá ta-dá-ší ḫa-li-qá-áš ù ma-at kà-né-eš lá i-na-mar
target: Do not sell her to an Assyrian or to a citizen of Kanesh. Get rid of her and she shall never (again) be seen in the land of Kanesh!

source: translate Akkadian to English: 15 ma-na URUDU ma-sí-um i li-bi a-šur-kà-ší-id DUMU ik-ra-a
target: 15 minas of washed copper is owed by Aššur-kāšid son of Ikraya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ma a-nim a-šu-ú-ma-an ù ki-kà-ar-ša-an i-ra-dí-ú-ni-ku-nu-tí
target: Ašu-uman and Kikaršan lead all this to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 ma-na áb-na-am ú-ba-am i ku-nu-ki-a na-áš-ú
target: They carry a weight-stone of 10 minas under my seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma lá ak-ta-áš-dam SÍG.ḪI.A ša-li-im-tám lu-sà-ni-qú-ni-ku-nu-tí
target: If I have not reached it, they shall check the safe wool for you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na PUZUR₄-a-šur qí-bi-ma um-ma a-ni-i-a-ni-ma <gap> ma-na 13 GÍN ni-ga-li DU₁₀-ṣí-lá-a-šur i-dí-nam
target: To Puzur-Aššur from Ani-ani: Ṭāb-ṣill-Aššur gave me <gap> mina 13 shekels of sickels.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ.BA 0.5 ma-na 0.6666 GÍN a-na a-ki-a ni-dí-in
target: Of that we gave 0.5 mina 0.6666 shekels to Akiya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na KÙ.BABBAR ša tù-šé-bi-la-ni 1.25 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR al-qé
target: Of the silver you sent I took 1 1 / 4 shekels.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2.75 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR DU₁₀-ṣí-lá-a-šur na-áš-a-ku-um
target: Ṭāb-ṣill-Aššur brings you 2 3 / 4 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma be-li a-ta iš-tí a-li-ki-im pá-ni-i-ma sà-ḫe-er-tám šé-bi-lam
target: If you are indeed my lord, send me small goods with the first transport.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 me-at 6.5 ma-na URUDU ša en-um-a-šùr i li-bi₄ kà-ri-im ší-im URUDU a-nim
target: 106 ½ minas of copper belonging to Ennam-Aššur is owed by the colony.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na KÙ.BABBAR ša wa-bar-tim ša ša-lá-tù-ar ki-ma en-um-a-šùr ku-da-tum i-lá-qé
target: Kudātum will receive the price of this copper in silver from the station at Šalatuwar on behalf of Ennam-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma i-ku-pì-a-ma a-na en-um-a-šur la-qé-pì-im i-dí-a-bi₄-im ù {d}IM-pí-lá-aḫ qí-bi₄-ma
target: From Ikūn-pīya to Ennam-Aššur, Lā-qēpum, Iddin-abum and Adad-pilah:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am en-um-a-šur ub-la-ku-nu-tí
target: Ennam Aššur has brought you 10 minas of refined silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša 2 ma-na <gap> KÙ.BABBAR AN.NA SIG₅ ša-ma-nim-ma a-ḫa-ma ku-un-kà-ni-šu
target: Buy good tin for 2 minas of silver and seal that seperately.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša ší-tí KÙ.BABBAR ší-ma-am ša ba-lá-ṭí-a ša-ma-nim a-na en-um-a-šur qí-bi₄-ma
target: For the rest of the silver make a profitable purchase for me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 40 ma-na AN.NA SIG₅ i li-bi₄-kà a-ḫi a-ta AN.NA dá-mì-iq-ma iš-tí a-li-ki-im pá-ni-e-ma šé-bi₄-la-nim
target: To Ennam-Aššur: you owe 40 minas of good tin. My dear brother, send me the tin with the first transport as a favour to me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫu-a a-tù-nu iḫ-da-ma ṣú-ḫa-ri lá i-sà-ḫu-ur
target: My dear brothers, take care that my servant is not delayed.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.3333 ma-na 3 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am sú-sà-a DUMU šu-ki-tim ḫa-bu-lam ITU.KAM ša ke-na-tim a-30 u₄-me i-ša-qal li-mu-um bu-zu-ta-a
target: Susaya son of Šukkutum owes me 0.3333 mina 3 shekels of refined silver; from the month Ša-kēnātim he is to pay in 30 days; eponymy Buzutaya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ṣí-ib-tim i-lá-ak-šu-um
target: It draws interest from him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pá-am ša ší-bi₄-a ša ba-áb DINGIR ú-kà-al
target: I hold the tablet with my witnesses from the Gate of the God.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ú ṣí-ba-sú ša-áš-qí-lá-šu
target: Make him pay the silver and its interest.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma mì-ma KÙ.BABBAR ù ṣí-ba-sú li-dí-na-ku-nu-tí-ma da-na-sú li-iq-bi₄-a-ku-nu-tí
target: If there is any silver and its interest then let him give it to you, even though he may raise objections to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma lá i-ta-aḫ-ba-lam ṭup-pè-a pè-té-a-ma ta-aḫ-sí-sà-tim ša šu-mì i-ri-ší-im lá-áp-tù šé
target: If he (pretends that he) has not become indebted to me, then open my tablets and send me the memoranda written in the name of Erišum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ni-qí-i-šu ša a-šùr-ma-lik DUMU a-lá-ḫi-im a-dí-in
target: I gave 2 shekels of silver for the sacrifices of Aššur-malik son of Ali-ahum;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.8333 ma-na 3.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-šùr-na-da DUMU er-nu-id
target: 1 mina 56.5 shekels of silver (with) Aššur-nādā, son of Ernu''id;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na 3.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR bé-ú-lá-at a-šùr-i-mì-tí DUMU ḫa-la-bi-im
target: 33.5 shekels of silver, working capital of Aššur-imittī, son of hali-abum;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.3333 ma-na 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR bé-ú-lá-at gal-da-a
target: 25 shekels of silver, working capital of Galdaya;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR KI gal-da-a iš-tù ITU.1.KAM ṣí-ip-im 1.5 GÍN.TA i-na ITU.1.KAM ú-ṣa-áb li-mu-um a-bi-a DUMU šu-da-gán
target: 1 mina of silver with Galdaya, from month VII he will add (as interest) 1.5 shekel per month, eponymy of Abiya son of Šu-Dagan;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.8333 ma-na 0.6666 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR KI i-dí-a-šùr ša na-aḫ-ri-a 1.5 GÍN.TA a-na 1 ma-na-im ú-ṣa-áb
target: 50.6666 shekels of silver due from Iddin-Aššur of Nahriya; he will add 1.5 shekel per mina (as interest);

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.8333 ma-na 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR KI bur-sú-in
target: 55 shekels of silver with Būr-Suen;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 48 ma-na URUDU KI ḫa-ab-tù-ni-ìš
target: 48 minas of copper with habtuniš;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na 15 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša-lim-a-šur DUMU up-ḫa-qí-im
target: 1 mina 15 shekels (with) Šalim-Aššur, son of Uphāqum;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 GÚ 13 ma-na URUDU KI DINGIR-ba-ni DUMU ib-ni-lí
target: 2 talents 13 minas of copper with Ilī-bāni, son of Ibni-ilī;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.8333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR KI a-šùr-ba-ni DUMU su-ku-ku
target: 0.8333 mina of silver with Aššur-bāni, son of Sukkuku;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 8.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR KI šu-li DUMU i-li-li iš-tù ITU.1.KAM na-ar-ma-ak-a-šur 1.5 GÍN.TA a-na 1 ma-na-im ú-ṣa-áb li-mu-um šu-IŠTAR kà-áb-kà-ba-nu-um
target: 8.5 minas of silver with Šuli, son of Ellil-ilī, from month II / III he will add 1.5 shekel per mina, eponymy of Šu-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.3333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR KI a-šùr-du-ri
target: 1.3333 mina of silver with Aššur-dūrī;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 GÚ URUDU KI i-dí-MAR.TU DUMU šu-ḫi-nim
target: 5 talents of copper with Iddin-Amurrum, son of Šuhanum;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR KI DINGIR-šu-GAL DUMU bu-lá-li
target: 1 mina of silver with Ilšu-rabi, son of Bulāli;

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ša-lim-a-šur qí-bi-ma um-ma en-nam-a-šur-ma
target: To Šalim-Aššur from Ennam-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša ki-ma ku-a-tí a-na É-tí-kà e-ru-bu-ma ṭup-pí-kà ip-té-ú-ma ṭup-pá-am ša ḫu-bu-ul ú-ṣú-ur-ša-a-šur ù a-šùr-DU₁₀ ú-šé-li-ú-ma a-na a-bu-a ni-ip-qí-du
target: Your representatives entered your house, opened for your tablets and took out the tablet concerning the debt of Uṣur-ša-Aššur and Aššur-ṭāb and we entrusted it to Abuwa.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma me-ḫe-er-šu PUZUR₄-tí-a-am-tim a-šur-i-mì-tí DUMU a-ta-a-a ú-ṣú-ur-ša-a-šur <gap> a-bu-a ú ší <gap>-ir a-šùr-DU₁₀ DUMU sá-da-a <gap>-ḫa-am áš-ta-na-pá-ar-ma a-lá-kam ú-lá i-mu-a
target: Now, (listen to) its copy: Puzur-Ti'amtum, Aššur-imittī son of Ataya and Uṣur-ša-Aššur <gap>Abuwa <gap> I keep writing Aššur-ṭāb son of Sadaya <gap> but he will not come.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí a-e-im u₄-mì-im tí-dí-a-tù-šu <gap> ù a-na qá-ba-im IGI ša ki-ma ku-a-tí ú-lá iš-ḫu-ut
target: For how long <gap> and he was not afraid to speak before your representatives.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-nam ma-da-tim lu-lá-pí-ta-kum iš-tù ma-ar-ṣa-am li-bi-im ú a-ší-ra-am ú-lá ni-ir-ta-ší
target: Why should I write at length to you, that we are unhappy and have no one to care for us?

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-bi a-ta tí-ir-ta-kà za-ku-tum a-ṣé-er ša ki-ma ku-a-tí ù a-ṣé-ri-a šu-up-ra-am
target: My dear father, send a final report to your representatives and to me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a ma-lá tí-ir-tí-kà le-pu-uš ú ra-mì-ni lu-za-ki-ma lá-li-kam-ma iš-tí-kà a-ma-kam lá-az-ku
target: I shall do what you order, and I shall clear myself and come so I can clear it with you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 ma-na 3 GÍN <gap> ḫu-sà-ri-im ša KÙ.BABBAR <gap> ša en-na-num ú ku <gap> ša-du-at KÙ.BABBAR <gap>
target: 4 minas 3 shekels <gap> lapis lazuli <gap> of Ennānum and <gap> the transport tariff for the silver <gap>

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-šur-ni-iw-ri a-la-ḫi-im {d}UTU-ba-ni ù nu-ur-IŠTAR qí-bi₄-ma um-ma PUZUR₄-a-na-ma
target: To Aššur-nimrī, Ali-ahum, Šamaš-bāni and Nūr-Ištar from Puzur-Anna.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na {d}UTU-ba-ni qí-bi₄-ma a-ṣé-er ta-aḫ-sí-is-tí-kà 6 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša wa-ar-kà-tám tù-ṣa-ni ú-ra-dí-ú-ni-kum
target: Specifically to Šamaš-bāni: In addition to (what was in) your memo - they added 6 shekels of silver for you from after you left.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 13 ma-na AN.NA ku-nu-ki-kà ù ku-nu-uk PUZUR₄-a-šur ša té-zi-ba-ni
target: 13 minas of tin under your seal and the seal of Puzur-Aššur that you left me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI da-ak-ni-bi₄-im IGI en-na-sú-in IGI i-dí-a-šur DUMU ku-zi-la-nim
target: Witnessed by Taqin-abum, by Enna-Suen, by Iddin-Aššur son of Kuzilānum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: e-<gap> bi-il₅-tí-kà a-na PUZUR₄-a-šur DUMU ì-lí-a as-ni-iq-šu-ma 13.6666 ma-na-šu 6.8333 ma-na.TA a-na-ku a šu-mì-kà áš-qú-ul
target: I checked your <gap> for Puzur-Aššur son of Iliya, and I personally paid his 13.6666 minas at 6.8333 minas each for you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠU.NÍGIN 19.5 ma-na AN.NA i-ší-qí-il₅
target: In all, 19.5 minas of tin were paid.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 ma-na-um áb-num ša ú-ša-qí-lu 0.3333 ma-na ra-bi₄-at
target: The 10 mina weighing stone by which he weighed was 0.3333 mina too large.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na ir-ni-tim šu-uq-la-tim ša um-me-a-ni-a a-na pá-ṭù-ri-im i-zi-iz
target: He is ready to open the packages of my investors <gap>.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí AN.NA ma-sí-ra-am ú-ša-áš-qí-li-ni a-ḫi a-ta 7 GÍN.TA KÙ.BABBAR a-na AN.NA-ki-a a-na ša ki-ma i-a-tí šu-qú-ul
target: Until he has made me pay the -tin, my dear brother, pay 7 shekels of silver per (mina) for my tin to my representatives.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu gi₅-mì-lu-um i-a-tí ki-ma ag-mì-lu-kà-ni-ma ḫa-ra-nam a-dí-na-ku-um
target: May it be a favour for me since I have done you a favour and I have arranged a caravan for you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ša ki-ma i-a-tí en-nam-a-šur ù a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi-ma um-ma ša-lim-a-šur
target: To my representatives, Ennam-Aššur and Ali-ahum from Šalim-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na té-ga-ra-ma wa-áš-ba-ku
target: I am staying in Tegarama.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí ú-nu-tám ú-ša-lu-ḫu a-pu-tum a-dí a-lá-ki-a
target: Before I take away my goods - urgent! - before I arrive,

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR 1 ma-na pá-ḫi-ra-ma i-na É-tí-a li-ib-ší
target: collect every mina of silver and let it be in my house.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR mì-ma a-na a-lim{ki} lá tù-šé-bi₄-lá
target: Do not send any silver to the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na {d}UTU-ši <gap> ṭup-pí ta-ša-me-a-ni
target: On the day you hear my letter

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-lá-ḫu-um lu a-na ḫu-ra-ma lu a-na ku-ša-ra a-na ṣé-ri-a li-li-kam
target: Ali-ahum should come to meet me either in hurama or in Kuššara,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù KÙ.BABBAR 1 ma-na a-na qá-tí-a lu-ub-lam
target: and he should bring every mina of silver that is at my disposal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: TÚG.ḪI.A ša a-lá-ḫu-um i-na pá-zu-ur-tim ú-šé-tí-qá-ni i-na ku-nu-ki-šu-nu li-ib-ší-ú
target: The textiles that Ali-ahum transported from the smuggling must remain under seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 TÚG a-na 0.3333 ma-na 1 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na DUMU wa-al-ḫa-áš-na a-dí-in
target: I sold 1 textile for 0.3333 mina 1 shekel of silver to Walhašna's son.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-la-ḫi-im DUMU šál-ma-a-šur a-ni-na DUMU PUZUR₄-a-na ú a-šur-ma-lik DUMU a-lá-ḫi-im KIŠIB zu-ku-a
target: To Ali-ahum son of Šalim-Aššur, Annina son of Puzur-Anna and Aššur-malik son of Ali-ahum; seal of Zukuwa.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫu-ú-a a-tù-nu a-na a-wa-at ṭup-pí-im iḫ-da
target: My dear brothers, pay attention to the words of the letter!

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ku-ku-a ù šu-IŠTAR-ma a-na en-um-a-šùr qí-bi-ma
target: From Kukuwa and Šu-Ištar to Ennam-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ma-lá tí-ir-tí-kà ša ki-ma ku-a-tí i-na qá-tí 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a-mu-ra-am 0.8333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am a-na IŠTAR-lá-ma-sí ù ma-nu-ki-e-lí-a a-na ṣí-ib-tim i-dí-in
target: In accordance with your instructions your representative gave 1 mina of checked silver and ⅚ mina of refined silver to Ištar-lamassī and Mannum-kī-iliya against interest.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam 2 ma-na 4 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ku-ku-a iš-qú-ul-ma ku-nu-ki-šu a-na šu-IŠTAR ip-qí-id
target: Here Kukuwa paid 2 minas 4 shekels of silver and entrusted it to Šu-Ištar under his seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na kà-ni-iš ni-lá-ak-ma ṭup-pá-am ša ku-nu-ki-šu i-ma-ar-ma KÙ.BABBAR ù ṣí-ba-sú a-na ša ki-ma DAM.GÀR-ri-im i-ša-qú-lu-ma ṭup-pá-áš-nu nu-ša-ar
target: We shall go to Kanesh and he will see the tablet with his seal, they will pay the silver and its interest to the representatives of the merchant, and we shall release their tablet.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR a šu-mì-šu-nu-ma GAN-lam₅ i-tí-iq
target: The silver will then travel overland in their name.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.8333 ma-na 3 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-ḫa-ma ša ṭup-pì-šu ša-al-ṭim KÙ.BABBAR iš-qú-ul-ma ku-nu-ki-šu a-na šu-IŠTAR ip-qí-id
target: He further paid ⅚ mina 3 shekels of silver from his valid tablet, and entrusted it under his seal to Šu-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-ut-ma ša-áp-ra-tí-a ú-qá-ma a-na kà-ni-iš a-na ṣé-er ša ki-ma ku-a-tí li-li-kam ša-áp-ra-tí-šu ù ṭup-pì-šu lu-šé-ru-ú
target: He said: I am waiting for my surety, so let him go to Kanesh to your representatives, so they may release his surety and his tablet.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 15 GÚ SÍG.ḪI.A ù 7 ANŠE.ḪI.A ṣa-lá-mì 7 pá-li-lu a-ba-ba ša-lim-wa-ar-dí ù šé-ep-IŠTAR i-ra-dí-ú-ni-kum
target: Ababa, Šalim-wardī, and Šēp-Ištar lead 15 talents of wool, 7 black donkeys and 7 to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-kam lu-qú-ut-kà ša-lim-wa
target: Have Šalim-wardī credit your goods to you there.

source: translate Akkadian to English: <gap> 2 me-at 21 TÚG <gap> 14.5 ma-na 1 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR it-bu-lu
target: 221 textiles cost 14.5 minas 1 shekel of silver;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 ANŠE ṣa-lá-mu 1.8333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR it-bu-lu
target: 5 black donkeys cost 1.8333 mina of silver;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 12 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ú-nu-ut ANŠE.ḪI.A
target: 12 shekels of silver: harness for the donkeys;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 24 ma-na AN.NA a qá-tí lá-ta-a a-dí-in
target: 24 minas of tin I gave to Lataya for expenses;

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BI 1.6666 ma-na 5.6666 GÍN
target: its value in silver: 1.3333 mina 5.6666 shekels;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.6666 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a-na sà-ri-dim ù mì-šál sà-ri-dim bé-ú-lá-tim áš-qúl
target: I paid 0.6666 mina of silver for a packer and half a packer, working capitals;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR lu-bu-šu-nu
target: 3 shekels of silver: their clothes;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3.8333 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ú-kúl-tí ANŠE.ḪI.A
target: 3.8333 shekels of silver: fodder for the donkeys;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na li-mì-im ša šu-da-a ḫa-bu-lá-tí-ma áš-qúl
target: you owed 2 shekels of silver to the eponym Šudaya, and I paid it;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na a-ší-tí-kà
target: 2 shekels of silver for your wife;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 15 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša-du-a-tám sí-ḫa-ar-ì-lí il₅-qé
target: Sihar-ilī received 15 shekels of silver as transport tariff;

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-dì-in-ma ša-lim-a-šùr ù DUMU a-mur-IŠTAR
target: the colony rendered a verdict, and Šalim-Aššur and Amur-Ištar's son

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.8333 ma-na 3.5 GÍN ḫu-sà-ra-am a-na 2.6666 ma-na 0.5 GÍN i-tur₄-DINGIR a-na me-er-e ša-ak-ri-ú-ma-an i-dí
target: Itūr-ilī deposited ⅚ mina 3 ½ shekels of lapis lazuli worth 2 ⅔ minas ½ shekel with the sons of Šakri-uman.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na 2 ma-na 15 GÍN ḫu-sà-ra-am ša iš-tí šu-IŠTAR ú-šé-bi-lu ŠÀ.BA ší-im 0.5 ma-na 7.5 GÍN ḫu-sà-ri-im 1.5 ma-na 2 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ú-šé-bi-lam
target: Of the 2 minas 15 shekels of lapis lazuli that he sent with Šu-Ištar, thereof he sent 1 ½ mina 2 shekels of silver, the price of ½ mina 7 ½ shekels of lapis.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ku-nu-ki a-na da-šùr áš-lu-uṭ
target: The sealed silver I placed under Aššur's authority.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-tí ḫu-sà-ri-im i li-bi šu-IŠTAR a-ḫu-ur
target: The rest of the lapis lazuli remains in Šu-Ištar's possession.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na mì-ma KÙ.BABBAR-pí-<gap> NÍG.KA-sí ni-sí-ma
target: We made an accounting for all the silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù KÙ.BABBAR ša i li-bi-a i-šu-ú-ma ú-ša-bi-ú <gap> KÙ.BABBAR ku-nu-ki <gap> lu <gap> 9.6666 GÍN ḫu-sà-ru-um e-lá-num iš-tí en-num-a-šùr i-ba-ší
target: after I have paid in full the silver that I owe, the sealed silver, 9 ⅔ shekels of lapis lazuli, an extra, is in Ennam-Aššur's possession.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-šùr-ma-lik a-na ITU.3.KAM ṭup-pá-am ša ší-be-šu ù ṭup-pá-am <gap> ša wa-ba-ar-tim ú-ba-lam-ma iš-tí šu-be-lim e-ta-wu
target: Within three months Aššur-mālik shall bring the tablet of his witnesses and the tablet of the trading-station and discuss with Šu-Bēlum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma a-na ITU.3.KAM a-šùr-ma-lik ṭup-pá-am ša sí-be-šu ù ša wa-ba-ar-tim lá i-ta-áb-lam 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a-na šu-be-lim a-šùr-ma-lik i-ša-qal
target: If within three months Aššur-mālik does not bring the tablet of his witnesses and the one of the trading-station, Aššur-mālik will pay 0.5 mina of silver to Šu-Bēlum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù ḫa-mu-uš-tim ša bu-zu-ta-a ù a-šùr-i-mì-tí ITU.KAM té-i-na-tim li-mu-um {d}IŠKUR-ba-ni
target: Reckoned from the week-eponymy of Buzutaya and Aššur-imittī, month X, eponymy-year of Adad-bāni.

source: translate Akkadian to English: tù-ra-a en-na-sú-in ú mu-ti-a-šùr a-wi-lu a-ni-ú-tum da-a-nu
target: Tūraya, Ennam-Suen and Muti-Aššur, these men acted as judges.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pá-am ša <gap> GÍN <gap> ḫu-bu-li ša <gap>
target: Tablet concerning <gap> shekels <gap> the debt of <gap>

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pu-um ni-is-ḫa-sú DIRI ša-du-a-sú ša-bu a-na ḫu-bu-li-a ša É a-bi-a ú-bi₄-il₅
target: I brought 10 minas of refined silver, its import duty added, its transport tariff paid for, for my debt to my father's house.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫa-ma 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am <gap> ša a-lá-ḫi-im ša e-li-tí-šu ku-nu-ki-a a-na a-šùr-dan DUMU zu-ú NU.BÀNDA áp-qí-id
target: Further, I entrusted 1 mina of refined silver belonging to Ali-ahum from his caravan, under my seal to Aššur-dan son of Zu'u, the lieutenant.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI {d}MAR.TU-ba-ni DUMU ma-na-na IGI a-mur-{d}UTU DUMU mì-šu-GAL IGI ṣí-lu-lu DUMU ú-ku
target: Witnessed by Amurrum-bāni son of Manana, by Amur-Šamaš son of Mišu-rabi, by Ṣilulu son of Uku.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 TÚG ku-ta-nam a-na 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a šu-ma-li-ba-a-šùr
target: 1 kutānu-textile for 10 shekel of silver to Šumma-libbi-Aššur;

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma pá-ru-ur-tum-ma a-na i-dí-a-bi-im qí-bi-ma
target: From Parrurtum to Iddin-abum:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫa-at a-bi-kà me-ta-at
target: Your father's sister is dead.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-ḫu-ni-ma ap-lúm la-šu
target: Our brothers say: There is no heir.

source: translate Akkadian to English: É-bé-tám né-nu ni-tá-ru
target: Let us take away the house.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ki-ma ṭup-pá-am ta-áš-me-ú tí-ib-a-ma a-ta-al-kam
target: Set out and come here when you have heard the letter.

source: translate Akkadian to English: É a-bi-kà a-na kà-nu-nim ba-li-im iš-ta-ak-nu
target: They have turned your father's house into an extinguished fireplace.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-a-ar-tí-ma a-na en-na-sú-in qí-bi-ma
target: From Ayarti to Enna-Suen:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-šu-mì KÙ.GI iš-tí-ku-nu <gap> i-ḫi-id-ma
target: Pay attention to the gold in your possession so that you and Elāli send me good gold.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ta ú e-lá-lí KÙ.GI SIG₅ šé-bi-lá-nim
target: The man should not say: Do not send any gold!

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-we-lúm lá i-qá-bi um-ma šu-ut-ma KÙ.GI lá šé-bi-lá-ma
target: but do take care to send me good gold.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-ḫi-id-ma KÙ.GI SIG₅ šé-bi-lá-nim
target: Do not wait until you leave (yourself).

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-lá-ku-nu lá tù-qá-a
target: Do me a great favour!

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na 8 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am ša e-lá-lí DUMU IŠTAR-pì-lá-aḫ i-na ḫa-ḫi-im en-um-a-šur i-qí-pu-ma i-na ṭup-pì-šu DAM.GÀR lá-áp-tù a-šur-lá-ma-sí a-šùr-SIG₅ ù a-šur-be-el-a-wa-tim i-na ṭup-pì-šu na-lu-ni
target: Of the 8 minas of refined silver that Elalī, son of Ištar-pilah, in hahhum had given as trust to Ennam-Aššur, and (for which) in his tablet was written (belongs to) the tamkārum, (and) on which tablet Aššur-lamassī, Aššur-damiq and Aššur-bēl-awātim are present (as witnesses).

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na KÙ.BABBAR a-nim 2 ma-na 15 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ki-ma e-lá-ma i-na-aḫ-DINGIR il₅-qé ma KÙ.BABBAR a-na lá-ma-sà-tim i-dí-in
target: 2 minas 15 shekels of that silver Ēnah-ilī has collected in the name of Elamma and given to Lamassutum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ITU.KAM ma-ḫu-ur-DINGIR li-mu-um a-šur-i-mì-tí
target: Month IV, eponymy of Aššur-imittī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma a-na 2 ma-na 15 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ù ṣí-ba-tí-šu en-um-a-šur DUMU šu-be-lim um-mì-a-nu IŠTAR-pì-lá-aḫ ù me-er-ú IŠTAR-pì-lá-aḫ ma-ma-an a-na e-na-aḫ-DINGIR i-tù-a-ar
target: If for these 2 minas 15 shekels of silver and the interest on it Ennam-Aššur, son of Šu-Bēlum, the investors of Ištar-pilah or the sons of Ištar-Pilah, raise a claim against Ēnah-ilī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lá-ma-sà-tum DAM e-lá-ma en-um-a-šur pì-lá-aḫ-IŠTAR me-er-ú e-lá-ma a-šur-i-mì-tí DUMU a-šur-DU₁₀ ú-bu-bu-šu
target: Lamassutum, Elamma's wife, Ennam-Aššur (and) Pilah-Ištar, Elamma's sons, (and) Aššur-imittī, son of Aššur-ṭāb, will clear him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB IŠTAR-ba-ni DUMU ás-qú-dim
target: Seal of Ištar-bāni, son of Asqudum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na e-lá-ma qí-bi-ma um-ma a-ḫu-wa-qar-ma
target: Say to Elamma, thus Ahu-waqar:

source: translate Akkadian to English: ta-áš-pu-ra-am um-ma a-ta-ma ṭup-pu-um i-ḫu-lá-pí-im lá-wi pá-nu-šu KIŠIB a-lá-ḫi-im a-na ḫi-na-a ú e-lá-ma lá-pí-it
target: You wrote me as follows: '(There is) a tablet wrapped in a rag, on the face of which is written: 'Seal of Ali-ahum to hinnāya and Elamma'.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i li-bi₄ ṭup-pé ša a-šur-DU₁₀ né-mu-ur-ma lá-šu
target: We looked for it among the tablets of Aššur-ṭāb, but it is not there.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-šur-DU₁₀ ni-iš-tap-ra-am té-er-tù-šu li-tù-ra-am-ma a-šar ša-ak-nu nu-šé-ba-lá-ku-šu
target: We have now sent a letter to Aššur-ṭāb. When his message (telling) where it has been placed comes back we will send it to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-šu-mì am-tí-im ša a-šur-ta-ak-lá-ku ša ta-áš-pu-ra-ni dan-a-šur ni-iš-al-ma um-ma šu-ut-ma ší-im GÉME a-na-ku i ra-mì-ni-a áš-qúl
target: As for the slave-girl of Aššur-taklāku, about whom you wrote us, we asked Dān-Aššur and he said: 'It was me who paid the price of the slave-girl out of my own means.'

source: translate Akkadian to English: LUGAL-{d}IŠKUR a-na wa-aḫ-šu-ša-na i-lá-ak ší-be ú-ša-a-lá-ma za-ku-sà ni-ša-pá-ra-kum
target: Šarrum-Adad will go to Wahšušana, he will interrogate the witnesses and then we will send you definite information.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 37 ku-ta-nu qá-du-um ta-ad-mì-iq-tim ša šu-IŠTAR
target: 37 textiles, including (those) as free loan, belonging to Šu-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR
target: 3 shekels of silver (balanced).

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 TÚG a ší-mì-im
