source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI i-dí-{d}IM DUMU a-šùr-DU₁₀ IGI tù-ur-a-a DUMU me-na-a IGI kur-ub-a-šùr DUMU ṣí-li-a
target: Witnessed by Iddin-Adad son of Ašsur-ṭāb, by Tūraya son of Menaya, by Kurub-Aššur son of Ṣilliya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na i-ku-pí-a dan-a-šur ša-lim-ar-dí ù šu-nu-nu qí-bi-ma um-ma en-um-a-šur-ma
target: To Ikūn-pīya, Dan-Aššur, Šalim-wardī, and Šu-Nūnu from Ennam-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: tá-áš-pu-ra-nim um-ma a-tù-nu-ma 3 GÚ URUDU ma-sí-am i ší-im AN.NA-ki-kà ù ṣú-ba-tí-kà šu-nu-nu na-áš-a-kum
target: You wrote me and said: Šu-Nūnu brings you 3 talents of washed copper from the proceeds of your tin and textiles.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam ú-sà-ni-iq-šu-ma 2.6666 ma-na ù 2 GÚ URUDU ša li-bi dan-a-šur ša tù-šé-bi₄-lá-ni-ni
target: I checked it here and found 2.6666 minas, plus 2 talents of copper owed by Dan-Aššur which you sent.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-šu ḫa-ar-ma-am ša ḫu-bu-li-šu šu-nu-nu na-áš-a-ku-nu-tí
target: Šu-Nūnu brings you his certified tablet concerning his debt.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫu-a a-tù-nu a-ma-kam iḫ-da-ma ší-im ṣú-ba-tí-a ú AN.NA-ki-a pá-ni-im ša-lim-ar-dí ù šu-nu-nu lu-ba-li-ṭù-ni-ku-nu-tí-ma
target: My dear brothers, take care there to have Šalim-wardī and Šu-Nūnu credit you with the proceeds from my previous shipment of textiles and tin.

source: translate Akkadian to English: URUDU i-na ku-nu-ki-ku-nu ku-un-kà-ma KI a-li-ki pá-ni-e-ma šé-bi-lá-nim
target: Then seal the copper with your own seals, and send it to me as soon as possible.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù e-wa-ri-mu-ša ṭù-ur-da-nim
target: Also, send me Ewarimuša.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫu-a a-tù-nu gi-im-lá-ni-ma iḫ-da ú a-na-ku a-we-el gi-mì-LAM
target: My dear lords do me a favour, and take care, for I too am a man of favours.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 25 TÚG ku-ta-ni <gap> ma-na AN.NA 15 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR me <gap> a <gap> ir šu-nu-nu ú e-wa-ri-mu-ša <gap> i-ra-dí-a-ku-nu-tí
target: 25 -textiles, <gap> minas of tin, 15 shekels of silver <gap> Šu-Nūnu and Ewarimuša <gap> will lead to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-pu-tum e-ku-nu i-ṣé-er ṣú-ḫa-ri-a li-li-ik
target: Urgent, keep an eye on my servants.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ša-lim-ar-dí qí-bi₄-ma a-na-kam-ma ú-na-ḫi-id-kà um-ma a-na-ku-ma e-ma-ru ša šé-pì-ku
target: To Šalim-wardī: Even here I gave you instructions, saying: "Let the donkeys from your transport remain."

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù e-wa-ri-mu-ša ṭù-ur-da-nim
target: Why is it that you have sold them? And why is it that you sent Šu-Nūnu here?

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam-ma ú-na-ḫi-id-kà um-ma a-na-ku-ma e-ma-ru ša šé-pì-ku
target: There, as many of my textiles as you take, both of you must seal what you receive with your own seals.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB {d}IŠKUR-pí-la-aḫ DUMU a-ni-nim KIŠIB a-šur-lá-ma-sí DUMU la-qé-eb KIŠIB na-zi DUMU PUZUR₄-ba-ni-ni
target: Seal of Adad-pilah, son of Anīnum, seal of Aššur-lamassī, son of Lā-qēp, seal of Nazi, son of Puzur-banini.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am i-ṣé-er a-šur-lá-ma-sí DUMU la-qé-ep e-lá-ma i-šu
target: 3 minas of refined silver Aššur-lamassī, son of Lā-qēp, owes to Elamma.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù ḫa-muš-tim ša e-lá-ma ú zu-ba a-na 24 ḫa-am-ša-tim i-ša-qal
target: He will pay within 24 months from the week of Elamma and Zuba.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma i-na u₄-me-šu ma-al-ú-tim lá iš-qú-ul 1.5 GÍN.TA a-na 1 ma-na-im i-na ITU.KAM-im ṣí-ib-tám ú-ṣa-áb
target: If he does not pay when his term is up, he will add as interest 1.5 shekel per mina per month.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ITU.KAM be-el-tí-É.GAL-lim li-mu-um ša qá-té šu-ḫu-bu-ur
target: Month I, eponymy of the successor of Šu-hubur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 8 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR i-ṣé-er šu-li DUMU PUZUR₄-a-be-eḫ e-lá-ma i-šu
target: 8 minas of refined silver Šuli, son of Puzur-Abeh, owes to Elamma.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.5 GÍN.TA ṣí-ib-tám i-na ITU.KAM-im a-na 1 ma-na-im ú-ṣa-áb
target: He will add as interest 1.5 shekel per mina per month.

source: translate Akkadian to English: li-mu-um ša qá-té ba-zi-a DUMU šé-ep-a-lim
target: Eponymy of the successor of Baziya, son of Šēp-ālim.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB DINGIR-ba-ni DUMU ib-ni-lí KIŠIB a-šur-ma-lik DUMU PUZUR₄-a-šur KIŠIB i-dí-a-šur DUMU PUZUR₄-a-be-eḫ
target: Seal of Ilī-bāni, son of Ibni-ilī, seal of Aššur-mālik, son of Puzur-Aššur, seal of Iddin-Aššur, son of Puzur-Abeh!.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 GÚ 32 ma-na URUDU ḫa-bu-ra-ta-am i-ṣé-er i-dí-a-šur DUMU PUZUR₄-a-be-eḫ e-lá-ma i-šu
target: 4 talents 32 minas of copper from haburata Iddin-Aššur, son of Puzur-Abeh, owes to Elamma.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù ḫa-muš-tim ša a-šur-re-ṣí a-na 14 ḫa-am-ša-tim i-ša-qal
target: He will pay within 14 weeks from the week of Aššur-rēṣī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma lá iš-qúl ki-ma a-wa-at kà-ri-im ṣí-ib-t
target: If he does not pay he will add interest in conformity with the rule of the colony.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 20 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pu-um
target: 20 minas of refined silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù ḫa-mu-uš-tim ša kà-ší-im a-na 13 ḫa-am-ša-tim
target: Reckoned from the week of the he must pay within 13 weeks.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB pè-ru-a KIŠIB ša-ḫi-iš-nu-ma-an KIŠIB ba-ri-me-a
target: Seal of Peruwa, seal of Šahišnuman, seal of Barimea.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 15 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR
target: 15 shekels of silver

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma bé-li-a-ma a-na en-um-a-šur ù lá-qé-ep a-na lá-qé-ep qí-bi-ma
target: From Bēliya to Ennam-Aššur and Lā-qēp; specifically to Lā-qēp:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 8 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am ni-is-ḫa-sú DIRI ša-du-a-sú ša-bu KÙ.BABBAR ša DAM.GÀR ša a-na ší-a-ma-tim IGI DU₁₀-a-ḫi ù IGI lá-qé-ep DUMU MAN-ša-du-e a-dí-na-ku-ni
target: As to the 8 minas of refined silver - its import duty added, its transport tariff paid - silver belonging to a merchant, that I gave you for purchases with Ṭāb-ahi and Lā-qēp son of Puzur-šadūʾe as witnesses -

source: translate Akkadian to English: tám-kà-ru-um en-um-a-šur
target: the merchant is Ennam-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu-qú-tám ma-lá ta-áš-a-ma-šu-ni a-na en-um-a-šur DUMU ša-lim-a-šur dí-in-ma
target: Any goods you have bought for him you must give to Ennam-Aššur son of Šalim-Aššur,

source: translate Akkadian to English: tí-ir-ta-ku-nu le-zi-ba-am
target: and let him leave me a message from you (plural).

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB en-na-nim DUMU a-lá-bi₄-im KIŠIB a-šùr-na-da DUMU ir-nu-id KIŠIB kà-ta-tim DUMU ma-la-ba KIŠIB nu-ur-{d}EN.ZU DUMU {d}MUŠ-mu-ta-bíl
target: Sealed by Ennānum son of Ali-abum, by Aššur-nādā son of Irnuid, by Katātum son of Malaba, by Nūr-Suen son of Nirah-muttabbil.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša ša-lim-a-šùr ù i-dí-sú-in DUMU i-ba-a-a
target: Concerning Šalim-Ašsur and Iddin-Suen son of Ibaya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-at ṭup-pí-im a-ni-im ni-iš a-lim{ki} it-mu-ú-ni-ma
target: They swore by the City concerning the words of this tablet.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫu-um a-na a-ḫi-im la i-tù-ru
target: And no one must raise claim against the other.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ša-lim-a-šùr qí-bi-ma um-ma en-um-a-šùr-ma
target: To Šalim-Aššur from Ennam-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: ta-áš-pu-ra-am um-ma a-ta-ma KÙ.BABBAR ša iš-tù bu-ru-uš-ḫa-dim tù-šé-ṣí-a-ni i-na ku-nu-ki ša ki-ma i-a-tí-ma li-ni-dí
target: You have written, saying: The silver that you have brought out from Burušhaddum should be deposited under the seals of my representatives.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR i-na ku-nu-ki ša ki-ma ku-a-tí i-ba-ší
target: The silver is available under the seals of your representatives.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-šu-mì ba-a-ba-tí-kà ša ta-áš-pu-ra-ni a-na-kam ša ki-ma ku-a-tí i-na 10.5 GÚ URUDU ší-ki-im a-ḫa-ma 40 ma-na ḫa-bu-ra-ta-i-im 7 ANŠE.ḪI.A ṣa-lá-me ù 2 ṣú-ḫa-ri qá-at-kà i-na KÙ.BABBAR ša sá-li-a ù ì-lí-dan ḫa-bu-lu-ni ú-ša-áš-ki-nu-ma lu-qú-tám a-na sà-aḫ-ri-DINGIR ù en-um-a-šur DUMU šu-be-lim ip-qí-du
target: As to your outstanding loans, that you wrote about, here your representatives made you lay claim to the 10.5 talents of -copper, also 40 minas of (copper) from haburat, 8 black donkeys and 2 servants, i.e. the yield in silver that Salliya and Ilī-dan owed, and they have entrusted the goods to Sahri-ilī and Ennam-Aššur son of Šu-Bēlum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma lu-qú-tám sá-li-a i-na ma-aḫ-ri-kà lá iš-ta-kán ší-a-ma-at a-lim a-šùr sá-li-a a ša-lim-a-šùr i-da-an
target: If Salliya has not placed the goods before you, Salliya must give purchases in the City of Assur to Šalim-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam ì-lí-dan aṣ-ba-at-ma 2 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ú-ša-áš-qí-il₅-šu
target: Here I seized Ilī-dan and made him pay 2 minas of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša da-tí-a ni-il₅-qé
target: We received 2 minas of silver of my fees.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 ma-na 15 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR KI da-tí-kà ša tù-um-li-a-i-im <gap> a-na-kam i-re-ší ba-áb-tí-kà a-za-az
target: 2 minas 15 shekels of silver with your fees from the man of Tumliya<gap> Here I keep a close watch over your outstanding loans.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù sú-in-na-da i-na wa-aḫ-šu-ša-na wa-ša-áb e-ra-ba-
target: Also, Suen-nādā is staying in Wahšušana; when he enters here I shall make him pay the silver and its interest.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma i-dí-a-šùr-ma a-na a-lá-ḫi-im ḫa-nu-nu e-na-na-tim ù ki-ba-al qí-bi-ma
target: From Iddin-Aššur to Ali-ahum, hanunu, Ennanātum and Kibal:

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma AN.NA ša en-nam-{d}IM tù-ša-áš-qí-lá a-na KÙ.BABBAR ta-e-ra-ma
target: If you have had Ennam-Adad's tin paid, then convert it to silver,

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR a-na ki-ba-al dí-na-ma
target: give the silver to Kibal

source: translate Akkadian to English: a ma-lá tí-ir-tí-a le-pu-uš
target: and let him act in accordance with my instructions.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú tí-ir-ta-ku-nu KÙ.BABBAR ma-lá ta-dí-na-šu-ni li-li-kam
target: Also, send me word about how much silver you have given him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pì-a ú ḫu-ur-ša-am a-tù-nu-ma ku-un-kà
target: You have to seal for my tablets and the store-room.

source: translate Akkadian to English: e-na-na-ta-am na-ḫi-da-ma ba-lu-ku-nu ṭup-pè-e-a ma-ma-na lá i-pá-té
target: Give Ennanātum instructions that no one must open for my tablets without your permission.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ma-ma-an e is-li-ší
target: No one must deceive.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI ku-ra DUMU i-dí-a-šur
target: Witnessed by Kura son of Iddin-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI i-dí-a DUMU i-ku-nim
target: By Idiya son of Ikūnum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB lá-ba-na-da DUMU i-dí-sú-in
target: Seal of Labān-nādā, son of Iddin-Suen.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB na-áb-sú-en₆ DUMU šu-be-lim
target: Seal of Nabi-Suen, son of Šu-Bēlum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB i-dí-IŠTAR DUMU i-dí-a-bi₄-im
target: Seal of Iddin-Ištar, son of Iddin-abum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um dur₄-ḫu-mì-it i-dí-ni-a-tí-ma
target: For these words the Durhumit colony made us available.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI GÍR ša a-šùr ší-bu-tí-ni ni-dí-in
target: Before Aššur's dagger we gave our testimony.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-um a-šu-mì ku-uk-ra ša DUMU zu-za-nim
target: A record concerning Kukra of the son of Zuzānum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB en-um-a-šur DUMU šu-{d}EN.LÍL
target: Seal of Ennam-Aššur son of Šu-Illil.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB šu-IŠTAR DUMU šu-ki-tim
target: Seal of Šu-Ištar son of Šukkutum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-šur-ba-ni-ma a-na a-lá-ḫi-im ù lu-lu qí-bi-ma

source: translate Akkadian to English: <gap> 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ku-nu-ki-a ša <gap> ub-lá-ku-nu-tí-ni

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-<gap> ni-ší <gap> tí-ir-ta-kà ni-ša-me-ma
target: and we shall <gap>

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi₄-ma um-ma ḫa-nu-ma a-na-kam šu-{d}EN.LÍL ša-zu-úz-ta-kà ù a-na-ku ni-iṣ-ba-at
target: To Ali-ahum from hanu: Here your agent and I seized Šu-Illil.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 20 u₄-me-e a-na KÙ.BABBAR ša-qá-lim ni-iš-ku-un-šu-um u₄-mu-šu im-lu-ú-ma šu-ut-ma a-na ma-at ḫa-ra-bi₄-iš i-ta-lá-ak
target: We set a term of 20 days for him to pay the silver. His term is up, but he has gone to the land harabiš.

target: He said: Do not bother me for 10 days. When I return I shall pay you the silver.

target: Here we searched for the tablet concerning the debt of Šu-Illil, Ilī-dan's packer, but the tablet is not here.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-kam a-mur-ša-ra-sà ša-i-il₅-ma a-šar ṭup-pu-um i-ba-ší-ú tí-ir-ta-kà iš-tí pá-ni-im li-li-kam
target: Ask Amur-šarrassa there where the tablet is. Send word as soon as possible.

target: Buzutaya has received 14 minas of refined silver from the proceeds of Ušinalam's wool.

target: Witnessed by Aššur-imittī son of Dudiki, by Išme-ilum, by Aššur-bāni, by Enna-Suen, by Aššur-emūqi, by Ah-šalim his son.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB šu-IŠTAR DUMU šu-a-a
target: Seal of Šu-Ištar son of Šuaya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um kà-ni-iš i-dí-ni-ma
target: The Kanesh colony gave me for these proceedings.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI GÍR ša a-šur ší-bu-tí a-dí-in

source: translate Akkadian to English: DINGIR-ba-ni DUMU ú-zu-a tap-pá-i
target: Ilī-bāni son of Uzuwa was my absent partner.

target: Of the 20 textiles that Amur-Ištar left Kuziziya sold 5 textiles for 5 talents 50 minas of šikku-copper.

target: Of the 4 textiles belonging to Abī-Anum, Kuziziya sold 1 textile for 1 talent of šikku-copper.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 TÚG nu-ku-ra-ú

target: 2 minas of good copper to Sahar-ilī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 GÍN a-na PUZUR₄-a-šur DUMU šu-be-lim
target: 1 shekel to Puzur-Aššur son of Šu-Bēlum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 GÍN a-na a-lá-ḫi-im a-ḫu-kà
target: 2 shekels to Ali-ahum, your brother.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 GÍN a-na lá-dí-a-ma
target: 1 shekel to Ladiya as well.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 GÍN a-na en-um-a-šur DUMU šu-a-šur
target: 1 shekel to Ennam-Aššur son of Šu-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na pu-šu-ki-in
target: 10 shekels of silver to Pūšu-kēn;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.5 GÍN a-na me-er-ì-šu
target: 1 ½ shekel to his son.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.5 GÍN a-na en-nam-a-šur DUMU sú-kà-li-a
target: 1 ½ shekel to Ennam-Aššur son of Sukalliya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 GÍN a-na ili₅-ba-ni DUMU PUZUR₄-a-šur
target: 2 shekels to Ilī-bāni son of Puzur-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 GÍN a-na lá-qé-pì-im kà-ṣa-ar i-dí-sú-in
target: 2 shekels to Lā-qēp, Iddin-Suen's packer.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 GÍN a-na i-na-a
target: 2 shekels to Innaya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 GÍN a-na a-ni-nim
target: 3 shekels to Anninum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 GÍN a-na a-mur-DINGIR
target: 3 shekels to Amur-ilī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 ma-na ḫu-ša-e i-na kà-ṣí-im a-na ta-ší-a-tim
target: 5 minas of scrap (copper) in the steppe for transport.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù qá-ṭá-ra a-dí ḫa-mì-za-nim 0.3333-ma-na AN.NA a-ta-ší-a-tim
target: From Qaṭṭarā until hamizānum 0.3333 mina of tin for transport.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ANŠE uš-pá-il₅-ma 1-ma-na 15 GÍN AN.NA a-pu-ul
target: I replaced a donkey and had to balance 1 mina and 15 shekels of tin.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù bu-ra-li-im a-dí bi-ir-tù-im 17 GÍN AN.NA a-na ta-ší-a-tim
target: From Burallum until Birtu'um 17 shekels of tin for transport.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 7 GÍN AN.NA iš-tù a-al kà-ni-ší-e a-dí tí-mì-il₅-ki-a a-na ig-re e-re-qí-im
target: 7 shekels of tin from the Town of the Kaneshites until Timilkiya as hire for a wagon.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB i-dí-a-bi₄-im DUMU i-tur₄-DINGIR KIŠIB ú-nu-ba KIŠIB a-ší-a-at
target: Seal of Iddin-abum son of Itūr-ilī, seal of Unuba, seal of Ašiat.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 15 ma-na URUDU ma-sí-a-am i-ṣé-er ú-nu-ba ú a-ší-a-at wa-ar-dí ša dan-a-šur lu-zi i-šu
target: Unuba and Ašiat, Dan-Aššur's slaves, owe 15 minas of washed copper to Luzi.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù ḫa-mu-uš-tim ša {d}MAR.TU-ba-ni ú a-šur-na-da a-na 4 ḫa-am-ša-tim i-ša-qú-lu
target: Reckoned from the week of Amurrum-bāni and Aššur-nādā they must pay within 4 weeks.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na áb-na-tí-ni i-ša-qú-lu
target: They must pay using our weight stones.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma lá iš-qú-lu ki-ma a-wa-at kà-ri-im ṣí-ib-tám ú-ṣú-bu
target: If they have not paid (in time) they must add interest in accordance with the rule of the colony.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ITU.KAM ḫu-bu-ur li-mu-um i-dí-a-bu-um
target: Month hubur eponymy Iddin-abum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 TÚG ku-ta-nam ša a-šur-ták-lá-ku ša kà-li-<gap> LUGAL-{d}IM ub-lam
target: Šar-Adad brought 1 -textile belonging to Aššur-taklāku from the <gap>.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 TÚG ku-ta-nam ša <gap> i li-bi₄ LUGAL-{d}IM a-ḫu-ur i-na ni-is-ḫa-tim lá-qé
target: 1 -textile belonging to <gap> remains in Šar-Adad's possession.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 TÚG ku-ta-nam ša i-a-a a-mur-ša-ra-sà ub-lá-ma i-ri-šum il₅-qé-šu
target: Amur-šarrassa brought 1 -textile belonging to Yaya and Irišum received it.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 TÚG ku-ta-nam {d}IM-ba-ni ub-lá-ma i-ri-šu-ma il₅-qé-šu
target: Adad-bāni brought 1 -textile and it was Irišum who received it.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 TÚG ku-ta-nam en-nam-a-šur DUMU a-mur-IŠTAR ub-lá-ma i-ri-šu-ma il₅-qé-šu
target: Ennam-Aššur son of Amur-Ištar brought 1 -textile and it was Irišum who received it.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-la-ḫi-im qí-bi₄-ma um-ma ḫa-nu-ma
target: To Ali-ahum from hanu:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a ma-lá tí-ir-tí-kà šu-ḫu-bu-ur ù a-na-ku ni-zi-iz-ma a-lu-lá-a ni-iṣ-ba-at-ma um-ma né-nu-ma KÙ.BABBAR ù ṣí-ba-tí-šu šu-qú-ul
target: In accordance with your instructions Šu-hubur and I stood up and seized Alulaya and said: Pay the silver and its interest.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-lu-lá-a-ma KÙ.BABBAR iš-tù ITU.1.KAM bur-sú-in ú-šé-bi₄-il₅-šu-um
target: Alulaya answered: "I sent him the silver a month ago with Būr-Suen."

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí ta-aḫ-sí-is-tim ša tù-ša-ḫi-zi-ni a-lu-lá-a a-áš-al-šu-ma um-ma šu-ut-ma la-qé-pu-um DUMU šu-a-šur ú-kà-al-ší
target: With respect to the memorandum that you instructed me about I questioned Alulaya, and he answered: "Lā-qēpum son of Šu-Aššur has it."

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù a-ḫu-wa-qar DUMU zu-ur-zu-ur a-áš-al-ma um-ma šu-ut-ma ta-aḫ-sí-is-tám ili₅-ba-ni DUMU ba-ší-li ú-kà-al-ší
target: I also questioned Ahu-waqar son of Zurzur, and he answered: "Ilī-bāni son of Baši-ilī has the memorandum."

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-zu aṣ-ba-at-ma um-ma šu-ut-ma ki ma-ṣí lu KÙ.BABBAR lu pì-ri-kà-ni-kà 5 GÍN.TA a-lá-qé
target: I seized Azu and he answered: "I shall take enough, either in silver or from your at 5 shekels per piece."

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-ut-ma ba-áb ḫa-ra-ni-kà KÙ.BABBAR ú ṣí-ba-sú a-kà-na-kà-ma
target: He said further: "At your departure I shall seal the silver and its interest";

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí ší-li-ip-kà-im šu-kà-tám aṣ-ba-at-ma um-ma šu-ut-ma ší-li-ip-kà-um i-ba-ší
target: and I seized Šukkutum about the -textile and he answered: "The is available."

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí-ni-ma be-lí a-ta a-ma-kam tù-na-ḫi-da-ni um-ma a-ta-ma a-na u₄-me-šu ú-šé-ra-kum
target: It still is, and you cautioned me there, my dear lord, saying: "I have released them to you on terms."

source: translate Akkadian to English: u₄-ma-am ta-áš-ta-na-me ki-ma ší-mu-um kà-sú ší-mì a-da-ma a-ta-be-a-ma a-ta-lá-kam
target: Today you keep hearing that trade is at a standstill. I shall sell my goods, set out and come.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-lá-ḫu-um-ma a-na šu-IŠTAR ù IŠTAR-lá-ma-sí qí-bi-ma
target: From Ali-ahum to Šu-Ištar and Ištar-lammassī:

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma ú-ṭá-tum iš-tù tù-ma-li-a e-ru-ba-am
target: If the grain has arrived from Tumliya,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 ÁŠ ú-ṭá-tám a-na am-tí-šu ša a-mur-IŠTAR dí-na-a
target: give 2 30-litre measures of grain to Amur-Ištar's maid.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ḫa-šu-i ù na-ki-le-ed na-áš-ú-ni-kum
target: haššui and Nakiled are bringing it to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 11 i-lá-tim ša URUDU ku-nu-ku ša en-nam-a-šur ù ra-bi₄-ṣí-im
target: 11 containers with copper under the seal of Ennam-Aššur and the attorney.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 6 ta-ma-lá-ku ša ṭup-pé ku-nu-ku ša en-nam-a-šur a-dí-da a-lá-ḫu-um ù ra-bi-ṣú-um ša a-na e-na-aḫ-DINGIR ni-ip-qí-du nu-šé-ṣí
target: 6 boxes with tablets under the seal of Ennam-Aššur, Adida, Ali-ahum and the attorney, which we entrusted to Enah-ilī, we brought out.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-šur-ba-ni DUMU ku-ta-a IGI be-lúm-ba-ni DUMU a-šur-be-el-a-wa-tim
target: Witnessed by Aššur-bani son of Kutaya, by Bēlum-bani son of Aššur-bēl-awātim.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša-lim-a-šùr šu-bé-lúm ù en-na-sú-in na-aṣ-bu-tù-ma
target: While Šalim-Aššur, Šu-Bēlum and Enna-Suen seized each other,

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-bé-lúm-ma a-na ša-lim-a-šùr a-na mì-nim tù-kà-al-ni-a-tí
target: Šu-Bēlum said to Šalim-Aššur: Why do you detain us?

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ša-lim-a-šur-ma a-na ḫu-bu-ul a-bi-ku-nu ša KÙ.BABBAR ú-ša-qí-lu ú-kà-al-ku-nu
target: Šalim-Aššur answered: I detain you because of the debt of your father, for which I paid silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-bé-lúm-ma a-na ki ma-ṣí KÙ.BABBAR tù-kà-al-ni-a-tí
target: Šu-Bēlum asked: For how much silver do you detain us?

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na 1 GÚ-at ù 2 GÚ KÙ.BABBAR tù-kà-al-ni-a-tí
target: Do you detain us for 1 talent or for 2 talents of silver?

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ša-lim-a-šur-ma lu 1 GÚ lu 2 GÚ a ma-lá ṭup-pí ḫa-ru-mu-tim ša a-na ḫu-bu-ul a-bi-ku-nu KÙ.BABBAR ú-ša-qí-lu ú-kà-al-ku-nu
target: Šalim-Aššur answered: I detain you for either 1 or 2 talents according to the certified tablets, stating that I paid silver for the debt of your father.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù qá-dum ṣí-ib-tí-šu a-na 5 GÚ KÙ.BABBAR i-tù-ar
target: But including its interest it has become 5 talents of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-bé-lúm uz-na-tí-ni il₅-pu-ut ša ni-iš a-lim{ki} ta-mu-ú lu-ú kà-i-lá
target: Šu-Bēlum reminded us: Keep this in mind, what was sworn by an oath by the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um kà-ni-iš i-dí-ni-a-tí-ma IGI GÍR ša a-šùr ší-bu-tí-ni ni-dí-in
target: The Kanesh colony gave us for these proceedings and we gave our testimony before Aššur's dagger.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI MAR.TU-ba-ni IGI šu-ku-bi-im
target: Witnessed by Amurrum-bāni, by Šu-Kūbum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ba-ba ra-bi-ṣú-um ša É ša-lim-a-šur en-um-a-šur ù ṣí-li-a ša ki-ma a-la-ḫi-im a-na i-dí-a-šur iṣ-ba-at-ni-a-tí-ma
target: Ababa, the attorney of Šalim-Aššur's firm, Ennam-Aššur and Ṣilliya, Ali-ahum's representative, seized us against Iddin-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-ba-ba ra-bi-ṣú-ma a-na i-dí-a-šur-ma ṭup-pá-am ša a-lim{ki} ta-áš-me
target: The attorney Ababa said to Iddin-Aššur: You have heard the tablet from the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR-ap ša-lim-a-šur ù-pá-ḫa-ar
target: I collect Šalim-Aššur's silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù na-áš-pé-er-tám ša um-me-a-ni ša-lim-a-šur iš-tù ITU.KAM ḫu-bu-ur li-mì-im a-šur-ma-lik DUMU a-lá-ḫi-im ub-lá-kum
target: Also, I brought you a missive from Šalim-Aššur's investors from the month, eponymy of Aššur-malik son of Ali-ahum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša 40 GÚ URUDU SIG₅ ip-qí-du-ni-ku-ni tù-šé-ra-am ù a-na me-er-e ša-lim-a-šur la ta-tù-ar
target: Stating that you must release 40 talents of good copper that they entrusted to you, and you must not raise claim against Šalim-Aššur's sons.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 40 GÚ URUDU SIG₅ ša um-me-a-ni ša-lim-a-šur ta-pu-lu-ni a-na ma-lá na-áš-pè-er-tí-šu-nu iš-tù ITU.1.KAM ḫu-bu-ur li-mu-um a-šur-ma-lik DUMU a-lá-ḫi-im URUDU al-qé
target: I have received the 40 talents of good copper about which you reached an agreement with Šalim-Aššur's investors, in accordance with their missive dated month, eponymy Aššur-malik son of Ali-ahum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lá tù-na-ḫa-ni
target: Do not obstruct me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma a-wi-lu a-ni-ú-tum lu i-de₈-ú
target: Indeed, may these men know.

source: translate Akkadian to English: na-áš-pé-er-tám ša um-me-a-ni IGI a-ni-ú-tim ší-me-ma a-na me-er-e ša-lim-a-šur lá ta-tù-ar
target: Listen to the missive from the investors before these witnesses, and do not raise claim against Šalim-Aššur's sons.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-dí-a-šur ra-bi₄-ṣa-am ša É ša-lim-a-šur en-um-a-šur ù ṣí-li-a ša
target: Iddin-Aššur answered the attorney of Šalim-Aššur's firm, Ennam-Aššur and Ṣilliya, Ali-ahum's representative.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i-na ḫu-ra-ma a-na É ub-ri a-dí-in
target: One shekel of silver in hurama I gave to the inn.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 12 GÍN pá-zu-ur-tí TÚG.ḪI.A i-na lu-ḫu-sà-dí-a a-na i-ku-pí-a DUMU da-a-a a-dí-in
target: 12 shekels (the cost) of smuggling textiles I gave in Luhuzaddiya to Ikuppiya, son of Dāya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 GÍN AN.NA a ANŠE.ḪI.A wa-bar-šu <gap> a-na <gap> a-dí-in
target: 3 shekels of tin for the donkeys (and) his lodging <gap> I gave to / in<gap>.

source: translate Akkadian to English: <gap> GÍN AN.NA i-tí-tù-ri-im <gap> GÍN AN.NA a-na É wa-áb-ri i-na ša-mu-ḫa a-dí-in
target: <gap> shekels of tin at the bridge; <gap> shekels of tin I gave to the inn in Šamuha.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na ig-ri ša bi₄-il₅-tim a-dí ša-mu-ḫa a-dí-in
target: I gave 1.5 shekel of silver as wages of a porter until Šamuha.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 GÍN AN.NA i-na ḫa-tí-kà-it-ra a-dí-in
target: 3 shekels of tin I gave in hatika'itra.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.5 GÍN AN.NA i-na ku-tí-a a-ḫa-za-nim a-dí-in
target: 1.5 shekel of tin I gave in Kutiya to the mayor.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 12 GÍN AN.NA i-na kà-ra-aḫ-na a-na GAL sí-ki-tim a-dí-in
target: 12 shekels of tin I gave in Karahna to the commander.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù kà-ra-aḫ-na a-dí ku-bu-ur-na-at 3 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša bi₄-lá-tim ik-šu-ud
target: From Karahna until Kuburnat the costs of porters amounted to 3 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 6 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ni-is-ḫa-tim a-ZU-LI-<gap> a-dí-in
target: 6 shekels of silver import-tax to / for<gap> I gave.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 GÍN AN.NA a-na É ub-ri a dí-in
target: 2 shekels of tin I paid for the inn.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na en-um-a-šur qí-bi-ma um-ma šu-nu-nu-ma a-na ma-lá na-áš-pé-er-tí-kà ša a-na ṣé-ri-a ù a-ṣé-er a-šùr-kà-ší-id tù-lá-pì-tù
target: To Ennam-Aššur from Šu-Nūnu: in accordance with your missive which you wrote to me and to Aššur-kāšid we have seized him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ni-ṣa-ba-sú um-ma šu-ut-ma e-lá-an KÙ.BABBAR 1.5 ma-na
target: And he said: Apart from some 1.5 mina of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ku-nu-ki-šu a-dí-in KÙ.BABBAR
target: Under his seal I gave.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ma la i-dí-na-am
target: He did not give me any silver!

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-na-ku-ma šé-sí-am il₅-kà ma URUDU
target: I said: Produce for me copper.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-ut-ma i-dí-nim
target: He answered: In court.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-na-ku-ma a-ša-ar-ma KÙ.BABBAR a-dí-na-ku-ni KÙ.BABBAR-ba ke-na-tí-ma lá-dí-šu-um
target: I answered: In case I did give you the silver, should I in fact also give that very silver to him?

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-ut-ma a-ša-qal
target: He answered: I shall pay.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI i-ku-pì-a DUMU a-da-lá-al IGI šu-IŠTAR DUMU šu-ku-tí-im
target: Witnessed by Ikūn-pīya son of Adallal, by Šu-Ištar son of Šukkutum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi-ma um-ma kà-lu-a-ma
target: To Ali-ahum from Kaluwa:

source: translate Akkadian to English: tí-ir-tí PUZUR₄-a-šur ma-la i-lá-kà-ni na-áš-pé-ra-tí-šu ší-ta-me-ma
target: Listen to the instructions that come from Puzur-Aššur, his missives.

source: translate Akkadian to English: qá-tí ú i-a-tum tí-ir-tí a-na-na i-lá-ak-šu-um
target: Then my own message will go to him from here.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù a-ḫi a-ta ib-ri a-ta a-lá-nu-kà a-ḫa-am ú ib-ra-am ú-lá i-šu
target: Also, my dear brother and friend, apart from you I have no brother and friend.

source: translate Akkadian to English: e ta-aq-bi um-ma a-ta-ma ša-zu-úz-tám iš-tí-a ú-ša-zi-iz
target: So do not say: I have appointed an agent with me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na tí-ir-tí-a i-ḫi-id
target: Pay attention to my message.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú a-na-ku a tí-ir-tí-kà a-na-ḫi-id
target: I too will pay attention to yours.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 45 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am i-ṣé-er ì-lí-dan ù sà-li-a a-ḫi-šu ša-lim-a-šur i-šu
target: Ilī-dan and his brother Salliya owe 45 minas of refined silver to Šalim-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ITU.KAM a-lá-na-tim li-mu-um a-šur-i-dí
target: Month Allanātum, eponymy Aššur-idī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 15 ma-na a-na 30 ḫa-am-ša-tim i-ša-qú-lu
target: They must pay 15 minas in 30 weeks.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù 30 ḫa-am-ša-tum i-ma-lu-ú-ni 15 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a-na 30 ḫa-am-ša-tim i-ša-qú-lu
target: After 30 weeks have passed they must pay 15 minas of silver within 30 weeks.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú iš-tù ša ša-ni-tim ma-áš-qá-al-tim u₄-mu-ú i-ma-lu-ú-ni 15 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a-na 30 ḫa-am-ša-tim i-ša-qú-lu
target: And after the terms are up for the second payment, they must pay 15 minas of silver within 30 weeks.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am i-ṣé-er a-šur-iš-tí-kál ša-lim-a-šur i-šu
target: Aššuriš-tikal owes 10 minas of refined silver to Šalim-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ITU.KAM ku-zal-li li-mu-um a-šur-i-dí
target: Month Kuzallu, eponymy Aššur-idī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3.3333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a-na 30 ḫa-am-ša-tim i-ša-qal
target: He must pay 3.3333 minas of silver in 30 weeks.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3.3333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a-na 50 ḫa-am-ša-tim i-ša-qal
target: He must pay 3.3333 minas in 50 weeks.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3.3333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a-na 70 ḫa-am-ša-tim i-ša-qal
target: He must pay (the last) 3.3333 minas of silver in 70 weeks.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.3333 ma-na iš-tí lá-qé-pí-im DUMU i-zi-za-am-i-li
target: 1.3333 mina owed by Lā-qēpum son of Izēzam-ilī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR iš-tí IŠTAR-il₅-šu DUMU ú-kà-pì-na-ḫi
target: 4 minas of silver owed by Ištar-ilšu son of Ukappin-ahi.

source: translate Akkadian to English: me-eḫ-ra-at ṭup-pé-e ḫa-ru-mu-tim ša ku-bu-ur-na-at
target: Copies of certified tablets from Kuburnat.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma i-dí-sú-in-ma a-na en-nam-a-šùr qí-bi₄-ma a-ḫi a-ta be-lí a-ta ší-im TÚG.ḪI.A KÙ.BABBAR 1 ma-na KI a-šùr-ta-ak-lá-ku ù IŠTAR-<gap> na-am-gu₅-ra-ni
target: From Iddin-Suen to Ennam-Aššur: My dear brother and lord, we have agreed on the price for the textiles as 1 mina of silver with Aššur-taklāku and Ištar-<gap>.

source: translate Akkadian to English: TÚG.ḪI.A ku-nu-ki-kà ku-nu-uk-ma dí-i-šu-nu-tí
target: Seal the textiles with your own seal and give them to them.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫi a-ta KÙ.BABBAR u₄-ma-am a-ni-a-am lá i-bi₄-at šé-bi₄-lam
target: My dear brother, may the silver not lie idle even this day. Send it!

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ta ḫa-ra-nam ta-dá-nam KÙ.BABBAR lá i-bi₄-at
target: It is you who will give me a journey. The silver must not wait.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-šu-mì SÍG.ḪI.A u₄-ma-am a be-et
target: Concerning the wool I shall stay one day.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ḫi-na-a ù e-la-ma qí-bí-ma um-ma i-dí-a-bu-ma
target: Say to hinnāya and Elamma, thus Iddin-abum:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am i-ṣé-er {d}EN.LÍL-ba-ni DUMU sà-sà-a ṭup-pu-šu ḫa-ar-mu-um i-na li-bi₄ ṭup-pí-a i-na tù-ur-ḫu-mì-it É ḫi-na-a i-ba-ší
target: 35 shekels of refined silver Enlil-bāni, son of Sasaya, owes (me); his sealed debt-note is among my tablets (that are) in Durhumit, in the house of hinnāya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ba-ú-a a-tù-nu ṣa-ab-ta-šu-ma KÙ.BABBAR ša-áš-qí-la-šu
target: Please, my fathers, seize him and make him pay the silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma mì-ma i-qá-bi₄ um-ma šu-ut-ma a-na e-la-i-šu KÙ.BABBAR a-ša-qal GÁN-lam ú-la 1 ú-ṣí
target: If he protests and says: 'I will pay him the silver when he comes up' - he must not leave for the countryside,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṣa-ab-ta-šu-ma KÙ.BABBAR ša-áš-qí-la-šu-ma ù iš-té-en i ba-ri-ku-nu ṭup-pá-am li-dí-šu-um ki-ma ṭup-pu-šu sà-ru
target: seize him and make him pay the silver and let one of you give him a quittance stating that his debt-note is no longer valid.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 TÚG ku-ta-ni a-šur-mu-ta-píl DUMU šu-be-lim i-na ku-nu-uk da-dí-a kà-an-ku-ma ub-la-kum
target: Aššur-mūtappil, son of Šu-Bēlum, brought you 2 -textiles provided with Dadiya's seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-bi a-ta be-lí a-ta 1 ṭup-pá-am ša 0.5 ma-na 3 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ḫa-bu-la-ku-nu ku-nu-uk-šu-ma a-na DUMU um-me-a-nim ke-nim dí-in-šu-ma lu-ub-lu-ni-šu
target: Please, my father, my lord, the tablet by which I owe you 33 shekels of silver, put it under seal and give it to a reliable affiliated trader, to bring it to me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na e-la-ma qí-bi₄-ma <gap> um-ma a-šur-ma-lik-ma
target: Say to Elamma, thus Aššur-mālik:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ma-lá ṭup-pí-im ša a-lim{ki} 1 ku-ta-nu-um ba-tí-iq
target: Compared with the tablet from the City 1 is missing.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ú-zu-a-ma TÚG.ḪI.A i-na a-lim{ki} ú-lá im-nu-ú-nim na-ru-qá-tim ip-qí-du-nim
target: Uzua said: 'They did not count the textiles in the City, they (simply) entrusted the bags to me'.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 TÚG i-na ni-is-ḫa-tim il₅-qé-ú
target: They took 1 textile when levying the import tax.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 TÚG.ḪI.A i-na e-kál-lim i-na sá-i-tí-kà iḫ-li-qú-ma
target: 2 textiles got lost in the palace from / at the time of your <gap>.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 TÚG a-ta tù-ma-li
target: and you made good 1 textile.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 TÚG ú-ṣú-ur-ša-IŠTAR DUMU a-šur-i-mì-tí i-na-pá-al
target: 1 textile Uṣur-ša-Aššur, Aššur-imittī's son, will compensate.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-kam ṣa-ba-sú-ma ku-ta-nam li-dí-na-kum
target: Seize him there and let him give you the -textile.

source: translate Akkadian to English: TÚG a-na É kà-ri-im a qá-tí-kà a-dí
target: I deposited a textile in the colonial office as your share.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 TÚG lá-ma-sà-tum tal-qé
target: 1 textile Lamassutum took.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 TÚG-tí-šu kà-ṣa-ru-um il₅-qé
target: The harnessor took his 2 textiles.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 31 ku-ta-ni be-lúm-ba-ni ub-la-kum
target: 31 textiles Bēlum-bāni brought you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na 25 TÚG šu-ru-tim 3 TÚG a-na ni-is-ḫa-tim il₅-qé-ú
target: Of the 25 dark textiles they took 3 textiles as import-tax.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 TÚG lá-ma-sà-tum tal-qé
target: Lamassutum took 1 textile.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 21 TÚG šu-ru-tim e-zi-ib ša li-wi-tim be-lúm-ba-ni ub-la-kum
target: 21 dark textiles, apart those for wrapping, Bēlum-bāni brought you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-šu ša i-na TÚG.ḪI.A 2 TÚG tal-qé-ú
target: Why did you take 2 pieces of the textiles?

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-im-šu-nu a-na be-lúm-ba-ni dí-in
target: Give their price to Bēlum-bāni.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù AN.NA-ak qá-tí-šu ša ú-zu-a ga-am-ru 17 ma-na AN.NA i-na ḫa-ra-nim il₅-qé-ú
target: After Uzua's tin for expenses had been spent they took 17 minas of tin during the journey.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na KÙ bé-ú-lá-tù-šu
target: His working capital was 0.5 mina of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.3333 ma-na a pá-ni-šu ú-šé-bi₄-il₅
target: I sent 0.3333 mina to him en route.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.3333 ma-na 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am ga-al-dá-a ša e-la-ma i-be-i-el
target: 25 shekels of refined silver Galdaya of Elamma will manage.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KI KÙ.BABBAR-pí-im uk-ta-al
target: He is held in service with the silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI lá-qé-pì-im IGI a-mur-{d}UTU IGI e-ze-e
target: Witnessed by Lā-qēpum, by Amur-Šamaš, by Ezē.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma ú-da-pí-ir 1 GÍN.TA i-na ITU.KAM ú-ṣa-áb
target: If he disappears he will add 1 shekel of silver as interest per month.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šál-ma-a-šur-ma a-na en-nam-a-šur qí-bi-ma
target: From Šalim-Aššur to Ennam-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša a-na i-tur₄-DINGIR ù e-lá-lí DUMU me-er-e PUZUR₄-a-na ta-dí-nu-ma a-na-kam ša-qá-lam qá-bi-ú-ni
target: As to the 1 mina of silver that you gave to Itūr-ilī and Elāli, the sons of Puzur-Anna, and which they promised to pay here -

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam KÙ.BABBAR ša-bu-a-ku
target: I have been paid the silver here.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pá-am ša ku-nu-ki-šu-nu dí-šu-nu-tí-ma le-tí-qú
target: Give them the tablet with their seals and let them travel.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ša-bu-a-ku
target: I have been paid the silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù tí-ir-ta-kà li-li-kam-ma ṭup-pì-i le-ri-iš-ma lá-du-uk
target: Also, send word and let me ask for my tablet so I can annul it.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-lá-ḫi-im ú a-šùr-ma-lik
target: To Ali-ahum and Aššur-malik.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-šur-ma-lik-ma ù a-mur-IŠTAR a-na a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi-ma a-na-kam sí-ki en-na-sú-in nu-kà-il₅-ma
target: From Aššur-malik and Amur-Ištar to Ali-ahum: We detained Enna-Suen here,

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-ut-ma a-lá-ak-ma i-na kà-ni-iš i re-iš ṭup-pì-a KÙ.BABBAR a-ša-qal-ma ṭup-pì ša ḫu-bu-li-a ú ša i-na-a ša qá-ta-tù-ni a-na-ku ṭup-pì-a ki-lá-le-en a-du-wa-ak
target: and he said: I shall go and pay the silver in compliance with my tablet in Kanesh, and I shall annul the tablet concerning my debt and the one where Innaya is the guarantor - I shall personally do it with both my tablets.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma né-nu-ma KÙ.BABBAR ku-nu-uk-ma a-na ṣé-er i-na-a ú a-lá-ḫi-im li-li-ik
target: We answered: "Seal the silver and let it go to Innaya and Ali-ahum."

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-ut-ma KÙ.BABBAR a-na-kam ú-lá i-šu a-lá-ak-ma i-na kà-ni-iš a-ša-qal
target: He said: "I do not have the silver here. I shall go to Kanesh and pay."

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma né-nu-ma a-na kà-ni-iš <gap>-tí-ra-ni ša-zi-iz
target: We said: "To Kanesh <gap> appoint an agent."

source: translate Akkadian to English: <gap> DUMU lá-ta-ra-ak ú-ša-zi-iz
target: He appointed Latarak's son.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na <gap>-ni-a-tí i-ša <gap> ib na-ki <gap> ma <gap> kà-šu-um <gap>-um i-ša-qal <gap> ú-la na-pu-úṣ
target: <gap> he will pay. <gap> he has not been cleared

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI da-da-a DUMU dí-li-a
target: Witnessed by Dadaya son of Diliya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-im TÚG.ḪI.A ma zi ri a a-dí 5 u₄-me-e lu KÙ.BABBAR lu KÙ.GI nu-ša-da-ma iš-tí wa-ar-ki-ú-tim nu-šé-ba-lam
target: We shall collect the price of the <gap> textiles, either silver or gold, in 5 days, and we shall send it with the very first (transport).

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pu-um i-ṣé-er ili₅-ba-ni DUMU i-a-a
target: 3 shekels of refined silver owed by Ilī-bāni son of Yaya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫa-ma 4.1666 GÍN 7 0.5 ŠE KÙ.BABBAR iš-tí-šu-ma
target: Further, 4.1666 shekels 7.5 grains of silver owed by him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-šur-<gap> ù a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi-ma um-ma be-lúm-ba-ni-ma
target: To Aššur-<gap> and Ali-ahum from Bēlum-bāni:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-kam PUZUR₄-a-be-eḫ DUMU zu-ba ṣa-áb-ta-ma 0.3333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša a-na šu-mì-šu a-na i-dí-ku-bi₄-im áš-qú-lu
target: Seize Puzur-Abeh son of Zuba there and make him pay the 0.3333 mina of silver that I paid to Iddin-Kūbum in his name.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ša-áš-qí-lá-šu šu-ma KÙ.BABBAR lá-šu i-na ṣú-ba-tí qá-at-ku-nu lu-ša-áš-ki-ku-nu
target: If there is no silver, then I will let you make a claim to the textiles.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ba-ú-a a-tù-nu šu-ma lá ta-ša-kà-na KÙ.BABBAR <gap> ni i-<gap>
target: My dear friends, if you do not lay claim, <gap>

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB {d}MAR.TU-ba-ni DUMU ma-na-na KIŠIB pu-šu-ke-en₆ DUMU sú-e-a
target: Seal of Amurrum-bāni son of Manana, seal of Pūšu-kēn son of Sueyya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um kà-ni-iš i-dì-ni-a-tí-ma
target: The Kanesh colony gave us for these proceedings.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI GÍR ša {d}a-šùr ší-bu-tí-ni ni-dí-in
target: We gave our testimony before Aššur's dagger.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ša-ta-áš-me-tim-ma a-na PUZUR₄-a-na ú šu-sú-in qí-bi₄-ma
target: Thus Šāt-Tašmētim, say to Puzur-Anna and Šu-Suen:

source: translate Akkadian to English: be-tum ḫa-bi₄-it-ma ki-da-tim ar-ta-na-pu-ud
target: The house has been robbed and I wander around outside.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma a-ḫu-ú-a a-tù-nu al-kà-nim-ma ša-li-ú-um i-ṣé-er É a-bi₄-ku-nu lá i-ša-lá
target: Please, my brothers, come here so that nobody will harm your paternal house.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na tù-ra-mì-il₅ DUMU ba-al-ṭù-um qá-tim a-na qá-tim ṣú-ba-tum e-ni <gap> ša-ak-šu-sú a-ma-kam ṣa-ba-sú-ma ṣú-ba-tám li-dí-na-kum
target: To Tūram-ilī, son of Balṭum, a <gap> garment has immediately been forwarded. Seize him there and let him give you the garment.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma ar-ḫi-iš lá ta-li-kà-nim ep-ra-am a-lu-um i-ta-ba-al
target: If you do not come quickly the city will take away the sustenance.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na PUZUR₄-a-na ú šu-sú-in qí-bi₄-ma um-ma ša-ta-áš-me-tim-ma
target: Say to Puzur-Anna and Šu-Suen, thus Šāt-Tašmētum:

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ša-ni-ú-um ša a-ta-na-<gap>-ú-ma ÌR a-ba-am lá i-da-na-ku-nu-tí-ni
target: 'Why that I keep <gap>, but he does not give you the slave <gap>?

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma a-ḫu-ú-a a-tù-nu ša-li-ú-um i-ṣé-ri-ku-nu lá i-ša-lá
target: If you are really my brothers let nobody harm you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ÌR a-šar pá-nu-im pá-ni-a-šu-nu-tí-ma a-bi DAM.GÀR-ru lá i-du-mu-nim
target: Forward the slave to them where you can, so that the creditors will not sell my father.

source: translate Akkadian to English: <gap>-li-ší-a-ta ša tù-šé-ba-lá-ni-ni a-ta-ma tí-dí-e ṣú-ba-tam bu-de₈-a aḫ-mu-úṣ-ma a-dí-na-kum
target: As for the <gap> you are sending me, you yourself know that I stripped the garment from my shoulder and gave it to you!

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tí pá-ni-im-ma a-li-ki-im KÙ.BABBAR dí-in-ma lu-ub-lu-nim
target: Provide silver and let one bring it me with the first caravan.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma li-BE-tí a-bi-ku-nu ta-ra-a-ma-nim tí-ba-nim-ma a-ta-al-kà-nim
target: If you love your ancestral get moving and come here!

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB la-qé-pì-im DUMU a-šur-ma-lik
target: Seal of Lā-qēpum, son of Aššur-mālik.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB dan-a-a DUMU a-ta-a
target: Seal of Dannaya, son of Ataya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB im-dí-DINGIR DUMU šu-lá-ba-an
target: Seal of Imdī-ilum, son of Šu-Labān.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša 10 ma-na AN.NA ša i-ku-pì-IŠTAR a-na e-lá-ma i-di-nu
target: That for the 10 minas of tin that Ikūn-pī-Ištar had given to Elamma.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.6666 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR im-dí-DINGIR il₅-qé
target: Imdī-ilum received 1.6666 mina of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma um-me-a-nu i-ku-pì-IŠTAR ú-la me-er-ú-šu a-na e-lá-ma i-tù-ru
target: If the investors of Ikūn-pī-Ištar or his sons raise a claim against Elamma.

source: translate Akkadian to English: im-dí-DINGIR ú-ba-áb-šu
target: Imdī-ilum will clear him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ší-ša-ra <gap> a-du-da <gap> qí-bi-ma um-ma ša-lim-a-šùr-ma
target: To Šišara and Aduda from Šalim-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 GÚ 10 ma-na AN.NA 4 TÚG ku-ta-nu li-we-tum 5 TÚG e-li-tum 7 ma-na AN.NA qá-tim ú 10 ma-na ni-ga-lu ANŠE.ḪI.A ṣa-lá-mu-um mì-ma a-nim pu-šu-ki-in ú e-ri-šum ša i-sú-rik₁₃ ub-lu-nim
target: 2 talents 10 minas of tin, 4 -textiles, the wrapping, 5 textiles in a top-pack, 7 minas of expense-tin plus 10 minas of sickles; 1 black donkey - all this, belonging to Issu-arik, Pūšu-kēn and Erišum brought.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 GÚ 30 ma-na AN.NA 8 šu-ru-tum li-we-sú-nu 5 ANŠE ṣa-lá-mu 13 TÚG ku-sí-a-tum 18 ma-na AN.NA qá-tim 33 ma-na ḫu-ša-ú mì-ma a-nim ša i-sú-rik₁₃ i-ri-šum ù a-bu-ša-lim ub-lu-nim
target: 4 talents 30 minas of tin, 8 black (textiles) to wrap it, 5 black donkeys, 13 robes, 18 minas of expense-tin, 33 minas of scrap metal - all this, belonging to Issu-arik, Irišum and Abu-šalim brought.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 6 GÚ 30 ma-na AN.NA ku-nu-ku 30 ku-ta-nu qá-dum li-we-tim 3 ANŠE.ḪI.A 30 ma-na AN.NA qá-tim 30 ma-na ni-ga-lu mì-ma a-nim i šé-ep a-bu-ša-lim ša i-sú-rik₁₃ i-li-kam la-qé-pu-um i-na lá i-dim i-šé-a-ni
target: 6 talents 30 minas of tin under seal, 30 -textiles including the wrapping, 3 donkeys, 30 minas of expense-tin, 30 minas of sickles - all this, belonging to Issu-arik, arrived transported by Abu-šalim.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-ut-ma mì-ma maš-kà-tum ša a-bi₄-kà i li-bi ú-lá i-ba-ší É a-bi-kà ša-bu-ú mì-nam ta-za-na-kà-ra-šu-nu mì-ma tí-šu ša na-ru-qí-ni
target: Lā-qēpum sues me without reason, saying: There is no deposit of your father's owed by me. Your father's firm has been paid. Why do you make declarations for them that anything you have is our joint-stock capital?

source: translate Akkadian to English: ma ṭup-pí ša maš-kà-na-tim me-eḫ-ri bi-ra-ma ší-bi ša ki maš-kà-na-tim ša i-sú-rik₁₃ iš-ta-ku-nu a-na KÁ DINGIR šé-ri-da-šu-nu-ma ṭup-pí ša
target: So as for the tablets of deposit, check the copies, and lead the witnesses whom Issu-arik kept appointing for deposits to the Gate of the God, and certify tablets with their testimony, but Iddin-abum's tablets which were sealed by Šu-Illil, Amur-Ištar and Šu-Anum you must not open until I arrive.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma i-<gap> a-na ku-zi-zi-a <gap> qí-bi-ma
target: From I<gap> to <gap> and Kuziziya:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 ma-na KÙ.GI 8 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ku-zi-zi-a ub-lam
target: Kuziziya brought 2 minas of gold and 8 minas of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.GI-kà ta-dí-in ší-im-šu <gap> KÙ.BABBAR <gap>-ku-um
target: Your gold has been sold; its price was <gap> to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ma a-nim bé-lá-num ú {d}IM-ba-ni i-ra-dí-ú-ni-kum
target: All this Bēlānum and Adad-bāni lead to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma-<gap> ù tám-kà-ru-um-ma a-na ì-lí-iš-tí-kál ù pí-lá-aḫ-IŠTAR qí-bi-ma
target: From <gap> and the merchant to Iliš-tikal and Pilah-Ištar:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 30 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am ni-is-ḫa-sú DIRI ša-du-a-sú ša-bu ku-nu-ki-ni zi-ki-ki na-áš-a-ku-nu-tí
target: Zikiki brings you 30 minas of refined silver, its import duty added, its transport tariff paid for, under our seals.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pá-am ša ba-áb DINGIR ša i-na ku-bu-ur-na-at a-ba-a ú a-na-aḫ-ì-lí ip-qí-du-ni-ni-ma
target: The tablet (with the testimony given) in the gate of the god, which in Kuburnat Abaya and Anah-ili entrusted to me,

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na kà-né-eš a-na a-ta-ta DUMU ma-num-ba-lúm-a-šur IGI a-šur-ba-ni DUMU ì-lí-a-lim IGI a-šur-e-nam DUMU be-lúm-ba-ni áp-qí-id
target: in Kanesh to Atata, son of Mannum-balum-Assur, in the presence of Assur-bani, son of Ili-alum and of Assur-ennam, son of Belum-bani I entrusted it.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma en-um-a-šur-ma a-na en-na-sú-in ù DINGIR-ba-ni qí-bi-ma šál-ma-ku
target: From Ennam-Aššur to Enna-Suen and Ili-bāni: I am well.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu ḫa-dí-a-ni₇
target: Let us be glad!

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ma i-ṣé-ri-a šál-ma-a-šur lá il₅-qé
target: Šalim-Aššur took nothing on my account.

source: translate Akkadian to English: É a-bi-ni a-na-ku ù a-tù-nu na-am-ra-ni
target: As for our paternal house, I and you are happy!

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-pu-tum tí-ib-a-ni-ma a-tal-kà-nim
target: Urgent, set out and come.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ší-tám ša DINGIR-ba-ni en-na-sú-in ub-lam
target: Enna-Suen has brought 1 shekel of silver the rest that belongs to Ilī-bāni.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša i-na-sú-in LUGAL-{d}IM mì-ma lá ub-lam
target: Šar-Adad has not brought anything belonging to Enna-Suen.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù šu-ma be-ú-lá-tí-ku-nu ba-at-qá-tù-nu a-na-ku ú-ša-ba
target: Also, if you are in arrears with your working capitals, I shall personally pay them.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tí a-ba-ba ta-ma-ku
target: I have sworn together with Ababa.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na 15 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am i-ṣé-er ú-ṣur-ša-a-šur DUMU a-ta-ta aḫ-ša-lim i-šu
target: Uṣur-ša-Aššur son of Atata owes 1 mina 15 shekels of refined silver to Ah-šalim.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù ḫa-muš-tim ša a-šur-ma-lik DUMU sú-kà-li-a a-na 12 ḫa-am-ša-tim i-ša-qal
target: Reckoned from the week of Aššur-malik son of Sukkalliya he is to pay within 12 weeks.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma la iš-qú-ul 1.5 GÍN.TA a-na 1 ma-na-im i-na ITU.KAM ṣí-ib-tám ú-ṣa-áb
target: If he has not paid he will add interest at the rate 1.5 shekel per month per mina.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ITU.1.KAM ḫu-bu-ur li-mu-um a-šur-ma-lik DUMU a-lá-ḫi-im
target: Month hubur, eponymy Aššur-malik son of Ali-ahum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI PUZUR₄-a-na DUMU en-nam-a-šur IGI a-la-ḫi-im DUMU šál-ma-a-šur
target: Witnessed by Puzur-Anna son of Ennam-Aššur, by Ali-ahum son of Šalim-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na en-nam-a-šur ù a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi-ma um-ma SIG₅-pí-a-šur-ma
target: To Ennam-Aššur and Ali-ahum from Damiq-pī-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: me-at 60 ṣú-ba-tù ša tám-kà-ri-im ŠÀ.BA 19 ṣú-ba-tù-kà
target: As to the 160 textiles belonging to the merchant, thereof 19 are your textiles.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-li-ik lu-qú-tim
target: Take a decision concerning the goods.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-il₅-kà ṣú-ba-tù SIG₅ DIRI ša tám-kà-ri-im
target: The textiles of extra-fine quality belong to the merchant.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫu-a a-tù-nu KÙ.BABBAR ší-im a-ni-ki-a ša e-ni-iš-ta-ru-um ub-lá-ku-nu-tí-ni a-na pá-ni-a šé-bi₄-lá-nim
target: My dear brothers, send me the silver that was the proceeds of my tin which Eništārum brought to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: e-ni-iš-ta-ra-am lá i-sà-ḫu-ur ṭù-ur-da-ni-šu-ma uz-né-kà id-a
target: Eništārum should not be delayed, send him and listen closely.

source: translate Akkadian to English: sà-ḫe-er-tám ša 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR šé-bi-lá-ni-im
target: Send me small goods worth 5 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB e-lá-ma DUMU i-dí-sú-en₆
target: Seal of Elamma, son of Iddin-Suen.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB zu-za-a DUMU i-sí-ḫi-im
target: Seal of Susāya, son of Isihum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB en-na-sú-en₆ DUMU ku-ku-ra-nim
target: Seal of Ennam-Suen, son of Kukurānum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-um ša a-wi-it e-lá-ma zu-za-a ù en-na-sú-en₆
target: Tablet of the declared value (of the goods) of Elamma, Susaya and Ennam-Suen.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma en-um-a-šur-ma a-na ma-num-ba-lúm-A-šur ú en-um-a-šur qí-bi₄-ma
target: From Enam-Aššur to Mannum-balum-Aššur and Ennam-Aššur; specifically to Ennam-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na en-um-a-šur ṭup-pu-um ša 5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR PUZUR₄-a-na i-ṣé-er a-šur-ta-ak-lá-ku i-šu-ú i be-tí-kà i-ba-ší
target: A tablet stating that Aššur-taklāku owes 5 minas of silver to Puzur-Anna is in your house.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-kam ṭup-pì-a bí-ri-ma šu-ma ṭup-pu-um i-ba-ší en-um-a-šur kà-li-im-šu-ma
target: Look at my tablets there, and if the tablet is indeed there, show it to Ennam-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù iš-tí-kà-ma ṭup-pu-um li-bi₄-ší
target: and then let the tablet be in your possession.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú tí-ir-ta-ak-nu a-ṣé-ri-a li-li-kam
target: Also, send word to me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma i-dí-a-bu-um-ma a-na en-um-a-šur ù a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi-ma
target: From Iddin-abum to Ennam-Aššur and Alāhum:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam 3 GÚ 55 ma-na URUDU ṣa-lá-ma-am qá-at-ku-nu É kà-ri-im al-qé
target: Here I have taken 3 talents 55 minas of black copper on your account in the colony office.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫu-a a-tù-nu a-na URUDU ša um-me-an a-bi-ku-nu a-pu-lu a-ma-kam iḫ-da-ma um-me-a-ni ṭá-i-ba-ma i-a-tí ša-ḫi-ṭá
target: My dear brothers, take care to satisfy the investors there for the copper that I have balanced with the investors of your father, and withdraw mine.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma lá ki-am ma-lá um-me-a-ni ú-ra-ki-sú-ni-ni li-ba-ak-nu i-ma-ra-aṣ
target: If this does not happen, you will be sorry about everything the investors have contracted with me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-IŠTAR-ma ù la-qé-pu-um-ma a-na tám-kà-ri-im qí-bi-ma
target: From Šu-Ištar and Lā-qēp to the merchant:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ni-is-ḫa-sú DIRI ša-du-a-sú ša-bu ku-nu-ki-kà i-dí-a-bu-um ub-lam
target: Iddin-abum brought 10 minas of silver, its import duty added, its transport tariff paid for, under your seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ.BA 1 GÚ 5 ma-na 6 GÍN AN.NA ku-nu-ku 15.6666 GÍN.TA KÙ.BABBAR-ap-šu 4 ma-na 9.3333 GÍN
target: Thereof: 1 talent 5 minas 6 shekels of sealed tin at the rate in silver 15.6666 to 1, in silver: 4 minas 9.3333 shekels;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 40 TÚG.ḪI.A ša qá-tim 2.3333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR it-bu-lu
target: 40 ordinary textiles cost 2.3333 minas of silver;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 15.3333 ma-na 5 GÍN AN.NA qá-tim 15 GÍN.TA KÙ.BABBAR-ap-šu 1 ma-na 1.6666 GÍN
target: 15.3333 minas 5 shekels of expense-tin at the rate 15 to 1, in silver: 1 mina 1.6666 shekels;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 ANŠE ṣa-lá-mu 0.6666 ma-na 6 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR it-bu-lu
target: 2 black donkeys cost 0.6666 mina 6 shekels of silver;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR be-ú-lá-at 1 sà-ri-dim i-dí-a-bu-um il₅-qé
target: Iddin-abum received 0.5 mina of silver, the working capital of a packer;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 GÍN lu-bu-šu ša-bu
target: he was paid 2 shekels for his clothing;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR wa-ṣí-tám ni-dí-in
target: we gave 5 shekels for the export duty;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ú-nu-ut ANŠE
target: 5 shekels of silver: harness for the donkeys;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 GÍN ša sà-e-tim
target: 1 shekel: of the .

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ga-am-ra-kum
target: The silver has been spent for you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ma a-nim ku-nu-ki-ni i-dí-a-bu-um i-ra-dí-a-kum
target: Iddin-abum leads all this to you under our seals.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.3333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am i-ṣé-er a-šur-ta-ak-lá-ku a-šur-DU₁₀ i-šu-ú
target: 0.3333 mina of refined silver Aššur-taklāku owed to Aššur-ṭāb.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR <gap> a-šur-DU₁₀ ša-bu
target: With that silver Aššur-ṭāb has been satisfied.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-um ša 0.3333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša ḫu-bu-ul a-šur-ta-ak-lá-ku ša e-li-a-ni sá-ar
target: The tablet recording a debt of 0.3333 mina of silver owed by Aššur-taklāku which turns up is invalid.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI ì-lí-áš-ra-ni IGI DUMU du-ur-a-šur
target: In the presence of Ilī-ašranni son of Tūr-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-ku-pí-a a-na ra-bi-ṣí-im ša šál-ma-a-šur iṣ-ba-at-ni-a-tí-ma
target: Ikūn-pīya seized us against the attorney of Šalim-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma i-ku-pí-a-ma i-na 40 GÚ URUDU SIG₅ ša áp-qí-du ŠÀ.BA 10 GÚ URUDU a-na-ku al-qé 30 GÚ URUDU a-ta tal-qé
target: Ikūn-pīya said: Of the 40 talents of good copper that I entrusted, thereof I personally took 10 talents of copper and you took 30 talents of copper.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ra-bi-ṣú-um-ma a-na-ku al-qé
target: The attorney answered: I personally took it.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ra-bi-ṣú-um-ma ù DUMU šál-ma-a-šur iš-tí i-dí-a-šur-ma ša-áš-ḫi-it-ni-a-tí
target: The attorney continued: And the son of Šalim-Aššur has been cleared for us Iddin-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI en-um-a-šur IGI DU₁₀-ṣí-lá-a-šur IGI lu-lu
target: Witnessed by Ennam-Aššur by Ṭāb-ṣill-Aššur, by Lulu.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša ḫi-na-a e-lá-ma a-na i-dí-sú-en₆ ú-šé-bi₄-il₅
target: 1 mina of silver belonging to hinnāya Elamma dispatched to Iddin-Suen.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṣé-eḫ-ri-lí ú-bi₄-il₅
target: Ṣeher-ilī brought it away.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI na-ni-a IGI a-šur-DU₁₀
target: Witnessed by Naniya, by Aššur-ṭāb.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 18 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša en-um-a-šur i li-bi a-šur-ba-ni
target: 18 shekels of silver belonging to Ennam-Aššur is owed by Aššur-bāni.

target: 13 ½ minas of -copper belonging to Ennam-Aššur is owed by Ennam-rēṣum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša 1 ma-na 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṭup-pá-am ḫa-ar-ma-am ša ḫu-bu-ul e-nu-re-ṣí-im a-na i-ku-pí-a e-zi-ib
target: Concerning 1 mina 5 shekels of silver he has left a certified tablet about the debt of Ennam-rēṣum to Ikūn-pīya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 37 ku-ta-ni 34 TÚG šu-ru-tum a-na lá-qé-pí-im áp-qí-id IGI i-dí-{d}IŠKUR IGI i-dí-a-šur DUMU sú-e-ta-ta
target: 37 textiles (and) 34 dark textiles I entrusted to Lā-qēpum in the presence of Iddin-Adad and of Iddin-Aššur, son of Suettata.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 7 TÚG.ḪI.A ša li-wi-tim IGI a-šùr-SIPA a-dí-šu-um
target: 7 textiles for wrapping I gave him in the presence of Aššur-rē'ī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na šu-a-šùr ù du-ma-na qí-bí-ma um-ma i-ku-pí-a-ma
target: To Šu-Aššur and Dumana say, thus Ikūn-pīya:

target: 2 -textiles of Āl-ṭāb <gap> of good quality, <gap> scarfs, one of which belongs to temple-funds of (the gods) Suen and Šamaš.

source: translate Akkadian to English: du-ma-na na-áš-a-ku-um
target: Dumana is bringing you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫi a-ta i-na ša-ḫa-at du-ma-na i-zi-iz-ma iš-tí na ku-zu-<gap> lu-ša-ri-id-da-<gap> i-ḫi-id-ma i-na ší-mì-šu-nu KÙ.BABBAR SIG₅ DIRI e-pu-uš
target: Please, my brother, assist Dumana and <gap> let him <gap> and take care to get as payment for them silver of extra good quality.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí sà-aḫ-ra-ku KÙ.BABBAR li-im-qú-tá-am
target: The silver must arrive with me while I am staying here.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫi a-ta ší-im ší-it-re ša ik-ri-bi iš-tí a-li-ki-im pá-ni-ma šé-bi-lam
target: Please, my brother, send me the price that the scarfs of the temple-fund yield with the first caravan.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-we-el-tum ta-áš-pu-ra-ma
target: The lady wrote me

source: translate Akkadian to English: ku-ta-nam ša 15 GÍN ú šu-ul-ḫa-am ša 4.5 GÍN a-lu-a ú-bi₄-il₅
target: that Aluwa brought a kutānu worth 15 shekels and a šulhu worth 4.5 shekels.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma i-ku-pí-a-ma a-na ib-ni-lí en-nam-a-šur ù <gap> qí-bi-ma
target: From Ikūn-pīya to Ibni-ilī, Ennam-Aššur and <gap>;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 TÚG ku-ta-num a-na am-tí-kà i-nu-mì a-na a-lá-ni ta-li-ku
target: 1 -textile for your maid when you went to the villages

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-im-šu-ma <gap> a-na ší-mì-im <gap>-ma ší-im-šu <gap>-kà li-ib-ší
target: indeed its price for purchases its price should remain

source: translate Akkadian to English: lá ta-dí-in
target: you have not sold
