target: Seal of Nab-Suen and Kuziziya; to Iddin-Aššur: 40 less 2 minas.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ša-lim-a-šur qí-bi₄-ma um-ma a-bu-ša-lim-ma
target: To Šalim-Aššur from Abu-šalim:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 13 ANŠE.ḪI.A i-šar-be-li i-ta-dí-in
target: Išar-bēli has sold 13 donkeys.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú 30 TÚG šu-ul-ḫu ša i-na ú-lá-ma i-lá-qé-ú-ni
target: Also, with respect to the 30 -textiles which they will receive in Ulama,

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na be-li-a ú-ba-lá-aṭ
target: I shall credit to my lord.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-kam sà-ni-iq-šu-ma lu-ma-li-kum
target: Check him there so he may pay you in full.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.6666 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am i-na ma-na-im ša a-mur-{d}UTU ba-lúm du-na-e i-ta-ki-is
target: 0.6666 mina of refined silver - he cut it off with the (1-)mina weight of Amur-Šamaš, without surcharge.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-ṣé-er ir-ma-a-šùr i-ri-ší-im ù il₅-me-ta-ku ú-ṣur-ša-a-šùr i-šu
target: Ir'am-Aššur, Irišum and Ilī-wedāku owe to Uṣur-ša-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù ḫa-muš-tim ša a-šùr-i-dí ù šu-IŠTAR ITU.KAM kán-wa-ar-ta li-mu-um {d}IŠKUR-ba-ni a-na 4 ḫa-am-ša-tim i-ša-qú-lu
target: From the week of Aššur-idī and Šu-Ištar, month IX, eponymy year of Adad-bāni, they will pay within 4 weeks.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma lá iš-qú-lu 1.5 GÍN.TA i ITU.KAM-im ú-ṣú-bu KÙ.BABBAR
target: If they do not pay they will add (an interest of) 1.5 shekel per mina per month.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i qá-qá-ad šál-mì-šu-nu ra-ki-is
target: They are jointly liable for the silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI DU₁₀-a-šur IGI šu-IŠTAR
target: In the presence of Ṭāb-Aššur, of Šu-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša 2 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am i-ṣé-er en-na-nim DUMU a-zu-a e-la-ma i-šu
target: That Ennānum, son of Azua, owes 2 minas of refined silver to Elamma.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ITU.1.KAM ša ke-na-tim li-mu-um ša qá-tí a-šùr-SIG₅ DUMU a-bar-sí-sí-im ḫa-muš-tum ša a-šur-mì-tí DUMU a-ta-a
target: Month III, eponymy of the successor of Aššur-damiq, son of Abarsisum, week eponymy of Aššur-imittī, son of Atāya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.6666 ma-na.TA i-na ša-tim i-ša-qal šu-ma lá iš-qúl 1.5 GÍN.TA ṣí-ib-tám a-na 1 ma-na-im i ITU.1.KAM ú-ṣa-áb
target: He will pay 0.6666 mina per year; if he does not pay he will add an interest of 1.5 shekel per mina per month.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI e-na-a-nim IGI la-qé-pì-im
target: In the presence of En(n)ānum, of Lā-qēpum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na 11 TÚG ku-ta-ni a-mur-IŠTAR ù a-la-ḫi-im a-na e-la-ma a-šùr-la-ma-sí a-na ITU.5.KAM ú-kà-an
target: For 11 -textiles Aššur-lamassī will confirm to Elamma (the liability of) Āmur-Ištar and Ali-ahum within 5 months.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma lá uk-ta-in-šu-nu 0.3333 ma-na 5 GÍN.TA KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am a-na e-lá-ma a-šùr-la-ma-sí i-ša-qal
target: If he does not confirm their liability Aššur-lamassī will pay to Elamma 25 shekels of silver apiece.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ITU.1.KAM ṣí-ip-um li-mu-um PUZUR₄-{d}MU IGI a-bu-sa-lim DUMU i-dí-ìr-ra IGI i-dí-a-šùr DUMU pu-ur-sí-sí-im
target: Month VII, eponymy of Puzur-Nirah. In the presence of Abu-šalim son of Iddin-Erra, of Iddin-Aššur, son of Bursa / isum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: na-áš-pá-ar-tám ša KÙ.BABBAR <gap> ša i-dí-a-bu-um a-na ṣé-er i-tur₄-DINGIR ù a-lá-ḫi-im ú-šé-bi₄-lá-ni
target: The missive concerning silver that Iddin-abum sent to Itūr-ilī and Ali-ahum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 me-at TÚG ku-ta-ni 4 GÚ AN.NA ù it-ra-sú 5 ANŠE.ḪI.A ša šu-be-lúm ù i-tur₄-DINGIR i-na <gap> ù tí-me-el-ki-a is-ni-qú-ni
target: As to the 100 kutānu-textiles, 4 talents of tin and its addition, 5 donkeys that Šu-Bēlum and Itūr-ilī checked in <gap> and Timelkiya,

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ta-ší-at AN.NA ù TÚG.ḪI.A iš-tù ḫa-ḫi-im a-dí ḫu-ra-ma 2 ma-na 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR áš-qúl
target: I paid 2 minas 10 shekels of silver for carriage of the tin and the textiles from hahhum to hurama.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na PUZUR₄-a-šur qí-bi-ma um-ma a-ni-wa-a-ni-ma
target: To Puzur-Aššur from Ani-wani:

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù 3 ITU.KAM ta-ta-lá-ak-ma mì-ma ú-lá tù-šé-bi₄-lam
target: You left 3 months ago and you have sent me nothing.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam dan-a-šur 2 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i-dí-nam šu-ut-ma
target: Dan-Aššur has given me 2 shekels of silver here, he himself.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ba-ru-um ma-ma-an lá-qá-am lá i-mu-a-šu
target: As to the lead, no one will take it.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 né-nu mì-nam ni-kà-al
target: Us four, what are we to eat?

source: translate Akkadian to English: qá-du-um ṣú-ḫa-ri-im ša SIG₅-a-a mì-šu-um KÙ.BABBAR ú-lá tù-šé-ba-lam-ma
target: Why do you not send any silver, with Damqaya's servant,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ma i-na bu-bu-tim ni-mu-a-at
target: for we are dying from hunger!

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma ḫu-bu-ru-um i-ta-al-kam
target: Indeed, the Netherworld has arrived.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma KÙ.BABBAR a-na ú-ku-ul-tí-a lá tù-šé-ba-lam a-ta-be-a-ma a-tal-kam
target: If you do not send me silver for my food I shall set out and come!

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma be-lí a-ta i-ḫi-id
target: If you are truly my lord - take care!

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ku-li-a qí-bi₄-ma um-ma a-šùr-i-mì-tí-ma
target: Say to Kuliya, thus Aššur-imittī:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.6666 ma-na 4 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i-na ša-lá-tù-ar me-eḫ-ra-tim a-šu-mì a-bi₄-ì-lí ṣú-ḫa-ri-kà a-dí-na-kum
target: In Šalatuwar I gave you 44 shekels of silver as counter value in the name of your servant Abī-ilī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na a-wi-tí-ni šu-ma KÙ.BABBAR-pì a-bi₄-DINGIR lá i-dí-nam 1 ma-na 6 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ta-da-nam
target: According to our agreement, should Abī-ilī not have given me my silver, you would give me 66 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù a-lim{ki} té-li-a-ma lá ni-na-me-er-ma ta-tù-ar
target: When you came up from the City we did not meet and you went back.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 ma-na 7 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ku-nu-ki ša en-na-sú-in ú el-pì-DINGIR na-áš-a-ku
target: I carry with me 2 minas and 7 shekels of silver under the seals of Ennam-Suen and Alpilī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫi a-ta šu-up-ra-ma KÙ.BABBAR ù ší-a-ma-tí-šu ša ší-ta ḫa-ra-na-tim lá-al-qé-ma ú ší-tí KÙ.BABBAR-pì-kà a-šar tù-ša-ḫi-zi-ni lá-dí-in
target: Please, my brother, write me that I can take the silver or what has been bought with it during two business trips and then I will give the rest of your silver where you will instruct me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na KÙ.BABBAR-áp IŠTAR-lá-ma-sí ša a DUMU-e-ša ta-dí-nu-ma KÙ.BABBAR i-na É e-lá-ma a-na-áb-šé-em ib-ší-ú ŠÀ.BA 7 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ì-lí-a i bu-ul-ṭí-šu i qá-tí-šu il₅-qé
target: From the silver of Ištar-lamassī that she gave to her sons and which silver rested as safe deposit in Elamma's house, from that silver Iliya, when he was still alive, took 7 shekels from his share.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù DUMU-ú ku-ni-lim me-tù lu a-na bi-ki-tí-šu-nu lu a-ku-sí-im ša um-mì-šu-nu ṭá-bu-im a-ḫu-ni e-ru-bu-ni-ma 0.3333 ma-na LÁ 0.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR lu a-bi₄-ki-tí-šu-nu lu a-na ku-sí-im ša um-mì-šu-nu lu a-na nu-a-im a šu-mì i-lí-a 7.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a ḫu-bu-li-šu i-ší-qí-il₅
target: After the sons of Kūn-ilum had died, (when) our brothers arrived for bewailing them and for removing the chair of their mother, 19.5 shekels of silver both for bewailing them and for the chair of their mother, and 7.5 shekels of silver to the Anatolian, because of Iliya for his debt, were paid.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-tí KÙ.BABBAR a-ṣé-er a-ḫa-tí-šu-nu DUMU.MÍ ku-ni-lim a-na a-lim{ki} i-lá-ak ù šu-ma-bi-a ša ki-ma DUMU-e ku-ni-lim ú-šé-bi₄-lu
target: The rest of the silver was sent to address of their sister, the daughter of Kūn-ilum, to the City, by son of Aššur-dān and Šumi-abiya, the representatives of Kūn-ilum's sons.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB a-ku-za DUMU šu-a-nim KIŠIB šu-a-nim DUMU <gap> ki KIŠIB i-dí-a-bi-im
target: Seal of Akuza son of Šu-Anum, seal of Šu-Anum son of <gap>ki, seal of Iddin-abum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša 2 ma-na KÙ.GI i-ku-pí-a-šùr a-na i-dí-a-bi-im DUMU i-sú-rik₁₃ i-dí-nu-ma
target: Concerning the 2 minas of gold that Ikūn-pī-Aššur gave to Iddin-abum son of Issu-arik,

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-um-šu i a-lim{ki} KI um-me-a-ni-šu i-lá-pu-tù
target: so he may write his name in the City together with his investors -

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ša-bu
target: he has been paid the silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.6666 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am bé-ú-la-tim ša ir-ma-a-šùr a-šùr-GAL ú-kà-al
target: 0.6666 mina of refined silver, the working capital of Ir'am-Aššur, Aššur-rabi has in his possession.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tí KÙ.BABBAR a-šùr-GAL uk-ta-al
target: With the silver Aššur-rabi is held (in service).

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-šùr-GAL IGI en-um-a-šùr
target: Witnessed by Aššur-rabi, by Ennam-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-šùr-UTU-ši ù en-na-sú-in iṣ-bu-tù-ni-a-tí-ma
target: Aššur-šamšī and Ennam-Suen seized us

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma en-na-sú-in-ma a-na a-šùr-UTU-ši-ma KÙ.BABBAR ki-iš-da-tí-a dí-nam
target: Ennam-Suen said to Aššur-šamšī: Give me the silver that accrues to me

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-šùr-UTU-ši-ma KÙ.BABBAR ú-lá a-da-na-kum a-na li-ta-tim ak-ru-ub-kà
target: Aššur-šamšī answered: I will not give you the silver, for I have you for

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma en-na-sú-in-ma mì-šu-um a-ta i-a-tí ta-kà-ra-ba-ni me-er-i-kà ku-ru-ub
target: Ennam-Suen said: Why is it me that you are me? Do it to your sons

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-šùr-UTU-ši-ma a-na ga-am-ri-kà a-na-ku a-za-za-kum
target: Aššur-šamšī answered: I will personally take your expenses for my account

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI zu-ba IGI PUZUR₄-{d}IŠKUR a-lá-bu-um DUMU zi-a tap-pá-i-ni
target: In the presence of Zuba and of Puzur-Adad; Ali-abum, son of Zia was our colleague

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-rum kà-ni-eš i-dí-ni-a-tí-ma
target: For these words the Kanesh colony made us available

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pá-am IGI GÍR ša a-šùr ší-bu-tí-ni ni-dí-in
target: and this tablet with our testimony we presented before Aššur's dagger

source: translate Akkadian to English: pá-šu-ru ša IGI i-li-šu
target: tables that were in front of his gods

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ku-sí-um ša IGI a-šùr
target: 1 chair that was in front of Aššur

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 kà-sú-um ša IGI ša-ru-ma-té-en
target: 1 goblet that was in front of Šarru-mātēn

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 kà-sú-um ša KÙ.BABBAR ú ší-ku-tù-um ša IGI ú-qú-ur
target: 1 silver goblet and a flask that was in front of Uqur

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 kà-ku-ú 2 qá-áb-li-a-tum 1 li-bu-um ša KÙ.BABBAR 1 ni-kà-sú ú 1 ṭup-pu-um ša is-ku-ri-im
target: 5 weapons, 2 -containers, 1 heart of silver, 1 emblem and 1 wax tablet

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ma a-nim ša DUMU ku-ra
target: all this, belonging to Kura's son

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-nu-mì e-kál-lu-šu en-um-a-šur ip-té-ú
target: When Ennam-Aššur opened his main house

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI ku-ku-wa IGI ma-nu-ki-ì-lí-a
target: Witnessed by Kukuwa, by Mannum-kī-iliya

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-šur-{d}UTU-ši ù en-na-sú-in qí-bi₄-ma um-ma a-al-DU₁₀-ma
target: Say to Aššur-šamšī and Ennam-Suen, thus Āl-ṭāb.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-šur-{d}UTU-ši qí-bi₄-ma mì-šu ša ta-áš-pu-ra-ni-ni um-ma a-tù-nu-ma al-kam ṣí-tám ni-ša-kà-an
target: Say in particular to Aššur-šamšī: Why are youplur. writing me as follows: 'Come here, we must submit the expenditures'?

source: translate Akkadian to English: tám-kà-ru-um i-na re-ší-a i-za-az KÙ.BABBAR 1-ma-na a-ša-qá-al
target: The creditor keeps a check on me (because) I have to pay 1 mina of silver!

source: translate Akkadian to English: ke-e lá-li-kà-am ú-lá 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i-na qá-tí-a i-ba-ší
target: How could I come while I do not even have 10 shekels of silver available?

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫu-a a-tù-nu a-dí ITU.1.KAM qá-i-a-ni
target: Please, my brothers, wait one month more for me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma e-mu-qá-tám e-pá-áš-ku-nu-ma ma a kà-ri-im i-lá-ak-ma kà-ru-um i-da-ku-nu ù a-na-ku qá-dí-ku-nu-ma
target: If he treats you in a violent way, yea even turns to the colony and the colony makes you appear in court, then I am with you in it!

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-bi₄ a-ta šé-ṭù-ta-kà a-na-ku a-lá-qé
target: My dear father, could I hold you in contempt?

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-lá-nu-kà-a a-ba-am ša-ni-am ni-šu
target: Do we have any father but you?

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na tù-ùḫ-pì-a e-tí-iq-ma KÙ.BABBAR 10 GÍN ù 0.3333 ma-na ma-lá ga-am-ri-a a-lá-qé-a-ma ù a-ta-bi₄-a-ma a-ta-lá-kam
target: I will travel on to Tuhpiya and try to get some silver, 10 or 20 shekels, as much as I need for my expenses, then I will get moving and depart for you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-bi₄ a-ta DÍ-RI-ú
target: You, my father, <gap>!

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ú ni-is-ḫa-sú wa-ta-ar ša-du-a-sú ša-bu-ú ša i-ku-pí-a a-na PUZUR₄.IŠTAR i-na a-lim{ki} ḫa-bu-lu-ú
target: The 10 shekels of silver, its import duty added, its transport tariff paid for, that Ikūn-pīya owes to Puzur-Ištar in the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam šu-ḫu-bu-ur il₅-qé
target: Šu-hubur has received that here.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma i-ku-pí-a a-na PUZUR₄.IŠTAR lá i-ta-ḫa-ba-al a-na KÙ.BABBAR ša il₅-qé-ú ma-na-um ma-na i-ša-qal
target: If Ikūn-pīya did not owe anything to Puzur-Ištar, he must pay (a fine of) mina for mina the silver he received.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ITU.KAM ḫu-bu-ur li-mu-um bu-zu-ta-a
target: Month hubur, eponymy Buzutaya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI ṣí-lu-šu-da-ga-an IGI DINGIR-ma-a-šur
target: Witnessed by Ṣilluš-Dagān, by Ilīma-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-iš-ḫa-ra-ma a-na pì-lá-aḫ-IŠTAR ú-ṣur-ša-a-šur ù a-bu-ša-lim qí-bi₄-ma
target: Thus Šu-Išhara, say to Pilah-Ištar, Uṣur-ša-Aššur and Abu-šalim.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ú-ṣur-ša-a-šur qí-bi₄-ma
target: and in particular to Uṣur-ša-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 GÚ SÍG.ḪI.A 2 ANŠE ṣa-lá-me ù ú-nu-sú-nu ša DAM.GÀR ša i-na IGI ší-be-e áp-qí-da-ku-ni
target: 4 talents of wool, 2 black donkeys and their harness, belonging to the merchant, which I entrusted to you in the presence of witnesses.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-na-ku-ma lu-qú-tum ša DAM.GÀR lá i-ṣa-ba-at {d}UTU e-ru-bu-ni lu-qú-tám a-na KÙ.BABBAR ta-er-ma a-bu-ša-lim 5 u₄-me-e lá tù-sà-as-ḫa-ar
target: whereby I said: 'The merchandise belongs to the merchant, it must not be seized! Convert it the very day it arrives into silver and let Abu-šalim not stay around for even 5 days!'

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí-ma 5 u₄-me-e lá tù-sà-as-ḫu-ru-šu-ni 7 ITU.KAM tù-uš-té-ší-ib-šu
target: While you were not to let him stay around for 5 days you made him stay 7 months!

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma a-ḫi a-ta {d}UTU ṭup-pá-am ta-ša-me-ú lu-qú-tám a-na pì-lá-aḫ-IŠTAR ù a-bu-ša-lim pì-qí-id-ma lu-ub-lu-nim
target: Please, my brother, the very day you hear this tablet, you must entrust the merchandise to Pilah-Ištar and Abu-šalim so that they bring it here.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù mì-šu ša tù-ma-ší-ḫi-ni
target: Moreover, why are you treating me with contempt?

source: translate Akkadian to English: 14.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR KI ì-lí-dan DUMU šu-ki-tim
target: 14.5 shekels of silver is owed by Ilī-dan son of Šukkutum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 ma-na 10 GÍN KÙ.KI šu-IŠTAR ša sà-e-im ba-lu-ni ma ar DUMU e-dí-ší-in na ḫi ni ù ṣa-al-tí <gap> iš-tù 10 ša-na-at 10 GÍN.TA <gap> i-lá-ak-šu-nu-tí i qá-qá-ad ke-ni-šu-nu ra-ki-is
target: 2 minas 10 shekels of silver is owed by Šu-Ištar, the wailer. <gap>son of Edišin <gap> for 10 years (interest) will accrue to them at the rate 10 shekels per <gap> They are jointly liable.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 15 GÍN KÙ.KI 2.5 ma-na URUDU KI a-bu-um-DINGIR DUMU a-be-lá
target: 15 shekels of gold and 2.5 minas of copper is owed by Abum-ilī son of Abela.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5.5 GÍN KÙ.KI {d}IM-pí-lá-aḫ DUMU a-ḫu-qar IGI pí-lá-aḫ-ŠA.ŠA
target: 5.5 shekels of silver is owed by Adad-pilah son of Ahu-waqar. Witnessed by Pilah-<gap>

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 ma-na <gap> GÍN KÙ.BABBAR KI ḫa-zu-a-lá
target: 5 minas <gap> shekels of silver is owed by hazuwalla.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na KÙ ša i-a-tí ù PUZUR₄.IŠTAR DUMU {d}AB-ba-ni KI be-lu-dan ù lá-qé-ep
target: 1 mina of silver belonging to me and Puzur-Ištar son of Illil-bāni is owed by Bēlu-dan and Lā-qēp.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.6666 ma-na KÙ na-dí-bu-um
target: 0.6666 mina of silver: Nadibum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na 3 ma-na i-sú-ḫi
target: For 3 minas: Isuhu.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na 5 GÍN a-ka-bi
target: 0.5 mina 5 shekels: Akabi.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.5 ma-na na-ab-sú-in i-nu-um-IŠTAR
target: 1.5 mina: Nab-Suen (and) Ennam-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.3333 ma-na 2 GÍN a-ḫu-qar DUMU a-ba-a-a
target: 1.3333 mina 2 shekels: Ahu-waqar son of Abaya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na 13 GÍN e-ri-DINGIR ù šu-IŠTAR a-ḫu-šu
target: 1 mina 13 shekels: Eri-ilī and his brother Šu-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na 15 GÍN KI ma-nu-ki-DINGIR-a i-ku-bu-ur ú-ṭí-tim i-ša-qal šu-ma lá eš-qúl 1 ma-na-um 0.3333 ma-na i-lá-ak iš-tù li-mì-im ša i-dí-sú-in DUMU šu-lí
target: 1 mina 15 shekels is owed by Mannu-kī-iliya; he is to pay when the grain is ripe. If he has not paid (in time) 0.3333 mina per mina will accrue (as interest). From the eponymy of Iddin-Suen son of Šuli.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 GÍN za-ar-ta-nim 1 ma-na URUDU ša bíl-li-tim 0.3333 ma-na LÁ 2 GÍN
target: 10 shekels of, 1 mina of copper from <gap>, 0.3333 mina less 2 shekels is owed by Ilšu-dan.

source: translate Akkadian to English: Šu-Bēlum owes <gap> shekels of refined silver to Šu-Illil; he is held in service with the silver - including his tablet from Kanesh. Witnessed by Šalim-Aššur son of Iliya, by Sasiya.
target: Šu-Bēlum owes <gap> shekels of refined silver to Šu-Illil; he is held in service with the silver - including his tablet from Kanesh. Witnessed by Šalim-Aššur son of Iliya, by Sasiya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: Ilī-idī owes 0.3333 mina less 2 shekels of silver to Šu-Illil. Witnessed by Emeni, by Ilī-ašrannī son of Šu-Ištar.
target: Ilī-idī owes 0.3333 mina less 2 shekels of silver to Šu-Illil. Witnessed by Emeni, by Ilī-ašrannī son of Šu-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 minas of refined silver is owed by Šu-Kūbum <gap> he must pay.
target: 2 minas of refined silver is owed by Šu-Kūbum <gap> he must pay.

source: translate Akkadian to English: Amurrum-bāni took 20 minas of copper for grain. Witnessed by Iddin-abum, by Šalim-Aššur son of Iliya.
target: Amurrum-bāni took 20 minas of copper for grain. Witnessed by Iddin-abum, by Šalim-Aššur son of Iliya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: Ennam-Aššur owes 70 grain to Šu-Illil. He is to measure out the good grain in a year. Witnessed by <gap>ni, by Šu-Anum.
target: Ennam-Aššur owes 70 grain to Šu-Illil. He is to measure out the good grain in a year. Witnessed by <gap>ni, by Šu-Anum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: After 6 months have passed a year will pass and he must pay 1 mina <gap>
target: After 6 months have passed a year will pass and he must pay 1 mina <gap>

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB šu-be-lim DUMU i-sú-rik₁₃
target: Seal of Šu-Bēlum son of Issu-arik;

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na en-na-sú-in a-ḫi-šu
target: to his brother Enna-Suen

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú a-lá-ḫi-im DUMU šál-ma-a-šur
target: and to Ali-ahum son of Šalim-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 11 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša a-mur-IŠTAR KI en-um-a-šùr i-ba-ší
target: 11 shekels of silver belonging to Amur-Ištar is owed by Ennam-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ku-zi-zi-a IŠTAR-lá-ma-sí na-áb-sú-in a-na-a-na a-mur-IŠTAR ša-lim-ar-dí ù ma-nu-ki-ì-lí-a qí-bi-ma um-ma en-um-a-šùr-ma
target: To Kuziziya, Ištar-lamassī, Nāb-Suen, Anna-anna, Amur-Ištar, Šalim-wardī and Mannum-kī-iliya from Ennam-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.5 ma-na 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ku-nu-ki ša ku-ku-wa ù ku-nu-ki-a 7 ANŠE.ḪI ú ú-nu-sú-nu mì-ma a-nim i-a-um ma-nu-ki-ì-lí-a na-áš-a-ku-nu-tí
target: 1 ½ mina 5 shekels of silver sealed by Kukuwa and by me, 7 donkeys and their harness - all this belonging to me, Mannum-kī-iliya brings to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ṣé-er KÙ.BABBAR a-nim ša ma-nu-ki-DINGIR-a na-áš-a-ku-nu-tí-ni a-na 3 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ú ṣí-ba-tí-šu ša ku-ku-wa a-na ma-nu-ki-a-šur DUMU MAN.IŠTAR ḫa-bu-lu-ni-ma 20 GÚ SÍG.ḪI.A a-na ša-pár-tim ú-kà-lu-ni
target: In addition to this silver that Mannum-kī-iliya brings to you, for the 3 minas of silver and its interest that Kukuwa owes to Mannum-kī-Aššur son of Puzur-Ištar, and for which he holds 20 talents of wool as security -

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ša ki-ma i-a-tí qí-bi-ma a-ma-kam ma-lá KÙ.BABBAR IŠTAR-lá-ma-sí ù ma-nu-ki-ì-lí-a i-ḫa-šu-ḫu-ni KÙ.BABBAR lu i-na ša ba-áb-tí-a ta-am-ḫu-ra-ni lu KÙ.BABBAR ša a-na ṣé-er a-na-na ku-nu-ki-a ú-šé-bi₄-lá-ni a-na ṣí-ib-tim KÙ.BABBAR ki-ma a-wa-at kà-ri-im dí-na-šu-nu-tí-ma
target: say to my representatives: Whatever silver Ištar-lamassī and Mannum-kī-iliya ask for there, lend them silver against interest according to the rate of the colony - from which silver you have received from my outstanding claims, or silver I sent to Anna-anna under my seal, and transfer 1 mina of refined silver thereof to them,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ.BA 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am ṭí-iḫ-a-šu-nu-tí-ma ṭup-pá-am ša ḫu-bu-ul IŠTAR-lá-ma-sí ù ma-nu-ki-ì-lí-a DUMU-i-ša i qá-qá-ad šál-mì-šu-nu ḫi-
target: write a debt-note for Ištar-lamassī and Mannum-kī-iliya, her son, certify it with joint liability, and give the tablet to my maid so it may remain in her possession until I come.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ku-ni-lim qí-bi₄-ma um-ma a-mur-a-šur-ma
target: Say to Kūn-ilum, thus Amur-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-šu-mì URUDU ša a-šur-{d}UTU-ši ša ta-áš-pu-ra-ni um-ma a-ta-ma i-nu-mì a-ta-al-kà-ni URUDU i-na ba-áb-tí-a áš-lu-uṭ-ma áp-qí-da-ku-nu-tí
target: As for Aššur-šamšī's copper, about which you wrote me, saying: 'When I left I decided to entrust to you (the collection of) copper from my outstanding claims.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-na-ku-ma URUDU šé-ṣí-a-ma 3.5 GÚ URUDU a-na a-šur-{d}UTU-ši šé-bi₄-lá
target: saying: 'Produce the copper and send 3.5 talents of copper to Aššur-šamšī'.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na ba-áb-tim ša ta-áš-lu-ṭù-ni-a-tí-ni 1 GÚ 3 ma-na ša šu-mì-a-ar ḫa-bu-lu
target: Of the outstanding claims you authorized us to collect, 1 talent 3 minas are owed by Šumi'ar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-mì-a-ar i-mu-ut-ma me-er-ú-šu i-na ku-na-na-mì-it a-di u₄-mì-im a-nim uš-bu-ma URUDU i-ta-am-sà-ar
target: (but) Šumi'ar has died and his sons live until today in Kunanamit, so that the copper has been tied up.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ni i-li-ku-nim-ma 23 ma-na URUDU SIG₅ nu-ku-ra-e e-ta-wu um-ma šu-nu-ma 40 ma-na-e-ma ší-im ḫi-dim KÙ.KI a-bu-ni ḫa-bu-ul
target: They have now come here, but they contested 23 minas of the copper, saying: 'Our father only owes 40 minas, the price of a golden bead!'

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-na-ku-ma 40 ma-na ší-im ḫi-dim KÙ.KI ù 23 ma-na ší-im AN.NA iš-té-ni-iš 1 GÚ 3 ma-na a-bu-ku-nu ḫa-bu-ul
target: I answered them: '40 minas, the price of the golden bead plus 23 minas, the price of tin, together 1 talent 3 minas is what your father owes!'

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-nu-ma URUDU né-ma-ra-ku-um-ma ù ta-ta-ma ta-lá-qé
target: They said: 'We will find the copper for you and then, when you swear you can take it'.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 GÚ ša du-du-na ḫa-bu-lu aṣ-ba-sú-ma um-ma šu-ut-ma URUDU lá i-šu a ṣí-ib-tim li-is-ḫu-ra-am
target: As for the 1 talent that Duduna owes, I seized him and he said: 'I have no copper, let it become interest bearing'.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na 1 GÚ URUDU SIG₅ 1 GÚ 30 ma-na URUDU SIG₅ a-na da-áš-e i-ša-qal
target: For the 1 talent of refined copper he will pay 1.5 talent of refined copper, in late spring.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na en-nu-um-a-šur KIŠIB a-mur-IŠTAR
target: To Ennam-Aššur; seal of Amur-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 ma-na URUDU ú 2 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR
target: 3 minas of copper and 2 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-lá-ḫu-um en-um-a-šur e-pu-ul um-ma a-lá-ḫu-um-ma
target: Ali-ahum answered Ennam-Aššur, saying:

source: translate Akkadian to English: ta-aḫ-sí-sà-tum ku-nu-ku-kà ú ku-nu-ku-a ba-a 3 lu ni-iṣ-ba-at
target: The memoranda have your seal and mine. Come on, let us seize 3 (witnesses).

source: translate Akkadian to English: a ma-lá ta-aḫ-sí-sà-tí ša i-na ku-nu-ki-ni lu ni-iz-ku ù KÙ.BABBAR ma-lá a-bu-ni <gap> i li-bi-a ú i li-bi-kà i-dí-ú-ma ṭup-pá-am a-bu-ni e-zi-bu-ma
target: Let us settle the affair in accordance with the memoranda sealed by us; further, our father left a tablet behind about how much silver he set down as owed by me and you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pá-am um-me-a-nu a-bi-ni ú-kà-i-lu-ni-ma i-na ma-ḫa-ar kà-ri-im iš-ku-nu-šu-ma kà-ru-um a-na ra-bi-ṣí-im ṭup-pá-am ip-qí-du-ni
target: And our father's investors kept the tablet and they have placed it before the colony, and the colony has entrusted the tablet to the attorney.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ba-a ú-ma-ma ma-lá KÙ.BABBAR lá-áp-ta-ni-ni lu ni-iš-qú-ul-ma a ma-lá dí-in a-lim{ki} KÙ.BABBAR <gap> lu ni-ik-nu-uk-ma a-na a-lim{ki} lu ni-li-ik
target: Come on, let us pay even today as much silver as we are booked for, let us seal it in accordance with the verdict of the City and go to the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pá-am ša a-lim{ki} ú ra-bi-ṣa-am lá nu-na-aḫ lá ri-ig-ma-tù ší-bu-tù
target: Let us not obstruct the tablet of the City and the attorney. This is not a formal lawsuit but a witnessed statement.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB šu-ta-mu-zi e-la-a en-um-a-šùr DUMU e-la-ma ù lá-ma-sí
target: Sealed by Šu-Tammuzī, Elaya, Ennam-Aššur son of Elamma and Lamassī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ša-lim-a-šur-ma a-na i-dí-a-bi-im e-na-nim i-na-aḫ-DINGIR i-ku-pí-a šu-IŠTAR ù en-nam-a-šur qí-bi-ma
target: From Šalim-Aššur to Iddin-abum, Ennānum, Inah-ilī, Ikūn-piya, Šu-Ištar and Ennam-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 8 ma-na 13 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-šur-ra-bi ù a-ḫu-šu DUMU a-ku-za ḫa-bu-lu-nim
target: Aššur-rabi and his brother, the sons of Akuza, owe me 8 minas 13 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ša-me-ma KÙ.BABBAR lá-qé
target: I hear that the silver has been received.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 8 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR iš-tí <gap> li a-ni-im iš-tù 4 ša-na-tim ṣí-ib-tám ù-ṣa-áb
target: For the 8 minas of silver he must add interest with this <gap> for 4 years.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu a-we-el-tum KÙ.BABBAR tal-qé lu en-nam-a-šur il₅-qí-i
target: Whether the lady has received it or Ennam-Aššur has received it,

source: translate Akkadian to English: qá-qá-ad KÙ.BABBAR a-we-lá-am iṭ-ra-šu-ma a-we-el-tum kà-aṣ-da-at
target: take the capital sum from the man, for the lady is tied down.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR lu tá-áš-qú-ul-ma ší-a-tí li-zi-zi-im
target: You are to pay the silver and it must become available for her.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma a-ki-am iš-tí a-we-li-im na-am-gi₅-ra
target: If it is like that, make an agreement with the man.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṣí-ib-tám ša ša-tim iš-tí-in le-qé-a-ma <gap>-a ma-li-a-nim
target: Take interest for a single year and <gap> pay in full.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫu-a a-tù-nu ṭup-pá-am a-we-el-tám ša-áš-me-a
target: My dear brothers, make the lady listen to the letter.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ú-kà-pá-am e-dí-am 4 eb-le-e 2-ší-na ma-at-li-iḫ-šé-e a-za-mì-lam ḫu-ur-ší-a-num ša du-ul-ba-tim ḫu-ur-ší-a-num ša kà-ma-re-e 2-ší-na eb-lu-ú i du-ur-ḫu-mì-it
target: 1 saddlecloth, 4 ropes, 2 pack-saddles, a sack, a box with dulbatum, a box with kamaru-fish, two ropes, in Durhumit.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ḫu-ur-ší-a-num ša ili₅-ba-ni DUMU mu-ta-lim 3 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ḫa-bu-ul
target: A box of Ili-bani, son of Mutalum, 3 shekels of silver he owes.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.3333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša a-na-aḫ-ì-lí a-na al-pì-lí i-lá-ak
target: 1.3333 mina of silver of Anah-ili will go to Alpili.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR i-na pá-ni-tí-a i-lá-ak
target: 0.5 mina of silver will go with the first opportunity I have.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ma a-nim iš-tí al-pì-lí
target: All this is with Alpili.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 ma-na URUDU iš-tí a-ša-at a-šur-SIG₅ ša tù-ùḫ-pì-a e-ma-ra-am ù ú-nu-sú-ú a-ḫa-ma
target: 10 minas of copper with the wife of Assur-damiq of Tuhpiya, a donkey with its harness (and) separately.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na a-sà-nim ḫa-bu-ul
target: 3 shekels of silver he owes to Asanum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 18 TÚG šu-ru-tim ù 10 TÚG ku-ta-ni
target: 18 dark textiles and 10 -textiles,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 GÚ AN.NA ù li-wi-sú ku-nu-ki-šu ša a-lim{ki}
target: 2 talents of tin with its wrapping, under his seals applied in the City,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 ANŠE ṣa-lá-me ú ú-nu-sú-nu ša a-lá-ḫi-im
target: 2 black donkeys with their harness belonging to Ali-ahum,

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-šur-iš-tí-kál áp-qí-id
target: I entrusted to Aššuriš-tikal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 16 GÚ 13 ma-na URUDU SIG₅ ŠÀ.BA 6 GÚ 40 ma-na URUDU SIG₅ ší-im KÙ.BABBAR iš-tí ì-lí-dan a-ba-ba ra-bi₄-ṣú-um ù a-lá-ḫu-um il₅-qé
target: The attorney Ababa and Ali-ahum received 16 talents 13 minas of good copper; thereof 6 talents 40 minas of good copper, the price of silver - from Ilī-dan.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma bé-lá-num ù lá-ma-sà-tum-ma a-na {d}UTU-ba-ni ù pì-lá-aḫ-IŠTAR qí-bi-ma
target: Thus Bēlānum and Lamassutum, say to Šamaš-bāni and Pilah-Ištar:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 26 TÚG.ḪI.A ša šu-sú-in DUMU ì-lí-a i-na 5 na-ru-qá-tim dar-ku ku-nu-ku ša en-um-a-šur DUMU e-lá-ma
target: 26 textiles belonging to Šu-Suen, son of Iliya, are packed in 5 bags under the seals of Ennam-Aššur, son of Elamma.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫa-ma 1 TÚG ku-sí-tum ša ú-ṣur-ša-a-šur iz-kà-nim kà-an-kà-ma e-lá-nu-ma i-ba-ší
target: Separately 1 -garment of Uṣur-ša-Aššur that has been sealed later? is also available.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠU.NÍGIN 27 TÚG.ḪI.A a-šur-{d}UTU-ši DUMU na-na kà-ší-im en-um-a-šur DUMU e-lá-ma ip-qí-sú-um
target: In all 27 textiles, <to> Aššur-šamšī, son of Nanakaš(š)um, Ennam-Aššur, son of Elamma entrusted (them).

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI ša-lim-a-šur DUMU a-zi-da IGI a-šur-ma-lik DUMU en-um-a-šur IGI DUMU sú-in-na-da DUMU a-kà-zi ip-qí-sú-um
target: Before Šalim-Aššur, son of Azida, Aššur-mālik, son of Ennam-Aššur, (and) Suen-nādā, son of Akazi, he entrusted (them) to him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-wi-lúm sà-ki-il₅
target: The man is stupid.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 ší-ta na-áš-pè-ra-tim ša en-um-a-šur pì-lá-aḫ-IŠTAR na-ší
target: Pilah-Ištar has with him 2 missives of Ennam-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma a-na TÚG.ḪI.A wa-šu-ri-im a-šur-{d}UTU-ši mì-ma i-qá-bi₄ na-áš-pè-er-tí en-um-a-šur ša-áš-me-a-šu-ma TÚG.ḪI.A ku-nu-ki na-ru-qá-NIM li-ip-qí-da-ku-nu-tí-ma a-na pí-lá-aḫ-IŠTAR a-ḫi-šu mu-nu-a-šu-ma a ma-lá té-er-tí-ni le-pu-uš
target: If Aššur-šamšī protests against releasing the textiles, let him hear the missive of Ennam-Aššur and let him entrust the textiles (and?) the seals of the bags to youplur and cound them! out to his brother Pilah-Ištar, who must act in accordance with our instruction.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na <gap> um-ma a-bi-<gap> KI ku-ra al-qé <gap> ku-ur-zi-a <gap> 4 GÚ KI a-šùr-i-mì-tí
target: To Ennam-Aššur from Abi-<gap> I received <gap> from Kura. <gap> Kurziya <gap> 4 talents owed by Aššur-imittī.

target: 3 talent 23 minas of copper owed by Iliš-tikal. <gap> Amur-Assur and Ataya <gap> I owe to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 20 ma-na ší-im ku-ta-nim ša a-bi-ì-lí i li-bi₄-a
target: 20 minas, the proceeds from Abī-ilī's is in my possession.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 8.5 ma-na KI a-bi₄-ì-lí
target: 8.5 minas owed by Abī-ilī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠU.NÍGIN 18 GÚ 50.5 ma-na URUDU ba-a-áb-tám té-zi-ba-am
target: In all: you left me 18 talents 50.5 minas of copper as outstanding claims.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ.BA 2.5 GÚ KI ku-ra al-qé 2 GÚ KI a-šur-i-mì-tí al-qé 2 GÚ 17 ma-na iš-tí ì-lí-iš-tí-kál al-qé 1 GÚ KI a-mur-a-šur al-qé 1 GÚ 38 ma-na iš-tí ku-ur-zi ù šu-ni-sà-ba al-qé
target: Of that I received 2.5 talents from Kura, 2 talents from Aššur-imittī, 2 talents 17 minas from Iliš-tikal, 1 talent from Amur-Aššur, 1 talent 38 minas from Kurzī and Šu-Nisaba.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠU.NÍGIN 9 GÚ 25 ma-na URUDU ša i ba-a-áb-tí-kà al-qé-ú
target: In all 9 talents 25 minas of copper that I received from your outstanding claims.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù a-na-ku 36 ma-na ú-ra-dí-ma 10 GÚ 1 ma-na a-na pu-ru-uš-ḫa-dí-e áš-qú-ul
target: Also, I personally added 36 minas and I paid 10 talents 1 mina to the men from Purušhaddum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 35 ma-na <gap> šu-mì-a-bi-a <gap> 30 ma-na <gap> a É kà-ri-im <gap> ma-áš-ḫi-li <gap> i li-bi <gap> 2 ma-na <gap> sà-nu-qí-im <gap> a-na <gap> la <gap> ù <gap> me <gap> a-<gap> ú-šé-ṣa-ma KÙ.BABBAR ša DAM.GÀR-ri-im ú-ša-áš-qá-al-ma ší-tí URUDU-kà a KÙ.BABBAR ú-ta-ar
target: 35 minas <gap> Šumi-abiya <gap> 30 minas <gap> for the office of the colony <gap> I shall lead out and I shall have the silver of the merchant paid, and convert the rest of your colony to silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na URUDU ša pu-šu-ki-in ù <gap> tí-šu a
target: As to Pūšu-kēn's copper and his <gap> I shall sell it for silver, set out and leave.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-ri-šum da-dí-a iṣ-ba-at-ma um-ma i-ri-šum-ma ig-ri ša 4 ANŠE.ḪI.A ša ta-as-ri-du KÙ.BABBAR dí-na-am
target: Irišum seized Dādiya and Irišum said: Give me the hire in silver for the 4 donkeys that you packed!

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma da-dí-a-ma a-ma ANŠE-ri sí-ri-id
target: Dādiya answered: "There, pack the donkeys (yourself)!"

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma i-ri-šum-ma a-dí ma-la ù ší-ni-šu e-ri-iš-kà-ma lá ta-dí-na-am ANŠE.ḪI.A-ri a-na sà-ra-dí-im ta-sà-na-li-a-ni
target: Irišum said: "I have asked you once or twice, but you have not given it to me. You keep cheating me on the packing of the donkeys, yet I did rent the donkeys to you for 10 shekels of silver each.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR dí-na-am ú-ul i-na KÙ.BABBAR-pì-kà a-ṣa-ba-at a-ma a-ta lu tí-de₈
target: Give me the silver, or I shall seize it from your silver. There, know this!"

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na da-da-a-a a-lá-ḫi-im ù {d}EN.LÍL-ba-ni qí-bi-ma um-ma PUZUR₄-a-šur-ma
target: To Dadaya, Ali-ahum and Illil-bāni from Puzur-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.3333 ma-na 2 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR šu-ḫu-bur DUMU i-dí-a-bi₄-im li-iš-qú-lá-ku-nu-tí-ma
target: Šu-hubur son of Iddin-abum should pay you 0.3333 mina 2 shekels of silver,

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR šu-a-tí a-na {d}EN.LÍL-ba-ni DUMU a-šùr-ma-lik šu-uq-lá-ma ṭup-pí šé-ṣí-a-ma li-it-a-ma a-šar a-lá-ḫi-im i-na li-bi-i ṭup-pé-e-a šu-uk-na
target: and then pay this silver to Ilill-bāni son of Aššur-malik, obtain the release of my tablet, split it and place it with my other tablets with Ali-ahum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫu-ú-a a-tù-nu iḫ-da-ma KÙ.BABBAR šu-ḫu-bur ša-áš-qí-lá-ma ṭup-pí-i šé-ṣí-a-nim
target: My dear brothers, take care to have Šu-hubur pay the silver and obtain the release of my tablet for me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša ša-lim-a-šur a-na a-šur-i-mì-tí DUMU a-mur-DINGIR ni-ip-qí-id
target: sealed by Šalim-Aššur we entrusted to Aššur-imittī son of Amur-ilī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫa-ma 7 ma-na 13 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am a-šur-i-mì-tí DUMU a-mur-DINGIR i-na KÙ.BABBAR-ap ša-lim-a-šùr il₅-qé
target: Further, Aššur-imittī son of Amur-ilī received 7 minas 13 shekels of refined silver from Šalim-Aššur's silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI ú-ra-a IGI pu-šu-ke-en₆
target: Witnessed by Uraya, by Pūšu-kēn.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR a-ni-a-am ki-ma šál-ma-a-šùr MAR.TU-ba-ni ù a-šùr-SIPA ip-qí-du
target: Amurrum-bāni and Aššur-rē'ī entrusted this silver on behalf of Šalim-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB IŠTAR-pá-li-il₅ DUMU šu-ku-bi₄-im KIŠIB ni-mar-IŠTAR DUMU ba-la KIŠIB a-bu-ša-lim DUMU ì-lí-a-lúm
target: Seal of Ištar-pālil, son of Šu-Kūbum, seal of Nimar-Ištar, son of Bala, seal of Abu-šalim, son of Ilī-ālum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am i-ṣé-er IŠTAR-pá-li-il₅ DUMU šu-ku-bi₄-im DAM.GÀR-ru-um i-šu
target: 0.5 mina of refined silver Ištar-pālil, son of Šu-Kūbum, owes to the creditor.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫa-ma 0.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na Ì.GIŠ sà-ar-dim na-ší
target: Separately he has with him 0.5 shekel of silver for (buying) olive oil.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí-i KÙ.BABBAR ša e-lá-lí-ni-ú-ma-an ù DAM a-ḫi-kà i-na e-ra-áb a-wi-il₅-tim <gap>-bi₄-a
target: As for the silver of Elal / niuman and your brother's wife, when the lady arrives <gap>.

source: translate Akkadian to English: PUZUR₄-a-šur DUMU i-ku-pí-a en-um-a-šur DUMU i-dí-sú-en₆ ù a-ḫu-šu i-dí-IŠTAR DUMU aḫ-ša-lim IŠTAR-ba-ni ma-ṣí-ì-lí en-nam-a-šur DUMU a-šur-dan šu-ma-a-bi₄-a ša ki-ma DUMU-e ku-ni-lim i pu-ùḫ-ri-šu-nu
target: Puzur-Aššur, son of Ikūn-pīya, Ennam-Aššur, son of Iddin-Suen, and his brother, Iddin-Ištar, son of Ah-šalim, Ištar-bāni, Maṣi-ilī Ennam-Aššur, son of Aššur-dān, Šumi-abiya - representing the sons of Kūn-ilum - collectively.

source: translate Akkadian to English: gám-ram ša bi₄-ki-tí-šu-nu ù ku-sí-im ša IŠTAR-lá-ma-sí i KÙ.BABBAR ša i É DAM e-lá-ma ib-ší-ú ig-mu-ru
target: paid the expenses of bewailing them and of Ištar-lamassī's chair from the silver that was in the house of Elamma's wife.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ḫu-ša-li DUMU a-šur-dan ù šu-ma-a-bi₄-a ik-nu-ku
target: The son of Aššur-dān and Šumi-abiya sealed the pouches.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi₄-ma um-ma MAN-a-šur-ma
target: To Ali-ahum from Puzur-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 48 TÚG dam-qú-tim 2 TÚG ša qá-tim 2 TÚG ša a-šur-be-el-a-wa-tim ša ta-ad-mì-iq-tim
target: 48 good textiles, 2 ordinary textiles, 2 textiles belonging to Aššur-bēl-awātim, a free loan,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 GÚ 10 ma-na ku-nu-ku 3 ANŠE ṣa-lá-me mì-ma a-nim ku-nu-ki šu-<gap>-ku ki-ma i-a-tí ip-qí-id <gap>
target: 2 talents 10 minas of sealed (tin), 3 black donkeys - all this sealed by <gap> my representative entrusted <gap>

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na ḫa-ḫi-im wa-áš-ba-ku
target: I am staying in hahhum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ší-tí ANŠE lu-qú-tim a-li-ik-ma ILLAT-tum ik-ta-al-ú-ni
target: I left for the rest of the donkeys (with) the goods but they held up the caravan.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫi a-ta mì-li-ik lu-qú-tí-kà mì-li-ik tí-ir-ta-kà li-li-kam-ma lá a-sà-ḫu-ur
target: My dear brother, decide about your goods. Send me word, and I shall not delay.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a-na pá-ni-a šé-bi₄-lam
target: Send 1 mina of silver to meet me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB ku-la a-ḫu-ú šu-ku-tim KIŠIB PUZUR₄-tí-a-am-tim DUMU IŠTAR-pá-li-il₅ KIŠIB en-um-a-šur DUMU kà-ri-a KIŠIB en-na-sú-in DUMU i-dí-a-bi-im KIŠIB a-nu-li a-ḫi-šu
target: Seal of Kula brother of Šukkutum, seal of Puzur-Ti'amtum son of Ištar-pālil, seal of Ennam-Aššur son of Karria, seal of Enna-Suen son of Iddin-abum, seal of Anuli his brother.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu-qú-tám ša ša-lim-a-šur ša i-na ḫa-ḫi-im É i-sú-ri-ik ù me-er-ú i-dí-a-bi-im iṣ-bu-tù-ni-ma
target: As to the goods belonging to Šalim-Aššur that were in hahhum in the house of Issu-arik, and which the sons of Iddin-abum seized.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a ma-lá ṭup-pí-im ša dí-in a-lim{ki} ša kà-ku-a ub-lá-ni a-na lu-qú-tim ší-a-tí en-na-sú-in ù a-nu-li a-na ša-lim-a-šur ú-lá i-tù-ru
target: In accordance with the tablet with a verdict of the City that Kakuwa brought, Enna-Suen and Anuli must not raise claim against Šalim-Aššur with respect to these goods.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-dí-da a-la-ḫi-im ú ú-ku-ú qí-bi₄-ma um-ma PUZUR₄-a-šur-ma
target: To Adida, Ali-ahum, and Uku from Puzur-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam ša li-bi₄-ni pá-zu-ur-tù-šu ú 1 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR 0.3333 ma-na 1 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša-bu-ú IGI DINGIR-pì-la-aḫ
target: Here he has been paid 0.3333 mina 1 shekel of silver from what we had available, his smuggled goods plus 2 shekel of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma a-ma-kam wa-at-ra-am e-ri-iš-ma lu-ša-zi-za-ku-nu-tí-ma ú ra-ki-sà-šu-ma a-na ú-ku-ú qí-bi₄-ma um-ma PUZUR₄-a-šur-ma
target: Witnessed by Ilī-pilah. If he asks for more there, then let him appoint a stand-in for you and bind him over.

source: translate Akkadian to English: la-a aq-bi₄-a-ku-um um-ma a-na-ku-ma 2 ú-me-e la ta-sà-ḫu-ra-am sà-ḫi-ar-tí na-áp-ra-is ú ma-áš-ki ša-pá-tí-a la té-zi-ba-am
target: To Uku from Puzur-Aššur: Have I not told you as follows: 'Do not delay by two days. You did not leave me my small goods, a chisel and my woollen fleeces.'

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-kam šu-ma a-li-ku-um kà-li-i 3 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na ma-ṣa-ra-tí-im dí-na-ma ú-ku-ú ṭù-ur-da-ni-im
target: If the traveling party is detained there, then give 3 shekels of silver to the guards and send Uku to me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 ší-ta sà-ma-lá-tim ra-bi₄-a-tim a-<gap> ša ba-áb ni <gap> a-dí-šu-um
target: 2 big -cups <gap> of the gate <gap> I gave to him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 GÍN <gap> 4 sà-ma-lá-tim <gap> lá i-ḫa-li-qú <gap>
target: ½ shekel<gap> 4 -cups <gap> should not be lost.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na 11 TÚG ku-ta-ni ša e-lá-ma a-lá-ḫa-am ù a-mur-IŠTAR a-šur-lá-ma-sí a-na e-lá+lá-<gap>-ma ITU.5.KAM ú-kà-na-šu-nu
target: Concerning 11 textiles, belonging to Elamma, Aššur-lamassī shall confirm the liability of Ali-ahum and Amur-Ištar for Elamma within 5 months.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma lá ú-kà-i-na-šu-nu 0.3333 ma-na 5 GÍN.TA KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am i-ša-qal
target: If he does not confirm them he shall pay 25 shekels of refined silver apiece.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ITU.1.KAM ṣí-ip-um li-mu-um PUZUR₄-{d}MUŠ
target: Month VII, eponymy of Puzur-Nirah.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma i-na ša 10 TÚG-tum 1 TÚG wa-at-ru-ú-tim i-na É.GAL-lim il₅-qé-ŠU ki-iš-dá-tí-šu a-na e-lá-ma i-na TÚG.ḪI-tí-šu i-ṣa-ḫi-ir-šu-um
target: If one has taken extra pieces in the palace, on top of the tithe on textiles, what accrues from it to Elamma will be deducted for him from his textiles.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša ILLAT la-qé-ep DUMU qá-a-a-tim IGI i-dí-a-šur DUMU bu-sú-sú IGI a-bu-ša-lim DUMU i-dí-èr-ra
target: of the caravan of Lā-qēp, son of Qa'atum. In the presence of Iddin-Aššur, son of B / Pususu, of Abu-šalim, son of Iddin-Erra.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na {d}MAR.TU-ba-ni <gap> e-nu-um-bé-lim LUGAL-{d}IM ù pá-na-kà qí-bi-ma um-ma ša-lim-a-šùr-ma
target: To Amurrum-bāni, (<gap>), Ennam-Bēlum, Šar-Adad and Panaka from Šalim-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 12 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am ni-is-ḫa-sú DIRI ša-du-a-sú ša-bu ša a-na na-ru-uq a-šùr-bé-el-a-wa-tim ma-áš-qá-al-tám pá-ni-tám ḫa-bu-lá-ku-ni ku-nu-ki-a pá-na-kà ù a-šùr-GAL DUMU ni-dí-ba-ni na-áš-ú-ni-ku-nu-tí
target: Panaka and Aššur-rabi son of Nīde-bāni are bringing you 12 minas of refined silver - its import duty added, its transport tariff paid, under my seal, that I owe on Aššur-bēl-awātim's joint-stock capital, for the first instalment.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù ṭup-pí ša 12 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša ḫu-bu-li-a ša a-na 5 ša-na-tim a-ša-qú-lu-šu-nu-ma na-áš-ú-ni-ku-nu-tí
target: They also bring my tablet concerning 12 minas of silver from my debt, which I am to pay to them in 5 years.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam IGI 3 DUMU um-me-a-ni KÙ.BABBAR ù ṭup-pá-am áp-qí-sú-nu-tí
target: Here I entrusted the silver and the tablet to them with 3 affiliated traders as witnesses.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí 20 ma-na 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša wa-aḫ-šu-ša-na ša iš-tí šu-nu-nu ù šu-ku-bi-im i-ba-ší-ú KÙ.BABBAR ku-nu-ki-a lu-ub-lu-ni-ku-nu-tí-ma ù ṭup-pá-am pá-ni-am ša 24 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR li-dí-nu-ni-ku-nu-tí-ma i-na li-bi₄ ṭup-pí-a šu-uk-na-šu
target: As to 20 minas 10 shekels of silver from Wahšušana that is with Šu-Nūnu and Šu-Kūbum, let them bring you the silver under my seal and then let them give you the old tablet concerning 24 minas of silver and place it with my tablets.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ù ṭup-pá-am ša pá-na-kà ù a-šùr-GAL na-áš-ú-ni-ku-nu-tí-ni KÙ.BABBAR šu-uq-lá ù ṭup-pá-am ša ḫu-bu-li-a a-na ša ki-ma šu-ku-bi₄-im dí-na-a
target: As to the silver and the tablet that Panaka and Aššur-rabi are bringing to you, pay the silver and give the tablet concerning my debt to Šu-Kūbum's representatives.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma u₄-mu-a a-ḫu-ru
target: If my term is not yet up, note it in your memorandum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am i-na ší-im SÍG.ḪI.A ša ú-ší-na-lam i-lá-áš-ra-ni DUMU sú-kà-li-a il₅-qé
target: Ilī-ašrannī son of Sukkalliya has received 3 minas of refined silver from the proceeds of Ušinalam's wool.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-šùr-ba-ni DUMU kur-bi-a-a IGI iš-me-DINGIR IGI i-dí-ku-bi-im
target: Witnessed by Aššur-bāni son of Kurbiya, by Išme-ilum, by Iddin-Kūbum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na i-ku-pí-a li-bi-IŠTAR a-lá-ḫi-im ù a-šur-ma-lik a-na li-bi-IŠTAR qí-bi-ma um-ma PUZUR₄-a-na-ma
target: To Ikūn-pīya, Libbi-Ištar, Ali-ahum and Aššur-malik; specifically to Libbi-Ištar from Puzur-Anna:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ni-is-ḫa-sú DIRI ša-du-a-sú ša-bu ša DAM.GÀR-ri-im a-dí-na-kum
target: I gave you 3 minas of silver, its import duty added, its transport tariff paid for, belonging to a merchant.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na a-wa-tí-ni ší-a-ma-at a-lim{ki} lu 1 ma-na-um 0.6666 ma-na lu 1 ma-na-um 0.5 ma-na a-na DAM.GÀR-ri-im ta-da-an
target: According to our agreement you will give from the purchase in the City either 0.6666 mina or 0.5 mina per mina to the merchant.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù a-ta 4 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ni-is-ḫa-sú DIRI ša-du-a-sú ša-bu i-a-tí ki-ma DAM.GÀR ta-da-nam-ma ù a-na-ku DAM.GÀR-ru-um i-na e-la-i-a-ma iš-tù a-lim{ki} a-da-na-kum
target: Then, you will personally give 4 minas of silver, its import duty added, its transport tariff paid for, to me, on behalf of the merchant, and then I shall personally be the merchant; when I come up (to Anatolia) from the City I shall give it to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫi a-ta KÙ.BABBAR ù ší-a-ma-tim KÙ.BABBAR ma-la ta-na-dí-ú a-na ša ki-ma i-a-tí dí-in
target: My dear brother, give whatever silver and purchases you will deposit to my representatives.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù a-ta 4 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ni-is-ḫa-sú DIRI ša-du-a-sú ša-bu šé-bi₄-lam-ma KÙ.BABBAR ma-la a-ta ta-da-na-ni ù a-na-ku i-na e-lá-i-a ki-am la-dí-na-kum
target: Also, you must personally send me 4 minas of silver, its import duty added, its transport tariff paid for, and whatever silver you give to me I shall personally give to you in this way when I come up.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ša ki-ma i-a-tí qí-bi-ma šu-ma ší-ma-am i-da-na-ku-nu-tí la ta-ma-ḫa-ra-šu ù tí-ir-ta-ku-nu li-li-kam
target: To my representatives: If he gives you purchased goods, do not receive them but send me word.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ku-zi-zi-a-ma ù a-mur-IŠTAR-ma a-na a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi-ma
target: From Kuziziya and Amur-Ištar to Ali-ahum:

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na 15 TÚG ša a-mur-IŠTAR e-zi-bu iš-tù a-mur-IŠTAR i-tù-ra-ni 2 TÚG i-ni-id-nu
target: Of the 15 textiles that Amur-Ištar left behind two textiles have been sold after Amur-Ištar returned.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 TÚG ša a-bi-a-nu-um ú-šé-bi-lá-ni ú 4 TÚG ku-a-ú-tim ŠU.NÍGIN 8 TÚG i li-bi-a
target: 4 textiles that Abī-Anum sent and your own 4 textiles: in all 8 textiles are in my possession.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-šu ša a-na 6 TÚG.ḪI.A ša a-bi-a-nim ša ta-áš-pu-ra-ni a-lá-an 4 TÚG ša ú-šé-bi₄-lá-ni mì-ma wa-at-ra-am lá ú-šé-bi₄-lam
target: Why is it that as for the 6 textiles belonging to Abī-Anum that you wrote about, apart from the 4 textiles he sent he has not sent anything else?

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù a-dí-ni 2 TÚG ší-ma-sú i-ba-ší-ú
target: So, until now the 2 textiles agreed by him are (still) outstanding.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-kam a-lu-a ša-i-il₅ ša TÚG.ḪI.A ub-lá-ni ší-im 4 TÚG ša a-bi-A-nim ú ší-im ku-a-ú-tim
target: Ask Aluwa there, who brought the textiles, about the price of Abī-Anum's 4 textiles and that of yours.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma a-we-lu i-na sí-kà-tim wa-áš-bu i-na e-ra-bi-šu-nu lu <gap> lu SÍG-tim e-ba-<gap> ú-šé-ba-lá-kum
target: If the men are staying in the sikkātum, then when they arrive I shall send you both <gap> and the wool <gap>.

source: translate Akkadian to English: <gap> TÚG.ḪI-tí-kà 12 <gap> i-na ku-nu-uk <gap> be-lúm-ba-ni i-ba-ší-ú
target: of your 12 textiles <gap> are present under Bēlum-bāni's seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na TÚG.ḪI.A a-ni-ú-tim mì-ma a-mur-IŠTAR ú-lá il₅-qé
target: Amur-Ištar has not taken any of these textiles.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma i-ku-pì-a-ma a-na ib-ni-lí be-kà-a ú en-um-a-šur qí-bi₄-ma
target: From Ikūn-pīya to Ibnī-ilī, Bekaya and Ennam-Aššur; specifically to Ennam-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na en-um-a-šur qí-bi₄-ma 1.6666 ma-na 6 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ḫa-bu-lá-ku-um
target: I owe you 1.6666 mina 6 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša 1 ma-na 7 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ú 9 GÍN a-ḫa-ma ša-áp-ra-tim e-zi-ba-kum
target: I left surety worth 1 mina 7 shekels of silver plus 9 shekels with you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 8 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR lu da-at a-bu-a lu gám-ru-um ša a-na-kam
target: 8 shekels of silver was either Abuwa's fees or expenses here.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠU.NÍGIN 1.3333 ma-na 4 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR tal-qé
target: In all you have received 1 mina 24 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.3333 ma-na 2 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ší-tí KÙ.BABBAR-pì-kà
target: 22 shekels of silver was the rest of your silver;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša ḫa-bu-lá-ku-ni iš-tí a-šur-ba-ni ú-šé-ba-lá-kum
target: 2.5 minas of silver that I owe you I shall send with Aššur-bāni.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 GÚ AN.NA e-zi-ba-kum
target: I left 1 talent of copper with you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma ší-mu-um lá ša-im ší-ma-am ša ba-lá-ṭí-a lu TÚG tí-sà-pì ša ḫa-ḫi-im lu sà-áp-tí-ni-ma ša tal-ḫa-at a-ḫu-a a-tù-nu i ša-ḫa-at en-um-a-šur i-zi-za-ma
target: If the purchase has not been carried out, then make purchases profitable for me, either -textiles from hahhum or from Talhat - my dear brothers, assist Ennam-Aššur in this, seal it and send it to me with Aššur-bāni.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na en-um-a-šur qí-bi₄-ma šu-ma na-áš-pé-er-tum iš-tù a-lim ú-ub-lu-nim ša-il₅-ma šé-bi₄-lam
target: To Ennam-Aššur: Ask whether they have brought a missive from the City and send it.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a ma-lá na-áš-pè-er-tí-kà i-ri-šu-um i-na dur₄-ḫu-mì-it u₄-ma-am ú-ra-am a-da-gal
target: In accordance with your missive I expect Erišum in Durhumit today or tomorrow.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-lá-kam-ma a-ṣa-ba-sú
target: When he comes, I shall seize him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na {d}IM-ba-ni <gap> Ì-lí-iš-ta-ki-il₅ <gap> ù pí-la-aḫ-IŠTAR qí-bi-ma um-ma DAM.GÀR-um-ma
target: To Adad-bāni <gap>, Iliš-takil <gap> and Pilah-Ištar from the merchant:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 GÚ 35 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ni-is-ḫa-sú DIRI ša-du-a-sú ša-bu-ú pì-lá-aḫ-IŠTAR ù ú-zu-a na-áš-a-ku-nu-tí
target: Pilah-Ištar and Uzuwa bring you 1 talent 35 minas of silver, its import duty added, its transport tariff paid for.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫu-a a-tù-nu ú iḫ-da-ma AN.NA-kam da-am-qám wa-at-ra-am ma-ḫi-ir i-za-zu <gap> ú ba šu <gap> ša-a-ma šu-uq-lam-<gap> ú <gap> ta nu-ša-li-<gap> um <gap> ú <gap> KÙ.GI pá-ša-lam da-am-qám ša ba-ri-ni pì-lá-aḫ-IŠTAR na-áš-a-ku-nu-ti
target: My dear brothers, buy tin of extra-fine quality according to the market price and <gap> Pilah-Ištar brings you <gap> fine -gold belonging to us jointly.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫu-a a-tù-nu ú iḫ-da-ma KI pá-ni-im wa-ṣí-im lu-qú-ti áb-kà-nim
target: My dear brothers, dispatch my goods with the first leaving caravan.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú a-ḫa-ma 40 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am ša a-na šu-mì É a-bi₄-a a-na pì-lá-aḫ-IŠTAR áp-qí-id
target: Also, I further entrusted 40 minas of refined silver in the name of our father's house to Pilah-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI pu-šu-ki-in IGI ku-zi-zi-a IGI {d}IM-re-<gap>
target: Witnessed by Pūšu-kēn, by Kuziziya, by Adad-rē'ī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma en-nam-a-šur-ma a-na a-la-ḫi-im qí-bi-ma
target: From Ennam-Aššur to Ali-ahum:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam a-du um-me-a-an a-bi-ni a-we-lu-ú 2 ší-na im-ta-ag-ru-ni mì-ša-al KÙ.BABBAR ma-aḫ-ri-šu a-ša-kà-an-ma a-na a-lim{ki} ší-ni-šu i-lá-ak-ma KÙ.BABBAR-pí-šu-nu uš-ta-bu-ú
target: Here 2 men have reached an agreement with me concerning our father's investors, that I shall place half of the silver before him, and it will go twice to the City and they will satisfy themselves with their silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-du-um 3.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša i-na a-lim{ki} a-bu-ni i-ṣé-er ú-ṣur-ša-IŠTAR il₅-qé-ú a ší-a-tí kà-áb-sà-ni
target: Concerning 3.5 minas of silver that our father took on Uṣur-ša-Ištar's account in the City - for that we are pardoned.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-wa-tum i-ma-qú-ut-ma a-dí 5 u₄-me-e <gap> ú e-ma-ri iš-tí <gap> a-ṭá-ra-dam
target: The matter will fail, and within 5 days <gap> and I shall send the donkeys with <gap>

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú a-ta-ma a-ma-kam lu za-ku-a-tí
target: Then you too must be cleared there.

source: translate Akkadian to English: URUDU lá-mu-nam a-na SIG₅ ta-e-er
target: Convert bad copper to good.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-pu-tum ša ša-ni-ú-tim la ta-áš-ta-na-me-e
target: Urgent! Do not listen to others all the time.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-šu ša áš-ta-na-me-ú-ma a-wa-at a-ḫi-ú-tim ta-áš-ta-na-me-ú
target: Why is it that I keep hearing that you always listen to what strangers say?

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-pu-tum la ta-ša-lá-at
target: Urgent! Do not act rashly.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 kà-sà-tum ù tù-dí-na-tum šu-qú-ul-ta-áš-na 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ku-nu-ku-a a-ḫa-ma 0.3333 ma-na 6 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ku-nu-ku-a-ma ik-ri-bu ša e-lá-ma
target: 3 cups and toggle pins, their weight in silver 1 mina, under my seals; separately 26 shekels of silver also under my seals, of Elamma.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 ṭup-pu-ú ša 2 ma-na 15 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša ḫu-bu-ul nu-a-im
target: 2 tablets of 2 minas 15 shekels of silver, being in the debt of the Anatolian.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ṭup-pu-um ša 1.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša ḫu-bu-ul na-ni-a
target: 1 tablet of 1.5 mina of silver, being the debt of Naniya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ṭup-pu-um ša 1 ma-na 6 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša ḫu-bu-ul bur-sú-en₆
target: 1 tablet of 1 mina and 6 shekels of silver, being the debt of Būr-Suen.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ṭup-pu-um ša 0.3333 ma-na 4 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša ḫu-bu-ul il₅-tap-pá
target: 1 tablet of 24 shekels of silver being the debt of Ilī-tappā.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a-na ir-ma-a-šùr a-na ší-a-ma-tim a-dí-in
target: 1 mina of silver (that) I gave to Ir'am-Aššur for making purchases.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a-na aḫ-ša-lim a-na ší-a-ma-tim a-dí-in
target: 1 mina of silver (that) I gave to Ah-šalim for making purchases.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 9 TÚG pí-ri-kà-ni ù 1 TÚG a-bar-ni-am a-na pí-lá-aḫ-IŠTAR a-na ší-a-ma-tim a-d-in
target: 9 textiles and 1 Abarnian one, (which) I gave to Pilah-Ištar for making purchases.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 ÌR-du ù 5 a-ma-tum ŠÀ.BA 1 am-tum i-a-an-tal-ga ša ì-lí-na DUMU.SAL a-šur-DU₁₀
target: 5 slaves and 5 slave-girls, of whom 1 slave-girl, named Iyantalga, is for Ilina, daughter of Aššur-ṭāb.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ma a-nim lá-ma-sà-tum DAM e-lá-ma té-zi-ib
target: All this, Lamassutum, the wife of Elamma, left behind.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IŠTAR-pá-li-il₅ en-na-sú-en₆ ù ma-ṣí-ì-lí ša ki-ma lá-ma-sà-tim a-na DUMU um-mì-a-nim ù ma-ri-ša i-pá-qí-du-ma a-na a-lim{ki} ú-bu-lu-ú-ma a ma-lá ší-ma-tí-šu-nu me-er-i-tí NIN.DIN
target: Ištar-pālil, Ennam-Suen and Maṣi-ilī, Lamassutum's representative(s), will entrust it to an affiliated trader and to her sons and they will bring it to the City and (there) my daughter, the priestess, and my sons will act in accordance with the testamentary dispositions applying to them.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na en-nam-a-šùr qí-bi-ma um-ma IŠTAR-ra-bi₄-at-ma
target: To Ennam-Aššur from Ištar-rabiʾat:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí KÙ.BABBAR-pí-kà ša ḫa-bu-lá-ku-ni DUMU a-ta li-ba-kà lá i-pá-ri-id
target: With respect to your silver that I owe you, my dear son, do not worry!

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-na-ku-ma ma-té-e ṣí-lá-{d}IM lá-mì-id
target: I said: When will Ṣill-Adad be informed?

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ta ṣí-lá-{d}IM u₄-mì-im ṣú-ḫa-ri ša i-šu-ú lá ṣú-ḫa-ru-kà
target: As for you - thinking of Ṣill-Adad - are not the servants I have to-day (also) your servants?

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí e-tí-i ḫa-ra-nim ṣú-ba-tí-a ú-za-kà-ma KÙ.BABBAR-áp-kà a ni-ir-tí-kà ú-qá-ra-áb
target: When the road (opens) I shall clear my textiles and have your silver delivered directly to your person.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam ki-a-am ša ki-ma ku-a-tí i-zi-zu-ma a-dí li-bi-kà lu-qú-tám ù e-ma-re-e qá-at-kà ša-ki-in
target: Here your representatives acted like this, so for as long as you wish your claim has been placed on the goods and the donkeys.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ṭup-pu-um ša be-lúm-ba-ni DUMU na-ra-am-ZU ù ší-na ṭup-pè ša DAM.GÀR ša É-tí-kà a-bi-a-nu-um e-zi-bu i-na a-lá-ak ṣú-ḫa-ri ṭup-pè lu-šé-tí-qú
target: As for the tablet concerning Bēlum-bāni son of Narām-Sīn and two tablets concerning customers, which Abī-Anum left in your house, when the servants arrive they will transport the tablets.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-a-am a-dí KÙ.BABBAR-pì-kà li-ba-kà lá i-pá-ri-id
target: As for mine - do not worry about your silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša-lim-a-šùr a-na a-mur-IŠTAR ú-ṭá-ḫi-ni-a-tí-ma um-ma ša-lim-a-šùr-ma mì-šu-um ší-im 10 TÚG ku-ta-ni ša kà-ru-um dur₄-ḫu-mì-it a-dí-nu tal-qé
target: Šalim-Aššur made us approach Amur-Ištar and Šalim-Aššur said: "Why have you taken the proceeds from 10 kutānu-textiles that I sold in the Durhumit colony?"

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-mur-IŠTAR-ma ke-na 4 GÚ URUDU lá-mu-na-am al-qé
target: Amur-Ištar said: "Yes, I have taken 4 talents of copper of poor quality."

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ša-lim-a-šùr-ma ú-lá a-kà-lá-ma ta-al-qé
target: Šalim-Aššur said: "I hold nothing, yet you have taken it."

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-mur-IŠTAR-ma a-ta-ba lu-qú-tí lá ta-aṣ-ba-at
target: Amur-Ištar said: "It is not you who have taken my merchandise?"

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ša-lim-a-šùr-ma mì-ma lu-qú-ut-kà ú-lá aṣ-ba-at
target: Šalim-Aššur answered: "I have taken none of your merchandise."

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-mur-IŠTAR-ma qá-i ÌR li-li-kam
target: Amur-Ištar then said: "Wait until the slave has come here."

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ša-lim-a-šùr-ma ma li-li-kam i-na pí-i ÌR-dí-kà-ma i-a-tí ta-a-ḫi-ta-ni lu qá-i
target: Šalim-Aššur said: "Sure, let him come. Then it will be me you can pressure on the basis of what your own slave says." "Do wait!"

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ša-lim-a-šùr-ma ù KÙ.BABBAR ša a-šu-mì i-dí-a-bi₄-im ša ta-al-qé-ú ṭup-pá-am ḫa-ar-ma-am ú-kà-lu lu a-ḫu-ra
target: Šalim-Aššur continued: "And for the silver that you have taken concerning Iddin-abum I hold the certified tablet. That remains."

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um kà-ni-iš i-dí-ni-a-tí-ma IGI GÍR ša a-šùr ší-bu-tí-ni ni-dí-in
target: The Kanesh colony gave us for these proceedings and we gave our testimony before Aššur's dagger.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI ú-ra-a IGI {d}MAR.TU-ba-ni bu-zu-ta-a tap-pá-i-ni
target: Witnessed by Uraya, by Amurrum-bāni; Buzutaya was our (absent) partner.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ša ki-ma a-šùr-i-mì-tí DUMU i-ku-pí-IŠTAR-ma a-šùr-i-mì-tí DUMU e-ta-a a-mur-a-šùr a-šùr-DU₁₀ i-lá-áš-ra-ni-ma a-na ša-lim-a-šùr-ma 1 GÚ AN.NA 10 TÚG ku-ta-ni ša a-šùr-i-mì-tí dí-ni-a-tí
target: The representatives of Aššur-imittī son of Ikūn-pī-Ištar, Aššur-imittī son of Etaya, Amur-Aššur, Aššur-ṭāb (and) Ilī-ašrannī said to Šalim-Aššur: Give us 1 talent of tin and 10 -textiles that belong to Aššur-imittī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma AN.NA ù ku-ta-ni i li-bi₄-kà iš-tí-tám a-na AN.NA 6 GÍN.TA ù ku-ta-ni-ma 15 GÍN.TA KÙ.BABBAR ta-ša-qal
target: If the tin and the remain in your possession, you must pay at the rate 6:1 for the tin and 15 shekels per in silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ša-lim-a-šùr-ma ù šu-ma a-na-ku i lu-qú-tí-a AN.NA ù ku-ta-ni i li-bi₄-šu áš-tí-tám a-na AN.NA-ki-a 6 GÍN.TA ù ku-ta-ni-a 15 GÍN.TA KÙ.BABBAR i-ša-qá-lam
target: Šalim-Aššur answered: "And what if I have tin and from my goods remaining in his possession? Will he pay me at the rate 6:1 for my tin and 15 shekels per in silver?"

source: translate Akkadian to English: na-áš-pé-er-tám ša a-lim{ki} ša i-ku-pí-IŠTAR ì-lí-dan ù a-ku-a ša lu-qú-tí-a i ku-nu-uk ša-lim-a-šùr a-šùr-i-mì-tí DUMU e-ta-a ù a-mur-a-šùr DUMU sú-kà-lí-a ik-nu-ku-ší-ma a-na a-<gap> pá-aq-da-at
target: They have sealed a missive from the City concerning Ikūn-pī-Ištar, Ilī-dan and Akuwa (and) about my goods with the seals of Šalim-Aššur, Aššur-imittī son of Etaya and Amur-Aššur son of Sukkalliya, and it has been entrusted to <gap>.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-ta-ta IGI a-šùr-ma-lik IGI en-na-nim
target: Witnessed by Atata, by Aššur-malik, by Ennānum.
